#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * sync-docs.mjs — v0.7.2
 * Réécrit les blocs `<!-- SUPPORT-SYNC:<clé>:start/end -->` de README.md et
 * SECURITY.md à partir de APP_VERSION (src/version.ts).
 *
 * Politique de support : seule la MINEURE COURANTE est supportée. Dès qu'une
 * nouvelle mineure sort (ex. 0.8.0), la mineure précédente (0.7) passe en fin
 * de support — comme 0.6 l'est depuis 0.7.0.
 *
 * Exécuté par .github/workflows/docs-sync.yml à chaque push sur main qui
 * touche src/version.ts ; le workflow commit & push si les docs changent.
 */
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';

const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');

const versionSrc = readFileSync(join(root, 'src/version.ts'), 'utf8');
const m = versionSrc.match(/APP_VERSION\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/);
if (!m) {
  console.error('sync-docs: APP_VERSION introuvable dans src/version.ts');
  process.exit(1);
}
const version = m[1]; // ex. 0.7.2-beta
const [major, minor] = version.split('-')[0].split('.').map(Number);
if (!Number.isFinite(major) || !Number.isFinite(minor)) {
  console.error(`sync-docs: version illisible (${version})`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const cur = `${major}.${minor}`;
const prev = minor > 0 ? `${major}.${minor - 1}` : `${major - 1}.9`;
const next = `${major}.${minor + 1}`;
const badge = version.replace(/-/g, '--'); // shields.io : - → --

let changed = false;

function replaceBlock(file, key, content) {
  const path = join(root, file);
  const src = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
  const start = `<!-- SUPPORT-SYNC:${key}:start -->`;
  const end = `<!-- SUPPORT-SYNC:${key}:end -->`;
  const i = src.indexOf(start);
  const j = src.indexOf(end);
  if (i < 0 || j < i || j < 0) {
    console.error(`sync-docs: bloc « ${key} » manquant/cassé dans ${file}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const out = `${src.slice(0, i + start.length)}\n${content}\n${src.slice(j)}`;
  if (out !== src) {
    writeFileSync(path, out);
    console.log(`sync-docs: ${file} — bloc « ${key} » mis à jour (${version})`);
    changed = true;
  } else {
    console.log(`sync-docs: ${file} — bloc « ${key} » déjà à jour`);
  }
}

replaceBlock(
  'README.md',
  'badge',
  `![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-${badge}-blue)`,
);

replaceBlock(
  'README.md',
  'support',
  `Version actuelle : **${version}** (gelée jusqu'au prochain ordre de push).

> **Politique de support** : seule la mineure courante (**${cur}**) reçoit correctifs et mises à jour de sécurité. Dès la sortie de la mineure suivante (ex. ${next}.0), la mineure précédente passe immédiatement en fin de support — ${prev}.x l'est depuis ${cur}.0. Les versions ${prev}.x et antérieures ne sont plus supportées.`,
);

replaceBlock(
  'SECURITY.md',
  'supported',
  `| Version        | Supported          |
| -------------- | ------------------ |
| ${cur}.x (beta)   | :white_check_mark: |
| ${prev}.x and older| :x:                |
| 1.0.0 (future) | :white_check_mark: at release |

**Policy:** only the current minor (**${cur}**) is supported. When the next minor
ships (e.g. ${next}.0), the previous minor reaches end of support immediately —
${prev}.x ended with the ${cur}.0 release. Only the latest beta on \`main\` receives
security updates. Production runs the Cloudflare Worker build of \`main\`;
previews run per-branch sandboxes.`,
);

console.log(changed ? 'sync-docs: docs modifiées' : 'sync-docs: rien à changer');

import { getCachedFingerprint } from './fingerprint';
import { getApiBase } from './config';

const TOKEN_KEY = 'stock_auth_token';
const SESSION_IP_KEY = 'stock_session_ip';
const ROLE_KEY = 'stock_role';
const USER_KEY = 'stock_auth_user';
const DISPLAY_NAME_KEY = 'stock_display_name';

// Avatar URL lives in memory only (never in DOM storage): it is refreshed
// from the API via setProfileCache(), so no DOM-storage text can ever flow
// into an <img> src (CodeQL js/dom-text-reinterpreted-as-html).
let memoryAvatarUrl = '';

export function sanitizeAvatarUrl(raw: string | null | undefined): string {
  const value = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (!value) return '';

  // Allow common safe image data URLs produced by client-side crop/upload flow.
  if (/^data:image\/(?:png|jpe?g|webp|gif);base64,[a-z0-9+/=]+$/i.test(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  // Server-side default monogram avatars are URL-encoded SVG data URIs —
  // safe in <img> context (no script execution), so let them through.
  if (/^data:image\/svg\+xml;(?:charset=utf-8,|base64,)/i.test(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  const isAllowedImagePath = (path: string): boolean => {
    return /\.(?:png|jpe?g|webp|gif|avif|svg)$/i.test(path);
  };

  // Allow same-origin relative image paths only.
  if (value.startsWith('/') || value.startsWith('./') || value.startsWith('../')) {
    if (/[<>"'`\\\s]/.test(value)) return '';
    const cleanPath = value.split('#')[0].split('?')[0];
    if (!isAllowedImagePath(cleanPath)) return '';
    return value;
  }

  // Allow only http(s) absolute image URLs.
  try {
    const u = new URL(value);
    if (u.protocol !== 'http:' && u.protocol !== 'https:') return '';
    if (u.username || u.password) return '';
    if (!isAllowedImagePath(u.pathname)) return '';
    return u.toString();
  } catch {
    // Invalid URL -> reject.
  }

  return '';
}

export function getToken(): string | null {
  return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
}

export function setToken(token: string, ip?: string, username?: string, role?: string) {
  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
  if (ip) localStorage.setItem(SESSION_IP_KEY, ip);
  if (username) localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, username);
  if (role) localStorage.setItem(ROLE_KEY, role);
  // v0.7.5 — switch de comptes façon app Android : chaque session réussie est
  // conservée (token + profil) pour pouvoir basculer sans se re-authentifier.
  if (username && token) upsertSavedAccount({ username, role, token });
}

};
export function listSavedAccounts(): SavedAccount[] {
  try {

    return Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.filter((a) => a && a.token && a.username) : [];
  } catch { return []; }
}
export function upsertSavedAccount(a: { username: string; role?: string; token: string }) {
  try {
    const u = String(a.username).trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = listSavedAccounts().filter((x) => x.username.toLowerCase() !== u);
    list.unshift({
      username: u,
      role: a.role || localStorage.getItem(ROLE_KEY) || 'user',
      display_name: localStorage.getItem(DISPLAY_NAME_KEY) || u,
      avatar_url: memoryAvatarUrl || '',

}
export function removeSavedAccount(username: string) {

    localStorage.setItem(ACCOUNTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(listSavedAccounts().filter((x) => x.username.toLowerCase() !== u)));

}
export function switchSavedAccount(username: string): boolean {

  if (!e) return false;

 * (blob:), plain base64 image data URLs, or whitelisted http(s) images.

export function sanitizePreviewUrl(raw: string | null | undefined): string {
  const value = String(raw || '').trim();

  // (blob:<scheme>://<host>/<uuid>): character classes that cannot match any

  // (js/dom-text-reinterpreted-as-html).
  if (/^blob:https?:\/\/[A-Za-z0-9.:-]+\/[A-Za-z0-9-]+$/i.test(value)) return value;

/**

 * Only plain base64 image data URLs pass; anything else becomes ''.
 * CodeQL: validated values stop the DOM-text -> HTML-sink taint flow.

export function sanitizeImageDataUrl(raw: string | null | undefined): string {
  const value = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (/^data:image\/(?:png|jpe?g|webp|gif);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/.test(value)) return value;
  return '';
}

/**
 * Whether a sanitized avatar URL is cached. Returns a plain boolean on
 * purpose: callers branch on it without ever carrying the URL text into
 * markup (see AvatarImage, which assigns src imperatively).

export function hasAvatarUrl(): boolean {
  return getAvatarUrl() !== '';

/** Cache profile fields used in sidebar / phone avatar (local only). */
export function setProfileCache(partial: {
  display_name?: string | null;
  avatar_url?: string | null;
  username?: string | null;
  role?: string | null;
}) {
  if (partial.display_name != null) {
    localStorage.setItem(DISPLAY_NAME_KEY, String(partial.display_name).trim());
  }
  if (partial.avatar_url != null) {
    memoryAvatarUrl = sanitizeAvatarUrl(partial.avatar_url);
    // Lets the avatar blob cache drop stale entries + prefetch the new one
    // without auth.ts importing it (no cycle).
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('atlas-avatar-changed')); } catch { /* */ }
  }
  if (partial.username) localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, String(partial.username));
  if (partial.role) localStorage.setItem(ROLE_KEY, String(partial.role));
  // Shells re-render as soon as the profile lands (refresh: avatar shows
  // without waiting for any click).
  try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('atlas-profile-changed')); } catch { /* */ }
}

export function getDisplayInitials(): string {
  const name = (getDisplayName() || getUsername() || '').trim();
  if (!name) return 'A';
  const parts = name.split(/[\s._-]+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length >= 2) return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
  // Single token: use first letter only for long labels (e.g. "Administrateur" → "A" not "AD")
  if (parts[0].length > 3) return parts[0][0].toUpperCase();
  return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}

export function clearToken() {
  localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(SESSION_IP_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(ROLE_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(DISPLAY_NAME_KEY);

export function startSessionGuard(): () => void {
  let stopped = false;

  const check = async () => {
    if (stopped) return;
    const token = getToken();
    if (!token) return;
    try {
      const fp = await Promise.race([

        new Promise<string>((r) => setTimeout(() => r('none'), 2500)),

      const res = await fetch(`${getApiBase()}/api/auth/me`, {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,

      });
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (res.status === 401) {
        clearToken();
        const code = data.code || 'UNAUTHORIZED';
        if (!window.location.pathname.includes('/login')) {
          window.location.href = '/login?reason=' + encodeURIComponent(code);
        }
      } else {
        const m = data?.data || data || {};
        // v0.7.7 — le refresh /me doit AUSSI rafraîchir l'UI : on compare avant/après
        // et on passe par setProfileCache (dispatch atlas-profile-changed + avatar)
        // pour que la topbar / le menu compte affichent les vraies données.
        const prevU = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY) || '';
        const prevR = localStorage.getItem(ROLE_KEY) || '';
        const prevN = localStorage.getItem(DISPLAY_NAME_KEY) || '';
        const prevA = memoryAvatarUrl || '';
        const nextU = m.username ? String(m.username) : prevU;
        const nextR = m.role ? String(m.role) : prevR;
        const nextN = m.display_name != null ? String(m.display_name) : prevN;
        const nextA = m.avatar_url != null ? sanitizeAvatarUrl(m.avatar_url) : prevA;
        if (prevU !== nextU || prevR !== nextR || prevN !== nextN || prevA !== nextA) {
          setProfileCache({
            username: nextU || null,
            role: nextR || null,
            display_name: nextN,
            avatar_url: nextA,
          });
        }
      }
    } catch {
      /* ignore network */
    }
  };

  check();
  const interval = window.setInterval(check, 20_000);
  const onFocus = () => check();
  window.addEventListener('focus', onFocus);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') check();
  });

  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    window.clearInterval(interval);
    window.removeEventListener('focus', onFocus);
  };
}

/**
 * Runtime config for web + Capacitor (Android / iOS).
 *
 * On the phone, the WebView origin is https://localhost — relative /api calls
 * never reach Cloudflare. We force the production Worker URL on native.
 *
 * Override at build time: VITE_API_URL=https://your-worker.example.com
 */
const DEFAULT_API = 'https://stock.afmarbre.com';

function readEnvApi(): string {
  try {
    const v = (import.meta as any)?.env?.VITE_API_URL;
    if (v && typeof v === 'string' && v.startsWith('http')) return v.replace(/\/$/, '');
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  return '';
}

/** True when running inside Capacitor native shell */
export function isNativeApp(): boolean {
  try {
    const w = window as any;
    if (w.Capacitor?.isNativePlatform?.()) return true;
    if (w.Capacitor?.getPlatform?.() === 'android' || w.Capacitor?.getPlatform?.() === 'ios') return true;
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  // Fallback: Capacitor androidScheme loads as https://localhost
  try {
    const h = window.location.hostname;
    if (h === 'localhost' && window.location.protocol === 'https:') return true;
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  return false;
}

/**
 * API origin (no trailing slash).
 * - Web (same Worker): '' → relative paths
 * - Native APK/IPA: absolute Worker URL
 */
export function getApiBase(): string {
  const env = readEnvApi();
  if (env) return env;
  if (isNativeApp()) return DEFAULT_API;
  // Browser on production domain — same origin
  try {
    const host = window.location.hostname;
    if (host && host !== 'localhost' && host !== '127.0.0.1') return '';
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  // Local vite dev → hit production API (or set VITE_API_URL)
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && /localhost|127\.0\.0\.1/.test(window.location.hostname)) {
    return DEFAULT_API;
  }
  return '';
}

export const APP_TAGLINE = 'Stock · Caisse · Facturation';

/**
 * Device fingerprint + WebAuthn (platform biometrics & hardware security keys).
 * Browsers cannot expose MAC address — install ID + fingerprint is the stable equivalent.
 */

const FP_KEY = 'stock_device_fp';
const INSTALL_KEY = 'stock_install_id';
const BIO_CRED_KEY = 'stock_bio_credential_id';

function getOrCreateInstallId(): string {
  try {
    let id = localStorage.getItem(INSTALL_KEY);
    if (id && id.length >= 16) return id;
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(16);
    crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
    id = Array.from(bytes)
      .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
      .join('');
    localStorage.setItem(INSTALL_KEY, id);
    return id;
  } catch {
    return 'no-install-id';
  }
}

async function sha256Hex(input: string): Promise<string> {
  if (crypto?.subtle) {
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(input));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf))
      .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
      .join('');
  }
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) h = (Math.imul(31, h) + input.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
  return 'fb' + Math.abs(h).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function canvasFingerprint(): string {
  try {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = 200;
    c.height = 50;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return '';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.font = '14px "Arial"';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f60';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 200, 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#069';
    ctx.fillText('AtlasCommerce·fp', 4, 12);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(120, 25, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    return c.toDataURL().slice(-96);
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

function webglFingerprint(): string {
  try {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    const gl =
      (c.getContext('webgl') as WebGLRenderingContext | null) ||
      (c.getContext('experimental-webgl') as WebGLRenderingContext | null);
    if (!gl) return '';
    const dbg = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');
    const vendor = dbg ? String(gl.getParameter(dbg.UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL) || '') : '';
    const renderer = dbg ? String(gl.getParameter(dbg.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL) || '') : '';
    return `${vendor}|${renderer}`;
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

export async function getDeviceFingerprint(): Promise<string> {
  const installId = getOrCreateInstallId();
  const parts = [
    installId,
    navigator.userAgent,
    navigator.language,
    (navigator.languages || []).join(','),
    String(screen.width),
    String(screen.height),
    String(screen.colorDepth),
    String(window.devicePixelRatio || 1),
    String(new Date().getTimezoneOffset()),
    Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || '',
    String(navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 0),
    String((navigator as any).deviceMemory || 0),
    navigator.platform || '',
    String(navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0),
    canvasFingerprint(),
    webglFingerprint(),
  ];
  const hash = await sha256Hex(parts.join('||'));
  return hash.slice(0, 64);
}

export async function getCachedFingerprint(): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem(FP_KEY);
    if (cached && cached.length >= 16) return cached;
  } catch { /* private mode */ }
  const fp = await getDeviceFingerprint();
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(FP_KEY, fp);
    sessionStorage.setItem(FP_KEY, fp);
  } catch {
    try { sessionStorage.setItem(FP_KEY, fp); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  return fp;
}


/** Human-readable device name for passkey labels (Windows / macOS / iPhone / Android browser). */
export function getDeviceLabel(): string {
  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
  const plat = navigator.platform || '';
  // iPhone / iPad
  if (/iPhone/i.test(ua)) {
    const m = ua.match(/OS (\d+)[._](\d+)/);
    const ver = m ? `${m[1]}.${m[2]}` : '';
    return ver ? `iPhone · iOS ${ver}` : 'iPhone · iOS';
  }
  if (/iPad/i.test(ua)) {
    const m = ua.match(/OS (\d+)[._](\d+)/);
    const ver = m ? `${m[1]}.${m[2]}` : '';
    return ver ? `iPad · iPadOS ${ver}` : 'iPad · iPadOS';
  }
  // Android browser
  if (/Android/i.test(ua)) {
    const v = ua.match(/Android (\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
    const model = ua.match(/;\s*([^;)]+)\s*Build\//);
    const name = model ? model[1].trim() : 'Android';
    return v ? `${name} · Android ${v[1]}` : `${name} · Android`;
  }
  // Windows
  if (/Windows NT 10\.0/i.test(ua)) {
    // Win 11 often still reports NT 10.0 — refine via userAgentData if available
    const uaData = (navigator as any).userAgentData;
    const isWin11 = uaData?.platform === 'Windows' && uaData?.getHighEntropyValues;
    return 'PC Windows · Windows 10/11';
  }
  if (/Windows NT 6\.3/i.test(ua)) return 'PC Windows · Windows 8.1';
  if (/Windows NT 6\.1/i.test(ua)) return 'PC Windows · Windows 7';
  if (/Windows/i.test(ua)) return 'PC Windows';
  // macOS
  if (/Mac OS X/i.test(ua) || /Macintosh/i.test(plat)) {
    const m = ua.match(/Mac OS X (\d+[._]\d+(?:[._]\d+)?)/);
    const ver = m ? m[1].replace(/_/g, '.') : '';
    return ver ? `Mac · macOS ${ver}` : 'Mac · macOS';
  }
  // Linux
  if (/Linux/i.test(ua)) return 'PC Linux';
  return plat || 'Navigateur web';
}

export function getDeviceMeta(): Record<string, string> {
  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
  return {
    platform: 'web',
    user_agent: ua.slice(0, 240),
    language: navigator.language || '',
    screen: `${screen.width}x${screen.height}`,
    timezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || '',
    label: getDeviceLabel(),
  };
}

/* ─── WebAuthn helpers ─── */

function b64urlToBuf(s: string): ArrayBuffer {
  const pad = '='.repeat((4 - (s.length % 4)) % 4);
  const b64 = (s + pad).replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
  const raw = atob(b64);
  const arr = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) arr[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
  return arr.buffer;
}

function bufToB64url(buf: ArrayBuffer): string {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) s += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  return btoa(s).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}

/** Encode challenge string (base64url) to ArrayBuffer for WebAuthn API */
function challengeToBuffer(challenge: string): ArrayBuffer {
  // Server sends base64url challenge
  try {
    return b64urlToBuf(challenge);
  } catch {
    return new TextEncoder().encode(challenge).buffer;
  }
}

export function isWebAuthnAvailable(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && !!window.PublicKeyCredential;
}

export async function isBiometricAvailable(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!isWebAuthnAvailable()) return false;
  try {
    if (typeof (PublicKeyCredential as any).isUserVerifyingPlatformAuthenticatorAvailable === 'function') {
      return await (PublicKeyCredential as any).isUserVerifyingPlatformAuthenticatorAvailable();
    }
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  return true;
}

export async function isSecurityKeyLikelyAvailable(): Promise<boolean> {
  return isWebAuthnAvailable();
}

/**
 * Register platform biometric OR cross-platform security key.
 * deviceType: 'platform' | 'cross-platform'
 */
export async function registerWebAuthn(
  options: any,
  deviceType: 'platform' | 'cross-platform' = 'platform',
): Promise<{ credentialId: string; challenge: string; transports?: string[] }> {
  if (!isWebAuthnAvailable()) throw new Error('WebAuthn non disponible sur cet appareil.');

  const publicKey: PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions = {
    challenge: challengeToBuffer(options.challenge),
    rp: options.rp,
    user: {
      id: new TextEncoder().encode(String(options.user.id)),
      name: options.user.name,
      displayName: options.user.displayName,
    },
    pubKeyCredParams: options.pubKeyCredParams,
    authenticatorSelection: {
      authenticatorAttachment: deviceType,
      userVerification: options.authenticatorSelection?.userVerification || 'preferred',
      residentKey: options.authenticatorSelection?.residentKey || 'preferred',
    },
    timeout: options.timeout || 120000,
    attestation: 'none',
    excludeCredentials: (options.excludeCredentials || []).map((c: any) => ({
      type: 'public-key' as const,
      id: b64urlToBuf(c.id),
    })),
  };

  const cred = (await navigator.credentials.create({ publicKey })) as PublicKeyCredential | null;
  if (!cred) throw new Error('Enregistrement annulé.');

  const att = cred.response as AuthenticatorAttestationResponse;
  const transports = (att as any).getTransports?.() as string[] | undefined;

  try {
    // Persist WebAuthn user id (base64url of user.id bytes) for signalAllAcceptedCredentials
    const uidBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(String(options.user?.id || ''));
    let bin = '';
    uidBytes.forEach((b) => { bin += String.fromCharCode(b); });
    const b64 = btoa(bin).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
    localStorage.setItem('atlas_webauthn_user_id', b64);
  } catch { /* */ }

  return {
    credentialId: bufToB64url(cred.rawId),
    challenge: options.challenge,
    transports,
  };
}

/** Authenticate with any registered credential (biometric or security key) */
export async function authenticateWebAuthn(options: any): Promise<{ credentialId: string; challenge: string }> {
  if (!isWebAuthnAvailable()) throw new Error('WebAuthn non disponible sur cet appareil.');

  const publicKey: PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions = {
    challenge: challengeToBuffer(options.challenge),
    timeout: options.timeout || 120000,
    userVerification: options.userVerification || 'preferred',
    rpId: options.rpId,
    allowCredentials: (options.allowCredentials || []).map((c: any) => ({
      type: 'public-key' as const,
      id: b64urlToBuf(c.id),
      transports: c.transports,
    })),
  };

  const assertion = (await navigator.credentials.get({ publicKey })) as PublicKeyCredential | null;
  if (!assertion) throw new Error('Authentification annulée.');

  return {
    credentialId: bufToB64url(assertion.rawId),
    challenge: options.challenge,
  };
}

export function getStoredBiometricCredentialId(): string | null {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(BIO_CRED_KEY);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function setStoredBiometricCredentialId(id: string | null) {
  try {
    if (id) localStorage.setItem(BIO_CRED_KEY, id);
    else localStorage.removeItem(BIO_CRED_KEY);
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
}


/** base64url id variants for browser signal APIs */
function credIdVariants(raw: string): string[] {
  const id = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (!id) return [];
  const set = new Set<string>([id]);
  set.add(id.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/'));
  set.add(id.replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_'));
  // oxlint-disable-next-line unicorn/no-useless-spread -- snapshot on purpose: variants are ADDED to the set during the loop
  for (const v of [...set]) {
    set.add(v.replace(/=+$/, ''));
    if (v.length % 4) set.add(v + '='.repeat((4 - (v.length % 4)) % 4));
  }
  return [...set];
}

/**
 * Clear local storage + ask the browser/OS to drop the passkey when supported
 * (WebAuthn Level 3 signalUnknownCredential / signalAllAcceptedCredentials).
 * Not all devices honor this — user may still need OS password settings.
 */
export async function removePasskeyLocally(
  credentialId: string | null | undefined,
  remainingAcceptedIds?: string[],
): Promise<{ signaled: boolean; method: string }> {
  const id = credentialId || getStoredBiometricCredentialId();
  if (id && getStoredBiometricCredentialId() === id) {
    setStoredBiometricCredentialId(null);
  } else if (!credentialId) {
    setStoredBiometricCredentialId(null);
  }
  // Always clear local marker for this id
  try {
    if (id && getStoredBiometricCredentialId() === id) setStoredBiometricCredentialId(null);
  } catch { /* */ }

  const PK = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window as any).PublicKeyCredential : null;
  if (!PK || !id) return { signaled: false, method: 'local-only' };

  const rpCandidates = Array.from(
    new Set(
      [
        window.location.hostname,
        window.location.hostname.replace(/^www\./, ''),
        // eTLD+1 heuristic: last two labels when possible
        (() => {
          const p = window.location.hostname.split('.');
          return p.length >= 2 ? p.slice(-2).join('.') : window.location.hostname;
        })(),
      ].filter(Boolean),
    ),
  );

  let signaled = false;
  let method = 'none';

  // 1) signalUnknownCredential — mark this credential invalid for the RP
  if (typeof PK.signalUnknownCredential === 'function') {
    for (const rpId of rpCandidates) {
      for (const cred of credIdVariants(id)) {
        try {
          await PK.signalUnknownCredential({ rpId, credentialId: cred });
          signaled = true;
          method = 'signalUnknownCredential';
          break;
        } catch {
          /* try next */
        }
      }
      if (signaled) break;
    }
  }

  // 2) signalAllAcceptedCredentials — remaining keys only (drops removed from autofill)
  if (typeof PK.signalAllAcceptedCredentials === 'function' && Array.isArray(remainingAcceptedIds)) {
    const userId = localStorage.getItem('atlas_webauthn_user_id') || '';
    for (const rpId of rpCandidates) {
      try {
        const payload: any = {
          rpId,
          allAcceptedCredentialIds: remainingAcceptedIds.filter((x) => x && x !== id),
        };
        if (userId) payload.userId = userId;
        await PK.signalAllAcceptedCredentials(payload);
        signaled = true;
        method = method === 'none' ? 'signalAllAcceptedCredentials' : method + '+allAccepted';
        break;
      } catch {
        /* try next rp */
      }
    }
  }

  return { signaled, method };
}

// v0.7 — splash (logo + loader) fades out as soon as the React shell lands
(function hideSplashWhenReady() {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  const splash = document.getElementById('splash');
  const rootEl = document.getElementById('root');
  if (!splash || !rootEl) return;
  let done = false;
  const t0 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : 0;
  const hide = () => {
    if (done) return;
    done = true;
    // Reste visible au moins 450 ms : pas de flash splash→shell ni de
    // disparition avant le premier paint réel (glitch ressenti).
    const wait = Math.max(0, 450 - ((typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : 0) - t0));
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(() =>
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          splash.classList.add('sp-hide');
          window.setTimeout(() => splash.remove(), 340);
        }),
      );
    }, wait);
  };
  if (rootEl.children.length) {
    hide();
    return;
  }
  const mo = new MutationObserver(() => {
    if (rootEl.children.length) {
      mo.disconnect();
      hide();
    }
  });
  mo.observe(rootEl, { childList: true });
  // Safety net: never trap the user behind the splash
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    mo.disconnect();
    hide();
  }, 15000);
})();

// Offline PWA: cache shell + GET /api/* for hors-ligne scan / catalogue
if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'serviceWorker' in navigator) {
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js?v=12').then((reg) => {
      // Prefer fresh worker after deploy
      if (reg.waiting) reg.waiting.postMessage({ type: 'SKIP_WAITING' });
      reg.addEventListener('updatefound', () => {
        const nw = reg.installing;
        if (!nw) return;
        nw.addEventListener('statechange', () => {
          if (nw.state === 'installed' && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
            nw.postMessage({ type: 'SKIP_WAITING' });
          }
        });
      });
    }).catch(() => {});
    // v0.7 — when a fresher worker takes control, reload ONCE so the open tab
    // never keeps rendering the previous bundle after a deploy.
    navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('controllerchange', () => {
      try {
        if (sessionStorage.getItem('atlas-sw-reload')) return;
        sessionStorage.setItem('atlas-sw-reload', '1');
        window.location.reload();
      } catch { /* */ }
    });
  });
}

/**
 * v0.7.4 — petit contrat de thème partagé entre l'app (useTheme dans App.tsx)
 * et les pages publiques (nav pill des landings). Même clé localStorage
 * (« atlas-theme ») et même événement de synchronisation
 * (« atlas-theme-change ») : un changement depuis n'importe quel composant
 * est repris partout, y compris le choix « système ».
 */

export type ThemeChoice = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';

const KEY = 'atlas-theme';
export const THEME_EVENT = 'atlas-theme-change';

export function getTheme(): ThemeChoice {
  try {
    const v = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    return v === 'light' || v === 'dark' || v === 'system' ? v : 'system';
  } catch {
    return 'system';
  }
}

export function setTheme(v: ThemeChoice): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, v);
  } catch { /* navigation privée : le choix reste en mémoire */ }
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(THEME_EVENT));
}

/** Thème réellement affiché (le mode « système » suit prefers-color-scheme). */
export function getResolvedTheme(): 'light' | 'dark' {
  const t = getTheme();
  if (t !== 'system') return t;
  try {
    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
  } catch {
    return 'dark';
  }
}

export function subscribeTheme(cb: (t: ThemeChoice) => void): () => void {
  const fn = () => cb(getTheme());
  window.addEventListener(THEME_EVENT, fn);
  window.addEventListener('storage', fn);
  let mq: MediaQueryList | null = null;
  try {
    mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    mq.addEventListener('change', fn);
  } catch { /* anciens navigateurs */ }
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener(THEME_EVENT, fn);
    window.removeEventListener('storage', fn);
    try { mq?.removeEventListener('change', fn); } catch { /* */ }
  };
}

export const RELEASE_VISIBLE_CAP = '0.8.0';

/** true si `v` (ex. « 0.7.2 », « 0.7.6-beta ») est ≤ `cap` en semver simplifié. */
export function semverAtMost(v: string, cap: string): boolean {
  const parse = (x: string): number[] =>
    (x.match(/(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)/) || []).slice(1, 4).map(Number);
  const a = parse(v);
  const b = parse(cap);
  if (a.length < 3 || b.length < 3) return true;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
    if (a[i] !== b[i]) return a[i] < b[i];
  }
  return true;
}

    saveDesktopApproval({ ...context, origin: 'https://another-server.example' });
    expect(desktopLoginReturn()).toBeNull();
    saveDesktopApproval({ ...context, expiresAt: Date.now() - 1 });
    expect(desktopLoginReturn()).toBeNull();
    clearDesktopApproval();
  });

  it('already logged in: only prepares; account/server/code and explicit buttons appear', async () => {
    await render();
    expect(calls.map(c => c.path)).toEqual(['/api/auth/desktop/v1/prepare']);
    expect(host.textContent).toContain('alice');
    expect(host.textContent).toContain(ORIGIN);
    expect(host.textContent).toContain('ABCD-EFGH');
    expect(button('Autoriser ce desktop').disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(button('Refuser').disabled).toBe(false);
    expect(window.location.hash).toBe('');
    expect(sessionStorage.getItem(DESKTOP_APPROVAL_KEY)).not.toContain(session.token);
  });

  it('preserves the request across logged-out → existing login/OTP → explicit consent', async () => {
    session.token = '';
    await render();
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(loadDesktopApproval()?.request_id).toBe(ID);
    await act(async () => button('Retour après connexion web et OTP').click());
    expect(calls.map(c => c.path)).toEqual(['/api/auth/desktop/v1/prepare']);
    expect(calls[0].body).toMatchObject({ request_id: ID, state: STATE, origin: ORIGIN });
    expect(host.textContent).toContain('Autoriser le desktop');
    expect(button('Autoriser ce desktop').disabled).toBe(true);
  });

  it('cannot approve until comparison is checked and the approval button is clicked', async () => {
    await render();
    await act(async () => button('Autoriser ce desktop').click());
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
    await act(async () => (host.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]') as HTMLInputElement).click());
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(button('Autoriser ce desktop').disabled).toBe(false);
    await act(async () => button('Autoriser ce desktop').click());
    expect(calls[1].path).toBe('/api/auth/desktop/v1/authorize');
    expect(calls[1].body).toMatchObject({ decision: 'approve', csrf_token: 'n'.repeat(64), request_id: ID, state: STATE, origin: ORIGIN });
    expect(sessionStorage.getItem(DESKTOP_APPROVAL_KEY)).toBeNull();
    expect(host.textContent).toContain('Revenez dans l’application desktop');
  });

  it('refusal requires a separate click, without comparison or auto-authorization', async () => {
    await render();
    await act(async () => button('Refuser').click());
    expect(calls[1].body.decision).toBe('deny');
    expect(host.textContent).toContain('Connexion refusée');
    expect(sessionStorage.getItem(DESKTOP_APPROVAL_KEY)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('uses same-origin, no-store, no-referrer fetch with redirects forbidden', async () => {
    await render();
    expect(calls[0].path).toBe('/api/auth/desktop/v1/prepare');
    expect(calls[0].init).toMatchObject({ redirect: 'error', cache: 'no-store', referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer', credentials: 'same-origin' });
    expect(calls[0].body).not.toHaveProperty('token');
    expect(calls[0].body).not.toHaveProperty('code_verifier');
  });

  it('rejects callback/query substitution without sending a request', async () => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, '', `/login/desktop?callback=https://evil.example${HASH}`);
    await render();
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(host.textContent).toContain('Demande invalide');
    expect(loadDesktopApproval()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('ignores a forged callback fragment instead of adopting its alleged session token', async () => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/login/desktop#access_token=forged-session&state=forged');
    await render();
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(session.token).toBe('browser-session-private');
    expect(loadDesktopApproval()).toBeNull();
    expect(host.textContent).not.toContain('forged-session');
  });

  it('never renders or logs untrusted server error bodies or session tokens', async () => {
    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
    const error = vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
    vi.mocked(fetch).mockResolvedValueOnce(Response.json({ success: false, code: 'UNAVAILABLE', error: 'secret-from-upstream browser-session-private' }, { status: 503 }));
    await render();
    expect(host.textContent).not.toContain('secret-from-upstream');
    expect(host.textContent).not.toContain(session.token);
    expect(JSON.stringify([warn.mock.calls, error.mock.calls])).not.toContain('secret-from-upstream');
    expect(host.querySelector('button')).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { createElement } from 'react';
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
import { WelcomePreview } from '../components/WelcomePreview';
import {
  WELCOME_PREVIEWS, WELCOME_PREVIEW_START, WELCOME_FEATURES_STEP,
  WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP, WELCOME_FINAL_STEP, WELCOME_STEP_COUNT,
  WELCOME_STEP_KEY, getWelcomeStep, setWelcomeStep, resetWelcome,
  markWelcomeCompleted, isWelcomeCompleted,
} from '../lib/welcome';

beforeEach(() => {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  vi.stubGlobal('localStorage', {
    getItem: (key: string) => values.get(key) ?? null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => values.set(key, value),
    removeItem: (key: string) => values.delete(key),
  });
});
afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());

describe('welcome capture steps', () => {
  it('gives each of the seven captures its own screen before overview and comparison', () => {
    expect(WELCOME_PREVIEWS).toHaveLength(7);
    expect(new Set(WELCOME_PREVIEWS.map((p) => p.src)).size).toBe(7);
    expect(WELCOME_FEATURES_STEP).toBe(WELCOME_PREVIEW_START + WELCOME_PREVIEWS.length);
    expect(WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP).toBe(WELCOME_FEATURES_STEP + 1);
    expect(WELCOME_FINAL_STEP).toBe(WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP + 1);
    expect(WELCOME_STEP_COUNT).toBe(WELCOME_FINAL_STEP + 1);
  });

  it('renders only the current capture with a title, progress and previous/next controls', () => {
    for (let index = 0; index < WELCOME_PREVIEWS.length; index++) {
      const html = renderToStaticMarkup(createElement(WelcomePreview, { index, onPrevious() {}, onNext() {} }));
      expect((html.match(/<img /g) || []).length).toBe(1);
      expect(html).toContain(`src="${WELCOME_PREVIEWS[index].src}"`);
      expect(html).toContain(`Aperçu ${index + 1} sur 7`);
      expect(html).toContain('Précédent');
      expect(html).toContain('Suivant');
      expect(html).toContain('aria-labelledby="welcome-preview-title"');
      for (const other of WELCOME_PREVIEWS.filter((_, i) => i !== index)) {
        expect(html).not.toContain(`src="${other.src}"`);
      }
    }
  });

  it('has a still-image alternative for the demo when reduced motion is requested', () => {
    const html = renderToStaticMarkup(createElement(WelcomePreview, { index: 0, onPrevious() {}, onNext() {} }));
    expect(html).toContain('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    expect(html).toContain('srcSet="/shots/devis-modal-dark.png"');
  });

  it('persists each new step including the inserted previews across refreshes', () => {
    for (let step = 0; step < WELCOME_STEP_COUNT; step++) {
      setWelcomeStep(step);
      expect(getWelcomeStep()).toBe(step);
    }
    setWelcomeStep(999);
    expect(getWelcomeStep()).toBe(WELCOME_FINAL_STEP);
    setWelcomeStep(-5);
    expect(getWelcomeStep()).toBe(0);
  });

  it('migrates old comparison and final indices without losing their place', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_STEP_KEY, '3');
    expect(getWelcomeStep()).toBe(WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP);
    localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_STEP_KEY, '4');
    expect(getWelcomeStep()).toBe(WELCOME_FINAL_STEP);
    localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_STEP_KEY, '2');
    expect(getWelcomeStep()).toBe(WELCOME_PREVIEW_START);
  });

  it('does not reopen completed installs and supports explicitly replaying the guide', () => {
    markWelcomeCompleted();
    expect(isWelcomeCompleted()).toBe(true);
    resetWelcome();
    expect(isWelcomeCompleted()).toBe(false);
    expect(getWelcomeStep()).toBe(0);
  });

  it('keeps previous and next callbacks separate', () => {
    const previous = vi.fn();
    const next = vi.fn();
    const view = WelcomePreview({ index: 0, onPrevious: previous, onNext: next });
    const nav = view.props.children[4];
    nav.props.children[0].props.onClick();
    expect(previous).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    nav.props.children[1].props.onClick();
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { RELEASES } from '../pages/WhatsNew';
import { APP_VERSION, DISPLAY_VERSION, RELEASE_VISIBLE_CAP, semverAtMost } from '../version';

/**
 * v0.7 — the public changelog must never lose an entry, and 0.7.0-beta must
 * exist (APP_VERSION is 0.7.0-beta while the page used to stop at 0.6.6-beta,
 * so the "Nouveautés" badge pointed at an empty section).
 */
describe('WhatsNew releases', () => {
  it('publishes 0.8.0 only on explicit instruction and aligns product versions', () => {
    expect(DISPLAY_VERSION).toBe('0.8.0');
    expect(RELEASE_VISIBLE_CAP).toBe('0.8.0');
    expect(APP_VERSION).toBe('0.8.0-beta');
    expect(RELEASES[0].version).toBe('0.8.0');
    expect(RELEASES[0].sections.flatMap((s) => s.items).map((i) => i.id)).toEqual(['080s1', '080s2', '080s4', '080s3']);
    for (const release of RELEASES) expect(semverAtMost(release.version, DISPLAY_VERSION)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('keeps the published 0.7.9 additions', () => {
    const release = RELEASES.find((r) => r.version === '0.7.9')!;
    expect(release.date).toBe('5 novembre 2026');
    const items = release.sections.flatMap((s) => s.items);
    expect(items.map((i) => i.id)).toEqual(['079s1', '079s2', '079s3', '079s4', '079s5']);
    const texts = items.map((i) => i.text).join(' ');
    for (const detail of ['push', 'approbation ou refus', 'streaming', 'Support et Hébergement', '7 tests']) {
      expect(texts).toContain(detail);
    }
    for (const release of RELEASES) {
      expect(semverAtMost(release.version, DISPLAY_VERSION)).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('the public log merges everything after 0.7.2 under 0.7.5 (bump 0.7.2 -> 0.7.5, no .3/.4)', () => {
    // v0.7.5 — groupes internes *-beta fusionnés sous la release publique 0.7.5.
    expect(RELEASES.find((r) => r.version === '0.7.5')).toBeDefined();
    expect(semverAtMost(RELEASES[0].version, RELEASE_VISIBLE_CAP)).toBe(true);
    const versions = RELEASES.map((r) => r.version);
    for (const hidden of ['0.7.3-beta', '0.7.4-beta', '0.7.5-beta', '0.7.6-beta', '0.7.7-beta']) {
      expect(versions).not.toContain(hidden);
    }
    // v0.7.9 — directive : aucune version entre 0.7.5 et 0.7.9 dans le journal.
    for (const between of ['0.7.6', '0.7.7', '0.7.8']) {
      expect(versions).not.toContain(between);
    }
    // v0.7.5 — release publique condensée en résumés thématiques courts.
    const topItems = RELEASES.find((r) => r.version === '0.7.5')!.sections.flatMap((s) => s.items);
    expect(topItems.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(12);
    const topIds = topItems.map((i) => i.id);
    expect(topIds).toContain('075s1'); // comptes : reprise sans OTP + bascule
    expect(topIds).toContain('075s10'); // correctifs groupés
    for (const item of topItems) {
      expect(item.platforms?.length ?? 0).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });

  it('0.7.0-beta keeps the 0.7 batch', () => {
    const r07 = RELEASES.find((r) => r.version === '0.7.0-beta');
    expect(r07).toBeDefined();
    const texts = (r07 as any).sections.flatMap((s: any) => s.items.map((i: any) => i.text)).join(' ');
    expect(texts).toContain('response_language');
    expect(texts).toContain('APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED');
    expect(texts).toContain('sans compte');
    expect(texts).toContain('Accept-Language');
    expect(texts).toContain('FCM');
    expect(texts).toContain('assetlinks');
    expect(texts).toContain('reçu PDF');
  });

  it('every release keeps a unique version and valid items', () => {
    const versions = RELEASES.map((r) => r.version);
    expect(new Set(versions).size).toBe(versions.length);
    for (const release of RELEASES) {
      expect(release.date.length).toBeGreaterThan(4);
      expect(release.sections.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      for (const section of release.sections) {
        expect(['features', 'improvements', 'fixes', 'breaking']).toContain(section.kind);
        for (const item of section.items) {
          expect(item.id.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
          expect(item.text.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
        }
      }
    }
  });

  it('0.7.0-beta covers web, android, desktop and server scopes', () => {
    const r07 = RELEASES.find((r) => r.version === '0.7.0-beta') as any;
    const items = r07.sections.flatMap((s: any) => s.items) as any[];
    const plats = new Set(items.flatMap((i) => i.platforms || []));
    for (const p of ['web', 'android', 'desktop', 'server']) {
      expect(plats.has(p)).toBe(true);
    }
    const texts = items.map((i) => i.text).join(' ');
    expect(texts).toContain('RTL');
    expect(texts).toContain('GitHub Releases');
  });

  it('platform badges stay within the allowlist, item ids are unique', () => {
    const ids: string[] = [];
    for (const release of RELEASES) {
      for (const section of release.sections) {
        for (const item of section.items as any[]) {
          ids.push(item.id);
          expect((item.platforms || []).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
          for (const pl of item.platforms || []) {
            expect(['web', 'android', 'desktop', 'server']).toContain(pl);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(ids.length);
  });

  it('no historical release was removed', () => {
    const versions = RELEASES.map((r) => r.version);
    for (const kept of [
      '0.6.6-beta', '0.6.5-beta', '0.6.4-beta', '0.6.3-beta', '0.6.2-beta', '0.6.1-beta',
      '0.5.9-beta', '0.5.8-beta', '0.5.7-beta', '0.5.6-beta', '0.5.5-beta', '0.5.4-beta',
      '0.5.3-beta', '0.5.2-beta', '0.5.1-beta', '0.5.0-beta', '0.4.9-beta', '0.4.8-beta',
      '0.4.7-beta', '0.4.6-beta',
    ]) {
      expect(versions).toContain(kept);
    }
  });
});

/**
 * v0.7.7 — Sécurité du COMPTE (Settings → onglet Profil) :
 * 2FA (owner), appareils connectés (popup « Appareils connectés ») et
 * suppression de compte protégée par OTP. Ces lignes vivaient avant dans
 * l'onglet Atlas Agent : ce n'était pas leur place.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { api } from '../api';

type Device = { fingerprint: string; full: string; last_ip: string; last_seen: string; user_agent: string; current: boolean; device_label?: string; city?: string; country?: string };
type OtpFlow = { kind: 'account'; message: string; code?: string } | null;

export default function AccountSecurityPanel({ isOwner, role }: { isOwner: boolean; role: string }) {
  const [twoFa, setTwoFa] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [devices, setDevices] = useState<Device[] | null>(null);
  const [showDevices, setShowDevices] = useState(false);
  const [revokedNote, setRevokedNote] = useState(false);
  const [otp, setOtp] = useState<OtpFlow>(null);
  const [otpInput, setOtpInput] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try { const d = await api.getDevices(); setDevices(d?.data || []); } catch { setDevices([]); }
    if (isOwner) {
      try { const t = await api.get2fa(); setTwoFa(!!t?.data?.enabled); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }, [isOwner]);

  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, [load]);

  const startOtp = async () => {
    setBusy('account');
    try {
      const res = await api.requestAccountOtp();
      setOtp({ kind: 'account', message: res?.message || 'Code demandé.', code: res?.otp });
      setOtpInput('');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setOtp({ kind: 'account', message: e?.message || 'Impossible de demander le code.' });
    } finally {
      setBusy('');
    }
  };

  const confirmOtp = async () => {
    if (!otp) return;
    setBusy('account');
    try {
      await api.deleteAccount(otpInput.trim());
      localStorage.clear();
      window.location.assign('/login');
      return;
    } catch (e: any) {
      setOtp({ ...otp, message: e?.message || 'Code refusé.' });
    } finally {
      setBusy('');
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <h3 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Sécurité du compte</h3>
        <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
          Double authentification, appareils connectés et suppression de compte —
          tout ce qui touche au compte, au même endroit.
        </p>

        {isOwner && (
          <div className="form-row">
            <label>Double authentification (2FA)</label>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={twoFa ? 'btn primary' : 'btn secondary'}
                disabled={twoFa === null || busy === '2fa'}
                onClick={async () => {
                  setBusy('2fa');
                  try {
                    const res = await api.put2fa(!twoFa);
                    setTwoFa(!!res?.data?.enabled);
                  } catch { /* */ } finally { setBusy(''); }
                }}
              >
                {twoFa ? '2FA activée' : '2FA désactivée'}
              </button>
              <span className="muted">OTP exigé à chaque connexion, même sur appareil de confiance.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="form-row">
          <label>Appareils connectés</label>
          <div>
            <button type="button" className="btn secondary" onClick={() => setShowDevices(true)}>
              Voir les appareils ({devices?.length ?? '…'})
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {role !== 'owner' && (
          <div className="form-row">
            <label>Compte</label>
            <div>
              <button type="button" className="btn danger" disabled={busy === 'account'} onClick={() => void startOtp()}>
                Supprimer mon compte (OTP)
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {otp && (
          <div className="modal-note" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px' }}>{otp.message}</p>
            {otp.code && <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px' }}>Code (environnement local) : <code>{otp.code}</code></p>}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
              <input
                value={otpInput}
                onChange={(e) => setOtpInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Code OTP"
                inputMode="numeric"
                autoComplete="one-time-code"
                style={{ maxWidth: 140 }}
              />
              <button type="button" className="btn primary" disabled={busy === 'account'} onClick={() => void confirmOtp()}>
                Confirmer
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={() => setOtp(null)}>Annuler</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {showDevices && createPortal(
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowDevices(false)}>
          <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 560, width: '94vw' }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <button type="button" className="modal-x modal-close" aria-label="Fermer" onClick={() => setShowDevices(false)}>
              <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.4" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" /></svg>
            </button>
            <h2>Appareils connectés</h2>
            <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
              Chaque appareil qui s’est connecté à ce compte. Révoquez ceux que vous ne reconnaissez pas.
            </p>
            {(devices || []).length === 0 && <p className="muted">Aucun appareil enregistré.</p>}
            <div className="ac-device-list">
              {(devices || []).map((d) => {
                const isAndroid = /android/i.test(String(d.user_agent || ''));
                return (
                  <div key={d.full} className="ac-device-row">
                    <span className="ac-device-ico" aria-hidden>
                      {isAndroid ? (
                        <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><rect x="7" y="2.5" width="10" height="19" rx="2.5" /><path d="M11 18.5h2" /></svg>
                      ) : (
                        <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><rect x="2.5" y="4" width="19" height="12.5" rx="2" /><path d="M8 20.5h8M12 16.5v4" /></svg>
                      )}
                    </span>
                    <div className="ac-device-main">
                      <strong>
                        {d.current ? 'Cet appareil' : d.device_label || d.fingerprint}
                        {d.current && <span className="ac-device-chip">actuel</span>}
                      </strong>
                      <span className="ac-device-ua">{d.user_agent}</span>
                      <span className="ac-device-meta">
                        {d.last_seen} · IP {d.last_ip}
                        {(d.city || d.country) ? ` · ${[d.city, d.country].filter(Boolean).join(', ')}` : ''}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {!d.current && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="ac-device-revoke"
                        onClick={async () => {
                          try {
                            await api.revokeDevice(d.full);
                            setDevices((prev) => (prev || []).filter((x) => x.full !== d.full));
                            setRevokedNote(true);
                          } catch { /* */ }
                        }}
                      >
                        Révoquer
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            {revokedNote && (
              <p className="ac-device-note" role="status">
                Appareil révoqué : un code OTP lui sera demandé à sa prochaine connexion.
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="ac-modal-foot">
              <button type="button" className="btn secondary" onClick={() => setShowDevices(false)}>Fermer</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>,
        document.body,
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * Atlas Agent permissions — auto-saving segmented selector + custom tool toggles.
 * v0.7.7 : dans Settings, rendu « trigger » = carte résumé + popup façon
 * « Appareils connectés » (modal-overlay / modal / ac-modal-foot). Les modes ne
 * sont plus trois gros cartons sombres mais un sélecteur segmenté lisible
 * (clair & sombre), et la liste des outils de l'organisation vit dans la popup.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { api } from '../api';
import { friendlyError } from '../lib/errors';

type Mode = 'full' | 'read_only' | 'custom';

const MODES: { id: Mode; label: string; desc: string }[] = [
  { id: 'full', label: 'Accès complet', desc: 'Tous les outils autorisés par le rôle' },
  { id: 'read_only', label: 'Lecture seule', desc: 'Pas de proposition d’ajustement stock' },
  { id: 'custom', label: 'Personnalisé', desc: 'Choisir les outils un par un' },
];

type OrgTool = { name: string; description: string; enabled: boolean; allowedForRole: boolean };

type Props = {
  /** Compact layout for Atlas Agent drawer popover */
  compact?: boolean;
  /** Called after a successful save */
  onSaved?: () => void;
  /** Settings : carte résumé + popup « Appareils connectés »-style */
  asTrigger?: boolean;
};

export default function AgentPermissionsPanel({ compact = false, onSaved, asTrigger = false }: Props) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>('full');
  const [tools, setTools] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [available, setAvailable] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'error'>('idle');
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [orgAdmin, setOrgAdmin] = useState(false);
  const [orgTools, setOrgTools] = useState<OrgTool[]>([]);
  const [orgBusy, setOrgBusy] = useState(false);
  const saveGen = useRef(0);
  const toolsTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      const r = await api.getAgentPermissions();
      setMode((r.data?.mode as Mode) || 'full');
      setTools(r.data?.tools || []);
      setAvailable(r.data?.available || []);
      setGroups(r.data?.groups || {});
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(friendlyError(e) || 'Chargement impossible');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadOrg = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const r = await api.getAgentKnowledge();
      setOrgAdmin(!!r.data?.isAdmin);
      setOrgTools(r.data?.tools || []);
    } catch { /* la section perso reste utilisable sans la partie org */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) void loadOrg();
  }, [open, loadOrg]);

  const persist = useCallback(
    async (nextMode: Mode, nextTools: string[]) => {
      const gen = ++saveGen.current;
      setStatus('saving');
      setErr('');
      try {
        await api.updateAgentPermissions({
          mode: nextMode,
          tools: nextMode === 'custom' ? nextTools : undefined,
        });
        if (gen !== saveGen.current) return;
        setStatus('saved');
        onSaved?.();
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (gen === saveGen.current) setStatus('idle');
        }, 1800);
      } catch (e: any) {
        if (gen !== saveGen.current) return;
        setStatus('error');
        setErr(friendlyError(e) || 'Échec de l’enregistrement');
        // Reload server state on failure
        void load();
      }
    },
    [load, onSaved],
  );

  const selectMode = (id: Mode) => {
    if (id === mode && status !== 'error') return;
    setMode(id);
    void persist(id, tools);
  };

  const toggleTool = (name: string) => {
    setTools((prev) => {
      const next = prev.includes(name) ? prev.filter((x) => x !== name) : [...prev, name];
      if (toolsTimer.current) clearTimeout(toolsTimer.current);
      toolsTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        void persist('custom', next);
      }, 280);
      return next;
    });
    if (mode !== 'custom') setMode('custom');
  };

  const selectGroup = (key: string) => {
    const g = groups[key] || [];
    setTools((prev) => {
      const next = Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...g]));
      if (toolsTimer.current) clearTimeout(toolsTimer.current);
      toolsTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        void persist('custom', next);
      }, 200);
      return next;
    });
    if (mode !== 'custom') setMode('custom');
  };

  const toggleOrgTool = async (name: string, enabled: boolean) => {
    setOrgBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.setAgentToolPref(name, enabled);
      setOrgTools((prev) => prev.map((t) => (t.name === name ? { ...t, enabled } : t)));
    } catch (e: any) {
      setStatus('error');
      setErr(friendlyError(e) || 'Échec de l’enregistrement');
    } finally {
      setOrgBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const descOf = (name: string) => orgTools.find((t) => t.name === name)?.description || '';
  const modeLabel = MODES.find((m) => m.id === mode)?.label || mode;

  const statusLine = (
    <p className={`agent-perm-status agent-perm-status-${status}`} aria-live="polite">
      {status === 'saving' && 'Enregistrement…'}
      {status === 'saved' && '✓ Enregistré'}
      {status === 'error' && (err || 'Erreur')}
      {status === 'idle' && 'Les changements sont enregistrés automatiquement.'}
    </p>
  );

  const body = (withLead: boolean) => (
    <>
      {withLead && (
        <p className="agent-perm-lead">
          Contrôle ce que l’assistant peut appeler (en plus des règles de rôle). Les
          conversations peuvent être enregistrées — voir la politique de confidentialité.
        </p>
      )}

      {/* v0.7.7 — sélecteur segmenté lisible (remplace les 3 gros cartons sombres) */}
      <div className="agent-perm-seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Mode de permissions">
        {MODES.map((m) => (
          <button
            key={m.id}
            type="button"
            role="radio"
            aria-checked={mode === m.id}
            className={`agent-perm-seg-opt${mode === m.id ? ' active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => selectMode(m.id)}
          >
            <span className="agent-perm-seg-dot" aria-hidden />
            {m.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="agent-perm-seg-desc">{MODES.find((m) => m.id === mode)?.desc}</p>

      {mode === 'custom' && (
        <div className="agent-perm-custom">
          {Object.keys(groups).length > 0 && (
            <div className="agent-perm-group-btns">
              {Object.keys(groups).map((k) => (
                <button key={k} type="button" className="secondary agent-perm-group-btn" onClick={() => selectGroup(k)}>
                  + {k}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="agent-perm-tools">
            {available.map((name) => {
              const on = tools.includes(name);
              const d = descOf(name);
              return (
                <button
                  key={name}
                  type="button"
                  className={`agent-perm-tool-switch${on ? ' on' : ''}`}
                  role="switch"
                  aria-checked={on}
                  onClick={() => toggleTool(name)}
                >
                  <span className="agent-perm-tool-label">
                    <code>{name}</code>
                    {d ? <span className="agent-perm-tool-desc">{d}</span> : null}
                  </span>
                  <span className="agent-perm-knob" aria-hidden />
                </button>
              );
            })}
            {available.length === 0 && (
              <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, margin: 0 }}>
                Aucun outil listé pour ce compte.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {!compact && orgAdmin && (
        <div className="agent-perm-org">
          <h3 className="agent-perm-org-title">Outils de l’organisation</h3>
          <p className="agent-perm-seg-desc">
            Activez ou coupez chaque outil disponible pour vos rôles (tous les utilisateurs).
          </p>
          <div className="agent-perm-org-list">
            {orgTools.map((t) => (
              <label key={t.name} className={`agent-perm-org-row${t.allowedForRole ? '' : ' is-locked'}`}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={t.enabled}
                  disabled={!t.allowedForRole || orgBusy}
                  aria-label={`Activer l’outil ${t.name}`}
                  onChange={(e) => void toggleOrgTool(t.name, e.target.checked)}
                />
                <span>
                  <strong>{t.name}</strong>
                  <span>{t.description || (t.allowedForRole ? '' : 'non autorisé pour votre rôle')}</span>
                </span>
              </label>
            ))}
            {orgTools.length === 0 && (
              <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, margin: 0 }}>Aucun outil côté organisation.</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className={`agent-perm-panel${compact ? ' is-compact' : ''}`}>
        <p className="agent-perm-status muted">Chargement…</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /* ── Settings : carte résumé + popup façon « Appareils connectés » ── */
  if (asTrigger) {
    return (
      <>
        <div className="agent-perm-summary">
          <div className="agent-perm-summary-txt">
            <strong>Permissions Atlas Agent</strong>
            <span>
              Mode : {modeLabel}
              {mode === 'custom' ? ` · ${tools.length} outil(s) choisi(s)` : ''}
            </span>
          </div>
          <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
            Gérer les permissions
          </button>
        </div>
        {open &&
          createPortal(
            <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              <div className="modal agent-perm-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                <button type="button" className="modal-x modal-close" aria-label="Fermer" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                  <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.4" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" /></svg>
                </button>
                <h2>Permissions Atlas Agent</h2>
                <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
                  Outils et actions que l’agent peut exécuter en votre nom.
                </p>
                <div className="agent-perm-modal-body">
                  {body(true)}
                  {statusLine}
                </div>
                <div className="ac-modal-foot">
                  <button type="button" className="btn secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Fermer</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>,
            document.body,
          )}
      </>
    );
  }

  /* ── inline (drawer compact) ── */
  return (
    <div className={`agent-perm-panel${compact ? ' is-compact' : ''}`}>
      {compact && (
        <div className="agent-perm-compact-head">
          <strong>Permissions</strong>
          <span className={`agent-perm-badge agent-perm-badge-${status}`} aria-live="polite">
            {status === 'saving' && 'Enregistrement…'}
            {status === 'saved' && '✓ Enregistré'}
            {status === 'error' && 'Erreur'}
            {status === 'idle' && 'Auto-save'}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
      {body(!compact)}
      {!compact && statusLine}
      {compact && err && <p className="agent-perm-status agent-perm-status-error">{err}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * v225 — Atlas Agent & Sécurité panel (Settings → profile tab).
 * 2FA toggle (owner), agent governance (quota/blocks, admin restore),
 * OTP-gated privacy deletes (agent data / account), logged-in devices popup.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { api } from '../api';

type Policy = { blocked: boolean; isAdmin: boolean; dailyUsed: number; weeklyUsed: number; dailyLimit: number; weeklyLimit: number; dailyResetsAt?: string; weeklyResetsAt?: string };
type OtpFlow = { kind: 'agent'; message: string; code?: string } | null;

function fmtReset(iso?: string): string {
  if (!iso) return 'au prochain cycle';
  try {
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('fr-FR', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', timeZone: 'UTC' }) + ' UTC';
  } catch { return 'au prochain cycle'; }
}

export default function AgentSecurityPanel({ isOwner }: { isOwner: boolean; role: string }) {
  const [policy, setPolicy] = useState<Policy | null>(null);
  const [controls, setControls] = useState<any[]>([]);
  // v0.7.7 — accès agent : popup dédié, même patron que « Appareils connectés »
  const [showAccess, setShowAccess] = useState(false);
  const [otp, setOtp] = useState<OtpFlow>(null);
  const [otpInput, setOtpInput] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try { const p = await api.getAgentPolicy(); if (p?.data) setPolicy(p.data); } catch { /* */ }
    if (isOwner) {
      try { const c = await api.getAgentControls(); setControls(c?.data || []); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }, [isOwner]);

  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, [load]);

  const startOtp = async (kind: 'agent') => {
    setBusy(kind);
    try {
      const res = await api.requestAgentDataOtp();
      setOtp({ kind, message: res?.message || 'Code demandé.', code: res?.otp });
      setOtpInput('');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setOtp({ kind, message: e?.message || 'Impossible de demander le code.' });
    } finally {
      setBusy('');
    }
  };

  const confirmOtp = async () => {
    if (!otp) return;
    setBusy(otp.kind);
    try {
      await api.deleteAgentData(otpInput.trim());
      for (const k of Object.keys(localStorage)) {
        if (k.startsWith('atlas_agent_')) localStorage.removeItem(k);
      }
      setOtp(null);
      setPolicy((p) => (p ? { ...p, dailyUsed: 0, weeklyUsed: 0 } : p));
      void load();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setOtp({ ...otp, message: e?.message || 'Code refusé.' });
    } finally {
      setBusy('');
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <h3 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Atlas Agent & Sécurité</h3>
        <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
          Gouvernance de l’agent IA : quotas, verrouillage anti-injection, accès utilisateurs et
          suppressions protégées par OTP. (2FA et appareils connectés : onglet Profil → « Sécurité du compte ».)
        </p>

        <div className="form-row">
          <label>Atlas Agent — statut</label>
          <div>
            {policy?.blocked ? (
              <strong style={{ color: 'var(--atlas-danger, #b91c1c)' }}>Accès suspendu (rétablissement par un administrateur)</strong>
            ) : (
              <strong>Actif</strong>
            )}
            {policy?.isAdmin && <span className="muted" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>Admin : sans limite</span>}
          </div>
          {policy && !policy.blocked && (
            <div className="ac-quota">
              <div className="ac-quota-row">
                <div className="ac-quota-head">
                  <span>Quota quotidien{policy.isAdmin ? ' · admin illimité' : ''}</span>
                  <strong>{policy.dailyUsed.toLocaleString('fr-FR')} / {policy.dailyLimit.toLocaleString('fr-FR')} jetons</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="ac-quota-bar" role="progressbar" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={policy.dailyLimit} aria-valuenow={policy.dailyUsed}>
                  <i className={!policy.isAdmin && policy.dailyUsed >= policy.dailyLimit ? 'full' : !policy.isAdmin && policy.dailyUsed > policy.dailyLimit * 0.8 ? 'warn' : undefined} style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.round((policy.dailyUsed / policy.dailyLimit) * 100))}%` }} />
                </div>
                <span className="ac-quota-reset">Rafraîchit {fmtReset(policy.dailyResetsAt)} (minuit UTC), chaque jour à la même heure</span>
              </div>
              <div className="ac-quota-row">
                <div className="ac-quota-head">
                  <span>Quota hebdomadaire{policy.isAdmin ? ' · admin illimité' : ''}</span>
                  <strong>{policy.weeklyUsed.toLocaleString('fr-FR')} / {policy.weeklyLimit.toLocaleString('fr-FR')} jetons</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="ac-quota-bar" role="progressbar" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={policy.weeklyLimit} aria-valuenow={policy.weeklyUsed}>
                  <i className={!policy.isAdmin && policy.weeklyUsed >= policy.weeklyLimit ? 'full' : !policy.isAdmin && policy.weeklyUsed > policy.weeklyLimit * 0.8 ? 'warn' : undefined} style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.round((policy.weeklyUsed / policy.weeklyLimit) * 100))}%` }} />
                </div>
                <span className="ac-quota-reset">Rafraîchit {fmtReset(policy.weeklyResetsAt)} (lundi 00:00 UTC), chaque semaine au même moment</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {isOwner && controls.length > 0 && (
          <div className="form-row">
            <label>Accès agent des utilisateurs</label>
            <div>
              <button type="button" className="btn secondary" onClick={() => setShowAccess(true)}>
                Gérer les accès ({controls.length ?? '…'})
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="form-row">
          <label>Données Atlas Agent</label>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <button type="button" className="btn secondary" disabled={busy === 'agent'} onClick={() => void startOtp('agent')}>
              Supprimer toutes mes conversations (OTP)
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {otp && (
          <div className="modal-note" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px' }}>{otp.message}</p>
            {otp.code && <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px' }}>Code (environnement local) : <code>{otp.code}</code></p>}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
              <input
                value={otpInput}
                onChange={(e) => setOtpInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Code OTP"
                inputMode="numeric"
                autoComplete="one-time-code"
                style={{ maxWidth: 140 }}
              />
              <button type="button" className="btn primary" disabled={busy === otp.kind} onClick={() => void confirmOtp()}>
                Confirmer
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={() => setOtp(null)}>Annuler</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {showAccess && createPortal(
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowAccess(false)}>
          <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 560, width: '94vw' }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <button type="button" className="modal-x modal-close" aria-label="Fermer" onClick={() => setShowAccess(false)}>
              <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.4" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" /></svg>
            </button>
            <h2>Accès agent des utilisateurs</h2>
            <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
              Suspendez ou rétablissez l’accès à l’Atlas Agent compte par compte (abus ou injection de prompt).
              Un compte suspendu voit sa barre de saisie masquée et un popup d’explication.
            </p>
            {(controls || []).length === 0 && <p className="muted">Aucun compte enregistré.</p>}
            <div className="ac-device-list">
              {(controls || []).map((ctl: any) => (
                <div key={ctl.username} className="ac-device-row">
                  <span className="ac-device-ico" aria-hidden>
                    <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2" /><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4" /></svg>
                  </span>
                  <div className="ac-device-main">
                    <strong>
                      {ctl.username}
                      <span className="ac-device-chip">{ctl.blocked ? 'suspendu' : 'ok'}</span>
                    </strong>
                    <span className="ac-device-meta">
                      {ctl.blocked
                        ? 'Accès verrouillé — barre de saisie masquée, popup affiché.'
                        : 'Accès normal (quotas appliqués).'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="ac-device-revoke"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        await api.setAgentAccess(ctl.username, ctl.blocked ? 'restore' : 'block');
                        void load();
                      } catch { /* */ }
                    }}
                  >
                    {ctl.blocked ? 'Rétablir' : 'Suspendre'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="ac-modal-foot">
              <button type="button" className="btn secondary" onClick={() => setShowAccess(false)}>Fermer</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>,
        document.body,
      )}
    </>
  );
}
