/**
 * CSS-based toast / confirm / prompt — replaces window.alert, confirm, prompt.
 * Always portaled to document.body with high z-index so they sit above page modals.
 */
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

type ToastKind = 'success' | 'error' | 'info';

type ToastItem = {
  id: number;
  message: string;
  kind: ToastKind;
};

type ConfirmState = {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  danger?: boolean;
  /** Single-button informational dialog (replaces window.alert) */
  alertOnly?: boolean;
  resolve: (ok: boolean) => void;
} | null;

type PromptState = {
  title: string;
  message?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  resolve: (value: string | null) => void;
} | null;

type UiApi = {
  toast: (message: string, kind?: ToastKind) => void;
  /** Styled modal replacing window.alert */
  alert: (message: string, title?: string) => Promise<void>;
  confirm: (opts: {
    title?: string;
    message: string;
    confirmLabel?: string;
    cancelLabel?: string;
    danger?: boolean;
  }) => Promise<boolean>;
  prompt: (opts: {
    title: string;
    message?: string;
    defaultValue?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    confirmLabel?: string;
  }) => Promise<string | null>;
};

const UiContext = createContext<UiApi | null>(null);

let idSeq = 1;


/** Icons aligned with react-icons/tb style (no extra dependency) */
function ToastGlyph({ kind }: { kind: string }) {
  const common = { width: 16, height: 16, viewBox: '0 0 24 24', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', strokeWidth: 2, strokeLinecap: 'round' as const, strokeLinejoin: 'round' as const, 'aria-hidden': true as const };
  if (kind === 'success') {
    return (
      <svg {...common}>
        <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14" />
        <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01" />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  if (kind === 'info') {
    return (
      <svg {...common}>
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
        <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12" y2="12" />
        <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12.01" y2="8" />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  // error / alert — TbFileAlert-like
  return (
    <svg {...common}>
      <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z" />
      <path d="M14 2v6h6" />
      <path d="M12 18v-4" />
      <path d="M12 10h.01" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export function AppDialogsProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastItem[]>([]);
  const [confirmState, setConfirmState] = useState<ConfirmState>(null);
  const [promptState, setPromptState] = useState<PromptState>(null);
  const [promptValue, setPromptValue] = useState('');
  const promptInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const toast = useCallback((message: string, kind: ToastKind = 'info') => {
    const id = idSeq++;
    setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, kind }]);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
    }, 4200);
  }, []);

  const confirm = useCallback(
    (opts: {
      title?: string;
      message: string;
      confirmLabel?: string;
      cancelLabel?: string;
      danger?: boolean;
    }) =>
      new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
        setConfirmState({
          title: opts.title || 'Confirmation',
          message: opts.message,
          confirmLabel: opts.confirmLabel || 'Confirmer',
          cancelLabel: opts.cancelLabel || 'Annuler',
          danger: opts.danger,
          resolve,
        });
      }),
    []
  );

  const alertFn = useCallback(
    (message: string, title?: string) =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        setConfirmState({
          title: title || 'Information',
          message,
          confirmLabel: 'OK',
          cancelLabel: '',
          alertOnly: true,
          resolve: () => resolve(),
        });
      }),
    []
  );

  const prompt = useCallback(
    (opts: {
      title: string;
      message?: string;
      defaultValue?: string;
      placeholder?: string;
      confirmLabel?: string;
    }) =>
      new Promise<string | null>((resolve) => {
        setPromptValue(opts.defaultValue || '');
        setPromptState({
          title: opts.title,
          message: opts.message,
          defaultValue: opts.defaultValue,
          placeholder: opts.placeholder,
          confirmLabel: opts.confirmLabel || 'OK',
          resolve,
        });
      }),
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (promptState) {
      const t = window.setTimeout(() => promptInputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
    }
  }, [promptState]);

  /* Esc closes confirm / prompt; trap focus remains on dialog body */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!confirmState && !promptState) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
      e.preventDefault();
      if (confirmState) {
        confirmState.resolve(false);
        setConfirmState(null);
      } else if (promptState) {
        promptState.resolve(null);
        setPromptState(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [confirmState, promptState]);

  const api: UiApi = { toast, alert: alertFn, confirm, prompt };

  // Expose for non-React modules (export.ts, reports.ts, thermal fallbacks)
  useEffect(() => {
    (window as any).__atlasUi = api;
    return () => {
      delete (window as any).__atlasUi;
    };
  }, [api]);

  const overlayUi =
    typeof document !== 'undefined'
      ? createPortal(
          <>
            {/* Toasts — always on top */}
            <div className="app-toast-stack" aria-live="polite">
              {toasts.map((t) => (
                <div key={t.id} className={`app-toast app-toast-${t.kind}`} role="status">
                  <div className="app-toast-icon-rail" aria-hidden>
                    <ToastGlyph kind={t.kind} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="app-toast-body">
                    <span className="app-toast-msg app-toast-title">{t.message}</span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="app-toast-close"
                    aria-label="Fermer"
                    onClick={() => setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((x) => x.id !== t.id))}
                  >
                    ×
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Confirm */}
            {confirmState && (
              <div
                className="modal-overlay modal-overlay-top"
                style={{ zIndex: 12000 }}
                role="presentation"
                onClick={() => {
                  confirmState.resolve(false);
                  setConfirmState(null);
                }}
              >
                <div
                  className="modal app-dialog-card"
                  role="dialog"
                  aria-modal="true"
                  aria-labelledby="atlas-confirm-title"
                  aria-describedby="atlas-confirm-desc"
                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                >
                  <h2 id="atlas-confirm-title">{confirmState.title}</h2>
                  <p id="atlas-confirm-desc" style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-line' }}>
                    {confirmState.message}
                  </p>
                  <div className="dialog-actions">
                    {!confirmState.alertOnly && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="secondary"
                        onClick={() => {
                          confirmState.resolve(false);
                          setConfirmState(null);
                        }}
                      >
                        {confirmState.cancelLabel || 'Annuler'}
                      </button>
                    )}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={confirmState.danger ? 'danger' : undefined}
                      autoFocus
                      onClick={() => {
                        confirmState.resolve(true);
                        setConfirmState(null);
                      }}
                    >
                      {confirmState.confirmLabel || 'OK'}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Prompt */}
            {promptState && (
              <div
                className="modal-overlay modal-overlay-top"
                style={{ zIndex: 12000 }}
                role="presentation"
                onClick={() => {
                  promptState.resolve(null);
                  setPromptState(null);
                }}
              >
                <div
                  className="modal app-dialog-card"
                  role="dialog"
                  aria-modal="true"
                  aria-labelledby="atlas-prompt-title"
                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                >
                  <h2 id="atlas-prompt-title">{promptState.title}</h2>
                  {promptState.message && <p>{promptState.message}</p>}
                  <input
                    ref={promptInputRef}
                    type="text"
                    value={promptValue}
                    placeholder={promptState.placeholder}
                    aria-label={promptState.title}
                    onChange={(e) => setPromptValue(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                        promptState.resolve(promptValue.trim() || null);
                        setPromptState(null);
                      }
                    }}
                    style={{ width: '100%', marginBottom: 16 }}
                  />
                  <div className="dialog-actions">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="secondary"
                      onClick={() => {
                        promptState.resolve(null);
                        setPromptState(null);
                      }}
                    >
                      Annuler
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        promptState.resolve(promptValue.trim() || null);
                        setPromptState(null);
                      }}
                    >
                      {promptState.confirmLabel}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </>,
          document.body
        )
      : null;

  return (
    <UiContext.Provider value={api}>
      {children}
      {overlayUi}
    </UiContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useUi(): UiApi {
  const ctx = useContext(UiContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    // Fallback if used outside provider (should not happen)
    return {
      toast: (m) => console.warn('[toast]', m),
      alert: async (m, title) => { console.warn('[alert]', title || '', m); },
      confirm: async ({ message }) => {
        console.warn('[confirm]', message);
        return false;
      },
      prompt: async () => null,
    };
  }
  return ctx;
}

/** For modules outside React (export.ts, reports.ts). */
export function uiToast(message: string, kind: ToastKind = 'info') {
  const api = (window as any).__atlasUi as UiApi | undefined;
  if (api) api.toast(message, kind);
  else console.warn('[toast]', message);
}

export function uiConfirm(message: string, opts?: { title?: string; danger?: boolean }) {
  const api = (window as any).__atlasUi as UiApi | undefined;
  if (api) return api.confirm({ message, title: opts?.title, danger: opts?.danger });
  console.warn('[confirm]', message);
  return Promise.resolve(false);
}

export function uiAlert(message: string, title?: string) {
  const api = (window as any).__atlasUi as UiApi | undefined;
  if (api) return api.alert(message, title);
  console.warn('[alert]', title || '', message);
  return Promise.resolve();
}

/** Small UI helpers for invoice/assist flows */
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

export function SuggestList({
  items,
  onPick,
}: {
  items: { key: string; title: string; sub?: string }[];
  onPick: (key: string) => void;
}) {
  if (!items.length) return null;
  return (
    <ul
      className="assist-suggest-list"
      style={{
        listStyle: 'none',
        margin: '4px 0 0',
        padding: 0,
        border: '1px solid var(--line, #e5e0d6)',
        borderRadius: 10,
        background: 'var(--paper, #fff)',
        maxHeight: 200,
        overflow: 'auto',
        zIndex: 20,
        position: 'absolute',
        left: 0,
        right: 0,
        boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)',
      }}
    >
      {items.map((it) => (
        <li key={it.key}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onPick(it.key)}
            style={{
              width: '100%',
              textAlign: 'left',
              border: 'none',
              background: 'transparent',
              padding: '8px 10px',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              font: 'inherit',
            }}

            ) : null}

        </li>

  );
}

const NOTE_CHIPS = [
  'Livraison urgente',
  'Client régulier',
  'Prix négocié',
  'Paiement à la livraison',
  'Retrait magasin',
];

export function NoteChips({
  value,
  onChange,
  chips = NOTE_CHIPS,
}: {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  chips?: string[];
}) {
  const add = (chip: string) => {
    const v = (value || '').trim();
    if (v.includes(chip)) return;
    onChange(v ? `${v} · ${chip}` : chip);
  };
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6, marginTop: 6 }}>
      {chips.map((c) => (
        <button
          key={c}
          type="button"
          className="secondary"
          style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '4px 10px', borderRadius: 999 }}
          onClick={() => add(c)}
        >
          {c}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function AssistHint({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)', margin: '6px 0 0' }}>{children}</p>
  );
}

/** v209 panels — alertes stock/documents (M5), références fournisseur (L7), kits & assemblages (L6). */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import RefreshIconButton from './RefreshIconButton';

const DEFAULT_ALERTS = [
  { key: 'stock_low', label: 'Stock sous le seuil', threshold: 0 },
  { key: 'stock_out', label: 'Rupture de stock', threshold: 0 },
  { key: 'invoice_overdue', label: 'Facture échue', threshold: 0 },
  { key: 'quote_stale', label: 'Devis sans réponse (jours)', threshold: 7 },
];

export function AlertsPanel() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [busyKey, setBusyKey] = useState('');
  const load = () => {
    api.getAlertSettings().then((r: any) => {
      const have = r?.data || [];
      const merged = DEFAULT_ALERTS.map((d) => ({ ...d, enabled: 1, ...have.find((h: any) => h.key === d.key) }));
      setRows(merged);
    }).catch(() => setRows(DEFAULT_ALERTS.map((d) => ({ ...d, enabled: 1 }))));
  };
  useEffect(load, []);
  const save = async (row: any, patch: any) => {
    setBusyKey(row.key);
    try {
      await api.saveAlertSetting({ ...row, ...patch });
      setRows((rs) => rs.map((r) => (r.key === row.key ? { ...r, ...patch } : r)));
    } finally {
      setBusyKey('');
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="ac-panel" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
      <div className="ac-panel-head" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
        <strong>Alertes stock & documents</strong>
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 12 }}>déclenchent les webhooks (événement atlas.alert)</span>
        <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}><RefreshIconButton onClick={() => load()} /></span>
      </div>
      <div className="table-wrap">
        <table className="data-dense">
          <thead><tr><th>Alerte</th><th>Seuil</th><th style={{ width: 90 }}>Active</th><th style={{ width: 90 }}>Test</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((r) => (
              <tr key={r.key}>
                <td>{r.label}</td>
                <td>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    style={{ width: 80 }}
                    value={r.threshold}
                    disabled={busyKey === r.key}
                    onChange={(e) => setRows((rs) => rs.map((x) => (x.key === r.key ? { ...x, threshold: Number(e.target.value) } : x)))}
                    onBlur={(e) => void save(r, { threshold: Number(e.target.value) })}
                  />
                </td>
                <td>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={!!r.enabled} disabled={busyKey === r.key} onChange={(e) => void save(r, { enabled: e.target.checked ? 1 : 0 })} />
                </td>
                <td>
                  <button type="button" className="secondary" style={{ padding: '2px 10px', fontSize: 12 }} disabled={busyKey === r.key} onClick={() => void api.saveAlertSetting({ ...r, test: true }).then(() => alert('Test envoyé aux webhooks.'))}>
                    Tester
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function SupplierPartsPanel() {
  const [vendors, setVendors] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [vendorId, setVendorId] = useState('');
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ product_id: '', supplier_sku: '', q1: '10', p1: '', q2: '50', p2: '' });
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    api.getVendors().then((r: any) => setVendors(r?.data || [])).catch(() => {});
    api.getProducts().then((r: any) => setProducts(r?.data || [])).catch(() => {});
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!vendorId) { setRows([]); return; }
    api.getVendorParts(Number(vendorId)).then((r: any) => setRows(r?.data || [])).catch(() => setRows([]));
  }, [vendorId]);
  const add = async () => {
    const breaks = [
      { qty: Number(form.q1) || 10, price: Number(form.p1) || 0 },
      { qty: Number(form.q2) || 50, price: Number(form.p2) || 0 },
    ].filter((b) => b.price > 0);
    await api.addVendorPart({ vendor_id: Number(vendorId), product_id: Number(form.product_id), supplier_sku: form.supplier_sku, price_breaks: breaks });
    setMsg('Référence ajoutée ✓');
    setTimeout(() => setMsg(''), 3000);
    const r: any = await api.getVendorParts(Number(vendorId));
    setRows(r?.data || []);
  };
  return (
    <div className="ac-panel" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
      <div className="ac-panel-head"><strong>Références fournisseur & tarifs dégressifs</strong></div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', padding: '8px 0' }}>
        <select value={vendorId} onChange={(e) => setVendorId(e.target.value)} aria-label="Fournisseur" style={{ width: 'auto' }}>
          <option value="">— choisir un fournisseur —</option>
          {vendors.map((v) => <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>{v.name}</option>)}
        </select>
        {vendorId && (
          <>
            <select value={form.product_id} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, product_id: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Produit" style={{ width: 'auto' }}>
              <option value="">— produit —</option>
              {products.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}
            </select>
            <input placeholder="SKU fournisseur" value={form.supplier_sku} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, supplier_sku: e.target.value }))} style={{ width: 140 }} />
            <input placeholder="Qté 1" type="number" value={form.q1} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, q1: e.target.value }))} style={{ width: 70 }} />
            <input placeholder="Prix 1" type="number" value={form.p1} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, p1: e.target.value }))} style={{ width: 90 }} />
            <input placeholder="Qté 2" type="number" value={form.q2} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, q2: e.target.value }))} style={{ width: 70 }} />
            <input placeholder="Prix 2" type="number" value={form.p2} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, p2: e.target.value }))} style={{ width: 90 }} />
            <button type="button" onClick={() => void add()} disabled={!form.product_id}>Ajouter</button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      {msg && <p style={{ color: 'var(--ok, #16a34a)', fontSize: 12 }}>{msg}</p>}
      {vendorId && (
        <div className="table-wrap">
          <table className="data-dense">
            <thead><tr><th>Produit</th><th>SKU fournisseur</th><th>Paliers</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <tr key={r.id}>
                  <td>{products.find((p) => p.id === r.product_id)?.name || `#${r.product_id}`}</td>
                  <td>{r.supplier_sku}</td>
                  <td>{(JSON.parse(r.price_breaks || '[]') as any[]).map((b) => `${b.qty}× → ${b.price} MAD`).join(' · ') || '—'}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {!rows.length && <tr><td colSpan={3} style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Aucune référence pour ce fournisseur.</td></tr>}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function KitsPanel() {
  const [kits, setKits] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', product_id: '', c1: '', q1: '1', c2: '', q2: '1' });
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const load = () => {
    api.getKits().then((r: any) => setKits(r?.data || [])).catch(() => {});
    api.getProducts().then((r: any) => setProducts(r?.data || [])).catch(() => {});
  };
  useEffect(load, []);
  const create = async () => {
    const items = [
      { product_id: Number(form.c1), quantity: Number(form.q1) || 1 },
      form.c2 ? { product_id: Number(form.c2), quantity: Number(form.q2) || 1 } : null,
    ].filter(Boolean) as any[];
    if (!form.name || !form.product_id || !items.length) return;
    await api.createKit({ name: form.name, product_id: Number(form.product_id), items });
    setMsg('Kit créé ✓');
    setTimeout(() => setMsg(''), 3000);
    load();
  };
  const assemble = async (id: number) => {
    try {
      await api.assembleKit(id, 1);
      setMsg('Assemblage ✓ (composants décrémentés, kit incrémenté)');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setMsg(`Impossible : ${e?.message || 'stock insuffisant'}`);
    }
    setTimeout(() => setMsg(''), 4000);
    load();
  };
  return (
    <div className="ac-panel" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
      <div className="ac-panel-head"><strong>Kits & assemblages (BOM)</strong></div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', padding: '8px 0' }}>
        <input placeholder="Nom du kit" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, name: e.target.value }))} style={{ width: 150 }} />
        <select value={form.product_id} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, product_id: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Produit fini" style={{ width: 'auto' }}>
          <option value="">— produit fini —</option>
          {products.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}
        </select>
        <select value={form.c1} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, c1: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Composant 1" style={{ width: 'auto' }}>
          <option value="">— composant 1 —</option>
          {products.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}
        </select>
        <input type="number" value={form.q1} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, q1: e.target.value }))} style={{ width: 60 }} aria-label="Qté 1" />
        <select value={form.c2} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, c2: e.target.value }))} aria-label="Composant 2" style={{ width: 'auto' }}>
          <option value="">— composant 2 —</option>
          {products.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}
        </select>
        <input type="number" value={form.q2} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, q2: e.target.value }))} style={{ width: 60 }} aria-label="Qté 2" />
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void create()}>Créer le kit</button>
      </div>
      {msg && <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{msg}</p>}
      <div className="table-wrap">
        <table className="data-dense">
          <thead><tr><th>Kit</th><th>Produit fini</th><th>Composants</th><th style={{ width: 110 }}>Assembler</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {kits.map((k) => (
              <tr key={k.id}>
                <td><strong>{k.name}</strong></td>
                <td>{products.find((p) => p.id === k.product_id)?.name || `#${k.product_id}`}</td>
                <td>{(k.items || []).map((it: any) => `${products.find((p) => p.id === it.product_id)?.name || '#' + it.product_id} ×${it.quantity}`).join(' + ') || '—'}</td>
                <td><button type="button" className="secondary" style={{ padding: '2px 10px', fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => void assemble(k.id)}>Assembler ×1</button></td>
              </tr>
            ))}
            {!kits.length && <tr><td colSpan={4} style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Aucun kit — créez le premier ci-dessus.</td></tr>}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * Top progress bar inspired by ngx-loading-bar, styled for Atlas Commerce
 * (zellij teal, soft trail). Controlled via window events:
 *   atlas-loading:start | atlas-loading:set | atlas-loading:done
 */
type Phase = 'idle' | 'running' | 'finishing';

export function startAtlasLoading() {
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('atlas-loading:start'));
}
export function setAtlasLoading(pct: number) {
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('atlas-loading:set', { detail: { pct } }));
}
export function doneAtlasLoading() {
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('atlas-loading:done'));
}

export default function AtlasLoadingBar() {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('idle');
  const [pct, setPct] = useState(0);
  const timer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onStart = () => {
      setPhase('running');
      setPct(8);
      if (timer.current) window.clearInterval(timer.current);
      timer.current = window.setInterval(() => {
        setPct((p) => {
          if (p >= 92) return p;
          const step = p < 40 ? 4 : p < 70 ? 2 : 0.6;
          return Math.min(92, p + step);
        });
      }, 320);
    };
    const onSet = (e: Event) => {
      const n = (e as CustomEvent).detail?.pct;
      if (typeof n === 'number') {
        setPhase('running');
        setPct(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, n)));
      }
    };
    const onDone = () => {
      if (timer.current) {
        window.clearInterval(timer.current);
        timer.current = null;
      }
      setPct(100);
      setPhase('finishing');
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        setPhase('idle');
        setPct(0);
      }, 280);
    };
    window.addEventListener('atlas-loading:start', onStart);
    window.addEventListener('atlas-loading:set', onSet);
    window.addEventListener('atlas-loading:done', onDone);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('atlas-loading:start', onStart);
      window.removeEventListener('atlas-loading:set', onSet);
      window.removeEventListener('atlas-loading:done', onDone);
      if (timer.current) window.clearInterval(timer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  if (phase === 'idle') return null;

  return (
    <div className="atlas-loading-bar" aria-hidden>
      <div
        className={`atlas-loading-bar-peg${phase === 'finishing' ? ' is-done' : ''}`}
        style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import {
  acceptAll,
  acceptNecessaryOnly,
  getConsent,
  hasDecidedConsent,
  saveConsent,
  type ConsentRecord,
} from '../lib/cookieConsent';

export default function CookieConsent() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [panel, setPanel] = useState<'banner' | 'details'>('banner');
  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState(true);
  const [analytics, setAnalytics] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // v0.7.2 — /download, /whats-new and /about set no cookie at all: never
    // ask for consent there. The banner can still be opened manually
    // (atlas-consent-open) from the privacy link.
    const path = window.location.pathname;
    const noCookiePages = ['/', '/download', '/android', '/desktop', '/whats-new', '/about'];
    const skip = noCookiePages.some((p) => path === p || path.startsWith(`${p}/`));
    setVisible(!skip && !hasDecidedConsent());
    const open = () => {
      const c = getConsent();
      if (c) {
        setPrefs(c.preferences);
        setAnalytics(c.analytics);
      }
      setPanel('details');
      setVisible(true);
    };
    window.addEventListener('atlas-consent-open', open);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('atlas-consent-open', open);
  }, []);

  const closeWith = (record: ConsentRecord) => {
    setPrefs(record.preferences);
    setAnalytics(record.analytics);
    setVisible(false);
    setPanel('banner');
  };

  if (!visible || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;

  const body = (
    <div
      className="cookie-consent"
      role="region"
      aria-labelledby="cookie-consent-title"
    >
      {hasDecidedConsent() && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="cookie-btn linkish cookie-consent-close"
          aria-label="Fermer"
          onClick={() => { setVisible(false); setPanel('banner'); }}
        >
          ×
        </button>
      )}
      <div className="cookie-consent-card" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="cookie-consent-head">
          <h2 id="cookie-consent-title">Cookies &amp; données locales</h2>
          <p>
            Atlas Commerce enregistre localement ce qui est nécessaire à la session sécurisée
            (connexion, rôles). Aucune publicité. Détails dans la{' '}
            <a href="/privacy" onClick={() => setVisible(false)}>
              politique de confidentialité
            </a>
            .
          </p>
        </div>

        {panel === 'details' && (
          <div className="cookie-consent-details">
            <label className="cookie-consent-row">
              <input type="checkbox" checked disabled readOnly />
              <span>
                <strong>Nécessaires</strong>
                <em>
                  Session, sécurité (OTP, limitation des abus), protection anti-bot éventuelle
                  (Cloudflare Turnstile). Toujours actifs.
                </em>
              </span>
            </label>
            <label className="cookie-consent-row">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={prefs}
                onChange={(e) => setPrefs(e.target.checked)}
              />
              <span>
                <strong>Préférences</strong>
                <em>Thème clair/sombre, guide d&apos;accueil.</em>
              </span>
            </label>
            <label className="cookie-consent-row">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={analytics}
                onChange={(e) => setAnalytics(e.target.checked)}
              />
              <span>
                <strong>Mesure d&apos;audience</strong>
                <em>Non utilisée aujourd&apos;hui — réservée à un outil anonymisé futur.</em>
              </span>
            </label>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="cookie-consent-actions">
          {panel === 'banner' ? (
            <>
              <button type="button" className="cookie-btn linkish" onClick={() => setPanel('details')}>
                Personnaliser
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="cookie-btn secondary" onClick={() => closeWith(acceptNecessaryOnly())}>
                Nécessaires seulement
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="cookie-btn primary" onClick={() => closeWith(acceptAll())}>
                Tout accepter
              </button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <button type="button" className="cookie-btn linkish" onClick={() => setPanel('banner')}>
                Retour
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="cookie-btn primary"
                onClick={() => closeWith(saveConsent({ preferences: prefs, analytics }, 'custom'))}
              >
                Enregistrer mes choix
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return createPortal(body, document.body);
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

const WEEKDAYS = ['Lu', 'Ma', 'Me', 'Je', 'Ve', 'Sa', 'Di'];
const MONTHS = [
  'Janvier', 'Février', 'Mars', 'Avril', 'Mai', 'Juin',
  'Juillet', 'Août', 'Septembre', 'Octobre', 'Novembre', 'Décembre',
];

function parseISO(v: string | undefined | null): Date | null {
  if (!v || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) return null;
  const [y, m, d] = v.split('-').map(Number);
  const dt = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
  if (dt.getFullYear() !== y || dt.getMonth() !== m - 1 || dt.getDate() !== d) return null;
  return dt;
}

function toISO(d: Date): string {
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function startOfMonth(d: Date) {
  return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), 1);
}

function sameDay(a: Date, b: Date) {
  return a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate();
}

function formatDisplay(iso: string): string {
  const d = parseISO(iso);
  if (!d) return '';
  return d.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
}

function formatRange(from: string, to: string): string {
  const a = formatDisplay(from);
  const b = formatDisplay(to);
  if (a && b) return `${a} — ${b}`;
  return a || b || '';
}

function dayCells(view: Date): (Date | null)[] {
  const first = startOfMonth(view);
  const startPad = (first.getDay() + 6) % 7;
  const days: (Date | null)[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < startPad; i++) days.push(null);
  const dim = new Date(view.getFullYear(), view.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
  for (let d = 1; d <= dim; d++) days.push(new Date(view.getFullYear(), view.getMonth(), d));
  while (days.length % 7 !== 0) days.push(null);
  return days;
}

function usePopPosition(open: boolean, triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, popRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, minW = 280) {
  const [pos, setPos] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0, width: minW });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const place = () => {
      const el = triggerRef.current;
      if (!el) return;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const width = Math.max(minW, Math.min(340, r.width < 200 ? minW : r.width));
      let left = r.left;
      let top = r.bottom + 6;
      if (left + width > window.innerWidth - 8) left = Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - width - 8);
      if (top + 340 > window.innerHeight - 8) top = Math.max(8, r.top - 346);
      setPos({ top, left, width });
    };
    place();
    const onDoc = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as Node;
      if (triggerRef.current?.contains(t) || popRef.current?.contains(t)) return;
      // close handled by parent via callback — attach on document in parent
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', place);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', place, true);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', place);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', place, true);
    };
  }, [open, triggerRef, popRef, minW]);
  return pos;
}

export type DatePickerProps = {
  value: string;
  onChange: (iso: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  className?: string;
  id?: string;
  min?: string;
  max?: string;
  /** First year in dropdown (default 1910 — birthdays, founding dates, etc.) */
  minYear?: number;
  /** Last year in dropdown (default current year + 10) */
  maxYear?: number;
  size?: 'md' | 'sm';
};

/** Single-date calendar — neutral secondary UI (no filled primary circles). */
export default function DatePicker({
  value,
  onChange,
  disabled,
  placeholder = 'Choisir une date',
  className = '',
  id,
  min,
  max,
  minYear = 1910,
  maxYear,
  size = 'md',
}: DatePickerProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const fn = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false); };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', fn);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', fn);
  }, [open]);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const popRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const selected = parseISO(value);
  const [view, setView] = useState<Date>(() => startOfMonth(selected || new Date()));
  const pos = usePopPosition(open, triggerRef, popRef, 280);
  const minD = parseISO(min || '');
  const maxD = parseISO(max || '');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selected) setView(startOfMonth(selected));
  }, [value]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDoc = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as Node;
      if (triggerRef.current?.contains(t) || popRef.current?.contains(t)) return;
      setOpen(false);
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDoc);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDoc);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [open]);

  const cells = useMemo(() => dayCells(view), [view]);
  const today = new Date();
  const isDisabledDay = (d: Date) => {
    if (minD && d < new Date(minD.getFullYear(), minD.getMonth(), minD.getDate())) return true;
    if (maxD && d > new Date(maxD.getFullYear(), maxD.getMonth(), maxD.getDate())) return true;
    return false;
  };

  const pop =
    open && typeof document !== 'undefined'
      ? createPortal(
          <div
            ref={popRef}
            className="atlas-dp-pop"
            style={{ top: pos.top, left: pos.left, width: pos.width, zIndex: 100100 }}
            role="dialog"
            aria-label="Calendrier"
          >
            <CalendarMonth
              view={view}
              setView={setView}
              cells={cells}
              selected={selected}
              hover={null}
              rangeStart={null}
              rangeEnd={null}
              today={today}
              isDisabledDay={isDisabledDay}
              minYear={minYear}
              maxYear={maxYear ?? new Date().getFullYear() + 10}
              onPick={(d) => {
                onChange(toISO(d));
                setOpen(false);
              }}
            />
            <div className="atlas-dp-foot">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="atlas-dp-btn secondary"
                onClick={() => {
                  const t = new Date();
                  if (!isDisabledDay(t)) {
                    onChange(toISO(t));
                    setOpen(false);
                  }
                }}
              >
                Aujourd&apos;hui
              </button>
              {value ? (
                <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-btn secondary" onClick={() => { onChange(''); setOpen(false); }}>
                  Effacer
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>,
          document.body,
        )
      : null;

  return (
    <div className={`atlas-dp ${className}`.trim()}>
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        id={id}
        className={`atlas-dp-trigger secondary size-${size}${open ? ' is-open' : ''}`}
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => !disabled && setOpen((o) => !o)}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        aria-expanded={open}
      >
        <span className={`atlas-dp-value${value ? '' : ' is-placeholder'}`}>
          {value ? formatDisplay(value) : placeholder}
        </span>
        <svg className="atlas-dp-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden>
          <rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.75" />
          <path d="M3 10h18M8 3v4M16 3v4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.75" strokeLinecap="round" />
        </svg>
      </button>
      {pop}
    </div>
  );
}

function yearOptions(minY: number, maxY: number): number[] {
  const a = Math.min(minY, maxY);
  const b = Math.max(minY, maxY);
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (let y = b; y >= a; y--) out.push(y); // newest first
  return out;
}

function CalendarMonth({
  view,
  setView,
  cells,
  selected,
  hover,
  rangeStart,
  rangeEnd,
  today,
  isDisabledDay,
  onPick,
  onHover,
  minYear = 1910,
  maxYear,
}: {
  view: Date;
  setView: (d: Date) => void;
  cells: (Date | null)[];
  selected: Date | null;
  hover: Date | null;
  rangeStart: Date | null;
  rangeEnd: Date | null;
  today: Date;
  isDisabledDay: (d: Date) => boolean;
  onPick: (d: Date) => void;
  onHover?: (d: Date | null) => void;
  minYear?: number;
  maxYear?: number;
}) {
  const yMax = maxYear ?? new Date().getFullYear() + 10;
  const yMin = minYear;
  const years = yearOptions(yMin, yMax);
  const inRange = (d: Date) => {
    if (!rangeStart) return false;
    const end = rangeEnd || hover;
    if (!end) return false;
    const a = rangeStart <= end ? rangeStart : end;
    const b = rangeStart <= end ? end : rangeStart;
    const t = d.getTime();
    return t >= a.getTime() && t <= b.getTime();
  };

  return (
    <div className="atlas-dp-cal">
      <div className="atlas-dp-head">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="atlas-dp-nav secondary"
          aria-label="Mois précédent"
          onClick={() => setView(new Date(view.getFullYear(), view.getMonth() - 1, 1))}
        >
          ‹
        </button>
        <div className="atlas-dp-title">
          <select
            className="atlas-dp-select"
            value={view.getMonth()}
            onChange={(e) => setView(new Date(view.getFullYear(), Number(e.target.value), 1))}
            aria-label="Mois"
          >
            {MONTHS.map((m, i) => (
              <option key={m} value={i}>{m}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <select
            className="atlas-dp-select"
            value={view.getFullYear()}
            onChange={(e) => setView(new Date(Number(e.target.value), view.getMonth(), 1))}
            aria-label="Année"
          >
            {years.map((y) => (
              <option key={y} value={y}>{y}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="atlas-dp-nav secondary"
          aria-label="Mois suivant"
          onClick={() => setView(new Date(view.getFullYear(), view.getMonth() + 1, 1))}
        >
          ›
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="atlas-dp-weekdays">
        {WEEKDAYS.map((w) => (
          <span key={w}>{w}</span>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="atlas-dp-grid">
        {cells.map((d, i) =>
          d ? (
            <button
              key={i}
              type="button"
              className={[
                'atlas-dp-day',
                selected && sameDay(d, selected) ? 'is-selected' : '',
                rangeStart && sameDay(d, rangeStart) ? 'is-selected' : '',
                rangeEnd && sameDay(d, rangeEnd) ? 'is-selected' : '',
                inRange(d) ? 'is-in-range' : '',
                sameDay(d, today) ? 'is-today' : '',
                isDisabledDay(d) ? 'is-disabled' : '',
              ]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(' ')}
              disabled={isDisabledDay(d)}
              onMouseEnter={() => onHover?.(d)}
              onMouseLeave={() => onHover?.(null)}
              onClick={() => onPick(d)}
            >
              {d.getDate()}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <span key={i} className="atlas-dp-day is-empty" />
          ),
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export type DateRangePickerProps = {
  from: string;
  to: string;
  onChange: (from: string, to: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  size?: 'md' | 'sm';
  /** Preset ranges shown on the left (dashboard-style) */
  showPresets?: boolean;
};

/** Range picker — dual-step selection + optional presets (daterangepicker-like). */
export function DateRangePicker({
  from,
  to,
  onChange,
  disabled,
  className = '',
  size = 'md',
  showPresets = true,
}: DateRangePickerProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const fn = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false); };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', fn);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', fn);
  }, [open]);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const popRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const start = parseISO(from);
  const end = parseISO(to);
  const [view, setView] = useState<Date>(() => startOfMonth(start || new Date()));
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState<'start' | 'end'>('start');
  const [draftStart, setDraftStart] = useState<Date | null>(start);
  const [draftEnd, setDraftEnd] = useState<Date | null>(end);
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  const pos = usePopPosition(open, triggerRef, popRef, showPresets ? 420 : 300);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setDraftStart(start);
      setDraftEnd(end);
      setPicking('start');
      setView(startOfMonth(start || new Date()));
    }
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDoc = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as Node;
      if (triggerRef.current?.contains(t) || popRef.current?.contains(t)) return;
      setOpen(false);
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDoc);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDoc);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [open]);

  const cells = useMemo(() => dayCells(view), [view]);
  const today = new Date();

  const applyPreset = (key: number | 'today' | 'yesterday' | 'month' | 'lastMonth') => {
    const endD = new Date();
    endD.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    let startD = new Date(endD);
    if (key === 'today') {
      /* same day */
    } else if (key === 'yesterday') {
      startD.setDate(endD.getDate() - 1);
      endD.setDate(endD.getDate() - 1);
    } else if (key === 'month') {
      startD = new Date(endD.getFullYear(), endD.getMonth(), 1);
    } else if (key === 'lastMonth') {
      startD = new Date(endD.getFullYear(), endD.getMonth() - 1, 1);
      const e2 = new Date(endD.getFullYear(), endD.getMonth(), 0);
      onChange(toISO(startD), toISO(e2));
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    } else if (typeof key === 'number') {
      startD.setDate(endD.getDate() - key);
    }
    onChange(toISO(startD), toISO(endD));
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const onPick = (d: Date) => {
    if (picking === 'start') {
      setDraftStart(d);
      setDraftEnd(null);
      setPicking('end');
    } else {
      let a = draftStart || d;
      let b = d;
      if (b < a) {
        const t = a;
        a = b;
        b = t;
      }
      setDraftStart(a);
      setDraftEnd(b);
      onChange(toISO(a), toISO(b));
      setOpen(false);
    }
  };

  const pop =
    open && typeof document !== 'undefined'
      ? createPortal(
          <div
            ref={popRef}
            className={`atlas-dp-pop atlas-dp-range${showPresets ? ' has-presets' : ''}`}
            style={{ top: pos.top, left: pos.left, width: pos.width, zIndex: 100100 }}
            role="dialog"
            aria-label="Période"
          >
            {showPresets && (
              <div className="atlas-dp-presets">
                <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-preset" onClick={() => applyPreset('today')}>Aujourd&apos;hui</button>
                <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-preset" onClick={() => applyPreset('yesterday')}>Hier</button>
                <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-preset" onClick={() => applyPreset(6)}>7 derniers jours</button>
                <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-preset" onClick={() => applyPreset(29)}>30 derniers jours</button>
                <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-preset" onClick={() => applyPreset('month')}>Ce mois</button>
                <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-preset" onClick={() => applyPreset('lastMonth')}>Mois dernier</button>
                <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-preset is-active">Personnalisé</button>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="atlas-dp-range-main">
              <p className="atlas-dp-hint">
                {picking === 'start' ? 'Choisissez la date de début' : 'Choisissez la date de fin'}
              </p>
              <CalendarMonth
                view={view}
                setView={setView}
                cells={cells}
                selected={null}
                hover={hover}
                rangeStart={draftStart}
                rangeEnd={draftEnd}
                today={today}
                isDisabledDay={() => false}
                minYear={1910}
                maxYear={new Date().getFullYear() + 10}
                onPick={onPick}
                onHover={setHover}
              />
              <div className="atlas-dp-foot">
                <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-btn secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                  Annuler
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';

type TableStat = { name: string; rows: number };
type Status = { enabled: boolean; primary: string; source: TableStat[]; target: TableStat[] };

/**
 * v232 — D1 → D1 migration tooling (owner only).
 * Copies every table (schema + rows, chunked) from the main database (company-stock-db)
 * into the optional DB_TARGET binding (atlas-db), then flips the app over with a cutover flag.
 */
export default function DbMigrationPanel() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<'idle' | 'copy' | 'cutover' | 'back'>('idle');
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<string>('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');
  const stopRef = useRef(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const r = await api.dbMigrateStatus();
      setStatus(r.data || null);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(String(e?.message || e));
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  const totalSource = (status?.source || []).reduce((a, t) => a + Math.max(0, t.rows), 0);
  const totalTarget = (status?.target || []).reduce((a, t) => a + Math.max(0, t.rows), 0);

  const copy = async () => {
    setBusy('copy');
    setError('');
    stopRef.current = false;
    let cursor: Record<string, number> = {};
    let copiedTotal = 0;
    try {
      for (let pass = 0; pass < 400; pass++) {
        if (stopRef.current) break;
        const r = await api.dbMigrateCopy({ cursor });
        cursor = r.data?.cursor || {};
        copiedTotal += Object.values(r.data?.copied || {}).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
        setProgress(`${copiedTotal} ligne(s) copiée(s)…`);
        if (!Object.keys(cursor).length) break;
      }
      await load();
      setProgress(stopRef.current ? 'Copie interrompue.' : 'Copie terminée ✓');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(String(e?.message || e));
    } finally {
      setBusy('idle');
    }
  };

  const cutover = async (on: boolean) => {
    setBusy(on ? 'cutover' : 'back');
    setError('');
    try {
      await api.dbMigrateCutover(on);
      await load();
      setProgress(on ? 'Bascule effectuée : l’application lit/écrit désormais atlas-db.' : 'Retour à company-stock-db.');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(String(e?.message || e));
    } finally {
      setBusy('idle');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="db-mig-panel">
      <h3 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Base de données &amp; migration</h3>
      <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 0, marginBottom: 12 }}>
        Copie intégrale (schéma + données) de <code>company-stock-db</code> vers <code>atlas-db</code> (binding D1
        « DB_TARGET »), puis bascule définitive depuis les Paramètres. Aucune donnée n’est supprimée.
      </p>
      {!status?.enabled ? (
        <div className="modal-note">
          Binding « DB_TARGET » non détecté sur ce déploiement. Ajoutez la base D1 <code>atlas-db</code> comme
          binding <code>DB_TARGET</code> (wrangler.jsonc ou tableau de bord Cloudflare) puis redéployez pour activer
          la migration.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="db-mig-grid">
            <div>
              <strong>Source (company-stock-db)</strong>
              <span className="muted">{totalSource} lignes · {(status?.source || []).length} tables</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <strong>Cible (atlas-db)</strong>
              <span className="muted">{totalTarget} lignes · {(status?.target || []).length} tables</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <strong>Base active</strong>
              <span className="muted">{status?.primary === 'target' ? 'atlas-db' : 'company-stock-db'}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="db-mig-actions">
            <button type="button" disabled={busy !== 'idle'} onClick={() => void copy()}>
              {busy === 'copy' ? 'Copie en cours…' : 'Copier les données'}
            </button>
            {busy === 'copy' && (
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => { stopRef.current = true; }}>
                Arrêter
              </button>
            )}
            {status?.primary !== 'target' ? (
              <button type="button" disabled={busy !== 'idle'} onClick={() => void cutover(true)}>
                {busy === 'cutover' ? 'Bascule…' : 'Basculer définitivement vers atlas-db'}
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy !== 'idle'} onClick={() => void cutover(false)}>
                {busy === 'back' ? 'Retour…' : 'Revenir à company-stock-db'}
              </button>
            )}
            <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy !== 'idle'} onClick={() => void load()}>
              Actualiser
            </button>
          </div>
          {progress && <p className="db-mig-progress" role="status">{progress}</p>}
          {error && <p className="db-mig-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
          <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 10 }}>
            La copie procède par lots de 200 lignes (reprise possible) ; la bascule écrit un drapeau
            <code> db_primary</code> dans les deux bases — réversible à tout moment.
          </p>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * v0.7 — pastille flottante animée qui attire l'attention vers la page de
 * téléchargement de l'APK. Le clic sur le lien ouvre /download dans un
 * nouvel onglet ET masque la pastille ; un × permet de la masquer aussi.
 * Respecte prefers-reduced-motion (voir CSS).
 */
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { getToken } from '../auth';

const KEY = 'atlas-dl-teaser';

export default function DownloadTeaser() {
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try { return localStorage.getItem(KEY) === 'off'; } catch { return true; }
  });
  const loc = useLocation();
  if (hidden || ['/', '/download', '/android', '/desktop'].includes(loc.pathname)) return null;
  const dismiss = () => {
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, 'off'); } catch { /* private mode */ }
    setHidden(true);
  };
  // v0.7.1 — never cover the floating buttons: stack above the Agent fab
  // when connected, and above both fabs on /settings.
  const loggedIn = !!getToken();
  const stack = loc.pathname === '/settings' ? ' atlas-dl-teaser--settings' : loggedIn ? ' atlas-dl-teaser--app' : '';
  return (
    <div className={`atlas-dl-teaser${stack}`}>
      <a
        className="atlas-dl-teaser-link"
        href="/android"
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
        onClick={dismiss}
      >
        <span className="atlas-dl-teaser-dot" aria-hidden />
        App Android · Télécharger l&apos;APK
      </a>
      <button type="button" aria-label="Masquer la suggestion" onClick={dismiss}>×</button>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Component, type ErrorInfo, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { reportCrash } from '../lib/crashReporter';

type Props = { children: ReactNode; label?: string };
type State = { error: Error | null };

function classifyClientError(err: Error | null): { kind: string; code: string; detail: string } {
  const msg = err?.message || String(err || 'Erreur inconnue');
  const name = err?.name || '';
  const low = msg.toLowerCase();

  // Network / HTTP-ish
  if (/failed to fetch|networkerror|load failed|net::/.test(low)) {
    return { kind: 'bad-gateway', code: '503', detail: msg };
  }
  if (/\b502\b|bad gateway/.test(low)) {
    return { kind: 'bad-gateway', code: '502', detail: msg };
  }
  if (/\b503\b|service unavailable/.test(low)) {
    return { kind: 'bad-gateway', code: '503', detail: msg };
  }
  if (/\b504\b|timeout|timed out/.test(low)) {
    return { kind: 'bad-gateway', code: '504', detail: msg };
  }
  if (/\b401\b|unauthorized|not authenticated/.test(low)) {
    return { kind: 'crash', code: '401', detail: msg };
  }
  if (/\b403\b|forbidden|accès refusé|access denied/.test(low)) {
    return { kind: 'crash', code: '403', detail: msg };
  }
  if (/\b404\b|not found/.test(low)) {
    return { kind: 'not-found', code: '404', detail: msg };
  }
  if (/\b500\b|internal server/.test(low)) {
    return { kind: 'crash', code: '500', detail: msg };
  }
  if (name === 'ChunkLoadError' || /loading chunk|dynamically imported module/.test(low)) {
    return { kind: 'bad-gateway', code: '503', detail: 'Mise à jour en cours — rechargez la page.\n' + msg };
  }
  if (/before initialization|cannot access/.test(low)) {
    return {
      kind: 'crash',
      code: 'ERR',
      detail: 'Erreur d’initialisation (ordre de chargement). Rechargez la page.\n' + msg,
    };
  }
  return { kind: 'crash', code: 'ERR', detail: msg };
}

/**
 * Full-page crash UI (same ghost language as 404 / AccessPage).
 */
export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  state: State = { error: null };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, info: ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('[ErrorBoundary]', this.props.label || 'app', error, info?.componentStack);
    // v260 — auto-report to the owner's GitHub issues (deduped + sanitized)
    reportCrash(error, { componentStack: String(info?.componentStack || '').slice(0, 2000) });
  }

  reset = () => this.setState({ error: null });

  reload = () => {
    try {
      window.location.reload();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  };

  /** Leave the crash screen for home; full navigation so the boundary unmounts. */
  goHome = () => {
    const path = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location?.pathname) || '/';
    const onDashboard = path === '/' || path === '' || path.startsWith('/dashboard');
    this.setState({ error: null });
    try {
      // Dashboard-related crash: hard reload home so a broken dashboard tree is not reused
      if (onDashboard) {
        window.location.assign('/dashboard');
      } else {
        window.location.assign('/dashboard');
      }
    } catch {
      try { window.location.href = '/'; } catch { /* */ }
    }
  };

  render() {
    if (!this.state.error) return this.props.children;
    const classified = classifyClientError(this.state.error);
    // Static UI only — AccessPage uses useLocation and cannot run outside <Router>
    return (
      <div
        className="error-boundary-root"
        style={{
          minHeight: '100vh',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          padding: 24,
          background: '#f5f2eb',
          fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif',
          color: '#0f1b2d',
          textAlign: 'center',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>
          <p style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '0.08em', color: '#94a3b8', margin: '0 0 8px' }}>
            ATLAS · {classified.code}
          </p>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: '1.35rem', margin: '0 0 10px' }}>Une erreur a interrompu l’app</h1>
          <p style={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#71717a', margin: '0 0 20px', whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>
            {classified.detail}
          </p>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, justifyContent: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={this.reload}
              style={{
                padding: '12px 18px',
                borderRadius: 12,
                border: 0,
                background: '#0a0a0a',
                color: '#fff',
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              Actualiser
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={this.goHome}
              style={{
                padding: '12px 18px',
                borderRadius: 12,
                border: '1px solid #e5e0d6',
                background: '#fff',
                color: '#0a0a0a',
                fontWeight: 600,
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              Accueil
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
}

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

/** Renders children into document.body to escape overflow:hidden ancestors. */
export function FloatingPortal({ children, enabled = true }: { children: ReactNode; enabled?: boolean }) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => setMounted(true), []);
  if (!enabled || !mounted || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
  return createPortal(children, document.body);
}

/**
 * GlobalSearchPanel — v0.7.7 : recherche globale en PANNEAU LATÉRAL animé.
 * - s'ouvre par événement `atlas-search-open` (topbars Paramètres & publiques) ;
 * - se superpose à l'Atlas Agent (et réciproquement) selon l'ordre d'ouverture :
 *   chaque ouverture monte d'un cran la couche zIndex (compteur global, aucune
 *   boucle : les panneaux ne se ferment jamais l'un l'autre) ;
 * - résultats = pages publiques + routes applicatives + sections Paramètres +
 *   produits / clients / factures (API, mis en cache 60 s), filtrés côté client ;
 * - rendu des résultats = STRICTEMENT le sélecteur des popups
 *   (`.atlas-typeahead-*`, celui du sélecteur de produits).
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api } from '../api';
import { isLoggedIn } from '../auth';

export type SearchRow = {
  id: string;
  href: string;
  label: string;
  sub?: string;
  meta?: string;
  ava?: string;
};

/** Monte la couche z du panneau ouvert en dernier (agent ou recherche). */
export function bumpAtlasLayer(varName: string): void {
  try {
    const seq = Number(document.documentElement.dataset.atlasLayerSeq || '0') + 1;
    document.documentElement.dataset.atlasLayerSeq = String(seq);
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(varName, String(100 + seq * 10));
  } catch { /* SSR / tests */ }
}

const norm = (s: string): string =>
  s.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim();

const PUBLIC_ROWS: SearchRow[] = [
  { id: 'g-home', href: '/', label: 'Accueil', sub: 'Vitrine publique', meta: 'Page', ava: 'AC' },
  { id: 'g-desktop', href: '/desktop', label: 'Bureau', sub: 'Windows · macOS · Linux', meta: 'Page', ava: 'BU' },
  { id: 'g-android', href: '/android', label: 'Android', sub: 'Téléchargement APK', meta: 'Page', ava: 'AN' },
  { id: 'g-wn', href: '/whats-new', label: 'Nouveautés', sub: 'Journal du produit', meta: 'Page', ava: 'NV' },
  { id: 'g-about', href: '/about', label: 'À propos', sub: 'Produit & hébergement', meta: 'Page', ava: 'AP' },
  { id: 'g-login', href: '/login', label: 'Connexion', sub: 'Se connecter à son espace', meta: 'Page', ava: 'CX' },
];

const APP_ROWS: SearchRow[] = [
  { id: 'a-dash', href: '/dashboard', label: 'Tableau de bord', sub: 'Vue d’ensemble', meta: 'App', ava: 'TB' },
  { id: 'a-qs', href: '/quick-sale', label: 'Vente rapide', sub: 'Caisse', meta: 'App', ava: 'VR' },
  { id: 'a-prod', href: '/products', label: 'Produits & stock', sub: 'Inventaire', meta: 'App', ava: 'PR' },
  { id: 'a-cli', href: '/clients', label: 'Clients', sub: 'Carnet & créances', meta: 'App', ava: 'CL' },
  { id: 'a-inv', href: '/invoices', label: 'Factures', sub: 'Facturation', meta: 'App', ava: 'FA' },
  { id: 'a-bal', href: '/balance', label: 'Créances', sub: 'Suivi des paiements', meta: 'App', ava: 'CR' },
  { id: 'a-rep', href: '/reports', label: 'Rapports', sub: 'Statistiques', meta: 'App', ava: 'RA' },
  { id: 'a-set', href: '/settings', label: 'Paramètres', sub: 'Espace de travail', meta: 'App', ava: 'PA' },
];

let dynCache: { at: number; rows: SearchRow[] } | null = null;

const HIST_KEY = 'atlas-search-history-v1';
const loadHist = (): string[] => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(HIST_KEY);
    const arr = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as unknown) : [];
    return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string').slice(0, 12) : [];
  } catch { return []; }
};
const saveHist = (h: string[]) => {
  try { localStorage.setItem(HIST_KEY, JSON.stringify(h.slice(0, 12))); } catch { /* privé */ }
};

export default function GlobalSearchPanel() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [hi, setHi] = useState(0);
  const [dyn, setDyn] = useState<SearchRow[]>(() => dynCache?.rows || []);
  const [hist, setHist] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const loggedIn = typeof isLoggedIn === 'function' ? isLoggedIn() : false;

  useEffect(() => {
    const onOpen = () => {
      bumpAtlasLayer('--z-search');
      setQ('');
      setHi(0);
      setHist(loadHist());
      setOpen(true);
    };
    const onClose = () => setOpen(false);
    window.addEventListener('atlas-search-open', onOpen);
    window.addEventListener('atlas-search-close', onClose);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('atlas-search-open', onOpen);
      window.removeEventListener('atlas-search-close', onClose);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 80);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [open]);

  //_collections métier : une seule fois par ouverture, cache 60 s_
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !loggedIn) return;
    if (dynCache && Date.now() - dynCache.at < 60_000) {
      setDyn(dynCache.rows);
      return;
    }
    let dead = false;
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const [pr, cl, inv] = await Promise.all([
          api.getProducts({ limit: 200 }),
          api.getClients(),
          api.getInvoices(),
        ]);
        if (dead) return;
        const rows: SearchRow[] = [
          ...((pr as any)?.data || []).slice(0, 200).map((p: any, i: number) => ({
            id: `d-p-${p.id ?? i}`,
            href: '/products',
            label: String(p.name || p.label || `Produit ${p.id ?? i}`),
            sub: p.sku ? `SKU ${p.sku}` : 'Produit',
            meta: 'Produit',
            ava: 'PR',
          })),
          ...((cl as any)?.data || []).slice(0, 200).map((c: any, i: number) => ({
            id: `d-c-${c.id ?? i}`,
            href: '/clients',
            label: String(c.name || c.full_name || `Client ${c.id ?? i}`),
            sub: c.phone ? String(c.phone) : 'Client',
            meta: 'Client',
            ava: 'CL',
          })),
          ...((inv as any)?.data || []).slice(0, 200).map((v: any, i: number) => ({
            id: `d-i-${v.id ?? i}`,
            href: '/invoices',
            label: `Facture ${v.number ?? v.id ?? i}`,
            sub: v.party_name || v.client_name || '',
            meta: 'Facture',
            ava: 'FA',
          })),
        ];
        dynCache = { at: Date.now(), rows };
        setDyn(rows);
      } catch { /* hors-ligne : pages & routes suffisent */ }
    })();
    return () => { dead = true; };
  }, [open, loggedIn]);

  const results = useMemo<SearchRow[]>(() => {
    const base = [...PUBLIC_ROWS, ...(loggedIn ? APP_ROWS : []), ...(loggedIn ? dyn : [])];
    const nq = norm(q);
    if (!nq) return base.slice(0, 24);
    return base
      .filter((r) => norm(`${r.label} ${r.sub || ''} ${r.meta || ''}`).includes(nq))
      .slice(0, 40);
  }, [q, dyn, loggedIn]);

  useEffect(() => { setHi(0); }, [q]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const pushHist = (term: string) => {
    const t = term.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    const next = [t, ...loadHist().filter((x) => x !== t)].slice(0, 12);
    saveHist(next);
    setHist(next);
  };
  const dropHist = (term: string) => {
    const next = loadHist().filter((x) => x !== term);
    saveHist(next);
    setHist(next);
  };
  const go = (r: SearchRow) => {
    if (q.trim()) pushHist(q);
    setOpen(false);
    navigate(r.href);
  };

  return (
    <aside
      className="gsp"
      role="dialog"
      aria-label="Recherche globale"
      style={{ zIndex: 'var(--z-search, 115)' } as React.CSSProperties}
    >
      <div className="gsp-head">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'block', flex: '0 0 auto', opacity: .6 }}>
          <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5" />
        </svg>
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          className="gsp-input"
          type="text"
          placeholder="Rechercher : page, produit, client, facture…"
          value={q}
          autoComplete="off"
          aria-label="Recherche globale"
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') { setOpen(false); return; }
            if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); setHi((h) => Math.min(h + 1, results.length - 1)); }
            if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); setHi((h) => Math.max(h - 1, 0)); }
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && results[hi]) { e.preventDefault(); go(results[hi]); }
          }}
        />
        <button type="button" className="gsp-close" aria-label="Fermer la recherche" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'block' }}>
            <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className={`atlas-typeahead-menu gsp-list${!q.trim() && hist.length === 0 ? ' gsp-list--compact' : ''}`} role="listbox" aria-label="Résultats">
        {!q.trim() && hist.length > 0 && (
          <div className="gsp-hist">
            <div className="gsp-hist-head">
              <span>Historique (cet appareil)</span>
              <button type="button" className="gsp-hist-clear" onClick={() => { saveHist([]); setHist([]); }}>
                Tout effacer
              </button>
            </div>
            {hist.map((h) => (
              <div key={h} className="gsp-hist-row">
                <button type="button" className="gsp-hist-item" onClick={() => setQ(h)}>
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'block' }}><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" /><path d="M12 7v5l3 3" /></svg>
                  {h}
                </button>
                <button type="button" className="gsp-hist-x" aria-label={`Retirer ${h} de l'historique`} onClick={() => dropHist(h)}>
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'block' }}><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" /></svg>
                </button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        {!q.trim() && hist.length === 0 && (
          <div className="atlas-typeahead-empty">Tapez un mot pour chercher partout…</div>
        )}
        {q.trim() && results.map((r, i) => (
          <button
            key={r.id}
            type="button"
            role="option"
            aria-selected={i === hi}
            className={`secondary atlas-typeahead-item${i === hi ? ' is-active' : ''}`}
            onMouseEnter={() => setHi(i)}
            onClick={() => go(r)}
          >
            <span className="atlas-typeahead-ava" aria-hidden>{r.ava}</span>
            <span className="atlas-typeahead-main">
              <strong>{r.label}</strong>
              {r.sub ? <span className="atlas-typeahead-sub">{r.sub}</span> : null}
            </span>
            {r.meta ? <span className="atlas-typeahead-meta">{r.meta}</span> : null}
          </button>
        ))}
        {q.trim() && !results.length && (
          <div className="atlas-typeahead-empty">Aucun résultat pour « {q} »</div>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="gsp-hint">↑↓ naviguer · Entrée ouvrir · Échap fermer</p>
    </aside>
  );
}

export type EmptyIconName =
  | 'document'
  | 'package'
  | 'user'
  | 'users'
  | 'receipt'
  | 'quote'
  | 'wallet'
  | 'chart'
  | 'inbox'
  | 'building'
  | 'search'
  | 'check';

const MAP: Record<EmptyIconName, (p: IconProps) => ReactElement> = {
  document: IconDocument,
  package: IconPackage,
  user: IconUser,
  users: IconUsers,
  receipt: IconReceipt,
  quote: IconQuote,
  wallet: IconWallet,
  chart: IconChart,
  inbox: IconInbox,
  building: IconBuilding,
  search: IconSearch,
  check: IconCheck,
};

export function EmptyIcon({ name, size = 40 }: { name: EmptyIconName; size?: number }) {
  const Comp = MAP[name] || IconDocument;
  return <Comp size={size} />;
}
