/** Admin: API keys + webhooks (Settings → API) */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { useUi } from './AppDialogs';
import { friendlyError } from '../lib/errors';

export default function IntegrationsPanel() {
  const { toast, confirm } = useUi();
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [hooks, setHooks] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [newKeyName, setNewKeyName] = useState('Clé API');
  const [revealedKey, setRevealedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hookUrl, setHookUrl] = useState('');
  const [hookEvents, setHookEvents] = useState('invoice.created,payment.created,stock.adjusted');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      const [k, h] = await Promise.all([api.listApiKeys(), api.listWebhooks()]);
      setKeys((k as any).data || []);
      setHooks((h as any).data || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(friendlyError(e));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  const createKey = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setMsg('');
    setRevealedKey(null);
    try {
      const r: any = await api.createApiKey({ name: newKeyName.trim() || 'Clé API' });
      setRevealedKey(r.data?.key || null);
      setMsg(r.message || 'Clé créée — copiez-la maintenant.');
      await load();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(friendlyError(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const revokeKey = async (id: number) => {
    if (!(await confirm({ title: 'Révoquer la clé', message: 'Cette clé API ne pourra plus être utilisée.', confirmLabel: 'Révoquer', danger: true }))) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.deleteApiKey(id);
      setMsg('Clé révoquée.');
      await load();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(friendlyError(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const createHook = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setMsg('');
    try {
      const r: any = await api.createWebhook({
        url: hookUrl.trim(),
        events: hookEvents.trim(),
      });
      setMsg(r.message || 'Webhook enregistré.');
      setHookUrl('');
      await load();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(friendlyError(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const removeHook = async (id: number) => {
    if (!(await confirm({ title: 'Supprimer le webhook', message: 'Les notifications vers cette URL s’arrêteront.', confirmLabel: 'Supprimer', danger: true }))) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.deleteWebhook(id);
      setMsg('Webhook supprimé.');
      await load();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(friendlyError(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <p className="muted">Chargement des intégrations…</p>;

  return (
    <div>
      {err && (
        <p style={{ color: 'var(--bad, #b91c1c)', fontSize: 13 }}>{err}</p>
      )}
      {msg && (
        <p style={{ color: 'var(--ok, #71717a)', fontSize: 13 }}>{msg}</p>
      )}

      {revealedKey && (
        <div
          style={{
            marginBottom: 12,
            padding: 12,
            borderRadius: 10,
            border: '1px solid var(--line)',
            background: 'var(--paper-2, #f7f4ee)',
          }}
        >
          <strong style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>Clé (une seule fois)</strong>
          <code
            style={{
              display: 'block',
              marginTop: 8,
              fontSize: 12,
              wordBreak: 'break-all',
              userSelect: 'all',
            }}
          >
            {revealedKey}
          </code>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="secondary"
            style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 12 }}
            onClick={() => {
              void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(revealedKey);
              setMsg('Clé copiée.');
            }}
          >
            Copier
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 12, alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <input
          value={newKeyName}
          onChange={(e) => setNewKeyName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Nom de la clé"
          style={{ minWidth: 160 }}
        />
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void createKey()}>
          Créer une clé
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void load()}>
          Actualiser
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="table-wrap" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        <table className="data-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Nom</th>
              <th>Préfixe</th>
              <th>Scopes</th>
              <th>Créée</th>
              <th />
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {keys.map((k) => (
              <tr key={k.id}>
                <td>{k.name}</td>
                <td>
                  <code>{k.key_prefix}…</code>
                </td>
                <td style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{k.scopes}</td>
                <td style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{String(k.created_at || '').slice(0, 16)}</td>
                <td>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="danger"
                    style={{ fontSize: 12 }}
                    disabled={busy}
                    onClick={() => void revokeKey(k.id)}
                  >
                    Révoquer
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
            {!keys.length && (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={5} className="empty">
                  Aucune clé API.
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <h3 style={{ fontSize: 15, marginTop: 8 }}>Webhooks</h3>
      <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
        URL HTTPS appelée sur certains événements (facture, paiement, stock).
      </p>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <input
          value={hookUrl}
          onChange={(e) => setHookUrl(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="https://…"
          style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 200 }}
        />
        <input
          value={hookEvents}
          onChange={(e) => setHookEvents(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="events"
          style={{ minWidth: 180 }}
        />
        <button type="button" disabled={busy || !hookUrl.trim()} onClick={() => void createHook()}>
          Ajouter
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="table-wrap">
        <table className="data-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>URL</th>
              <th>Events</th>
              <th />
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {hooks.map((h) => (
              <tr key={h.id}>
                <td style={{ fontSize: 12, wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>{h.url}</td>
                <td style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{h.events}</td>
                <td>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="danger"
                    style={{ fontSize: 12 }}
                    disabled={busy}
                    onClick={() => void removeHook(h.id)}
                  >
                    Supprimer
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
            {!hooks.length && (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={3} className="empty">
                  Aucun webhook.
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Error / success banner at the bottom of a modal (French UI). */
export function ModalFormError({
  message,
  kind = 'error',
}: {
  message?: string | null;
  kind?: 'error' | 'success' | 'info';
}) {
  if (!message) return null;
  return (
    <div
      className={'modal-form-alert modal-form-alert--' + kind}
      role={kind === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'status'}
    >
      {message}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Clear inline error / hint under a form field. */
export function FieldHint({ error, hint }: { error?: string | null; hint?: string | null }) {
  if (error) {
    return (
      <span className="field-error-msg field-hint field-hint--error" role="alert">
        {error}
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (hint) return <span className="field-hint">{hint}</span>;
  return null;
}

/** Inline error only — use next to any input. */
export function FieldError({ message }: { message?: string | null }) {
  if (!message) return null;
  return (
    <span className="field-error-msg" role="alert">
      {message}
    </span>
  );
}

/** Wrapper: puts children then sticky error at bottom of modal body */
export function ModalFormFooter({
  error,
  success,
  children,
}: {
  error?: string | null;
  success?: string | null;
  children?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="modal-form-footer">
      <ModalFormError message={error} kind="error" />
      <ModalFormError message={success} kind="success" />
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Number field that never shows a lone 0.
 * Uses local string state so clearing stays blank and "0.5" can be typed.
 * Parent still receives a number (empty → 0).
 */
import { useEffect, useState, type InputHTMLAttributes } from 'react';

type Props = Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'type' | 'value' | 'onChange'> & {
  value: number | string | null | undefined;
  onValueChange: (n: number) => void;
};

function toDisplay(v: number | string | null | undefined): string {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return '';
  const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(v);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n === 0) return '';
  return String(v);
}

function toNumber(raw: string): number {
  const t = raw.trim();
  if (t === '' || t === '-' || t === '.' || t === '-.') return 0;
  const n = Number(t);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}

export default function NumberField({
  value,
  onValueChange,
  onBlur,
  onFocus,
  ...rest
}: Props) {
  const [text, setText] = useState(() => toDisplay(value));
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);

  // Sync from parent when not focused (e.g. form reset / load)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focused) setText(toDisplay(value));
  }, [value, focused]);

  return (
    <input
      {...rest}
      type="text"
      inputMode="decimal"
      autoComplete="off"
      value={text}
      placeholder={rest.placeholder ?? ''}
      onFocus={(e) => {
        setFocused(true);
        onFocus?.(e);
      }}
      onChange={(e) => {
        const raw = e.target.value;
        if (raw !== '' && !/^-?\d*\.?\d*$/.test(raw)) return;
        setText(raw);
        // Push number to parent; empty → 0 (save still works)
        onValueChange(toNumber(raw));
      }}
      onBlur={(e) => {
        setFocused(false);
        const n = toNumber(text);
        onValueChange(n);
        // Normalize display: 0 → empty, else clean number string
        setText(n === 0 ? '' : String(n));
        onBlur?.(e);
      }}
    />
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

/** In-app offline screen — not the browser's default offline page */
export default function OfflineBanner() {
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(
    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const on = () => setOnline(true);
    const off = () => setOnline(false);
    window.addEventListener('online', on);
    window.addEventListener('offline', off);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', on);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', off);
    };
  }, []);

  if (online) return null;

  return (
    <div className="atlas-offline" role="alert">
      <div className="atlas-offline-card">
        <div className="atlas-offline-ico" aria-hidden>
          <svg width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.75">
            <path d="M1 1l22 22" />
            <path d="M16.72 11.06A10.94 10.94 0 0 1 19 12.55" />
            <path d="M5 12.55a10.94 10.94 0 0 1 5.17-2.39" />
            <path d="M10.71 5.05A16 16 0 0 1 22.56 9" />
            <path d="M1.42 9a15.91 15.91 0 0 1 4.7-2.88" />
            <path d="M12 20h.01" />
          </svg>
        </div>
        <h2>Pas de connexion</h2>
        <p>
          Atlas Commerce ne peut pas joindre le serveur. Vérifiez le Wi‑Fi ou les données mobiles,
          puis réessayez. Vos dernières données affichées restent visibles hors ligne.
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="primary"
          onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
        >
          Réessayer
        </button>
        <p className="atlas-offline-hint">Astuce : un café pendant que le réseau revient ?</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Shared route-level skeleton while lazy chunks load */
export default function PageSkeleton({ variant = 'list' }: { variant?: 'list' | 'dashboard' | 'form' | 'phone' }) {
  if (variant === 'phone') {
    return (
      <div className="page-skeleton page-skeleton--phone" aria-busy="true" aria-label="Chargement">
        <div className="skeleton skeleton-title" style={{ width: '55%' }} />

  }
  if (variant === 'form') {
    return (
      <div className="page-skeleton" aria-busy="true" aria-label="Chargement">
        <div className="skeleton skeleton-title" style={{ width: '36%' }} />
        <div className="skeleton skeleton-line" style={{ width: '22%' }} />

}

export function PageFallback() {
  return <PageSkeleton variant="list" />;

import { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';

const spring = { type: 'spring' as const, duration: 0.35, bounce: 0 };

/**
 * Route enter — short opacity + lift (interruptible feel via spring).
 */
export default function PageTransition({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const location = useLocation();
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={location.key}
      className="page-anim"
      data-path={location.pathname}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={spring}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

type Props = {
  open: boolean;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  onConfirm: (password: string) => void | Promise<void>;
  onCancel: () => void;
};

/**
 * Simple confirmation dialog (portaled above other modals).
 *
 * The session (login + OTP) is the security gate — re-typing the admin password
 * for every delete/create was removed on purpose: this dialog only asks
 * "are you sure?". `onConfirm` still receives a (empty) password argument so
 * every existing call-site keeps working unchanged.
 */
export default function PasswordConfirm({
  open,
  title = "Confirmer l'action",
  description = 'Cette action est immédiate. Confirmez pour continuer.',
  confirmLabel = 'Confirmer',
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: Props) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setError('');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [open]);

  if (!open || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;

  const submit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      await onConfirm('');
    } catch (err: any) {
      const raw = String(err?.message || err?.error || '');
      const code = String(err?.code || '');
      let msg = raw || 'Échec de la confirmation.';
      if (code === 'FORBIDDEN_ROLE' || code === 'OWNER_ONLY') {
        msg = 'Action non autorisée pour votre compte.';
      } else if (code === 'BAD_PASSWORD') {
        msg = 'Session expirée — reconnectez-vous puis réessayez.';
      }
      setError(msg);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  return createPortal(
    <div
      className="modal-overlay modal-overlay-top"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        background: 'rgba(10, 10, 12, 0.55)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        zIndex: 11000,
        padding: 16,
      }}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !loading) onCancel();
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="modal-card"
        style={{
          background: 'var(--ac-paper, var(--paper, #ffffff))',
          color: 'var(--ac-ink, var(--ink, #0f172a))',
          borderRadius: 14,
          padding: '22px 24px',
          maxWidth: 400,
          width: '100%',
          boxShadow: '0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)',
          border: '1px solid var(--ac-line, var(--line, #e8eaef))',
          position: 'relative',
          zIndex: 11001,
        }}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="pw-confirm-title"
      >
        <h2
          id="pw-confirm-title"
          style={{ margin: '0 0 8px', fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700 }}
        >
          {title}
        </h2>
        <p
          style={{
            margin: '0 0 16px',
            fontSize: 14,
            color: 'var(--ac-muted, var(--muted, #64748b))',
            lineHeight: 1.45,
          }}
        >
          {description}
        </p>
        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            style={{
              background: 'rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.12)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.4)',
              color: 'var(--ac-danger, #dc2626)',
              padding: '10px 12px',
              borderRadius: 8,
              marginBottom: 12,
              fontSize: 13,
            }}
          >
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        <form onSubmit={submit} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="secondary"
            onClick={onCancel}
            disabled={loading}
            style={{ minHeight: 40, borderRadius: 10, padding: '8px 14px' }}
          >
            Annuler
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="danger"
            disabled={loading}
            style={{ minHeight: 40, borderRadius: 10, padding: '8px 16px' }}
          >
            {loading ? '…' : confirmLabel}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { api } from '../api';

type Img = { id: number; url: string; is_primary?: number; alt_text?: string };

/* ─── helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

async function blobToDataUrl(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = () => resolve(String(r.result || ''));
    r.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Lecture blob impossible'));
    r.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

function loadImage(src: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const img = new Image();
    if (src.startsWith('http://') || src.startsWith('https://')) {
      img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    }
    img.onload = () => {
      if (!img.naturalWidth) reject(new Error('Image vide'));
      else resolve(img);
    };
    img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Image illisible'));
    img.src = src;
  });
}

/** Load any src into a clean data: URL (proxy → CDN → fail). */
async function toEditableDataUrl(src: string): Promise<string> {
  if (!src) throw new Error('Aucune image');
  if (src.startsWith('data:image')) return src;

  const errors: string[] = [];
  try {
    const { getApiBase } = await import('../config');
    const base = getApiBase();
    const proxyUrl = `${base}/api/media/proxy?url=${encodeURIComponent(src)}`;
    const res = await fetch(proxyUrl, {
      credentials: 'omit',
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: { Accept: 'image/*' },
    });
    const ct = (res.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!res.ok) {
      let msg = `Proxy HTTP ${res.status}`;
      try {
        const j = await res.clone().json();
        if (j?.error) msg = String(j.error);
      } catch { /* */ }
      throw new Error(msg);
    }
    if (ct.includes('application/json')) {
      const j = await res.json();
      throw new Error(j?.error || 'Proxy JSON');
    }
    const blob = await res.blob();
    if (!blob.size) throw new Error('Proxy vide');
    const typed =
      blob.type && blob.type.startsWith('image/')
        ? blob
        : new Blob([await blob.arrayBuffer()], { type: 'image/jpeg' });
    return await blobToDataUrl(typed);
  } catch (e: any) {
    errors.push(`proxy: ${e?.message || e}`);
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch(src, { mode: 'cors', credentials: 'omit', cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await blobToDataUrl(await res.blob());
  } catch (e: any) {
    errors.push(`cdn: ${e?.message || e}`);
  }

  throw new Error(`Impossible de charger l’image. ${errors.join(' · ')}`);
}

async function rotateDataUrl(src: string, dir: 1 | -1): Promise<string> {
  const img = await loadImage(src);
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = img.naturalHeight;
  c.height = img.naturalWidth;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('Canvas indisponible');
  ctx.translate(c.width / 2, c.height / 2);
  ctx.rotate((dir * 90 * Math.PI) / 180);
  ctx.drawImage(img, -img.naturalWidth / 2, -img.naturalHeight / 2);
  return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.9);
}

/** Crop using pixel box in natural image coordinates. */
async function cropDataUrl(
  src: string,
  box: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number },
): Promise<string> {
  const img = await loadImage(src);
  const sx = Math.max(0, Math.round(box.x));
  const sy = Math.max(0, Math.round(box.y));
  const sw = Math.max(8, Math.min(img.naturalWidth - sx, Math.round(box.w)));
  const sh = Math.max(8, Math.min(img.naturalHeight - sy, Math.round(box.h)));
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = sw;
  c.height = sh;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('Canvas indisponible');
  ctx.drawImage(img, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, sw, sh);
  return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.9);
}

function fileToDataUrl(file: File): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (file.size > 4_000_000) {
      reject(new Error('Image trop lourde (max 4 Mo)'));
      return;
    }
    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = () => resolve(String(r.result || ''));
    r.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Lecture fichier impossible'));
    r.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

/* ─── Crop tool (visible frame + handles) ───────────────────── */

type CropBox = { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }; // natural image pixels

type DragMode =
  | { kind: 'move'; ox: number; oy: number; start: CropBox }
  | { kind: 'resize'; handle: string; ox: number; oy: number; start: CropBox }
  | null;

/**
 * Full crop tool:
 * - loads image to data URL
 * - shows dimmed overlay + crop rectangle
 * - drag to move, corner/edge handles to resize
 * - Apply / rotate buttons
 */
export function ImageWorkbench({
  src,
  onChange,
  compact,
}: {
  src: string;
  onChange: (next: string) => void;
  compact?: boolean;
}) {
  const stageRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const imgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null);
  // CodeQL js/dom-xss guard: only strict image data-URLs may reach <img src>.
  const SAFE_IMG_DATA_URL = /^data:image\/(png|jpe?g|webp|gif);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=\s]+$/i;
  const safeImgUrl = (u: unknown): string | null => {
    const v = String(u || '').trim();
    return SAFE_IMG_DATA_URL.test(v) ? v : null;
  };
  const [dataSrc, setDataSrc] = useState<string | null>(safeImgUrl(src));
  const [nat, setNat] = useState({ w: 0, h: 0 });
  const [crop, setCrop] = useState<CropBox | null>(null);
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState<DragMode>(null);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const originalSrc = useRef(src);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!src.startsWith('data:'));

  // Load remote → data URL once
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setErr('');
    setCrop(null);
    if (src.startsWith('data:image')) {
      const safe = safeImgUrl(src);
      if (!safe) { setErr('Format d’image non pris en charge'); setLoading(false); return; }
      setDataSrc(safe);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setDataSrc(null);
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const data = safeImgUrl(await toEditableDataUrl(src));
        if (cancelled) return;
        if (!data) { setErr('Format d’image non pris en charge'); return; }
        setDataSrc(data);
        onChange(data);
      } catch (e: any) {
        if (!cancelled) setErr(e?.message || 'Chargement impossible');
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [src]);

  const onImgLoad = () => {
    const img = imgRef.current;
    if (!img) return;
    const w = img.naturalWidth;
    const h = img.naturalHeight;
    setNat({ w, h });
    // Default crop = centered 80%
    const cw = Math.round(w * 0.8);
    const ch = Math.round(h * 0.8);
    setCrop({
      x: Math.round((w - cw) / 2),
      y: Math.round((h - ch) / 2),
      w: cw,
      h: ch,
    });
  };

  /** Map display coords → natural pixels (object-fit: contain). */
  const displayMetrics = useCallback(() => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    const img = imgRef.current;
    if (!stage || !img || !nat.w) {
      return { scale: 1, ox: 0, oy: 0, dw: 0, dh: 0 };
    }
    const cw = stage.clientWidth;
    const ch = stage.clientHeight;
    const scale = Math.min(cw / nat.w, ch / nat.h);
    const dw = nat.w * scale;
    const dh = nat.h * scale;
    const ox = (cw - dw) / 2;
    const oy = (ch - dh) / 2;
    return { scale, ox, oy, dw, dh };
  }, [nat.w, nat.h]);

  const clientToNatural = (clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
    const { scale, ox, oy } = displayMetrics();
    const lx = clientX - r.left - ox;
    const ly = clientY - r.top - oy;
    return {
      x: Math.min(nat.w, Math.max(0, lx / (scale || 1))),
      y: Math.min(nat.h, Math.max(0, ly / (scale || 1))),
    };
  };

  const clampCrop = (b: CropBox): CropBox => {
    let { x, y, w, h } = b;
    w = Math.max(16, Math.min(w, nat.w));
    h = Math.max(16, Math.min(h, nat.h));
    x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, nat.w - w));
    y = Math.max(0, Math.min(y, nat.h - h));
    return { x, y, w, h };
  };

  const onPointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent, mode: DragMode) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
    setDrag(mode);
  };

  const onPointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!drag || !crop) return;
    const p = clientToNatural(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    if (drag.kind === 'move') {
      const dx = p.x - drag.ox;
      const dy = p.y - drag.oy;
      setCrop(
        clampCrop({
          x: drag.start.x + dx,
          y: drag.start.y + dy,
          w: drag.start.w,
          h: drag.start.h,
        }),
      );
      return;
    }
    // resize
    const { handle, start } = drag;
    let { x, y, w, h } = start;
    const right = start.x + start.w;
    const bottom = start.y + start.h;
    if (handle.includes('w')) {
      x = Math.min(p.x, right - 16);
      w = right - x;
    }
    if (handle.includes('e')) {
      w = Math.max(16, p.x - start.x);
    }
    if (handle.includes('n')) {
      y = Math.min(p.y, bottom - 16);
      h = bottom - y;
    }
    if (handle.includes('s')) {
      h = Math.max(16, p.y - start.y);
    }
    setCrop(clampCrop({ x, y, w, h }));
  };

  const onPointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    try {
      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
    } catch { /* */ }
    setDrag(null);
  };

  const applyCrop = async () => {
    if (!dataSrc || !crop) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      const next = await cropDataUrl(dataSrc, crop);
      const safeNext = safeImgUrl(next);
      if (safeNext) setDataSrc(safeNext);
      onChange(next);
      // reset crop box on new image
      const img = await loadImage(next);
      setNat({ w: img.naturalWidth, h: img.naturalHeight });
      const cw = Math.round(img.naturalWidth * 0.85);
      const ch = Math.round(img.naturalHeight * 0.85);
      setCrop({
        x: Math.round((img.naturalWidth - cw) / 2),
        y: Math.round((img.naturalHeight - ch) / 2),
        w: cw,
        h: ch,
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e?.message || 'Recadrage impossible');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const applyRotate = async (dir: 1 | -1) => {
    if (!dataSrc) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      const next = await rotateDataUrl(dataSrc, dir);
      const safeNext = safeImgUrl(next);
      if (safeNext) setDataSrc(safeNext);
      onChange(next);
      const img = await loadImage(next);
      setNat({ w: img.naturalWidth, h: img.naturalHeight });
      const cw = Math.round(img.naturalWidth * 0.85);
      const ch = Math.round(img.naturalHeight * 0.85);
      setCrop({
        x: Math.round((img.naturalWidth - cw) / 2),
        y: Math.round((img.naturalHeight - ch) / 2),
        w: cw,
        h: ch,
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e?.message || 'Rotation impossible');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const { scale, ox, oy } = displayMetrics();
  const frame =
    crop && nat.w
      ? {
          left: ox + crop.x * scale,
          top: oy + crop.y * scale,
          width: crop.w * scale,
          height: crop.h * scale,
        }
      : null;

  const handles = ['nw', 'n', 'ne', 'e', 'se', 's', 'sw', 'w'] as const;
  const handlePos = (h: string, f: { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number }) => {
    const size = 14;
    const half = size / 2;
    let left = f.left + f.width / 2 - half;
    let top = f.top + f.height / 2 - half;
    if (h.includes('n')) top = f.top - half;
    if (h.includes('s')) top = f.top + f.height - half;
    if (h.includes('w')) left = f.left - half;
    if (h.includes('e')) left = f.left + f.width - half;
    if (h === 'n' || h === 's') left = f.left + f.width / 2 - half;
    if (h === 'e' || h === 'w') top = f.top + f.height / 2 - half;
    const cursor =
      h === 'n' || h === 's'
        ? 'ns-resize'
        : h === 'e' || h === 'w'
          ? 'ew-resize'
          : h === 'nw' || h === 'se'
            ? 'nwse-resize'
            : 'nesw-resize';
    return { left, top, width: size, height: size, cursor };
  };

  const baseW = compact ? 300 : 480;
  const baseH = compact ? 220 : 320;
  return (
    <div className="image-crop-tool">
      <div
        style={{
          overflow: 'auto',
          maxWidth: baseW + 24,
          maxHeight: baseH + 60,
          margin: '0 auto',
          borderRadius: 12,
          background: 'var(--pie-stage-bg, #0a0a0a)',
        }}
      >
      <div
        ref={stageRef}
        onDoubleClick={() => setZoom((z) => (z > 1 ? 1 : 2))}
        title="Double-clic : zoom ×2 / retour ×1"
        style={{
          position: 'relative',
          width: baseW * zoom,
          height: baseH * zoom,
          margin: zoom === 1 ? '0 auto' : undefined,
          background: 'var(--pie-stage-bg, #0a0a0a)',
          borderRadius: 12,
          overflow: 'hidden',
          userSelect: 'none',
          touchAction: 'none',
          border: '1px solid var(--line, #3f3f46)',
        }}
        onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
        onPointerUp={onPointerUp}
        onPointerCancel={onPointerUp}
      >
        {loading && (
          <div
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 0,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              color: '#ccc',
              fontSize: 13,
              zIndex: 2,
            }}
          >
            Chargement de l’outil de recadrage…
          </div>
        )}
        {dataSrc && (
          <img loading="lazy" decoding="async"
            ref={imgRef}
            src={dataSrc}
            alt=""
            draggable={false}
            onLoad={onImgLoad}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 0,
              width: '100%',
              height: '100%',
              objectFit: 'contain',
              pointerEvents: 'none',
            }}
          />
        )}
        {/* dim outside crop */}
        {frame && (
          <>
            <div
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                inset: 0,
                boxShadow: `inset ${frame.left}px ${frame.top}px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.55),
                  inset ${frame.left - (stageRef.current?.clientWidth || 0)}px ${frame.top}px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.55),
                  inset ${frame.left}px ${frame.top - (stageRef.current?.clientHeight || 0)}px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.55)`,
                pointerEvents: 'none',
              }}
            />
            {/* simpler overlay: dark full + clear window via crop box */}
            <div
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                inset: 0,
                background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
                clipPath: `polygon(
                  0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%, 0% 0%,
                  ${frame.left}px ${frame.top}px,
                  ${frame.left}px ${frame.top + frame.height}px,
                  ${frame.left + frame.width}px ${frame.top + frame.height}px,
                  ${frame.left + frame.width}px ${frame.top}px,
                  ${frame.left}px ${frame.top}px
                )`,
                pointerEvents: 'none',
              }}
            />
            <div
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                left: frame.left,
                top: frame.top,
                width: frame.width,
                height: frame.height,
                border: '2px solid #e8a317',
                boxSizing: 'border-box',
                cursor: 'move',
                // grid lines
                backgroundImage:
                  'linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255,255,255,0.25) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0.25) 1px, transparent 1px)',
                backgroundSize: '33.33% 33.33%',
              }}
              onPointerDown={(e) => {
                if (!crop) return;
                const p = clientToNatural(e.clientX, e.clientY);
                onPointerDown(e, {
                  kind: 'move',
                  ox: p.x,
                  oy: p.y,
                  start: { ...crop },
                });
              }}
            />
            {handles.map((h) => {
              const pos = handlePos(h, frame);
              return (
                <div
                  key={h}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    left: pos.left,
                    top: pos.top,
                    width: pos.width,
                    height: pos.height,
                    background: '#e8a317',
                    border: '2px solid #fff',
                    borderRadius: 3,
                    cursor: pos.cursor,
                    zIndex: 3,
                    boxSizing: 'border-box',
                  }}
                  onPointerDown={(e) => {
                    if (!crop) return;
                    const p = clientToNatural(e.clientX, e.clientY);
                    onPointerDown(e, {
                      kind: 'resize',
                      handle: h,
                      ox: p.x,
                      oy: p.y,
                      start: { ...crop },
                    });
                  }}
                />
              );
            })}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8, marginTop: 10, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy || !dataSrc || zoom <= 1} onClick={() => setZoom((z) => Math.max(1, Math.round((z - 0.5) * 10) / 10))} title="Zoom arrière">
          −
        </button>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 12, minWidth: 44, textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--muted, #a1a1aa)' }}>{Math.round(zoom * 100)}%</span>
        <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy || !dataSrc || zoom >= 4} onClick={() => setZoom((z) => Math.min(4, Math.round((z + 0.5) * 10) / 10))} title="Zoom avant">
          +
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy || !dataSrc || zoom === 1} onClick={() => setZoom(1)}>
          1:1
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="secondary"
          disabled={busy || !dataSrc}
          title="Revenir à la photo d'origine (annule recadrage/rotation)"
          onClick={() => {
            setCrop(null);
            setZoom(1);
            setDataSrc(safeImgUrl(originalSrc.current));
            if (!originalSrc.current.startsWith('data:')) {
              setLoading(true);
              void (async () => {
                try {
                  const res = await fetch(originalSrc.current);
                  const blob = await res.blob();
                  const fr = new FileReader();
                  fr.onload = () => { setDataSrc(safeImgUrl(fr.result)); setLoading(false); };
                  fr.readAsDataURL(blob);
                } catch { setLoading(false); }
              })();
            }
            onChange(originalSrc.current);
          }}
        >
          ↩ Original
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy || !dataSrc} onClick={() => void applyRotate(-1)}>
          ↺ 90°
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy || !dataSrc} onClick={() => void applyRotate(1)}>
          ↻ 90°
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={busy || !dataSrc || !crop}
          onClick={() => void applyCrop()}
          style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}
        >
          {busy ? '…' : 'Appliquer le recadrage'}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="secondary"
          disabled={busy || !nat.w}
          onClick={() => {
            if (!nat.w) return;
            const cw = Math.round(nat.w * 0.8);
            const ch = Math.round(nat.h * 0.8);
            setCrop({
              x: Math.round((nat.w - cw) / 2),
              y: Math.round((nat.h - ch) / 2),
              w: cw,
              h: ch,
            });
          }}
        >
          Réinitialiser cadre
        </button>
      </div>
      {err && <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--bad, #c44)', margin: '8px 0 0' }}>{err}</p>}
      <p style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--muted)', margin: '8px 0 0' }}>
        Déplacez le cadre orange · poignées pour redimensionner · puis « Appliquer le recadrage ».
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ─── Product gallery editor ────────────────────────────────── */

export default function ProductImageEditor({ productId }: { productId: number }) {
  const [images, setImages] = useState<Img[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<Img | null>(null);
  const [editSrc, setEditSrc] = useState('');
  const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const r = await api.getProductImages(productId);
      setImages(r.data || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || 'Images indisponibles');
    }
  }, [productId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  const addFiles = async (files: FileList | null) => {
    if (!files?.length) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      for (const file of Array.from(files)) {
        const data_url = await fileToDataUrl(file);
        await api.addProductImage(productId, {
          data_url,
          is_primary: images.length === 0,
          alt_text: file.name,
        });
      }
      await load();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || 'Échec ajout image');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const remove = async (img: Img) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.deleteProductImage(productId, img.id);
      if (edit?.id === img.id) setEdit(null);
      await load();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || 'Suppression impossible');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const setPrimary = async (img: Img) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.updateProductImage(productId, img.id, { is_primary: true });
      await load();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || 'Impossible de définir la photo principale');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const saveEdit = async () => {
    if (!edit) return;
    if (!editSrc.startsWith('data:')) {
      setErr('Appliquez d’abord un recadrage ou une rotation.');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      await api.updateProductImage(productId, edit.id, {
        data_url: editSrc,
        is_primary: !!edit.is_primary,
      });
      setEdit(null);
      await load();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || 'Enregistrement image impossible');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="product-image-editor"
      onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'copy'; if (!busy) setDragOver(true); }}
      onDragLeave={(e) => { if (e.currentTarget === e.target) setDragOver(false); }}
      onDrop={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setDragOver(false);
        if (busy) return;
        const files = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files || []).filter((f) => f.type.startsWith('image/'));
        if (files.length) {
          const dt = new DataTransfer();
          files.forEach((f) => dt.items.add(f));
          void addFiles(dt.files);
        } else {
          setErr('Déposez des fichiers image (JPEG, PNG ou WebP).');
        }
      }}
      style={{
        marginTop: 16,
        paddingTop: 12,
        borderTop: '1px solid var(--line, #e0d9cc)',
        borderRadius: 10,
        outline: dragOver ? '2px dashed var(--pie-ring, #e8a317)' : 'none',
        outlineOffset: 4,
        background: dragOver ? 'rgba(232, 163, 23, 0.05)' : 'transparent',
        transition: 'background 0.15s ease, outline-color 0.15s ease',
      }}
    >
      <h3 style={{ fontSize: 13, margin: '0 0 6px' }}>Photos produit</h3>
      <p style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 8 }}>
        Ajoutez, recadrez, tournez ou supprimez. La photo principale sert au catalogue / boutique.
      </p>
      {err && <p style={{ color: 'var(--bad)', fontSize: 12 }}>{err}</p>}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10, marginBottom: 10 }}>
        {images.map((img) => (
          <div
            key={img.id}
            style={{
              width: 92,
              borderRadius: 10,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              border: img.is_primary ? '2px solid var(--pie-ring, #e8a317)' : '1px solid var(--pie-thumb-border, #d4d4d8)',
              background: 'var(--pie-thumb-bg, #faf9f6)',
            }}
          >
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setEdit(img);
                setEditSrc(img.url);
              }}
              style={{ display: 'block', padding: 0, border: 0, background: 'none', width: '100%' }}
            >
              <img loading="lazy" decoding="async"
                src={img.url}
                alt=""
                style={{ width: '100%', height: 72, objectFit: 'cover', display: 'block' }}
              />
            </button>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', fontSize: 10 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="secondary"
                style={{ flex: 1, padding: '3px 0', fontSize: 10 }}
                disabled={busy || !!img.is_primary}
                onClick={() => setPrimary(img)}
              >
                {img.is_primary ? '★ Principale' : 'Définir'}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="danger"
                style={{ padding: '3px 6px', fontSize: 10 }}
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => void remove(img)}
              >
                ×
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        <label
          style={{
            width: '100%',
            minHeight: 58,
            borderRadius: 10,
            border: dragOver ? '2px dashed var(--pie-ring, #e8a317)' : '1px dashed var(--line)',
            background: dragOver ? 'rgba(232, 163, 23, 0.07)' : 'transparent',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            gap: 8,
            fontSize: 12,
            color: 'var(--muted)',
            cursor: busy ? 'wait' : 'pointer',
            textAlign: 'center',
            padding: '10px 12px',
            transition: 'border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease',
          }}
        >
          {busy ? 'Traitement des images…' : dragOver ? 'Relâchez pour ajouter les photos' : 'Déposez une image ici — ou cliquez pour parcourir'}
          <input
            type="file"
            accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
            multiple
            hidden
            disabled={busy}
            onChange={(e) => {
              void addFiles(e.target.files);
              e.target.value = '';
            }}
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      {edit && createPortal(
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => !busy && setEdit(null)}>
          <div
            className="modal-card"
            style={{ maxWidth: 'min(560px, calc(100vw - 32px))' }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <h3 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Modifier la photo — outil de recadrage</h3>
            <ImageWorkbench src={editSrc} onChange={setEditSrc} />
            <div className="modal-actions" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setEdit(null)}>
                Fermer
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="danger" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void remove(edit)}>
                Supprimer
              </button>
              <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void saveEdit()}>
                {busy ? 'Enregistrement…' : 'Enregistrer'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>,
        document.body
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useLocation, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { getTheme, setTheme as applyTheme, subscribeTheme, type ThemeChoice } from '../theme';

import { invalidateAvatarCache } from '../lib/avatarCache';
import { resetWelcome } from '../lib/welcome';
import { useProfileWarm, useProfileTick } from '../lib/useProfileWarm';

const LOGO_DARK = '/atlas-logo-dark.png';
const LOGO_LIGHT = '/atlas-logo-light.png';

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* v0.7.6 — chrome partagé des pages publiques (/, /desktop, /download,
   /about, /whats-new). Tout le rendu critique (formes, couleurs, icônes)
   passe en styles INLINE : aucune feuille de style globale (ancien thème,
   overrides, extensions) ne peut plus transformer les boutons en pastilles
   noires, souligner les pills ni dédoubler le logo. */

export type Platform = 'android' | 'windows' | 'macos' | 'linux';

export const PLATFORM_LABEL: Record<Platform, string> = {
  android: 'Android',
  windows: 'Windows',
  macos: 'macOS',
  linux: 'Linux',
};

/** Détection simple de la plateforme de l'appareil qui visite la page. */
export function detectPlatform(): Platform {
  if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return 'windows';
  const ua = navigator.userAgent;
  if (/android/i.test(ua)) return 'android';
  if (/iphone|ipad|ipod/i.test(ua)) return 'android';
  if (/mac os x|macintosh/i.test(ua)) return 'macos';
  if (/linux|x11/i.test(ua)) return 'linux';
  return 'windows';
}

export function useResolvedTheme(): ThemeChoice {
  const [theme, setT] = useState<ThemeChoice>(() => getTheme());
  useEffect(() => subscribeTheme(setT), []);
  return theme;
}

function resolvedNow(): 'light' | 'dark' {
  const t = getTheme();
  if (t !== 'system') return t;
  try {
    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
  } catch {
    return 'dark';
  }
}

/** Thème réellement affiché ('light' | 'dark'), le mode système suivant l'OS. */
export function useThemeValue(): 'light' | 'dark' {
  const [v, setV] = useState<'light' | 'dark'>(() => resolvedNow());
  useEffect(() => {
    const fn = () => setV(resolvedNow());
    window.addEventListener('atlas-theme-change', fn);
    window.addEventListener('storage', fn);
    let mq: MediaQueryList | null = null;
    try {
      mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
      mq.addEventListener('change', fn);
    } catch { /* anciens navigateurs */ }
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('atlas-theme-change', fn);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', fn);
      try { mq?.removeEventListener('change', fn); } catch { /* */ }
    };
  }, []);
  return v;
}

/** Palette du chrome public, selon le thème résolu. */
function useChromeColors() {
  const dark = useThemeValue() === 'dark';
  return dark
    ? {
        dark: true,
        navBg: 'rgba(24,24,27,.78)', navBorder: 'rgba(63,63,70,.75)', navShadow: '0 10px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.38)',
        ink: '#fafafa', sub: '#a1a1aa', faint: '#71717a',
        pillBg: 'rgba(255,255,255,.05)', pillBorder: 'rgba(63,63,70,.8)',
        ghostBg: 'rgba(255,255,255,.03)', ghostBorder: 'rgba(63,63,70,.95)', ghostInk: '#e4e4e7',
        hover: 'rgba(255,255,255,.08)',
        menuBg: '#18181b', menuBorder: '#27272a', menuShadow: '0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.55)',
        cta: '#c45c26',
      }
    : {
        dark: false,
        navBg: 'rgba(255,255,255,.85)', navBorder: '#e4e4e7', navShadow: '0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08)',
        ink: '#18181b', sub: '#52525b', faint: '#71717a',
        pillBg: '#f4f4f5', pillBorder: '#e4e4e7',
        ghostBg: '#ffffff', ghostBorder: '#e4e4e7', ghostInk: '#27272a',
        hover: '#f4f4f5',
        menuBg: '#ffffff', menuBorder: '#e4e4e7', menuShadow: '0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.14)',
        cta: '#b4531f',
      };
}

/** Toggle système/clair/sombre — v0.7.7 : STRICTEMENT le même trio que le
 *  dashboard (`.settings-topbar-theme`), actif terracotta via CSS. */
export function PublicThemeToggle() {
  const theme = useResolvedTheme();
  const btn = (v: ThemeChoice, label: string): ReactNode => {
    const active = theme === v;
    return (
      <button
        key={v}
        type="button"
        data-theme-toggle
        className={active ? 'active' : undefined}
        onClick={() => applyTheme(v)}
        title={`Thème ${label}`}
        aria-label={`Thème ${label}`}
        aria-pressed={active}
      >
        {ICONS[v]}
      </button>
    );
  };
  return (
    <div className="settings-topbar-theme public-theme-trio" role="group" aria-label="Thème">
      {btn('system', 'système')}
      {btn('light', 'clair')}
      {btn('dark', 'sombre')}
    </div>
  );
}

              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.85" aria-hidden><path d="M13 2L3 14h9l-1 8 10-12h-9l1-8z" /></svg>
              <span className="account-menu-item-label">Nouveautés</span>
            </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              role="menuitem"
              className="secondary settings-topbar-menu-item"
              style={{ color: '#c45c26' }}
              onClick={() => { setOpen(false); clearToken(); invalidateAvatarCache(); window.location.replace('/login'); }}
            >
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.85" aria-hidden><path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4M16 17l5-5-5-5M21 12H9" /></svg>
              Déconnexion
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

 *  Cookies) rendus avec les classes littérales de la topbar Paramètres.

export function PnLegacyTabs() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  return (
    <div className="settings-topbar-tabs pn-tabs" role="navigation" aria-label="Liens utiles">
        {PN_TABS.filter((t) => {
          if (t.id === 'terms') return location.pathname !== '/terms';

          return true;
        }).map((t) => {

            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.85" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden style={{ display: 'block' }}>

export function PublicNav({ links, cta, classic = false }: { links: NavLink[]; cta?: ReactNode; classic?: boolean }) {
  const c = useChromeColors();
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const loggedIn = isLoggedIn();
  // v0.7.7 — la pilule RÉTRÉCIT quand on descend, reprend sa taille en remontant.
  const [compact, setCompact] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    // v0.7.7 — hystérésis : il faut un cumul de 48 px dans une direction pour
    // changer d'état → plus de scintillement au moindre pixel de scroll.
    let last = window.scrollY;
    let acc = 0;
    let compactNow = false;
    const onScroll = () => {
      const y = window.scrollY;
      const d = y - last;
      last = y;
      if (y <= 60) {
        acc = 0;
        if (compactNow) { compactNow = false; setCompact(false); }
        return;
      }
      if (d > 0) {
        acc = acc > 0 ? acc + d : d;
        if (!compactNow && y > 140 && acc > 48) { compactNow = true; setCompact(true); }
      } else if (d < 0) {
        acc = acc < 0 ? acc + d : d;
        if (compactNow && acc < -48) { compactNow = false; setCompact(false); }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
  }, []);
  const tabSt = (extra?: CSSProperties): CSSProperties => ({
    display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', width: compact ? 28 : 32, height: compact ? 28 : 32,
    borderRadius: 10, color: c.sub, textDecoration: 'none', background: 'transparent',
    transition: 'width .18s ease, height .18s ease', ...extra,
  });
  const linkSt = (extra?: CSSProperties): CSSProperties => ({
    padding: compact ? '5px 9px' : '7px 12px', borderRadius: 999, color: c.sub,
    fontSize: compact ? 12.5 : 13.5,
    textDecoration: 'none', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', background: 'transparent',
    border: 0, cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600,
    transition: 'padding .18s ease, font-size .18s ease', ...extra,
  });
  return (
    <header
      style={{
        position: 'sticky', top: compact ? 8 : 14, zIndex: 60,
        padding: compact ? '6px 10px 0' : '14px 16px 0',
        transition: 'padding .18s ease, top .18s ease',
      }}
    >
      <nav
        aria-label="Navigation publique"
        style={{
          maxWidth: 1080, margin: '0 auto', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: compact ? 10 : 14,
          padding: compact ? '5px 8px 5px 12px' : '8px 10px 8px 18px', borderRadius: 999,
          background: c.navBg, border: `1px solid ${c.navBorder}`,
          backdropFilter: 'blur(16px)', WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(16px)',
          boxShadow: c.navShadow,
          transition: 'padding .18s ease, gap .18s ease',
        }}
      >
        <Link to="/" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', textDecoration: 'none', flex: '0 0 auto' }} aria-label="Atlas — accueil">
          <img src={c.dark ? LOGO_DARK : LOGO_LIGHT} alt="Atlas" style={{ height: compact ? 19 : 24, width: 'auto', display: 'block', transition: 'height .18s ease' }} />
        </Link>
        {loggedIn && !classic ? (
          <PnLegacyTabs />
        ) : (
          <div className="pn-links" style={{ gap: 2, margin: '0 auto', minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            {links.map((l) => (
              <a key={l.href} href={l.href} style={linkSt()}>{l.label}</a>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginLeft: 'auto', flex: '0 0 auto' }}>
          {!classic && (
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Recherche globale"
              title="Recherche globale"
              onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('atlas-search-open'))}
              style={{
                display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 999,
                border: 0, background: 'transparent', color: c.sub, cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0,
              }}
            >
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'block' }}>
                <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          )}
          <PublicThemeToggle />
          {isLoggedIn() ? <PublicProfileChip /> : cta}
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Menu"
            aria-expanded={menu}
            onClick={() => setMenu((m) => !m)}
            className="pn-burger-btn pn-burger"
            style={{
              placeItems: 'center', width: 34, height: 34, padding: 0,
              border: `1px solid ${c.ghostBorder}`, borderRadius: 999,
              background: c.ghostBg, color: c.ghostInk, cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'block' }}>
              {menu ? <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" /> : <path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16" />}
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>
      </nav>
      {menu && (
        <div
          style={{
            maxWidth: 1080, margin: '8px auto 0', padding: 8, borderRadius: 18,
            background: c.menuBg, border: `1px solid ${c.menuBorder}`, boxShadow: c.menuShadow,
          }}
        >
          {links.map((l) => (
            <a
              key={l.href}
              href={l.href}
              onClick={() => setMenu(false)}
              style={{ display: 'block', padding: '11px 14px', borderRadius: 12, color: c.ghostInk, textDecoration: 'none', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600 }}
            >
              {l.label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

/** Récupère les dernières versions (bureau via GitHub, Android via manifest.json public). */

 *  compacte (hystérésis 48 px, aucun scintillement). Un SEUL bouton recherche. */
export function PublicSettingsTopbar() {
  const [compact, setCompact] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    let last = window.scrollY;
    let acc = 0;
    let compactNow = false;
    const onScroll = () => {
      const y = window.scrollY;
      const d = y - last;
      last = y;
      if (y <= 60) {
        acc = 0;
        if (compactNow) { compactNow = false; setCompact(false); }
        return;
      }
      if (d > 0) {
        acc = acc > 0 ? acc + d : d;
        if (!compactNow && y > 140 && acc > 48) { compactNow = true; setCompact(true); }
      } else if (d < 0) {
        acc = acc < 0 ? acc + d : d;
        if (compactNow && acc < -48) { compactNow = false; setCompact(false); }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
  }, []);
  const location = useLocation();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();

              </svg>

            </button>
            <span className="settings-topbar-sep" aria-hidden />

        )}
        <div className="settings-topbar-brand">
          <img src="/atlas-icon-light.png" alt="" className="brand-img brand-img--light" width={28} height={28} />
          <img src="/atlas-icon-dark.png" alt="" className="brand-img brand-img--dark" width={28} height={28} />
          <div>
            <strong>{title}</strong>
            <span>Atlas Commerce · beta</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {location.pathname === '/whats-new' ? (
        <div className="settings-topbar-tabs pst-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filtrer le journal">

      {loggedIn && location.pathname !== '/whats-new' && <PnLegacyTabs />}
      <div className="settings-topbar-right">
        {/* v0.7.7 — même gabarit d'icône que la topbar Paramètres, collé au sélecteur
            de thème, jamais masqué (ni en compact, ni en scroll) */}

        </button>
        <PublicThemeToggle />
        {loggedIn ? <PublicProfileChip /> : <PublicSessionCta />}
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

export function usePublicReleases(): { desktop: ReleaseAssets; android: { url: string; label: string } | null; loaded: boolean } {
  const [desktop, setDesktop] = useState<ReleaseAssets>({});
  const [android, setAndroid] = useState<{ url: string; label: string } | null>(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    let dead = false;
    const done = () => { if (!dead) setLoaded(true); };
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const r = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-desktop/releases/latest', { headers: { Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json' } });
        if (r.ok) {
          const j: any = await r.json();
          const assets: { name?: string; browser_download_url?: string }[] = Array.isArray(j?.assets) ? j.assets : [];
          const pick = (re: RegExp) => {
            const f = assets.find((a) => typeof a.name === 'string' && re.test(a.name));
            return f?.browser_download_url || '';
          };
          if (!dead) {
            setDesktop({
              windows: pick(/setup\.exe$/i) || pick(/\.msi$/i),
              macos: pick(/\.dmg$/i),
              linux: pick(/\.AppImage$/i),
            });
          }
        }
      } catch { /* hors-ligne : repli vers /desktop */ }
      // v0.7.7 — source de vérité APK : le manifeste R2 `latest.json`
      // (celui que l'appli Android consulte pour se mettre à jour).
      let apkSet = false;
      try {
        const res = await fetch('https://cdn1.afmarbre.com/app-updates/android/latest.json', { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (res.ok) {
          const m: any = await res.json();
          if (m?.apkUrl && !dead) {
            setAndroid({ url: String(m.apkUrl), label: String(m.versionName || m.version || '') });
            apkSet = true;
          }
        }
      } catch { /* repli ci-dessous */ }
      if (!apkSet) {
        try {
          const res = await fetch('/public/android/manifest.json');
          if (res.ok) {
            const m: any = await res.json();
            const apk = Array.isArray(m?.artifacts) ? m.artifacts.find((a: any) => (a.url || '').endsWith('.apk')) : null;
            if (apk?.url && !dead) setAndroid({ url: String(apk.url), label: String(m?.version || '') });
          }
        } catch { /* /download reste la valeur de repli */ }
      }
      done();
    })();
    return () => { dead = true; };
  }, []);
  return { desktop, android, loaded };
}

/** Démarre un téléchargement : vrai BOUTON (pas un lien) qui ouvre l'asset. */
function startDownload(url: string) {
  if (url.startsWith('/')) {
    window.location.assign(url);
    return;
  }
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.target = '_blank';
  a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
}

/** Bouton de téléchargement scindé : action principale + menu des autres
 *  plateformes. Forme et couleurs 100 % inline (conteneur = pill orange). */
export function PublicDownloadCta({ prefer, full = true }: { prefer?: Platform; full?: boolean }) {
  const { desktop, android } = usePublicReleases();
  const main: Platform = prefer || detectPlatform();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const c = useChromeColors();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDoc = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
      if (box.current && !box.current.contains(ev.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    };
    const onKey = (ev: KeyboardEvent) => { if (ev.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false); };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDoc);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDoc); document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); };
  }, [open]);

  const urlFor = (p: Platform): string => {
    if (p === 'android') return android?.url || '/android';
    return desktop[p] || `/desktop#${p}`;
  };
  const extFor = (p: Platform): string =>
    p === 'android' ? 'APK' : p === 'windows' ? 'MSI / EXE' : p === 'macos' ? 'DMG' : 'AppImage';

  const order: Platform[] = ['android', 'windows', 'macos', 'linux'];
  const others = order.filter((p) => p !== main);

  return (
    <div
      ref={box}
      style={{
        position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'stretch',
        background: c.cta, borderRadius: 999, overflow: 'visible',
        boxShadow: '0 14px 34px rgba(196,92,38,.35)',
      }}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => startDownload(urlFor(main))}
        style={{
          display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9,
          padding: '13px 20px', border: 0, borderRadius: full ? '999px 0 0 999px' : 999,
          background: 'transparent', color: '#fff', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14,
          textDecoration: 'none', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', cursor: 'pointer',
        }}
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'block' }}>
          <path d="M12 3v12M7 10l5 5 5-5M5 21h14" />
        </svg>
        Télécharger pour {PLATFORM_LABEL[main]}
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Autres plateformes"
        aria-expanded={open}
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        style={{
          width: 40, border: 0, borderLeft: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28)',
          borderRadius: '0 999px 999px 0', background: 'transparent', color: '#fff',
          cursor: 'pointer', display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', padding: 0,
        }}
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'block' }}>
          <path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" />
        </svg>
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div
          role="menu"
          style={{
            position: 'absolute', top: 'calc(100% + 10px)', left: 0, minWidth: 272,
            display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', padding: 6, zIndex: 40,
            background: c.menuBg, border: `1px solid ${c.menuBorder}`, borderRadius: 16,
            boxShadow: c.menuShadow,
          }}
        >
          {others.map((p) => (
            <button
              key={p}
              type="button"
              role="menuitem"
              onClick={() => { setOpen(false); startDownload(urlFor(p)); }}
              style={{
                display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
                padding: '10px 12px', borderRadius: 10, border: 0, textAlign: 'left',
                background: 'transparent', color: c.ghostInk, fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: 600,
                cursor: 'pointer', textDecoration: 'none',
              }}
            >
              <span>Télécharger pour {PLATFORM_LABEL[p]}</span>
              <span style={{ color: c.faint, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700 }}>{extFor(p)}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
          <button
            type="button"
            role="menuitem"
            onClick={() => { setOpen(false); navigate('/desktop'); }}
            style={{
              display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
              padding: '10px 12px', borderRadius: 10, border: 0, textAlign: 'left',
              background: 'transparent', color: c.ghostInk, fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: 600,
              cursor: 'pointer', textDecoration: 'none',
            }}
          >
            <span>Toutes les versions bureau</span>
            <span style={{ color: c.faint, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700 }}>→</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Bouton « Star » GitHub avec compteur live. */
export function GitHubStarButton({ repo = 'Etherealmber/atlas-commerce' }: { repo?: string }) {
  const [stars, setStars] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const c = useChromeColors();
  useEffect(() => {
    let dead = false;
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const r = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}`);
        if (r.ok) {
          const j: any = await r.json();
          if (!dead && typeof j?.stargazers_count === 'number') setStars(j.stargazers_count);
        }
      } catch { /* simple bouton */ }
    })();
    return () => { dead = true; };
  }, [repo]);
  return (
    <a
      href={`https://github.com/${repo}`}
      target="_blank"
      rel="noreferrer noopener"
      aria-label={`Dépôt GitHub ${repo}${stars != null ? ` — ${stars} étoiles` : ''}`}
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, padding: '12px 16px',
        borderRadius: 999, border: `1px solid ${c.ghostBorder}`, color: c.ghostInk,
        textDecoration: 'none', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', background: c.ghostBg,
        fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600,
      }}
    >
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" style={{ display: 'block' }}>
        <path d="M12 .5a12 12 0 0 0-3.8 23.4c.6.1.8-.3.8-.6v-2c-3.3.7-4-1.6-4-1.6-.6-1.4-1.4-1.8-1.4-1.8-1-.7.1-.7.1-.7 1.2.1 1.8 1.2 1.8 1.2 1 1.8 2.8 1.3 3.5 1 .1-.8.4-1.3.7-1.6-2.7-.3-5.5-1.3-5.5-5.9 0-1.3.5-2.4 1.2-3.2-.1-.3-.5-1.5.1-3.2 0 0 1-.3 3.3 1.2a11.5 11.5 0 0 1 6 0C17.1 4.7 18.1 5 18.1 5c.6 1.7.2 2.9.1 3.2.8.8 1.2 1.9 1.2 3.2 0 4.6-2.8 5.6-5.5 5.9.4.4.8 1.1.8 2.2v3.3c0 .3.2.7.8.6A12 12 0 0 0 12 .5z" />
      </svg>
      <span>GitHub</span>
      {stars != null && <span style={{ color: c.dark ? '#d4a017' : '#a16207', fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 700 }}>★ {stars.toLocaleString('fr-FR')}</span>}
    </a>
  );
}

/** CTA de connexion / tableau de bord selon la session. */
export function PublicSessionCta({ solid = true }: { solid?: boolean }) {
  const c = useChromeColors();
  const st: CSSProperties = {
    padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 999, fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: 700,
    textDecoration: 'none', whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
    color: solid ? '#fff' : c.ink,
    border: `1px solid ${solid ? c.cta : c.ghostBorder}`,
    background: solid ? c.cta : c.ghostBg,
  };
  return isLoggedIn() ? (
    <Link to="/dashboard" style={st}>Ouvrir l’app</Link>
  ) : (
    <Link to="/login" style={st}>Se connecter</Link>
  );
}

import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes } from 'react';

type Props = ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
  loading?: boolean;
  label?: string;
};

/**
 * Icon-only refresh.
 * Uses a filled path (not stroke) so the glyph always paints.
 * Comfort = round pill; Compact = slight radius (set in CSS).
 */
export default function RefreshIconButton({
  loading = false,
  label = 'Actualiser',
  className = '',
  disabled,
  ...rest
}: Props) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={`icon-refresh-btn secondary ${loading ? 'is-loading' : ''} ${className}`.trim()}
      title={label}
      aria-label={label}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      {...rest}
    >
      <svg
        className={loading ? 'icon-refresh-spin' : undefined}
        width="20"
        height="20"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        aria-hidden="true"
        focusable="false"
        style={{ display: 'block', width: 20, height: 20, flexShrink: 0 }}
      >
        {/* Material-style filled refresh — does not depend on stroke CSS */}
        <path
          fill="#0f172a"
          d="M17.65 6.35A7.958 7.958 0 0 0 12 4V1L7 6l5 5V7c3.31 0 6 2.69 6 6s-2.69 6-6 6-6-2.69-6-6H4c0 4.42 3.58 8 8 8s8-3.58 8-8c0-2.21-.9-4.2-2.35-5.65z"
        />
      </svg>
    </button>
  );
}
