import { FloatingPortal } from './FloatingPortal';
import { useWizard, StepBody, WizardFoot } from './ui/FormWizard';
import { ModalFormError, FieldHint } from './ModalFormFeedback';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import NumberField from './NumberField';
import { statusFr } from '../lib/labels';
import { fmtMoney } from '../lib/money';
import { useUi } from './AppDialogs';
import { friendlyError } from '../lib/errors';

type Props = {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated?: () => void;
  /** Prefer VR tickets when opened from Quick Sale */
  preferQuickSale?: boolean;
};

const REASON_CODES = [
  { value: 'error_us', label: 'Erreur de notre part' },
  { value: 'defective', label: 'Article cassé / défectueux (non causé par le client)' },
  { value: 'wrong_item', label: 'Mauvais article' },
  { value: 'missing_qty', label: 'Quantité manquante' },
  { value: 'transport', label: 'Dommage transport' },
];

/**
 * Shared WR create dialog — used from Factures, Vente rapide, Remboursements.
 */
export default function RemboursementModal({ open, onClose, onCreated, preferQuickSale }: Props) {
  const { confirm, toast } = useUi();
  const [sources, setSources] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [sourceId, setSourceId] = useState<number | ''>('');
  const [source, setSource] = useState<any>(null);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<
    {
      invoice_item_id: number;
      product_name: string;
      max_qty: number;
      already_refunded: number;
      quantity: number;
      unit_price: number;
      restock: boolean;
      disposition: string;
    }[]
  >([]);
  const [reasonCode, setReasonCode] = useState('');
  const [reasonDetail, setReasonDetail] = useState('');
  const [payMethod, setPayMethod] = useState('cash');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const wz = useWizard(2);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');

  const fmt = (n: number) => fmtMoney(n, 'MAD');

  const buildLines = async (data: any) => {
    const prior = await api.getInvoices('remboursement', { kind: 'all' }).catch(() => ({ data: [] }));
    const related = (prior.data || []).filter(
      (x: any) => Number(x.refund_of_invoice_id) === Number(data.id),
    );
    const refundedMap = new Map<number, number>();
    for (const wr of related) {
      try {
        const full = await api.getInvoice(wr.id);
        for (const it of full.data?.items || []) {
          const m = String(it.sku || it.notes || '').match(/src_item:(\d+)/);
          const key = m ? Number(m[1]) : Number(it.product_id || 0);
          if (key) refundedMap.set(key, (refundedMap.get(key) || 0) + Number(it.quantity || 0));
        }
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    }
    return (data.items || []).map((it: any) => {
      const already = refundedMap.get(Number(it.id)) || refundedMap.get(Number(it.product_id || 0)) || 0;
      const maxQty = Math.max(0, Number(it.quantity || 0) - already);
      return {
        invoice_item_id: it.id,
        product_name: it.product_name,
        max_qty: maxQty,
        already_refunded: already,
        quantity: maxQty,
        unit_price: Number(it.unit_price || 0),
        restock: true,
        disposition: '',
      };
    });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setSourceId('');
    setSource(null);
    setLines([]);
    setReasonCode('');
    setReasonDetail('');
    setPayMethod('cash');
    setErr('');
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const [all, qs] = await Promise.all([
          api.getInvoices(undefined, { kind: 'all' }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
          api.getInvoices(undefined, { kind: 'quick_sale' }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
        ]);
        const map = new Map<number, any>();
        for (const inv of [...(all.data || []), ...(qs.data || [])]) {
          if (inv?.id == null) continue;
          const st = String(inv.status || '');
          const kind = String(inv.doc_kind || '');
          // Paid FA / VR are allowed — WR still applies (cash refund to Solde)
          if (st === 'quote' || st === 'devis' || st === 'cancelled' || st === 'remboursement') continue;
          if (kind === 'remboursement') continue;
          map.set(inv.id, inv);
        }
        let list = Array.from(map.values());
        if (preferQuickSale) {
          list = list.sort((a, b) => {
            const av = a.doc_kind === 'quick_sale' || String(a.number || '').startsWith('VR') ? 0 : 1;
            const bv = b.doc_kind === 'quick_sale' || String(b.number || '').startsWith('VR') ? 0 : 1;
            return av - bv;
          });
        }
        setSources(list);
      } catch (e: any) {
        setErr(e?.message || 'Impossible de charger les documents');
      }
    })();
  }, [open, preferQuickSale]);

  const submitWr = async () => {
              if (!sourceId) {
                setErr('Choisissez le document d’origine.');
                return;
              }
              if (!reasonCode) {
                setErr('Sélectionnez un motif valable.');
                return;
              }
              if (reasonDetail.trim().length < 12) {
                setErr('Explication trop courte (min. 12 caractères).');
                return;
              }
              const active = lines.filter((l) => Number(l.quantity) > 0);
              if (!active.length) {
                setErr('Indiquez au moins une quantité à rembourser.');
                return;
              }
              for (const l of active) {
                if (!l.restock && !l.disposition) {
                  setErr(`Disposition obligatoire pour « ${l.product_name} ».`);
                  return;
                }
              }
              const restockCount = active.filter((l) => l.restock).length;
              const ok = await confirm({
                title: 'Confirmer le remboursement WR',
                message: `Créer un avoir WR ?\n• ${restockCount} ligne(s) → retour stock\n• ${active.length - restockCount} hors stock`,
                confirmLabel: 'Créer l’avoir WR',
                cancelLabel: 'Retour',
              });
              if (!ok) return;
              setSaving(true);
              setErr('');
              try {
                const res: any = await api.createRemboursement({
                  refund_of_invoice_id: sourceId,
                  refund_reason_code: reasonCode,
                  refund_payment_method: payMethod,
                  refund_reason: reasonDetail.trim(),
                  items: active.map((l) => ({
                    invoice_item_id: l.invoice_item_id,
                    quantity: l.quantity,
                    restock: l.restock,
                    disposition: l.restock ? undefined : l.disposition,
                  })),
                });
                const msg = res.message || `Avoir ${res.data?.number || 'WR'} créé.`;
                toast(msg, 'success');
                onCreated?.();
                onClose();
              } catch (e: any) {
                const msg = friendlyError(e, 'Impossible de créer le remboursement.');
                setErr(msg);
              } finally {
                setSaving(false);
              }
  };

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <FloatingPortal><div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => !saving && onClose()}>
      <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 720, width: '96vw' }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Créer un remboursement (WR)</h2>
        <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)', lineHeight: 1.5, marginBottom: 12 }}>
          Choisissez une facture ou un ticket VR, les quantités, le motif, et pour chaque ligne si l’article revient
          en stock (par défaut oui).
        </p>
        <StepBody active={wz.step === 1}>
        <div
          className="modal-note modal-note--warn"
          style={{
            padding: '10px 12px',
          }}
        >
          <strong>Numérotation WR-</strong> — distincte des tickets <strong>VR-</strong>. Motifs acceptés : erreur de
          notre part, article défectueux, mauvais article, quantité manquante, dommage transport.
        </div>

        {err && (
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--bad)', fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 8 }}>{err}</p>
        )}

        <div className="form-row">
          <label>Document d’origine *</label>
          <select
            value={sourceId}
            disabled={saving}
            onChange={async (e) => {
              const id = e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : '';
              setSourceId(id);
              setSource(null);
              setLines([]);
              if (!id) return;
              try {
                const res = await api.getInvoice(id);
                setSource(res.data);
                setLines(await buildLines(res.data));
              } catch (ex: any) {
                setErr(ex?.message || 'Chargement impossible');
              }
            }}
          >
            <option value="">— Choisir FA ou ticket VR —</option>
            {sources.map((inv) => (
              <option key={inv.id} value={inv.id}>
                {inv.number}
                {inv.doc_kind === 'quick_sale' || String(inv.number || '').startsWith('VR') ? ' [VR]' : ' [FA]'}
                {' — '}
                {inv.client_name} — {fmt(Number(inv.total || 0))}
                {Number(inv.amount_paid || 0) >= Number(inv.total || 0) - 0.001 ? ' · payé' : ''}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        </StepBody>
        <StepBody active={wz.step === 2}>
        {source && (
          <>
            <p style={{ fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 8 }}>
              Client : <strong>{source.client_name}</strong> · Statut : {statusFr(source.status)} · Payé{' '}
              {fmt(Number(source.amount_paid || 0))} / {fmt(Number(source.total || 0))}
            </p>
            {Number(source.amount_paid || 0) + 0.001 >= Number(source.total || 0) || source.status === 'paid' ? (
              <p className="modal-note modal-note--ok">
                Document déjà payé — le WR créera une <strong>sortie de solde</strong> (remboursement client). Stock ajusté selon les lignes.
              </p>
            ) : Number(source.amount_paid || 0) > 0.001 ? (
              <p className="modal-note modal-note--warn">
                Partiellement payé — crédit sur le reste dû + sortie de solde pour la part déjà encaissée.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p className="modal-note modal-note--warn">
                Non payé — le WR s’applique en crédit sur le reste dû (pas de sortie caisse).
              </p>
            )}
            <h3 style={{ fontSize: 14, margin: '12px 0 8px' }}>Lignes à rembourser</h3>
            <div
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                color: 'var(--muted)',
                display: 'grid',
                gridTemplateColumns: '1.2fr 56px 72px 88px 1fr',
                gap: 6,
                marginBottom: 6,
              }}
            >
              <span>Article</span>
              <span>Max</span>
              <span>Qté</span>
              <span>Stock</span>
              <span>Disposition si hors stock</span>
            </div>
            {lines.map((line, idx) => (
              <div
                key={line.invoice_item_id}
                style={{
                  display: 'grid',
                  gridTemplateColumns: '1.2fr 56px 72px 88px 1fr',
                  gap: 6,
                  marginBottom: 10,
                  alignItems: 'center',
                }}
              >
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
                  {line.product_name}
                  {line.already_refunded > 0 && (
                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                      {' '}
                      (déjà remboursé {line.already_refunded} — reste {line.max_qty})
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                    {fmt(line.unit_price)} / u
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{line.max_qty}</span>
                <NumberField
                  min={0}
                  max={line.max_qty}
                  step="0.01"
                  value={line.quantity}
                  disabled={saving}
                  onValueChange={(v) => {
                    const next = [...lines];
                    next[idx] = { ...next[idx], quantity: Math.min(Math.max(0, v), line.max_qty) };
                    setLines(next);
                  }}
                />
                <label style={{ fontSize: 12, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={line.restock}
                    disabled={saving}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const next = [...lines];
                      next[idx] = { ...next[idx], restock: e.target.checked };
                      setLines(next);
                    }}
                  />
                  Retour
                </label>
                <select
                  value={line.disposition}
                  disabled={saving || line.restock}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const next = [...lines];
                    next[idx] = { ...next[idx], disposition: e.target.value };
                    setLines(next);
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="">—</option>
                  <option value="broken">Cassé</option>
                  <option value="lost">Perdu</option>
                  <option value="other">Autre</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            ))}
          </>
        )}

        <div className="form-row">
          <label>Motif *</label>
          <select value={reasonCode} onChange={(e) => setReasonCode(e.target.value)} disabled={saving}>
            <option value="">— Choisir —</option>
            {REASON_CODES.map((r) => (
              <option key={r.value} value={r.value}>
                {r.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="form-row">
          <label>Explication détaillée *</label>
          <textarea
            rows={3}
            value={reasonDetail}
            onChange={(e) => setReasonDetail(e.target.value)}
            disabled={saving}
            placeholder="Min. 12 caractères — description claire du problème"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="form-row">
          <label>Mode de remboursement (obligatoire si document payé)</label>
          <select value={payMethod} onChange={(e) => setPayMethod(e.target.value)} disabled={saving}>
            <option value="cash">Espèces (caisse)</option>
            <option value="card">Carte</option>
            <option value="transfer">Virement</option>
            <option value="cheque">Chèque</option>
            <option value="other">Autre</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        </StepBody>
        <ModalFormError message={err} />
            <WizardFoot
              title="Remboursement (WR)"
              wz={wz}
              stepLabel={wz.step === 1 ? 'Document & motif' : 'Lignes & dispositions'}
              onCancel={() => !saving && onClose()}
              onSubmit={() => void submitWr()}
              submitLabel={saving ? 'Création…' : 'Créer le remboursement'}
              saving={saving}
            />
      </div>
    </div></FloatingPortal>
  );
}

type Props = {
  message: string;
  type?: 'success' | 'error' | 'saving';
};

export default function SaveFeedback({ message, type = 'success' }: Props) {
  if (!message) return null;

  const colors = {
    success: { bg: 'var(--ok-bg, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1))', color: 'var(--ok, #3f3f46)' },
    error: { bg: 'var(--bad-bg)', color: 'var(--bad)' },
    saving: { bg: 'rgba(59,130,246,0.08)', color: 'var(--muted)' },
  };
  const style = colors[type];

  return (
    <div
      className="save-feedback"
      role="status"
      aria-live="polite"
      style={{
        marginBottom: 16,
        padding: '12px 16px',
        borderRadius: 10,
        background: style.bg,
        color: style.color,
        fontSize: 14,
        fontWeight: 500,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 10,
      }}
    >
      {type === 'saving' && <span className="save-spinner" aria-hidden />}
      {message}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

/**
 * Reset window + main content scroll on every route change
 * so navigating away from a scrolled page does not leave the next page mid-scroll.
 */
export default function ScrollToTop() {
  const { pathname, search, hash } = useLocation();

  useEffect(() => {
    // In-page anchors: let the browser handle hash targets
    if (hash && hash.length > 1) {
      const id = hash.slice(1);
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) {
        el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
        return;
      }
    }

    const reset = () => {
      try {
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, left: 0, behavior: 'auto' });
      } catch {
        window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      }
      // Primary app shell scroll container
      const main = document.querySelector('main.content') as HTMLElement | null;
      if (main) {
        main.scrollTop = 0;
        main.scrollLeft = 0;
      }
      // Any nested page scroll containers used across modules
      document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
        '.atlas-page, .content-scroll, .phone-scroll, .settings-main, .table-wrap',
      ).forEach((node) => {
        // Only reset elements that actually scroll (avoid resetting table inner if user expects keep — still safer to top on route change)
        if (node.scrollTop || node.scrollLeft) {
          node.scrollTop = 0;
          node.scrollLeft = 0;
        }
      });
      // DocumentElement / body for overflow on html
      if (document.documentElement) document.documentElement.scrollTop = 0;
      if (document.body) document.body.scrollTop = 0;
    };

    reset();
    // After layout (lazy routes / images)
    requestAnimationFrame(reset);
    const t = window.setTimeout(reset, 50);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [pathname, search, hash]);

  return null;
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

function pad(n: number) {
  return String(n).padStart(2, '0');
}

/** Normalize to HH:MM */
export function normalizeTime(v: string | null | undefined): string {
  const m = String(v || '').trim().match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (!m) return '';
  const h = Math.min(23, Math.max(0, Number(m[1])));
  const min = Math.min(59, Math.max(0, Number(m[2])));
  return `${pad(h)}:${pad(min)}`;
}

function usePopPosition(
  open: boolean,
  triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
  popRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
  minW = 260,
) {
  const [pos, setPos] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0, width: minW });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const place = () => {
      const el = triggerRef.current;
      if (!el) return;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const width = Math.max(minW, Math.min(300, r.width < 160 ? minW : r.width));
      let left = r.left;
      let top = r.bottom + 6;
      if (left + width > window.innerWidth - 8) left = Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - width - 8);
      if (top + 320 > window.innerHeight - 8) top = Math.max(8, r.top - 326);
      setPos({ top, left, width });
    };
    place();
    window.addEventListener('resize', place);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', place, true);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', place);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', place, true);
    };
  }, [open, triggerRef, popRef, minW]);
  return pos;
}

export type TimePickerProps = {
  value: string;
  onChange: (hhmm: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  id?: string;
  className?: string;
  /** Minute step: 1 | 5 | 15 */
  step?: 1 | 5 | 15;
};

/**
 * Time picker — same interaction model as DatePicker:
 * secondary trigger + portal popover (atlas-dp-*), neutral (no primary green fills).
 */
export default function TimePicker({
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder = 'Choisir une heure',
  disabled,
  id,
  className = '',
  step = 5,
}: TimePickerProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const popRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pos = usePopPosition(open, triggerRef, popRef, 260);

  const norm = normalizeTime(value);
  const [h, m] = norm ? norm.split(':').map(Number) : [9, 0];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDoc = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as Node;
      if (triggerRef.current?.contains(t) || popRef.current?.contains(t)) return;
      setOpen(false);
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDoc);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDoc);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [open]);

  // Scroll selected into view when opened
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !popRef.current) return;
    const hourEl = popRef.current.querySelector('[data-tp-hour].is-selected');
    const minEl = popRef.current.querySelector('[data-tp-min].is-selected');
    hourEl?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
    minEl?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
  }, [open, norm]);

  const hours = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => i);
  const minutes = Array.from({ length: Math.floor(60 / step) }, (_, i) => i * step);

  const pick = (nh: number, nm: number) => {
    onChange(`${pad(nh)}:${pad(nm)}`);
  };

  const now = () => {
    try {
      const s = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR', {
        timeZone: 'Africa/Casablanca',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      const n = normalizeTime(s.replace('h', ':'));
      if (n) {
        onChange(n);
        setOpen(false);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    const d = new Date();
    onChange(`${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(Math.floor(d.getMinutes() / step) * step)}`);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const clear = () => {
    onChange('');
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const pop =
    open && typeof document !== 'undefined'
      ? createPortal(
          <div
            ref={popRef}
            className="atlas-dp-pop atlas-tp-pop"
            style={{ top: pos.top, left: pos.left, width: pos.width, zIndex: 12050 }}
            role="dialog"
            aria-label="Choisir une heure"
          >
            <div className="atlas-tp-head">
              <span className="atlas-tp-head-label">Heure</span>
              <span className="atlas-tp-head-value">{norm || '——:——'}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="atlas-tp-cols">
              <div className="atlas-tp-col">
                <div className="atlas-tp-col-title">H</div>
                <div className="atlas-tp-scroll">
                  {hours.map((hh) => (
                    <button
                      key={hh}
                      type="button"
                      data-tp-hour
                      className={`atlas-tp-cell${hh === h && norm ? ' is-selected' : ''}`}
                      onClick={() => pick(hh, norm ? m : 0)}
                    >
                      {pad(hh)}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="atlas-tp-col">
                <div className="atlas-tp-col-title">Min</div>
                <div className="atlas-tp-scroll">
                  {minutes.map((mm) => (
                    <button
                      key={mm}
                      type="button"
                      data-tp-min
                      className={`atlas-tp-cell${mm === m && norm ? ' is-selected' : ''}`}
                      onClick={() => pick(norm ? h : 9, mm)}
                    >
                      {pad(mm)}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="atlas-dp-footer atlas-tp-footer">
              <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-btn" onClick={now}>
                Maintenant
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-btn" onClick={clear}>
                Effacer
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="atlas-dp-btn is-primary-text" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                OK
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>,
          document.body,
        )
      : null;

  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        id={id}
        ref={triggerRef}
        disabled={disabled}
        className={`atlas-dp-trigger atlas-tp-trigger ${className}`.trim()}
        onClick={() => !disabled && setOpen((o) => !o)}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        aria-expanded={open}
      >
        <span className={norm ? 'atlas-dp-trigger-value' : 'atlas-dp-trigger-placeholder'}>
          {norm || placeholder}
        </span>
        <span className="atlas-tp-trigger-icon" aria-hidden>
          🕒
        </span>
      </button>
      {pop}
    </>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export type TypeaheadOption = {
  id: string | number;
  label: string;
  sub?: string;
  /** Extra line e.g. stock */
  meta?: string;
  searchText?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
};

type Props = {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  onPick: (opt: TypeaheadOption) => void;
  options: TypeaheadOption[];
  placeholder?: string;
  emptyLabel?: string;
  max?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Refresh options when the field is focused (e.g. reload stock) */
  onOpen?: () => void;
};

/**
 * Typeahead: shows what the user types; does NOT auto-select.
 * Pick only on click or Enter (highlighted row).
 */
export default function TypeaheadField({
  value,
  onChange,
  onPick,
  options,
  placeholder = 'Rechercher…',
  emptyLabel = 'Aucun résultat',
  max = 12,
  disabled,
  onOpen,
}: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [hi, setHi] = useState(0);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = value.toLowerCase().trim();
    const list = !q
      ? options
      : options.filter((o) => {
          const hay = (o.searchText || `${o.label} ${o.sub || ''} ${o.meta || ''}`).toLowerCase();
          return hay.includes(q);
        });
    return list.slice(0, max);
  }, [options, value, max]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setHi(0);
  }, [value, open]);

  const pick = (o: TypeaheadOption) => {
    if (o.disabled) return;
    onPick(o);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="atlas-typeahead" ref={rootRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
      <input
        value={value}
        disabled={disabled}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        autoComplete="off"
        aria-autocomplete="list"
        aria-expanded={open}
        onFocus={() => {
          setOpen(true);
          onOpen?.();
        }}
        onChange={(e) => {
          onChange(e.target.value);
          setOpen(true);
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (!open && (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
            setOpen(true);
            return;
          }
          if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
            e.preventDefault();
            setHi((h) => Math.min(h + 1, Math.max(filtered.length - 1, 0)));
          } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
            e.preventDefault();
            setHi((h) => Math.max(h - 1, 0));
          } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            const o = filtered[hi];
            if (o) pick(o);
          } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            setOpen(false);
          }
        }}
        onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setOpen(false), 200)}
      />
      {open && (
        <div className="atlas-typeahead-menu" role="listbox">
          {filtered.map((o, i) => (
            <button
              key={String(o.id)}
              type="button"
              role="option"
              aria-selected={i === hi}
              className={`secondary atlas-typeahead-item${i === hi ? ' is-active' : ''}${o.disabled ? ' is-disabled' : ''}`}
              onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
              onMouseEnter={() => setHi(i)}
              onClick={() => pick(o)}
            >
              <span className="atlas-typeahead-ava" aria-hidden>
                {(o.label || '?').trim().slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
              </span>
              <span className="atlas-typeahead-main">
                <strong>{o.label}</strong>
                {o.sub ? <span className="atlas-typeahead-sub">{o.sub}</span> : null}
              </span>
              {o.meta ? <span className="atlas-typeahead-meta">{o.meta}</span> : null}
            </button>
          ))}
          {!filtered.length && <div className="atlas-typeahead-empty">{emptyLabel}</div>}
          <div className="atlas-typeahead-hint">Entrée pour choisir · Échap pour fermer</div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Build product options with live stock label */
export function productTypeaheadOptions(products: any[]): TypeaheadOption[] {
  return (products || []).map((p) => {
    const stock = Number(p.stock_quantity ?? p.stock ?? p.qty ?? 0);
    const price = Number(p.price ?? p.unit_price ?? p.cost ?? 0);
    const sku = p.sku ? String(p.sku) : '';
    return {
      id: p.id,
      label: p.name || `#${p.id}`,
      sub: [sku, price ? `${price.toLocaleString('fr-FR')} MAD` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
      meta: `Stock ${stock.toLocaleString('fr-FR')}`,
      searchText: `${p.name || ''} ${sku} ${p.barcode || ''}`,
      disabled: false,
    };
  });
}

export function partyTypeaheadOptions(rows: any[], kind: 'client' | 'vendor' = 'client'): TypeaheadOption[] {
  return (rows || []).map((c) => {
    const due = Number(c.balance_due ?? c.balance ?? 0);
    const limit = Number(c.credit_limit ?? 0);
    let meta = '';
    if (kind === 'client') {
      if (limit > 0) {
        meta = due > 0.001
          ? `Crédit ${Math.round(due).toLocaleString('fr-FR')} / ${Math.round(limit).toLocaleString('fr-FR')}`
          : `Crédit max ${Math.round(limit).toLocaleString('fr-FR')}`;
      } else if (due > 0.001) {
        meta = `Ouvert ${Math.round(due).toLocaleString('fr-FR')} MAD`;
      } else {
        meta = 'Crédit libre';
      }
    }
    return {
      id: c.id,
      label: c.name || `#${c.id}`,
      sub: [c.city, c.ice ? `ICE ${c.ice}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
      meta: meta || undefined,
      searchText: `${c.name || ''} ${c.ice || ''} ${c.city || ''} ${c.phone || ''}`,
    };
  });
}

import { useRef, useState, useEffect, type ReactNode } from 'react';

/**
 * Lightweight windowing for large tables (Phase 2 / 5).
 * Renders only ~rowHeight * overscan rows; keeps table semantics.
 * Listens to the nearest scroll parent (VirtualScroll wrapper).
 */
type Props<T> = {
  rows: T[];
  rowHeight?: number;
  overscan?: number;
  maxHeight?: number;
  renderRow: (row: T, index: number) => ReactNode;
  getKey: (row: T, index: number) => string | number;
};

export default function VirtualTableBody<T>({
  rows,
  rowHeight = 44,
  overscan = 8,
  maxHeight = 560,
  renderRow,
  getKey,
}: Props<T>) {
  const anchorRef = useRef<HTMLTableSectionElement>(null);
  const [scrollTop, setScrollTop] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const tbody = anchorRef.current;
    if (!tbody) return;
    let el: HTMLElement | null = tbody.parentElement;
    while (el && el !== document.body) {
      const oy = getComputedStyle(el).overflowY;
      if (oy === 'auto' || oy === 'scroll' || el.classList.contains('atlas-virtual-scroll')) break;
      el = el.parentElement;
    }
    if (!el) return;
    const onScroll = () => setScrollTop(el!.scrollTop);
    el.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    setScrollTop(el.scrollTop);
    return () => el!.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
  }, [rows.length]);

  // Small lists: no virtualization overhead
  if (rows.length <= 60) {
    return (
      <tbody ref={anchorRef}>
        {rows.map((row, i) => (
          <FragmentRow key={getKey(row, i)}>{renderRow(row, i)}</FragmentRow>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    );
  }

  const total = rows.length * rowHeight;
  const start = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / rowHeight) - overscan);
  const visibleCount = Math.ceil(maxHeight / rowHeight) + overscan * 2;
  const end = Math.min(rows.length, start + visibleCount);
  const padTop = start * rowHeight;
  const padBottom = Math.max(0, total - end * rowHeight);

  return (
    <tbody ref={anchorRef}>
      <tr aria-hidden>
        <td colSpan={20} style={{ padding: 0, border: 'none', height: padTop }} />
      </tr>
      {rows.slice(start, end).map((row, i) => (
        <FragmentRow key={getKey(row, start + i)}>{renderRow(row, start + i)}</FragmentRow>
      ))}
      <tr aria-hidden>
        <td colSpan={20} style={{ padding: 0, border: 'none', height: padBottom }} />
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  );
}

/** Wrapper so React accepts fragment-like single parent from renderRow which returns <tr> */
function FragmentRow({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return <>{children}</>;
}

/** Scroll container helper — wrap table with this when virtualizing */
export function VirtualScroll({
  maxHeight,
  children,
}: {
  maxHeight?: number;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className="table-wrap atlas-virtual-scroll"
      style={maxHeight ? { maxHeight, overflow: 'auto' } : undefined}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { WELCOME_PREVIEWS } from '../lib/welcome';

/** One real capture per welcome screen; navigation belongs to the full wizard. */
export function WelcomePreview({ index, onPrevious, onNext }: {
  index: number;
  onPrevious: () => void;
  onNext: () => void;
}) {
  const preview = WELCOME_PREVIEWS[index];
  return (
    <section className="welcome-panel welcome-panel-wide welcome-preview-step" aria-labelledby="welcome-preview-title">
      <p className="welcome-kicker">Découvrez Atlas · Aperçu {index + 1} sur {WELCOME_PREVIEWS.length}</p>
      <h2 id="welcome-preview-title" className="welcome-title" tabIndex={-1}>{preview.title}</h2>
      <p className="welcome-sub">{preview.description}</p>
      <figure className="welcome-preview-media">
        <picture>
          {'poster' in preview && <source media="(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)" srcSet={preview.poster} />}
          <img src={preview.src} alt={preview.alt} decoding="async" />
        </picture>
      </figure>
      <div className="welcome-nav">
        <button type="button" className="welcome-btn-ghost" onClick={onPrevious}>
          <ArrowLeft size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> Précédent
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="welcome-cta" onClick={onNext}>
          Suivant <ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { DISPLAY_VERSION, APP_BUILD_DATE, APP_CHANNEL, RELEASE_VISIBLE_CAP, semverAtMost } from '../version';
import { RELEASES } from '../pages/WhatsNew';
import {
  shouldShowWhatsNewModal,
  markWhatsNewModalSeen,
  markWhatsNewSeen,
} from '../lib/whatsNew';

/** Lightweight once-per-version intro modal (P3). */
export default function WhatsNewModal() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      location.pathname.startsWith('/whats-new') ||
      location.pathname.startsWith('/login') ||
      location.pathname.startsWith('/welcome')
    ) {
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (shouldShowWhatsNewModal()) setOpen(true);
    }, 900);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [location.pathname]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const dismiss = (goFull = false) => {
    markWhatsNewModalSeen();
    setOpen(false);
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('atlas-whats-new-seen'));
    } catch { /* */ }
    if (goFull) {
      markWhatsNewSeen();
      navigate('/whats-new');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="whats-new-modal-backdrop" role="presentation" onClick={() => dismiss(false)}>
      <div
        className="whats-new-modal card"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="whats-new-modal-title"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <p className="atlas-eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>Mise à jour</p>
        <h2 id="whats-new-modal-title" style={{ margin: '0 0 8px', fontSize: '1.25rem' }}>
          Atlas Commerce {DISPLAY_VERSION}
        </h2>
        <p className="muted" style={{ margin: '0 0 16px', lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
          Canal <strong>{APP_CHANNEL}</strong> · build {APP_BUILD_DATE}.  
          Assistants pas à pas partout, thème sombre integral, et sélecteurs façon Discord.
        </p>
        <ul className="whats-new-modal-bullets">
          {RELEASES.filter((r) => semverAtMost(r.version, RELEASE_VISIBLE_CAP))
            .flatMap((r) => r.sections.flatMap((s) => s.items))
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map((it) => (
              <li key={it.id}>{it.text}</li>
            ))}
        </ul>
        <div className="whats-new-modal-actions">
          <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => dismiss(false)}>
            Plus tard
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => dismiss(true)}>
            Voir les nouveautés
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Atlas ERP density tokens (pure CSS — no Tailwind).
 * Light defaults; dark via html.dark / [data-theme="dark"].
 */
:root {
  --atlas-bg-app: #f8fafc;
  --atlas-bg-surface: #ffffff;
  --atlas-bg-hover: #f1f5f9;
  --atlas-border: #e2e8f0;
  --atlas-text-primary: #0f172a;
  --atlas-text-secondary: #71717a;
  --atlas-accent: #0a0a0a; /* was teal; Option B black */
  --atlas-accent-hover: #2a3040;
  --atlas-accent-soft: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
  --atlas-success: #0a0a0a;
  --atlas-warning: #d97706;
  --atlas-danger: #dc2626;
  --atlas-font-size-sm: 12px;
  --atlas-font-size-base: 13px;
  --atlas-radius: 4px;
  --atlas-radius-lg: 8px;
  --space-3xs: 2px;
  --space-2xs: 4px;
  --space-xs: 8px;
  --space-sm: 12px;
  --space-md: 16px;
  --atlas-mono: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;

}

html.dark,
[data-theme="dark"] {
  --atlas-bg-app: #0f172a;
  --atlas-bg-surface: #1e293b;
  --atlas-bg-hover: #334155;

}

  font-family: var(--atlas-sans);

}
.atlas-mono {

/* ── Phase 1 bridge: legacy page tokens → atlas ERP density ── */
:root {
  /* Prefer atlas tokens when screens use either naming */
  --atlas-bg-primary: var(--atlas-bg-app);
  --atlas-text-muted: var(--atlas-text-secondary);
  --atlas-bg-primary-surface: var(--atlas-bg-surface);

  /* Soft-align classic Atlas vars for denser screens */
  --line: var(--atlas-border);
  --muted: var(--atlas-text-secondary);
  --paper: var(--atlas-bg-surface);
  --ok: var(--atlas-success);
  --warn: var(--atlas-warning);
  --bad: var(--atlas-danger);
  --zellij: var(--atlas-accent);
  --zellij-soft: var(--atlas-accent-soft);
}

/* Dense desk content under token layer */
.layout main.content {
  font-size: var(--atlas-font-size-base);
}
.layout main.content .card {
  border: 1px solid var(--atlas-border);
  border-radius: var(--atlas-radius-lg, 8px);
  background: var(--atlas-bg-surface);
}
.layout main.content table {
  font-size: var(--atlas-font-size-sm);
}
.layout main.content th {

  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: var(--atlas-text-secondary);
}

/* Phase 2 Step 3 — Catalog & Inventory density */

.atlas-mobile-nav {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  padding: 6px 10px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
}
html[data-theme="dark"] .atlas-mobile-nav {
  background: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.92);
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .atlas-mobile-nav {
    display: block;
  }
  main.content,
  .layout .content {
    padding-bottom: calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
  }
}
.atlas-mobile-nav-container {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-around;
  align-items: stretch;
  max-width: 520px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  gap: 4px;
}
/* Default: light, not black */
.atlas-mobile-nav .atlas-nav-btn,
button.atlas-nav-btn {
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  color: #71717a !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 52px;
  flex: 1;
  max-width: 88px;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  padding: 6px 4px !important;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  filter: none !important;
  gap: 2px;
  transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, transform 0.12s ease;
}
.atlas-mobile-nav .atlas-nav-btn:hover,
button.atlas-nav-btn:hover {
  background: #f1f5f9 !important;
  color: #0f172a !important;
}
.atlas-mobile-nav .atlas-nav-btn:active,
button.atlas-nav-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}
/* Active: soft neutral, NOT solid black */
.atlas-mobile-nav .atlas-nav-btn.active,
button.atlas-nav-btn.active {
  background: #f1f5f9 !important;
  color: #0a0a0a !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
html[data-theme="dark"] .atlas-mobile-nav .atlas-nav-btn {
  color: #a1a1aa !important;
}
html[data-theme="dark"] .atlas-mobile-nav .atlas-nav-btn.active {
  background: #27272a !important;
  color: #fafafa !important;
}
.atlas-icon-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
}
.atlas-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: -5px;
  right: -11px;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  min-width: 16px;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.atlas-nav-label {
  margin-top: 1px;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import './atlas-tokens.css';
import './MobileBottomNav.css';
import {
  canManageStock,
  canOfficeWork,
  canSell,
  canAccessSettings,
  isStockRole,
} from '../../auth';

type Item = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  path: string;
  icon: string;
  visible: boolean;
};

function buildNav(): Item[] {
  const stockOnly = isStockRole();
  return [
    {
      id: 'dashboard',
      label: 'Accueil',
      path: stockOnly ? '/products' : '/',
      icon: 'M3 12l9-9 9 9M5 10v10h14V10',
      visible: true,
    },
    {
      id: 'products',
      label: 'Stock',
      path: '/products',
      icon: 'M21 16V8a2 2 0 00-1-1.73l-7-4a2 2 0 00-2 0l-7 4A2 2 0 003 8v8a2 2 0 001 1.73l7 4a2 2 0 002 0l7-4A2 2 0 0021 16z',
      visible: canManageStock(),
    },
    {
      id: 'scan',
      label: 'Scan',
      path: '/scan',
      icon: 'M4 7V5a1 1 0 011-1h2M20 7V5a1 1 0 00-1-1h-2M4 17v2a1 1 0 001 1h2M20 17v2a1 1 0 01-1 1h-2M8 12h8',
      visible: canManageStock(),
    },
    {
      id: 'orders',
      label: 'Caisse',
      path: '/quick-sale',
      icon: 'M6 6h15l-1.5 9h-12zM6 6L5 3H2M9 20a1 1 0 100-2 1 1 0 000 2zm9 0a1 1 0 100-2 1 1 0 000 2z',
      visible: canSell() && !stockOnly,
    },
    {
      id: 'invoices',
      label: 'Factures',
      path: '/invoices',
      icon: 'M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8zM14 2v6h6',
      visible: canOfficeWork() && !stockOnly,
    },
    {
      id: 'settings',
      label: 'Réglages',
      path: '/settings',
      icon: 'M12 15a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6zM19.4 15a1.7 1.7 0 00.3 1.8l.1.1a2 2 0 11-2.8 2.8l-.1-.1a1.7 1.7 0 00-1.8-.3 1.7 1.7 0 00-1 1.5V21a2 2 0 11-4 0v-.1a1.7 1.7 0 00-1-1.5 1.7 1.7 0 00-1.8.3l-.1.1a2 2 0 11-2.8-2.8l.1-.1a1.7 1.7 0 00.3-1.8 1.7 1.7 0 00-1.5-1H3a2 2 0 110-4h.1a1.7 1.7 0 001.5-1 1.7 1.7 0 00-.3-1.8l-.1-.1a2 2 0 112.8-2.8l.1.1a1.7 1.7 0 001.8.3H9a1.7 1.7 0 001-1.5V3a2 2 0 114 0v.1a1.7 1.7 0 001 1.5 1.7 1.7 0 001.8-.3l.1-.1a2 2 0 112.8 2.8l-.1.1a1.7 1.7 0 00-.3 1.8V9c.3.6.9 1 1.6 1H21a2 2 0 110 4h-.1a1.7 1.7 0 00-1.5 1z',
      visible: canAccessSettings(),
    },
  ].filter((i) => i.visible);
}

function activePath(pathname: string, path: string) {
  if (path === '/') return pathname === '/' || pathname === '';
  return pathname === path || pathname.startsWith(path + '/');
}

export default function MobileBottomNav({ badges }: { badges?: Partial<Record<string, number>> }) {
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const loc = useLocation();
  const items = buildNav().slice(0, 5);

  return (
    <nav className="atlas-mobile-nav" aria-label="Navigation mobile">
      <div className="atlas-mobile-nav-container">
        {items.map((item) => {
          const isActive = activePath(loc.pathname, item.path);
          const badge = badges?.[item.id];
          return (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              type="button"
              className={`atlas-nav-btn${isActive ? ' active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => nav(item.path)}
              aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
            >
              <div className="atlas-icon-wrapper">
                <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden>
                  <path d={item.icon} />
                </svg>
                {badge && badge > 0 ? (
                  <span className="atlas-badge">{badge > 99 ? '99+' : badge}</span>
                ) : null}
              </div>
              <span className="atlas-nav-label">{item.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import './atlas-tokens.css';
import './TransactionMatchingSheet.css';

export type MatchCandidate = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  amount?: number;
  score?: number;
};

export type SheetTransaction = {
  id?: string;
  date: string;
  description: string;
  amount: number;
  type?: 'deposit' | 'withdrawal';
};

type Props = {
  isOpen?: boolean;
  open?: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  transaction: SheetTransaction | null;
  candidates?: MatchCandidate[];
  onConfirmMatch?: (transactionId: string, matchedId: string) => void;
  onConfirm?: (matchedId: string) => void;
  currency?: string;
};

function fmt(n: number) {
  return Math.round(Math.abs(Number(n || 0))).toLocaleString('fr-FR');
}

/** ERPNext-style matching sheet — pure React + CSS tokens (no Lucide/Tailwind). */
export default function TransactionMatchingSheet({
  isOpen,
  open,
  onClose,
  transaction,
  candidates = [],
  onConfirmMatch,
  onConfirm,
  currency = 'MAD',
}: Props) {
  const shown = isOpen ?? open ?? false;
  const [selectedMatchId, setSelectedMatchId] = useState<string | null>(
    candidates[0]?.id ?? null,
  );

  if (!shown || !transaction) return null;

  const deposit = transaction.type === 'deposit' || transaction.amount >= 0;
  const list = candidates.length
    ? candidates
    : [];

  return (
    <div className="atlas-sheet-backdrop" onClick={onClose} role="presentation">
      <div
        className="atlas-sheet-content"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal
        aria-label="Rapprochement"
      >
        <div className="atlas-sheet-header">
          <div className="atlas-sheet-top-row">
            <span className="atlas-status-tag">Écriture non rapprochée</span>
            <div className="atlas-header-actions">
              <span className="atlas-date-text">{transaction.date}</span>
              <button type="button" className="atlas-close-btn" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Fermer">
                ×
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <h3 className="atlas-sheet-title">{transaction.description || '—'}</h3>
          <p className={`atlas-sheet-amount${deposit ? '' : ' debit'}`}>
            {deposit ? '+' : '−'}
            {fmt(transaction.amount)} {currency}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="atlas-sheet-body">
          <div className="atlas-section-label">
            <span className="atlas-ai-title">Candidats Atlas</span>
            <span>Score</span>
          </div>

          {list.length === 0 && (
            <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--atlas-text-secondary)' }}>
              Aucun candidat automatique. Lancez le rapprochement ou cherchez manuellement.
            </p>
          )}

          {list.map((c) => (
            <button
              key={c.id}
              type="button"
              className={`atlas-match-card${selectedMatchId === c.id ? ' selected' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setSelectedMatchId(c.id)}
            >
              <div className="atlas-card-top">
                <span className="atlas-party-name">{c.title}</span>
                {c.score != null && (
                  <span className="atlas-match-score">{c.score}% match</span>
                )}
              </div>
              {c.subtitle && <p className="atlas-subtext">{c.subtitle}</p>}
              <div className="atlas-card-footer">
                <span>Montant</span>
                <strong className="atlas-mono-amt">
                  {c.amount != null ? `${fmt(c.amount)} ${currency}` : '—'}
                </strong>
              </div>
            </button>
          ))}

          <button
            type="button"
            className="atlas-search-btn"
            onClick={() => {
              window.location.href = '/balance';
            }}
          >
            Rechercher dans Solde & factures
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="atlas-sheet-footer">
          <button type="button" className="atlas-btn-secondary" onClick={onClose}>
            Plus tard
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="atlas-btn-primary"
            disabled={!selectedMatchId}
            onClick={() => {
              if (!selectedMatchId) return;
              onConfirm?.(selectedMatchId);
              onConfirmMatch?.(transaction.id || '', selectedMatchId);
              onClose();
            }}
          >
            Confirmer le match
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import EyeBall from './EyeBall';
import Pupil from './Pupil';

type Props = {
  isTyping?: boolean;
  showPassword?: boolean;
  passwordLength?: number;
  loginFailed?: boolean;
  loginSuccess?: boolean;
};

type Pos = { faceX: number; faceY: number; bodySkew: number };

function calcPos(
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  mx: number,
  my: number,
  rangeX = 15,
  rangeY = 10,
  minX?: number,
  maxX?: number,
  minY?: number,
  maxY?: number
): Pos {
  const rMinX = minX ?? -rangeX;
  const rMaxX = maxX ?? rangeX;
  const rMinY = minY ?? -rangeY;
  const rMaxY = maxY ?? rangeY;
  const dx = mx - cx;
  const dy = my - cy;
  const scaleX = Math.max(Math.abs(rMinX), Math.abs(rMaxX));
  const scaleY = Math.max(Math.abs(rMinY), Math.abs(rMaxY));
  const faceX = Math.max(rMinX, Math.min(rMaxX, dx / (300 / scaleX)));
  const faceY = Math.max(rMinY, Math.min(rMaxY, dy / (300 / scaleY)));
  const bodySkew = Math.max(-6, Math.min(6, -dx / 120));
  return { faceX, faceY, bodySkew };
}

export default function AnimatedCharacters({
  isTyping = false,
  showPassword = false,
  passwordLength = 0,
  loginFailed = false,
  loginSuccess = false,
}: Props) {
  const purpleRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const blackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const orangeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const yellowRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const [hasEntered, setHasEntered] = useState(false);
  const [purpleBlink, setPurpleBlink] = useState(false);
  const [blackBlink, setBlackBlink] = useState(false);
  const [orangeBlink, setOrangeBlink] = useState(false);
  const [yellowBlink, setYellowBlink] = useState(false);
  const [lookingEachOther, setLookingEachOther] = useState(false);
  const [purplePeek, setPurplePeek] = useState(false);
  const [purplePos, setPurplePos] = useState<Pos>({ faceX: 0, faceY: 0, bodySkew: 0 });
  const [blackPos, setBlackPos] = useState<Pos>({ faceX: 0, faceY: 0, bodySkew: 0 });
  const [orangePos, setOrangePos] = useState<Pos>({ faceX: 0, faceY: 0, bodySkew: 0 });
  const [yellowPos, setYellowPos] = useState<Pos>({ faceX: 0, faceY: 0, bodySkew: 0 });
  const [confetti, setConfetti] = useState<{ style: React.CSSProperties; key: number }[]>([]);
  const [successLookY, setSuccessLookY] = useState(-5);

  const centers = useRef({
    purple: { x: 0, y: 0 },
    black: { x: 0, y: 0 },
    orange: { x: 0, y: 0 },
    yellow: { x: 0, y: 0 },
  });
  const pending = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0, need: false });
  const isHiding = passwordLength > 0 && !showPassword;
  const peekingPwd = passwordLength > 0 && showPassword;

  const updateCenters = useCallback(() => {
    const map = [
      ['purple', purpleRef],
      ['black', blackRef],
      ['orange', orangeRef],
      ['yellow', yellowRef],
    ] as const;
    for (const [k, r] of map) {
      if (r.current) {
        const rect = r.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        centers.current[k] = { x: rect.left + rect.width / 2, y: rect.top + rect.height / 3 };
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      pending.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, need: true };
    };
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateCenters, { passive: true });

    let raf = 0;
    const loop = () => {
      if (pending.current.need && hasEntered) {
        pending.current.need = false;
        const { x, y } = pending.current;
        const c = centers.current;
        setPurplePos(calcPos(c.purple.x, c.purple.y, x, y, 30, 20));
        setBlackPos(calcPos(c.black.x, c.black.y, x, y));
        setOrangePos(calcPos(c.orange.x, c.orange.y, x, y, 0, 0, -46, 20, -18, 20));
        setYellowPos(calcPos(c.yellow.x, c.yellow.y, x, y));
      }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };

    const enterT = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setHasEntered(true);
      updateCenters();
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }, 1400);

    const blink = (setB: (v: boolean) => void) => {
      let t: number;
      const schedule = () => {
        t = window.setTimeout(() => {
          setB(true);
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            setB(false);
            schedule();
          }, 150);
        }, Math.random() * 4000 + 3000);
      };
      schedule();
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    };
    const c1 = blink(setPurpleBlink);
    const c2 = blink(setBlackBlink);
    const c3 = blink(setOrangeBlink);
    const c4 = blink(setYellowBlink);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', updateCenters);
      clearTimeout(enterT);
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      c1();
      c2();
      c3();
      c4();
    };
  }, [hasEntered, updateCenters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isTyping) {
      setLookingEachOther(true);
      const t = window.setTimeout(() => setLookingEachOther(false), 800);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }
    setLookingEachOther(false);
  }, [isTyping]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (passwordLength > 0 && showPassword && !purplePeek) {
      const t = window.setTimeout(() => {
        setPurplePeek(true);
        window.setTimeout(() => setPurplePeek(false), 800);
      }, Math.random() * 3000 + 2000);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }
    if (passwordLength === 0 || !showPassword) setPurplePeek(false);
  }, [passwordLength, showPassword, purplePeek]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loginSuccess) {
      setSuccessLookY(-5);
      return;
    }
    const colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#71717a', '#FFE66D', '#A78BFA', '#FF9B6B', '#71717a', '#4D96FF'];
    setConfetti(
      Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, i) => ({
        key: i,
        style: {
          left: `${Math.random() * 100}%`,
          top: `-${10 + Math.random() * 30}%`,
          backgroundColor: colors[i % colors.length],
          width: `${4 + Math.random() * 6}px`,
          height: `${8 + Math.random() * 12}px`,
          animationDelay: `${Math.random() * 2}s`,
          animationDuration: `${4.5 + Math.random() * 2}s`,
          transform: `rotate(${Math.random() * 360}deg)`,
        } as React.CSSProperties,
      }))
    );
    const start = performance.now();
    let id = 0;
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const p = Math.min((now - start) / 5500, 1);
      const eased = p < 0.5 ? 4 * p * p * p : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * p + 2, 3) / 2;
      setSuccessLookY(-5 + 9 * eased);
      if (p < 1) id = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    id = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    const clear = window.setTimeout(() => setConfetti([]), 8000);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(id);
      clearTimeout(clear);
    };
  }, [loginSuccess]);

  const purpleTransform = hasEntered
    ? peekingPwd
      ? 'skewX(0deg)'
      : isTyping || isHiding
        ? `skewX(${(purplePos.bodySkew || 0) - 12}deg) translateX(40px)`
        : `skewX(${purplePos.bodySkew || 0}deg)`
    : undefined;

  const blackTransform = hasEntered
    ? peekingPwd
      ? 'skewX(0deg)'
      : lookingEachOther
        ? `skewX(${(blackPos.bodySkew || 0) * 1.5 + 10}deg) translateX(20px)`
        : isTyping || isHiding
          ? `skewX(${(blackPos.bodySkew || 0) * 1.5}deg)`
          : `skewX(${blackPos.bodySkew || 0}deg)`
    : undefined;

  return (
    <div className="atlas-chars">
      {confetti.length > 0 && (

          {confetti.map((c) => (

          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Purple */}
      <div
        ref={purpleRef}
        className={`atlas-char atlas-char-purple${hasEntered ? ' is-ready' : ''}`}
        style={{
          left: 70,
          width: 180,
          height: isTyping || isHiding ? 440 : 400,

          zIndex: 1,
          transform: purpleTransform,
        }}
      >
        <div
          className="atlas-char-eyes atlas-char-eyes--purple"
          style={{
            left: peekingPwd ? 50 : lookingEachOther ? 85 : 75 + purplePos.faceX,
            top: peekingPwd ? 20 : lookingEachOther ? 50 : 25 + purplePos.faceY,
          }}
        >
          <EyeBall
            size={18}
            pupilSize={7}
            maxDistance={5}
            isBlinking={purpleBlink}
            forceLookX={loginSuccess ? 0 : peekingPwd ? (purplePeek ? 5 : -5) : isHiding ? 6 : lookingEachOther ? 3 : undefined}
            forceLookY={loginSuccess ? successLookY : peekingPwd ? (purplePeek ? 4 : -3) : isHiding ? -6 : lookingEachOther ? 4 : undefined}
          />
          <EyeBall
            size={18}
            pupilSize={7}
            maxDistance={5}
            isBlinking={purpleBlink}
            forceLookX={loginSuccess ? 0 : peekingPwd ? (purplePeek ? 5 : -5) : isHiding ? 6 : lookingEachOther ? 3 : undefined}
            forceLookY={loginSuccess ? successLookY : peekingPwd ? (purplePeek ? 4 : -3) : isHiding ? -6 : lookingEachOther ? 4 : undefined}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

type Props = {
  size?: number;
  pupilSize?: number;
  maxDistance?: number;
  eyeColor?: string;
  pupilColor?: string;
  isBlinking?: boolean;
  forceLookX?: number;
  forceLookY?: number;
  isSad?: boolean;
  sadRotate?: number;
};

export default function EyeBall({
  size = 48,
  pupilSize = 16,
  maxDistance = 10,
  eyeColor = 'white',
  pupilColor = '#0a0a0a',
  isBlinking = false,
  forceLookX,
  forceLookY,
  isSad = false,
  sadRotate = 0,
}: Props) {
  const eyeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [mouse, setMouse] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  useEffect(() => {
    const onMove = (e: MouseEvent) => setMouse({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
  }, []);

  let px = 0;
  let py = 0;
  if (forceLookX !== undefined && forceLookY !== undefined) {
    px = forceLookX;
    py = forceLookY;
  } else if (eyeRef.current) {
    const eye = eyeRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = eye.left + eye.width / 2;
    const cy = eye.top + eye.height / 2;
    const dx = mouse.x - cx;
    const dy = mouse.y - cy;
    const max = Math.max(2, maxDistance);
    const dist = Math.min(Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), max);
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    px = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
    py = Math.sin(angle) * dist;
  }

  const h = isBlinking ? Math.max(3, size * 0.08) : isSad ? size * 0.45 : size;
  const r = isSad ? `0 0 ${size}px ${size}px` : '50%';

  return (
    <div
      ref={eyeRef}
      className={`atlas-eyeball${isSad ? ' atlas-eyeball--sad' : ''}${isBlinking ? ' atlas-eyeball--blink' : ''}`}
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: h,
        backgroundColor: eyeColor,
        borderRadius: r,
        transform: isSad ? `rotate(${sadRotate}deg)` : undefined,
        position: 'relative',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        flexShrink: 0,
        boxShadow: 'inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)',
        transition: 'height 0.12s ease, border-radius 0.12s ease',
      }}
    >
      {!isBlinking && (
        <div
          className="atlas-eyeball-pupil"
          style={{
            width: pupilSize,
            height: pupilSize,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            backgroundColor: pupilColor,
            position: 'absolute',
            left: '50%',
            top: '50%',
            marginLeft: -pupilSize / 2,
            marginTop: -pupilSize / 2,
            transform: `translate(${px}px, ${isSad ? Math.min(py, 0) : py}px)`,
            transition: 'transform 0.08s linear',
            boxShadow: `inset -${Math.max(2, pupilSize * 0.18)}px -${Math.max(2, pupilSize * 0.15)}px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.25)`,
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

type Props = {
  size?: number;
  maxDistance?: number;
  pupilColor?: string;
  forceLookX?: number;
  forceLookY?: number;
  isBlinking?: boolean;
};

/** Standalone pupil (used on faces without full EyeBall). Always centered + look offset. */
export default function Pupil({
  size = 12,
  maxDistance = 5,
  pupilColor = '#0a0a0a',
  forceLookX,
  forceLookY,
  isBlinking = false,
}: Props) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [mouse, setMouse] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  useEffect(() => {
    const onMove = (e: MouseEvent) => setMouse({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
  }, []);

  let px = 0;
  let py = 0;
  if (forceLookX !== undefined && forceLookY !== undefined) {
    px = forceLookX;
    py = forceLookY;
  } else if (ref.current) {
    const r = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
    const cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
    const dx = mouse.x - cx;
    const dy = mouse.y - cy;
    const max = Math.max(2, maxDistance);
    const dist = Math.min(Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), max);
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    px = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
    py = Math.sin(angle) * dist;
  }

  if (isBlinking) {
    return (
      <div
        className="atlas-pupil-dot atlas-pupil-dot--blink"
        style={{
          width: size,
          height: 2,
          backgroundColor: pupilColor,
          borderRadius: 999,
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className="atlas-pupil-dot"
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        backgroundColor: pupilColor,
        transform: `translate(${px}px, ${py}px)`,
        transition: 'transform 0.08s linear',
        boxShadow: `inset -${Math.max(1, size * 0.2)}px -${Math.max(1, size * 0.15)}px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.28)`,
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
    />
  );
}

const spring = { type: 'spring' as const, stiffness: 420, damping: 34, mass: 1 };

function fmtSize(n: number) {
  if (n < 1024) return `${n} o`;
  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} Ko`;
  return `${(n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} Mo`;
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../../api';

type Knowledge = {
  isAdmin: boolean;
  memory: { id: number; username: string; scope: string; content: string; created_at: string }[];
  context: string;
  guardrails: { id: number; rule: string; active: number; created_at: string }[];
  docs: { id: number; name: string; chars: number; created_at: string }[];
  tools: { name: string; description: string; enabled: boolean; allowedForRole: boolean }[];
};

const cardTitle: React.CSSProperties = { fontSize: 15, marginTop: 0, marginBottom: 8 };
const hint: React.CSSProperties = { fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)', lineHeight: 1.5, margin: '0 0 10px' };
const row: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  gap: 8,
  padding: '7px 10px',
  border: '1px solid var(--line)',
  borderRadius: 10,
  marginBottom: 6,
  fontSize: 13,
};
const input: React.CSSProperties = { flex: '1 1 auto', minWidth: 0 };

/**
 * v0.7.7 — Paramètres → Intégrations : pilote MÉMOIRE, CONTEXTE, GARDE-FOUS,
 * OUTILS et BASE DE CONNAISSANCES (RAG) de l'Atlas Agent. Tout est persisté
 * côté serveur (D1) et injecté dans chaque conversation de l'Agent.
 */
export default function AgentKnowledgePanel() {
  const [k, setK] = useState<Knowledge | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [mem, setMem] = useState('');
  const [ctx, setCtx] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [rule, setRule] = useState('');
  const [docName, setDocName] = useState('');
  const [docBody, setDocBody] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const reload = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const r = await api.getAgentKnowledge();
      setK((r as any)?.data || null);
      setCtx((prev) => prev ?? (r as any)?.data?.context ?? '');
    } catch {
      setErr('Impossible de charger le savoir de l’Agent.');
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void reload();
  }, [reload]);

  const run = async (fn: () => Promise<unknown>, okMsg?: string) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      await fn();
      await reload();
      if (okMsg) setErr('');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(String(e?.message || 'Action refusée.'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (!k) {
    return (
      <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 16, padding: 16 }} data-settings-anchor="agent-knowledge">
        <h2 style={cardTitle}>Mémoire & savoir de l’Agent</h2>
        <p style={hint}>{err || 'Chargement…'}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 16, padding: 16 }} data-settings-anchor="agent-knowledge">
      <h2 style={cardTitle}>Mémoire & savoir de l’Atlas Agent</h2>
      <p style={hint}>
        Mémoire, contexte métier, garde-fous, outils et base de connaissances (RAG) : tout ce que l’Agent
        utilise à chaque conversation, éditable ici. La mémoire personnelle est privée à votre compte.
      </p>
      {err && (
        <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#b91c1c', marginBottom: 10 }} role="alert">
          {err}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* ── Mémoire ── */}
      <h3 style={{ fontSize: 13, margin: '14px 0 8px' }}>Mémoire</h3>
      {k.memory.length === 0 && <p style={hint}>Aucun souvenir enregistré pour l’instant.</p>}
      {k.memory.map((m) => (
        <div key={m.id} style={row}>
          <span
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: 800,
              textTransform: 'uppercase',
              padding: '2px 7px',
              borderRadius: 999,
              border: '1px solid var(--line)',
              flex: '0 0 auto',
            }}
          >
            {m.scope === 'org' ? 'Org' : 'Moi'}
          </span>
          <span style={{ flex: '1 1 auto', minWidth: 0 }}>{m.content}</span>
          {(k.isAdmin || m.scope === 'user') && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="secondary"
              style={{ flex: '0 0 auto', padding: '3px 9px', fontSize: 12 }}
              disabled={busy}
              aria-label={`Supprimer le souvenir ${m.content}`}
              onClick={() => void run(() => api.deleteAgentMemory(m.id))}
            >
              Retirer
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
        <input
          style={input}
          value={mem}
          maxLength={500}
          placeholder="Ex. : le client préfère les factures par WhatsApp…"
          onChange={(e) => setMem(e.target.value)}
          aria-label="Nouveau souvenir"
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="secondary"
          disabled={busy || !mem.trim()}
          onClick={() => {
            const v = mem.trim();
            setMem('');
            void run(() => api.addAgentMemory(v, 'user'));
          }}
        >
          Mémoriser
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ── Contexte (org) ── */}
      {k.isAdmin && (
        <>
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: 13, margin: '18px 0 8px' }}>Contexte métier</h3>
          <p style={hint}>Injecté à chaque conversation (ton, horaires, règles commerciales…).</p>
          <textarea
            style={{ width: '100%', minHeight: 84, fontSize: 13 }}
            value={ctx ?? k.context}
            maxLength={4000}
            onChange={(e) => setCtx(e.target.value)}
            aria-label="Contexte métier"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="secondary"
            style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void run(() => api.setAgentContext(ctx ?? ''), 'ok')}
          >
            Enregistrer le contexte
          </button>
        </>
      )}

      {/* ── Garde-fous (org) ── */}
      {k.isAdmin && (
        <>
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: 13, margin: '18px 0 8px' }}>Garde-fous</h3>
          <p style={hint}>Règles absolues imposées à l’Agent (prioritaires sur tout le reste).</p>
          {k.guardrails.map((g) => (
            <div key={g.id} style={row}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={g.active === 1}
                aria-label={`Activer la règle ${g.rule}`}
                onChange={(e) => void run(() => api.setAgentGuardrailActive(g.id, e.target.checked))}
              />
              <span style={{ flex: '1 1 auto', minWidth: 0, opacity: g.active === 1 ? 1 : 0.55 }}>{g.rule}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="secondary"
                style={{ flex: '0 0 auto', padding: '3px 9px', fontSize: 12 }}
                disabled={busy}
                aria-label={`Supprimer la règle ${g.rule}`}
                onClick={() => void run(() => api.deleteAgentGuardrail(g.id))}
              >
                Supprimer
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
            <input
              style={input}
              value={rule}
              maxLength={300}
              placeholder="Ex. : ne jamais modifier un prix sans confirmation écrite"
              onChange={(e) => setRule(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Nouvelle règle"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              className="secondary"
              disabled={busy || !rule.trim()}
              onClick={() => {
                const v = rule.trim();
                setRule('');
                void run(() => api.addAgentGuardrail(v));
              }}
            >
              Ajouter
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {/* ── Base de connaissances RAG (org) ── */}
      {k.isAdmin && (
        <>
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: 13, margin: '18px 0 8px' }}>Base de connaissances (RAG)</h3>
          <p style={hint}>
            Documents texte interrogés par recherche à chaque question (procédures, tarifs, catalogue…).
          </p>
          {k.docs.map((d) => (

              <span style={{ flex: '1 1 auto', minWidth: 0 }}>
                <strong style={{ fontSize: 12.5 }}>{d.name}</strong>
                <span style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: 11.5, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                  {d.chars.toLocaleString('fr-FR')} caractères
                </span>
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="secondary"
                style={{ flex: '0 0 auto', padding: '3px 9px', fontSize: 12 }}
                disabled={busy}
                aria-label={`Supprimer le document ${d.name}`}
                onClick={() => void run(() => api.deleteAgentDoc(d.id))}
              >
                Supprimer
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
          <input
            style={{ ...input, marginBottom: 6 }}
            value={docName}
            maxLength={120}
            placeholder="Nom du document (ex. : Procédure retour marchandises)"
            onChange={(e) => setDocName(e.target.value)}
            aria-label="Nom du document"
          />
          <textarea
            style={{ width: '100%', minHeight: 90, fontSize: 13 }}
            value={docBody}
            maxLength={20000}
            placeholder="Collez ici le contenu texte du document…"
            onChange={(e) => setDocBody(e.target.value)}
            aria-label="Contenu du document"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="secondary"
            style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
            disabled={busy || !docBody.trim()}
            onClick={() => {
              const n = docName.trim() || 'Document';
              const b = docBody.trim();
              setDocName('');
              setDocBody('');
              void run(() => api.addAgentDoc(n, b));
            }}
          >
            Indexer le document
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
