/**
 * Local “AI helpers” for Atlas Commerce — no external API keys required.
 * Heuristics + French templates suitable for a small marble / stock shop.
 */

export type ProductLike = {
  id?: number;
  name?: string;
  sku?: string;
  barcode?: string;
  price?: number;
  unit_price?: number;
  cost?: number;
  cost_price?: number;
  category?: string;
  stock_quantity?: number;
  low_stock_threshold?: number;
};

export type MatchResult = {
  product: ProductLike;
  score: number;
  reason: string;
};

function norm(s: string): string {
  return String(s || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

/** 1. Smart product match from messy name / SKU / barcode */
export function matchProducts(query: string, products: ProductLike[], limit = 6): MatchResult[] {
  const q = norm(query);
  if (!q || q.length < 1) return [];
  const tokens = q.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const out: MatchResult[] = [];

  for (const p of products) {
    const name = norm(p.name || '');
    const sku = norm(p.sku || '');
    const bar = String(p.barcode || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    let score = 0;
    let reason = '';

    if (bar && (bar === query.trim().toLowerCase() || bar.includes(query.trim().toLowerCase()))) {
      score = 100;
      reason = 'code-barres';
    } else if (sku && (sku === q || sku.includes(q) || q.includes(sku))) {
      score = 92;
      reason = 'SKU';
    } else if (name === q) {
      score = 90;
      reason = 'nom exact';
    } else if (name.startsWith(q) || q.startsWith(name.slice(0, Math.min(12, name.length)))) {
      score = 80;
      reason = 'début de nom';
    } else {
      let hit = 0;
      for (const t of tokens) {
        if (t.length < 2) continue;
        if (name.includes(t)) hit += 1;
        if (sku.includes(t)) hit += 0.5;
      }
      if (hit > 0) {
        score = 50 + hit * 12;
        reason = 'mots-clés';
      }
      // typo: shared prefix length
      if (score < 50 && name && q) {
        let pref = 0;
        while (pref < name.length && pref < q.length && name[pref] === q[pref]) pref++;
        if (pref >= 4) {
          score = Math.max(score, 40 + pref);
          reason = 'ressemblance';
        }
      }
    }
    if (score >= 40) out.push({ product: p, score, reason });
  }
  out.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return out.slice(0, limit);
}

/** 2. Draft supplier reorder message (French) */
export function draftReorderMessage(
  items: { name?: string; sku?: string; stock_quantity?: number; low_stock_threshold?: number; reorder_qty?: number }[],
  companyName = 'notre société',
): string {
  const lines = (items || []).slice(0, 40).map((it, i) => {
    const need =
      it.reorder_qty != null
        ? Number(it.reorder_qty)
        : Math.max(1, Number(it.low_stock_threshold || 5) * 2 - Number(it.stock_quantity || 0));
    return `${i + 1}. ${it.name || 'Article'}${it.sku ? ` (${it.sku})` : ''} — qté souhaitée ≈ ${Math.round(need)} (stock actuel ${Math.round(Number(it.stock_quantity || 0))})`;
  });
  return [
    `Bonjour,`,
    ``,
    `Nous souhaiterions passer une commande de réassort pour ${companyName} :`,
    ``,
    ...lines,
    ``,
    `Merci de nous confirmer disponibilités, délais et prix.`,
    `Cordialement,`,
  ].join('\n');
}

/** 3. Invoice note chips */
export const NOTE_CHIPS: { id: string; label: string; text: string }[] = [
  { id: 'retard', label: 'Retard', text: 'Livraison en retard — merci de prioriser.' },
  { id: 'remise', label: 'Remise', text: 'Remise commerciale accordée sur cette pièce.' },
  { id: 'livraison', label: 'Livraison', text: 'Livraison à l’adresse indiquée — contacter avant passage.' },
  { id: 'acompte', label: 'Acompte', text: 'Acompte reçu ; solde à régler à la livraison.' },
  { id: 'chantier', label: 'Chantier', text: 'Matériel destiné au chantier — vérifier quantités à réception.' },
  { id: 'sav', label: 'SAV', text: 'Suite à échange / SAV — voir ticket précédent.' },
];

export function applyNoteChip(current: string, chipText: string): string {
  const cur = (current || '').trim();
  if (!cur) return chipText;
  if (cur.includes(chipText)) return cur;
  return `${cur}${cur.endsWith('.') ? '' : '.'} ${chipText}`;
}

/** 4. Refund reason assistant — expand a rough phrase */
export function polishRefundReason(raw: string, code?: string): string {
  const t = String(raw || '').trim();
  const codeHints: Record<string, string> = {
    our_error: 'Erreur de notre part lors de la préparation ou de la facturation',
    defective: 'Article reçu défectueux ou endommagé (non causé par le client)',
    wrong_item: 'Mauvais article / mauvaise référence livrée',
    missing_qty: 'Quantité manquante par rapport à la commande',
    transport: 'Dommage survenu pendant le transport',
  };
  const base = code && codeHints[code] ? codeHints[code] : '';
  if (!t && base) {
    return `${base}. Merci de procéder au remboursement / avoir correspondant.`;
  }
  if (!t) return '';
  let out = t;
  if (out.length < 12) {
    out = base ? `${base} : ${out}` : `Problème signalé par le client : ${out}`;
  }
  if (!/[.!?]$/.test(out)) out += '.';
  if (out.length < 40 && base && !out.includes(base.slice(0, 20))) {
    out = `${base}. Détail : ${t}${/[.!?]$/.test(t) ? '' : '.'}`;
  }
  if (out.length < 12) {
    out += ' Demande d’avoir formalisée après vérification.';
  }
  return out.slice(0, 500);
}

/** 5. Daily closing summary (5 lines) */
export function dailyClosingSummary(input: {
  dateLabel: string;
  salesTotal?: number;
  salesCount?: number;
  unpaidTotal?: number;
  unpaidCount?: number;
  lowStockCount?: number;
  openQuotes?: number;
  currency?: string;
}): string {
  const cur = input.currency || 'MAD';
  const f = (n: number) => Math.round(Number(n || 0)).toLocaleString('fr-FR');
  return [
    `Clôture du ${input.dateLabel}`,
    `• Ventes du jour : ${f(input.salesTotal || 0)} ${cur} (${input.salesCount || 0} pièce${(input.salesCount || 0) > 1 ? 's' : ''})`,
    `• Impayés ouverts : ${f(input.unpaidTotal || 0)} ${cur} (${input.unpaidCount || 0} dossier${(input.unpaidCount || 0) > 1 ? 's' : ''})`,
    `• Stock bas : ${input.lowStockCount || 0} article${(input.lowStockCount || 0) > 1 ? 's' : ''}`,
    `• Devis ouverts : ${input.openQuotes || 0}`,
  ].join('\n');
}

/** 6. Price anomaly vs list / cost */
export function priceAnomaly(
  unitPrice: number,
  ref: { list?: number; cost?: number },
): { warn: boolean; level: 'ok' | 'low' | 'below_cost'; message: string } {
  const u = Number(unitPrice || 0);
  const list = Number(ref.list || 0);
  const cost = Number(ref.cost || 0);
  if (u <= 0) return { warn: false, level: 'ok', message: '' };
  if (cost > 0 && u < cost - 0.001) {
    return {
      warn: true,
      level: 'below_cost',
      message: `Prix (${u}) sous le coût (${cost}) — marge négative.`,
    };
  }
  if (list > 0 && u < list * 0.7) {
    return {
      warn: true,
      level: 'low',
      message: `Prix nettement sous le tarif catalogue (${list}) — vérifiez la remise.`,
    };
  }
  return { warn: false, level: 'ok', message: '' };
}

/** 7. Client risk from open invoices */
export function clientRisk(invoices: { status?: string; due_date?: string; issue_date?: string; total?: number; amount_paid?: number; client_id?: number; client_name?: string; doc_kind?: string; number?: string }[], clientId?: number | string, clientName?: string): {
  level: 'ok' | 'watch' | 'high';
  message: string;
  unpaid: number;
  overdue: number;
} {
  // Only evaluate after a real client is chosen (id or non-empty name)
  const hasId = clientId !== undefined && clientId !== null && clientId !== '';
  const hasName = !!(clientName && String(clientName).trim());
  if (!hasId && !hasName) {
    return { level: 'ok', message: '', unpaid: 0, overdue: 0 };
  }
  const now = Date.now();
  let unpaid = 0;
  let overdue = 0;
  for (const inv of invoices || []) {
    if (['quote', 'devis', 'cancelled', 'remboursement'].includes(String(inv.status))) continue;
    const dk = String(inv.doc_kind || '');
    if (dk === 'quick_sale' || dk === 'ticket') continue;
    if (String(inv.number || '').startsWith('VR')) continue;
    if (hasId && Number(inv.client_id) !== Number(clientId)) continue;
    if (!hasId && hasName && norm(inv.client_name || '') !== norm(clientName || '')) continue;
    if (!hasId && !hasName) continue;
    const due = Math.max(0, Number(inv.total || 0) - Number(inv.amount_paid || 0));
    if (due < 0.01) continue;
    unpaid += due;
    const d = inv.due_date || inv.issue_date;
    if (d && new Date(d).getTime() < now - 86400000) overdue += due;
  }
  if (overdue > 0) {
    return {
      level: 'high',
      message: `Client à risque : ${Math.round(overdue).toLocaleString('fr-FR')} MAD en retard (total ouvert ${Math.round(unpaid).toLocaleString('fr-FR')} MAD).`,
      unpaid,
      overdue,
    };
  }
  if (unpaid > 5000) {
    return {
      level: 'watch',
      message: `Encours client élevé : ${Math.round(unpaid).toLocaleString('fr-FR')} MAD non réglés.`,
      unpaid,
      overdue,
    };
  }
  return { level: 'ok', message: '', unpaid, overdue };
}

/** 8. Photo → product draft (manual confirm; uses file name) */
export function draftProductFromFile(file: File | null): { name: string; category: string; note: string } {
  if (!file) return { name: '', category: '', note: '' };
  const base = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '').replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ').trim();
  const name = base
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase())
    .join(' ')
    .slice(0, 80);
  let category = 'Divers';
  const n = norm(name);
  if (/marbre|carrel|granit|sanitaire/.test(n)) category = 'Marbre / carrelage';
  else if (/colle|joint|mortier/.test(n)) category = 'Consommables';
  else if (/outil|disque|meule/.test(n)) category = 'Outillage';
  return {
    name: name || 'Nouveau produit',
    category,
    note: 'Brouillon depuis photo — vérifiez le nom et le prix avant enregistrement.',
  };
}

/** 9. WhatsApp-style reply drafts */
export function whatsAppDraft(
  kind: 'quote' | 'invoice' | 'paid' | 'reminder',
  ctx: { number?: string; client?: string; total?: number; currency?: string },
): string {
  const cur = ctx.currency || 'MAD';
  const total = Math.round(Number(ctx.total || 0)).toLocaleString('fr-FR');
  const who = ctx.client ? `Bonjour ${ctx.client},` : 'Bonjour,';
  switch (kind) {
    case 'quote':
      return `${who}\nVoici notre devis ${ctx.number || ''} d’un montant de ${total} ${cur}.\nDites-nous si vous validez pour lancer la préparation.\nMerci.`;
    case 'invoice':
      return `${who}\nVeuillez trouver la facture ${ctx.number || ''} — total ${total} ${cur}.\nMerci de votre règlement.\nCordialement.`;
    case 'paid':
      return `${who}\nNous confirmons la bonne réception de votre règlement pour ${ctx.number || ''}.\nMerci pour votre confiance.`;
    case 'reminder':
      return `${who}\nPetit rappel concernant la facture ${ctx.number || ''} (reste ${total} ${cur}).\nMerci de nous indiquer la date de règlement prévue.\nCordialement.`;
    default:
      return who;
  }
}

/** 11. Expense category from description */
export function suggestExpenseCategory(description: string): string {
  const d = norm(description);
  if (/loyer|bail|location local/.test(d)) return 'Loyer';
  if (/essence|gasoil|carburant|transport|taxi/.test(d)) return 'Transport';
  if (/salaire|paie|cnss/.test(d)) return 'Personnel';
  if (/electric|eau|onée|onee|iam|telecom|internet/.test(d)) return 'Charges';
  if (/publicit|facebook|insta|pub /.test(d)) return 'Marketing';
  if (/achat|fournisseur|marchandise|stock/.test(d)) return 'Achats stock';
  if (/repar|maintenance|sav/.test(d)) return 'Entretien';
  if (/rembours/.test(d)) return 'Remboursement client';
  return 'Divers';
}

/** 12. Simple demand hint from qty series (newest last) */
export function demandHint(qtyByPeriod: number[]): string {
  const a = (qtyByPeriod || []).map((n) => Number(n || 0));
  if (a.length < 2) return 'Pas assez d’historique pour une tendance.';
  const recent = a.slice(-3);
  const older = a.slice(0, -3);
  const avg = (xs: number[]) => (xs.length ? xs.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / xs.length : 0);
  const r = avg(recent);
  const o = avg(older.length ? older : a.slice(0, -1));
  if (o <= 0 && r > 0) return 'Demande émergente — surveiller le stock.';
  if (r > o * 1.25) return `Tendance haussière (~${Math.round(((r - o) / (o || 1)) * 100)} %). Anticiper un réassort.`;
  if (r < o * 0.75) return `Tendance baissière — éviter le surstock.`;
  return 'Demande stable.';
}

/** Mini FAQ / “chat” without LLM */
export function localAssistAnswer(question: string, ctx: Record<string, string | number>): string {
  const q = norm(question);
  if (/impay|creance|retard/.test(q)) {
    return `Impayés estimés : ${ctx.unpaid ?? '—'} MAD. Consultez Rapports → Balance âgée.`;
  }
  if (/stock|rupture|bas/.test(q)) {
    return `Articles en stock bas : ${ctx.lowStock ?? '—'}. Utilisez Rapports → Réassort pour un message fournisseur.`;
  }
  if (/vente|ca |chiffre/.test(q)) {
    return `Ventes (période affichée) : ${ctx.sales ?? '—'} MAD. Détail sur le tableau de bord.`;
  }
  if (/tva/.test(q)) {
    return 'Rapports → TVA pour le récapitulatif. Les tickets VR sont hors TVA.';
  }
  if (/wr|rembours|avoir/.test(q)) {
    return 'Les avoirs utilisent la série WR-. Un ticket VR peut être remboursé (0 % TVA). Pièce déjà payée → sortie dans Solde.';
  }
  return 'Je peux aider sur : impayés, stock bas, ventes, TVA, remboursements WR. Reformulez en une phrase courte.';
}

import { getAvatarUrl, getToken } from '../auth';

/**
 * Shared in-memory avatar blob cache (v243).
 *
 * Every AvatarImage instance (topbar, user menu, sidebar, settings, phone
 * shell) resolves the avatar through ONE fetch per session: the first caller
 * fetches + converts to an object URL, everybody else reuses it instantly.
 * Object URLs are never persisted (session-only), same rule as before.
 */
const cache = new Map<string, string>();
const inflight = new Map<string, Promise<string>>();

function fetchAvatarBlob(url: string): Promise<string> {
  const crossOrigin = /^https?:\/\//i.test(url) && !url.startsWith(window.location.origin);
  const fetchUrl = crossOrigin ? '/api/me/avatar' : url;
  const token = crossOrigin ? getToken() : null;
  return fetch(fetchUrl, token ? { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } } : undefined)
    .then((r) => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`http ${r.status}`);
      return r.blob();
    })
    .then((blob) => URL.createObjectURL(blob));
}

/** Resolve an opaque object URL for the avatar, shared + deduped. */
export function avatarObjectUrl(url: string): Promise<string> {
  const hit = cache.get(url);
  if (hit) return Promise.resolve(hit);
  const running = inflight.get(url);
  if (running) return running;
  const p = fetchAvatarBlob(url)
    .then((objectUrl) => {
      cache.set(url, objectUrl);
      inflight.delete(url);
      return objectUrl;
    })
    .catch((e) => {
      inflight.delete(url);
      throw e;
    });
  inflight.set(url, p);
  return p;
}

/** Synchronous peek — renders instantly when the blob is already warm. */
export function peekAvatarObjectUrl(url: string): string | null {
  return cache.get(url) || null;
}

/** Fire-and-forget warm-up (called as soon as the profile cache lands). */
export function prefetchAvatar(url?: string | null): void {
  const u = String(url || '').trim();
  if (!u) return;
  void avatarObjectUrl(u).catch(() => { /* initials fallback stays */ });
}

/** Drop everything (logout or avatar re-upload). */
export function invalidateAvatarCache(): void {
  for (const objectUrl of cache.values()) {
    try { URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl); } catch { /* */ }
  }
  cache.clear();
  inflight.clear();
}

// React to profile/avatar changes: drop stale blobs, prefetch the fresh one.
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.addEventListener('atlas-avatar-changed', () => {
    invalidateAvatarCache();
    prefetchAvatar(getAvatarUrl());
  });
}

/**
 * Barcode scanner pipeline:
 * 1) Quagga2 (@ericblade/quagga2) — free, maintained fork, strong EAN/UPC/Code128
 * 2) html5-qrcode
 * 3) getUserMedia + native BarcodeDetector + ZXing WASM
 */

export type ScanStop = () => void;

const ZXING_VERSION = '2.2.0';
/** Same-origin vendor first, then several CDNs (jsdelivr alone is often blocked). */
const ZXING_SCRIPT_URLS = [
  `/vendor/zxing-wasm/${ZXING_VERSION}/reader.js`,
  `https://unpkg.com/zxing-wasm@${ZXING_VERSION}/dist/iife/reader/index.js`,
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/zxing-wasm@${ZXING_VERSION}/dist/iife/reader/index.js`,
  `https://fastly.jsdelivr.net/npm/zxing-wasm@${ZXING_VERSION}/dist/iife/reader/index.js`,
];
const ZXING_WASM_URLS = [
  `/vendor/zxing-wasm/${ZXING_VERSION}/zxing_reader.wasm`,
  `https://unpkg.com/zxing-wasm@${ZXING_VERSION}/dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm`,
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/zxing-wasm@${ZXING_VERSION}/dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm`,
  `https://fastly.jsdelivr.net/npm/zxing-wasm@${ZXING_VERSION}/dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm`,
];

const RETAIL_FORMATS = [
  'EAN-13',
  'EAN-8',
  'UPC-A',
  'UPC-E',
  'Code128',
  'Code39',
  'Code93',
  'Codabar',
  'ITF',
] as const;

let zxingReady: Promise<any> | null = null;
let html5Ready: Promise<any> | null = null;
let preloaded = false;

export function preloadBarcodeScanner(): void {
  if (preloaded) return;
  preloaded = true;
  void loadQuagga().catch(() => {});
  void loadHtml5Qrcode().catch(() => {});
  void loadZXing().catch(() => {});
}

function loadScriptOnce(src: string, timeoutMs = 10000): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const sel = 'script[data-scan-src="' + src.replace(/"/g, '') + '"]';
    const existing = document.querySelector(sel) as HTMLScriptElement | null;
    if (existing) {
      const t = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('timeout')), timeoutMs);
      if ((existing as any).dataset.loaded === '1') {
        clearTimeout(t);
        return resolve();
      }
      existing.addEventListener('load', () => {
        clearTimeout(t);
        resolve();
      });
      existing.addEventListener('error', () => {
        clearTimeout(t);
        reject(new Error('load'));
      });
      return;
    }
    const s = document.createElement('script');
    s.src = src;
    s.async = true;
    s.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    s.setAttribute('data-scan-src', src);
    const t = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('timeout')), timeoutMs);
    s.onload = () => {
      clearTimeout(t);
      s.dataset.loaded = '1';
      resolve();
    };
    s.onerror = () => {
      clearTimeout(t);
      try { s.remove(); } catch { /* */ }
      reject(new Error('load'));
    };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  });
}

export function loadZXing(): Promise<any> {
  if (zxingReady) return zxingReady;
  const w = window as any;
  if (w.ZXingWASM?.readBarcodes) {
    zxingReady = Promise.resolve(w.ZXingWASM);
    return zxingReady;
  }
  zxingReady = (async () => {
    let ok = false;
    for (const src of ZXING_SCRIPT_URLS) {
      try {
        await loadScriptOnce(src, 10000);
        if (w.ZXingWASM?.readBarcodes) {
          ok = true;
          break;
        }
      } catch {
        /* try next CDN */
      }
    }
    if (!ok || !w.ZXingWASM?.readBarcodes) {
      throw new Error('Scanner WASM indisponible (réseau). Passage au scanner alternatif…');
    }
    const api = w.ZXingWASM;
    // Prefer same-origin vendor (no network); skip slow multi-CDN probe
    const wasmUrl = ZXING_WASM_URLS[0] || ZXING_WASM_URLS[ZXING_WASM_URLS.length - 1];
    try {
      api.prepareZXingModule?.({
        overrides: {
          locateFile: (path: string, prefix: string) => {
            if (String(path).endsWith('.wasm')) return wasmUrl;
            return prefix + path;
          },
        },
      });
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    try {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas');
      c.width = 32;
      c.height = 32;
      const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
      if (ctx) {
        const id = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 32, 32);
        await api.readBarcodes(id, { maxNumberOfSymbols: 1, tryHarder: false });
      }
    } catch {
      /* warm-up optional */
    }
    return api;
  })();
  return zxingReady;
}

function loadHtml5Qrcode(): Promise<any> {
  const w = window as any;
  if (w.Html5Qrcode) return Promise.resolve(w.Html5Qrcode);
  if (html5Ready) return html5Ready;
  const urls = [
    '/vendor/html5-qrcode/html5-qrcode.min.js',
    'https://unpkg.com/html5-qrcode@2.3.8/html5-qrcode.min.js',
    'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html5-qrcode@2.3.8/html5-qrcode.min.js',
    'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html5-qrcode/2.3.8/html5-qrcode.min.js',
  ];
  html5Ready = (async () => {
    for (const src of urls) {
      try {
        await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
          if (document.querySelector(`script[data-h5q="${src}"]`)) {
            if (w.Html5Qrcode) return resolve();
            const el = document.querySelector(`script[data-h5q="${src}"]`)!;
            el.addEventListener('load', () => resolve());
            el.addEventListener('error', () => reject());
            return;
          }
          const s = document.createElement('script');
          s.src = src;
          s.async = true;
          s.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
          s.dataset.h5q = src;
          s.onload = () => resolve();
          s.onerror = () => reject(new Error('load fail'));
          document.head.appendChild(s);
        });
        if (w.Html5Qrcode) return w.Html5Qrcode;
      } catch {
        /* next */
      }
    }
    throw new Error('html5-qrcode unavailable');
  })();
  return html5Ready;
}

export function isBarcodeLike(code: string): boolean {
  const c = String(code || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, '');
  if (!c || c.length < 3) return false;
  if (c.includes('://') || /^https?/i.test(c)) return false;
  // Numeric retail (EAN/UPC/ITF) or alnum SKU-like
  if (/^\d{6,18}$/.test(c)) return true;
  return /^[0-9A-Za-z\-._/]{3,64}$/.test(c);
}

function normalizeCode(raw: string): string {
  return String(raw || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, '');
}

function needHits(_text: string): number {
  return 1;
}

const ZXING_OPTS = {
  tryHarder: true,
  // empty / omit formats → all symbologies (zxing-wasm default)
  maxNumberOfSymbols: 4,
};

async function zxingDecodeImageData(imageData: ImageData): Promise<string | null> {
  const api = await loadZXing();
  let results: any[] = [];
  try {
    if (typeof api.readBarcodes === 'function') {
      results = await api.readBarcodes(imageData, ZXING_OPTS);
    } else if (typeof api.readBarcodesFromImageData === 'function') {
      results = await api.readBarcodesFromImageData(imageData, ZXING_OPTS);
    }
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  for (const r of results || []) {
    const text = r?.text || r?.rawValue || '';
    if (text && isBarcodeLike(text)) return normalizeCode(text);
  }
  return null;
}

async function zxingDecodeBlob(blob: Blob): Promise<string | null> {
  const api = await loadZXing();
  const results = await api.readBarcodes(blob, ZXING_OPTS);
  const text = results?.[0]?.text;
  if (text && isBarcodeLike(text)) return normalizeCode(text);
  return null;
}


/** Chrome Android / some Chromium: native Shape Detection API (fast, reliable). */
async function startNativeBarcodeDetector(
  video: HTMLVideoElement,
  onCode: (code: string) => void,
  onError?: (msg: string) => void
): Promise<ScanStop | null> {
  const BD = (globalThis as any).BarcodeDetector;
  if (typeof BD !== 'function') return null;
  let formats: string[] | undefined;
  try {
    const supported: string[] = await BD.getSupportedFormats?.() || [];
    const prefer = [
      'ean_13', 'ean_8', 'upc_a', 'upc_e',
      'code_128', 'code_39', 'code_93', 'codabar', 'itf',
      'qr_code', 'data_matrix',
    ];
    formats = prefer.filter((f) => supported.includes(f));
    if (!formats.length) formats = undefined;
  } catch {
    formats = undefined;
  }
  let detector: any;
  try {
    detector = formats?.length ? new BD({ formats }) : new BD();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }

  let stopped = false;
  let raf = 0;
  let inFlight = false;
  let last = '';
  let hits = 0;

  const stop: ScanStop = () => {
    stopped = true;
    if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  };

  const emit = (raw: string) => {
    if (stopped) return;
    const text = normalizeCode(raw);
    if (!isBarcodeLike(text)) return;
    if (text === last) hits++;
    else {
      last = text;
      hits = 1;
    }
    if (hits < needHits(text)) return;
    onCode(text);
    stop();
  };

  const tick = async () => {
    if (stopped) return;
    if (!inFlight && video.readyState >= 2 && video.videoWidth > 0) {
      inFlight = true;
      try {
        const codes = await detector.detect(video);
        for (const c of codes || []) {
          const v = c?.rawValue || c?.rawData || '';
          if (v) {
            emit(String(v));
            if (stopped) {
              inFlight = false;
              return;
            }
          }
        }
      } catch {
        /* transient */
      }
      inFlight = false;
    }
    if (!stopped) raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => { void tick(); });
  };
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => { void tick(); });
  return stop;
}




/** Quagga2 — maintained fork of QuaggaJS (@ericblade/quagga2 v1.12.1) */
const QUAGGA_SCRIPT_URLS = [
  '/vendor/quagga2/quagga.min.js',
  '/vendor/quagga2/quagga.js',
  'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ericblade/quagga2@1.12.1/dist/quagga.min.js',
  'https://unpkg.com/@ericblade/quagga2@1.12.1/dist/quagga.min.js',
];

let quaggaReady: Promise<any> | null = null;

function loadQuagga(): Promise<any> {
  const w = window as any;
  if (w.Quagga) return Promise.resolve(w.Quagga);
  if (quaggaReady) return quaggaReady;
  quaggaReady = (async () => {
    let last: any = null;
    for (const src of QUAGGA_SCRIPT_URLS) {
      try {
        await loadScriptOnce(src, 15000);
        if (w.Quagga) return w.Quagga;
      } catch (e) {
        last = e;
      }
    }
    throw last || new Error('Quagga2 indisponible');
  })();
  return quaggaReady;
}

async function startQuaggaScan(
  container: HTMLElement,
  onCode: (code: string) => void,
  onError?: (msg: string) => void
): Promise<ScanStop> {
  const Quagga = await loadQuagga();
  container.innerHTML = '';
  container.style.position = container.style.position || 'relative';
  container.style.minHeight = container.style.minHeight || '240px';
  container.style.overflow = 'hidden';

  let stopped = false;
  let last = '';
  let hits = 0;
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  /** EAN-13 / UPC-A check digit */
  const validEan13 = (code: string): boolean => {
    if (!/^\d{13}$/.test(code)) return false;
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) sum += parseInt(code[i], 10) * (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 3);
    return (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10 === parseInt(code[12], 10);
  };
  /** EAN-8 check digit */
  const validEan8 = (code: string): boolean => {
    if (!/^\d{8}$/.test(code)) return false;
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) sum += parseInt(code[i], 10) * (i % 2 === 0 ? 3 : 1);
    return (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10 === parseInt(code[7], 10);
  };
  const looksReliable = (text: string, result: any): boolean => {
    if (text.length < 6) return false;
    // Reject numeric codes that fail checksum when length matches EAN/UPC
    if (/^\d{13}$/.test(text) && !validEan13(text)) return false;
    if (/^\d{12}$/.test(text)) {
      // UPC-A often as 12 digits — validate as EAN-13 with leading 0
      if (!validEan13('0' + text)) return false;
    }
    if (/^\d{8}$/.test(text) && !validEan8(text)) return false;
    // Quagga decodedCodes error errors — skip high-error frames
    const decoded = result?.codeResult?.decodedCodes;
    if (Array.isArray(decoded) && decoded.length > 2) {
      const errs = decoded.filter((d: any) => typeof d?.error === 'number');
      if (errs.length) {
        const avg = errs.reduce((a: number, d: any) => a + d.error, 0) / errs.length;
        if (avg > 0.12) return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  };

  const stop: ScanStop = () => {
    stopped = true;
    try {
      Quagga.offDetected?.(onDetected);
      Quagga.stop();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    try {
      container.innerHTML = '';
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  };

  function onDetected(result: any) {
    if (stopped) return;
    // Ignore first ~400ms (auto-focus noise / wrong partial reads)
    if (Date.now() - startedAt < 400) return;
    const text = normalizeCode(result?.codeResult?.code || '');
    if (!text || text.length < 6) return;
    if (!isBarcodeLike(text) && !/^\d{6,}$/.test(text)) return;
    if (!looksReliable(text, result)) {
      // Wrong checksum or noisy — reset streak
      if (text !== last) {
        last = '';
        hits = 0;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (text === last) hits += 1;
    else {
      last = text;
      hits = 1;
    }
    // Need several identical reads in a row (stops fast wrong codes)
    const need = text.length >= 12 ? 3 : 4;
    if (hits < need) return;
    onCode(text);
    stop();
  }

  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    Quagga.init(
      {
        inputStream: {
          type: 'LiveStream',
          target: container,
          constraints: {
            facingMode: 'environment',
            width: { min: 640, ideal: 1280 },
            height: { min: 480, ideal: 720 },
          },
          // Match yellow frame — less edge noise
          area: { top: '32%', right: '12%', left: '12%', bottom: '32%' },
        },
        locator: {
          patchSize: 'large',
          halfSample: false,
        },
        numOfWorkers: Math.min(2, navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 2),
        frequency: 8,
        decoder: {
          readers: [
            'ean_reader',
            'ean_8_reader',
            'upc_reader',
            'upc_e_reader',
            'code_128_reader',
            'code_39_reader',
          ],
          multiple: false,
        },
        locate: true,
      },
      (err: any) => {
        if (err) {
          onError?.(err?.message || String(err) || 'Quagga init failed');
          reject(err);
          return;
        }
        Quagga.onDetected(onDetected);
        Quagga.start();
        resolve();
      }
    );
  });

  return stop;
}

/** Commercial: Dynamsoft Barcode Reader (primary when license is set). */
const DYNAMSOFT_BUNDLE_URLS = [
  'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dynamsoft-barcode-reader-bundle@11.6.3200/dist/dbr.bundle.js',
  'https://unpkg.com/dynamsoft-barcode-reader-bundle@11.6.3200/dist/dbr.bundle.js',
];

export function getDynamsoftLicense(): string {
  try {
    const fromEnv = String((import.meta as any)?.env?.VITE_DYNAMSOFT_LICENSE || '').trim();
    if (fromEnv) return fromEnv;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  try {
    const fromLs = String(localStorage.getItem('atlas_dynamsoft_license') || '').trim();
    if (fromLs) return fromLs;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  try {
    const fromWin = String((window as any).__ATLAS_DYNAMSOFT_LICENSE__ || '').trim();
    if (fromWin) return fromWin;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return '';
}

export function setDynamsoftLicense(key: string) {
  try {
    const k = String(key || '').trim();
    if (k) localStorage.setItem('atlas_dynamsoft_license', k);
    else localStorage.removeItem('atlas_dynamsoft_license');
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

let dynamsoftReady: Promise<any> | null = null;

function loadDynamsoftBundle(): Promise<any> {
  const w = window as any;
  if (w.Dynamsoft?.CVR || w.Dynamsoft?.BarcodeScanner || w.Dynamsoft?.DBR) {
    return Promise.resolve(w.Dynamsoft);
  }
  if (dynamsoftReady) return dynamsoftReady;
  dynamsoftReady = (async () => {
    let lastErr: any = null;
    for (const src of DYNAMSOFT_BUNDLE_URLS) {
      try {
        await loadScriptOnce(src, 20000);
        if (w.Dynamsoft) return w.Dynamsoft;
      } catch (e) {
        lastErr = e;
      }
    }
    throw lastErr || new Error('Dynamsoft SDK indisponible (réseau)');
  })();
  return dynamsoftReady;
}

/**
 * Commercial scanner — Dynamsoft Capture Vision (camera + decode).
 * Requires a license (trial 30 days from dynamsoft.com, or VITE_DYNAMSOFT_LICENSE).
 */
async function startDynamsoftScan(
  container: HTMLElement,
  onCode: (code: string) => void,
  onError?: (msg: string) => void
): Promise<ScanStop> {
  const license = getDynamsoftLicense();
  if (!license) throw new Error('Dynamsoft: aucune licence configurée');

  const Dynamsoft = await loadDynamsoftBundle();
  container.innerHTML = '';
  container.style.position = container.style.position || 'relative';
  container.style.minHeight = container.style.minHeight || '240px';

  // License
  try {
    if (Dynamsoft.License?.LicenseManager?.initLicense) {
      await Dynamsoft.License.LicenseManager.initLicense(license);
    } else if (Dynamsoft.DBR?.BarcodeScanner) {
      Dynamsoft.DBR.BarcodeScanner.license = license;
    } else if (Dynamsoft.BarcodeScanner) {
      /* BarcodeScanner ctor accepts license */
    }
  } catch (e: any) {
    throw new Error(e?.message || 'Licence Dynamsoft invalide');
  }

  // Prefer high-level BarcodeScanner.launch into container when available
  if (typeof Dynamsoft.BarcodeScanner === 'function') {
    let scanner: any = null;
    let stopped = false;
    scanner = new Dynamsoft.BarcodeScanner({
      license,
      container,
      scannerViewConfig: {
        cameraEnhancerUIElement: container,
      },
    });
    const stop: ScanStop = () => {
      stopped = true;
      try {
        scanner?.dispose?.();
        scanner?.destroy?.();
        scanner?.stop?.();
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
      try {
        container.innerHTML = '';
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    };
    // Non-blocking continuous: use launch promise only for first result, or CVR below
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const result = await scanner.launch();
        if (stopped) return;
        const items = result?.barcodeResults || result?.barcodes || [];
        const text =
          items[0]?.text ||
          items[0]?.barcodeText ||
          result?.text ||
          '';
        if (text) {
          onCode(normalizeCode(String(text)));
          stop();
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        if (!stopped) onError?.(e?.message || 'Dynamsoft scan arrêté');
      }
    })();
    return stop;
  }

  // Foundational API: CameraView + CaptureVisionRouter (v10/v11)
  const DCE = Dynamsoft.DCE;
  const CVR = Dynamsoft.CVR;
  if (!DCE?.CameraView || !CVR?.CaptureVisionRouter) {
    throw new Error('Dynamsoft CVR/DCE non disponibles dans ce bundle');
  }

  try {
    await Dynamsoft.Core?.CoreModule?.loadWasm?.();
  } catch {
    /* optional */
  }

  const cameraView = await DCE.CameraView.createInstance();
  const ui = cameraView.getUIElement?.() || cameraView;
  if (ui instanceof HTMLElement) {
    ui.style.width = '100%';
    ui.style.minHeight = '240px';
    container.appendChild(ui);
  }

  const cameraEnhancer = await DCE.CameraEnhancer.createInstance(cameraView);
  await cameraEnhancer.open();

  const router = await CVR.CaptureVisionRouter.createInstance();
  router.setInput(cameraEnhancer);

  let stopped = false;
  const stop: ScanStop = () => {
    stopped = true;
    try {
      router.stopCapturing?.();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    try {
      router.dispose?.();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    try {
      cameraEnhancer.close?.();
      cameraEnhancer.dispose?.();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    try {
      container.innerHTML = '';
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  };

  router.addResultReceiver({
    onDecodedBarcodesReceived: (result: any) => {
      if (stopped) return;
      const items = result?.barcodeResultItems || result?.barcodes || [];
      for (const item of items) {
        const text = item?.text || item?.barcodeText || '';
        if (text && (isBarcodeLike(String(text)) || /^\d{4,}$/.test(String(text)))) {
          onCode(normalizeCode(String(text)));
          stop();
          return;
        }
      }
    },
  });

  const template =
    (await router.getSimplifiedSettings?.('ReadBarcodes_Speed')) ? 'ReadBarcodes_Speed' : 'ReadSingleBarcode';
  try {
    await router.startCapturing(template);
  } catch {
    await router.startCapturing('ReadSingleBarcode');
  }

  return stop;
}

async function startHtml5Scan(
  container: HTMLElement,
  onCode: (code: string) => void,
  onError?: (msg: string) => void
): Promise<ScanStop> {
  const Html5Qrcode = await loadHtml5Qrcode();
  if (!container.id) container.id = 'ph-h5-reader-' + Date.now();
  // html5-qrcode requires a clean container
  const scanner = new Html5Qrcode(container.id);
  let stopped = false;
  let last = '';

  const stop: ScanStop = () => {
    stopped = true;
    try {
      if (scanner.isScanning) scanner.stop().catch(() => {});
      scanner.clear?.();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  };

  const emit = (raw: string) => {
    if (stopped) return;
    const text = normalizeCode(raw);
    if (!text || text.length < 3) return;
    if (text === last) return; // debounce identical
    last = text;
    if (!isBarcodeLike(text) && !/^\d{4,}$/.test(text)) return;
    onCode(text);
    stop();
  };

  // Build formats list from library enum when available
  let formats: number[] | undefined;
  try {
    const F = (globalThis as any).Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats || (Html5Qrcode as any).FORMATS;
    // Prefer numeric enum values used by html5-qrcode 2.x
    const w = globalThis as any;
    const enumObj = w.Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats;
    if (enumObj) {
      formats = [
        enumObj.EAN_13,
        enumObj.EAN_8,
        enumObj.UPC_A,
        enumObj.UPC_E,
        enumObj.CODE_128,
        enumObj.CODE_39,
        enumObj.CODE_93,
        enumObj.ITF,
        enumObj.CODABAR,
        enumObj.QR_CODE,
      ].filter((x) => typeof x === 'number');
    }
  } catch {
    formats = undefined;
  }

  const config: any = {
    fps: 15,
    qrbox: (viewW: number, viewH: number) => ({
      width: Math.floor(viewW * 0.92),
      height: Math.floor(viewH * 0.45),
    }),
    aspectRatio: 1.777778,
    disableFlip: false,
    experimentalFeatures: { useBarCodeDetectorIfSupported: true },
  };
  if (formats && formats.length) config.formatsToSupport = formats;

  try {
    await scanner.start(
      { facingMode: 'environment' },
      config,
      (decoded: string) => emit(decoded),
      () => {
        /* ignore per-frame failures */
      }
    );
  } catch (e1: any) {
    // Retry without format restriction / with basic camera
    try {
      await scanner.start(
        { facingMode: 'environment' },
        { fps: 10, disableFlip: false },
        (decoded: string) => emit(decoded),
        () => {}
      );
    } catch (e2: any) {
      onError?.(e2?.message || e1?.message || 'html5-qrcode start failed');
      throw e2 || e1;
    }
  }

  return stop;
}

export async function startBarcodeScan(
  containerOrVideo: HTMLElement | HTMLVideoElement,
  onCode: (code: string) => void,
  onError?: (msg: string) => void
): Promise<ScanStop> {
  let stopped = false;
  let last = '';
  let hits = 0;
  let video: HTMLVideoElement | null = null;
  let stream: MediaStream | null = null;
  let raf = 0;
  let inFlight = false;
  let html5Stop: ScanStop | null = null;
  let nativeStop: ScanStop | null = null;

  const stopAll: ScanStop = () => {
    stopped = true;
    if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = 0;
    try { nativeStop?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    nativeStop = null;
    try { html5Stop?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    html5Stop = null;
    try {
      stream?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    } catch { /* */ }
    stream = null;
    if (video) {
      try {
        video.srcObject = null;
      } catch { /* */ }
    }
  };

  const emit = (raw: string) => {
    if (stopped) return;
    const text = normalizeCode(raw);
    if (!text || text.length < 3) return;
    // Accept almost anything that looks like a product code / SKU
    if (!isBarcodeLike(text) && !/^\d{4,}$/.test(text)) return;
    if (text === last) hits += 1;
    else {
      last = text;
      hits = 1;
    }
    if (hits < 1) return;
    onCode(text);
    stopAll();
  };

  // ---------- Path A0: Quagga2 (primary free 1D / EAN) ----------
  try {
    const container =
      containerOrVideo instanceof HTMLVideoElement
        ? (containerOrVideo.parentElement as HTMLElement)
        : (containerOrVideo as HTMLElement);
    if (container) {
      container.innerHTML = '';
      const qStop = await startQuaggaScan(container, (code) => emit(code), onError);
      if (qStop) {
        html5Stop = qStop;
        return () => stopAll();
      }
    }
  } catch {
    try {
      html5Stop?.();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    html5Stop = null;
  }

  // ---------- Path A: html5-qrcode owns camera (free fallback) ----------
  try {
    const container =
      containerOrVideo instanceof HTMLVideoElement
        ? (containerOrVideo.parentElement as HTMLElement)
        : containerOrVideo;
    if (container) {
      // Ensure element has an id for html5-qrcode
      if (!container.id) container.id = 'ph-h5-reader';
      container.innerHTML = '';
      html5Stop = await startHtml5Scan(container, (code) => emit(code), onError);
      if (html5Stop) {
        // Also try native BD on the video html5 creates (Chrome Android boost)
        const tryAttachNative = () => {
          if (stopped) return;
          const v = container.querySelector('video') as HTMLVideoElement | null;
          if (v && v.videoWidth > 0) {
            void startNativeBarcodeDetector(v, (code) => emit(code)).then((s) => {
              if (s && !stopped) nativeStop = s;
            });
            return;
          }
          setTimeout(tryAttachNative, 400);
        };
        setTimeout(tryAttachNative, 500);
        return () => stopAll();
      }
    }
  } catch (e: any) {
    /* fall through to manual getUserMedia + ZXing */
    try {
      html5Stop?.();
    } catch { /* */ }
    html5Stop = null;
  }

  // ---------- Path B: getUserMedia + ZXing WASM (+ native BD) ----------
  try {
    const container =
      containerOrVideo instanceof HTMLVideoElement
        ? null
        : (containerOrVideo as HTMLElement);

    if (containerOrVideo instanceof HTMLVideoElement) {
      video = containerOrVideo;
    } else {
      video = document.createElement('video');
      video.playsInline = true;
      video.setAttribute('playsinline', 'true');
      video.setAttribute('webkit-playsinline', 'true');
      video.muted = true;
      video.autoplay = true;
      video.style.cssText =
        'width:100%;max-height:70vh;object-fit:cover;background:#000;border-radius:12px;display:block';
      if (container) {
        container.innerHTML = '';
        container.appendChild(video);
      }
    }

    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      throw new Error('Caméra non accessible (HTTPS requis)');
    }

    try {
      stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: false,
        video: {
          facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' },
          width: { ideal: 1280 },
          height: { ideal: 720 },
        },
      });
    } catch {
      stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: false, video: true });
    }

    video.srcObject = stream;
    await video.play().catch(() => {});
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      if (video && video.readyState >= 2 && video.videoWidth > 0) return resolve();
      const onReady = () => {
        video?.removeEventListener('loadeddata', onReady);
        resolve();
      };
      video?.addEventListener('loadeddata', onReady);
      setTimeout(resolve, 2000);
    });

    try {
      nativeStop = await startNativeBarcodeDetector(video!, (code) => emit(code));
    } catch {
      nativeStop = null;
    }

    const zx = await loadZXing().catch(() => null);
    if (!zx && !nativeStop) {
      throw new Error('Scanner non chargé');
    }

    if (zx) {
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
      if (!ctx) throw new Error('Canvas indisponible');

      const tick = async () => {
        if (stopped) return;
        if (inFlight) {
          raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            void tick();
          });
          return;
        }
        try {
          if (video && video.readyState >= 2 && video.videoWidth > 0) {
            const maxW = 1280;
            const scale = video.videoWidth > maxW ? maxW / video.videoWidth : 1;
            const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(video.videoWidth * scale));
            const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(video.videoHeight * scale));
            if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
              canvas.width = w;
              canvas.height = h;
            }
            ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, w, h);
            inFlight = true;
            const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
            // tryHarder every other frame to balance speed
            const code = await zxingDecodeImageData(imageData);
            inFlight = false;
            if (code) {
              emit(code);
              return;
            }
          }
        } catch {
          inFlight = false;
        }
        if (!stopped) {
          raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            void tick();
          });
        }
      };
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        void tick();
      });
    }

    return () => stopAll();
  } catch (e: any) {
    stopAll();
    const msg = e?.message || 'Caméra / scanner indisponible';
    onError?.(msg);
    throw e;
  }
}

export async function captureAndDecode(
  video: HTMLVideoElement | null
): Promise<string | null> {
  let vid = video;
  if (!vid?.videoWidth) {
    vid = document.querySelector(
      '.ph-cam-wrap video, [data-h5-reader] video, #ph-h5-reader video'
    ) as HTMLVideoElement | null;
  }
  if (!vid?.videoWidth) return null;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = vid.videoWidth;
  c.height = vid.videoHeight;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) return null;
  ctx.drawImage(vid, 0, 0);
  return decodeCanvas(c);
}

export async function decodeCanvas(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): Promise<string | null> {
  const candidates = buildCandidates(canvas);
  for (const c of candidates) {
    try {
      const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
      if (!ctx) continue;
      const id = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
      const hit = await zxingDecodeImageData(id);
      if (hit) return hit;
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
  try {
    const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>((res) =>
      canvas.toBlob((b) => res(b), 'image/jpeg', 0.92)
    );
    if (blob) {
      const file = new File([blob], 'scan.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      const viaH5 = await html5ScanFile(file);
      if (viaH5) return viaH5;
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return null;
}

export async function decodeImageFile(file: File): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
  const name = (file.name || '').toLowerCase();
  const type = (file.type || '').toLowerCase();
  if (type.includes('heic') || type.includes('heif') || name.endsWith('.heic') || name.endsWith('.heif')) {
    throw new Error('Image HEIC (iPhone) non supportée ici. Ouvrez-la dans Photos → partagez en JPEG ou PNG, puis réessayez.');
  }

    const hit = await zxingDecodeBlob(file);
    if (hit) return hit;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  try {
    const canvas = await fileToCanvas(file);
    const hit = await decodeCanvas(canvas);
    if (hit) return hit;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  try {
    const hit = await html5ScanFile(file);
    if (hit) return hit;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return null;
}

async function html5ScanFile(file: File): Promise<string | null> {
  const Html5Qrcode = await loadHtml5Qrcode();
  const tmpId = `h5f-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
  const div = document.createElement('div');
  div.id = tmpId;
  div.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden';
  document.body.appendChild(div);
  const scanner = new Html5Qrcode(tmpId);
  try {
    const result = await scanner.scanFile(file, false);
    await scanner.clear?.();
    div.remove();
    if (result && isBarcodeLike(String(result))) return normalizeCode(String(result));
  } catch {
    try {
      await scanner.clear?.();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    div.remove();
  }
  return null;
}

async function fileToCanvas(file: File): Promise<HTMLCanvasElement> {
  try {
    const bmp = await createImageBitmap(file);
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = bmp.width;
    c.height = bmp.height;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) throw new Error('ctx');
    ctx.drawImage(bmp, 0, 0);
    bmp.close?.();
    return c;
  } catch {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        const c = document.createElement('canvas');
        c.width = img.naturalWidth || img.width;
        c.height = img.naturalHeight || img.height;
        const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          reject(new Error('ctx'));
          return;
        }
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        resolve(c);
      };
      img.onerror = () => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        reject(new Error('img'));
      };
      img.src = url;
    });
  }
}

function buildCandidates(source: HTMLCanvasElement): HTMLCanvasElement[] {
  const out: HTMLCanvasElement[] = [source];
  const w = source.width;
  const h = source.height;
  if (w < 8 || h < 8) return out;

  // Cap large photos early (memory limit on low-end devices)
  if (w > 1024 || h > 1024) {
    out.push(scaleCanvas(source, 1024 / Math.max(w, h)));
  }
  for (const deg of [90, 180, 270]) out.push(rotateCanvas(source, deg));

  const regions: [number, number, number, number][] = [
    [0.05, 0.05, 0.9, 0.9],
    [0, 0, 1, 0.5],
    [0, 0.5, 1, 0.5],
    [0, 0, 0.5, 1],
    [0.5, 0, 0.5, 1],
    [0.05, 0.3, 0.9, 0.4],
    [0.2, 0.05, 0.6, 0.9],
    [0, 0, 0.55, 0.55],
    [0.45, 0, 0.55, 0.55],
    [0, 0.45, 0.55, 0.55],
    [0.45, 0.45, 0.55, 0.55],
  ];
  for (const [rx, ry, rw, rh] of regions) {
    const crop = cropCanvas(source, rx * w, ry * h, rw * w, rh * h);
    if (crop) out.push(crop);
  }
  out.push(contrastCanvas(source));
  return out;
}

function scaleCanvas(source: HTMLCanvasElement, scale: number): HTMLCanvasElement {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(source.width * scale));
  c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(source.height * scale));
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  if (ctx) {
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    ctx.drawImage(source, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
  }
  return c;
}

function rotateCanvas(source: HTMLCanvasElement, deg: number): HTMLCanvasElement {
  const rad = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  if (deg === 90 || deg === 270) {
    c.width = source.height;
    c.height = source.width;
  } else {
    c.width = source.width;
    c.height = source.height;
  }
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) return c;
  ctx.translate(c.width / 2, c.height / 2);
  ctx.rotate(rad);
  ctx.drawImage(source, -source.width / 2, -source.height / 2);
  return c;
}

function cropCanvas(
  source: HTMLCanvasElement,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  w: number,
  h: number
): HTMLCanvasElement | null {
  const sx = Math.max(0, Math.floor(x));
  const sy = Math.max(0, Math.floor(y));
  const sw = Math.min(source.width - sx, Math.floor(w));
  const sh = Math.min(source.height - sy, Math.floor(h));
  if (sw < 24 || sh < 24) return null;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = sw;
  c.height = sh;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) return null;
  ctx.drawImage(source, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, sw, sh);
  return c;
}

function contrastCanvas(source: HTMLCanvasElement): HTMLCanvasElement {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = source.width;
  c.height = source.height;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) return c;
  ctx.drawImage(source, 0, 0);
  try {
    const img = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
    const d = img.data;
    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
      let y = 0.299 * d[i] + 0.587 * d[i + 1] + 0.114 * d[i + 2];
      y = (y - 128) * 1.4 + 128;
      y = y < 0 ? 0 : y > 255 ? 255 : y;
      d[i] = d[i + 1] = d[i + 2] = y;
    }
    ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return c;
}

/** Alias for app preload */
export function prepareZXing(): Promise<any> {
  return loadZXing();
}

/** GDPR cookie / local-storage consent (Atlas Commerce). */

export const CONSENT_VERSION = 1;
const STORAGE_KEY = 'atlas_cookie_consent_v1';

export type ConsentCategories = {
  /** Always true — auth session, security, load balancing. */
  necessary: true;
  /** Theme, density, onboarding flags stored locally. */
  preferences: boolean;
  /** Reserved — no third-party analytics today. */
  analytics: boolean;
};

export type ConsentRecord = {
  version: number;
  necessary: true;
  preferences: boolean;
  analytics: boolean;
  decidedAt: string; // ISO
  method: 'accept_all' | 'necessary_only' | 'custom';
};

export function getConsent(): ConsentRecord | null {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as ConsentRecord;
    if (!parsed || parsed.version !== CONSENT_VERSION) return null;
    return parsed;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function hasDecidedConsent(): boolean {
  return getConsent() != null;
}

export function saveConsent(
  partial: Pick<ConsentCategories, 'preferences' | 'analytics'>,
  method: ConsentRecord['method'],
): ConsentRecord {
  const record: ConsentRecord = {
    version: CONSENT_VERSION,
    necessary: true,
    preferences: !!partial.preferences,
    analytics: !!partial.analytics,
    decidedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    method,
  };
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(record));
  } catch {
    /* private mode */
  }
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('atlas-consent-updated', { detail: record }));
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return record;
}

export function acceptAll(): ConsentRecord {
  return saveConsent({ preferences: true, analytics: true }, 'accept_all');
}

export function acceptNecessaryOnly(): ConsentRecord {
  return saveConsent({ preferences: false, analytics: false }, 'necessary_only');
}

/** Prefer preferences category for UI chrome (theme/density). If undecided, allow (first paint). */
export function canUsePreferences(): boolean {
  const c = getConsent();
  if (!c) return true;
  return c.preferences;
}

export function canUseAnalytics(): boolean {
  const c = getConsent();
  return !!(c && c.analytics);
}

export function openConsentSettings() {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('atlas-consent-open'));
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

/**
 * v260 — Crash reporting (docs/reports-github.md).
 *
 * Fire-and-forget: window errors, unhandled promise rejections and React
 * ErrorBoundary crashes are POSTed to /api/crash-reports (public endpoint,
 * rate-limited + sanitized server-side). The worker queues them in D1 and —
 * when the owner configured a GitHub token — turns each unique crash into a
 * deduplicated issue in the project repo.
 *
 * Rules: never throw, never block the UI, max 5 reports per session,
 * same message+frame deduped client-side, network noise ignored.
 */
import { getApiBase } from '../config';
import { isLoggedIn } from '../auth';
import { APP_VERSION } from '../version';

const MAX_PER_SESSION = 5;
let sent = 0;
const seen = new Set<string>();

export function reportCrash(err: unknown, ctx: { route?: string; componentStack?: string } = {}): void {
  try {
    // v0.7.4 — aucun rapport de bug pour les visiteurs non connectés (pages publiques, accueil, desktop…).
    if (!isLoggedIn()) return;
    if (sent >= MAX_PER_SESSION) return;
    const e = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err ?? 'Erreur inconnue'));
    const message = (e.message || 'Erreur inconnue').slice(0, 400);
    const firstFrame =
      (e.stack || '').split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).find((l) => l.startsWith('at ')) || '';
    const key = `${message}|${firstFrame}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return;
    seen.add(key);
    sent += 1;
    const payload = JSON.stringify({
      message,
      stack: (e.stack || '').slice(0, 4000),
      componentStack: (ctx.componentStack || '').slice(0, 2000),
      route: ctx.route || (typeof location !== 'undefined' ? location.pathname : ''),
      version: APP_VERSION,
      ua: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.userAgent : '',
    });
    const url = `${getApiBase()}/api/crash-reports`;
    fetch(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: payload,
      keepalive: true,
    }).catch(() => {
      try {
        navigator.sendBeacon(url, new Blob([payload], { type: 'application/json' }));
      } catch {
        /* abandon — reporting must never make things worse */
      }
    });
  } catch {
    /* never throw from the reporter */
  }
}

export function installCrashReporting(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  window.addEventListener('error', (ev) => {
    reportCrash(ev.error instanceof Error ? ev.error : new Error(String(ev.message || 'Erreur globale')), {
      route: typeof location !== 'undefined' ? location.pathname : '',
    });
  });
  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (ev: PromiseRejectionEvent) => {
    const r = ev.reason;
    const msg = r instanceof Error ? r.message : String(r ?? '');
    // Network noise is already surfaced by the ErrorBoundary UX — don't spam.
    if (/failed to fetch|networkerror|load failed|net::/i.test(msg)) return;
    reportCrash(r instanceof Error ? r : new Error(`Promise rejetée : ${msg.slice(0, 300)}`));
  });
}

const KEY = 'atlas_ui_density';
const GLASS_KEY = 'atlas_ui_glass';
const SCALE_KEY = 'atlas_ui_scale';

/** @deprecated Compact removed; always comfortable. */
export type Density = 'comfortable' | 'compact';
export type UiScale = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

export function getDensity(): Density {
  return 'comfortable';
}

export function setDensity(_d?: Density) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, 'comfortable');
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-density', 'comfortable');
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('density-compact');
    document.documentElement.classList.add('density-comfortable');
  }
  applyEffectiveGlassToDom();
  notifyUiPrefs();
}

export function getUiScale(): UiScale {
  try {
    const v = localStorage.getItem(SCALE_KEY);
    if (v === 'sm' || v === 'lg' || v === 'md') return v;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return 'md';
}

export function setUiScale(scale: UiScale) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SCALE_KEY, scale);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-ui-scale', scale);
  }
  notifyUiPrefs();
}

/** Liquid glass permanently disabled. */
export function isGlassEnabled(): boolean {
  return false;
}

export function setGlassEnabled(_on: boolean) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(GLASS_KEY, '0');
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  applyEffectiveGlassToDom();
  notifyUiPrefs();
}

export function isLiquidGlassActive(): boolean {
  return false;
}

function applyEffectiveGlassToDom() {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  const root = document.documentElement;
  root.setAttribute('data-liquid-glass', 'off');
  root.setAttribute('data-glass', 'off');
  root.classList.remove('liquid-glass-active');
  root.classList.add('liquid-glass-off');
  root.style.setProperty('--glass-blur', '0px');
  root.style.setProperty('--glass-saturate', '1');
  root.style.setProperty('--glass-bg', 'transparent');
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(GLASS_KEY, '0');
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

export function notifyUiPrefs() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('atlas-ui-prefs', {
        detail: {
          density: getDensity(),
          scale: getUiScale(),
          glass: false,
          liquidActive: false,
        },
      }),
    );
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

export function applyDensityFromStorage() {
  setDensity('comfortable');
  setUiScale(getUiScale());
  applyEffectiveGlassToDom();
}

export function subscribeUiPrefs(cb: () => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};
  const handler = () => cb();
  window.addEventListener('atlas-ui-prefs', handler);
  return () => window.removeEventListener('atlas-ui-prefs', handler);
}

/** Browser-only handoff state: never a session token, PKCE verifier or URL redirect. */
export type DesktopApproval = { request_id: string; state: string; origin: string; expiresAt: number };
export const DESKTOP_APPROVAL_KEY = 'atlas_desktop_approval_v1';
const ID = /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/;
const STATE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43,128}$/;

/** Parse only our exact fragment contract, not arbitrary callbacks or return URLs. */
export function parseDesktopApproval(fragment: string, origin: string, now = Date.now()): DesktopApproval | null {
  try {
    if (new URL(origin).protocol !== 'https:' || new URL(origin).origin !== origin) return null;
    const p = new URLSearchParams(fragment.replace(/^#/, ''));
    if ([...p.keys()].length !== 2 || p.getAll('request_id').length !== 1 || p.getAll('state').length !== 1) return null;
    const id = p.get('request_id') || '';
    const state = p.get('state') || '';
    if (!ID.test(id) || !STATE.test(state)) return null;
    return { request_id: id, state, origin, expiresAt: now + 300_000 };
  } catch { return null; }
}

export function clearDesktopApproval(): void {
  try { sessionStorage.removeItem(DESKTOP_APPROVAL_KEY); } catch { /* fail closed on read */ }
}
export function saveDesktopApproval(context: DesktopApproval): boolean {
  try { sessionStorage.setItem(DESKTOP_APPROVAL_KEY, JSON.stringify(context)); return true; }
  catch { return false; }
}
/** Only this fixed route may replace the usual post-login destination. */
export function desktopLoginReturn(): '/login/desktop' | null {
  return loadDesktopApproval() ? '/login/desktop' : null;
}
export function loadDesktopApproval(): DesktopApproval | null {
  try {
    const c = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(DESKTOP_APPROVAL_KEY) || 'null');
    if (c && Object.keys(c).sort().join(',') === 'expiresAt,origin,request_id,state' &&
      typeof c.request_id === 'string' && ID.test(c.request_id) && typeof c.state === 'string' && STATE.test(c.state) &&
      c.origin === window.location.origin && window.location.protocol === 'https:' &&
      Number.isFinite(c.expiresAt) && c.expiresAt > Date.now() && c.expiresAt <= Date.now() + 300_000) return c;
  } catch { /* absent, blocked or invalid storage is not a redirect */ }
  clearDesktopApproval();
  return null;
}

export type DesktopConsent = {
  request_id: string; origin: string; username: string; device_label: string;
  pairing_code: string; csrf_token: string; expires_at: string; consent_expires_at: string;
};
const MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  DEVICE_REQUIRED: 'Empreinte du navigateur indisponible. Cette connexion desktop ne peut pas continuer.',
  EXPIRED: 'La demande a expiré. Recommencez depuis le desktop.',
  USED: 'Cette demande a déjà été utilisée.', CANCELLED: 'Demande annulée sur le desktop.',
  DENIED: 'Connexion refusée.', CSRF_INVALID: 'Confirmation expirée ou remplacée. Rechargez cette page.',
  INVALID_PROOF: 'La demande ou son état ne correspond pas.', ORIGIN_MISMATCH: 'Le serveur ne correspond pas à la demande.',
  ACCOUNT_CHANGED: 'Le compte a été modifié. Recommencez la connexion.', RATE_LIMITED: 'Trop de tentatives. Patientez.',
};
export class DesktopApprovalError extends Error {
  constructor(public code: string) { super(MESSAGES[code] || 'Impossible de poursuivre la connexion desktop.'); }
}
/** Same-origin fetch only; never follow a redirect carrying the browser bearer. */
export async function desktopBrowserPost<T>(action: 'prepare' | 'authorize', context: DesktopApproval, token: string, fingerprint: string, decision?: { csrf_token: string; decision: 'approve' | 'deny' }): Promise<T> {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 15_000);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/auth/desktop/v1/${action}`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'X-Device-Fingerprint': fingerprint },
      body: JSON.stringify({ request_id: context.request_id, origin: context.origin, state: context.state, ...decision }),
      signal: controller.signal, redirect: 'error', cache: 'no-store', referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer', credentials: 'same-origin',
    });
    const reply: any = await res.json().catch(() => null);
    if (!res.ok || !reply?.success) {
      // No raw server text, body, URLs or credentials in an Error/console/crash report.
      const code = typeof reply?.code === 'string' && /^[A-Z_]{1,40}$/.test(reply.code) ? reply.code : 'UNAVAILABLE';
      throw new DesktopApprovalError(code);
    }
    return reply.data as T;
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}

/** Messages d’erreur utilisateur (FR) — codes API + textes génériques. */

const CODE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  BAD_PASSWORD: 'Mot de passe incorrect. Vérifiez et réessayez.',
  PASSWORD_REQUIRED: 'Le mot de passe de confirmation est obligatoire.',
  UNAUTHORIZED: 'Session expirée ou non autorisée. Reconnectez-vous.',
  FORBIDDEN_ROLE: 'Votre rôle ne permet pas cette action. Contactez un administrateur.',
  OWNER_ONLY: 'Réservé au propriétaire / administrateur principal.',
  REASON_REQUIRED:
    'Un motif de remboursement valable et une explication détaillée sont obligatoires. Sans cela, le remboursement est refusé.',
  SOURCE_REQUIRED: 'Sélectionnez la facture d’origine à rembourser.',
  ITEMS_REQUIRED: 'Indiquez au moins une ligne et une quantité à retourner.',
  QTY_EXCEEDED: 'La quantité à rembourser dépasse le reste remboursable sur cette ligne.',
  DISPOSITION_REQUIRED: 'Sans remise en stock, une disposition est obligatoire (cassé, perdu, client conserve…).',
  INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: 'Stock insuffisant pour cette opération. Réduisez la quantité ou réapprovisionnez.',
  WR_NO_PAYMENT: 'Impossible d’enregistrer un paiement sur un avoir WR.',
  VOID_REASON_REQUIRED: 'Motif d’annulation obligatoire (le numéro de document est conservé).',
  PERIOD_LOCKED: 'Période fiscale clôturée — document refusé pour cette date.',
  REFUND_FAILED: 'Impossible de créer le remboursement. Réessayez ou contactez le support.',
  INVOICE_CREATE_FAILED: 'Impossible de créer la facture. Vérifiez les lignes et le client.',
  ALREADY_PAID: 'Cette facture est déjà soldée (reste dû = 0).',
  CREDIT_LIMIT: 'Limite de crédit client dépassée.',
  DUPLICATE_PRODUCT: 'Produit en doublon (SKU, code-barres ou nom).',
  ROLE_LOCKED: 'Vous ne pouvez pas modifier votre rôle ici. Contactez un administrateur.',
  WR_PREFIX_INVALID: 'Préfixe WR invalide. Utilisez 1 à 12 caractères (lettres, chiffres, - ou /).',
  WR_NUMBER_INVALID: 'Numéro de remboursement (WR) invalide.',
  WR_NUMBER_TAKEN: 'Ce numéro WR est déjà utilisé. Augmentez le compteur dans Paramètres → Facturation.',
  DELETE_FAILED: 'Suppression impossible. Vérifiez le mot de passe et réessayez.',
  RATE_LIMIT: 'Trop de requêtes. Patientez une minute puis réessayez.',
  TRANSFER_FAILED: 'Transfert de stock impossible. Vérifiez les quantités et emplacements.',
  UBL_VALIDATION_FAILED: 'Export UBL refusé : champs obligatoires manquants (ICE, client, lignes…).',
  NO_FIELDS: 'Aucun champ à modifier.',
  SETTINGS_SAVE_FAILED: 'Impossible d’enregistrer les paramètres. Réessayez après déploiement.',
  FORM_INCOMPLETE: 'Complétez les champs obligatoires (surlignés en rouge).',
  INVALID_PERIOD: 'Format de période invalide. Utilisez AAAA-MM (ex. 2026-06).',
};

export function friendlyError(err: any, fallback = 'Une erreur est survenue. Réessayez ou contactez le support.'): string {
  if (!err) return fallback;
  const code = String(err.code || err.body?.code || '').trim();
  if (code && CODE_MAP[code]) return CODE_MAP[code];
  const msg = String(err.message || err.error || err.body?.error || '').trim();
  if (!msg) return fallback;
  // Soft-map common English / raw strings
  const low = msg.toLowerCase();
  if (low.includes('password') || low.includes('mot de passe')) {
    if (low.includes('required') || low.includes('obligatoire') || low.includes('saisir')) {
      return CODE_MAP.PASSWORD_REQUIRED;
    }
    return CODE_MAP.BAD_PASSWORD;
  }
  if (low.includes('network') || low.includes('failed to fetch')) {
    return 'Connexion impossible. Vérifiez le réseau et l’URL de l’API.';
  }
  return msg;
}

/** Validate credit / WR prefix client-side (mirror of server). */
export function validateWrPrefix(raw: string): { ok: true; value: string } | { ok: false; error: string } {
  const v = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (!v) return { ok: false, error: 'Le préfixe WR ne peut pas être vide (ex. WR-).' };
  if (v.length > 12) return { ok: false, error: CODE_MAP.WR_PREFIX_INVALID };
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-/]{0,11}$/.test(v)) {
    return { ok: false, error: CODE_MAP.WR_PREFIX_INVALID };
  }
  return { ok: true, value: v };
}

import { getToken } from '../auth';
import { getCachedFingerprint } from '../fingerprint';
import { BASE } from '../api';
import { uiToast } from '../components/AppDialogs';

/** Download a CSV export (Excel-friendly: UTF-8 BOM + ; separator from API). */
export async function downloadExport(path: string, filename: string) {
  const token = getToken();
  if (!token) {
    uiToast('Session expirée. Reconnectez-vous.', 'error');
    return;
  }
  const fp = await getCachedFingerprint();
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        'X-Device-Fingerprint': fp,
        Accept: 'text/csv, application/json',
      },
    });
  } catch {
    uiToast('Réseau indisponible. Réessayez.', 'error');
    return;
  }
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    uiToast((err as any).error || `Export impossible (${res.status})`, 'error');
    return;
  }
  // Prefer server filename (with date) when present
  const cd = res.headers.get('Content-Disposition') || '';
  const m = cd.match(/filename="?([^";]+)"?/i);
  const finalName = (m?.[1] || filename || 'export.csv').trim();

  const blob = await res.blob();
  if (!blob || blob.size < 3) {
    uiToast('Export vide — aucun produit à exporter.', 'error');
    return;
  }
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = finalName;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  uiToast(`Fichier téléchargé : ${finalName}`, 'success');
}

/** Client-side field validation — messages FR clairs */

export type FieldErrors = Record<string, string>;

export function firstError(errors: FieldErrors): string | null {
  const k = Object.keys(errors).find((key) => errors[key]);
  return k ? errors[k] : null;
}

export function isEmail(v: string): boolean {
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v.trim());
}

export function validateClientForm(form: {
  name?: string;
  ice?: string;
  email?: string;
  phone?: string;
}): FieldErrors {
  const e: FieldErrors = {};
  if (!String(form.name || '').trim()) e.name = 'Le nom du client est obligatoire.';
  const ice = String(form.ice || '').replace(/\s/g, '');
  if (ice && !/^\d{15}$/.test(ice)) e.ice = 'ICE : 15 chiffres (sans espaces).';
  const email = String(form.email || '').trim();
  if (email && !isEmail(email)) e.email = 'Adresse e-mail invalide.';
  const phone = String(form.phone || '').replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
  if (phone && phone.length < 8) e.phone = 'Numéro de téléphone trop court.';
  return e;
}

export function validateVendorForm(form: {
  name?: string;
  ice?: string;
  email?: string;
  phone?: string;
}): FieldErrors {
  const e: FieldErrors = {};
  if (!String(form.name || '').trim()) e.name = 'Le nom du fournisseur est obligatoire.';
  const ice = String(form.ice || '').replace(/\s/g, '');
  if (ice && !/^\d{15}$/.test(ice)) e.ice = 'ICE : 15 chiffres (sans espaces).';
  const email = String(form.email || '').trim();
  if (email && !isEmail(email)) e.email = 'Adresse e-mail invalide.';
  return e;
}

export function validateProductForm(form: {
  name?: string;
  price?: number | string;
  cost?: number | string;
  stock_quantity?: number | string;
  sku?: string;
  tax_rate?: number | string | null;
}): FieldErrors {
  const e: FieldErrors = {};
  if (!String(form.name || '').trim()) e.name = 'Le nom du produit est obligatoire.';
  const price = Number(form.price);
  if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) e.price = 'Prix de vente invalide (nombre ≥ 0).';
  if (form.cost !== undefined && form.cost !== '' && form.cost !== null) {
    const cost = Number(form.cost);
    if (!Number.isFinite(cost) || cost < 0) e.cost = 'Coût d’achat invalide (nombre ≥ 0).';
  }
  if (form.tax_rate !== undefined && form.tax_rate !== '' && form.tax_rate !== null) {
    const tr = Number(form.tax_rate);
    if (!Number.isFinite(tr) || tr < 0 || tr > 100) e.tax_rate = 'TVA : entre 0 et 100 %.';
  }
  return e;
}

export function validateInvoiceForm(opts: {
  client_name?: string;
  items?: { product_name?: string; quantity?: number; unit_price?: number }[];
}): FieldErrors {
  const e: FieldErrors = {};
  if (!String(opts.client_name || '').trim()) e.client_name = 'Le client est obligatoire.';
  const items = opts.items || [];
  if (!items.length || items.every((i) => !String(i.product_name || '').trim())) {
    e.items = 'Ajoutez au moins une ligne avec une désignation.';
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    const it = items[i];
    if (!String(it.product_name || '').trim()) continue;
    if (!(Number(it.quantity) > 0)) e[`item_qty_${i}`] = `Ligne ${i + 1} : quantité invalide.`;
    if (!(Number(it.unit_price) >= 0) || !Number.isFinite(Number(it.unit_price))) {
      e[`item_price_${i}`] = `Ligne ${i + 1} : prix unitaire invalide.`;
    }
  }
  return e;
}

export function validateBillForm(opts: {
  vendor_name?: string;
  items?: { product_name?: string; quantity?: number; unit_cost?: number }[];
}): FieldErrors {
  const e: FieldErrors = {};
  if (!String(opts.vendor_name || '').trim()) e.vendor_name = 'Le fournisseur est obligatoire.';
  const items = opts.items || [];
  if (!items.length || items.every((i) => !String(i.product_name || '').trim())) {
    e.items = 'Ajoutez au moins une ligne d’achat.';
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    const it = items[i];
    if (!String(it.product_name || '').trim()) continue;
    if (!(Number(it.quantity) > 0)) e[`item_qty_${i}`] = `Ligne ${i + 1} : quantité invalide.`;
    if (!(Number(it.unit_cost) >= 0) || !Number.isFinite(Number(it.unit_cost))) {
      e[`item_cost_${i}`] = `Ligne ${i + 1} : coût unitaire invalide.`;
    }
  }
  return e;
}

export function validateBalanceEntry(opts: {
  description?: string;
  amount?: number | string;
}): FieldErrors {
  const e: FieldErrors = {};
  if (!String(opts.description || '').trim()) e.description = 'La description est obligatoire.';
  const amount = Number(opts.amount);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) e.amount = 'Montant invalide (nombre > 0).';
  return e;
}

export function validateLoginForm(opts: {
  username?: string;
  password?: string;
}): FieldErrors {
  const e: FieldErrors = {};
  if (!String(opts.username || '').trim()) e.username = 'Identifiant obligatoire.';
  if (!String(opts.password || '')) e.password = 'Mot de passe obligatoire.';
  return e;
}

export function validateSettingsCompany(form: {
  company_name?: string;
  email?: string;
  tax_rate?: number | string | null;
  phone?: string;
}): FieldErrors {
  const e: FieldErrors = {};
  if (!String(form.company_name || '').trim()) e.company_name = 'Le nom de la société est obligatoire.';
  const email = String(form.email || '').trim();
  if (email && !isEmail(email)) e.email = 'Adresse e-mail invalide.';
  if (form.tax_rate != null && form.tax_rate !== '') {
    const tr = Number(form.tax_rate);
    if (!Number.isFinite(tr) || tr < 0 || tr > 100) e.tax_rate = 'Taux de TVA : entre 0 et 100 %.';
  }
  return e;
}


/** French hints for common input constraints */
export const FR_HINT = {
  required: 'Ce champ est obligatoire.',
  numbersOnly: 'Chiffres uniquement.',
  positiveNumber: 'Entrez un nombre valide (≥ 0).',
  email: 'Adresse e-mail invalide.',
  phone: 'Numéro de téléphone invalide.',
  ice: 'ICE : 15 chiffres (sans espaces).',
  minLength: (n: number) => `Au moins ${n} caractères.`,
} as const;

export function requireNonEmpty(v: unknown, label = 'Ce champ'): string | null {
  if (!String(v ?? '').trim()) return `${label} est obligatoire.`;
  return null;
}

export function requireNumber(v: unknown, label = 'Valeur'): string | null {
  const s = String(v ?? '').trim();
  if (!s) return `${label} est obligatoire.`;
  if (!/^-?\d+([.,]\d+)?$/.test(s)) return 'Chiffres uniquement (décimales autorisées).';
  const n = Number(s.replace(',', '.'));
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 'Nombre invalide.';
  return null;
}

export function requireDigits(v: unknown, label = 'Ce champ'): string | null {
  const s = String(v ?? '').replace(/\s/g, '');
  if (!s) return `${label} est obligatoire.`;
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(s)) return 'Chiffres uniquement.';
  return null;
}
