import { type ReactNode } from 'react';

/**
 * miniMarkdown — tiny, dependency-free Markdown renderer for Atlas Agent replies.
 * Supports: ``` code fences, # / ## / ### headings, - / * and 1. lists,
 * **bold**, *italic*, `inline code`, [liens](url), > citations, --- séparateurs.
 * Input is HTML-escaped by construction (text nodes only, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML).
 */

const INLINE = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|\*[^*]+\*|`[^`]+`|\[[^\]]+\]\([^)\s]+\))/g;

function renderInline(text: string, keyBase: string): ReactNode[] {
  const out: ReactNode[] = [];
  let last = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  let i = 0;
  INLINE.lastIndex = 0;
  while ((m = INLINE.exec(text))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push(text.slice(last, m.index));
    const tok = m[0];
    const key = `${keyBase}-i${i++}`;
    if (tok.startsWith('**')) out.push(<strong key={key}>{tok.slice(2, -2)}</strong>);
    else if (tok.startsWith('`')) out.push(<code key={key} className="md-inline-code">{tok.slice(1, -1)}</code>);
    else if (tok.startsWith('*')) out.push(<em key={key}>{tok.slice(1, -1)}</em>);
    else {
      const mm = /^\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)$/.exec(tok);
      if (mm) {
        const safe = /^(https?:\/\/|\/|#)/i.test(mm[2]);
        out.push(
          safe ? (
            <a key={key} href={mm[2]} target={mm[2].startsWith('http') ? '_blank' : undefined} rel="noreferrer noopener">{mm[1]}</a>
          ) : (
            <span key={key}>{mm[1]}</span>
          ),
        );
      } else out.push(tok);
    }
    last = m.index + tok.length;
  }
  if (last < text.length) out.push(text.slice(last));
  return out;
}

export function renderMiniMarkdown(src: string): ReactNode {
  const lines = String(src || '').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
  const blocks: ReactNode[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  let k = 0;

  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i];

    // code fence
    if (line.trim().startsWith('```')) {
      const buf: string[] = [];
      i += 1;
      while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].trim().startsWith('```')) { buf.push(lines[i]); i += 1; }
      i += 1;
      blocks.push(<pre key={`b${k++}`} className="md-pre"><code>{buf.join('\n')}</code></pre>);
      continue;
    }

    // headings
    const h = /^(#{1,3})\s+(.*)$/.exec(line);
    if (h) {
      const lvl = h[1].length;
      const content = renderInline(h[2], `b${k}`);
      blocks.push(lvl === 1 ? <h4 key={`b${k++}`} className="md-h1">{content}</h4>
        : lvl === 2 ? <h5 key={`b${k++}`} className="md-h2">{content}</h5>
        : <h6 key={`b${k++}`} className="md-h3">{content}</h6>);
      i += 1;
      continue;
    }

    // separator
    if (/^\s*(-{3,}|\*{3,})\s*$/.test(line)) { blocks.push(<hr key={`b${k++}`} className="md-hr" />); i += 1; continue; }

    // blockquote
    if (/^>\s?/.test(line)) {
      const buf: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^>\s?/.test(lines[i])) { buf.push(lines[i].replace(/^>\s?/, '')); i += 1; }
      blocks.push(<blockquote key={`b${k++}`} className="md-quote">{renderInline(buf.join(' '), `b${k}`)}</blockquote>);
      continue;
    }

    // unordered list
    if (/^\s*[-*•]\s+/.test(line)) {
      const items: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^\s*[-*•]\s+/.test(lines[i])) { items.push(lines[i].replace(/^\s*[-*•]\s+/, '')); i += 1; }
      blocks.push(
        <ul key={`b${k++}`} className="md-ul">
          {items.map((it, j) => <li key={j}>{renderInline(it, `b${k}-${j}`)}</li>)}
        </ul>,
      );
      continue;
    }

    // ordered list
    if (/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/.test(line)) {
      const items: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/.test(lines[i])) { items.push(lines[i].replace(/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/, '')); i += 1; }
      blocks.push(
        <ol key={`b${k++}`} className="md-ol">
          {items.map((it, j) => <li key={j}>{renderInline(it, `b${k}-${j}`)}</li>)}
        </ol>,
      );
      continue;
    }

    // blank line
    if (!line.trim()) { i += 1; continue; }

    // paragraph (merge consecutive plain lines)
    const buf: string[] = [line];
    i += 1;
    while (
      i < lines.length
      && lines[i].trim()
      && !/^(```|#{1,3}\s|>\s?|\s*[-*•]\s+|\s*\d+[.)]\s+)/.test(lines[i])
    ) { buf.push(lines[i]); i += 1; }
    blocks.push(<p key={`b${k++}`} className="md-p">{renderInline(buf.join(' '), `b${k}`)}</p>);
  }

  return <div className="md-root">{blocks}</div>;
}

/**
 * Money helpers — Moroccan dirham (MAD) displayed as DH.
 * Client-facing amounts are whole dirhams (no cents): 115.49 → 115, 115.79 → 116.
 */

const SYMBOLS: Record<string, string> = {
  MAD: 'DH',
  MADH: 'DH',
  DH: 'DH',
  EUR: '€',
  USD: '$',
  GBP: '£',
  TND: 'DT',
  DZD: 'DA',
  CAD: 'CA$',
};

export function currencySymbol(code?: string): string {
  const c = (code || 'MAD').toUpperCase();
  return SYMBOLS[c] || c;
}

export function normalizeCurrencyCode(code?: string): string {
  const c = (code || 'MAD').toUpperCase().trim();
  if (c === 'DH' || c === 'MADH') return 'MAD';
  return c || 'MAD';
}

/** Round to nearest whole dirham (clients do not use fractions). */
export function roundMoney(n: number | null | undefined): number {
  const x = Number(n || 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return 0;
  return Math.round(x);
}

/** 2-decimal internal (rare); prefer roundMoney for UI. */
export function roundMoney2(n: number | null | undefined): number {
  const x = Number(n || 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return 0;
  return Math.round(x * 100) / 100;
}

/**
 * Format for UI: "1 234 DH" — whole numbers only.
 */
export function fmtMoney(n: number | null | undefined, currency = 'MAD'): string {
  const v = roundMoney(n).toLocaleString('fr-FR', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  });
  const code = normalizeCurrencyCode(currency);
  const sym = currencySymbol(code);
  if (sym === 'DH' || sym === 'DT' || sym === 'DA') return `${v} ${sym}`;
  if (sym === '€' || sym === '$' || sym === '£') return `${sym}${v}`;
  return `${v} ${sym}`;
}

export const PAYMENT_METHODS = [
  { value: 'cash', label: 'Espèces (caisse)' },
  { value: 'bank_company', label: 'Virement bancaire — compte société' },
  { value: 'bank_owner', label: 'Virement bancaire — compte propriétaire' },
  { value: 'check_company', label: 'Chèque — à l’ordre de la société' },
  { value: 'check_owner', label: 'Chèque — à l’ordre du propriétaire' },
  { value: 'card', label: 'Carte bancaire' },
  { value: 'other', label: 'Autre' },
] as const;

export function paymentMethodLabel(code?: string): string {
  const m = PAYMENT_METHODS.find((x) => x.value === code);
  if (m) return m.label;
  const legacy: Record<string, string> = {
    bank: 'Virement bancaire',
    check: 'Chèque',
    cash: 'Espèces',
  };
  return legacy[code || ''] || code || '—';
}

/**
 * Number fields: never show 0 — empty string in the UI.
 * type="text" + inputMode="decimal" avoids browser forcing 0 on <input type="number">.
 * Empty still saves as 0 when the API expects a number.
 */

/** Display value: blank for 0 / null / undefined / "" */
export function numStr(v: number | string | null | undefined): string {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return '';
  const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(String(v).replace(',', '.'));
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n === 0) return '';
  return String(v);
}

/** Parse typing → number; empty → 0 (allowed on save) */
export function numFromInput(raw: string): number {
  const t = String(raw ?? '').trim().replace(',', '.');
  if (t === '' || t === '-' || t === '.' || t === '-.') return 0;
  const n = Number(t);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}

/** Keep '' while typing empty; otherwise number */
export function numFromInputOrEmpty(raw: string): number | '' {
  const t = String(raw ?? '').trim().replace(',', '.');
  if (t === '' || t === '-' || t === '.' || t === '-.') return '';
  const n = Number(t);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : '';
}

export function numOrZero(v: number | string | null | undefined): number {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return 0;
  const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(String(v).replace(',', '.'));
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}

/** Shared props for money / qty fields (no forced zero) */
export const numFieldProps = {
  type: 'text' as const,
  inputMode: 'decimal' as const,
  autoComplete: 'off' as const,
};

/**
 * Local Office preview — zero npm deps.
 * Google-Docs-like slide/document reading for PPTX & DOCX.
 */

export type OfficeSlide = {
  index: number;
  title: string;
  lines: string[];
  images: string[];
  /** Optional table grid for XLSX */
  table?: string[][];
};

type ZipEntry = { name: string; data: Uint8Array };

function u16(v: DataView, o: number) {
  return v.getUint16(o, true);
}
function u32(v: DataView, o: number) {
  return v.getUint32(o, true);
}

async function inflateRaw(data: Uint8Array): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const ds = new DecompressionStream('deflate-raw');
  const stream = new Blob([data as BlobPart]).stream().pipeThrough(ds);
  const buf = await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer();
  return new Uint8Array(buf);
}

async function unzip(buf: ArrayBuffer): Promise<ZipEntry[]> {
  const view = new DataView(buf);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
  let eocd = -1;
  for (let i = bytes.length - 22; i >= Math.max(0, bytes.length - 0x10000); i--) {
    if (u32(view, i) === 0x06054b50) {
      eocd = i;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (eocd < 0) throw new Error('ZIP EOCD not found');
  const totalEntries = u16(view, eocd + 10);
  let cdOff = u32(view, eocd + 16);
  const entries: ZipEntry[] = [];

  for (let n = 0; n < totalEntries; n++) {
    if (u32(view, cdOff) !== 0x02014b50) break;
    const method = u16(view, cdOff + 10);
    const compSize = u32(view, cdOff + 20);
    const nameLen = u16(view, cdOff + 28);
    const extraLen = u16(view, cdOff + 30);
    const commentLen = u16(view, cdOff + 32);
    const localOff = u32(view, cdOff + 42);
    const nameBytes = bytes.subarray(cdOff + 46, cdOff + 46 + nameLen);
    const name = new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(nameBytes);
    cdOff += 46 + nameLen + extraLen + commentLen;

    if (u32(view, localOff) !== 0x04034b50) continue;
    const locNameLen = u16(view, localOff + 26);
    const locExtraLen = u16(view, localOff + 28);
    const dataStart = localOff + 30 + locNameLen + locExtraLen;
    const compressed = bytes.subarray(dataStart, dataStart + compSize);
    let data: Uint8Array;
    if (method === 0) data = compressed.slice();
    else if (method === 8) {
      try {
        data = await inflateRaw(compressed);
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
    } else continue;
    entries.push({ name, data });
  }
  return entries;
}

function entryText(e: ZipEntry): string {
  return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(e.data);
}

/**
 * Decode XML character entities in ONE pass. Sequential `.replace()` chains
 * unescape twice (`&amp;lt;` -> `&lt;` -> `<`), which corrupts text and can
 * smuggle markup into previews; a single pass decodes each entity exactly
 * once and leaves unknown entities untouched.
 */
function decodeXmlEntities(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/&(#[0-9]+|#[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*);/g, (full, ent: string) => {
    if (ent[0] === '#') {
      const hex = ent[1] === 'x' || ent[1] === 'X';
      const cp = parseInt(ent.slice(hex ? 2 : 1), hex ? 16 : 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(cp) && cp >= 0 && cp <= 0x10ffff) return String.fromCodePoint(cp);
      return full;
    }
    switch (ent) {
      case 'lt':
        return '<';
      case 'gt':
        return '>';
      case 'quot':
        return '"';
      case 'apos':
        return "'";
      case 'amp':
        return '&';
      default:
        return full;
    }
  });
}

/** Extract paragraph-ish text blocks from OOXML. */
function extractLines(xml: string, paraTag: 'a:p' | 'w:p', runTag: 'a:t' | 'w:t'): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  const paraRe = new RegExp(`<${paraTag}[\\s\\S]*?<\\/${paraTag}>`, 'gi');
  const runRe = new RegExp(`<${runTag}[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/${runTag}>`, 'gi');
  let pm: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((pm = paraRe.exec(xml))) {
    const block = pm[0];
    const parts: string[] = [];
    let rm: RegExpExecArray | null;
    runRe.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((rm = runRe.exec(block))) {
      const t = decodeXmlEntities(rm[1]!)
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
      if (t) parts.push(t);
    }
    const line = parts.join('').trim();
    if (line) lines.push(line);
  }
  if (!lines.length) {
    // fallback flat
    const flat = decodeXmlEntities(
      xml
        .replace(new RegExp(`<${runTag}[^>]*>`, 'gi'), '')
        .replace(new RegExp(`</${runTag}>`, 'gi'), ' ')
        .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' '),
    )
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim();
    if (flat) lines.push(flat);
  }
  return lines;
}

function toDataUrl(name: string, data: Uint8Array): string | null {
  const lower = name.toLowerCase();
  let mime = '';
  if (lower.endsWith('.png')) mime = 'image/png';
  else if (lower.endsWith('.jpg') || lower.endsWith('.jpeg')) mime = 'image/jpeg';
  else if (lower.endsWith('.gif')) mime = 'image/gif';
  else if (lower.endsWith('.webp')) mime = 'image/webp';
  else return null;
  let binary = '';
  const chunk = 0x8000;
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += chunk) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(...data.subarray(i, i + chunk));
  }
  return `data:${mime};base64,${btoa(binary)}`;
}

export async function previewPptx(blob: Blob): Promise<OfficeSlide[]> {
  const entries = await unzip(await blob.arrayBuffer());
  const byName = new Map(entries.map((e) => [e.name.replace(/\\/g, '/'), e]));
  const media = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const e of entries) {
    const n = e.name.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    if (!/^ppt\/media\//i.test(n)) continue;
    const url = toDataUrl(n, e.data);
    if (!url) continue;
    media.set(n.toLowerCase(), url);
    media.set(n.split('/').pop()!.toLowerCase(), url);
  }

  const slidePaths = entries
    .map((e) => e.name.replace(/\\/g, '/'))
    .filter((p) => /^ppt\/slides\/slide\d+\.xml$/i.test(p))
    .sort((a, b) => Number(a.match(/(\d+)/)?.[1] || 0) - Number(b.match(/(\d+)/)?.[1] || 0));

  if (!slidePaths.length) {
    return [{ index: 1, title: 'Diapositive 1', lines: ['Aucune diapositive trouvée.'], images: [] }];
  }

  const slides: OfficeSlide[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < slidePaths.length; i++) {
    const path = slidePaths[i]!;
    const xml = entryText(byName.get(path)!);
    const lines = extractLines(xml, 'a:p', 'a:t');
    const relPath = path.replace('slides/slide', 'slides/_rels/slide') + '.rels';
    const relEntry = byName.get(relPath);
    const images: string[] = [];
    if (relEntry) {
      const relXml = entryText(relEntry);
      const re = /Target="([^"]+)"/gi;
      let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
      while ((m = re.exec(relXml))) {
        let target = m[1]!.replace(/\\/g, '/');
        if (target.startsWith('../')) target = 'ppt/' + target.replace(/^\.\.\//, '');
        const base = target.split('/').pop()!.toLowerCase();
        const data = media.get(target.toLowerCase()) || media.get(base);
        if (data && !images.includes(data)) images.push(data);
      }
    }
    slides.push({
      index: i + 1,
      title: lines[0] || `Diapositive ${i + 1}`,
      lines: lines.length ? lines : images.length ? [] : ['(Diapositive sans texte)'],
      images,
    });
  }
  return slides;
}

export async function previewDocx(blob: Blob): Promise<OfficeSlide[]> {
  const entries = await unzip(await blob.arrayBuffer());
  const byName = new Map(entries.map((e) => [e.name.replace(/\\/g, '/'), e]));
  const doc = byName.get('word/document.xml');
  const lines = doc ? extractLines(entryText(doc), 'w:p', 'w:t') : [];
  const images: string[] = [];
  for (const e of entries) {
    const n = e.name.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    if (!/^word\/media\//i.test(n)) continue;
    const url = toDataUrl(n, e.data);
    if (url) {
      images.push(url);
      if (images.length >= 12) break;
    }
  }
  return [
    {
      index: 1,
      title: 'Document',
      lines: lines.length ? lines : ['Pas de texte extractible.'],
      images,
    },
  ];
}


function colLettersToIndex(col: string): number {
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < col.length; i++) {
    n = n * 26 + (col.charCodeAt(i) - 64);
  }
  return n - 1;
}

function parseCellRef(ref: string): { r: number; c: number } | null {
  const m = /^([A-Z]+)(\d+)$/i.exec(ref.trim());
  if (!m) return null;
  return { c: colLettersToIndex(m[1]!.toUpperCase()), r: Number(m[2]) - 1 };
}

export async function previewXlsx(blob: Blob): Promise<OfficeSlide[]> {
  const entries = await unzip(await blob.arrayBuffer());
  const byName = new Map(entries.map((e) => [e.name.replace(/\\/g, '/'), e]));

  // Shared strings
  const shared: string[] = [];
  const ss = byName.get('xl/sharedStrings.xml');
  if (ss) {
    const xml = entryText(ss);
    // each <si>…</si>
    const siRe = /<si[\s\S]*?<\/si>/gi;
    let sm: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((sm = siRe.exec(xml))) {
      const block = sm[0];
      const parts: string[] = [];
      const tRe = /<t[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/t>/gi;
      let tm: RegExpExecArray | null;
      while ((tm = tRe.exec(block))) {
        parts.push(decodeXmlEntities(tm[1]!));
      }
      shared.push(parts.join(''));
    }
  }

  // Sheet list from workbook
  const sheetFiles: { name: string; path: string }[] = [];
  const wb = byName.get('xl/workbook.xml');
  const rels = byName.get('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels');
  const ridToTarget = new Map<string, string>();
  if (rels) {
    const relXml = entryText(rels);
    const re = /Id="([^"]+)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"/gi;
    let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((m = re.exec(relXml))) {
      let target = m[2]!.replace(/^\//, '');
      if (!target.startsWith('xl/')) target = 'xl/' + target.replace(/^\.\.\//, '');
      ridToTarget.set(m[1]!, target.replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    }
    // also Target before Id
    const re2 = /Target="([^"]+)"[^>]*Id="([^"]+)"/gi;
    while ((m = re2.exec(relXml))) {
      let target = m[1]!.replace(/^\//, '');
      if (!target.startsWith('xl/')) target = 'xl/' + target.replace(/^\.\.\//, '');
      ridToTarget.set(m[2]!, target.replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    }
  }
  if (wb) {
    const xml = entryText(wb);
    const re = /<sheet[^>]*name="([^"]+)"[^>]*r:id="([^"]+)"[^>]*\/>/gi;
    let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((m = re.exec(xml))) {
      const target = ridToTarget.get(m[2]!);
      if (target) sheetFiles.push({ name: m[1]!, path: target });
    }
    // alternate attribute order
    const re2 = /<sheet[^>]*r:id="([^"]+)"[^>]*name="([^"]+)"[^>]*\/>/gi;
    while ((m = re2.exec(xml))) {
      const target = ridToTarget.get(m[1]!);
      if (target && !sheetFiles.some((s) => s.path === target)) {
        sheetFiles.push({ name: m[2]!, path: target });
      }
    }
  }
  // Fallback: any worksheet XML
  if (!sheetFiles.length) {
    for (const e of entries) {
      const n = e.name.replace(/\\/g, '/');
      if (/^xl\/worksheets\/sheet\d+\.xml$/i.test(n)) {
        sheetFiles.push({ name: n.split('/').pop()!.replace(/\.xml$/i, ''), path: n });
      }
    }
    sheetFiles.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
  }

  const slides: OfficeSlide[] = [];
  for (let si = 0; si < sheetFiles.length; si++) {
    const sheet = sheetFiles[si]!;
    const entry = byName.get(sheet.path) || byName.get(sheet.path.replace(/^xl\//, ''));
    if (!entry) continue;
    const xml = entryText(entry);
    // Build sparse grid from <c r="A1" ...>
    const cells = new Map<string, string>();
    let maxR = 0;
    let maxC = 0;
    const cellRe = /<c\s+([^>]+)>([\s\S]*?)<\/c>|<c\s+([^>]+)\/>/gi;
    let cm: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((cm = cellRe.exec(xml))) {
      const attrs = cm[1] || cm[3] || '';
      const inner = cm[2] || '';
      const refM = /r="([A-Z]+\d+)"/i.exec(attrs);
      if (!refM) continue;
      const ref = refM[1]!;
      const pos = parseCellRef(ref);
      if (!pos) continue;
      maxR = Math.max(maxR, pos.r);
      maxC = Math.max(maxC, pos.c);
      const tAttr = /t="([^"]+)"/.exec(attrs);
      const type = tAttr?.[1] || '';
      let val = '';
      const vM = /<v>([\s\S]*?)<\/v>/.exec(inner);
      const isM = /<is>[\s\S]*?<t[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/t>/.exec(inner);
      if (type === 's' && vM) {
        const idx = Number(vM[1]);
        // Shared strings were already entity-decoded when the table was
        // built — decoding again would double-unescape (&amp;lt; -> <).
        val = shared[idx] ?? '';
      } else if (type === 'inlineStr' && isM) {
        val = decodeXmlEntities(isM[1] || '');
      } else if (vM) {
        val = decodeXmlEntities(vM[1] || '');
      } else if (isM) {
        val = decodeXmlEntities(isM[1] || '');
      }
      val = val.trim();
      cells.set(`${pos.r}:${pos.c}`, val);
    }
    // Cap preview size for UI
    const rowLimit = Math.min(maxR + 1, 80);
    const colLimit = Math.min(maxC + 1, 20);
    const table: string[][] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < rowLimit; r++) {
      const row: string[] = [];
      for (let c = 0; c < colLimit; c++) {
        row.push(cells.get(`${r}:${c}`) || '');
      }
      // skip fully empty rows
      if (row.every((x) => !x)) continue;
      table.push(row);
    }
    // Trim empty trailing columns
    if (table.length) {
      let lastCol = 0;
      for (const row of table) {
        for (let c = row.length - 1; c >= 0; c--) {
          if (row[c]) {
            lastCol = Math.max(lastCol, c);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < table.length; i++) table[i] = table[i]!.slice(0, lastCol + 1);
    }
    slides.push({
      index: si + 1,
      title: sheet.name || `Feuille ${si + 1}`,
      lines: table.length
        ? [`${table.length} ligne(s) · ${(table[0]?.length || 0)} colonne(s)`]
        : ['Feuille vide'],
      images: [],
      table: table.length ? table : [['(vide)']],
    });
  }
  if (!slides.length) {
    return [{ index: 1, title: 'Classeur', lines: ['Aucune feuille trouvée.'], images: [], table: [['(vide)']] }];
  }
  return slides;
}

export async function buildOfficePreview(blob: Blob, filename: string): Promise<OfficeSlide[] | null> {
  const n = filename.toLowerCase();
  if (n.endsWith('.pptx')) return previewPptx(blob);
  if (n.endsWith('.docx')) return previewDocx(blob);
  if (n.endsWith('.xlsx')) return previewXlsx(blob);
  return null;
}

/**
 * Offline product catalog + action outbox (IndexedDB).
 * Optimized: bulk put without blocking UI, no full clear when possible.
 */

const DB_NAME = 'atlas-commerce-offline';
const DB_VER = 3;
const STORE = 'products';
const OUTBOX = 'outbox';
const META = 'meta';
const LOCATIONS = 'locations';

let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase> | null = null;

function openDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;
  dbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VER);
    req.onerror = () => {
      dbPromise = null;
      reject(req.error);
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      const db = req.result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE)) {
        const store = db.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath: 'id' });
        store.createIndex('barcode', 'barcode', { unique: false });
        store.createIndex('sku', 'sku', { unique: false });
      }
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(OUTBOX)) {
        db.createObjectStore(OUTBOX, { keyPath: 'local_id', autoIncrement: true });
      }
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(META)) {
        db.createObjectStore(META, { keyPath: 'key' });
      }
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(LOCATIONS)) {
        db.createObjectStore(LOCATIONS, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
    };
  });
  return dbPromise;
}

function mapProduct(p: any) {
  return {
    id: p.id,
    name: p.name,
    sku: p.sku || '',
    barcode: p.barcode || '',
    price: Number(p.price ?? p.unit_price ?? 0),
    stock_quantity: Number(p.stock_quantity ?? p.stock ?? 0),
    track_inventory: p.track_inventory,
    low_stock_threshold: p.low_stock_threshold ?? p.min_stock,
    category: p.category,
    unit: p.unit,
    parent_id: p.parent_id || null,
    variant_label: p.variant_label || '',
    tax_rate: p.tax_rate,
    cached_at: Date.now(),
  };
}

/** Bulk upsert products (single transaction). Clears only once per full sync. */
export async function cacheProducts(products: any[]): Promise<number> {
  if (!products?.length) return 0;
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE);
    store.clear();
    let n = 0;
    for (const p of products) {
      if (!p?.id) continue;
      store.put(mapProduct(p));
      n++;
    }
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(n);
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

/** Upsert single product (after create/update) without full resync */
export async function upsertProduct(p: any): Promise<void> {
  if (!p?.id) return;
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE, 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(STORE).put(mapProduct(p));
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

export async function lookupOffline(code: string): Promise<any | null> {
  const needle = code.trim();
  if (!needle) return null;
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE);
    const req = store.index('barcode').getAll(needle);
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const byBc = (req.result || []).filter((p: any) => p.barcode === needle);
      if (byBc.length) {
        resolve(byBc[0]);
        return;
      }
      const all = store.getAll();
      all.onsuccess = () => {
        const found = (all.result || []).find(
          (p: any) => String(p.sku || '').toLowerCase() === needle.toLowerCase()
        );
        resolve(found || null);
      };
      all.onerror = () => reject(all.error);
    };
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

export async function cacheCount(): Promise<number> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = db.transaction(STORE, 'readonly').objectStore(STORE).count();
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

export async function enqueueOutbox(payload: {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  detail?: string;
  barcode?: string;
  product_id?: number;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}): Promise<void> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(OUTBOX, 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(OUTBOX).add({ ...payload, created_at: new Date().toISOString() });
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

export async function countOutbox(): Promise<number> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(OUTBOX, 'readonly');
    const req = tx.objectStore(OUTBOX).count();
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(Number(req.result || 0));
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

export async function listOutbox(): Promise<any[]> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = db.transaction(OUTBOX, 'readonly').objectStore(OUTBOX).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

export async function removeOutboxItem(localId: number): Promise<void> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(OUTBOX, 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(OUTBOX).delete(localId);
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

export async function flushOutbox(
  postFn: (item: any) => Promise<boolean>
): Promise<{ sent: number; failed: number }> {
  const items = await listOutbox();
  let sent = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    try {
      if (await postFn(item)) {
        await removeOutboxItem(item.local_id);
        sent++;
      } else failed++;
    } catch {
      failed++;
    }
  }
  return { sent, failed };
}

export function isOnline(): boolean {
  return typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true;
}

/** alias FR */
export const cacheProduits = cacheProducts;


/** Request Background Sync so offline scans flush when connectivity returns */
export async function requestBackgroundSync(tag = 'atlas-outbox-sync'): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return false;
    const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
    // Background Sync API (Chrome/Android). iOS Safari ignores — online event still works.
    if ('sync' in reg) {
      await (reg as any).sync.register(tag);
      return true;
    }
  } catch {
    /* unsupported or permission */
  }
  return false;
}

/** Enqueue + ask browser to sync when back online */
export async function enqueueOutboxAndSync(payload: {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  detail?: string;
  barcode?: string;
  product_id?: number;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}): Promise<void> {
  await enqueueOutbox(payload);
  await requestBackgroundSync('atlas-outbox-sync');
}

/** Cache warehouse list for offline selection */
export async function cacheLocations(locations: any[]): Promise<number> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(LOCATIONS, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(LOCATIONS);
    store.clear();
    let n = 0;
    for (const l of locations || []) {
      if (!l?.id) continue;
      store.put({
        id: l.id,
        code: l.code,
        name: l.name,
        is_default: !!l.is_default,
        total_units: Number(l.total_units || 0),
        cached_at: Date.now(),
      });
      n++;
    }
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(n);
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

export async function listCachedLocations(): Promise<any[]> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = db.transaction(LOCATIONS, 'readonly').objectStore(LOCATIONS).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

/**
 * Optimistic local stock change (offline). Syncs via outbox as stock_adjust.
 * Returns new local quantity or null if product missing offline.
 */
export async function applyLocalStockDelta(
  productId: number,
  delta: number,
  meta?: { location_id?: number; reason?: string },
): Promise<number | null> {
  const db = await openDb();
  const prod = await new Promise<any>((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = db.transaction(STORE, 'readonly').objectStore(STORE).get(productId);
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || null);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
  if (!prod) return null;
  const next = Math.max(0, Number(prod.stock_quantity || 0) + delta);
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE, 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(STORE).put({ ...prod, stock_quantity: next, cached_at: Date.now() });
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
  await enqueueOutboxAndSync({
    type: 'stock_adjust',
    title: `Ajust. stock ${prod.name}`,
    detail: `${delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${delta} → ${next}`,
    product_id: productId,
    meta: {
      delta,
      location_id: meta?.location_id,
      reason: meta?.reason || 'offline_adjust',
      previous: prod.stock_quantity,
    },
  });
  return next;
}

/** List products with low stock from offline cache */
export async function listLowStockOffline(): Promise<any[]> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = db.transaction(STORE, 'readonly').objectStore(STORE).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const rows = (req.result || []).filter(
        (p: any) =>
          p.track_inventory &&
          Number(p.stock_quantity || 0) <= Number(p.low_stock_threshold ?? 5),
      );
      resolve(rows);
    };
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

/** Unique document titles per route — all under 60 characters. */

const BRAND = 'Atlas';

/** Exact path → title (no brand suffix yet). */
const EXACT: Record<string, string> = {
  '/': 'Tableau de bord',
  '/actions': 'Actions en attente',
  '/products': 'Produits & stock',
  '/scan': 'Scan code-barres',
  '/clients': 'Clients',
  '/employees': 'Employés',
  '/attendance': 'Présence',
  '/vendors': 'Fournisseurs',
  '/quotes': 'Devis',
  '/quick-sale': 'Vente rapide',
  '/invoices': 'Factures de vente',
  '/reimbursements': 'Remboursements',
  '/bills': "Factures d'achat",
  '/receipts': 'Reçus',
  '/balance': 'Solde & recettes',
  '/reports': 'Rapports & clôture',
  '/inventory-ops': 'Ops stock',
  '/settings': 'Paramètres',
  '/about': 'À propos',
  '/whats-new': 'Nouveautés',
  '/privacy': 'Confidentialité',
  '/terms': "Conditions d'utilisation",
  '/login': 'Connexion',
  '/welcome': 'Bienvenue',
  '/404': 'Page introuvable',
  '/403': 'Accès refusé',
};

function withBrand(page: string): string {
  const full = `${page} · ${BRAND}`;
  return full.length <= 60 ? full : page.slice(0, 60);
}

/**
 * Resolve a unique <title> for a location pathname.
 * Dynamic segments (ids) get a stable generic title.
 */
export function titleForPath(pathname: string): string {
  const path = (pathname || '/').replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/';

  if (EXACT[path]) return withBrand(EXACT[path]);

  // Dynamic desktop routes
  if (/^\/products\/[^/]+\/historique$/.test(path)) return withBrand('Historique produit');
  if (/^\/quick-sale\/[^/]+$/.test(path)) return withBrand('Détail vente rapide');
  if (/^\/invoices\/[^/]+$/.test(path)) return withBrand('Détail facture');
  if (/^\/error\/[^/]+$/.test(path)) return withBrand('Erreur');
  if (path.startsWith('/settings')) return withBrand('Paramètres');
  if (path === '/m-legacy') return withBrand('Mobile');

  return withBrand('Atlas Commerce');
}

const DEFAULT_DESC =
  'Atlas Commerce — stock, caisse et facturation pour commerces et entrepôts au Maroc.';
const OG_IMAGE = '/og-image.png';

function setMeta(attr: 'name' | 'property', key: string, content: string) {
  try {
    let el = document.head.querySelector(`meta[${attr}="${key}"]`) as HTMLMetaElement | null;
    if (!el) {
      el = document.createElement('meta');
      el.setAttribute(attr, key);
      document.head.appendChild(el);
    }
    el.setAttribute('content', content);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

/** Title + Open Graph / Twitter cards for the current route. */
export function applyPageMeta(pathname: string): void {
  const title = titleForPath(pathname);
  try {
    document.title = title;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  setMeta('property', 'og:title', title);
  setMeta('property', 'og:description', DEFAULT_DESC);
  setMeta('property', 'og:image', OG_IMAGE);
  setMeta('property', 'og:type', 'website');
  setMeta('property', 'og:site_name', 'Atlas Commerce');
  setMeta('name', 'twitter:card', 'summary_large_image');
  setMeta('name', 'twitter:title', title);
  setMeta('name', 'twitter:description', DEFAULT_DESC);
  setMeta('name', 'twitter:image', OG_IMAGE);
  setMeta('name', 'description', DEFAULT_DESC);
}

// Keep legacy name working
export function applyPageTitle(pathname: string): void {
  applyPageMeta(pathname);
}

/**
 * Frontend performance helpers — debounce, in-flight request dedupe, short GET cache.
 * Keep dependencies zero (no React Query required on free-tier stack).
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

/** Debounce a value (search boxes, autocomplete). Default 300ms. */
export function useDebouncedValue<T>(value: T, delayMs = 300): T {
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delayMs);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [value, delayMs]);
  return debounced;
}

/** Classic function debounce (for event handlers). */
export function debounce<T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(fn: T, wait = 300): T {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  return ((...args: Parameters<T>) => {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timer = null;
      fn(...args);
    }, wait);
  }) as T;
}

type CacheEntry = { expires: number; data: unknown };

const inflight = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();
const getCache = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();

/** Max entries to avoid unbounded memory on long sessions */
const MAX_CACHE = 80;

/**
 * Deduplicate concurrent identical GET requests and optionally cache successful
 * responses for `ttlMs` (stale-while-revalidate style for low-volatility data).
 */
export function dedupedGet<T>(
  key: string,
  fetcher: () => Promise<T>,
  ttlMs = 0
): Promise<T> {
  if (ttlMs > 0) {
    const hit = getCache.get(key);
    if (hit && hit.expires > Date.now()) {
      return Promise.resolve(hit.data as T);
    }
  }
  const existing = inflight.get(key);
  if (existing) return existing as Promise<T>;

  const p = fetcher()
    .then((data) => {
      if (ttlMs > 0) {
        if (getCache.size >= MAX_CACHE) {
          const first = getCache.keys().next().value;
          if (first != null) getCache.delete(first);
        }
        getCache.set(key, { expires: Date.now() + ttlMs, data });
      }
      return data;
    })
    .finally(() => {
      inflight.delete(key);
    });

  inflight.set(key, p);
  return p;
}

/** Drop cached GET entries (call after mutations that invalidate lists). */
export function invalidateGetCache(prefix?: string) {
  if (!prefix) {
    getCache.clear();
    return;
  }
  // oxlint-disable-next-line unicorn/no-useless-spread -- snapshot on purpose: keys are deleted during the loop
  for (const k of [...getCache.keys()]) {
    if (k.startsWith(prefix)) getCache.delete(k);
  }
}

/** Open a print-friendly product barcode label (PC). */
export function printProductLabel(p: {
  name: string;
  sku?: string;
  barcode?: string;
  price?: number | string;
  showPrice?: boolean;
}) {
  const code = String(p.barcode || p.sku || '').trim();
  const name = String(p.name || '').slice(0, 48);
  const price =
    p.showPrice !== false && p.price != null && p.price !== ''
      ? `${Math.round(Number(p.price)).toLocaleString('fr-MA')} MAD`
      : '';
  const w = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=420,height=520');
  if (!w) return;
  w.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Étiquette</title>
<style>
  @page { size: 50mm 30mm; margin: 2mm; }
  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 12px; text-align: center; }
  .name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .code { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin: 8px 0; }
  .bars { height: 48px; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1px; margin: 8px auto; }
  .bars i { display: inline-block; width: 2px; background: #111; height: 100%; }
  .bars i.w { width: 4px; }
  .price { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 6px; }
  .sku { font-size: 11px; color: #444; }
  @media print { button { display: none; } }
</style></head><body>
  <div class="name">${escapeHtml(name)}</div>
  <div class="sku">${escapeHtml(p.sku || '')}</div>
  <div class="bars" id="bars"></div>
  <div class="code">${escapeHtml(code || '—')}</div>
  ${price ? `<div class="price">${escapeHtml(price)}</div>` : ''}
  <button onclick="window.print()" style="margin-top:16px;padding:8px 16px">Imprimer</button>
  <script>
    (function(){
      var s = ${JSON.stringify(code || '0')};
      var el = document.getElementById('bars');
      if (!el) return;
      for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
        var n = s.charCodeAt(i) % 5;
        var bar = document.createElement('i');
        if (n > 2) bar.className = 'w';
        el.appendChild(bar);
        var gap = document.createElement('i');
        gap.style.background = 'transparent';
        gap.style.width = '1px';
        el.appendChild(gap);
      }
    })();
  </script>
</body></html>`);
  w.document.close();
}

function escapeHtml(s: string) {
  return String(s)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

import { getToken } from '../auth';
import { uiToast } from '../components/AppDialogs';
import { getApiBase } from '../config';

function qsFromParams(params?: Record<string, string | undefined>): string {
  if (!params) return '';
  const q = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (v != null && v !== '') q.set(k, v);
  }
  const s = q.toString();
  return s ? s : '';
}

/**
 * Open printable HTML report in a real navigable URL (with short-lived rt ticket)
 * so the browser Refresh button keeps working.
 * JWT is never put in the URL — only a 30‑minute HMAC report ticket.
 */
export function openReport(
  path: string,
  params?: Record<string, string | undefined>,
) {
  const token = getToken() || '';
  if (!token) {
    uiToast('Session expirée. Veuillez vous reconnecter.', 'error');
    return;
  }

  // Open synchronously on the user gesture (avoids popup blockers)
  const tab = window.open('about:blank', '_blank');
  if (!tab) {
    uiToast(
      'Le navigateur a bloqué la nouvelle fenêtre. Autorisez les pop-ups pour ce site, puis réessayez.',
      'error',
    );
    return;
  }
  try {
    tab.opener = null;
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
  try {
    tab.document.write(
      `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="fr"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><title>Chargement…</title>
      <style>body{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;padding:48px;color:#334;background:#fafafa}
      .s{width:28px;height:28px;border:3px solid #ccc;border-top-color:#71717a;border-radius:50%;animation:r .7s linear infinite;margin:0 auto 16px}
      @keyframes r{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}} p{text-align:center}</style></head>
      <body><div class="s"></div><p>Ouverture du rapport…</p></body></html>`,
    );
    tab.document.close();
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  void (async () => {
    try {
      const { getCachedFingerprint } = await import('../fingerprint');
      const fp = await getCachedFingerprint();
      const base = getApiBase();

      // Mint short-lived report ticket (not the session JWT)
      let rt = '';
      try {
        const tr = await fetch(`${base}/api/reports/link-ticket`, {
          credentials: 'same-origin',
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
            'X-Device-Fingerprint': fp || '',
            Accept: 'application/json',
          },
        });
        const tj = await tr.json().catch(() => null);
        if (tr.ok && tj?.data?.rt) rt = String(tj.data.rt);
      } catch {
        /* fall through — still try header-based fetch */
      }

      const fullPath = path.startsWith('http') ? path : `${base}${path}`;
      const q = new URLSearchParams();
      if (rt) q.set('rt', rt);
      if (params) {
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
          if (v != null && v !== '') q.set(k, v);
        }
      }
      const qs = q.toString();
      const navUrl = qs ? `${fullPath}?${qs}` : fullPath;

      if (rt) {
        // Real URL → refresh / share within 30 min works
        tab.location.href = navUrl;
        return;
      }

      // Fallback: fetch with Authorization and write HTML (refresh won't work on about:blank)
      const res = await fetch(navUrl, {
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          'X-Device-Fingerprint': fp || '',
          Accept: 'text/html, application/xhtml+xml',
        },
      });
      const html = await res.text();
      if (!res.ok) {
        let msg = `Impossible d’ouvrir le rapport (${res.status})`;
        try {
          const j = JSON.parse(html);
          if (j?.error) msg = String(j.error);
        } catch {
          /* */
        }
        throw new Error(msg);
      }
      if (!html || html.length < 40) throw new Error('Rapport vide');
      try {
        tab.document.open();
        tab.document.write(html);
        tab.document.close();
      } catch {
        const blob = new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
        const u = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        tab.location.href = u;
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(u), 120_000);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      const msg = e?.message || 'Impossible d’ouvrir le rapport';
      try {
        tab.document.open();
        tab.document.write(
          `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="fr"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><title>Erreur</title></head>
          <body style="font-family:system-ui;padding:40px;max-width:480px;margin:auto">
          <h1 style="font-size:1.2rem">Rapport indisponible</h1>
          <p>${String(msg).replace(/</g, '&lt;')}</p>
          </body></html>`,
        );
        tab.document.close();
      } catch {
        try {
          tab.close();
        } catch {
          /* */
        }
      }
      uiToast(msg, 'error');
    }
  })();
}

export function openPrintDoc(path: string, params?: Record<string, string | undefined>) {
  openReport(path, params);
}

const HISTORY_KEY = 'atlas-settings-search-history';
const PENDING_KEY = 'atlas-settings-pending-anchor';

export function loadSearchHistory(): string[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(HISTORY_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr.map(String).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 12) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function saveSearchHistory(items: string[]) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(items.slice(0, 12)));
  } catch { /* */ }
}

export function pushSearchHistory(q: string) {
  const t = q.trim();
  if (!t) return;
  const prev = loadSearchHistory().filter((x) => x.toLowerCase() !== t.toLowerCase());
  saveSearchHistory([t, ...prev]);
}

export function removeSearchHistoryItem(q: string) {
  saveSearchHistory(loadSearchHistory().filter((x) => x !== q));
}

export function clearSearchHistory() {
  saveSearchHistory([]);
}

export function setPendingAnchor(id: string, tab: string) {
  try {
    sessionStorage.setItem(PENDING_KEY, JSON.stringify({ id, tab, t: Date.now() }));
  } catch { /* */ }
}

export function getPendingAnchor(): { id: string; tab: string } | null {
  try {
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(PENDING_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const p = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (p && (p.id || p.tab)) return { id: String(p.id || ''), tab: String(p.tab || '') };
  } catch { /* */ }
  return null;
}

export function clearPendingAnchor() {
  try {
    sessionStorage.removeItem(PENDING_KEY);
  } catch { /* */ }
}

function normalize(s: string): string {
  return s
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function lev(a: string, b: string): number {
  if (a === b) return 0;
  if (!a.length) return b.length;
  if (!b.length) return a.length;
  const m = a.length;
  const n = b.length;
  const dp: number[] = Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, () => 0);
  for (let j = 0; j <= n; j++) dp[j] = j;
  for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
    let prev = dp[0];
    dp[0] = i;
    for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
      const tmp = dp[j];
      const cost = a[i - 1] === b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1;
      dp[j] = Math.min(dp[j] + 1, dp[j - 1] + 1, prev + cost);
      prev = tmp;
    }
  }
  return dp[n];
}

function scoreHit(q: string, hit: SettingsSearchHit): number {
  const nq = normalize(q);
  if (!nq) return 0;
  const label = normalize(hit.label);
  const kw = normalize(hit.keywords + ' ' + hit.id + ' ' + hit.tab);
  if (label === nq) return 100;
  if (label.startsWith(nq)) return 92;
  if (nq.length >= 2 && label.includes(nq)) return 85;
  const words = kw.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
  if (words.some((w) => w === nq)) return 88;
  if (words.some((w) => w.startsWith(nq))) return 75;
  if (kw.includes(nq)) return 65;
  // multi-word query: all tokens must appear somewhere
  const qTokens = nq.split(' ').filter((t) => t.length >= 2);
  if (qTokens.length > 1) {
    const blob = label + ' ' + kw;
    if (qTokens.every((t) => blob.includes(t))) return 70;
  }
  let best = 0;
  const tokens = [...label.split(' '), ...words].filter((t) => t.length >= 3);
  for (const t of tokens) {
    const d = lev(nq, t);
    const maxLen = Math.max(nq.length, t.length);
    const sim = 1 - d / maxLen;
    if (sim >= 0.6) best = Math.max(best, 42 + sim * 35);
  }
  const dLab = lev(nq, label);
  if (label.length && dLab <= Math.max(2, Math.floor(label.length * 0.4))) {
    best = Math.max(best, 48 - dLab * 4);
  }
  return best;
}

export type SearchResult = { hits: SettingsSearchHit[]; suggestions: SettingsSearchHit[] };

export function searchSettings(q: string, allowedTabs?: Set<string>): SearchResult {
  const s = q.trim();
  if (!s) return { hits: [], suggestions: [] };
  const scored = SETTINGS_SEARCH_INDEX
    .filter((x) => !allowedTabs || allowedTabs.has(x.tab))
    .map((x) => ({ x, score: scoreHit(s, x) }))
    .filter((r) => r.score > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

  const hits = scored.filter((r) => r.score >= 58).map((r) => r.x).slice(0, 12);
  const hitIds = new Set(hits.map((h) => h.id));
  const suggestions = scored
    .filter((r) => r.score >= 38 && r.score < 58 && !hitIds.has(r.x.id))
    .map((r) => r.x)
    .slice(0, 5);

  if (hits.length === 0 && scored.length) {
    return { hits: [], suggestions: scored.slice(0, 6).map((r) => r.x) };
  }
  return { hits, suggestions };
}

export function filterSettingsHits(q: string, allowedTabs?: Set<string>): SettingsSearchHit[] {
  const { hits, suggestions } = searchSettings(q, allowedTabs);
  return hits.length ? hits : suggestions;
}

/** Resolve a history label back to a hit. */
export function resolveHitByLabel(label: string): SettingsSearchHit | undefined {
  const n = normalize(label);
  return (
    SETTINGS_SEARCH_INDEX.find((x) => normalize(x.label) === n) ||
    filterSettingsHits(label)[0]
  );
}

/**
 * v0.7.6 — « page d'ouverture » : chaque personne choisit où arriver après
 * la connexion (et en ouvrant « / » connecté) : tableau de bord par défaut,
 * ou n'importe quelle page de l'app, ou la vitrine publique.
 *
 * Préférence côté client (localStorage) : elle fonctionne partout, y compris
 * en auto-hébergement, sans réglage serveur ni migration de base.
 */

export type StartPage = { value: string; label: string };

export const START_PAGES: StartPage[] = [
  { value: '/dashboard', label: 'Tableau de bord' },
  { value: '/quick-sale', label: 'Vente rapide (caisse)' },
  { value: '/products', label: 'Stock & produits' },
  { value: '/clients', label: 'Clients' },
  { value: '/invoices', label: 'Factures' },
  { value: '/balance', label: 'Créances & balance' },
  { value: '/reports', label: 'Rapports' },
  { value: '/settings', label: 'Paramètres' },
  { value: '/home', label: 'Accueil public (vitrine)' },
];

const KEY = 'atlas-start-page';
export const START_PAGE_EVENT = 'atlas-start-page-change';

export function getStartPage(): string {
  try {
    const v = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    return v && START_PAGES.some((p) => p.value === v) ? v : '/dashboard';
  } catch {
    return '/dashboard';
  }
}

export function setStartPage(v: string): void {
  const ok = START_PAGES.some((p) => p.value === v) ? v : '/dashboard';
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, ok);
  } catch { /* navigation privée */ }
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(START_PAGE_EVENT));
}

/** Destination réelle après connexion : « /home » signifie la vitrine « / ». */
export function startDestination(): string {
  const sp = getStartPage();
  return sp === '/home' ? '/' : sp;
}

/**
 * ESC/POS + Web Serial + Web Bluetooth (GATT discovery)
 *
 * Server ticket: GET /api/print/thermal/:id?width=32|48
 *
 * Web Bluetooth = BLE GATT only (not classic SPP).
 * Web Serial = USB CDC / UART printers (Chrome desktop, HTTPS, user gesture).
 */

export type ThermalWidth = 32 | 48;

const ESC = 0x1b;
const GS = 0x1d;

function cmd(...bytes: number[]): Uint8Array {
  return new Uint8Array(bytes);
}

function concat(...parts: Uint8Array[]): Uint8Array {
  const len = parts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.length, 0);
  const out = new Uint8Array(len);
  let o = 0;
  for (const p of parts) {
    out.set(p, o);
    o += p.length;
  }
  return out;
}

function text(s: string): Uint8Array {
  return new TextEncoder().encode(s);
}

export const EscPos = {
  init: () => cmd(ESC, 0x40),
  align: (mode: 'left' | 'center' | 'right') =>
    cmd(ESC, 0x61, mode === 'center' ? 1 : mode === 'right' ? 2 : 0),
  bold: (on: boolean) => cmd(ESC, 0x45, on ? 1 : 0),
  underline: (n: 0 | 1 | 2 = 0) => cmd(ESC, 0x2d, n),
  size: (w: 1 | 2 = 1, h: 1 | 2 = 1) =>
    cmd(GS, 0x21, (h === 2 ? 0x01 : 0) | (w === 2 ? 0x10 : 0)),
  feed: (n = 1) => cmd(ESC, 0x64, Math.max(0, Math.min(255, n))),
  lf: () => cmd(0x0a),
  cut: () => cmd(GS, 0x56, 0x00),
  cutPartial: () => cmd(GS, 0x56, 0x01),
  drawer: () => cmd(ESC, 0x70, 0x00, 0x19, 0xfa),
  codePage: (n: number) => cmd(ESC, 0x74, n),
  barcodeCode128: (data: string) => {
    const payload = text('{B' + data);
    return concat(cmd(GS, 0x6b, 73, payload.length), payload);
  },
  qrCode: (data: string, size = 6) => {
    const d = text(data);
    const storeLen = d.length + 3;
    return concat(
      cmd(GS, 0x28, 0x6b, 0x04, 0x00, 0x31, 0x41, 0x32, 0x00),
      cmd(GS, 0x28, 0x6b, 0x03, 0x00, 0x31, 0x43, size),
      cmd(GS, 0x28, 0x6b, 0x03, 0x00, 0x31, 0x45, 0x30),
      cmd(GS, 0x28, 0x6b, storeLen & 0xff, (storeLen >> 8) & 0xff, 0x31, 0x50, 0x30),
      d,
      cmd(GS, 0x28, 0x6b, 0x03, 0x00, 0x31, 0x51, 0x30)
    );
  },
};

export function line(str: string, width: ThermalWidth = 32): Uint8Array {
  return concat(text(String(str || '').slice(0, width)), EscPos.lf());
}

export function hr(width: ThermalWidth = 32, char = '-'): Uint8Array {
  return line(char.repeat(width), width);
}

export function pair(left: string, right: string, width: ThermalWidth = 32): Uint8Array {
  const l = String(left || '');
  const r = String(right || '');
  const gap = Math.max(1, width - l.length - r.length);
  return line(l + ' '.repeat(gap) + r, width);
}

export function buildReceiptEscPos(opts: {
  company: string;
  number: string;
  date: string;
  client: string;
  items: { name: string; qty: number; total: number }[];
  total: number;
  currency?: string;
  width?: ThermalWidth;
  footer?: string;
  qr?: string;
}): Uint8Array {
  const w = opts.width || 32;
  const cur = opts.currency || 'MAD';
  const parts: Uint8Array[] = [
    EscPos.init(),
    EscPos.align('center'),
    EscPos.bold(true),
    EscPos.size(1, 2),
    line(opts.company.slice(0, w), w),
    EscPos.size(1, 1),
    EscPos.bold(false),
    line(opts.number, w),
    line(opts.date, w),
    hr(w),
    EscPos.align('left'),
    line(('Client: ' + opts.client).slice(0, w), w),
    hr(w),
  ];
  for (const it of opts.items) {
    parts.push(line(it.name.slice(0, w), w));
    parts.push(pair('  x' + it.qty, String(Math.round(Number(it.total))), w));
  }
  parts.push(hr(w, '='));
  parts.push(EscPos.bold(true));
  parts.push(pair('TOTAL', String(Math.round(Number(opts.total))) + ' ' + cur, w));
  parts.push(EscPos.bold(false));
  if (opts.qr) {
    parts.push(EscPos.align('center'), EscPos.feed(1), EscPos.qrCode(opts.qr, 5));
  }
  parts.push(EscPos.align('center'), EscPos.feed(1));
  parts.push(line((opts.footer || 'Merci de votre visite').slice(0, w), w));
  parts.push(EscPos.feed(2), EscPos.cut());
  return concat(...parts);
}

export function toBytes(escpos: string): Uint8Array {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(escpos.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < escpos.length; i++) bytes[i] = escpos.charCodeAt(i) & 0xff;
  return bytes;
}

// ─── Ticket fetch / download ────────────────────────────────────

export function thermalTicketUrl(invoiceId: number, width: ThermalWidth = 32): string {
  return '/api/print/thermal/' + invoiceId + '?width=' + width;
}

export async function fetchTicketBytes(
  invoiceId: number,
  width: ThermalWidth = 32
): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  // Must match auth.ts TOKEN_KEY and send fingerprint (worker auth middleware)
  const token = localStorage.getItem('stock_auth_token') || '';
  let fingerprint = 'none';
  try {
    const { getCachedFingerprint } = await import('../fingerprint');
    fingerprint = await getCachedFingerprint();
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
  const res = await fetch(thermalTicketUrl(invoiceId, width), {
    headers: {
      Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token,
      'X-Device-Fingerprint': fingerprint,
    },
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    let msg = 'Ticket indisponible (' + res.status + ')';
    try {
      const data = await res.clone().json();
      if (data?.error) msg = data.error + ' (' + res.status + ')';
    } catch {
      /* non-JSON body (raw ESC/POS or plain text) */
    }
    throw new Error(msg);
  }
  return new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
}

/** Force browser download of raw ESC/POS (.bin) for external tools / APK debug */
export async function downloadTicket(
  invoiceId: number,
  width: ThermalWidth = 32,
  filename?: string
): Promise<void> {
  const bytes = await fetchTicketBytes(invoiceId, width);
  const blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: 'application/octet-stream' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename || 'ticket-' + invoiceId + '-w' + width + '.bin';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

// ─── Web Serial ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type SerialPrintOptions = {
  baudRate?: number;
  dataBits?: 7 | 8;
  stopBits?: 1 | 2;
  parity?: 'none' | 'even' | 'odd';
  bufferSize?: number;
};

export function supportsWebSerial(): boolean {
  return typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !!(navigator as any).serial;
}

/**
 * Print via Web Serial (USB serial / CDC ACM).
 * Requires Chrome/Edge desktop, HTTPS (or localhost), user gesture.
 * Opens the OS port picker; no vendor filter by default (most POS chips vary).
 */
export async function printViaSerial(
  data: Uint8Array | string,
  opts: SerialPrintOptions = {}
): Promise<void> {
  const nav = navigator as any;
  if (!nav.serial) {
    throw new Error(
      'Web Serial indisponible. Utilisez Chrome desktop + USB, ou téléchargez le ticket .bin.'
    );
  }
  const port = await nav.serial.requestPort({ filters: [] });
  await port.open({
    baudRate: opts.baudRate || 9600,
    dataBits: opts.dataBits || 8,
    stopBits: opts.stopBits || 1,
    parity: opts.parity || 'none',
    bufferSize: opts.bufferSize || 255,
  });
  const writer = port.writable.getWriter();
  const bytes = typeof data === 'string' ? toBytes(data) : data;
  const CHUNK = 512;
  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += CHUNK) {
      await writer.write(bytes.subarray(i, i + CHUNK));
    }
  } finally {
    writer.releaseLock();
    await port.close();
  }
}

/** List previously permitted serial ports (no picker) */
export async function listSerialPorts(): Promise<any[]> {
  const nav = navigator as any;
  if (!nav.serial?.getPorts) return [];
  return nav.serial.getPorts();
}

// ─── Web Bluetooth + GATT discovery ─────────────────────────────

/** Services frequently used by ESC/POS BLE modules */
export const BLE_PRINTER_SERVICES = [
  '000018f0-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb',
  '49535343-fe7d-4ae5-8fa9-9fafd205e455',
  'e7810a71-73ae-499d-8c15-faa9aef0c3f2',
  '0000ff00-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb',
  '0000ffe0-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb',
  '0000fff0-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb',
  '6e400001-b5a3-f393-e0a9-e50e24dcca9e', // Nordic UART
];

export type GattCharInfo = {
  uuid: string;
  serviceUuid: string;
  write: boolean;
  writeWithoutResponse: boolean;
  notify: boolean;
  read: boolean;
};

export type GattDiscoveryReport = {
  deviceName: string;
  deviceId: string;
  services: { uuid: string; characteristics: GattCharInfo[] }[];
  preferredWrite?: GattCharInfo;
};

export function supportsWebBluetooth(): boolean {
  return typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !!(navigator as any).bluetooth;
}

function uuidStr(u: string | { toString(): string }): string {
  return String(u).toLowerCase();
}

/**
 * Full GATT walk: every primary service + characteristic properties.
 * Use this once per printer model to learn which UUID accepts ESC/POS writes.
 */
export async function discoverGattUuids(): Promise<GattDiscoveryReport> {
  const nav = navigator as any;
  if (!nav.bluetooth) {
    throw new Error('Web Bluetooth non supporté (Chrome/Edge, HTTPS, geste utilisateur).');
  }

  const device = await nav.bluetooth.requestDevice({
    acceptAllDevices: true,
    optionalServices: BLE_PRINTER_SERVICES,
  });

  const server = await device.gatt.connect();
  // Request a broad set so getPrimaryServices is allowed
  try {
    await Promise.all(
      BLE_PRINTER_SERVICES.map((u: string) =>
        server.getPrimaryService(u).catch(() => null)
      )
    );
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  let services: any[] = [];
  try {
    services = await server.getPrimaryServices();
  } catch (e) {
    // Browser may require explicit optionalServices — retry known list only
    for (const u of BLE_PRINTER_SERVICES) {
      try {
        services.push(await server.getPrimaryService(u));
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    }
  }

  const report: GattDiscoveryReport = {
    deviceName: device.name || '(sans nom)',
    deviceId: device.id || '',
    services: [],
  };

  for (const service of services) {
    const svcUuid = uuidStr(service.uuid);
    const charsInfo: GattCharInfo[] = [];
    try {
      const chars = await service.getCharacteristics();
      for (const ch of chars) {
        const info: GattCharInfo = {
          uuid: uuidStr(ch.uuid),
          serviceUuid: svcUuid,
          write: !!ch.properties.write,
          writeWithoutResponse: !!ch.properties.writeWithoutResponse,
          notify: !!ch.properties.notify,
          read: !!ch.properties.read,
        };
        charsInfo.push(info);
        if (
          !report.preferredWrite &&
          (info.write || info.writeWithoutResponse)
        ) {
          report.preferredWrite = info;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      /* characteristic access denied */
    }
    report.services.push({ uuid: svcUuid, characteristics: charsInfo });
  }

  try {
    server.disconnect();
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return report;
}

async function findWritableCharacteristic(server: any): Promise<any> {
  // 1) Known printer services first
  for (const svcUuid of BLE_PRINTER_SERVICES) {
    try {
      const service = await server.getPrimaryService(svcUuid);
      const chars = await service.getCharacteristics();
      for (const ch of chars) {
        if (ch.properties.writeWithoutResponse || ch.properties.write) return ch;
      }
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
  // 2) Full discovery fallback
  try {
    const services = await server.getPrimaryServices();
    for (const service of services) {
      const chars = await service.getCharacteristics();
      for (const ch of chars) {
        if (ch.properties.writeWithoutResponse || ch.properties.write) return ch;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return null;
}

export async function printViaBluetooth(data: Uint8Array | string): Promise<void> {
  const nav = navigator as any;
  if (!nav.bluetooth) {
    throw new Error(
      'Web Bluetooth non supporté. Imprimantes SPP Classic → APK Android. Ou téléchargez le .bin.'
    );
  }

  const device = await nav.bluetooth.requestDevice({
    acceptAllDevices: true,
    optionalServices: BLE_PRINTER_SERVICES,
  });

  const server = await device.gatt.connect();
  const bytes = typeof data === 'string' ? toBytes(data) : data;
  const writeChar = await findWritableCharacteristic(server);

  if (!writeChar) {
    try {
      server.disconnect();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    throw new Error(
      'Aucune caractéristique GATT en écriture. Souvent Bluetooth Classic (SPP) — utilisez l’APK ou le téléchargement .bin.'
    );
  }

  const CHUNK = 180;
  const withoutResponse = writeChar.properties.writeWithoutResponse;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += CHUNK) {
    const slice = bytes.subarray(i, i + CHUNK);
    if (withoutResponse) await writeChar.writeValueWithoutResponse(slice);
    else await writeChar.writeValue(slice);
  }

  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      server.disconnect();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }, 600);
}

export async function printInvoiceTicket(
  invoiceId: number,
  opts?: {
    width?: ThermalWidth;
    transport?: 'serial' | 'bluetooth' | 'auto';
    serial?: SerialPrintOptions;
  }
): Promise<'serial' | 'bluetooth'> {
  const width = opts?.width || 32;
  const buf = await fetchTicketBytes(invoiceId, width);
  const transport = opts?.transport || 'auto';

  if (transport === 'serial') {
    await printViaSerial(buf, opts?.serial);
    return 'serial';
  }
  if (transport === 'bluetooth') {
    await printViaBluetooth(buf);
    return 'bluetooth';
  }
  // auto: prefer BLE if present, else Serial
  if (supportsWebBluetooth()) {
    try {
      await printViaBluetooth(buf);
      return 'bluetooth';
    } catch (e) {
      if (supportsWebSerial()) {
        await printViaSerial(buf, opts?.serial);
        return 'serial';
      }
      throw e;
    }
  }
  if (supportsWebSerial()) {
    await printViaSerial(buf, opts?.serial);
    return 'serial';
  }
  throw new Error(
    'Aucun transport navigateur (Serial/Bluetooth). Téléchargez le ticket .bin à la place.'
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { setProfileCache } from '../auth';
import { prefetchAvatar } from './avatarCache';

/**
 * Warm the in-memory profile cache (name, role, avatar) once at mount.
 * The avatar URL is no longer persisted in DOM storage, so shells fetch it
 * from the API on boot (best-effort; initials show until then).
 */
export function useProfileWarm(): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const r = await api.getMe();
        const m = (r as any)?.data || r || {};
        if (cancelled) return;
        setProfileCache({
          display_name: m.display_name,
          avatar_url: m.avatar_url,
          username: m.username,
          role: m.role,
        });
        // Start the avatar blob fetch now so the topbar never waits on it.
        prefetchAvatar(m.avatar_url);
      } catch {
        /* best-effort: keep whatever the login flow cached */
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);
}

/**
 * v0.7 — re-render the caller when the profile cache changes (avatar URL and
 * display name arrive asynchronously after a refresh). Without this the
 * topbar kept showing initials until some unrelated state (opening the menu)
 * forced a re-render.
 */
export function useProfileTick(): number {
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const bump = () => setTick((t) => t + 1);
    window.addEventListener('atlas-profile-changed', bump);
    window.addEventListener('atlas-avatar-changed', bump);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('atlas-profile-changed', bump);
      window.removeEventListener('atlas-avatar-changed', bump);
    };
  }, []);
  return tick;
}

export default useProfileWarm;

/**
 * First-run welcome experience — persistent completion + in-progress step.
 * atlas_welcome_completed: 'true' when finished.
 * atlas_welcome_step: current step index while in progress (survives refresh).
 * atlas_welcome_prefs: JSON of theme / density / glass choices.
 */

export const WELCOME_COMPLETED_KEY = 'atlas_welcome_completed';
export const WELCOME_STEP_KEY = 'atlas_welcome_step';
export const WELCOME_PREFS_KEY = 'atlas_welcome_prefs';

export type WelcomeTheme = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';
export type WelcomeDensity = 'comfortable' | 'compact';

export type WelcomePrefs = {
  theme: WelcomeTheme;
  density: WelcomeDensity;
  liquidGlass: boolean;
};

/** Real captures are individual welcome steps, never a stacked gallery. */
export const WELCOME_PREVIEWS = [
  { src: '/shots/demo.gif', title: 'Une session Atlas, en pratique', description: 'Découvrez le parcours de création d’un devis dans l’application.', alt: 'Enregistrement réel d’une session Atlas Commerce', poster: '/shots/devis-modal-dark.png' },
  { src: '/shots/dashboard-dark.png', title: 'Tableau de bord — sombre', description: 'Suivez votre activité dans une interface sombre.', alt: 'Tableau de bord Atlas Commerce en thème sombre' },
  { src: '/shots/dashboard-light.png', title: 'Tableau de bord — clair', description: 'Retrouvez les mêmes repères dans le thème clair.', alt: 'Tableau de bord Atlas Commerce en thème clair' },
  { src: '/shots/devis-modal-dark.png', title: 'Un devis, étape par étape', description: 'Renseignez le client, ajoutez les lignes puis vérifiez votre devis.', alt: 'Assistant de création de devis Atlas Commerce' },
  { src: '/shots/settings-dark.png', title: 'Une interface à votre goût', description: 'Découvrez les réglages d’apparence de votre espace de travail.', alt: 'Paramètres d’apparence Atlas Commerce' },
  { src: '/shots/phone-dashboard-dark.png', title: 'Votre activité sur téléphone', description: 'Consultez votre tableau de bord dans un format adapté au mobile.', alt: 'Tableau de bord Atlas Commerce sur téléphone' },
  { src: '/shots/phone-quotes-dark.png', title: 'Les devis, même sur mobile', description: 'Retrouvez vos devis depuis votre téléphone.', alt: 'Liste des devis Atlas Commerce sur téléphone' },
] as const;

export const WELCOME_PREVIEW_START = 2;
export const WELCOME_FEATURES_STEP = WELCOME_PREVIEW_START + WELCOME_PREVIEWS.length;
export const WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP = WELCOME_FEATURES_STEP + 1;
export const WELCOME_FINAL_STEP = WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP + 1;
export const WELCOME_STEP_COUNT = WELCOME_FINAL_STEP + 1;
const WELCOME_LAYOUT_KEY = 'atlas_welcome_layout';
const WELCOME_LAYOUT = 'capture-steps-v2';

export function isWelcomeCompleted(): boolean {
  try {
    const v = localStorage.getItem(WELCOME_COMPLETED_KEY);
    // Explicit false → must complete (or re-run via « Revoir le guide »)
    if (v === 'false') return false;
    if (v === 'true') return true;
    // Missing key: treat as completed for existing installs; first-time
    // installs get false only after we opt them in below.
    // Brand-new browser: no theme / onboarding yet → show welcome.
    const hadOnboarding =
      localStorage.getItem('atlas_onboarding_v1') === 'done' ||
      localStorage.getItem('atlas_onboarding_v1') === 'skipped';
    const hadTheme = !!localStorage.getItem('atlas-theme');
    if (hadOnboarding || hadTheme) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_COMPLETED_KEY, 'true');
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  } catch {
    return true; // fail-open if storage blocked
  }
}

export function markWelcomeCompleted(): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_COMPLETED_KEY, 'true');
    localStorage.removeItem(WELCOME_STEP_KEY);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

export function resetWelcome(): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_COMPLETED_KEY, 'false');
    localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_STEP_KEY, '0');
    localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_LAYOUT_KEY, WELCOME_LAYOUT);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

export function getWelcomeStep(): number {
  try {
    const n = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(WELCOME_STEP_KEY) || '0', 10);
    if (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n < WELCOME_STEP_COUNT) {
      // Keep existing in-progress users on comparison / final screens after
      // inserting previews. Completed installs are not forced through again.
      if (localStorage.getItem(WELCOME_LAYOUT_KEY) !== WELCOME_LAYOUT) {
        if (n === 3) return WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP;
        if (n === 4) return WELCOME_FINAL_STEP;
        if (n > 4) return 0;
      }
      return n;
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return 0;
}

export function setWelcomeStep(step: number): void {
  try {
    const s = Math.max(0, Math.min(WELCOME_STEP_COUNT - 1, step));
    localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_STEP_KEY, String(s));
    localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_LAYOUT_KEY, WELCOME_LAYOUT);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

export function getWelcomePrefs(): WelcomePrefs {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(WELCOME_PREFS_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const p = JSON.parse(raw);
      return {
        theme: p.theme === 'dark' || p.theme === 'system' || p.theme === 'light' ? p.theme : 'system',
        density: p.density === 'comfortable' ? 'comfortable' : 'compact',
        liquidGlass: false,
      };
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return { theme: 'system', density: 'comfortable', liquidGlass: false };
}

export function saveWelcomePrefs(prefs: Partial<WelcomePrefs>): WelcomePrefs {
  const next = { ...getWelcomePrefs(), ...prefs };
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(WELCOME_PREFS_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return next;
}

import { APP_VERSION } from '../version';

const SEEN_KEY = 'atlas-whats-new-seen';
const MODAL_KEY = 'atlas-whats-new-modal-seen';

export function getSeenWhatsNewVersion(): string {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(SEEN_KEY) || '';
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

export function markWhatsNewSeen(version: string = APP_VERSION): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SEEN_KEY, version);
    localStorage.setItem(MODAL_KEY, version);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

export function hasUnreadWhatsNew(): boolean {
  const seen = getSeenWhatsNewVersion();
  if (!seen) return true;
  return seen !== APP_VERSION;
}

/** Show once-per-version modal until user dismisses or visits /whats-new */
export function shouldShowWhatsNewModal(): boolean {
  try {
    const modalSeen = localStorage.getItem(MODAL_KEY) || '';
    return modalSeen !== APP_VERSION;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function markWhatsNewModalSeen(version: string = APP_VERSION): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(MODAL_KEY, version);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}
