/**
 * Native phone UI for purchase bills & reception (not desktop table embed).
 * Pattern: card list + empty state + large CTA (mobile ERP best practice).
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { friendlyError } from '../lib/errors';
import { statusFr } from '../lib/labels';
import NumberField from '../components/NumberField';
import { IconPackage } from '../components/Icons';

const fmt = (n: number) => Math.round(Number(n || 0)).toLocaleString('fr-FR');

type Props = { onToast: (msg: string) => void };

export default function PhoneBills({ onToast }: Props) {
  const [bills, setBills] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [receiveBill, setReceiveBill] = useState<any>(null);
  const [receiveLines, setReceiveLines] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [locations, setLocations] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [receiveLoc, setReceiveLoc] = useState(0);
  const [scanCode, setScanCode] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [b, loc] = await Promise.all([api.getBills(), api.getStockLocations()]);
      setBills((b as any).data || []);
      setLocations((loc as any).data || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      onToast(friendlyError(e));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [onToast]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const filtered = bills.filter((b) => {
    if (!search.trim()) return true;
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return String(b.number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(b.vendor_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });

  const openReceive = async (b: any) => {
    try {
      const r: any = await api.getBillMatch(b.id);
      setReceiveBill(b);
      setReceiveLines(
        (r.data?.lines || []).map((l: any) => ({
          id: l.id,
          product_id: l.product_id,
          product_name: l.product_name || '—',
          sku: l.sku || '',
          barcode: l.barcode || '',
          ordered: Number(l.ordered || 0),
          received: Number(l.received || 0),
          add: 0, // start at 0 — scan or type to fill
        })),
      );
      setScanCode('');
      const def = (locations as any[]).find((x) => x.is_default);
      setReceiveLoc(def?.id || locations[0]?.id || 0);
    } catch (e: any) {
      onToast(friendlyError(e));
    }
  };

  const submitReceive = async () => {
    if (!receiveBill) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const items = receiveLines.filter((l) => l.add > 0).map((l) => ({ bill_item_id: l.id, qty_received: l.add }));
      if (!items.length) {
        onToast('Aucune quantité à recevoir');
        return;
      }
      const r: any = await api.receiveBill(receiveBill.id, {
        items,
        location_id: receiveLoc || undefined,
      });
      onToast(r.message || 'Réception enregistrée');
      setReceiveBill(null);
      load();
    } catch (e: any) {
      onToast(friendlyError(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const applyScan = (raw: string) => {
    const code = raw.trim();
    if (!code) return;
    const q = code.toLowerCase();
    setReceiveLines((prev) => {
      let idx = prev.findIndex(
        (l) =>
          (l.barcode && String(l.barcode).toLowerCase() === q) ||
          (l.sku && String(l.sku).toLowerCase() === q) ||
          (l.product_name && String(l.product_name).toLowerCase() === q),
      );
      if (idx < 0) {
        idx = prev.findIndex(
          (l) =>
            (l.barcode && String(l.barcode).toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
            (l.sku && String(l.sku).toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
            (l.product_name && String(l.product_name).toLowerCase().includes(q)),
        );
      }
      if (idx < 0) {
        queueMicrotask(() => onToast(`Code non trouvé sur cette facture : ${code}`));
        return prev;
      }
      const next = [...prev];
      const l = next[idx];
      const maxAdd = Math.max(0, l.ordered - l.received);
      next[idx] = { ...l, add: Math.min(maxAdd, Number(l.add || 0) + 1) };
      queueMicrotask(() => onToast(`+1 · ${l.product_name}`));
      return next;
    });
    setScanCode('');
  };

  if (receiveBill) {
    return (
      <div className="phone-panel">
        <button type="button" className="ph-back" onClick={() => setReceiveBill(null)}>← Retour</button>
        <h1 className="ph-title" style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>Réception</h1>
        <p className="ph-sub">{receiveBill.number} · {receiveBill.vendor_name}</p>

        <div className="ph-field">
          <label>Scan code-barres / SKU</label>
          <input
            className="ph-search"
            value={scanCode}
            placeholder="Scanner ou saisir puis Entrée"
            autoComplete="off"
            enterKeyHint="done"
            onChange={(e) => setScanCode(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                e.preventDefault();
                applyScan(scanCode);
              }
            }}
            onBlur={() => {
              if (scanCode.trim().length >= 3) applyScan(scanCode);
            }}
          />
          <p className="ph-sub" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>Chaque scan ajoute +1 à la ligne correspondante (plafond = reste à recevoir).</p>
        </div>

        <div className="ph-field">
          <label>Entrepôt de réception</label>
          <select value={receiveLoc || ''} onChange={(e) => setReceiveLoc(Number(e.target.value))}>
            <option value={0}>Par défaut</option>
            {locations.map((l) => (
              <option key={l.id} value={l.id}>{l.name} ({l.code})</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="ph-card-list">
          {receiveLines.map((l, idx) => (
            <div key={l.id} className="ph-card">
              <div className="ph-card-title">{l.product_name}</div>
              <div className="ph-card-meta">Commandé {l.ordered} · Reçu {l.received}</div>
              <div className="ph-field" style={{ marginTop: 8, marginBottom: 0 }}>
                <label>À recevoir maintenant</label>
                <NumberField
                  min={0}
                  max={Math.max(0, l.ordered - l.received)}
                  step="0.01"
                  value={l.add}
                  onValueChange={(n) => {
                    const next = [...receiveLines];
                    next[idx] = { ...l, add: Math.min(Math.max(0, n), Math.max(0, l.ordered - l.received)) };
                    setReceiveLines(next);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <button type="button" className="ph-cta" style={{ marginTop: 16 }} disabled={busy} onClick={submitReceive}>
          <span className="ph-cta-text">
            <strong>{busy ? 'Enregistrement…' : 'Valider la réception'}</strong>
            <span>Stock mis à jour sur l’entrepôt choisi</span>
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="phone-panel">
      <p className="ph-eyebrow">Achats</p>
      <h1 className="ph-title" style={{ fontSize: 24 }}>Factures d’achat</h1>
      <p className="ph-sub">Réceptionnez les livraisons et alimentez le stock par entrepôt.</p>

      <div className="ph-search-wrap">
        <input
          className="ph-search"
          placeholder="N° ou fournisseur…"
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>

      {loading && <p className="ph-sub">Chargement…</p>}

      {!loading && !filtered.length && (
        <div className="ph-empty">
          <div className="ph-empty-ico" aria-hidden><IconPackage size={28} /></div>
          <h2>Aucune facture d’achat</h2>
          <p>Enregistrez un achat fournisseur sur le PC, puis validez la réception ici pour alimenter le stock.</p>
          <a className="ph-chip on" href="/?mode=pc#/bills">Créer sur PC</a>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="ph-card-list">
        {filtered.map((b) => (
          <article key={b.id} className="ph-card">
            <div className="ph-card-row">
              <div>
                <div className="ph-card-title">{b.number}</div>
                <div className="ph-card-meta">{b.vendor_name}</div>
              </div>
              <span className="ph-badge">{statusFr(b.status)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="ph-card-row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
              <span className="ph-card-meta">{b.issue_date}</span>
              <strong>{fmt(b.total)} MAD</strong>
            </div>
            {b.status !== 'cancelled' && (
              <button type="button" className="ph-btn-block" onClick={() => openReceive(b)}>
                Réception / stock
              </button>
            )}
          </article>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { getDisplayName, getUsername, getRole, clearToken } from '../auth';
import { DISPLAY_VERSION } from '../version';

type Props = {
  theme: string;
  glass: boolean;
  onTheme: (t: 'light' | 'dark' | 'system') => void;
  onGlass: (v: boolean) => void;
};

/* v255 — same words as the native app (Roles.kt label). */
function androidRoleLabel(role: string | null | undefined): string {
  const r = String(role || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (r === 'owner') return 'Propriétaire (Admin)';
  if (r === 'admin') return 'Administrateur';
  if (r === 'secretaire') return 'Secrétaire · Ventes';
  if (r === 'stock' || r === 'magasinier') return 'Magasinier · Stock';
  return 'Opérateur';
}

export default function PhoneSettings({ theme, onTheme }: Props) {
  const nav = useNavigate();

  return (
    <div className="ph-settings">
      <header className="ph-page-head" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="ph-refresh"
          aria-label="Retour"
          style={{ marginLeft: -8 }}
          onClick={() => nav('/m')}
        >
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 12H5M11 6l-6 6 6 6" /></svg>
        </button>
        <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.25rem' }}>Mon profil</h1>
      </header>

      <section className="ph-settings-card">
        <h2>Compte</h2>
        <div className="ph-settings-row">
          <span>Nom</span>
          <strong>{getDisplayName() || getUsername() || '—'}</strong>
        </div>
        <div className="ph-settings-row">
          <span>Rôle</span>
          <strong>{androidRoleLabel(getRole())}</strong>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="ph-settings-card">
        <h2>Affichage</h2>
        <p className="ph-settings-hint" style={{ margin: '0 0 10px', fontSize: 13, color: '#9aa3b5' }}>
          Thème de l&apos;application sur cet appareil.
        </p>
        <div className="ph-seg">
          <button type="button" className={theme === 'light' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => onTheme('light')}>
            Clair
          </button>
          <button type="button" className={theme === 'dark' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => onTheme('dark')}>
            Sombre
          </button>
          <button type="button" className={theme === 'system' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => onTheme('system')}>
            Système
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="ph-settings-card">
        <h2>Application</h2>
        <div className="ph-settings-row">
          <span>Version</span>
          <strong className="mono">{DISPLAY_VERSION}</strong>
        </div>
        <div className="ph-settings-row">
          <span>Mode</span>
          <strong>Mobile / PWA</strong>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="ph-settings-card">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="ph-primary"
          style={{ width: '100%' }}
          onClick={() => {
            clearToken();
            window.location.href = '/login';
          }}
        >
          Se déconnecter
        </button>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Phone warehouse: pick location, cycle-count session, transfer between locations */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { friendlyError } from '../lib/errors';
import { isStockRole } from '../auth';
import {
  cacheLocations,
  listCachedLocations,
  isOnline,
  listLowStockOffline,
} from '../lib/offlineCatalog';

const fmt = (n: number) => Math.round(Number(n || 0)).toLocaleString('fr-FR');

const STORAGE_KEY = 'atlas_phone_location_id';

export function getPhoneLocationId(): number {
  try {
    return Number(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || 0) || 0;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

export function setPhoneLocationId(id: number) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(id || 0));
  } catch { /* */ }
}

type Props = { onToast: (msg: string) => void };

type CountLine = { product_id: number; name: string; sku?: string; system_qty: number; counted: string };

export default function PhoneWarehouse({ onToast }: Props) {
  const stockOnly = isStockRole();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'view' | 'count' | 'transfer'>('view');
  const [locations, setLocations] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(getPhoneLocationId);
  const [report, setReport] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [offline, setOffline] = useState(!isOnline());
  const [low, setLow] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [pq, setPq] = useState('');
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<CountLine[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  // transfer form
  const [tProduct, setTProduct] = useState<any>(null);
  const [tFrom, setTFrom] = useState(0);
  const [tTo, setTTo] = useState(0);
  const [tQty, setTQty] = useState('1');
  const [tNote, setTNote] = useState('');

  const load = async (locId: number | string = selected || 'all') => {
    setLoading(true);
    setOffline(!isOnline());
    try {
      if (!isOnline()) {
        const cached = await listCachedLocations();
        setLocations(cached);
        const lows = await listLowStockOffline();
        setLow(lows.slice(0, 8));
        setReport(null);
        onToast('Mode hors ligne — emplacements en cache');
        return;
      }
      const [loc, rep, prods] = await Promise.all([
        api.getStockLocations(),
        api.getStockReport({ location_id: locId || 'all' }),
        api.getProducts({ limit: 500, fields: 'mobile' } as any).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
      ]);
      const list = (loc as any).data || [];
      setLocations(list);
      await cacheLocations(list);
      setReport((rep as any).data);
      setProducts(Array.isArray((prods as any)?.data) ? (prods as any).data : Array.isArray(prods) ? prods as any : []);
      setLow([]);
      if (list.length >= 2 && !tFrom) {
        setTFrom(list[0].id);
        setTTo(list[1].id);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      try {
        const cached = await listCachedLocations();
        if (cached.length) {
          setLocations(cached);
          onToast('Serveur indisponible — cache local');
        } else {
          onToast(friendlyError(e));
        }
      } catch {
        onToast(friendlyError(e));
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load(selected || 'all');
    const on = () => { setOffline(false); load(selected || 'all'); };
    const off = () => setOffline(true);
    window.addEventListener('online', on);
    window.addEventListener('offline', off);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', on);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', off);
    };
  }, []);

  const pick = (id: number) => {
    setSelected(id);
    setPhoneLocationId(id);
    load(id || 'all');
  };

  const activeName =
    selected === 0
      ? 'Tous les entrepôts'
      : locations.find((l) => l.id === selected)?.name || 'Entrepôt';

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = pq.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return products.slice(0, 40);
    return products
      .filter((p) =>
        [p.name, p.sku, p.barcode].some((x) => String(x || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)),
      )
      .slice(0, 40);
  }, [products, pq]);

  const addToCount = (p: any) => {
    if (lines.some((l) => l.product_id === p.id)) {
      onToast('Déjà dans la session');
      return;
    }
    setLines((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        product_id: p.id,
        name: p.name,
        sku: p.sku,
        system_qty: Number(p.stock_quantity ?? p.stock ?? 0),
        counted: String(Number(p.stock_quantity ?? p.stock ?? 0)),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const submitCount = async () => {
    if (!lines.length) {
      onToast('Ajoutez au moins un produit');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.cycleCountBatch({
        lines: lines.map((l) => ({
          product_id: l.product_id,
          counted_qty: Number(l.counted) || 0,
        })),
        note: `Inventaire mobile · ${activeName}`,
        apply: false,
      });
      onToast((r as any).message || 'Inventaire envoyé au PC');
      setLines([]);
      setTab('view');
    } catch (e: any) {
      onToast(friendlyError(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const submitTransfer = async () => {
    if (!tProduct || !tFrom || !tTo || tFrom === tTo) {
      onToast('Produit + emplacements source et destination requis');
      return;
    }
    const qty = Number(tQty);
    if (!qty || qty <= 0) {
      onToast('Quantité invalide');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.stockTransfer({
        product_id: tProduct.id,
        quantity: qty,
        from_location_id: tFrom,
        to_location_id: tTo,
        note: tNote || 'Transfert mobile',
      });
      onToast((r as any).message || 'Transfert enregistré');
      setTProduct(null);
      setTQty('1');
      setTNote('');
      load(selected || 'all');
    } catch (e: any) {
      onToast(friendlyError(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="phone-panel">
      <h1 className="ph-title" style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>Entrepôts</h1>
      <p className="ph-sub">
        Emplacement, inventaire et transferts.
        {offline && <span style={{ color: '#b45309' }}> · Hors ligne</span>}
      </p>

      <div className="ph-seg" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        {([
          ['view', 'Aperçu'],
          ['count', 'Inventaire'],
          ['transfer', 'Transfert'],
        ] as const).map(([k, label]) => (
          <button
            key={k}
            type="button"
            className={`ph-chip ${tab === k ? 'on' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setTab(k)}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {tab === 'view' && (
        <>
          <div className="ph-wh-active">
            <span className="lbl">Sélection</span>
            <strong>{activeName}</strong>
          </div>

          <div className="ph-wh-chips" role="listbox" aria-label="Choisir un entrepôt">
            <button
              type="button"
              role="option"
              aria-selected={!selected}
              className={`ph-chip ${!selected ? 'on' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => pick(0)}
            >
              Tous
            </button>
            {locations.map((l) => (
              <button
                key={l.id}
                type="button"
                role="option"
                aria-selected={selected === l.id}
                className={`ph-chip ${selected === l.id ? 'on' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => pick(l.id)}
              >
                <span className="ph-chip-code">{l.code}</span>
                {l.is_default ? <span className="ph-chip-star">★</span> : null}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {loading && <p className="ph-sub">Chargement…</p>}

          {report && !loading && (
            <>
              <div className="ph-stats">
                <div className="ph-stat">
                  <span className="lbl">Unités</span>
                  <strong>{fmt(report.totals?.qty)}</strong>
                  <span className="hint">en stock</span>
                </div>
                {!stockOnly && (
                  <div className="ph-stat peach">
                    <span className="lbl">Valeur</span>
                    <strong style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>{fmt(report.totals?.value)}</strong>
                    <span className="hint">MAD</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="ph-stat rose">
                  <span className="lbl">Lignes</span>
                  <strong>{fmt(report.totals?.lines)}</strong>
                  <span className="hint">références</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              {Array.isArray(report.lines) && report.lines.length > 0 && (
                <div className="ph-panel" style={{ marginTop: 10, padding: 0 }}>
                  {report.lines.slice(0, 12).map((row: any) => (
                    <div key={row.product_id || row.sku} className="ph-row ph-card" style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                      <div>
                        <div className="ph-row-title">{row.name}</div>
                        <div className="ph-row-detail">{row.sku || '—'} · qté {fmt(row.quantity ?? row.qty)}</div>
                      </div>
                      {!stockOnly && <strong>{fmt(row.value)} MAD</strong>}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}

          {low.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <p className="ph-sub">Stock bas (cache)</p>
              {low.map((p) => (
                <div key={p.id} className="ph-row ph-card">
                  <div className="ph-row-title">{p.name}</div>
                  <div className="ph-row-detail">qté {p.stock_quantity}</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {tab === 'count' && (
        <>
          <p className="ph-sub" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            Session d’inventaire — les quantités partent au PC pour validation (magasinier).
          </p>
          <input
            className="ph-search"
            value={pq}
            onChange={(e) => setPq(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Rechercher produit à compter…"
            style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
          />
          <div className="ph-panel" style={{ padding: 0, maxHeight: 180, overflow: 'auto', marginBottom: 10 }}>
            {filtered.map((p) => (
              <button
                key={p.id}
                type="button"
                className="ph-row ph-card"
                style={{ width: '100%', textAlign: 'left', border: 'none', background: 'transparent' }}
                onClick={() => addToCount(p)}
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="ph-row-title">{p.name}</div>
                  <div className="ph-row-detail">
                    {p.sku || '—'} · système {Number(p.stock_quantity ?? 0)}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="ph-chip">+</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {lines.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <p className="ph-sub">{lines.length} ligne(s) dans la session</p>
              {lines.map((l, idx) => (
                <div key={l.product_id} className="ph-row ph-card" style={{ alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <div className="ph-row-title">{l.name}</div>
                    <div className="ph-row-detail">Système: {l.system_qty}</div>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    inputMode="decimal"
                    value={l.counted}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const v = e.target.value;
                      setLines((prev) => prev.map((x, i) => (i === idx ? { ...x, counted: v } : x)));
                    }}
                    style={{ width: 72, height: 40, borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid #e5e0d6', padding: '0 8px' }}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="ph-chip"
                    onClick={() => setLines((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx))}
                  >
                    ×
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
              <button
                type="button"
                className="ph-inv-go"
                style={{ marginTop: 12 }}
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => void submitCount()}
              >
                {busy ? 'Envoi…' : 'Envoyer l’inventaire au PC →'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {tab === 'transfer' && (
        <>
          <p className="ph-sub" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            Déplacer du stock entre entrepôts (MAG ↔ RES…).
          </p>
          <input
            className="ph-search"
            value={pq}
            onChange={(e) => setPq(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Produit à transférer…"
            style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
          />
          {!tProduct && (
            <div className="ph-panel" style={{ padding: 0, maxHeight: 160, overflow: 'auto', marginBottom: 10 }}>
              {filtered.map((p) => (
                <button
                  key={p.id}
                  type="button"
                  className="ph-row ph-card"
                  style={{ width: '100%', textAlign: 'left', border: 'none', background: 'transparent' }}
                  onClick={() => setTProduct(p)}
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="ph-row-title">{p.name}</div>
                    <div className="ph-row-detail">{p.sku} · stock {Number(p.stock_quantity ?? 0)}</div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          {tProduct && (
            <div className="ph-panel" style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
              <div className="ph-row-title">{tProduct.name}</div>
              <button type="button" className="ph-chip" style={{ marginTop: 6 }} onClick={() => setTProduct(null)}>
                Changer de produit
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="form-row" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <label style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>De</label>
            <select
              value={tFrom}
              onChange={(e) => setTFrom(Number(e.target.value))}
              style={{ width: '100%', height: 44, borderRadius: 12 }}
            >

              {locations.map((l) => (
                <option key={l.id} value={l.id}>{l.code} — {l.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="form-row" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <label style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>Vers</label>
            <select
              value={tTo}
              onChange={(e) => setTTo(Number(e.target.value))}
              style={{ width: '100%', height: 44, borderRadius: 12 }}
            >
              <option value={0}>—</option>
              {locations.map((l) => (
                <option key={l.id} value={l.id}>{l.code} — {l.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="form-row" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <label style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>Quantité</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              inputMode="decimal"
              value={tQty}
              onChange={(e) => setTQty(e.target.value)}
              style={{ width: '100%', height: 44, borderRadius: 12, padding: '0 12px' }}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="form-row" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <label style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>Note</label>
            <input
              value={tNote}
              onChange={(e) => setTNote(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Optionnel"
              style={{ width: '100%', height: 44, borderRadius: 12, padding: '0 12px' }}
            />
          </div>
          <button type="button" className="ph-inv-go" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void submitTransfer()}>
            {busy ? 'Transfert…' : 'Transférer →'}
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * About — product identity + owner GitHub showcase + legal links.
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  APP_NAME,
  APP_TAGLINE,
  APP_VERSION,
  APP_BUILD,
  APP_CREATOR,
  APP_CREATOR_NAME,
  APP_TEAM,
  APP_GITHUB,
  APP_TEAM_GITHUB,
  APP_INSTAGRAM,
  APP_LOCATION,
  APP_DESCRIPTION,
  APP_PROFILE,
} from '../version';
import { openConsentSettings } from '../lib/cookieConsent';
import { resetWelcome } from '../lib/welcome';
import { api } from '../api';
import { isLoggedIn } from '../auth';

type GhUser = {
  name: string | null;
  company: string | null;
  location: string | null;
  public_repos: number;
  avatar_url: string;
  bio: string | null;
  html_url: string;
};

type GhRepo = {

  html_url: string;
  description: string | null;
  language: string | null;
  stargazers_count: number;
  fork: boolean;
};

const PROJECT_SHOWCASE: {

}[] = [

/** v260 — "Signaler un problème" : user report → GitHub issue (docs/reports-github.md). */
function ReportProblemForm() {
  // v0.7.4 — le signalement de bug est réservé aux utilisateurs connectés :
  // aucun formulaire ni rapport automatique pour les visiteurs non connectés.
  const canReport = isLoggedIn();
  const [kind, setKind] = useState('bug');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [contact, setContact] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit() {
    const text = message.trim();
    if (text.length < 5) { setErr('Décrivez le problème en quelques mots (5 caractères minimum).'); return; }
    setBusy(true); setErr(null); setDone(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.submitUserReport({
        kind,
        message: text,
        contact: contact.trim() || undefined,
        page: typeof location !== 'undefined' ? location.pathname : '',
        version: APP_VERSION,
      });
      const ref = res?.data?.reference || 'OK';
      setDone(`Merci ! Signalement envoyé — référence ${ref}. Il arrive dans les issues GitHub du projet.`);
      setMessage(''); setContact('');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(String(e?.message || 'Envoi impossible. Réessayez ou contactez le support.'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  if (!canReport) return null;
  return (
    <section className="card about-section" id="signaler">
      <h2>Signaler un problème</h2>
      <p className="about-muted" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
        Bug, idée ou question : votre message est envoyé directement dans les <strong>issues GitHub</strong> du
        projet Atlas Commerce (sans compte GitHub nécessaire). Les plantages de l’application sont aussi
        signalés automatiquement — jamais de données personnelles ni de mots de passe dans ces rapports.
      </p>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
        {[['bug', '🐛 Bug'], ['feedback', '💡 Idée / amélioration'], ['other', '❓ Autre']].map(([v, label]) => (
          <button
            key={v}
            type="button"
            className={kind === v ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
            style={{ borderRadius: 999, padding: '6px 14px', fontSize: 13 }}
            onClick={() => setKind(v)}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <textarea
        value={message}
        onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Décrivez le problème : ce que vous faisiez, ce qui s’est passé, ce que vous attendiez…"
        maxLength={2000}
        rows={4}
        style={{ width: '100%', borderRadius: 12, padding: 12, fontSize: 14, resize: 'vertical' }}
      />
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 10 }}>
        <input
          value={contact}
          onChange={(e) => setContact(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Contact (facultatif — email ou téléphone)"
          maxLength={120}
          style={{ flex: '1 1 220px', borderRadius: 12, padding: '10px 12px', fontSize: 13 }}
        />
        <button type="button" className="primary" disabled={busy} onClick={submit} style={{ borderRadius: 12, minHeight: 44, padding: '0 20px' }}>
          {busy ? 'Envoi…' : 'Envoyer le signalement'}
        </button>
      </div>
      {err && <p style={{ color: '#b91c1c', fontSize: 13, marginTop: 10 }}>{err}</p>}
      {done && <p style={{ color: '#15803d', fontSize: 13, marginTop: 10 }}>{done}</p>}
    </section>
  );
}

export default function About() {

        // Prefer same-origin proxy (CSP-safe). Fallback to GitHub API if allowed.

        let r: GhRepo[] = [];

        if (proxied.ok) {
          const json = await proxied.json();
          if (json?.success && json.data?.user) {
            u = json.data.user as GhUser;
            r = (json.data.repos || []) as GhRepo[];
          }
        }
        if (!u) {
          const [uRes, rRes] = await Promise.all([
            fetch(`https://api.github.com/users/${APP_CREATOR}`, {
              headers: { Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json' },
            }),
            fetch(`https://api.github.com/users/${APP_CREATOR}/repos?sort=updated&per_page=20`, {
              headers: { Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json' },
            }),
          ]);
          if (!uRes.ok || !rRes.ok) throw new Error('GitHub indisponible');
          u = (await uRes.json()) as GhUser;
          r = ((await rRes.json()) as GhRepo[]) || [];
        }
        if (stopped || !u) return;
        setUser(u);
        setRepos((r || []).filter((x) => !x.fork));
      } catch {
        /* static showcase remains */
      } finally {
        if (!stopped) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      stopped = true;

  | 'too-many'

  onRetry?: () => void;
  onReload?: () => void;
  onHome?: () => void;
}) {
  const loc = useLocation();
  const logged = typeof isLoggedIn === 'function' ? isLoggedIn() : !!getToken();
  const home = !logged ? '/login' : isStockRole() ? '/products' : '/';
  const c = COPY[kind] || COPY['not-found'];
  const displayCode = code || c.code;

  return (
    <div className={`access-page access-page--${kind} access-page--fullscreen`}>
      <div className="access-home container">
        <div className="access-home__data">
          <span className="access-home__subtitle">{code ? `Erreur ${displayCode}` : c.subtitle}</span>
          <h1 className="access-home__title">{c.title}</h1>
          <p className="access-home__description">{c.body}</p>
          {kind === 'forbidden' && logged && (
            <p className="access-meta">
              Rôle actuel : <strong>{getRole() || '—'}</strong>
            </p>
          )}
          {(kind === 'not-found' || kind === 'crash') && (
            <p className="access-meta access-path">
              <code>
                {(loc.state as { attempted?: string } | null)?.attempted ||
                  detail ||
                  loc.pathname}
              </code>
            </p>
          )}
          {kind === 'crash' && (
            <p className="access-meta">
              Code : <strong>{displayCode}</strong>
              {/\b(40[0-9]|41[0-9]|42[0-9]|43[0-9]|44[0-9]|45[0-9]|50[0-9]|51[0-9])\b/.test(displayCode)
                ? ' (HTTP)'
                : ' (client)'}
            </p>
          )}
          {detail && kind === 'crash' && (
            <pre className="access-error-detail">{detail}</pre>
          )}
          <div className="access-actions">
            {onRetry && (
              <button type="button" className="access-home__button" onClick={onRetry}>
                Réessayer
              </button>
            )}
            {onReload && (
              <button type="button" className="access-home__button access-home__button--ghost" onClick={onReload}>
                Recharger
              </button>
            )}
            {onHome ? (
              <button type="button" className="access-home__button access-home__button--ghost" onClick={onHome}>
                {logged ? 'Retour à l’accueil' : 'Se connecter'}
              </button>
            ) : (
              <Link to={home} className="access-home__button access-home__button--ghost">
                {logged ? 'Retour à l’accueil' : 'Se connecter'}
              </Link>
            )}
            {logged && kind === 'forbidden' && (
              <Link to="/products" className="access-home__button access-home__button--ghost">
                Produits
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="access-home__visual">
          <AtlasGhost label={displayCode} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Route /error/:code — e.g. /error/502 */
export function HttpErrorPage() {
  const { code } = useParams();
  const kind = CODE_TO_KIND[String(code || '500')] || 'server';
  return <AccessPage kind={kind} />;
}

export function RoleGate({
  allow,
  children,
}: {
  allow: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  if (!allow) return <AccessPage kind="forbidden" />;
  return <>{children}</>;
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api } from '../api';
import { useUi } from '../components/AppDialogs';
import { ImageWorkbench } from '../components/ProductImageEditor';
import RefreshIconButton from '../components/RefreshIconButton';
import { ModalFormError } from '../components/ModalFormFeedback';

type Action = {
  id: number;
  type: string;
  title: string;
  detail: string;
  barcode?: string;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
  completed_at?: string;
  product_id?: number;
  meta_json?: string;
};

function parseMeta(a: Action): any {
  try {
    return a.meta_json ? JSON.parse(a.meta_json) : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function autoSku(name: string, barcode: string): string {
  if (barcode.trim()) {
    const digits = barcode.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (digits.length >= 4) return digits.slice(-8).toUpperCase();
    return barcode.trim().slice(0, 16).toUpperCase();
  }
  const base = name
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
    .slice(0, 12)
    .toUpperCase();
  return (base || 'SKU') + '-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4).toUpperCase();
}

export default function Actions() {
  const { toast, prompt } = useUi();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'pending' | 'done' | 'all'>('pending');
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Action[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [approve, setApprove] = useState<Action | null>(null);
  const [stockApprove, setStockApprove] = useState<Action | null>(null);
  const [stockQty, setStockQty] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: '',
    sku: '',
    barcode: '',
    price: '',
    cost: '',
    stock: '0',
    category: 'Épicerie',
    unit: 'unité',
    image_data_url: '' as string,
    image_url: '' as string,
  });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async (soft = false) => {
    if (!soft) setLoading(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      const res = await api.listMobileActions({
        status: tab === 'all' ? 'all' : tab === 'done' ? 'done' : 'pending',
        limit: 100,
      });
      setRows((res.data || []) as Action[]);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || 'Erreur chargement');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [tab]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    const t = setInterval(() => load(true), 10000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [load]);

  const complete = async (id: number) => {
    try {
      await api.completeMobileAction(id, { completed_by: 'pc' });
      toast('Action traitée');
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast(e.message || 'Erreur', 'error');
    }
  };

  const openApprove = async (a: Action) => {
    let full = a;
    try {
      const r: any = await api.getMobileAction(a.id);
      if (r?.data) full = r.data;
    } catch { /* use list row */ }
    const meta = parseMeta(full);
    const body = meta.create_product_body || {};
    const barcode = body.barcode || full.barcode || '';
    const name = body.name || '';
    const sku = body.sku || (barcode ? autoSku(name || 'PROD', barcode) : '');
    setForm({
      name,
      sku,
      barcode,
      price: body.unit_price != null ? String(body.unit_price) : body.price != null ? String(body.price) : '',
      cost: body.cost != null ? String(body.cost) : '',
      stock: body.stock_quantity != null ? String(body.stock_quantity) : '0',
      category: body.category || 'Épicerie',
      unit: body.unit || 'unité',
      image_data_url: String(body.image_data_url || body.data_url || meta.image_data_url || ''),
      image_url: String(body.image_url || meta.image_url || ''),
    });
    setErr('');
    setApprove(full);
  };

  const submitApprove = async () => {
    if (!approve) return;
    if (!form.name.trim()) {
      toast('Le nom du produit est obligatoire', 'error');
      return;
    }
    if (form.price !== '' && Number(form.price) < 0) {
      toast('Prix invalide', 'error');
      return;
    }
    const sku = (form.sku.trim() || autoSku(form.name, form.barcode)).toUpperCase();
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
        name: form.name.trim(),
        sku,
        barcode: form.barcode.trim() || sku,
        price: Number(form.price) || 0,
        unit_price: Number(form.price) || 0,
        cost: Number(form.cost) || 0,
        stock_quantity: Number(form.stock) || 0,
        category: form.category || 'Épicerie',
        unit: form.unit || 'unité',
        track_inventory: true,
        tax_rate: 20,
      };
      if (form.image_url) body.image_url = form.image_url;
      const created: any = await api.createProduct(body);
      const newId = Number(created?.data?.id || created?.id);
      if (newId && (form.image_data_url || form.image_url)) {
        try {
          await api.addProductImage(newId, {
            data_url: form.image_data_url || undefined,
            url: form.image_url || undefined,
            is_primary: true,
            alt_text: form.name.trim(),
          });
        } catch { /* image optional */ }
      }
      await api.completeMobileAction(approve.id, { completed_by: 'pc' });
      toast('Produit enregistré dans le catalogue · demande clôturée');
      setApprove(null);
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      // Allow force duplicate if API supports it
      if (e.code === 'DUPLICATE_PRODUCT') {
        try {
          await api.createProduct({
            name: form.name.trim(),
            sku: (form.sku.trim() || autoSku(form.name, form.barcode) + '-2').toUpperCase(),
            barcode: form.barcode.trim() || undefined,
            price: Number(form.price) || 0,
            unit_price: Number(form.price) || 0,
            stock_quantity: Number(form.stock) || 0,
            category: form.category || 'Épicerie',
            unit: form.unit || 'unité',
            track_inventory: true,
            force_duplicate: true,
          });
          await api.completeMobileAction(approve.id, { completed_by: 'pc' });
          toast('Produit créé (doublon forcé)');
          setApprove(null);
          load(true);
          return;
        } catch (e2: any) {
          setErr(e2.message || e.message || 'Erreur création');
        }
      } else {
        setErr(e.message || 'Erreur création');
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const needsProductApproval = (a: Action) => {
    if (a.type !== 'new_product' || a.status !== 'pending') return false;
    const meta = parseMeta(a);
    return meta.needs_approval || meta.create_product || !a.product_id;
  };

  const needsStockApproval = (a: Action) => {
    if (a.type !== 'stock_check' || a.status !== 'pending') return false;
    const meta = parseMeta(a);
    if (meta.cycle_batch && Array.isArray(meta.lines) && meta.lines.length) return true;
    return !!(meta.adjust_stock || meta.proposed_stock != null) && !!a.product_id;
  };

  const needsInvoiceApproval = (a: Action) => {
    if (a.type !== 'invoice' || a.status !== 'pending') return false;
    const meta = parseMeta(a);
    return !!(meta.needs_approval || meta.quick_sale || meta.create_invoice_body);
  };

  const submitInvoiceApprove = async (a: Action) => {
    const meta = parseMeta(a);
    const body = meta.create_invoice_body || {};
    if (!body.items || !Array.isArray(body.items) || !body.items.length) {
      toast('Panier manquant dans la demande', 'error');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const invBody = {
        client_id: body.client_id || null,
        client_name: body.client_name || 'Comptoir',
        status: 'paid',
        quick_sale: true,
        doc_kind: 'quick_sale',
        tax_exempt: body.tax_exempt !== false,
        notes: body.notes || 'Vente rapide validée depuis le téléphone',
        items: body.items,
      };
      const inv: any = await api.createInvoice(invBody);
      const invId = inv?.data?.id;
      const invTotal = Number(inv?.data?.total || meta.total || 0);
      if (invId && invTotal > 0) {
        try {
          await api.recordInvoicePayment(invId, {
            amount: invTotal,
            payment_method: 'cash',
            payee: 'company',
            note: 'Validation vente rapide mobile (PC)',
          });
        } catch {
          try {
            await api.updateInvoiceStatus(invId, { status: 'paid', amount_paid: invTotal });
          } catch { /* */ }
        }
      }
      await api.completeMobileAction(a.id, { completed_by: 'pc' });
      toast(inv?.data?.number ? `Ticket ${inv.data.number} créé et payé` : 'Vente validée');
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast(e.message || 'Erreur validation vente', 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const openStockApprove = (a: Action) => {
    const meta = parseMeta(a);
    setStockQty(
      meta.proposed_stock != null ? String(meta.proposed_stock) : meta.stock != null ? String(meta.stock) : '0'
    );
    setErr('');
    setStockApprove(a);
  };

  const submitStockApprove = async () => {
    if (!stockApprove) return;
    const meta = parseMeta(stockApprove);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (meta.cycle_batch && Array.isArray(meta.lines)) {
        await api.completeMobileAction(stockApprove.id, {
          completed_by: 'pc',
          apply_stock: true,
        });
        toast(`Inventaire ${meta.lines.length} produit(s) appliqué`);
      } else {
        if (!stockApprove.product_id) return;
        const qty = Number(stockQty);
        if (!Number.isFinite(qty) || qty < 0) {
          toast('Stock invalide', 'error');
          setBusy(false);
          return;
        }
        await api.completeMobileAction(stockApprove.id, {
          completed_by: 'pc',
          apply_stock: true,
          product_id: stockApprove.product_id,
          proposed_stock: qty,
        });
        toast(`Stock mis à jour → ${qty}`);
      }
      setStockApprove(null);
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || 'Erreur ajustement stock');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const rejectAction = async (a: Action) => {
    const reason = await prompt({
      title: 'Refuser la demande',
      message: 'Motif du refus (visible sur le téléphone). Obligatoire.',
      placeholder: 'Ex. prix incorrect, produit déjà en stock…',
      confirmLabel: 'Refuser',
    });
    if (reason == null) return;
    if (!String(reason).trim()) {
      toast('Motif obligatoire', 'error');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.rejectMobileAction(a.id, String(reason).trim());
      toast('Demande refusée');
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast(e.message || 'Refus impossible', 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="atlas-page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <p className="atlas-eyebrow">Espace partagé</p>
          <h1 className="atlas-hello" style={{ fontSize: '1.75rem' }}>Boîte d&apos;actions</h1>
          <p className="atlas-lead" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
            Scans et demandes du téléphone — validez ici.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>

          <RefreshIconButton onClick={() => load(true)} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 16, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        {(['pending', 'done', 'all'] as const).map((t) => (

            key={t}
            type="button"
            className={tab === t ? '' : 'secondary'}
            onClick={() => setTab(t)}
            style={{ borderRadius: 999, padding: '8px 16px' }}
          >
            {t === 'pending' ? 'En attente' : t === 'done' ? 'Terminées' : 'Toutes'}
          </button>
        ))}
        <span className="muted" style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600 }}>
          {rows.length} ENREGISTREMENTS
        </span>
      </div>

      {loading && rows.length === 0 && (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 16, width: 160, margin: '0 auto' }} />

      )}
      {err && (
        <div className="empty-state" style={{ color: 'var(--bad)' }}>

      {!loading && !err && rows.length === 0 && (

          <div className="empty-state__desc">
            Quand le téléphone envoie un scan ou une demande produit, elle apparaît ici.

        </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>

          const meta = parseMeta(a);
          return (
            <div

              className="ac-panel"
              style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, padding: '14px 16px', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}

              <div
                style={{
                  width: 42,
                  height: 42,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  background:
                    a.type === 'stock_check'
                      ? 'var(--bad-bg)'
                      : a.type === 'new_product'
                        ? 'var(--warn-bg)'
                        : 'var(--zellij-soft)',
                  display: 'grid',
                  placeItems: 'center',
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                {(a.type || 'AC').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
              </div>
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 160 }}>
                <div
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                    color: 'var(--muted)',

                  }}
                >
                  {a.type} · {a.created_at?.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{a.title}</div>
                <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
                  {a.detail}
                </div>
                {stockNeeded && meta.proposed_stock != null && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 13, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    Stock proposé : <strong>{meta.proposed_stock}</strong>
                    {meta.stock != null ? ` (système ${meta.stock})` : ''}
                  </div>
                )}
                {stockNeeded && meta.cycle_batch && Array.isArray(meta.lines) && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 13, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    Inventaire lot : <strong>{meta.lines.length}</strong> ligne(s)
                  </div>
                )}
                {a.barcode && (
                  <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                    #{a.barcode}
                  </div>
                )}
                {(a as any).source && (
                  <p style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--muted)', margin: '0 0 4px' }}>
                    Source : {(a as any).source}
                  </p>
                )}
                {a.status === 'cancelled' && meta.reject_reason && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--bad)', marginTop: 4 }}>
                    Refus : {meta.reject_reason}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              {a.status === 'pending' ? (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                  {approveNeeded && (
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => openApprove(a)}>
                      Approuver le produit
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {stockNeeded && (
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => openStockApprove(a)}>
                      {meta.cycle_batch ? 'Appliquer inventaire' : 'Approuver le stock'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {needsInvoiceApproval(a) && (
                    <button type="button" className="primary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => submitInvoiceApprove(a)}>
                      Marquer payé
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => complete(a.id)}>
                    Marquer traité
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" className="danger" disabled={busy} onClick={() => rejectAction(a)}>
                    Refuser
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : a.status === 'cancelled' ? (
                <span className="badge" style={{ background: 'var(--bad-bg)' }}>Refusé</span>
              ) : (
                <span className="badge success">Traité</span>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {approve && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => { if (busy) return; setErr(''); setApprove(null); }}>
          <div className="modal-card" style={{ maxWidth: 560 }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3>Approuver la création produit</h3>
            <p>Même formulaire que Produits. Le produit est ajouté au catalogue, puis la demande est clôturée.</p>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Nom *</label>
              <input value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Réf. (SKU) — auto si vide</label>
              <input
                value={form.sku}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, sku: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Généré depuis le code-barres"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Code-barres</label>
              <input value={form.barcode} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, barcode: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Prix (MAD)</label>
              <input value={form.price} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, price: e.target.value })} inputMode="decimal" />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Coût (MAD)</label>
              <input value={form.cost} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, cost: e.target.value })} inputMode="decimal" />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Stock initial</label>
              <input value={form.stock} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, stock: e.target.value })} inputMode="numeric" />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Catégorie</label>
              <input value={form.category} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, category: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Unité</label>
              <input value={form.unit} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, unit: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            {(form.image_data_url || form.image_url) && (
              <div className="form-row">
                <label>Photo (téléphone) — recadrez / tournez avant d’approuver</label>
                <ImageWorkbench
                  src={form.image_data_url || form.image_url}
                  onChange={(next) => setForm({ ...form, image_data_url: next })}
                  compact
                />
              </div>
            )}
            {err ? <ModalFormError message={err} /> : null}
            <div className="modal-actions">
              <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { setErr(''); setApprove(null); }}>
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={submitApprove}>
                {busy ? 'Création…' : 'Créer et approuver'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {stockApprove && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => { if (busy) return; setErr(''); setStockApprove(null); }}>
          <div className="modal-card" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3>
              {parseMeta(stockApprove).cycle_batch
                ? 'Appliquer l’inventaire lot'
                : 'Approuver l’ajustement de stock'}
            </h3>
            <p>
              {stockApprove.title}
              <br />
              <span className="muted">{stockApprove.detail}</span>
            </p>
            {parseMeta(stockApprove).cycle_batch ? (
              <p style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
                {(parseMeta(stockApprove).lines || []).length} ligne(s) seront appliquées au stock système.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <div className="form-row">
                <label>Nouveau stock (quantité réelle)</label>
                <input
                  value={stockQty}
                  onChange={(e) => setStockQty(e.target.value)}
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  autoFocus
                />
              </div>
            )}
            {err ? <ModalFormError message={err} /> : null}
            <div className="modal-actions">
              <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { setErr(''); setStockApprove(null); }}>
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={submitStockApprove}>
                {busy ? 'Application…' : parseMeta(stockApprove).cycle_batch ? 'Appliquer inventaire' : 'Appliquer le stock'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
