import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api, BASE } from '../api';
import { getToken } from '../auth';
import DatePicker from '../components/DatePicker';
import TimePicker from '../components/TimePicker';
import RefreshIconButton from '../components/RefreshIconButton';
import SaveFeedback from '../components/SaveFeedback';
import { getCachedFingerprint } from '../fingerprint';
import { openReport } from '../lib/reports';

type Row = {
  employee_id: number;
  emp_number?: string;
  name: string;
  role_title?: string;
  team?: string;
  work_date: string;
  check_in: string | null;
  check_out: string | null;
  status: string;
  note?: string;
  month_rate_pct: number | null;
  suggested_pay: number | null;
};

type Summary = { present: number; absent: number; late: number; excused: number; total: number };

function todayMA(): string {
  try {
    return new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Africa/Casablanca' });
  } catch {
    return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}

async function attFetch(path: string, init?: RequestInit) {
  const token = getToken() || '';
  const fp = await getCachedFingerprint();
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
    ...init,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: token ? `Bearer ${token}` : '',
      'X-Device-Fingerprint': fp || '',
      ...(init?.headers as Record<string, string> | undefined),
    },
  });
  const j = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(j?.error || `Erreur ${res.status}`);
  return j;
}

function statusLabel(s: string) {
  const m: Record<string, string> = {
    present: 'Présent',
    late: 'Retard',
    half: 'Demi',
    excused: 'Excusé',
    absent: 'Absent',
  };
  return m[s] || s || '—';
}

export default function Attendance() {
  const [date, setDate] = useState(todayMA());
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Row[]>([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<Summary | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [msgType, setMsgType] = useState<'success' | 'error'>('success');
  const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('all');
  const [teamFilter, setTeamFilter] = useState('all');
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<number[]>([]);

  const [editId, setEditId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [editIn, setEditIn] = useState('');
  const [editOut, setEditOut] = useState('');
  const [editStatus, setEditStatus] = useState('present');
  const [editNote, setEditNote] = useState('');

  const [absentOpen, setAbsentOpen] = useState(false);
  const [exportFrom, setExportFrom] = useState(() => todayMA().slice(0, 8) + '01');
  const [exportTo, setExportTo] = useState(todayMA());
  const [exportOpen, setExportOpen] = useState(false);
  const [recordTarget, setRecordTarget] = useState<Row | null>(null);
  const [recordScope, setRecordScope] = useState<'cycle' | 'career'>('cycle');
  const [recordData, setRecordData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [recordLoading, setRecordLoading] = useState(false);

  const flash = (m: string, t: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setMsg(m);
    setMsgType(t);
    setTimeout(() => setMsg(''), 4000);
  };

  const load = useCallback(async (soft = false) => {
    if (soft) setRefreshing(true);
    else setLoading(true);
    try {
      let on = false;
      try {
        const s: any = await api.getSettings();
        on = Number(s?.data?.attendance_enabled) === 1;
      } catch {
        on = false;
      }
      setEnabled(on);
      if (!on) {
        setRows([]);
        setSummary(null);
        setSelected([]);
        return;
      }
      const j = await attFetch(`/api/attendance?date=${encodeURIComponent(date)}`);
      setRows(j?.data?.rows || []);
      setSummary(j?.data?.summary || null);
      setSelected([]);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Chargement impossible', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [date]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  const teams = useMemo(() => {
    const s = new Set<string>();
    rows.forEach((r) => {
      if (r.team) s.add(r.team);
    });
    return Array.from(s).sort();
  }, [rows]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return rows.filter((r) => {
      if (statusFilter !== 'all' && r.status !== statusFilter) return false;
      if (teamFilter !== 'all' && (r.team || '') !== teamFilter) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      return (
        r.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(r.emp_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(r.role_title || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [rows, search, statusFilter, teamFilter]);

  const allFilteredIds = filtered.map((r) => r.employee_id);
  const allChecked =
    allFilteredIds.length > 0 && allFilteredIds.every((id) => selected.includes(id));

  const toggleAll = () => {
    if (allChecked) {
      setSelected((prev) => prev.filter((id) => !allFilteredIds.includes(id)));
    } else {
      setSelected((prev) => Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...allFilteredIds])));
    }
  };

  const toggleOne = (id: number) => {
    setSelected((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...prev, id],
    );
  };

  const checkIn = async (employee_id: number) => {
    setBusyId(employee_id);
    try {
      await attFetch('/api/attendance/check-in', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ employee_id, date }),
      });
      flash('Entrée enregistrée');
      await load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Erreur', 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const checkOut = async (employee_id: number) => {
    setBusyId(employee_id);
    try {
      await attFetch('/api/attendance/check-out', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ employee_id, date }),
      });
      flash('Sortie enregistrée');
      await load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Erreur', 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const loadRecord = async (r: Row, scope: 'cycle' | 'career') => {
    setRecordTarget(r);
    setRecordScope(scope);
    setRecordLoading(true);
    setRecordData(null);
    try {
      const { getToken } = await import('../auth');
      const { getApiBase } = await import('../config');
      const token = getToken() || '';
      const base = getApiBase();
      const res = await fetch(`${base}/api/attendance/record/${r.employee_id}?scope=${scope}`, {
        headers: token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {},
      });
      const j = await res.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(j?.error || 'Erreur fiche');
      setRecordData(j?.data || null);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Impossible de charger la fiche', 'error');
      setRecordTarget(null);
    } finally {
      setRecordLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const openEdit = (r: Row) => {
    setEditId(r.employee_id);
    setEditIn(r.check_in || '');
    setEditOut(r.check_out || '');
    setEditStatus(r.status === 'absent' || r.status === 'excused' ? r.status : 'auto');
    setEditNote(r.note || '');
  };

  const saveEdit = async () => {
    if (editId == null) return;
    setBusyId(editId);
    try {
      const st = String(editStatus || '').toLowerCase();
      await attFetch('/api/attendance', {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          employee_id: editId,
          date,
          check_in: editIn || null,
          check_out: editOut || null,
          // absent/excused only forced; present/late/half computed from times (9–13 / 14–18 = demi)
          status: st === 'absent' || st === 'excused' ? st : undefined,
          force_status: st === 'absent' || st === 'excused',
          note: editNote,
        }),
      });
      flash('Pointage mis à jour');
      setEditId(null);
      await load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Erreur', 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const confirmBulkAbsent = async () => {
    try {
      for (const employee_id of selected) {
        await attFetch('/api/attendance', {
          method: 'PUT',
          body: JSON.stringify({
            employee_id,
            date,
            check_in: null,
            check_out: null,
            status: 'absent',
            note: 'Marqué absent',
          }),
        });
      }
      flash(`${selected.length} absence(s) enregistrée(s)`);
      setAbsentOpen(false);
      await load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Erreur', 'error');
    }
  };

  const downloadCsv = async () => {
    const token = getToken() || '';
    const fp = await getCachedFingerprint();
    const url = `${BASE}/api/attendance/export?from=${encodeURIComponent(exportFrom)}&to=${encodeURIComponent(exportTo)}&format=csv`;
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'X-Device-Fingerprint': fp || '' },
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      flash('Export CSV impossible', 'error');
      return;
    }
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `presence_${exportFrom}_${exportTo}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    flash('CSV téléchargé');
    setExportOpen(false);
  };

  const openPdfReport = () => {
    openReport('/api/attendance/export', {
      from: exportFrom,
      to: exportTo,
      format: 'html',
    });
    setExportOpen(false);
  };

  if (enabled === null || (loading && enabled === null)) {
    return (
      <div className="atlas-crm attendance-page">
        <div className="page-header">
          <h1>Présence</h1>
        </div>
        <div className="ac-panel" style={{ padding: 24 }}>
          <p className="muted" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Chargement…</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!enabled) {
    return (
      <div className="atlas-crm attendance-page">
        <div className="page-header">
          <h1>Présence</h1>
        </div>
        <div className="ac-panel" style={{ padding: 24 }}>
          <p style={{ margin: '0 0 14px' }}>
            Le module présence est <strong>désactivé</strong> (réglage enregistré en base).
            Activez-le dans <strong>Paramètres → Présence</strong> pour charger le pointage.
          </p>
          <Link to="/settings?tab=attendance" className="btn" style={{ display: 'inline-flex' }}>
            Ouvrir les paramètres Présence
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="atlas-crm attendance-page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h1>Présence / pointage</h1>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ minWidth: 150 }}>
            <DatePicker value={date} onChange={setDate} />
          </div>
          <RefreshIconButton onClick={() => load(true)} loading={refreshing} />
          <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setExportOpen(true)}>
            Export CSV / PDF
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="secondary"
            onClick={() => setAbsentOpen(true)}
            disabled={!selected.length}
          >
            Absents ({selected.length})
          </button>
          <Link
            to="/employees"
            style={{
              textDecoration: 'none',
              padding: '8px 14px',
              borderRadius: 999,
              background: 'var(--atlas-primary, #71717a)',
              color: '#fff',
              fontWeight: 600,
              fontSize: 14,
            }}
          >
            Employés / paie
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
      <SaveFeedback message={msg} type={msgType} />

      {summary && (
        <div
          className="attendance-stats-row ac-metric-grid"
          style={{
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))',
            gap: 10,
            marginBottom: 12,
          }}
        >
          {(
            [
              ['Présents', summary.present],
              ['Retards', summary.late],
              ['Absents', summary.absent],
              ['Effectif', summary.total],
            ] as const
          ).map(([l, v]) => (
            <div key={l} className="ac-metric">
              <div className="as-label">{l}</div>
              <div className="as-value">{v}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-filters">
        <div className="ac-products-filters-row">
          <div className="ac-search-field">
            <svg className="ac-search-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" aria-hidden>
              <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </svg>
            <input
              className="ac-search-input"
              placeholder="Rechercher…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Rechercher présence"
            />
          </div>
          <select className="ac-filter-select" value={statusFilter} onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)} aria-label="Statut">
            <option value="all">Tous statuts</option>
            <option value="present">Présent</option>
            <option value="late">Retard</option>
            <option value="half">Demi</option>
            <option value="excused">Excusé</option>
            <option value="absent">Absent</option>
          </select>
          <select className="ac-filter-select" value={teamFilter} onChange={(e) => setTeamFilter(e.target.value)} aria-label="Équipe">
            <option value="all">Toutes équipes</option>
            {teams.map((tm) => (
              <option key={tm} value={tm}>{tm}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-table-panel" style={{ overflow: 'auto' }}>
        {loading ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>Chargement…</div>
        ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="empty" style={{ padding: 24 }}>
            Aucun résultat.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <table className="data-dense ac-products-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style={{ width: 36 }}>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={allChecked}
                    onChange={toggleAll}
                    aria-label="Tout cocher"
                  />
                </th>
                <th>N°</th>
                <th>Nom</th>
                <th>Statut</th>
                <th>Entrée</th>
                <th>Sortie</th>
                <th>Taux</th>
                <th>Paie*</th>
                <th>Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {filtered.map((r) => (
                <tr key={r.employee_id}>
                  <td>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={selected.includes(r.employee_id)}
                      onChange={() => toggleOne(r.employee_id)}
                      aria-label={`Sélectionner ${r.name}`}
                    />
                  </td>
                  <td>{r.emp_number || '—'}</td>
                  <td>
                    <div>{r.name}</div>
                    <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                      {r.role_title || ''}
                      {r.team ? ` · ${r.team}` : ''}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>{statusLabel(r.status)}</td>
                  <td>{r.check_in || '—'}</td>
                  <td>{r.check_out || '—'}</td>
                  <td>{r.month_rate_pct != null ? `${r.month_rate_pct} %` : '—'}</td>
                  <td>
                    <div>{`${Number(r.suggested_pay || 0).toLocaleString('fr-FR')} MAD`}</div>
                    {(r as any).period_from && (
                      <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
                        {String((r as any).period_from).slice(0, 10)}
                        {(r as any).accrued_days != null ? ` · ${(r as any).accrued_days} j` : ''}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {Number((r as any).late_penalty || 0) > 0 && (
                      <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--bad, #b91c1c)' }}>
                        −{(r as any).late_penalty} MAD retards
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="secondary"
                        disabled={!!r.check_in || busyId === r.employee_id}
                        onClick={() => checkIn(r.employee_id)}
                      >
                        Entrée
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="secondary"
                        disabled={!r.check_in || !!r.check_out || busyId === r.employee_id}
                        onClick={() => checkOut(r.employee_id)}
                      >
                        Sortie
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => openEdit(r)}>
                        Modifier
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => void loadRecord(r, 'cycle')}>
                        Fiche
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </div>
      <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 12 }}>
        Cochez les lignes pour marquer absents en groupe. Export = plage de dates (CSV ou rapport).
      </p>

      {editId != null && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={() => setEditId(null)} role="presentation">
          <div className="modal-card" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Corriger le pointage</h2>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Entrée</label>
              <TimePicker value={editIn} onChange={setEditIn} placeholder="09:00" step={5} />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Sortie</label>
              <TimePicker value={editOut} onChange={setEditOut} placeholder="18:00" step={5} />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Statut (auto si heures saisies)</label>
              <select value={editStatus} onChange={(e) => setEditStatus(e.target.value)}>
                <option value="auto">Automatique (heures)</option>
                <option value="excused">Excusé (forcé)</option>
                <option value="absent">Absent (forcé)</option>
              </select>
              <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                Après 09:15 → retard · 09:00–13:00 ou 14:00–18:00 → demi-journée
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Note</label>
              <input value={editNote} onChange={(e) => setEditNote(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 12 }}>
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setEditId(null)}>
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void saveEdit()}>
                Enregistrer
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {absentOpen && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={() => setAbsentOpen(false)} role="presentation">
          <div className="modal-card" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ maxWidth: 400 }}>
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Marquer absents</h2>
            <p>
              Marquer <strong>{selected.length}</strong> employé(s) coché(s) absents pour le {date} ?
            </p>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setAbsentOpen(false)}>
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void confirmBulkAbsent()}>
                Confirmer
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      
      {recordTarget && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={() => setRecordTarget(null)} role="presentation">
          <div
            className="modal-card"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{ maxWidth: 560, maxHeight: '90vh', overflow: 'auto' }}
          >
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
              Fiche présence (cycle de paie) — {recordTarget.name}
            </h2>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={recordScope === 'cycle' ? '' : 'secondary'}
                onClick={() => void loadRecord(recordTarget, 'cycle')}
              >
                Cycle de paie
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={recordScope === 'career' ? '' : 'secondary'}
                onClick={() => void loadRecord(recordTarget, 'career')}
              >
                Toute la carrière
              </button>
            </div>
            {recordLoading && <p className="muted">Chargement…</p>}
            {recordData && (
              <>
                <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
                  {recordData.from} → {recordData.to} · {recordData.summary?.logged || 0} jour(s)
                </p>
                <div
                  style={{
                    display: 'grid',
                    gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(100px, 1fr))',
                    gap: 8,
                    marginBottom: 12,
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="card" style={{ padding: 10 }}>
                    <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>Présent</div>
                    <strong>{recordData.summary?.present ?? 0}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div className="card" style={{ padding: 10 }}>
                    <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>Retard</div>
                    <strong>{recordData.summary?.late ?? 0}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div className="card" style={{ padding: 10 }}>
                    <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>Absent</div>
                    <strong>{recordData.summary?.absent ?? 0}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div className="card" style={{ padding: 10 }}>
                    <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>Taux</div>
                    <strong>{recordData.summary?.rate_pct ?? 0}%</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div className="card" style={{ padding: 10 }}>
                    <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>% retard</div>
                    <strong>{recordData.summary?.late_pct ?? 0}%</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div className="card" style={{ padding: 10 }}>
                    <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>Paie suggérée</div>
                    <strong>
                      {recordData.summary?.net_suggested ?? 0} MAD
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                  <div className="card" style={{ padding: 10 }}>

            <div style={{ marginTop: 12, textAlign: 'right' }}>
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setRecordTarget(null)}>
                Fermer
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

{exportOpen && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={() => setExportOpen(false)} role="presentation">
          <div className="modal-card" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ maxWidth: 400 }}>
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Export présence</h2>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Du</label>
              <DatePicker value={exportFrom} onChange={setExportFrom} />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Au</label>
              <DatePicker value={exportTo} onChange={setExportTo} />

              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setExportOpen(false)}>

              </button>
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => void downloadCsv()}>

              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={openPdfReport}>

              </button>
            </div>

        @media (max-width: 640px) {
          .attendance-stats-row { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}

import { suggestExpenseCategory } from '../lib/assist';

import {
  Banknote, ShoppingBag, Truck, Fuel, Building2, Wrench, Users, Receipt,
  ArrowDownLeft, ArrowUpRight, Wallet, Package,
} from 'lucide-react';

const EXPENSE_CATEGORIES = [
  'Fournitures de bureau', 'Équipement', 'Électronique', 'Loyer',
  'Charges (eau, électricité, telecom)', 'Transport de marchandises', 'Transport personnel',
  'Carburant', 'Marketing & publicité', 'Maintenance & réparations',
  'Salaires & charges sociales', 'CNSS / AMO',
  'TVA déductible', 'Impôt sur les sociétés (IS)', 'Impôt sur le revenu (IR)',
  'Taxe professionnelle', 'Droits de douane', 'Honoraires (expert-comptable, avocat)',
  'Assurances', 'Matière première', 'Emballage & logistique', 'Formation', 'Autre charge déductible',
];
const INCOME_CATEGORIES = [
  'Vente divers', 'Prestation de service', 'Remboursement', 'Subvention', 'Intérêts', 'Autre recette',
];
const OWNER_DRAW_CATEGORIES = ['Prélèvement personnel', 'Dividende', 'Remboursement associé', 'Autre prélèvement'];
const OWNER_CONTRIB_CATEGORIES = ['Apport en capital', 'Apport en compte courant', 'Autre apport'];


function BalanceMiniBars({ title, rows }: { title: string; rows: { label: string; value: number; tone?: string }[] }) {
  const max = Math.max(1, ...rows.map((r) => Math.abs(r.value)));
  return (
    <div className="ac-panel balance-chart-card balance-page">
      <h3 className="balance-chart-title">{title}</h3>
      <div className="balance-chart-bars">
        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="muted" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 13 }}>Aucune donnée</p>
        ) : (
          rows.map((r) => (
            <div key={r.label} className="balance-chart-row">
              <span className="balance-chart-label" title={r.label}>{r.label}</span>
              <div className="balance-chart-track">
                <div
                  className="balance-chart-fill"
                  style={{
                    width: `${Math.min(100, (Math.abs(r.value) / max) * 100)}%`,
                    background: r.tone || '#0f172a',
                  }}
                />
              </div>
              <span className="balance-chart-val">{Math.round(r.value).toLocaleString('fr-FR')}</span>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type EntryType = 'expense' | 'income' | 'owner_draw' | 'owner_contrib';

const TYPE_META: Record<EntryType, { label: string; direction: 'in' | 'out'; badge: string }> = {
  expense: { label: 'Dépense', direction: 'out', badge: 'danger' },
  income: { label: 'Recette', direction: 'in', badge: 'success' },
  owner_draw: { label: 'Prélèvement propriétaire', direction: 'out', badge: 'warning' },
  owner_contrib: { label: 'Apport propriétaire', direction: 'in', badge: 'info' },
};


function txIcon(type: EntryType, category?: string) {
  const c = (category || '').toLowerCase();
  if (type === 'income' || type === 'owner_contrib') return ArrowDownLeft;
  if (type === 'owner_draw') return ArrowUpRight;
  if (/carburant|fuel|essence/.test(c)) return Fuel;
  if (/transport|livraison/.test(c)) return Truck;
  if (/loyer|local|entrepôt|entrepot/.test(c)) return Building2;
  if (/salaire|cnss|personnel/.test(c)) return Users;
  if (/maintenance|réparation|reparation/.test(c)) return Wrench;
  if (/fourniture|équipement|electron|électr|matière|matiere/.test(c)) return Package;
  if (/taxe|impôt|impot|tva|douane/.test(c)) return Receipt;
  if (/marketing|publicit/.test(c)) return ShoppingBag;
  return Wallet;
}

function formatTxDate(d: string) {
  if (!d) return '—';
  try {
    const dt = new Date(d.length === 10 ? d + 'T12:00:00' : d);
    if (Number.isNaN(dt.getTime())) return d;
    const now = new Date();
    const startToday = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    const startY = new Date(startToday); startY.setDate(startY.getDate() - 1);
    if (dt >= startToday) return `Aujourd'hui`;
    if (dt >= startY) return 'Hier';
    return dt.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
  } catch {
    return d;
  }
}

function catsFor(t: EntryType) {
  if (t === 'income') return INCOME_CATEGORIES;
  if (t === 'owner_draw') return OWNER_DRAW_CATEGORIES;
  if (t === 'owner_contrib') return OWNER_CONTRIB_CATEGORIES;
  return EXPENSE_CATEGORIES;
}

function isCash(method?: string) {
  return !method || method === 'cash';
}

/** v262.1 — human-readable French label for the selected report period. */
const REPORT_MONTHS_FR = [
  'janvier', 'février', 'mars', 'avril', 'mai', 'juin',
  'juillet', 'août', 'septembre', 'octobre', 'novembre', 'décembre',
];
const REPORT_RELATIVE_LABELS_FR: Record<string, string> = {
  month: 'Ce mois',
  '3m': '3 derniers mois',
  '6m': '6 derniers mois',
  '9m': '9 derniers mois',
  '12m': '12 derniers mois',
  '24m': '24 derniers mois (2 ans)',
  '36m': '36 derniers mois (3 ans)',
  '48m': '48 derniers mois (4 ans)',
  year: 'Année civile',
};
export function reportPeriodLabel(period: string): string {
  const m = String(period || '').match(/^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/);
  if (m) return `${REPORT_MONTHS_FR[Number(m[2]) - 1]} ${m[1]}`;
  return REPORT_RELATIVE_LABELS_FR[period] || 'Ce mois';
}
/** Current calendar month (YYYY-MM) — anchor shown for relative periods. */
function currentMonthYmd(): string {
  const now = new Date();
  return `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
/** The month the report bar's date field displays: the chosen month, or the
 *  anchor month of the active relative window (never empty dashes). */
export function reportPeriodMonthValue(period: string): string {
  return /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(period) ? period : currentMonthYmd();
}

/** Whitelisted persisted values only — never trust storage blindly. */
const REPORT_PERIOD_STORAGE_KEY = 'atlas-report-period';
function readStoredReportPeriod(): string {
  try {
    const v = String(localStorage.getItem(REPORT_PERIOD_STORAGE_KEY) || '');
    return /^(\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])|month|3m|6m|9m|12m|24m|36m|48m|year)$/.test(v) ? v : 'month';
  } catch {
    return 'month';
  }
}

export default function Balance() {
  const { confirm, prompt } = useUi();
  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [pwOpen, setPwOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pwTitle, setPwTitle] = useState('');
  const [pwDesc, setPwDesc] = useState('');
  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<null | ((password: string) => Promise<void>)>(null);
  const [reconcile, setReconcile] = useState<any>(null);
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const wz = useWizard(2);
  const [entryType, setEntryType] = useState<EntryType>('expense');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(EXPENSE_CATEGORIES[0]);
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(0);
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState('cash');
  const [expenseDate, setExpenseDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  const [vendorName, setVendorName] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [modalError, setModalError] = useState('');
  const [saveMsg, setSaveMsg] = useState('');
  const [saveMsgType, setSaveMsgType] = useState<'success' | 'error'>('success');
  const [txPage, setTxPage] = useState(0);
  const [txQuery, setTxQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState<'all' | EntryType>('all');
  const [reportPeriod, setReportPeriod] = useState<string>(readStoredReportPeriod);
  // v262.1 — the chosen month/period stays visible on the bar across refreshes
  const changeReportPeriod = (v: string) => {
    const next = /^(\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])|month|3m|6m|9m|12m|24m|36m|48m|year)$/.test(v) ? v : 'month';
    setReportPeriod(next);
    try { localStorage.setItem(REPORT_PERIOD_STORAGE_KEY, next); } catch { /* private mode */ }
  };

  const flash = (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setSaveMsg(msg); setSaveMsgType(type);
    setTimeout(() => setSaveMsg(''), 4500);
  };

  const load = (soft = false) => {
    if (soft) setRefreshing(true);
    else setLoading(true);
    Promise.all([api.getExpenses(), api.getDashboard()])
      .then(([e, d]) => { setExpenses(e.data); setDashboard(d.data); })
      .finally(() => {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      });
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const openNew = (type: EntryType) => {
    setEntryType(type);
    setCategory(catsFor(type)[0]);
    setDescription(''); setAmount(0); setVendorName(''); setNotes('');
    setExpenseDate(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    setPaymentMethod('cash');
    setModalError(''); wz.reset(); setShowModal(true);
  };

  const create = async () => {
    const fe = validateBalanceEntry({ description, amount }); setFieldErrors(fe); if (Object.keys(fe).length) return; // erreurs affichées sous chaque champ
    setModalError('');
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.createExpense({
        category, description, amount, payment_method: paymentMethod,
        expense_date: expenseDate, vendor_name: vendorName, notes,
        entry_type: entryType,
      });
      setShowModal(false);
      flash(TYPE_META[entryType].label + ' enregistré(e).');
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) { setModalError(e?.message || 'Enregistrement impossible'); } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const remove = async (id: number) => {
    let disclaimer = 'Supprimer cette écriture ? Le solde sera recalculé.';
    let doCascade = false;
    try {
      const links = await api.getExpenseLinks(id);
      if (links.data?.disclaimer || links.data?.invoice || (links.data?.receipts || []).length) {
        const inv = links.data.invoice ? `facture ${links.data.invoice.number}` : null;
        const recs = (links.data.receipts || []).map((r: any) => r.number).join(', ');
        disclaimer =
          `Cette écriture est liée${inv ? ' à la ' + inv : ''}${recs ? (inv ? ' et ' : ' au ') + 'reçu(s) ' + recs : ''}.\n` +
          `Les écritures liées peuvent être supprimées en cascade.`;
        // Ask cascade BEFORE password so dialogs never stack
        doCascade = await confirm({
          title: 'Suppression liée',
          message: 'Supprimer aussi la facture / les reçus liés ?\nOui = cascade (tout), Non = solde uniquement.',
          confirmLabel: 'Tout supprimer',
          cancelLabel: 'Solde uniquement',
          danger: true,
        });
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }

    setPwTitle('Supprimer l\'écriture de solde');
    setPwDesc(disclaimer);
    setPendingAction(() => async (password: string) => {
      await api.deleteExpense(id, password, doCascade);
      flash(doCascade ? 'Écriture et éléments liés supprimés.' : 'Écriture solde supprimée.');
      setPwOpen(false); setPendingAction(null);
      load(true);
      loadReconcile();
    });
    setPwOpen(true);
  };

  const loadReconcile = () => {
    api.getLedgerReconcile().then((r) => setReconcile(r.data)).catch(() => setReconcile(null));
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadReconcile(); }, []);

  const fixReceipts = () => {
    setPwTitle('Créer les reçus manquants');
    setPwDesc('Génère un reçu pour chaque facture payée qui n\'en a pas encore.');
    setPendingAction(() => async (password: string) => {
      const res: any = await api.fixMissingReceipts(password);
      flash(res.message || 'Reçus générés.');
      setPwOpen(false); setPendingAction(null);
      loadReconcile();
    });
    setPwOpen(true);
  };

  const fmt = (n: number) =>
    Math.round(Number(n || 0)).toLocaleString('fr-FR');
  const cur = dashboard?.currency || 'MAD';

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    let cashIn = 0, cashOut = 0, bankIn = 0, bankOut = 0;
    let income = 0, expense = 0, ownerDraw = 0, ownerContrib = 0;
    for (const e of expenses) {
      const t = (e.entry_type || 'expense') as EntryType;
      const amt = Number(e.amount || 0);
      const cash = isCash(e.payment_method);
      const isIn = t === 'income' || t === 'owner_contrib';
      if (t === 'income') income += amt;
      else if (t === 'owner_draw') ownerDraw += amt;
      else if (t === 'owner_contrib') ownerContrib += amt;
      else expense += amt;
      if (isIn) {
        if (cash) cashIn += amt; else bankIn += amt;
      } else {
        if (cash) cashOut += amt; else bankOut += amt;
      }
    }
    return { cashIn, cashOut, bankIn, bankOut, income, expense, ownerDraw, ownerContrib };
  }, [expenses]);

  const rows = expenses
    .filter((e) => {
      const t = (e.entry_type || 'expense') as EntryType;
      if (filterType !== 'all' && filterType !== t) return false;
      if (txQuery.trim()) {
        const q = txQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
        const hay = `${e.label || ''} ${e.category || ''} ${e.type || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    })
    .map((e) => {
      const t = (e.entry_type || 'expense') as EntryType;
      return {
        id: e.id,
        date: e.expense_date,
        type: t,
        label: e.description,
        category: e.category,
        amount: Number(e.amount),
        method: e.payment_method,
        direction: TYPE_META[t]?.direction || 'out',
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? 1 : -1));

  const TX_PAGE = 50;
  const sortedRows = rows;
  const pagedRows = sortedRows.slice(txPage * TX_PAGE, txPage * TX_PAGE + TX_PAGE);

  const byCategoryChart = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const e of expenses) {
      const tpe = (e as any).entry_type || 'expense';
      if (tpe !== 'expense' && tpe !== 'owner_draw') continue;
      const cat = String((e as any).category || 'Autre');
      map.set(cat, (map.get(cat) || 0) + Number((e as any).amount || 0));
    }
    return [...map.entries()]
      .map(([label, value]) => ({ label, value, tone: '#0f172a' }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
      .slice(0, 8);
  }, [expenses]);

  const byTypeChart = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, number> = { expense: 0, income: 0, owner_draw: 0, owner_contrib: 0 };
    for (const e of expenses) {
      const tpe = ((e as any).entry_type || 'expense') as string;
      if (map[tpe] !== undefined) map[tpe] += Number((e as any).amount || 0);
    }
    return [
      { label: 'Dépenses', value: map.expense, tone: '#ef4444' },
      { label: 'Recettes', value: map.income, tone: '#2563eb' },
      { label: 'Prélèvements', value: map.owner_draw, tone: '#f59e0b' },
      { label: 'Apports', value: map.owner_contrib, tone: '#0f172a' },
    ];
  }, [expenses]);

  if (loading)
    return (
      <div className="atlas-page balance-page">
        <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 14, width: 120, marginBottom: 10 }} />
        <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 32, width: 260, marginBottom: 18 }} />
        <div className="atlas-loading-grid">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
            <div key={i} className="skeleton" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );

  const balance = Number(dashboard?.currentBalance || 0);
  const moneyIn = Number(dashboard?.salesReceived || 0) + Number(dashboard?.otherIncomeTotal || 0) + Number(dashboard?.ownerContribTotal || 0);
  const moneyOut = Number(dashboard?.purchasesPaid || 0) + Number(dashboard?.expensesTotal || 0) + Number(dashboard?.ownerDrawTotal || 0);


  const methodLabel = (m?: string) => {
    if (!m || m === 'cash') return 'Espèces';
    if (m === 'bank') return 'Banque';
    if (m === 'card') return 'Carte';
    if (m === 'check') return 'Chèque';
    return m;
  };

  return (
    <div className="atlas-page balance-page">
      <p className="atlas-eyebrow">Trésorerie</p>
      <div className="page-header" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
        <div>
          <h1 className="atlas-hello" style={{ fontSize: '1.75rem' }}>Solde &amp; mouvements</h1>
          <p className="atlas-lead" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
            Caisse, banque, apports et prélèvements. Rapports PDF imprimables.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <RefreshIconButton onClick={() => load(true)} loading={refreshing} />
          <button className="secondary" onClick={() => openNew('income')}>+ Recette</button>
          <button className="secondary" onClick={() => openNew('owner_contrib')}>+ Apport</button>
          <button className="secondary" onClick={() => openNew('owner_draw')}>+ Prélèvement</button>
          <button onClick={() => openNew('expense')}>+ Dépense</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <SaveFeedback message={saveMsg} type={saveMsgType} />

      <div className="ac-metric-grid">
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label">Solde actuel</div>
          <div className="as-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.15rem' }}>
            {balance.toLocaleString('fr-FR', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} MAD
          </div>
          <div className="as-hint">caisse &amp; banque</div>
        </div>
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label">Entrées</div>
          <div className="as-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.15rem' }}>
            {moneyIn.toLocaleString('fr-FR', { minimumFractionDigits: 0 })} MAD
          </div>
          <div className="as-hint">ventes + recettes + apports</div>
        </div>
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label">Sorties</div>
          <div className="as-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.15rem' }}>
            {moneyOut.toLocaleString('fr-FR', { minimumFractionDigits: 0 })} MAD
          </div>
          <div className="as-hint">achats + dépenses + prélèvements</div>
        </div>
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label">Flux net</div>
          <div className="as-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.15rem' }}>
            {(moneyIn - moneyOut).toLocaleString('fr-FR', { minimumFractionDigits: 0 })} MAD
          </div>
          <div className="as-hint">entrées − sorties</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="balance-charts-grid">
        <BalanceMiniBars title="Sorties par catégorie" rows={byCategoryChart} />
        <BalanceMiniBars title="Répartition par type" rows={byTypeChart} />
      </div>
      <div className="balance-charts-grid" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import DatePicker from '../components/DatePicker';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api } from '../api';
import { useUi } from '../components/AppDialogs';
import RefreshIconButton from '../components/RefreshIconButton';
import './bank/bank.css';
import TransactionMatchingSheet from '../components/erp/TransactionMatchingSheet';

type BankRow = { date: string; label: string; amount: number; raw?: string };
type MatchItem = {
  bank: BankRow;
  match?: any | null;
  confidence?: number;
  reason?: string;
  status?: 'matched' | 'unmatched' | 'pending';
};
type Rule = {
  id: string;
  field: 'label' | 'amount' | 'date';
  op: 'contains' | 'eq' | 'gt' | 'lt';
  value: string;
  action: 'category' | 'party' | 'ignore';
  actionValue: string;
};

type MobileTab = 'feed' | 'match' | 'import' | 'rules' | 'logs';
type DetailTab = 'exact' | 'suggest' | 'manual';
type WizardStep = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;

function fmt(n: number) {
  return Math.round(Number(n || 0)).toLocaleString('fr-FR');
}

function Badge({ children, tone = 'muted' }: { children: React.ReactNode; tone?: string }) {
  return <span className={`bank-badge ${tone}`}>{children}</span>;
}

function parseCsvSync(text: string): BankRow[] {
  const lines = String(text || '').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const out: BankRow[] = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (/^date/i.test(line) && /libell|label|montant|amount/i.test(line)) continue;
    const sep = line.includes(';') ? ';' : ',';
    const parts = line.split(sep).map((p) => p.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, ''));
    if (parts.length < 2) continue;
    const dateRaw = parts[0];
    const label = parts.length >= 3 ? parts[1] : '';
    const amountStr = parts.length >= 3 ? parts[2] : parts[1];
    const amount = Number(String(amountStr).replace(/\s/g, '').replace(',', '.'));
    if (!Number.isFinite(amount)) continue;
    let date = dateRaw;
    const m = dateRaw.match(/^(\d{1,2})[/\-.](\d{1,2})[/\-.](\d{2,4})$/);
    if (m) {
      const y = m[3].length === 2 ? `20${m[3]}` : m[3];
      date = `${y}-${m[2].padStart(2, '0')}-${m[1].padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
    out.push({ date, label, amount, raw: line });
  }
  return out;
}

export default function Bank() {
  const { toast } = useUi();
  const [mobileTab, setMobileTab] = useState<MobileTab>('feed');
  const [detailTab, setDetailTab] = useState<DetailTab>('exact');
  const [csvText, setCsvText] = useState('');
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<BankRow[]>([]);

  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0);

  const [from, setFrom] = useState('');
  const [to, setTo] = useState('');
  const [windowDays, setWindowDays] = useState(7);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [parsePct, setParsePct] = useState(0);
  const [matchPct, setMatchPct] = useState(0);

  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<{ at: string; msg: string; tone?: string }[]>([]);
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState<'import' | 'rules' | 'logs' | null>(null);
  const [matchSheetOpen, setMatchSheetOpen] = useState(false);

  };

  const parseInWorker = (text: string) => {
    setParsePct(0);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      workerParse.current?.terminate();
      const blob = new Blob(
        [
          `self.onmessage=function(e){var t=String(e.data.csv||'').replace(/^\\uFEFF/,'').split(/\\r?\\n/).map(function(l){return l.trim()}).filter(Boolean);var out=[];for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){var line=t[i];if(/^date/i.test(line)&&/libell|label|montant/i.test(line))continue;var sep=line.indexOf(';')>=0?';':',';var p=line.split(sep).map(function(x){return x.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g,'')});if(p.length<2)continue;var date=p[0],label=p.length>=3?p[1]:'',as=p.length>=3?p[2]:p[1];var amount=Number(String(as).replace(/\\s/g,'').replace(',','.'));if(!isFinite(amount))continue;var m=date.match(/^(\\d{1,2})[\\/\\-.](\\d{1,2})[\\/\\-.](\\d{2,4})$/);if(m){var y=m[3].length===2?'20'+m[3]:m[3];date=y+'-'+m[2].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+m[1].padStart(2,'0')}out.push({date:date,label:label,amount:amount,raw:line});if(i%100===0)self.postMessage({type:'progress',done:i,total:t.length})}self.postMessage({type:'done',rows:out})}`,
        ],
        { type: 'application/javascript' },
      );
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const w = new Worker(url);

      w.onmessage = (ev) => {
        const d = ev.data;
        if (d.type === 'progress') {
          setParsePct(d.total ? Math.round((d.done / d.total) * 100) : 0);

          pushParsed(d.rows || []);

          setWizard(3);

          toast(`${(d.rows || []).length} lignes`, 'success');
        }
      };
      w.onerror = () => {
        pushParsed(parseCsvSync(text));

      };
      w.postMessage({ csv: text });
    } catch {

      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const onPickFile = async (file: File) => {

    const sep = first.includes(';') ? ';' : ',';
    const headers = first.split(sep).map((h) => h.trim());
    setPreviewHeaders(headers.length ? headers : ['Col 1', 'Col 2', 'Col 3']);
    const body = text.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8).map((l) => l.split(sep).map((c) => c.trim()));
    setPreviewRows(body);

    setSheet('import');

  const applyMappingAndParse = () => {

    const remapped: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      const sep = lines[i].includes(';') ? ';' : ',';
      const p = lines[i].split(sep).map((x) => x.trim());
      if (i === 0 && /date|libell|montant/i.test(lines[i])) continue;
      const d = p[mapDate] ?? '';
      const l = p[mapLabel] ?? '';
      const a = p[mapAmount] ?? '';
      remapped.push(`${d};${l};${a}`);
    }
    const joined = remapped.join('\n');
    setCsvText(joined);
    parseInWorker(joined);
  };

  const runServerMatch = async () => {
    const payload = csvText.trim() || rows.map((r) => `${r.date};${r.label};${r.amount}`).join('\n');
    if (!payload.trim()) {
      toast('Importez un relevé d’abord', 'error');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setMatchPct(10);
    try {
      const r: any = await api.reconcileBankCsv(payload, { date_window_days: windowDays });
      const matches = (r.data?.matches || []) as any[];
      if (matches.length) {
        setItems(
          matches.map((m) => ({
            bank: m.bank || { date: m.date, label: m.label, amount: m.amount },
            match: m.match || m.atlas || null,
            confidence: m.confidence ?? m.score,
            reason: m.reason || m.rule,
            status: m.match || m.atlas ? 'matched' : 'unmatched',
          })),
        );
      } else if (r.data) {
        // fallback structure
        const unmatched = r.data.unmatched || [];
        setItems((prev) => {
          if (!prev.length && rows.length) {
            return rows.map((bank) => ({ bank, match: null, status: 'unmatched' as const }));
          }
          return prev.map((it) => {
            const hit = unmatched.find(
              (u: any) => u.date === it.bank.date && Math.abs(Number(u.amount) - it.bank.amount) < 0.02,
            );
            return hit ? { ...it, status: 'unmatched' as const } : it;
          });
        });
      }
      setMatchPct(100);
      log(r.message || `Rapprochement serveur · ${r.data?.matched ?? '?'} match(s)`, 'ok');
      toast(r.message || 'Rapprochement terminé', 'success');
      void loadHealth();
      setMobileTab('match');
      setWizard(4);
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast(e?.message || 'Échec', 'error');
      log(e?.message || 'Échec matching', 'bad');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let list = items;
    if (filter === 'matched') list = list.filter((i) => i.status === 'matched' || i.match);
    if (filter === 'unmatched') list = list.filter((i) => !i.match);
    if (from) list = list.filter((i) => String(i.bank.date) >= from);
    if (to) list = list.filter((i) => String(i.bank.date) <= to);
    return list;
  }, [items, filter, from, to]);

  const current = filtered[selected] || null;

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const matched = items.filter((i) => i.match).length;
    const sumIn = rows.filter((r) => r.amount > 0).reduce((s, r) => s + r.amount, 0);
    const sumOut = rows.filter((r) => r.amount < 0).reduce((s, r) => s + r.amount, 0);
    return {
      lines: items.length || rows.length,
      matched,
      unmatched: (items.length || rows.length) - matched,
      sumIn,
      sumOut,
      net: sumIn + sumOut,
    };
  }, [items, rows]);

  const candidates = useMemo(() => {
    if (!current) return { exact: [], suggest: [] };
    if (current.match) {
      return { exact: [current.match], suggest: [] };
    }
    return { exact: [], suggest: [] };
  }, [current]);

  const saveRule = () => {
    if (!ruleDraft.value.trim()) {
      toast('Valeur de condition requise', 'error');
      return;
    }
    const id = ruleDraft.id || `r_${Date.now()}`;
    const next = [...rules.filter((r) => r.id !== id), { ...ruleDraft, id }];
    setRules(next);
    setRuleDraft({ id: '', field: 'label', op: 'contains', value: '', action: 'category', actionValue: '' });
    log('Règle enregistrée (locale)', 'ok');
    toast('Règle sauvegardée', 'success');
  };

  const unmatch = (idx: number) => {
    const target = filtered[idx];
    if (!target) return;
    setItems((prev) =>
      prev.map((it) =>
        it.bank.date === target.bank.date && it.bank.amount === target.bank.amount && it.bank.label === target.bank.label
          ? { ...it, match: null, status: 'unmatched', confidence: 0, reason: '' }
          : it,
      ),
    );
    log('Match retiré', 'warn');
  };

  /* ——— subviews ——— */
  const FeedPane = (
    <div className="bank-pane">
      <div className="bank-pane-head">
        <span>Transactions relevé ({filtered.length})</span>
        <Badge tone={filter === 'unmatched' ? 'warn' : 'muted'}>{filter}</Badge>
      </div>
      <div className="bank-feed">
        {filtered.length === 0 && (
          <p style={{ padding: 16, color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 13 }}>
            Aucune ligne. Utilisez l’onglet Import ou le bouton Importer.
          </p>
        )}
        {filtered.map((it, i) => {
          const amt = Number(it.bank.amount || 0);
          const active = i === selected;
          return (
            <button
              key={`${it.bank.date}-${i}-${it.bank.amount}`}
              type="button"
              className={`bank-row${active ? ' active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => {
                setSelected(i);
                setMobileTab('match');
                if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches) {
                  setMatchSheetOpen(true);
                  setMatchSel(filtered[i]?.match ? 'm0' : null);
                }
              }}
            >
              <span className="date">{it.bank.date || '—'}</span>
              <span className="desc">
                <span className="t">{it.bank.label || '—'}</span>
                <span style={{ marginTop: 4, display: 'inline-block' }}>
                  {it.match ? <Badge tone="ok">Matché</Badge> : <Badge tone="warn">Non rapproché</Badge>}
                </span>
              </span>
              <span className={`amt ${amt >= 0 ? 'credit' : 'debit'}`}>{fmt(amt)}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const MatchPane = (
    <div className="bank-pane">
      <div className="bank-pane-head">
        <span>Espace matching</span>
        {current?.confidence != null && current.match && (
          <Badge tone="info">{current.confidence}%</Badge>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="bank-detail">
        <div className="bank-tabs">
          {(
            [
              ['exact', 'Exact'],
              ['suggest', 'Suggestions'],
              ['manual', 'Manuel'],
            ] as const
          ).map(([k, lab]) => (
            <button
              key={k}
              type="button"
              className={`bank-tab${detailTab === k ? ' active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setDetailTab(k)}
            >
              {lab}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {!current && <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 13 }}>Sélectionnez une transaction.</p>}

        {current && (
          <>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Ligne banque</div>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 650, fontSize: 15 }}>{current.bank.label || '—'}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 13, marginTop: 4 }}>
                {current.bank.date} · <strong>{fmt(current.bank.amount)} MAD</strong>
              </div>
            </div>

            {detailTab === 'exact' && (
              <div>
                {candidates.exact.length === 0 && !current.match && (
                  <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Aucun match exact — essayez Suggestions ou le matching serveur.</p>
                )}
                {(current.match ? [current.match] : candidates.exact).map((m: any, idx: number) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
                    <Badge tone="ok">Candidat</Badge>
                    <div style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                      <div><strong>{m.kind || m.type || m.category || 'écriture Atlas'}</strong></div>
                      {m.invoice_number && <div>Facture {m.invoice_number}</div>}
                      {m.client_name && <div>{m.client_name}</div>}
                      {m.amount != null && <div>{fmt(Number(m.amount))} MAD</div>}
                      {current.reason && <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 12 }}>Règle : {current.reason}</div>}
                    </div>
                    <div className="bank-actions-row">
                      <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => unmatch(selected)}>Unmatch</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {detailTab === 'suggest' && (
              <div>
                <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                  Lancez le rapprochement serveur pour remplir les suggestions (montant + date + libellé).
                </p>
                <div className="bank-actions-row">
                  <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void runServerMatch()}>
                    {busy ? `Matching… ${matchPct}%` : 'Matcher maintenant'}
                  </button>
                </div>
                {matchPct > 0 && matchPct < 100 && (
                  <div className="bank-progress"><i style={{ width: `${matchPct}%` }} /></div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {detailTab === 'manual' && (
              <div>
                <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 8 }}>
                  Créer / ajuster l’écriture dans Solde, puis relancer le matching.
                </p>
                <div className="bank-actions-row">
                  <Link to="/balance"><button type="button">Ouvrir Solde</button></Link>
                  <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setSheet('rules')}>Règles</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const ImportBody = (
    <div>
      <div className="bank-wizard-steps">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((s) => (
          <span key={s} className={wizard === s ? 'on' : ''}>
            {s === 1 ? '1 · Fichier' : s === 2 ? '2 · Colonnes' : s === 3 ? '3 · Aperçu' : '4 · Poster'}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>

      {wizard === 1 && (
        <>
          <div
            className="bank-drop"
            onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.currentTarget.classList.add('over'); }}
            onDragLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.classList.remove('over')}
            onDrop={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.currentTarget.classList.remove('over');
              const f = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
              if (f) void onPickFile(f);
            }}
          >
            <div>Glissez un CSV ici</div>
            <button type="button" className="secondary" style={{ minHeight: 48 }} onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}>
              Choisir un fichier
            </button>
            <input
              ref={fileRef}
              type="file"
              accept=".csv,text/csv,text/plain"
              hidden
              onChange={(e) => {
                const f = e.target.files?.[0];
                if (f) void onPickFile(f);
                e.target.value = '';
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <textarea
            rows={4}
            value={csvText}
            onChange={(e) => setCsvText(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={'2026-08-01;Virement FA-2026-0001;12000\n2026-08-02;Loyer;-3500'}
            style={{ width: '100%', marginTop: 12, fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, monospace', fontSize: 12 }}
          />
          <div className="bank-actions-row">
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={!csvText.trim()}
              onClick={() => {
                const sep = csvText.includes(';') ? ';' : ',';
                const first = csvText.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean)[0] || '';
                setPreviewHeaders(first.split(sep).map((h) => h.trim()));
                setPreviewRows(
                  csvText.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8).map((l) => l.split(sep).map((c) => c.trim())),
                );
                setWizard(2);
              }}
            >
              Continuer → colonnes
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {wizard === 2 && (
        <>
          <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Associez chaque colonne Atlas à votre fichier.</p>
          <div className="bank-map-grid">
            <div>
              <label>Date</label>
              <select value={mapDate} onChange={(e) => setMapDate(Number(e.target.value))}>
                {previewHeaders.map((h, i) => (
                  <option key={i} value={i}>{h || `Col ${i + 1}`}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label>Libellé</label>
              <select value={mapLabel} onChange={(e) => setMapLabel(Number(e.target.value))}>
                {previewHeaders.map((h, i) => (
                  <option key={i} value={i}>{h || `Col ${i + 1}`}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label>Montant</label>
              <select value={mapAmount} onChange={(e) => setMapAmount(Number(e.target.value))}>
                {previewHeaders.map((h, i) => (
                  <option key={i} value={i}>{h || `Col ${i + 1}`}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="bank-actions-row">
            <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setWizard(1)}>Retour</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={applyMappingAndParse} disabled={busy}>
              {busy ? `Parse ${parsePct}%` : 'Parser & aperçu'}
            </button>
          </div>
          {busy && <div className="bank-progress"><i style={{ width: `${parsePct}%` }} /></div>}
        </>
      )}

      {wizard >= 3 && (
        <>
          <div className="bank-preview-table">
            <table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Date</th>
                  <th>Libellé</th>
                  <th>Montant</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {(rows.length ? rows : parseCsvSync(csvText)).slice(0, 25).map((r, i) => (
                  <tr key={i}>
                    <td>{r.date}</td>
                    <td>{r.label}</td>
                    <td>{fmt(r.amount)}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <div className="bank-actions-row">
            <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setWizard(2)}>Colonnes</button>
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || !(rows.length || csvText.trim())} onClick={() => void runServerMatch()}>
              {busy ? 'Matching…' : 'Lancer rapprochement'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  const RulesBody = (
    <div>
      <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
        Règles locales (navigateur). Le matching serveur reste la source principale.
      </p>
      <div className="bank-map-grid">
        <div>
          <label>Champ</label>
          <select
            value={ruleDraft.field}
            onChange={(e) => setRuleDraft((d) => ({ ...d, field: e.target.value as Rule['field'] }))}
          >
            <option value="label">Libellé</option>
            <option value="amount">Montant</option>
            <option value="date">Date</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Opérateur</label>
          <select
            value={ruleDraft.op}
            onChange={(e) => setRuleDraft((d) => ({ ...d, op: e.target.value as Rule['op'] }))}
          >
            <option value="contains">contient</option>
            <option value="eq">égal</option>
            <option value="gt">supérieur</option>
            <option value="lt">inférieur</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Valeur</label>
          <input value={ruleDraft.value} onChange={(e) => setRuleDraft((d) => ({ ...d, value: e.target.value }))} placeholder="ex. LOYER" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Action</label>
          <select
            value={ruleDraft.action}
            onChange={(e) => setRuleDraft((d) => ({ ...d, action: e.target.value as Rule['action'] }))}
          >
            <option value="category">Catégoriser</option>
            <option value="party">Assigner tiers</option>
            <option value="ignore">Ignorer</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Valeur action</label>
          <input
            value={ruleDraft.actionValue}
            onChange={(e) => setRuleDraft((d) => ({ ...d, actionValue: e.target.value }))}
            placeholder="ex. Loyer"
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="bank-actions-row">
        <button type="button" onClick={saveRule}>Enregistrer la règle</button>
      </div>
      <ul style={{ marginTop: 14, paddingLeft: 18, fontSize: 13 }}>
        {rules.length === 0 && <li style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Aucune règle</li>}
        {rules.map((r) => (
          <li key={r.id} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
            Si <strong>{r.field}</strong> {r.op} « {r.value} » → {r.action} {r.actionValue}
            <button
              type="button"
              className="secondary"
              style={{ marginLeft: 8, minHeight: 36, padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }}
              onClick={() => setRules((prev) => prev.filter((x) => x.id !== r.id))}
            >
              Supprimer
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );

  const LogsBody = (
    <div>
      {logs.length === 0 && <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 13 }}>Aucune activité pour cette session.</p>}
      <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', padding: 0, margin: 0 }}>
        {logs.map((l, i) => (
          <li key={i} style={{ padding: '10px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--line)', fontSize: 13 }}>
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 11, marginRight: 8 }}>{l.at}</span>
            {l.msg}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="page bank-hub">
      <div className="bank-top">
        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 180 }}>
          <h1>Banque & rapprochement</h1>
          <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
            Hub type ERPNext Banking — desktop split-pane, mobile onglets, workers hors UI.
          </p>
        </div>
        <RefreshIconButton onClick={() => { void loadHealth(); log('Rafraîchi', 'info'); }} />
        <button type="button" className="secondary bank-desktop-only" style={{ minHeight: 44 }} onClick={() => setSheet('logs')}>
          Journal
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="secondary" style={{ minHeight: 44 }} onClick={() => { setSheet('import'); setWizard(1); }}>
          Importer
        </button>
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} style={{ minHeight: 44 }} onClick={() => void runServerMatch()}>
          {busy ? '…' : 'Rapprocher'}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="bank-metrics">
        {[
          { lbl: 'Lignes', val: stats.lines },
          { lbl: 'Matchés', val: stats.matched },
          { lbl: 'Ouverts', val: stats.unmatched },
          { lbl: 'Crédits', val: `+${fmt(stats.sumIn)}` },
          { lbl: 'Débits', val: fmt(stats.sumOut) },
          { lbl: 'Net', val: fmt(stats.net) },
        ].map((m) => (
          <div key={m.lbl} className="bank-metric">
            <div className="lbl">{m.lbl}</div>
            <div className="val">{m.val}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {ledgerHealth?.summary && (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 12, padding: 12 }}>
          <Badge tone={ledgerHealth.summary.ok ? 'ok' : 'warn'}>
            {ledgerHealth.summary.ok ? 'Ledger cohérent' : 'Écarts ledger'}
          </Badge>
          <span style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 13 }}>{ledgerHealth.summary.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="bank-toolbar">
        <div>
          <label>Du</label>
          <DatePicker value={from} onChange={setFrom} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Au</label>
          <DatePicker value={to} onChange={setTo} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>± jours</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            min={0}
            max={60}
            value={windowDays}
            onChange={(e) => setWindowDays(Math.max(0, Math.min(60, Number(e.target.value) || 0)))}
            style={{ width: 72 }}
          />
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {(['all', 'matched', 'unmatched'] as const).map((f) => (
            <button
              key={f}
              type="button"
              className={`bank-pill${filter === f ? ' active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => { setFilter(f); setSelected(0); }}
            >
              {f === 'all' ? 'Tous' : f === 'matched' ? 'Matchés' : 'Ouverts'}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Desktop dual pane */}
      <div className="bank-split bank-desktop-only">
        {FeedPane}
        {MatchPane}
      </div>

      {/* Mobile stacked by tab */}
      <div className="bank-mobile-only">
        {mobileTab === 'feed' && FeedPane}
        {mobileTab === 'match' && MatchPane}
        {mobileTab === 'import' && <div className="card">{ImportBody}</div>}
        {mobileTab === 'rules' && <div className="card">{RulesBody}</div>}
        {mobileTab === 'logs' && <div className="card">{LogsBody}</div>}
      </div>

      <nav className="bank-mobile-nav" aria-label="Banque mobile">
        {(
          [
            ['feed', 'Transactions'],
            ['match', 'Match'],
            ['import', 'Import'],
            ['rules', 'Règles'],
            ['logs', 'Journal'],
          ] as const
        ).map(([id, lab]) => (
          <button
            key={id}
            type="button"
            className={mobileTab === id ? 'active' : ''}
            onClick={() => {
              setMobileTab(id);
              if (id === 'import') setWizard(1);
            }}
          >
            {lab}
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>

      {matchSheetOpen && current && (
        <TransactionMatchingSheet
          isOpen={matchSheetOpen}
          onClose={() => setMatchSheetOpen(false)}
          transaction={{
            date: current.bank.date,
            description: current.bank.label,
            amount: current.bank.amount,
            type: current.bank.amount >= 0 ? 'deposit' : 'withdrawal',
          }}
          candidates={
            current.match
              ? [{
                  id: 'm0',
                  title: String(current.match.kind || current.match.type || current.match.category || 'Écriture Atlas'),
                  subtitle: [current.match.invoice_number, current.match.client_name].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
                  amount: current.match.amount != null ? Number(current.match.amount) : undefined,
                  score: current.confidence,
                }]
              : []
          }
          selectedId={matchSel}
          onSelect={setMatchSel}
          onConfirm={() => { setMatchSheetOpen(false); }}
        />
      )}
      {sheet && (
        <div className="bank-sheet-backdrop" onClick={() => setSheet(null)} role="presentation">
          <div className="bank-sheet" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} role="dialog" aria-modal>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <h3>
                {sheet === 'import' ? 'Import relevé' : sheet === 'rules' ? 'Règles' : 'Journal'}
              </h3>
              <button type="button" className="secondary" style={{ minHeight: 44 }} onClick={() => setSheet(null)}>
                Fermer
              </button>
            </div>
            {sheet === 'import' && ImportBody}
            {sheet === 'rules' && RulesBody}
            {sheet === 'logs' && LogsBody}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
