import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import DatePicker, { DateRangePicker } from '../components/DatePicker';
import { Link, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api } from '../api';
import { getUsername, isStockRole } from '../auth';
import { IconPackage } from '../components/Icons';
import { useUi } from '../components/AppDialogs';

/**
 * Date + place from the *device* clock/timezone only (never IP geolocation).
 * VPNs change IP but not the phone/PC timezone the user set — so this stays correct.
 */
function devicePlaceLabel(): string {
  try {
    const tz = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || '';
    const map: Record<string, string> = {
      'Africa/Casablanca': 'Casablanca',
      'Africa/El_Aaiun': 'Laâyoune',
      'Europe/Paris': 'Paris',
      'Asia/Shanghai': 'Shanghai',
      'Asia/Tokyo': 'Tokyo',
      'UTC': 'UTC',
    };
    if (map[tz]) return map[tz];
    const tail = tz.split('/').pop() || tz;
    return tail.replace(/_/g, ' ');
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

function todayLabel() {
  const d = new Date(); // device local time
  const date = d
    .toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' })
    .toUpperCase();
  const place = devicePlaceLabel();
  return place ? `${date} · ${place.toUpperCase()}` : date;
}

function fmt(n: number, cur = 'MAD') {
  return `${Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('fr-FR', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} ${cur}`;
}

/** Local YYYY-MM-DD (avoids UTC shift from toISOString that breaks "2 ans" ranges). */
function toLocalYMD(d: Date) {
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}

function defaultRange(preset: string) {
  const to = new Date();
  to.setHours(12, 0, 0, 0); // noon local → stable date
  let from = new Date(to);
  if (preset === '7d') from = new Date(to.getFullYear(), to.getMonth(), to.getDate() - 6);
  else if (preset === '1m') from = new Date(to.getFullYear(), to.getMonth(), 1);
  else if (preset === '6m') from = new Date(to.getFullYear(), to.getMonth() - 5, 1);
  else if (preset === '12m' || preset === '1y') from = new Date(to.getFullYear(), to.getMonth() - 11, 1);
  else if (preset === '24m' || preset === '2y') from = new Date(to.getFullYear(), to.getMonth() - 23, 1);
  else if (preset === 'ytd' || preset === 'year') from = new Date(to.getFullYear(), 0, 1);
  else if (preset === '3m') from = new Date(to.getFullYear(), to.getMonth() - 2, 1);
  else from = new Date(to.getFullYear(), to.getMonth() - 5, 1);
  from.setHours(12, 0, 0, 0);
  return { from: toLocalYMD(from), to: toLocalYMD(to) };
}

/** Short axis label: always "MM/YY" so it stays readable when dense */
function shortMonthLabel(s: { key?: string; label?: string }) {
  const k = String(s.key || '');
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}/.test(k)) {
    return `${k.slice(5, 7)}/${k.slice(2, 4)}`;
  }
  const lab = String(s.label || '');
  const m = lab.match(/(\d{2})\/(\d{2})/);
  if (m) return `${m[1]}/${m[2]}`;
  return lab.slice(0, 8) || '—';
}

/** Simple SVG bar chart — labels in SVG so bars align with months */
function formatAxisVal(v: number, max: number) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return '0';
  if (max >= 1_000_000) return `${(v / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (max >= 10_000) return `${Math.round(v / 1000)}k`;
  if (max >= 1000) return `${(v / 1000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  if (max < 10) return (Math.round(v * 10) / 10).toString();
  return String(Math.round(v));
}

function niceMax(raw: number) {
  if (raw <= 0) return 1;
  if (raw <= 1) return 1;
  if (raw <= 5) return Math.ceil(raw);
  const mag = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw));
  const n = raw / mag;
  const nice = n <= 1 ? 1 : n <= 2 ? 2 : n <= 5 ? 5 : 10;
  return nice * mag;
}

function BarChart({
  series,
  keys,
}: {
  series: { key: string; label?: string; [k: string]: any }[];
  keys: { key: string; label: string; color: string }[];
  colors?: string[];
}) {
  // Dual-tone greyscale pairs (reference Total Revenue style)
  const toneKeys = keys.map((k, i) => ({
    ...k,
    color: i % 2 === 0 ? '#d4d4d8' : '#52525b',
  }));
  keys = toneKeys;
  if (!series.length) {
    return (
      <div className="ac-dash-empty" style={{ minHeight: 160 }}>
        <p>Pas encore de données pour cette période.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const allZero = series.every((s) => keys.every((k) => !Number(s[k.key] || 0)));
  const rawMax = Math.max(0, ...series.flatMap((s) => keys.map((k) => Number(s[k.key] || 0))));
  const max = niceMax(rawMax || 0);
  const n = series.length;
  const labelEvery = n <= 6 ? 1 : n <= 12 ? 1 : n <= 18 ? 2 : 3;
  const leftPad = 44;
  const rightPad = 12;
  const topPad = 12;
  const bottomPad = 28;
  const barAreaMinW = Math.max(28, Math.min(48, Math.floor(720 / Math.max(n, 1))));
  const w = leftPad + rightPad + n * barAreaMinW;
  const h = 200;
  const plotH = h - topPad - bottomPad;
  const groupW = (w - leftPad - rightPad) / Math.max(1, n);
  const barW = Math.min(14, Math.max(3, (groupW - 6) / Math.max(1, keys.length)));

  const yearStarts = new Set<number>();
  series.forEach((s, i) => {
    const k = String(s.key || '');
    if (/^\d{4}-01$/.test(k.slice(0, 7))) yearStarts.add(i);
  });

  const ticks = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map((t) => ({
    t,
    v: max * t,
    y: topPad + plotH * (1 - t),
  }));


  return (
    <div style={{ width: '100%', overflowX: n > 14 ? 'auto' : 'visible' }}>
      {allZero && (
        <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--ac-muted)', textAlign: 'center' }}>
          Aucun mouvement sur cette période — les barres resteront à 0.
        </p>
      )}
      <svg
        viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`}
        width="100%"
        style={{ maxHeight: 280, minWidth: n > 14 ? w : undefined, display: 'block' }}
        role="img"
        aria-label="Graphique"
        className="ac-bionis-chart"
      >
        <defs>
          {keys.map((k) => (
            <linearGradient key={`g-${k.key}`} id={`ac-bar-${k.key}`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={k.color} stopOpacity="1" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={k.color} stopOpacity="0.75" />
            </linearGradient>
          ))}
        </defs>
        {ticks.map(({ t, v, y }) => (
          <g key={t}>
            <line x1={leftPad} x2={w - rightPad} y1={y} y2={y} stroke="var(--ac-line)" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray={t === 0 ? undefined : '4 4'} opacity={t === 0 ? 1 : 0.7} />
            <text x={leftPad - 6} y={y + 3} fontSize="10" fill="var(--ac-muted)" textAnchor="end">
              {formatAxisVal(v, max)}
            </text>
          </g>
        ))}
        {series.map((s, i) => {
          const x0 = leftPad + i * groupW + groupW / 2;
          const lab = shortMonthLabel(s);
          const showLabel = i % labelEvery === 0 || i === n - 1 || yearStarts.has(i);
          return (
            <g key={s.key || i}>
              {yearStarts.has(i) && (
                <line
                  x1={x0 - groupW / 2}
                  x2={x0 - groupW / 2}
                  y1={topPad}
                  y2={topPad + plotH}
                  stroke="var(--ac-line)"
                  strokeWidth="1"
                  strokeDasharray="3 3"
                />
              )}
              {keys.map((k, ki) => {
                const val = Number(s[k.key] || 0);
                const bh = max > 0 ? (val / max) * plotH : 0;
                const x = x0 - (keys.length * barW) / 2 + ki * barW;
                const y = topPad + plotH - bh;
                return (
                  <rect
                    key={k.key}
                    x={x}
                    y={y}
                    width={Math.max(2, barW - 1)}
                    height={Math.max(0, bh)}
                    rx={6}
                    fill={`url(#ac-bar-${k.key})`}
                    className="ac-chart-bar"
                  >
                    <title>{`${lab} · ${k.label}: ${val}`}</title>
                  </rect>
                );
              })}
              {showLabel && (
                <text
                  x={x0}
                  y={h - 8}
                  fontSize={n > 18 ? 9 : 10}
                  fill="#9aa3b5"
                  textAnchor="middle"
                  fontWeight={yearStarts.has(i) ? 700 : 500}
                >
                  {lab}
                </text>
              )}
            </g>
          );
        })}
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Line chart for profit / trends over long ranges */
function LineChart({
  series,
  valueKey = 'profit',
  color = '#71717a',
  label = 'Profit',
}: {
  series: { key: string; label?: string; [k: string]: any }[];
  valueKey?: string;
  color?: string;
  label?: string;
}) {
  if (!series.length) {
    return (
      <div className="ac-dash-empty" style={{ minHeight: 140 }}>
        <p>Pas de données.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const vals = series.map((s) => Number(s[valueKey] || 0));
  const max = Math.max(1, ...vals.map((v) => Math.abs(v)));
  const w = Math.max(560, Math.min(960, series.length * 28));
  const h = 180;
  const padL = 40;
  const padB = 36;
  const padT = 16;
  const plotW = w - padL - 12;
  const plotH = h - padB - padT;
  const n = series.length;
  const pts = series.map((s, i) => {
    const x = padL + (n <= 1 ? plotW / 2 : (i / (n - 1)) * plotW);
    const v = Number(s[valueKey] || 0);
    const y = padT + plotH / 2 - (v / max) * (plotH / 2);
    return { x, y, v, lab: shortMonthLabel(s) };
  });
  const path = pts.map((p, i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'}${p.x.toFixed(1)},${p.y.toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
  const labelEvery = n <= 8 ? 1 : n <= 14 ? 2 : 4;
  return (
    <div style={{ width: '100%' }}>
      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} width="100%" style={{ maxHeight: 180 }} role="img" aria-label={label}>
        <line x1={padL} x2={w - 8} y1={padT + plotH / 2} y2={padT + plotH / 2} stroke="var(--ac-line)" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="4 3" />
        <path d={path} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeLinecap="round" />
        {pts.map((p, i) => (
          <circle key={i} cx={p.x} cy={p.y} r={3} fill={color}>
            <title>{`${p.lab}: ${Math.round(p.v)}`}</title>
          </circle>
        ))}
        <text x={4} y={padT + 8} fontSize="9" fill="var(--ac-muted)">{max >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(max / 1000)}k` : Math.round(max)}</text>
      </svg>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${n}, minmax(0, 1fr))`, paddingLeft: padL, paddingRight: 12, fontSize: 10, color: '#9aa3b5' }}>
        {pts.map((p, i) => (
          <span key={i} style={{ textAlign: 'center', visibility: (i % labelEvery === 0 || i === n - 1) ? 'visible' : 'hidden' }}>{p.lab}</span>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


/** Bionis-style area chart (filled path + stroke). */
function AreaChart({
  series,
  keys,
  height = 220,
}: {
  series: { key: string; label?: string; [k: string]: any }[];
  keys: { key: string; label: string; color: string }[];
  height?: number;
}) {
  // Always draw axes + baseline — even when every value is 0
  const safeSeries =
    series.length > 0
      ? series
      : [{ key: 'empty', label: '—', ...Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k) => [k.key, 0])) }];
  const rawMax = Math.max(
    0,
    ...safeSeries.flatMap((s) => keys.map((k) => Number(s[k.key] || 0))),
  );
  const allZero = rawMax <= 0;
  const max = niceMax(rawMax || 0) || 1;
  const n = safeSeries.length;
  const leftPad = 44;
  const rightPad = 12;
  const topPad = 16;
  const bottomPad = 28;
  const w = Math.max(320, leftPad + rightPad + n * 36);
  const h = height;
  const plotH = h - topPad - bottomPad;
  const plotW = w - leftPad - rightPad;

  const xAt = (i: number) => leftPad + (n <= 1 ? plotW / 2 : (i / (n - 1)) * plotW);
  const yAt = (v: number) => topPad + plotH * (1 - (max > 0 ? Number(v) / max : 0));

  const ticks = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map((t) => ({
    t,
    v: max * t,
    y: topPad + plotH * (1 - t),
  }));

  const paths = keys.map((k) => {
    const pts = safeSeries.map((s, i) => ({ x: xAt(i), y: yAt(Number(s[k.key] || 0)), v: Number(s[k.key] || 0) }));
    const line = pts.map((p, i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'}${p.x.toFixed(1)},${p.y.toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
    const area =
      pts.length > 0
        ? `${line} L${pts[pts.length - 1].x.toFixed(1)},${(topPad + plotH).toFixed(1)} L${pts[0].x.toFixed(1)},${(topPad + plotH).toFixed(1)} Z`
        : '';
    return { k, pts, line, area };
  });

  return (
    <div style={{ width: '100%', overflowX: n > 14 ? 'auto' : 'visible' }}>
      {allZero && (
        <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--ac-muted, #71717a)', textAlign: 'center' }}>
          Aucune entrée/sortie sur cette période.
        </p>
      )}
      <svg
        viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`}
        width="100%"
        style={{ maxHeight: height + 20, minWidth: n > 14 ? w : undefined, display: 'block' }}
        role="img"
        aria-label="Graphique aire"
        className="ac-bionis-chart ac-area-chart"
      >
        <defs>
          {keys.map((k) => (
            <linearGradient key={`ag-${k.key}`} id={`ac-area-${k.key}`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={k.color} stopOpacity="0.35" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={k.color} stopOpacity="0.02" />
            </linearGradient>
          ))}
        </defs>
        {ticks.map(({ t, v, y }) => (
          <g key={t}>
            <line
              x1={leftPad}
              x2={w - rightPad}
              y1={y}
              y2={y}
              stroke="var(--ac-line)"
              strokeWidth="1"
              strokeDasharray={t === 0 ? undefined : '4 4'}
              opacity={t === 0 ? 1 : 0.65}
            />
            <text x={leftPad - 6} y={y + 3} fontSize="10" fill="var(--ac-muted)" textAnchor="end">
              {formatAxisVal(v, max)}
            </text>
          </g>
        ))}
        {paths.map(({ k, line, area, pts }) => (
          <g key={k.key}>
            {area && <path d={area} fill={`url(#ac-area-${k.key})`} className="ac-chart-area" />}
            <path d={line} fill="none" stroke={k.color} strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" className="ac-chart-line" />
            {pts.map((pt, i) => (
              <circle key={i} cx={pt.x} cy={pt.y} r="3.5" fill="#fff" stroke={k.color} strokeWidth="2" className="ac-chart-dot">
                <title>{`${shortMonthLabel(safeSeries[i] || {})} · ${k.label}: ${pt.v}`}</title>
              </circle>
            ))}
          </g>
        ))}
        {safeSeries.map((s, i) => {
          const lab = shortMonthLabel(s);
          const show = n <= 12 || i % Math.ceil(n / 8) === 0 || i === n - 1;
          if (!show) return null;
          return (
            <text key={s.key || i} x={xAt(i)} y={h - 8} fontSize={n > 18 ? 9 : 10} fill="#71717a" textAnchor="middle">
              {lab}
            </text>
          );
        })}
      </svg>
      <div className="ac-chart-legend">
        {keys.map((k) => (
          <span key={k.key} className="ac-chart-legend-item">
            <i style={{ background: k.color }} />
            {k.label}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function HBarChart({
  items,
  color = 'var(--ac-ink)',
}: {
  items: { label: string; value: number }[];
  color?: string;
}) {
  if (!items.length) {
    return (
      <div className="ac-dash-empty" style={{ minHeight: 100 }}>
        <p>Aucune catégorie.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const max = Math.max(1, ...items.map((i) => Math.abs(i.value)));
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
      {items.slice(0, 8).map((it) => (
        <div key={it.label} style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '100px 1fr 72px', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#9aa3b5', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }} title={it.label}>{it.label}</span>
          <div style={{ height: 10, background: '#f0ebe3', borderRadius: 99, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (Math.abs(it.value) / max) * 100)}%`, height: '100%', background: color, borderRadius: 99 }} />
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, textAlign: 'right' }}>{Math.round(it.value).toLocaleString('fr-FR')}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}


function DonutChart({
  segments,
  centerLabel,
  centerValue,
}: {
  segments: { value: number; color: string; label: string }[];
  centerLabel: string;
  centerValue: string;
}) {
  const total = segments.reduce((a, s) => a + Math.max(0, s.value), 0) || 1;
  const r = 52;
  const c = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  let offset = 0;
  const size = 160;
  const cx = size / 2;
  const cy = size / 2;
  // Force greyscale palette like reference
  const greys = ['#a3a3a3', '#737373', '#525252', '#262626', '#d4d4d4'];
  return (
    <div className="ac-donut">
      <div className="ac-donut-ring" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
        <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}>
          <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r} fill="none" stroke="#f4f4f5" strokeWidth="18" />
          {segments.map((seg, i) => {
            const frac = Math.max(0, seg.value) / total;
            const dash = frac * c;
            const stroke = greys[i % greys.length];
            const el = (
              <circle
                key={i}
                cx={cx}
                cy={cy}
                r={r}
                fill="none"
                stroke={stroke}
                strokeWidth="18"
                strokeDasharray={`${dash} ${c - dash}`}
                strokeDashoffset={-offset}
                strokeLinecap="butt"
                transform={`rotate(-90 ${cx} ${cy})`}
              />
            );
            offset += dash;
            return el;
          })}
        </svg>
        <div className="ac-donut-center">
          <strong>{centerValue}</strong>
          <span>{centerLabel}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <ul className="ac-donut-legend">
        {segments.map((seg, i) => (
          <li key={i}>
            <i style={{ background: greys[i % greys.length] }} />
            {seg.label}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

function NextActionsPanel() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<{ priority: number; title: string; detail: string; href?: string }[]>([]);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    api.assistNextActions()
      .then((r) => { if (!cancelled) setItems(r.data?.items || []); })
      .catch((e: any) => { if (!cancelled) setErr(e?.message || 'Impossible de charger'); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);
  if (err) return null;
  if (!items.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className="ac-panel" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
      <div className="ac-panel-head">
        <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 15 }}>Que faire ensuite ?</h3>
      </div>
      <ul style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 18, fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
        {items.map((it, i) => (
          <li key={i} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
            <strong>{it.title}</strong>
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}> — {it.detail}</span>
            {it.href ? (
              <a href={it.href} style={{ marginLeft: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>Ouvrir</a>
            ) : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Dashboard() {
  const [attWeek, setAttWeek] = useState<{ date: string; present: number; late: number; absent: number }[] | null>(null);
  const [attEmpId, setAttEmpId] = useState<string>('');
  const [attDays, setAttDays] = useState(7);
  const [attEmployees, setAttEmployees] = useState<{ id: number; name: string }[]>([]);

  const { toast } = useUi();

  const stockOnly = isStockRole();
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [actions, setActions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [locations, setLocations] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [preset, setPreset] = useState('6m');
  const [range, setRange] = useState(() => defaultRange('6m'));

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const { getToken } = await import('../auth');
        const { getApiBase } = await import('../config');
        const { api } = await import('../api');
        const token = getToken() || '';
        const base = getApiBase();
        /* Silent-skip when the Pointage module is disabled — avoids a noisy 403. */
        let attOn = false;
        try {
          const s: any = await api.getSettings();
          attOn = Number(s?.data?.attendance_enabled) === 1;
        } catch {
          attOn = false;
        }
        if (!attOn) {
          if (!cancelled) setAttWeek([]);
          return;
        }
        try {
          const el: any = await api.getEmployees?.({ status: 'active', limit: 200 });
          const list = el?.data?.rows || el?.data || [];
          if (!cancelled && Array.isArray(list)) {
            setAttEmployees(
              list.map((e: any) => ({
                id: Number(e.id),
                name: e.display_name || e.name || `${e.first_name || ''} ${e.last_name || ''}`.trim() || `#${e.id}`,
              })),
            );
          }
        } catch {
          /* */
        }
        const q = new URLSearchParams({ days: String(attDays) });
        if (attEmpId) q.set('employee_id', attEmpId);
        const r = await fetch(`${base}/api/attendance/weekly?${q}`, {
          headers: token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {},
        });
        const j = await r.json().catch(() => null);
        if (!cancelled && j?.data?.days) setAttWeek(j.data.days);
        else if (!cancelled) setAttWeek([]);
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setAttWeek([]);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [attEmpId, attDays]);


  useEffect(() => {
    let stopped = false;
    let timer: number | null = null;
    let failStreak = 0;
    const baseMs = 90000;

    const schedule = () => {
      if (stopped) return;
      if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
      // Pause when tab hidden; backoff on errors (30s → 60s → 120s max)
      const hidden = typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'hidden';
      const delay = hidden
        ? baseMs * 4
        : Math.min(baseMs * Math.pow(2, Math.min(failStreak, 2)), 120000);
      timer = window.setTimeout(() => void load(true), delay);
    };

    const load = async (soft = false) => {
      if (!soft) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const [dash, ac, pr, st, locs] = await Promise.all([
          api.getDashboard().catch((e) => {
            throw e;
          }),
          api.listMobileActions({ status: 'all', limit: 12 }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
          api.getProducts({ include_variants: true }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
          api.getMobileActionStats().catch(() => ({ data: { pending: 0 } })),
          api.getStockLocations().catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
        ]);
        if (stopped) return;
        setData(dash.data);
        setActions(ac.data || []);
        setProducts(pr.data || []);
        setLocations(locs.data || []);
        setPending(Number(st.data?.pending || 0));
        setError('');
        failStreak = 0;
      } catch (e: any) {
        if (!stopped) {
          setError(e.message || 'Erreur réseau');
          failStreak += 1;
        }
      } finally {
        if (!stopped) {
          setLoading(false);
          schedule();
        }
      }
    };

    void load();
    const onVis = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') void load(true);
      else schedule();
    };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
    };
  }, []);

  const filteredSeries = useMemo(() => {
    const series = data?.monthlySeries || data?.monthly_series || data?.cashflow || [];
    const fromKey = range.from.slice(0, 7);
    const toKey = range.to.slice(0, 7);
    const byKey: Record<string, any> = {};
    if (Array.isArray(series)) {
      for (const s of series) {
        const k = String(s.key || s.month || '').slice(0, 7);
        if (k.length === 7 && k[4] === '-') byKey[k] = s;
      }
    }
    // Always materialize every month in the selected range so 1y / 2y charts never go blank
    const keys: string[] = [];
    {
      let [y, m] = fromKey.split('-').map(Number);
      const [ty, tm] = toKey.split('-').map(Number);
      let guard = 0;
      while ((y < ty || (y === ty && m <= tm)) && guard < 48) {
        keys.push(`${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`);
        m += 1;
        if (m > 12) { m = 1; y += 1; }
        guard += 1;
      }
    }
    const fr = ['Jan', 'Fév', 'Mar', 'Avr', 'Mai', 'Juin', 'Juil', 'Aoû', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Déc'];
    return keys.map((k) => {
      const s = byKey[k] || {};
      const income = Number(s.sales ?? s.income ?? 0);
      const expense = Number(s.expenses ?? s.expense ?? 0);
      const [ys, ms] = k.split('-');
      const mi = Math.max(0, Math.min(11, Number(ms) - 1));
      return {
        key: k,
        label: `${fr[mi]} ${ys.slice(2)}`,
        income,
        expense,
        profit: Number(s.profit ?? income - expense),
        invoices_fa: Number(s.invoices_fa || 0),
        sales_vr: Number(s.sales_vr || 0),
        bills: Number(s.bills || 0),
        salaries: Number(s.salaries || 0),
        clients_new: Number(s.clients_new || 0),
        receipts: Number(s.receipts || 0),
        owner_contrib: Number(s.owner_contrib || 0),
        owner_draw: Number(s.owner_draw || 0),
      };
    });
  }, [data, range]);

  const applyPreset = (p: string) => {
    setPreset(p);
    setRange(defaultRange(p));
  };

  if (stockOnly) {
    return <Navigate to="/products" replace />;
  }

  if (loading && !data)
    return (
      <div className="atlas-page ac-dash">
        <div className="ac-dash-hero">
          <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 12, width: 160, marginBottom: 10 }} />
          <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 32, width: 240, marginBottom: 8 }} />
          <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 14, width: 320 }} />
        </div>
        <div className="ac-metric-grid">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
            <div key={i} className="ac-metric skeleton" style={{ minHeight: 100 }} />
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: 240, borderRadius: 16, marginTop: 12 }} />
      </div>
    );
  if (error && !data)
    return (
      <div className="ac-dash ac-dash-error">
        <strong>Impossible de charger le tableau de bord</strong>
        <p>{error}</p>
      </div>
    );

  const cur = data?.currency || 'MAD';
  const productCount = products.length || data?.productCount || 0;
  const lowList = (
    products.length
      ? products.filter(
          (p: any) =>
            Number(p.stock_quantity ?? p.stock ?? 0) <
            Number(p.low_stock_threshold ?? p.min_stock ?? 5)
        )
      : data?.lowStockProducts || []
  ).slice(0, 5);
  const lowCount = lowList.length || data?.lowStockCount || 0;
  const todayRev = data?.today_revenue ?? data?.todayRevenue ?? data?.salesToday ?? 0;
  const pendingActions = actions.filter((a) => a.status === 'pending').slice(0, 5);
  const name = getUsername();
  const incomeSum = filteredSeries.reduce((a, s) => a + s.income, 0);
  const expenseSum = filteredSeries.reduce((a, s) => a + s.expense, 0);

  return (
    <div className="atlas-page ac-dash">
      <header className="ac-dash-hero">
        <p className="ac-dash-eyebrow">{todayLabel()}</p>
        <div className="ac-dash-hero-row">
          <div>
            <h1 className="ac-dash-hello">Bonjour, {name}.</h1>
            <p className="ac-dash-lead">
              Surface de vente synchronisée — voici ce qui mérite votre attention.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="ac-metric-grid">
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label"><svg className="as-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/></svg>Produits</div>
          <div className="as-value">{productCount}</div>
          <div className="as-hint">valeur {fmt(Number(data?.stockValue ?? 0), cur)}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label"><svg className="as-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"><path d="M12 9v4"/><path d="M12 17h.01"/><path d="M10.3 4.3 2.6 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.7 3h15.4a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L13.7 4.3a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0z"/></svg>Stock bas</div>
          <div className="as-value">{lowCount}</div>
          <div className="as-hint">à vérifier en rayon</div>
        </div>
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label"><svg className="as-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"><path d="M4 4h16v12H4z"/><path d="M4 12l8 5 8-5"/></svg>À traiter</div>
          <div className="as-value">{pending}</div>
          <div className="as-hint">envois mobile</div>
        </div>
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label"><svg className="as-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"><path d="M12 2v20M17 5H9.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7H6"/></svg>Ventes du jour</div>
          <div className="as-value">{fmt(todayRev, cur)}</div>
          <div className="as-hint">toutes factures</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      
      <NextActionsPanel />
      <div className="ac-panel" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
        <div className="ac-panel-head">
<div>
            <h3><svg className="as-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" style={{marginRight:6,verticalAlign:'middle'}}><path d="M3 3v18h18"/><path d="M7 14l4-4 3 3 5-6"/></svg>Flux de trésorerie</h3>
            <p>Entrées, sorties et résultat par mois</p>
          </div>
          <select
            className="dash-range-select"
            value={preset}
            aria-label="Période du graphique"
            onChange={(e) => applyPreset(e.target.value)}
          >
            {preset === 'custom' && <option value="custom">Personnalisé</option>}
            {[
              ['7d', '7 jours'],
              ['1m', '1 mois'],
              ['6m', '6 mois'],
              ['12m', '1 an'],
              ['24m', '2 ans'],
              ['ytd', 'Cette année'],
            ].map(([k, lab]) => (
              <option key={k} value={k}>
                {lab}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="ac-chart-toolbar">
          <div className="dash-date-range" style={{ marginTop: 0, minWidth: 220, flex: '1 1 220px' }}>
            <DateRangePicker
              size="sm"
              from={range.from}
              to={range.to}
              showPresets
              onChange={(from, to) => {
                setPreset('custom');
                setRange({ from, to });
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="ac-stat-pair">
            <div>
              <span className="ac-stat-pair-lab">ENTRÉES</span>
              <strong>{fmt(incomeSum, cur)}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="ac-stat-pair-lab">SORTIES</span>
              <strong>{fmt(expenseSum, cur)}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <AreaChart
          series={filteredSeries}
          keys={[
            { key: 'income', label: 'Entrées', color: '#2563eb' },
            { key: 'expense', label: 'Sorties', color: '#f59e0b' },
          ]}
          height={240}
        />

        <div style={{ marginTop: 18, borderTop: '1px solid #e8eaef', paddingTop: 14 }}>
          <h4 style={{ margin: '0 0 6px', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>Évolution du profit</h4>
          <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Résultat net mensuel sur la période sélectionnée</p>
          <AreaChart
            series={filteredSeries}
            keys={[{ key: 'profit', label: 'Profit', color: '#0ea5e9' }]}
            height={180}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      
      <div className="ac-panel" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
        <div className="ac-panel-head">
          <div>
            <h3>Ventes FA vs VR / vente rapide</h3>
            <p>Chiffre d’affaires factures vs tickets / VR sur la période</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <BarChart
          series={filteredSeries}
          keys={[
            { key: 'invoices_fa', color: '#2563eb', label: 'Factures (FA)' },
            { key: 'sales_vr', color: '#0369a1', label: 'VR / Quick sale' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="ac-panel" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
        <div className="ac-panel-head">
          <div>
            <h3>Achats fournisseurs & salaires</h3>
            <p>Factures d’achat (bills) et masse salariale débitée du solde</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <BarChart
          series={filteredSeries}
          keys={[
            { key: 'bills', color: '#b45309', label: 'Achats (bills)' },
            { key: 'salaries', color: '#52525b', label: 'Salaires' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="ac-panel" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
        <div className="ac-panel-head">
          <div>
            <h3>Encaissements & nouveaux clients</h3>
            <p>Recettes encaissées et clients créés par mois</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <BarChart
          series={filteredSeries}
          keys={[
            { key: 'receipts', color: '#525252', label: 'Encaissements' },
            { key: 'clients_new', color: '#a3a3a3', label: 'Nouveaux clients' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>

      {(Array.isArray(data?.expenseCategories) || Array.isArray(data?.expenseByCategory) || Array.isArray(data?.expenseCats)) && (
        <div className="ac-panel" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
          <div className="ac-panel-head">
            <div>
              <h3>Répartition des charges</h3>
              <p>Top catégories de dépenses (hors achats fournisseurs)</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <HBarChart
            color="#b45309"
            items={(data.expenseCategories || data.expenseByCategory || data.expenseCats || []).map((c: any) => ({
              label: String(c.category || c.name || c.label || 'Autre'),
              value: Number(c.total || c.value || c.amount || 0),
            }))}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="ac-metric-grid" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label"><svg className="as-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"><rect x="2" y="6" width="20" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M2 10h20"/></svg>Solde actuel</div>
          <div className="as-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.35rem' }}>
            {fmt(data?.balance ?? data?.cashBalance, cur)}
          </div>
          <div className="as-hint">caisse &amp; banque</div>

/**
 * Desktop — page de téléchargement de l'application bureau (v0.7.3).
 *
 * Même gabarit standalone que /download (classes `dl-*`, responsive, thèmes) :
 * releases lues depuis GitHub Releases du dépôt atlas-commerce-desktop
 * (Windows .msi/.exe, macOS .dmg, Linux .AppImage), détection de l'OS du
 * visiteur pour le bouton principal, notes de version et historique.
 * Ni topbar, ni cookie, ni session : lecture libre, connecté ou non.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { PublicNav, PublicSessionCta, GitHubStarButton } from '../components/PublicChrome';
import { APP_BUILD_DATE, APP_GITHUB, APP_NAME } from '../version';

const GH_RELEASES = 'https://api.github.com/repos/Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-desktop/releases?per_page=50';
const DESKTOP_REPO = 'https://github.com/Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-desktop';

type GhAsset = { name?: string; browser_download_url?: string };
type GhRelease = {
  tag_name?: string;
  name?: string;
  body?: string;
  published_at?: string;
  html_url?: string;
  assets?: GhAsset[];
};

type OsKey = 'windows' | 'macos' | 'linux';

function detectOs(): OsKey {
  const ua = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.userAgent || '' : '';
  if (/mac os x|macintosh|iphone|ipad/i.test(ua)) return 'macos';
  if (/linux|android/i.test(ua)) return 'linux';
  return 'windows';
}

function osAsset(release: GhRelease | null, os: OsKey): GhAsset | null {
  const assets = release?.assets || [];
  const has = (re: RegExp) => assets.find((a) => re.test(String(a.name || ''))) || null;
  if (os === 'windows') {
    // .msi d'abord (installateur entreprise), puis setup.exe x86_64.
    return (
      has(/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc\.msi$/i) ||
      has(/-pc-windows-msvc\.msi$/i) ||
      has(/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-setup\.exe$/i) ||
      has(/setup\.exe$/i)
    );
  }
  if (os === 'macos') return has(/macos.*\.dmg$/i) || has(/\.dmg$/i);
  return has(/x86_64\.AppImage$/i) || has(/\.AppImage$/i);
}

const OS_LABEL: Record<OsKey, string> = {
  windows: 'Windows',
  macos: 'macOS',
  linux: 'Linux',
};

const FEATURES: { title: string; text: string }[] = [
  { title: 'Sensation native', text: 'Fenêtre dédiée, raccourcis clavier, impression système et notifications du poste — comme une app métier classique.' },
  { title: 'Même compte, mêmes données', text: 'Connexion OTP / QR identique au web : le bureau retrouve dépôts, caisse, factures et rapports à l’ouverture.' },
  { title: 'Trois systèmes', text: 'Installateurs Windows (.msi / .exe), image macOS universelle (.dmg) et AppImage Linux (x86_64 & aarch64).' },
  { title: 'Mises à jour via Releases', text: 'Les binaires sont publiés par GitHub Actions sur GitHub Releases — aucun store, aucune télémétrie.' },
  { title: 'Pensé pour le comptoir', text: 'Caisse rapide au clavier, douchette code-barres USB et ticket thermique branché au poste.' },
  { title: 'Open source MIT', text: 'Code public (Rust / Tauri) : forkez, auditez, empaquetez pour votre distribution.' },
];

/* ── Mini-rendu Markdown sûr : escape HTML d'abord, puis titres, listes,
      gras, italiques, code inline et liens http(s) uniquement. ── */
function escMd(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}
function inlineMd(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>')
    .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
    .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>')
    .replace(
      /\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:\/\/[^)\s]+)\)/g,
      '<a href="$2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">$1</a>',
    );
}
function mdToHtml(src: string): string {
  const out: string[] = [];
  let inUl = false;
  const closeUl = () => {
    if (inUl) {
      out.push('</ul>');
      inUl = false;
    }
  };
  for (const raw of escMd(src).split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const line = raw.trimEnd();
    if (!line.trim()) {
      closeUl();
      continue;
    }
    const h = line.match(/^(#{1,4})\s+(.*)$/);
    if (h) {
      closeUl();
      out.push(`<h${h[1].length + 2}>${inlineMd(h[2])}</h${h[1].length + 2}>`);
      continue;
    }
    const li = line.match(/^[-*]\s+(.*)$/);
    if (li) {
      if (!inUl) {
        out.push('<ul>');
        inUl = true;
      }
      out.push(`<li>${inlineMd(li[1])}</li>`);
      continue;
    }
    closeUl();
    out.push(`<p>${inlineMd(line)}</p>`);
  }
  closeUl();
  return out.join('');
}

export default function Desktop() {
  const [rels, setRels] = useState<GhRelease[]>([]);
  const [state, setState] = useState<'load' | 'ok' | 'error'>('load');
  const [os, setOs] = useState<OsKey>('windows');

  useEffect(() => {
    setOs(detectOs());
  }, []);

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    setState('load');
    fetch(GH_RELEASES, { cache: 'no-store', headers: { Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json' } })
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(new Error(String(r.status)))))
      .then((j: any) => {
        if (!Array.isArray(j) || j.length === 0) throw new Error('empty');
        setRels(j as GhRelease[]);
        setState('ok');
      })
      .catch(() => setState('error'));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const prevTitle = document.title;
    document.title = `${APP_NAME} pour bureau — Windows, macOS & Linux`;
    const upsert = (attr: 'name' | 'property', key: string, content: string) => {
      let el = document.head.querySelector<HTMLMetaElement>(`meta[${attr}="${key}"]`);
      if (!el) {
        el = document.createElement('meta');
        el.setAttribute(attr, key);
        document.head.appendChild(el);
      }
      el.setAttribute('content', content);
      return el;
    };
    const metas = [
      upsert('name', 'description', `${APP_NAME} version bureau : installateurs Windows, macOS et Linux publiés sur GitHub Releases. Même compte, mêmes données que le web.`),
      upsert('property', 'og:type', 'website'),
      upsert('property', 'og:title', `${APP_NAME} pour bureau — Windows, macOS & Linux`),
      upsert('property', 'og:description', 'Application bureau native : caisse au clavier, douchette USB, impression système. Releases officielles GitHub.'),
      upsert('property', 'og:url', 'https://stock.afmarbre.com/desktop'),
      upsert('property', 'og:image', 'https://stock.afmarbre.com/atlas-logo-dark.png'),
    ];
    return () => {
      document.title = prevTitle;
      metas.forEach((el) => el.remove());
    };
  }, []);

  const latest = rels[0] || null;
  const relBody = String(latest?.body || '').trim();
  const relTitle = latest?.name || latest?.tag_name || 'Atlas Commerce Desktop';
  const relDate = latest?.published_at ? String(latest.published_at).slice(0, 10) : APP_BUILD_DATE;
  const mainAsset = osAsset(latest, os);
  const otherOs = (['windows', 'macos', 'linux'] as OsKey[]).filter((k) => k !== os);

  return (
    <div className="download-landing desktop-landing">
      <PublicNav
        links={[
          { href: '/', label: 'Accueil' },
          { href: '/android', label: 'Android' },
          { href: '#assets', label: 'Téléchargements' },
          { href: '/whats-new', label: 'Nouveautés' },
          { href: '/privacy', label: 'Confidentialité' },
          { href: '/about', label: 'À propos' },
        ]}
        cta={<PublicSessionCta />}
        classic
      />

      <section className="dl-hero">
        <div className="dl-hero-bg" aria-hidden />
        <div className="dl-hero-grid" aria-hidden />
        <div className="dl-container">
          <div className="dl-hero-content">
            <p className="dl-eyebrow">Application bureau officielle</p>
            <h1 className="dl-h1">
              Atlas Commerce
              <br />
              <span className="dl-h1-soft">sur votre ordinateur.</span>
            </h1>
            <p className="dl-desc">
              La version bureau d&apos;{APP_NAME} : une fenêtre native pour tenir la caisse au clavier,
              imprimer sur votre imprimante système et garder l&apos;ERP ouvert toute la journée —
              Windows, macOS et Linux.
            </p>
            <div className="dl-ctas">
              {state === 'ok' && mainAsset ? (
                <a className="dl-cta-main" href={String(mainAsset.browser_download_url)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                  Télécharger pour {OS_LABEL[os]}
                </a>
              ) : state === 'error' ? (
                <span className="dl-cta-main dl-cta-wait" aria-disabled="true">Releases injoignables</span>
              ) : (
                <span className="dl-cta-main dl-cta-wait" aria-disabled="true">Chargement…</span>
              )}
              {otherOs.map((k) => {
                const a = osAsset(latest, k);
                return a ? (
                  <a key={k} className="dl-cta-ghost" href={String(a.browser_download_url)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                    {OS_LABEL[k]}
                  </a>
                ) : null;
              })}
              <a className="dl-cta-ghost" href={DESKTOP_REPO} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                Dépôt & code source
              </a>
              <GitHubStarButton repo="Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-desktop" />
            </div>
            <p className="dl-note">
              <span className="dl-note-dot" aria-hidden />
              Binaires signés et publiés automatiquement par GitHub Actions — téléchargez-les uniquement
              depuis cette page ou le dépôt officiel.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="dl-band">
        <div className="dl-container">
          <div className="dl-stats" aria-label="Informations de version">
            <div className="dl-stat">
              <strong>{latest?.tag_name || '…'}</strong>
              <span>Version</span>
            </div>
            <div className="dl-stat">
              <strong>{relDate}</strong>
              <span>Publiée le</span>
            </div>
            <div className="dl-stat">
              <strong>{latest?.assets?.length || 0}</strong>
              <span>Fichiers</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <h2 className="dl-sec-title">Pensée pour le comptoir</h2>
          <p className="dl-sec-sub">Une app de poste fixe, rapide et sobre, branchée sur votre compte Atlas.</p>
          <div className="dl-feats">

                      : /\.dmg$/i.test(String(a.name || ''))
                        ? 'macOS'
                        : /AppImage|linux/i.test(String(a.name || ''))

                          : '—'}
                  </span>
                  <a href={String(a.browser_download_url)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Télécharger</a>
                </div>
              ))}
            {(latest?.assets || []).length === 0 && (

            )}
          </div>

          <h2 className="dl-sec-title" style={{ marginTop: 56 }}>Notes de version</h2>
          <p className="dl-sec-sub">Dernière publication du dépôt bureau sur GitHub Releases.</p>

            )}
            {latest?.html_url ? (
              <a className="dl-release-link" href={latest.html_url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">

            ) : null}
          </div>

          <h2 className="dl-sec-title" id="assets" style={{ marginTop: 56 }}>Toutes les versions</h2>

          <div className="dl-rel-list">
            {rels.map((r, i) => (

const ANDROID_REPO = 'https://github.com/Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android';

  apkUrl?: string;
  buildDate?: string;
  notes?: string;
  mandatory?: boolean;
};

};

  { title: 'Factures & PDF', text: 'Factures, devis, reçus et avoirs en PDF prêts à imprimer, avec QR de vérification.' },
  { title: 'Stock & caisse', text: 'Entrées/sorties, stock bas, ventes du jour et trésorerie suivis en temps réel.' },
  { title: 'Notifications & mises à jour', text: 'Mises à jour applicatives servies par CDN, avec plancher de version piloté depuis le web.' },

/* ── Mini-rendu Markdown sûr : escape HTML d'abord, puis titres, listes,
      gras, italique, code inline et liens http(s) uniquement. ── */
function escMd(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}
function inlineMd(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>')
    .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
    .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>')
    .replace(
      /\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:\/\/[^)\s]+)\)/g,
      '<a href="$2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">$1</a>',
    );
}
function mdToHtml(src: string): string {
  const out: string[] = [];
  let inUl = false;
  const closeUl = () => { if (inUl) { out.push('</ul>'); inUl = false; } };
  for (const raw of escMd(src).split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const t = raw.trim();
    if (!t) { closeUl(); continue; }
    const bullet = t.match(/^[-*•]\s+(.*)$/);
    if (bullet) {
      if (!inUl) { out.push('<ul>'); inUl = true; }
      out.push(`<li>${inlineMd(bullet[1])}</li>`);
      continue;
    }
    closeUl();
    const h = t.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$/);
    if (h) {
      const lvl = Math.min(h[1].length + 2, 6);
      out.push(`<h${lvl}>${inlineMd(h[2])}</h${lvl}>`);
      continue;
    }
    out.push(`<p>${inlineMd(t)}</p>`);
  }
  closeUl();
  return out.join('');
}

/**
 * /verify — one-tap e-mail verification (OTP deep link).
 *
 * The OTP e-mail button lands here with ?user&code&sig&exp. The page:
 *  1. detects the environment: installed PWA (standalone display-mode),
 *     native Android app (via an `atlascommerce://verify` intent handoff —
 *     the Kotlin app verifies the link itself and falls back to this page
 *     when not installed), or plain browser;
 *  2. submits the signed link to POST /api/auth/verify-link — the user never
 *     types the code;
 *  3. stores the session exactly like the login page and opens the app.
 *
 * Visual language mirrors the e-mail template — which follows the server
 * theme (dark zinc canvas, terracotta action, saffron accents) — so the tap
 * feels continuous.
 */
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { setToken, setProfileCache } from '../auth';
import { getApiBase } from '../config';
import { getCachedFingerprint } from '../fingerprint';

type Status = 'detect' | 'verifying' | 'ok' | 'error';

const ORANGE = '#c45c26'; /* terracotta Atlas */
const SALMON = '#d4a017'; /* saffron Atlas */
const CANVAS = '#09090b'; /* zinc-950 — thème serveur */
const CARD = '#18181b'; /* zinc-900 */
const LINE = '#27272a'; /* zinc-800 */
const INK = '#fafafa'; /* zinc-50 */
const GREY = '#a1a1aa'; /* zinc-400 */

export default function EmailVerify() {
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const user = params.get('user') || '';
  const code = params.get('code') || '';
  const sig = params.get('sig') || '';
  const exp = params.get('exp') || '';

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>('detect');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [env, setEnv] = useState<{ pwa: boolean; android: boolean; handedOff: boolean }>({
    pwa: false,
    android: false,
    handedOff: false,
  });
  const started = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (started.current) return;
    started.current = true;

    const pwa =
      window.matchMedia?.('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
      (navigator as unknown as { standalone?: boolean }).standalone === true;
    const android = /android/i.test(navigator.userAgent || '');
    setEnv({ pwa, android, handedOff: false });

    const run = async () => {
      // Native handoff (Android browsers only, once per tab): if the Kotlin
      // app is installed it opens straight on its verification screen; if
      // not, Chrome reloads this very URL as the fallback and we continue
      // in the web/PWA path (the sessionStorage flag prevents a loop).
      if (android && !pwa && !sessionStorage.getItem('verify-handoff-tried')) {
        sessionStorage.setItem('verify-handoff-tried', '1');
        const fallback = encodeURIComponent(window.location.href);
        const intent =
          `intent://verify?user=${encodeURIComponent(user)}&code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}` +
          `&sig=${encodeURIComponent(sig)}&exp=${encodeURIComponent(exp)}` +
          `#Intent;scheme=atlascommerce;package=ma.etherealmber.atlascommerce;` +
          `S.browser_fallback_url=${fallback};end`;
        setEnv((e) => ({ ...e, handedOff: true }));
        window.location.replace(intent);
        // If the intent did not navigate (app absent → fallback reloads),
        // the line below resumes the web verification on the reloaded page.
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200));
      }
      setStatus('verifying');
      try {
        const fp = await Promise.race([
          getCachedFingerprint().catch(() => 'none'),
          new Promise<string>((r) => setTimeout(() => r('none'), 8000)),
        ]);
        const res = await fetch(`${getApiBase()}/api/auth/verify-link`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Device-Fingerprint': fp },
          body: JSON.stringify({ username: user, otp: code, sig, exp: Number(exp), fingerprint: fp }),
        });
        const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, any>;
        if (!res.ok || !data.token) {
          setError(
            data.code === 'LINK_EXPIRED' || data.code === 'OTP_EXPIRED'
              ? 'Ce lien a expiré (10 minutes). Relancez une connexion pour recevoir un nouveau code.'
              : data.code === 'BAD_OTP'
                ? 'Ce code a déjà été utilisé ou est invalide.'
                : data.error || 'Vérification impossible sur cet appareil.',
          );
          setStatus('error');
          return;
        }
        setToken(data.token, data.ip, String(data.username || user).toLowerCase(), data.role || 'user');
        setProfileCache({
          display_name: data.display_name ?? null,
          avatar_url: data.avatar_url ?? null,
          username: data.username,
          role: data.role,
        });
        setStatus('ok');
        window.setTimeout(() => navigate('/dashboard', { replace: true }), 1400);
      } catch {
        setError('Erreur réseau. Vérifiez votre connexion puis rouvrez le lien du mail.');
        setStatus('error');
      }
    };
    void run();
  }, [user, code, sig, exp, navigate]);

  const chip = (on: boolean, label: string) =>
    on ? (
      <span
        style={{
          display: 'inline-block',
          margin: '3px 4px',
          padding: '5px 12px',
          borderRadius: 999,
          background: CARD,
          border: `1px solid ${LINE}`,
          fontSize: 12,
          fontWeight: 600,
          color: '#e4e4e7',
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </span>
    ) : null;

  return (
    <div style={{ minHeight: '100vh', background: CANVAS, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', padding: 22 }}>
      <div style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 460, textAlign: 'center' }}>
        <img src="/atlas-logo-dark.png" alt="Atlas" style={{ display: 'block', height: 42, width: 'auto', maxWidth: '100%', margin: '0 auto' }} />
        <div style={{ height: 26 }} />
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: 2, color: SALMON, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
          Vérification de l’appareil
        </div>
        <h1 style={{ margin: '12px 0 0', fontSize: 28, lineHeight: 1.2, fontWeight: 800, color: INK }}>
          {status === 'ok' ? (
            <>
              Appareil vérifié <em style={{ fontFamily: "Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif", fontStyle: 'italic', fontWeight: 600, color: SALMON }}>✓</em>
            </>
          ) : status === 'error' ? (
            <>
              Vérification <em style={{ fontFamily: "Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif", fontStyle: 'italic', fontWeight: 600, color: SALMON }}>interrompue</em>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              Un instant, nous sécurisons votre <em style={{ fontFamily: "Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif", fontStyle: 'italic', fontWeight: 600, color: SALMON }}>compte</em>
            </>
          )}
        </h1>
        <p style={{ margin: '14px auto 0', maxWidth: 380, fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1.65, color: GREY }}>
          {status === 'ok'
            ? 'Session ouverte sur cet appareil. Ouverture de l’application…'
            : status === 'error'
              ? error
              : 'Le code du mail est transmis automatiquement — rien à saisir.'}
        </p>

        <div style={{ margin: '24px 0 0', background: CARD, border: `1px solid ${LINE}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: '22px 16px' }}>
          {status === 'ok' ? (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 34, fontWeight: 800, color: '#16a34a' }}>✓</div>
          ) : status === 'error' ? (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 800, color: '#dc2626' }}>!</div>
          ) : (
            <div
              aria-label="vérification en cours"
              style={{
                width: 34,
                height: 34,
                margin: '0 auto',
                borderRadius: '50%',
                border: `3px solid ${LINE}`,
                borderTopColor: ORANGE,
                animation: 'emailverify-spin 0.9s linear infinite',
              }}
            />
          )}
          <style>{'@keyframes emailverify-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}'}</style>
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          {chip(env.pwa, 'App PWA installée')}
          {chip(env.android && !env.pwa, 'Android')}
          {chip(env.handedOff, 'Ouverture de l’app native tentée')}
          {!env.pwa && !env.android ? chip(true, 'Navigateur') : null}
        </div>

        {status === 'error' && (
          <div style={{ marginTop: 22 }}>
            <Link
              to={`/login?user=${encodeURIComponent(user)}&hint=otp`}
              style={{
                display: 'block',
                background: ORANGE,
                borderRadius: 10,
                padding: '15px 12px',
                color: '#fff',
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: 800,
                letterSpacing: 1.2,
                textTransform: 'uppercase',
                textDecoration: 'none',
              }}
            >
              Saisir le code manuellement
            </Link>
          </div>
        )}
        <p style={{ margin: '22px auto 0', maxWidth: 360, fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.6, color: '#71717a' }}>
          Vous n’êtes pas à l’origine de cette demande ? Fermez cette page et changez votre mot de passe.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const HOME_DARK = '/shots/dashboard-dark.png';

/** Fond animé du hero (particules lumineuses dérivantes, façon Liner).
 * Respecte prefers-reduced-motion : une seule image fixe est alors peinte. */
function HeroCanvas() {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const cv = ref.current;
    if (!cv) return;
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    let raf = 0;
    let w = 0;
    let h = 0;
    const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    const dots = Array.from({ length: 46 }, () => ({
      x: Math.random(),
      y: Math.random(),
      r: 0.8 + Math.random() * 2.1,
      p: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      v: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.8,
    }));
    const resize = () => {
      const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
      w = cv.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(r.width * dpr));
      h = cv.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(r.height * dpr));
    };
    const draw = (t: number) => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      for (const d of dots) {
        const x = (d.x + Math.sin(t * 0.00006 * d.v + d.p) * 0.03) * w;
        const y = (d.y + Math.cos(t * 0.00005 * d.v + d.p) * 0.045) * h;
        const rad = d.r * 7 * dpr;
        const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, rad);
        g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(228, 113, 58, .38)');
        g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(228, 113, 58, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, y, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    };
    const loop = (t: number) => {
      draw(t);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    const reduce =
      typeof window.matchMedia === 'function' &&
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    if (reduce) draw(1200);
    else raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    const onVis = () => {
      if (document.hidden) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
        raf = 0;
      } else if (!reduce && !raf) {
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
    };
  }, []);
  return <canvas ref={ref} className="hm-canvas" aria-hidden="true" />;
}

/** Révélation douce au scroll (IntersectionObserver, une seule fois). */
function useRiseObserver() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const en of entries) {
          if (en.isIntersecting) {
            (en.target as HTMLElement).classList.add('is-in');
            io.unobserve(en.target);
          }
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.12 },
    );
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => {
      document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.home-landing .rise').forEach((el) => io.observe(el));
    }, 60);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(t);
      io.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import SaveFeedback from '../components/SaveFeedback';

type PreviewRow = {
  date: string;
  description: string;
  amount: number;
  entry_type: 'income' | 'expense' | 'owner_draw' | 'owner_contrib';
  category: string;
  payment_method: string;
  selected: boolean;
};

type BillPreview = {
  vendor_name: string;
  number: string;
  issue_date: string;
  total: number;
  description: string;
  selected: boolean;
};

type ClientPreview = {
  row: number;
  name: string;
  ice: string;
  if_number: string;
  address: string;
  city: string;
  phone: string;
  email: string;
  valid: boolean;
  warning?: boolean;
  errors: string[];
  duplicate: null | { id: number; name: string; ice?: string; email?: string; match_on: string };
  action: 'create' | 'update' | 'skip';
  selected: boolean;
};

const CLIENT_FIELDS = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Nom *', aliases: ['name', 'nom', 'raison', 'client', 'company', 'societe', 'société'] },
  { key: 'ice', label: 'ICE', aliases: ['ice', 'identifiant commun'] },
  { key: 'if_number', label: 'IF', aliases: ['if', 'if_number', 'identifiant fiscal', 'idf'] },
  { key: 'address', label: 'Adresse', aliases: ['address', 'adresse', 'addr'] },
  { key: 'city', label: 'Ville', aliases: ['city', 'ville'] },
  { key: 'phone', label: 'Téléphone', aliases: ['phone', 'tel', 'téléphone', 'telephone', 'mobile'] },
  { key: 'email', label: 'E-mail', aliases: ['email', 'mail', 'e-mail', 'courriel'] },
] as const;

function parseCsv(text: string): string[][] {
  const lines = text.replace(/\r/g, '').split('\n').filter((l) => l.trim());
  return lines.map((line) => {
    const cells: string[] = [];
    let cur = '';
    let inQ = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
      const ch = line[i];
      if (ch === '"') { inQ = !inQ; continue; }
      if ((ch === ',' || ch === ';' || ch === '\t') && !inQ) { cells.push(cur.trim()); cur = ''; continue; }
      cur += ch;
    }
    cells.push(cur.trim());
    return cells;
  });
}

function autoMapHeaders(header: string[]): Record<string, number> {
  const h = header.map((x) => x.toLowerCase().trim());
  const map: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const f of CLIENT_FIELDS) {
    let idx = -1;
    for (const alias of f.aliases) {
      idx = h.findIndex((cell) => cell === alias || cell.includes(alias));
      if (idx >= 0) break;
    }
    map[f.key] = idx;
  }
  return map;
}

function mapLedgerRows(table: string[][]): PreviewRow[] {
  if (!table.length) return [];
  const header = table[0].map((h) => h.toLowerCase());
  const find = (...keys: string[]) => {
    for (const k of keys) {
      const i = header.findIndex((h) => h.includes(k));
      if (i >= 0) return i;
    }
    return -1;
  };
  const iDate = find('date', 'تاريخ', 'التاريخ');
  const iDesc = find('desc', 'libell', 'info', 'معلومات', 'label', 'designation');
  const iOut = find('sortie', 'خروج', 'out', 'debit');
  const iIn = find('entrée', 'entree', 'دخول', 'in', 'credit');
  const iAmt = find('montant', 'amount', 'prix');
  const rows: PreviewRow[] = [];
  for (const cells of table.slice(1)) {
    if (cells.every((c) => !c)) continue;
    const date = (iDate >= 0 ? cells[iDate] : '') || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const description = (iDesc >= 0 ? cells[iDesc] : cells[0]) || 'Import';
    const outV = iOut >= 0 ? Number(String(cells[iOut]).replace(/[^\d.-]/g, '')) : 0;
    const inV = iIn >= 0 ? Number(String(cells[iIn]).replace(/[^\d.-]/g, '')) : 0;
    let amount = iAmt >= 0 ? Number(String(cells[iAmt]).replace(/[^\d.-]/g, '')) : 0;
    let entry_type: PreviewRow['entry_type'] = 'expense';
    if (inV > 0) { amount = inV; entry_type = 'income'; }
    else if (outV > 0) { amount = outV; entry_type = 'expense'; }
    if (!amount || amount <= 0) continue;
    rows.push({
      date: String(date).slice(0, 10),
      description,
      amount,
      entry_type,
      category: entry_type === 'income' ? 'Import recette' : 'Import dépense',
      payment_method: 'cash',
      selected: true,
    });
  }
  return rows;
}

export default function ImportData() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'ledger' | 'bills' | 'clients'>('clients');
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<PreviewRow[]>([]);
  const [billPreview, setBillPreview] = useState<BillPreview[]>([]);
  const [clientPreview, setClientPreview] = useState<ClientPreview[]>([]);
  const [clientStats, setClientStats] = useState<any>(null);
  const [rawHeaders, setRawHeaders] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [columnMap, setColumnMap] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [rawTable, setRawTable] = useState<string[][]>([]);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveMsg, setSaveMsg] = useState('');
  const [saveMsgType, setSaveMsgType] = useState<'success' | 'error'>('success');

  const flash = (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setSaveMsg(msg); setSaveMsgType(type);
    setTimeout(() => setSaveMsg(''), 5000);
  };

  const onFile = async (file: File | null) => {
    if (!file) return;
    const text = await file.text();
    const table = parseCsv(text);
    if (table.length < 2) { flash('Fichier vide ou sans données.', 'error'); return; }
    setRawTable(table);

    if (mode === 'ledger') {
      const rows = mapLedgerRows(table);
      setPreview(rows); setBillPreview([]); setClientPreview([]);
      flash(rows.length ? `${rows.length} ligne(s) solde à valider` : 'Aucune ligne reconnue', rows.length ? 'success' : 'error');
    } else if (mode === 'bills') {
      const header = table[0].map((h) => h.toLowerCase());
      const idx = (keys: string[]) => {
        for (const k of keys) {
          const i = header.findIndex((h) => h.includes(k));
          if (i >= 0) return i;
        }
        return -1;
      };
      const iVen = idx(['vendor', 'fournisseur', 'supplier', 'nom']);
      const iNum = idx(['number', 'numero', 'n°', 'ref']);
      const iDate = idx(['date']);
      const iTot = idx(['total', 'montant', 'amount']);
      const iDesc = idx(['desc', 'libell', 'designation']);
      const rows: BillPreview[] = [];
      for (const cells of table.slice(1)) {
        const total = Number(String(cells[iTot >= 0 ? iTot : cells.length - 1] || '').replace(/[^\d.-]/g, ''));
        if (!total) continue;
        rows.push({
          vendor_name: cells[iVen >= 0 ? iVen : 0] || 'Fournisseur',
          number: cells[iNum >= 0 ? iNum : 1] || '',
          issue_date: String(cells[iDate >= 0 ? iDate : 2] || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)).slice(0, 10),
          total,
          description: cells[iDesc >= 0 ? iDesc : 0] || 'Import facture fournisseur',
          selected: true,
        });
      }
      setBillPreview(rows); setPreview([]); setClientPreview([]);
      flash(rows.length ? `${rows.length} facture(s) fournisseur à valider` : 'Aucune ligne', rows.length ? 'success' : 'error');
    } else {
      const headers = table[0];
      setRawHeaders(headers);
      setColumnMap(autoMapHeaders(headers));
      setPreview([]); setBillPreview([]); setClientPreview([]); setClientStats(null);
      flash('Fichier chargé. Vérifiez le mapping des colonnes puis lancez l\'analyse.', 'success');
    }
  };

  const buildClientRowsFromMap = (): any[] => {
    if (!rawTable.length) return [];
    return rawTable.slice(1).map((cells) => {
      const get = (key: string) => {
        const i = columnMap[key];
        return i >= 0 && i < cells.length ? cells[i] : '';
      };
      return {
        name: get('name'), ice: get('ice'), if_number: get('if_number'),
        address: get('address'), city: get('city'), phone: get('phone'), email: get('email'),
      };
    }).filter((r) => Object.values(r).some((v) => String(v).trim()));
  };

  const analyzeClients = async () => {
    const rows = buildClientRowsFromMap();
    if (!rows.length) { flash('Aucune ligne à analyser. Vérifiez le mapping (colonne Nom).', 'error'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.importClientsPreview(rows);
      const list = (res.data.rows || []).map((r: any) => ({
        ...r, selected: r.valid, action: r.duplicate ? 'skip' : 'create',
      }));
      setClientPreview(list);
      setClientStats(res.data.stats);
      flash(`Analyse : ${res.data.stats.valid} valide(s), ${res.data.stats.duplicates} doublon(s), ${res.data.stats.invalid} invalide(s).`);
    } catch (e: any) { flash(e.message || 'Erreur analyse', 'error'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const importLedger = async () => {
    const rows = preview.filter((r) => r.selected);
    if (!rows.length) { flash('Aucune ligne sélectionnée', 'error'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res: any = await api.importExpenses(rows.map((r) => ({
        date: r.date, description: r.description, amount: r.amount,
        entry_type: r.entry_type, category: r.category, payment_method: r.payment_method,
      })));
      flash(res.message || 'Import terminé'); setPreview([]);
    } catch (e: any) { flash(e.message || 'Erreur import', 'error'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const importBills = async () => {
    const rows = billPreview.filter((r) => r.selected);
    if (!rows.length) { flash('Aucune ligne sélectionnée', 'error'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    let ok = 0;
    try {
      for (const r of rows) {
        await api.createBill({
          vendor_name: r.vendor_name, number: r.number || undefined, issue_date: r.issue_date,
          status: 'sent', notes: 'Import CSV',
          items: [{ product_name: r.description, quantity: 1, unit_cost: r.total, tax_rate: 0 }],
        });
        ok++;
      }
      flash(`${ok} facture(s) d'achat créée(s).`); setBillPreview([]);
    } catch (e: any) { flash(e.message || `Import partiel (${ok})`, 'error'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const importClients = async () => {
    const rows = clientPreview.filter((r) => r.selected && r.valid);
    if (!rows.length) { flash('Aucune ligne valide sélectionnée.', 'error'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload = rows.map((r) => ({
        name: r.name, ice: r.ice, if_number: r.if_number, address: r.address,
        city: r.city, phone: r.phone, email: r.email, action: r.action, duplicate_id: r.duplicate?.id,
      }));
      const res: any = await api.importClients(payload);
      flash(res.message || 'Import clients terminé.');
      setClientPreview([]); setClientStats(null); setRawTable([]); setRawHeaders([]);
    } catch (e: any) { flash(e.message || 'Erreur import clients', 'error'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const setAllClientActions = (action: 'create' | 'update' | 'skip') => {
    setClientPreview((list) => list.map((r) => {
      if (!r.duplicate && action === 'update') return r;
      if (!r.duplicate && action === 'skip') return { ...r, action: 'create' };
      return { ...r, action: r.duplicate ? action : r.action };
    }));
  };

  const fmt = (n: number) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString('fr-FR');

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="page-header"><h1>Import de données</h1></div>
      <SaveFeedback message={saveMsg} type={saveMsgType} />

      <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 12, lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
