import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { clearToken, getToken, isLoggedIn } from '../auth';
import { getCachedFingerprint } from '../fingerprint';
import {
  clearDesktopApproval, DesktopApprovalError, desktopBrowserPost, loadDesktopApproval,
  parseDesktopApproval, saveDesktopApproval, type DesktopConsent,
} from '../lib/desktopApproval';
import '../styles/login-auth.css';

/** Loading this page only prepares consent. Only a user click can authorize. */
export default function LoginDesktop() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [context] = useState(() => {
    if (window.location.search) { clearDesktopApproval(); return null; }
    if (!window.location.hash) return loadDesktopApproval();
    const parsed = parseDesktopApproval(window.location.hash, window.location.origin);
    clearDesktopApproval();
    if (!parsed || !saveDesktopApproval(parsed)) return null;
    window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/login/desktop');
    return parsed;
  });
  const [consent, setConsent] = useState<DesktopConsent | null>(null);
  const [compared, setCompared] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState(context ? 'Vérification de la demande…' : 'Demande invalide ou expirée. Recommencez depuis le desktop.');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!context) return;
    let stopped = false;
    if (!isLoggedIn()) { navigate('/login', { replace: true }); return; }
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const fp = await getCachedFingerprint();
        if (stopped) return;
        if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{16,128}$/.test(fp)) throw new DesktopApprovalError('DEVICE_REQUIRED');
        const result = await desktopBrowserPost<DesktopConsent>('prepare', context, getToken() || '', fp);
        if (stopped) return;
        if (result.request_id !== context.request_id || result.origin !== context.origin) throw new DesktopApprovalError('INVALID_PROOF');
        setConsent(result);
        setMessage('Cette action connectera le desktop à votre compte.');
        saveDesktopApproval({ ...context, expiresAt: Math.min(context.expiresAt, Date.parse(result.expires_at)) });
      } catch (e) {
        if (stopped) return;
        if (e instanceof DesktopApprovalError && ['UNAUTHORIZED', 'IP_CHANGED', 'DEVICE_CHANGED', 'DEVICE_REVOKED'].includes(e.code)) {
          clearToken();
          navigate('/login', { replace: true });
          return;
        }
        setMessage(e instanceof DesktopApprovalError ? e.message : 'Connexion indisponible. Recommencez depuis le desktop.');
        clearDesktopApproval();
      }
    })();
    return () => { stopped = true; };
  }, [context, navigate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!consent || done) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setConsent(null);
      setMessage('Confirmation expirée. Recommencez depuis le desktop.');
      clearDesktopApproval();
    }, Math.max(0, Math.min(Date.parse(consent.expires_at), Date.parse(consent.consent_expires_at)) - Date.now()));
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [consent, done]);

  const decide = async (decision: 'approve' | 'deny') => {
    if (!context || !consent || busy || done || (decision === 'approve' && !compared)) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const fp = await getCachedFingerprint();
      await desktopBrowserPost('authorize', context, getToken() || '', fp, { csrf_token: consent.csrf_token, decision });
      setDone(true);
      setMessage(decision === 'approve' ? 'Desktop autorisé. Revenez dans l’application desktop pour terminer la connexion.' : 'Connexion refusée. Le desktop ne sera pas connecté.');
      clearDesktopApproval();
    } catch (e) {
      setMessage(e instanceof DesktopApprovalError ? e.message : 'Impossible de confirmer. Recommencez depuis le desktop.');
      setConsent(null);
      clearDesktopApproval();
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  return <main className="login-qr-page">
    <section className="login-qr-card" aria-labelledby="desktop-auth-title">
      <p className="login-qr-brand">Atlas Commerce</p>
      <h1 id="desktop-auth-title">Autoriser le desktop</h1>
      <p role="status" className="login-qr-msg">{message}</p>
      {consent && !done ? <>
        <p className="login-qr-account">Compte : <strong><bdi>{consent.username}</bdi></strong></p>
        <p>Serveur : <strong style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>{consent.origin}</strong></p>
        <p>Appareil : <strong><bdi>{consent.device_label}</bdi></strong> (nom déclaré par le client)</p>
        <p>Code à comparer : <strong>{consent.pairing_code}</strong></p>
        <p>Autorisez uniquement une demande que vous venez de lancer dans votre application desktop, sur ce serveur. N’acceptez jamais un code envoyé par une autre personne.</p>
        <label><input type="checkbox" checked={compared} disabled={busy} onChange={e => setCompared(e.target.checked)} /> Le même code apparaît dans mon application desktop.</label>
        <div className="login-qr-actions">
          <button type="button" className="login-qr-btn login-qr-btn--ok" disabled={!compared || busy} onClick={() => void decide('approve')}>Autoriser ce desktop</button>
          <button type="button" className="login-qr-btn login-qr-btn--no" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void decide('deny')}>Refuser</button>
        </div>
      </> : null}
      <p className="login-qr-hint">Aucun jeton de session n’est transmis dans un lien ou à un callback. Vous pouvez fermer cette page après votre décision.</p>
      {!consent && !done ? <Link to="/login" onClick={clearDesktopApproval}>Retour à la connexion</Link> : null}
    </section>
  </main>;
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api } from '../api';
import { setToken, setProfileCache, isLoggedIn, getToken, sanitizeAvatarUrl } from '../auth';
import { getCachedFingerprint } from '../fingerprint';
import '../styles/login-auth.css';

/**
 * Phone / mobile-web handler for QR codes.
 * - mode=pc: must be logged in → claim → Accept/Refuse → approve PC
 * - default (settings): phone claims → PC approves → phone receives token
 */
export default function LoginQr() {
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const token = (params.get('t') || '').trim();
  const mode = (params.get('mode') || '').trim();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'loading' | 'confirm' | 'ok' | 'wait' | 'err'>('loading');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('Traitement du QR…');
  const [account, setAccount] = useState('');
  const [avatarUrl, setAvatarUrl] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const done = useRef(false);
  const fpRef = useRef('none');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!token) {
      setStatus('err');
      setMsg('Lien QR invalide.');
      return;
    }
    let stopped = false;
    let timer: number | undefined;

    const run = async () => {
      try {
        const fp = (await getCachedFingerprint()) || 'none';
        fpRef.current = fp;

        // PC authorization: claim then wait for Accept on this phone (native or mobile web)
        if (mode === 'pc') {
          if (!isLoggedIn() || !getToken()) {
            setStatus('err');
            setMsg('Connectez-vous d’abord sur ce téléphone (app ou navigateur), puis rescannnez le QR du PC.');
            return;
          }
          const res = await api.qrPhoneBind(token, {
            fingerprint: fp,
            user_agent: navigator.userAgent,
            confirm: false,
          });
          if (stopped) return;
          setAccount(res.data?.display_name || res.data?.username || '');
          if (res.data?.avatar_url) setAvatarUrl(sanitizeAvatarUrl(String(res.data.avatar_url)));
          if (res.data?.needs_confirm || res.data?.status === 'claimed') {
            setStatus('confirm');
            setMsg('Autoriser la connexion de cet ordinateur avec votre compte ?');
            return;
          }
          // Already approved (legacy)
          setStatus('ok');
          setMsg(res.data?.message || 'Ordinateur autorisé. Revenez sur le PC.');
          return;
        }

        // Settings flow: phone logs in after PC approves
        await api.qrLoginClaim(token, {
          fingerprint: fp,
          user_agent: navigator.userAgent,
        });
        if (stopped) return;
        setStatus('wait');
        setMsg('Scanné — validez sur l’ordinateur (Accepter).');

        const poll = async () => {
          if (stopped || done.current) return;
          try {
            const st = await api.qrLoginStatus(token);
            const s = st.data?.status || '';
            if (st.data?.display_name || st.data?.username) {
              setAccount(String(st.data.display_name || st.data.username));
            }
            if (st.data?.avatar_url) setAvatarUrl(sanitizeAvatarUrl(String(st.data.avatar_url)));
            if (s === 'denied' || s === 'expired') {
              setStatus('err');
              setMsg(s === 'denied' ? 'Connexion refusée sur l’ordinateur.' : 'QR expiré.');
              return;
            }
            if (s === 'approved' || s === 'consumed') {
              const fin = await api.qrLoginComplete(token, { fingerprint: fp });
              if (fin.data?.token) {
                done.current = true;
                setToken(fin.data.token, undefined, fin.data.username, fin.data.role);
                setProfileCache({
                  username: fin.data.username,
                  role: fin.data.role,
                  display_name: (fin.data as any).display_name || fin.data.username,
                  avatar_url: (fin.data as any).avatar_url || null,
                });
                try {
                  const me = await api.getMe();
                  const m = (me as any)?.data || me;
                  if (m) {
                    setProfileCache({
                      username: m.username || fin.data.username,
                      role: m.role || fin.data.role,
                      display_name: m.display_name,
                      avatar_url: m.avatar_url,
                    });
                  }
                } catch { /* */ }
                setStatus('ok');
                setMsg('Connecté. Redirection…');
                window.setTimeout(() => window.location.replace('/'), 500);
                return;
              }
            }
            setStatus('wait');
            setMsg('En attente de validation sur l’ordinateur…');
          } catch (e: any) {
            if (e?.code === 'USED') {
              setStatus('err');
              setMsg('Ce QR a déjà été utilisé.');
              return;
            }
          }
          timer = window.setTimeout(poll, 2000) as unknown as number;
        };
        void poll();
      } catch (e: any) {
        setStatus('err');
        setMsg(e?.message || 'Impossible d’utiliser ce QR.');
      }
    };
    void run();
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [token, mode]);

  const onAccept = async () => {
    if (!token || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.qrPhoneBind(token, {
        fingerprint: fpRef.current,
        user_agent: navigator.userAgent,
        confirm: true,
      });
      setStatus('ok');
      setMsg(res.data?.message || 'Ordinateur autorisé. Revenez sur le PC — connexion en cours.');
      if (res.data?.display_name || res.data?.username) {
        setAccount(String(res.data.display_name || res.data.username));
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setStatus('err');
      setMsg(e?.message || 'Échec de la confirmation.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const onRefuse = async () => {
    if (!token || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api.qrLoginDeny(token);
      setStatus('err');
      setMsg('Connexion refusée. L’ordinateur ne sera pas connecté.');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setStatus('err');
      setMsg(e?.message || 'Impossible de refuser.');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="login-qr-page">
      <div className="login-qr-card">
        <p className="login-qr-brand">Atlas Commerce</p>
        <h1>{mode === 'pc' ? 'Autoriser l’ordinateur' : 'Connexion par QR'}</h1>

        {(account || avatarUrl) && (
          <div className="login-qr-identity">
            {avatarUrl ? (
              <img src={avatarUrl} alt="" className="login-qr-avatar" width={72} height={72} />
            ) : account ? (
              <div className="login-qr-avatar login-qr-avatar--letter" aria-hidden>
                {account.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}
              </div>
            ) : null}
            {account ? (
              <p className="login-qr-account">
                Compte : <strong>{account}</strong>
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}

        <p className={`login-qr-msg login-qr-msg--${status}`}>{msg}</p>

        {status === 'confirm' ? (
          <div className="login-qr-actions">
            <button type="button" className="login-qr-btn login-qr-btn--ok" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void onAccept()}>
              {busy ? '…' : 'Accepter'}
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="login-qr-btn login-qr-btn--no" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void onRefuse()}>
              Refuser
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : null}

        {status === 'err' ? (
          <Link className="login-qr-link" to="/login">
            Aller à la connexion
          </Link>
        ) : null}
        {status === 'ok' && mode === 'pc' ? (
          <p className="login-qr-hint">Vous pouvez fermer cette page et revenir sur le PC.</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

}

            <strong>Cloudflare, Inc.</strong> (Workers, base de données D1, stockage d’objets
            R2, réseau CDN/WAF).
          </p>
          <p>
            Pour l’application Android et les notifications push, des services{' '}
            <strong>Google Firebase</strong> (Firebase Cloud Messaging) peuvent être utilisés
            (voir § 3.5 et § 6).
          </p>
        </section>

        <section>
          <h2>3. Données traitées</h2>

          <h3>3.1 Comptes staff</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Identifiant de connexion, mot de passe (empreinte hachée côté serveur)</li>
            <li>Rôle (ex. administrateur, stock, secrétariat), nom affiché, e-mail, téléphone</li>
            <li>Date de dernière connexion, état du compte (actif / désactivé)</li>
          </ul>

          <h3>3.2 Sécurité &amp; session</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>
              Jeton de session stocké localement (navigateur&nbsp;: localStorage ;
              application Android&nbsp;: stockage sécurisé de l’app)
            </li>
            <li>Adresse IP, empreinte d’appareil, tentatives de connexion</li>
            <li>Codes OTP envoyés par e-mail pour valider un nouvel appareil</li>
            <li>
              Identifiants de passkey (WebAuthn / Credential Manager) liés au compte, si
              l’utilisateur en enregistre (empreinte biométrique traitée par l’OS, non
              transmise à nos serveurs)
            </li>
            <li>Journal d’audit des actions sensibles</li>
            <li>
              Liste des appareils de confiance associés au compte (empreinte, dernière IP,
              dernier accès, type de navigateur) — consultable et révocable à tout moment
              depuis Paramètres → « Atlas Agent &amp; Sécurité » → « Voir les appareils »
            </li>
            <li>
              Préférence de double authentification (2FA) : lorsqu’elle est activée par le
              propriétaire de l’instance, un code OTP par e-mail est exigé à chaque connexion,
              y compris depuis un appareil de confiance
            </li>
          </ul>

          <h3>3.3 Données métier</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Produits, stocks, emplacements, inventaires, transferts</li>
            <li>Clients, fournisseurs, devis, factures, règlements</li>
            <li>
              Actions mobiles (« Boîte d’actions »)&nbsp;: scans, propositions de stock,
              demandes issues du téléphone ou de l’app native
            </li>
          </ul>

          <h3>3.4 Atlas Agent (assistant intégré)</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Messages que vous envoyez à l’assistant et réponses générées</li>
            <li>
              Outils métier invoqués (lecture stock, factures, etc.) — résultats issus de
              votre base
            </li>
            <li>
              Conversations stockées sur <strong>Cloudflare R2</strong> (préfixe{' '}
              <code>agent/&lt;utilisateur&gt;/</code>), <strong>un fichier chiffré par conversation</strong> (<code>.agent</code>, AES-GCM), séparément de D1 — pas de JSON en clair
            </li>
            <li>
              Une conversation unique et persistante par utilisateur : les échanges sont
              conservés localement (navigateur) et synchronisés sur R2 jusqu’à suppression
              volontaire — il n’existe plus d’historique multi-conversations ni de création
              de nouvelle discussion
            </li>
            <li>
              Compteurs d’usage techniques (jetons estimés par jour et par semaine) utilisés
              uniquement pour appliquer les quotas d’Atlas Agent ; remis à zéro à chaque
              période et lors d’une suppression de données
            </li>
            <li>
              En cas de détection d’abus ou d’injection de prompt (tentative de contourner
              les consignes de l’assistant), l’accès à l’agent est suspendu et l’incident est
              journalisé (<code>agent.security_lock</code>) jusqu’à rétablissement par un
              administrateur
            </li>
            <li>
              Indication de plateforme (<code>source</code> / en-tête{' '}
              <code>X-App-Platform</code>&nbsp;: web, android, mobile) pour adapter le
              contexte (réponses plus courtes sur mobile, outils de navigation native)
            </li>
            <li>
              Propositions soumises à validation humaine (ex. ajustement de stock) avant
              application
            </li>
          </ul>
          <p>
            Les messages adressés à Atlas Agent peuvent être traités par un ou plusieurs sous-traitants techniques de génération de texte (choisis par l’administrateur de l’instance, par ex. via le paramètre fournisseur IA) afin de produire une réponse. Atlas Agent se présente uniquement sous ce nom dans l’interface et dans ses réponses ; les noms de marques de modèles ne sont pas exposés aux utilisateurs finaux. L’application mobile native appelle le même endpoint serveur <code>POST /api/assist/chat</code> — le choix du fournisseur est exclusivement côté Worker.
            L’assistant ne doit pas recevoir de données sensibles non nécessaires (CIN,
            mots de passe, codes OTP, données bancaires). Les fichiers de conversation sont
            chiffrés côté serveur (jeton de chiffrement Worker) et inclus dans les sauvegardes

          <p>

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ListPager } from '../components/ui/ListPager';
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api } from '../api';
import RefreshIconButton from '../components/RefreshIconButton';

const TYPE_FR: Record<string, string> = {
  in: 'Entrée',
  out: 'Sortie',
  sale: 'Vente',
  adjust: 'Ajustement',
  transfer: 'Transfert',
  return: 'Retour',
};

export default function ProductHistory() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const productId = Number(id);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [product, setProduct] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const pageSize = 50;

  const load = async () => {
    if (!productId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      const [mov, prod] = await Promise.all([
        api.getProductMovements(productId, 1000, { full: true }),
        api.getProduct?.(productId).catch(() => null) ??
          api.getProducts?.().then((r: any) => ({ data: (r.data || []).find((p: any) => Number(p.id) === productId) })),
      ]);
      setRows(Array.isArray(mov.data) ? mov.data : []);
      const p = (prod as any)?.data;
      setProduct(p && !Array.isArray(p) ? p : p);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e?.message || 'Chargement impossible');
      setRows([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [productId]);

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rows.length / pageSize));
  const slice = rows.slice((page - 1) * pageSize, page * pageSize);
  const title = product?.name ? `${product.name}` : `Produit #${productId}`;

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header" style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 200 }}>
          <h1 style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>Historique stock</h1>
          <p className="muted" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 14 }}>
            {title}
            {product?.sku ? ` · SKU ${product.sku}` : ''}
            {!loading ? ` · ${rows.length} mouvement${rows.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} (tout l’historique)` : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        <RefreshIconButton onClick={() => load()} loading={loading} />
        <Link to="/products" className="secondary" style={{ textDecoration: 'none', padding: '8px 14px' }}>
          ← Produits
        </Link>
      </div>

      {err ? (
        <div className="modal-form-alert modal-form-alert--error" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
          {err}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="card" style={{ padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        {loading ? (
          <div className="empty" style={{ padding: 24 }}>
            Chargement…
          </div>
        ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="empty" style={{ padding: 24 }}>
            Aucun mouvement enregistré pour ce produit.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="table-wrap">
              <table>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Date</th>
                    <th>Type</th>
                    <th>Qté</th>
                    <th>Avant</th>
                    <th>Après</th>
                    <th>Raison</th>
                    <th>Réf.</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {slice.map((m: any) => (
                    <tr key={m.id || `${m.created_at}-${m.new_quantity}`}>
                      <td style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{String(m.created_at || '').replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)}</td>
                      <td>{TYPE_FR[m.type] || m.type || '—'}</td>
                      <td>{m.quantity}</td>
                      <td>{m.previous_quantity}</td>
                      <td>
                        <strong>{m.new_quantity}</strong>
                      </td>
                      <td>{m.reason || '—'}</td>
                      <td>{m.reference || '—'}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            {rows.length > pageSize ? (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', padding: 12, borderTop: '1px solid #e8eaef' }}>
                <ListPager page={page} pageSize={pageSize} total={rows.length} onPageChange={setPage} pageBase={1} />
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  const [pwDesc, setPwDesc] = useState('');
  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<null | ((password: string) => Promise<void>)>(null);

  const flash = (m: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setMsg(m);
    setMsgType(type);
    setTimeout(() => setMsg(''), 4500);
  };

  const refreshCounts = () => load(true);
  const load = (soft = false) => {
    if (soft) setRefreshing(true);
    else setLoading(true);
    Promise.all([
      api.getInvoices(filter || undefined, { kind: 'quick_sale' }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
      api.getProducts({ include_variants: true } as any).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
      api.getClients().catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
      api.getInvoices(undefined, { kind: 'all' } as any).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
    ])
      .then(([i, p, c, all]: any[]) => {
        setList(i.data || []);
        setProducts(p.data || []);
        setClients(c.data || []);
        const allArr: any[] = all.data || [];
        const isVR = (x: any) => /^VR[-/]/.test(x.number || '') || ['quick_sale', 'ticket'].includes(x.doc_kind || '');
        const isWR = (x: any) => /^WR[-/]/.test(x.number || '') || (x.doc_kind || '') === 'remboursement';
        setCashIn(allArr.filter((x) => isVR(x) && x.status === 'paid').reduce((s2, x) => s2 + (Number(x.amount_paid) || Number(x.total) || 0), 0));
        setWrTotal(allArr.filter((x) => isWR(x) && x.status !== 'cancelled').reduce((s2, x) => s2 + (Number(x.total) || 0), 0));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      });
  };
  
  useEffect(() => {
    const onLists = () => {
      try { load(true); } catch { /* */ }
    };
    window.addEventListener('atlas-lists-refresh', onLists as EventListener);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('atlas-lists-refresh', onLists as EventListener);
  }, []);


  const applyBarcodeScan = async (code: string) => {
    const c = code.trim();
    if (!c) return;
    let p = products.find(
      (x) => String(x.barcode || '') === c || String(x.sku || '') === c || String(x.id) === c,
    );
    if (!p) {
      try {
        const list: any = await api.getProducts({ q: c, limit: 8 } as any);
        const rows = list?.data || [];
        p = rows.find(
          (x: any) => String(x.barcode || '') === c || String(x.sku || '').toLowerCase() === c.toLowerCase(),
        ) || rows[0];
      } catch { /* */ }
    }
    if (!p) {
      setScanError('Produit introuvable pour ce code.');
      setBarcodeScan('');
      return;
    }
    let unit = Number(p.price || 0);
    if (clientId) {
      try {
        const pr: any = await api.getClientPriceForProduct(Number(clientId), Number(p.id));
        if (pr?.data?.unit_price != null) unit = Number(pr.data.unit_price);
      } catch { /* */ }
    }
    setItems((prev) => {
      const emptyIdx = prev.findIndex((it) => !it.product_id && !String(it.product_name || '').trim());
      const row = {
        product_id: p.id,
        product_name: p.name || '',
        product_query: p.name || '',
        sku: p.sku || '',
        quantity: 1,
        list_price: Number(p.price || 0),
        unit_price: unit,
      };
      if (emptyIdx >= 0) {
        const next = [...prev];
        next[emptyIdx] = { ...next[emptyIdx], ...row };
        return next;
      }
      return [...prev, row];
    });
    setBarcodeScan('');
    setScanError('');
    flash(`Ajouté: ${p.name}`);
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [filter]);

  const selectClient = (id: number | '') => {
    setClientId(id);
    if (!id) {
      setClientName('');
      setClientIce('');
      setClientPhone('');
      return;
    }
    const cl = clients.find((x) => Number(x.id) === Number(id));
    if (cl) {
      setClientName(cl.name || '');
      setClientIce(cl.ice || '');
      setClientPhone(cl.phone || '');
    }
  };

  const updateLine = (idx: number, field: string, value: any) => {
    setItems((prev) => {
      const next = [...prev];
      const line = { ...next[idx], [field]: value };
      if (field === 'product_id' && value) {
        const p = products.find((x) => Number(x.id) === Number(value));
        if (p) {
          const price = Number(p.unit_price ?? p.price ?? 0);
          line.product_name = p.name;
          line.list_price = price;
          line.unit_price = price;
          line.product_query = p.name;
        }
      }
      if (field === 'product_query') {
        const q = String(value || '').toLowerCase();
        const match = products.find(
          (p) =>
            p.name?.toLowerCase() === q ||
            p.sku?.toLowerCase() === q ||
            String(p.barcode || '') === String(value),
        );
        if (match) {
          const price = Number(match.unit_price ?? match.price ?? 0);
          line.product_id = match.id;
          line.product_name = match.name;
          line.list_price = price;
          line.unit_price = price;
        }
      }
      next[idx] = line;
      return next;
    });
  };

  const total = items.reduce(
    (s, it) => s + Number(it.quantity || 0) * Number(it.unit_price || 0),
    0,
  );
  const fmt = (n: number) => fmtMoney(n, 'MAD');

  const remainingOf = (inv: any) =>
    Math.max(0, Number(inv.total || 0) - Number(inv.amount_paid || 0));

  const markPaid = (inv: any) => {
    const rest = remainingOf(inv);
    if (rest <= 0) {
      flash('Ce ticket est déjà soldé.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    setModalError('');
    setPayTarget(inv);
    setSettleAmount(rest);
    setSettleMethod('cash');
    setSettleNote('Règlement intégral');
    setSettleDate(today());
    setSettleMode('full');
  };

  const openPartialPay = (inv: any) => {
    const rest = remainingOf(inv);
    if (rest <= 0) {
      flash('Ce ticket est déjà soldé.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    setModalError('');
    setPayTarget(inv);
    setSettleAmount(rest);
    setSettleMethod('cash');
    setSettleNote('');
    setSettleDate(today());
    setSettleMode('partial');
  };

  const submitSettle = async () => {
    if (!payTarget) return;
    const rest = remainingOf(payTarget);
    const amount = settleMode === 'full' ? rest : Number(settleAmount);
    if (!amount || amount <= 0) {
      setModalError('Montant invalide.');
      return;
    }
    if (amount > rest + 0.001) {
      setModalError(`Le montant ne peut pas dépasser le reste dû (${fmt(rest)}).`);
      return;
    }
    setSettleSaving(true);
    try {
      const res: any = await api.recordInvoicePayment(payTarget.id, {
        amount,
        payment_method: settleMethod,
        payee: settleMethod.includes('owner') ? 'owner' : 'company',
        note: settleNote || (settleMode === 'full' ? 'Règlement intégral' : ''),
        paid_at: settleDate,
      });
      flash(res.message || 'Paiement enregistré');
      setPayTarget(null);
      refreshCounts();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setModalError(e?.message || 'Paiement impossible');
    } finally {
      setSettleSaving(false);
    }
  };


  const cancelTicket = async (id: number) => {
    const ok = await confirm({
      title: 'Annuler ce ticket VR',
      message: 'Le numéro VR est conservé. Le stock sera rétabli.',
      danger: true,
      confirmLabel: 'Continuer',
    });
    if (!ok) return;
    const voidReason = await prompt({
      title: 'Motif d’annulation (obligatoire)',
      message: 'Ex. erreur de caisse, doublon…',
      placeholder: 'Motif (min. 5 caractères)',
      confirmLabel: 'Annuler le ticket',
    });
    if (!voidReason || voidReason.trim().length < 5) {
      setModalError('Motif trop court.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const r: any = await api.updateInvoiceStatus(id, { status: 'cancelled', void_reason: voidReason.trim() } as any);
      flash(r.message || 'Ticket annulé — stock rétabli.');
      refreshCounts();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setModalError(friendlyError(e) || 'Opération impossible — réessayez.');
    }
  };

  const requestDelete = async (id: number) => {
    let disclaimer =
      'Suppression définitive du ticket VR et des paiements liés. Stock rétabli si le ticket n’est pas déjà annulé.';
    try {
      const links = await api.getInvoiceLinks(id);
      const d = links.data;
      const bits: string[] = [];
      if (d?.receipts?.length) bits.push(`${d.receipts.length} reçu(s)`);
      if (d?.payments_count) bits.push(`${d.payments_count} paiement(s)`);
      if (bits.length) disclaimer = `Ce ticket VR et ${bits.join(', ')} seront effacés. Stock rétabli.`;
    } catch { /* */ }
    setPwTitle('Supprimer le ticket VR');
    setPwDesc(disclaimer + ' Confirmez pour continuer.');
    setPendingAction(() => async (password: string) => {
      const res: any = await api.deleteInvoice(id, password);
      flash(res.message || 'Ticket supprimé.');
      setPwOpen(false);
      setPendingAction(null);
      refreshCounts();
    });
    setPwOpen(true);
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setClientId('');
    setClientName('');
    setClientIce('');
    setClientPhone('');
    setIssueDate(today());
    setNotes('');
    setPayMode('cash');
    setItems([{ product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, product_query: '' }]);
  };

  const checkout = async () => {
    const lines = items.filter(
      (it) => (it.product_name || '').trim() && Number(it.quantity) > 0,
    );
    if (!lines.length) {
      setModalError('Ajoutez au moins une ligne produit.');
      return;
    }
    if (!(clientName || '').trim()) {
      flash('Indiquez un nom de client.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const inv: any = await api.createInvoice({
        client_id: clientId || undefined,
        client_name: clientName.trim(),
        client_ice: clientIce,
        client_phone: clientPhone,
        issue_date: issueDate,
        status: 'sent',
        quick_sale: true,
        doc_kind: 'quick_sale',
        tax_exempt: true,
        notes:
          notes ||
          `Vente rapide · mode prévu : ${payMode === 'card' ? 'Carte' : 'Espèces'} · sans TVA · non encaissé`,
        items: lines.map((l) => ({
          product_id: l.product_id,
          product_name: l.product_name,
          quantity: l.quantity,
          unit_price: l.unit_price,
          list_price: l.list_price,
          tax_rate: 0,
        })),
      });
      const data = inv?.data || inv;
      const invId = Number(data?.id);
      const invTotal = Number(data?.total ?? total);
      const number = String(data?.number || invId);

      // VR is NOT paid automatically — user encaisses later from the ticket page
      // Remember client-specific prices when discounted vs catalogue
      if (clientId) {
        for (const it of items) {
          if (!it.product_id) continue;
          const list = Number(it.list_price || 0);
          const unit = Number(it.unit_price || 0);
          if (unit > 0 && (list <= 0 || Math.abs(unit - list) > 0.001)) {
            api.setClientProductPrice(Number(clientId), Number(it.product_id), unit).catch(() => {});
          }
        }
      }
      flash(`Ticket ${number} créé · ${fmt(invTotal)} (à encaisser)`, 'success');
      toast(`Ticket ${number} créé — à encaisser · ${fmt(invTotal)}`, 'success');
      resetForm();
      setShowModal(false);
      refreshCounts();
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Échec de la vente rapide', 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const isQuickSaleDoc = (inv: any) => {
    const kind = String(inv.doc_kind || '').toLowerCase();
    const st = String(inv.status || '').toLowerCase();
    const num = String(inv.number || '');
    if (st === 'quote' || st === 'devis' || st === 'remboursement') return false;
    if (kind === 'quote' || kind === 'devis' || kind === 'remboursement') return false;
    if (kind === 'quick_sale' || kind === 'ticket' || num.startsWith('VR')) return true;
    // Backend kind=quick_sale already scopes list; keep search-only pass-through for VR rows
    return true;
  };
  const filtered = list.filter((inv) => {
    if (!isQuickSaleDoc(inv)) return false;
    if (!search) return true;
    const s = search.toLowerCase();
    return (inv.number || '').toLowerCase().includes(s) || (inv.client_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(s);
  });

  const token = getToken() || '';

  if (loading) return <div className="empty">Chargement des ventes rapides...</div>;

  const qsKpis = (() => {
    const open = filtered.filter((i: any) => i.status !== 'paid' && i.status !== 'cancelled').length;
    const paid = filtered.filter((i: any) => i.status === 'paid').length;
    return { n: filtered.length, open, paid };
  })();

  return (
    <div className="atlas-orders quicksale-page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1>Vente rapide</h1>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 14, marginTop: 4 }}>
            Tickets caisse série VR — sans TVA. Le paiement n’est pas appliqué automatiquement : encaissement depuis le ticket. Distinct des factures FA.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <RefreshIconButton onClick={() => load(true)} loading={refreshing} />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="secondary"
            style={{ borderColor: 'var(--copper, #b87333)', color: 'var(--copper-dark, #8a5520)' }}
            onClick={() => setShowRefund(true)}
          >
            + Remboursement (WR)
          </button>
          <select value={filter} onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)} style={{ width: 'auto' }} aria-label="Filtrer par statut">
            <option value="">Tous les tickets</option>
            <option value="sent">Non soldés</option>
            <option value="partial">Partiels</option>
            <option value="paid">Encaissés</option>
            <option value="cancelled">Annulés</option>
          </select>
          <button onClick={() => { resetForm(); setModalError(''); wz.reset(); setShowModal(true); }}>+ Nouvelle vente</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      
      <div className="ac-metric-grid" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div className="ac-metric"><div className="as-label">Tickets</div><div className="as-value">{qsKpis.n}</div></div>
        <div className="ac-metric"><div className="as-label">Ouverts</div><div className="as-value">{qsKpis.open}</div></div>
        <div className="ac-metric"><div className="as-label">Payés</div><div className="as-value">{qsKpis.paid}</div></div>
        <div className="ac-metric ac-metric--solde"><div className="as-label">Solde caisse</div><div className="as-value">{new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-MA', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(cashIn - wrTotal)} <small>MAD</small></div><div className="as-hint">encaissé {new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-MA', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(cashIn)} − remboursements {new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-MA', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(wrTotal)}</div></div>
      </div>
<SaveFeedback message={msg} type={msgType} />

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-filters" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div className="ac-products-filters-row">
          <div className="ac-search-field">
            <input
              className="ac-search-input"
              placeholder="Rechercher par numéro ou nom de client..."
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-table-panel">
        <VirtualScroll maxHeight={filtered.length > 60 ? 560 : undefined}>
          <table className="data-dense ac-products-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Numéro</th>
                <th>Client</th>
                <th>Date</th>
                <th>Statut</th>
                <th>Total</th>
                <th>Payé</th>
                <th>Reste</th>
                <th>Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <tbody>
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={8}>
                    <EmptyState
                      title="Aucune vente rapide"
                      description="Créez un ticket caisse (série VR). Aucune TVA n’est appliquée."
                      actionLabel="Nouvelle vente"
                      onAction={() => { resetForm(); setModalError(''); wz.reset(); setShowModal(true); }}
                      icon="document"
                    />
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            ) : (
              <VirtualTableBody
                rows={filtered}
                rowHeight={52}
                maxHeight={560}
                getKey={(inv) => inv.id}
                renderRow={(inv) => (
                  <tr>
                    <td><Link to={`/quick-sale/${inv.id}`}><strong>{inv.number}</strong></Link></td>
                    <td>{inv.client_name}</td>
                    <td>{inv.issue_date}</td>
                    <td><span className={`badge ${statusBadgeClass(inv.status)}`}>{statusFr(inv.status)}</span></td>
                    <td style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{fmt(inv.total)}</td>
                    <td>{fmt(inv.amount_paid || 0)}</td>
                    <td style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: inv.status === 'paid' || inv.status === 'cancelled' ? 'var(--muted)' : 'var(--bad)' }}>
                      {inv.status === 'cancelled' ? '—' : fmt(Math.max(0, Number(inv.total || 0) - Number(inv.amount_paid || 0)))}
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                      {inv.status !== 'cancelled' && remainingOf(inv) > 0.001 && (
                        <>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="success"
                            style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }}
                            onClick={() => markPaid(inv)}
                          >
                            Tout payer
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="secondary"
                            style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }}
                            onClick={() => openPartialPay(inv)}
                          >
                            Paiement
                          </button>
                        </>
                      )}
                      <Link to={`/quick-sale/${inv.id}`} className="btn secondary" style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }}>Ouvrir</Link>
                      <a
                        className="btn secondary"
                        style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }}
                        href={`${BASE}/api/invoices/${inv.id}/print?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noreferrer"
                      >
                        Imprimer
                      </a>
                      {inv.status !== 'cancelled' && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="secondary"
                          style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }}
                          onClick={() => void cancelTicket(inv.id)}
                        >
                          Annuler
                        </button>
                      )}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="danger"
                        style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }}
                        onClick={() => void requestDelete(inv.id)}
                      >
                        Suppr.
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
              />
            )}
          </table>
        </VirtualScroll>
      </div>

      {showModal && (
        <FloatingPortal><div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => { if (busy) return; setShowModal(false); resetForm(); wz.reset(); }}>
          <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 1080, width: '96vw' }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h2>Nouvelle vente rapide (caisse)</h2>
            <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 14, lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
              Prix saisis tels quels. <strong>Aucune TVA</strong> n’est calculée sur les tickets VR.
            </p>

            <StepBody active={wz.step === 1}>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Client enregistré</label>
              <TypeaheadField
                value={clientName}
                placeholder="Rechercher un client…"
                options={partyTypeaheadOptions(clients, 'client')}
                onOpen={() => {
                  api.getClients().then((r: any) => {
                    if (Array.isArray(r?.data)) setClients(r.data);
                  }).catch(() => {});
                }}
                onChange={(v) => {
                  setClientName(v);
                  setClientId('');
                }}
                onPick={(o) => {
                  selectClient(Number(o.id));
                }}
                emptyLabel="Aucun client"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-2">
              <div className="form-row">
                <label>Nom du client *</label>
                <input
                  value={clientName}
                  onChange={(e) => setClientName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Nom du client"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="form-row">
                <label>ICE / Identifiant fiscal</label>
                <input value={clientIce} onChange={(e) => setClientIce(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-2">
              <div className="form-row">
                <label>Téléphone</label>
                <input value={clientPhone} onChange={(e) => setClientPhone(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              <div className="form-row">
                <label>Date d'émission</label>
                <DatePicker value={issueDate} onChange={setIssueDate} />
              </div>
            </div>

            </StepBody>
            <StepBody active={wz.step === 2}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: '16px 0 8px', fontSize: 14 }}>
              Lignes — recherche produit · prix · quantité
            </h3>
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'grid',
                gridTemplateColumns: '1.5fr 1.2fr 70px 100px 100px 100px 36px',
                gap: 6,
                marginBottom: 6,
                fontSize: 10,
                color: 'var(--muted)',
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            >
              <span>Recherche / produit</span>
              <span>Désignation</span>
              <span>Qté</span>
              <span>P.U. catalogue</span>
              <span>P.U. client</span>
              <span>Total</span>
              <span />
            </div>
            {items.map((item, idx) => {
              const lineTotal = Number(item.quantity || 0) * Number(item.unit_price || 0);
              const q = (item.product_query || '').toLowerCase();
              const filteredP = q
                ? products.filter(
                    (p) =>
                      p.name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                      p.sku?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                      String(p.barcode || '').includes(q),
                  ).slice(0, 40)
                : products.slice(0, 40);
              return (
                <div key={idx} style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: 'grid',
                      gridTemplateColumns: '1.5fr 1.2fr 70px 100px 100px 100px 36px',
                      gap: 6,
                      alignItems: 'center',
                    }}
                  >
                    <TypeaheadField
                      value={item.product_query ?? ''}
                      placeholder="Rechercher nom, SKU…"
                      options={productTypeaheadOptions(products)}
                    onOpen={() => {
                      api.getProducts({ fields: 'light', limit: 500 }).then((r: any) => {
                        if (Array.isArray(r?.data)) setProducts(r.data);
                      }).catch(() => {});
                    }}
                      onChange={(v) => updateLine(idx, 'product_query', v)}
                      onPick={async (o) => {
                        const p = products.find((x) => String(x.id) === String(o.id));
                        if (!p) return;
                        let unit = Number(p.price || 0);
                        if (clientId) {
                          try {
                            const pr: any = await api.getClientPriceForProduct(Number(clientId), Number(p.id));
                            if (pr?.data?.unit_price != null) unit = Number(pr.data.unit_price);
                          } catch { /* */ }
                        }
                        updateLine(idx, 'product_id', p.id);
                        updateLine(idx, 'product_name', p.name || '');
                        updateLine(idx, 'product_query', p.name || '');
                        updateLine(idx, 'list_price', Number(p.price || 0));
                        updateLine(idx, 'unit_price', unit);
                        if (p.sku) updateLine(idx, 'sku', p.sku);
                      }}
                      emptyLabel="Aucun produit"
                    />
                    <input
                      placeholder="Désignation *"
                      value={item.product_name}
                      onChange={(e) => updateLine(idx, 'product_name', e.target.value)}
                    />
                    <NumberField value={item.quantity} onValueChange={(n) => updateLine(idx, 'quantity', n)} min={0.01} step="0.01" />
                    <NumberField value={item.list_price} onValueChange={(n) => updateLine(idx, 'list_price', n)} min={0} step="0.01" />
                    <NumberField value={item.unit_price} onValueChange={(n) => updateLine(idx, 'unit_price', n)} min={0} step="0.01" />
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'right', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', fontSize: 13 }}>
                      {fmt(lineTotal)}
                    </div>
                    <button

                      className="danger"
                      style={{ padding: '6px 8px' }}
                      onClick={() =>
                        setItems((prev) => {
                          if (prev.length <= 1) {
                            return [{ product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, product_query: '' }];
                          }
                          return prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx);
                        })
                      }
                      aria-label="Supprimer"
                    >
                      ×
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
            <button
              type="button"
              className="secondary"
              onClick={() =>
                setItems([...items, { product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, product_query: '' }])
              }
              style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
            >
              + Ajouter une ligne
            </button>

            </StepBody>
            <StepBody active={wz.step === 3}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {([['cash', 'Espèces'], ['card', 'Carte']] as const).map(([k, lab]) => (
                <button
                  key={k}
                  type="button"
                  className={payMode === k ? 'qs-pay is-on' : 'secondary qs-pay'}
                  onClick={() => setPayMode(k)}
                >
                  {lab}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 800, textAlign: 'right', marginBottom: 12 }}>
              Total {fmt(total)}
            </div>

            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Notes</label>
              <textarea rows={2} value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="Optionnel" />
            </div>

            </StepBody>
            <ModalFormError message={modalError} />
            <WizardFoot
              wz={wz}
              title="Nouvelle vente rapide (caisse)"
              stepLabel={['Client', 'Articles', 'Paiement'][wz.step - 1]}
              onCancel={() => { if (busy) return; setShowModal(false); resetForm(); wz.reset(); }}
              onSubmit={() => void checkout()}
              submitLabel={`Encaisser · ${fmt(total)}`}
              saving={busy}
            />
          </div>
        </div></FloatingPortal>
      )}

      {pwOpen && pendingAction && (
        <PasswordConfirm
          open={pwOpen}
          title={pwTitle}
          description={pwDesc}
          confirmLabel="Supprimer définitivement"
          onCancel={() => { setPwOpen(false); setPendingAction(null); }}
          onConfirm={async (password) => { await pendingAction(password); }}
        />
      )}
    
      {payTarget && (
        <FloatingPortal><div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => !settleSaving && setPayTarget(null)}>
          <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ maxWidth: 440 }}>
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
              {settleMode === 'full' ? 'Tout payer — ticket VR' : 'Paiement partiel — ticket VR'}
            </h2>
            <p style={{ fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1.5, marginBottom: 16 }}>
              Ticket <strong>{payTarget.number}</strong> — {payTarget.client_name}
            </p>
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'grid',
                gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr',
                gap: 10,
                marginBottom: 16,
                padding: 12,
                background: 'var(--stone, #f5f2eb)',
                borderRadius: 8,
                fontSize: 13,
              }}
            >
              <div>
                <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 11, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>Total</div>
                <strong>{fmt(payTarget.total)}</strong>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 11, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>Déjà payé</div>
                <strong style={{ color: 'var(--success, #3f3f46)' }}>{fmt(payTarget.amount_paid || 0)}</strong>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 11, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>Reste dû</div>
                <strong style={{ color: 'var(--bad, #8b2e2e)' }}>{fmt(remainingOf(payTarget))}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Montant à encaisser</label>
              <NumberField
                min={0.01}
                step="0.01"
                value={settleAmount}
                onValueChange={(v) => {
                  const max = remainingOf(payTarget);
                  const clamped = Math.min(v, max);
                  setSettleAmount(clamped);
                  setSettleMode(clamped >= max - 0.001 ? 'full' : 'partial');
                }}
                disabled={settleMode === 'full' || settleSaving}
              />
              {settleMode === 'full' && (
                <small style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 12 }}>Montant fixé au reste dû.</small>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Mode de paiement *</label>
              <select value={settleMethod} onChange={(e) => setSettleMethod(e.target.value)} disabled={settleSaving}>
                {PAYMENT_METHODS.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m.value} value={m.value}>{m.label}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Date</label>
              <DatePicker value={settleDate} onChange={setSettleDate} disabled={settleSaving} />
            </div>

            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Note (optionnel)</label>
              <input type="text" value={settleNote} onChange={(e) => setSettleNote(e.target.value)} disabled={settleSaving} />
            </div>

            <ModalFormError message={modalError} />
            <div className="form-actions">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void submitSettle()} disabled={settleSaving}>
                {settleSaving ? '…' : settleMode === 'full' ? 'Valider le règlement intégral' : 'Enregistrer ce paiement'}
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setPayTarget(null)} disabled={settleSaving}>
                Annuler
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div></FloatingPortal>
      )}

      <RemboursementModal
        open={showRefund}
        onClose={() => setShowRefund(false)}
        onCreated={() => load(true)}
        preferQuickSale
      />
</div>
  );
}

import { printInvoiceTicket } from '../lib/thermal';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, Navigate, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api, BASE } from '../api';
import { getToken } from '../auth';
import { statusFr, statusBadgeClass } from '../lib/labels';
import { fmtMoney, paymentMethodLabel } from '../lib/money';
import { useUi } from '../components/AppDialogs';
import PasswordConfirm from '../components/PasswordConfirm';
import SaveFeedback from '../components/SaveFeedback';
import NumberField from '../components/NumberField';
import { friendlyError } from '../lib/errors';

function isVrDoc(inv: any) {
  return (
    inv?.doc_kind === 'quick_sale' ||
    inv?.doc_kind === 'ticket' ||
    String(inv?.number || '').startsWith('VR')
  );
}

export default function QuickSaleDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const { toast, confirm, prompt } = useUi();
  const [ticket, setTicket] = useState<any>(null);
  const [payments, setPayments] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [msgType, setMsgType] = useState<'success' | 'error'>('success');
  const [payAmount, setPayAmount] = useState(0);
  const [payMethod, setPayMethod] = useState('cash');
  const [paying, setPaying] = useState(false);
  const [pwOpen, setPwOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pwDesc, setPwDesc] = useState('');
  const [pendingDelete, setPendingDelete] = useState<null | ((password: string) => Promise<void>)>(null);

  const flash = (m: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setMsg(m);
    setMsgType(type);
    setTimeout(() => setMsg(''), 5000);
  };

  const reload = async () => {
    if (!id) return;
    const [res, pays] = await Promise.all([
      api.getInvoice(+id),
      api.getInvoicePayments(+id).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
    ]);
    setTicket(res.data);
    setPayments(pays.data || []);
    const due = Math.max(0, Number(res.data?.total || 0) - Number(res.data?.amount_paid || 0));
    setPayAmount(due);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    setLoading(true);
    reload().finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id]);

  if (loading) return <div className="empty">Chargement du ticket…</div>;
  if (!ticket) return <div className="empty">Ticket introuvable</div>;
  if (!isVrDoc(ticket)) return <Navigate to={`/invoices/${ticket.id}`} replace />;

  const fmt = (n: number) => fmtMoney(n, 'MAD');
  const due = Math.max(0, Number(ticket.total || 0) - Number(ticket.amount_paid || 0));
  const cancelled = ticket.status === 'cancelled';
  const token = getToken() || '';

  const goRefund = () => {
    // Reuse FA refund flow with preselected VR ticket
    nav(`/invoices?refund=${ticket.id}`);
  };

  const cancelTicket = async () => {
    const ok = await confirm({
      title: 'Annuler ce ticket VR',
      message:
        'Le numéro VR est conservé (pas de trou de série).\nLe stock sera rétabli.\nLes encaissements restent en historique jusqu’à suppression.',
      danger: true,
      confirmLabel: 'Continuer',
    });
    if (!ok) return;
    const voidReason = await prompt({
      title: 'Motif d’annulation (obligatoire)',
      message: 'Ex. erreur de caisse, doublon, client a changé d’avis…',
      placeholder: 'Motif (min. 5 caractères)',
      confirmLabel: 'Annuler le ticket',
    });
    if (!voidReason || voidReason.trim().length < 5) {
      toast('Motif trop court — annulation annulée.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const r: any = await api.updateInvoiceStatus(ticket.id, {
        status: 'cancelled',
        void_reason: voidReason.trim(),
      } as any);
      flash(r.message || 'Ticket annulé — stock rétabli.');
      toast('Ticket VR annulé', 'success');
      await reload();
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(friendlyError(e), 'error');
    }
  };

  const requestDelete = async () => {
    let disclaimer =
      'Suppression définitive du ticket VR, des paiements et reçus liés. Le stock sera rétabli si le ticket n’est pas déjà annulé. Confirmez pour continuer.';
    try {
      const links = await api.getInvoiceLinks(ticket.id);
      const d = links.data;
      const bits: string[] = [];
      if (d?.receipts?.length) bits.push(`${d.receipts.length} reçu(s)`);
      if (d?.payments_count) bits.push(`${d.payments_count} paiement(s)`);
      if (bits.length) {
        disclaimer = `ATTENTION : ce ticket VR et ${bits.join(', ')} seront effacés. Stock rétabli. Confirmez pour continuer.`;
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
    setPwDesc(disclaimer);
    setPendingDelete(() => async (password: string) => {
      const res: any = await api.deleteInvoice(ticket.id, password);
      toast(res.message || 'Ticket supprimé', 'success');
      setPwOpen(false);
      setPendingDelete(null);
      nav('/quick-sale');
    });
    setPwOpen(true);
  };

  const recordPay = async () => {
    if (payAmount <= 0) {
      flash('Montant invalide.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    setPaying(true);
    try {
      await api.recordInvoicePayment(ticket.id, {
        amount: payAmount,
        payment_method: payMethod,
        payee: 'company',
        note: 'Encaissement ticket VR',
      });
      flash('Paiement enregistré.');
      toast('Paiement VR enregistré', 'success');
      await reload();
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(friendlyError(e), 'error');
    } finally {
      setPaying(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {!cancelled && ticket.status !== 'remboursement' && (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 12, padding: '10px 14px', fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
          <strong>Remboursement WR</strong> — ce ticket VR peut faire l’objet d’un avoir (série WR-),
          sans TVA. S’il est déjà encaissé, la sortie apparaît dans Solde.
          {' '}
          <button type="button" className="secondary" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }} onClick={goRefund}>
            Créer un WR…
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <Link to="/quick-sale" style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
            ← Retour aux ventes rapides
          </Link>
          <h1 style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
            Ticket {ticket.number}
            <span className={`badge ${statusBadgeClass(ticket.status)}`} style={{ marginLeft: 10, fontSize: 13 }}>
              {statusFr(ticket.status)}
            </span>
          </h1>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 14 }}>
            Vente rapide (série VR) — sans TVA · stock déduit à l’encaissement
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <a
            className="btn secondary"
            href={`${BASE}/api/invoices/${ticket.id}/print?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer"
          >
            Imprimer
          </a>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="secondary"
            onClick={async () => {
              try {
                await printInvoiceTicket(ticket.id, { prefer: 'auto' });
                flash('Ticket envoyé à l’imprimante');
              } catch (e: any) {
                flash(e?.message || 'Impression thermique indisponible — utilisez Imprimer', 'error');
              }
            }}
          >
            Ticket thermique
          </button>
          <a
            className="btn secondary"
            href={`${BASE}/api/invoices/${ticket.id}/pdf?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer"
          >
            PDF
          </a>
          {!cancelled && (
            <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => void cancelTicket()}>
              Annuler (stock)
            </button>
          )}
          <button type="button" className="danger" onClick={() => void requestDelete()}>
            Supprimer
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <SaveFeedback message={msg} type={msgType} />

      <div className="grid grid-2" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div className="card">
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: 15, marginTop: 0 }}>Client</h3>
          <p style={{ margin: 0, fontWeight: 700 }}>{ticket.client_name || '—'}</p>
          {ticket.client_ice && <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: 13 }}>ICE {ticket.client_ice}</p>}
          {ticket.client_phone && <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: 13 }}>{ticket.client_phone}</p>}
        </div>
        <div className="card">
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: 15, marginTop: 0 }}>Ticket</h3>
          <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 13 }}>Date : {ticket.issue_date || '—'}</p>
          <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: 13 }}>Total : <strong>{fmt(ticket.total)}</strong></p>
          <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: 13 }}>Payé : {fmt(ticket.amount_paid || 0)}</p>
          <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: 13 }}>
            Reste : <strong style={{ color: due > 0.001 && !cancelled ? 'var(--bad)' : 'var(--muted)' }}>{cancelled ? '—' : fmt(due)}</strong>
          </p>
          {ticket.void_reason && (
            <p style={{ margin: '8px 0 0', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>Motif d’annulation : {ticket.void_reason}</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <h3 style={{ fontSize: 15, marginTop: 0 }}>Lignes (sans TVA)</h3>
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Désignation</th>
              <th>Qté</th>
              <th>P.U.</th>
              <th>Total</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {(ticket.items || []).map((it: any) => (
              <tr key={it.id || `${it.product_name}-${it.quantity}`}>
                <td>
                  {it.product_name}
                  {it.sku ? <small style={{ display: 'block', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{it.sku}</small> : null}
                </td>
                <td>{it.quantity}{it.unit ? ` ${it.unit}` : ''}</td>
                <td>{fmt(it.unit_price)}</td>
                <td style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{fmt(it.line_total ?? Number(it.quantity) * Number(it.unit_price))}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
        {ticket.notes && (
          <p style={{ marginTop: 12, fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)' }}>{ticket.notes}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      {!cancelled && due > 0.001 && (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: 15, marginTop: 0 }}>Encaisser le reste</h3>
          <div className="grid grid-2">
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Montant</label>
              <NumberField value={payAmount} onValueChange={(n) => setPayAmount(n)} min={0} step="0.01" />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Mode</label>
              <select value={payMethod} onChange={(e) => setPayMethod(e.target.value)}>
                <option value="cash">Espèces</option>
                <option value="card">Carte</option>
                <option value="transfer">Virement</option>
                <option value="cheque">Chèque</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => void recordPay()} disabled={paying}>
            {paying ? '…' : `Encaisser ${fmt(payAmount)}`}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="card">
        <h3 style={{ fontSize: 15, marginTop: 0 }}>Paiements</h3>
        {payments.length === 0 ? (
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 13, margin: 0 }}>Aucun paiement enregistré.</p>
        ) : (
          <table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Date</th>
                <th>Montant</th>
                <th>Mode</th>
                <th>Note</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {payments.map((p: any) => (
                <tr key={p.id}>
                  <td>{String(p.paid_at || '').slice(0, 10)}</td>
                  <td>{fmt(p.amount)}</td>

                  <td>{p.note || '—'}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </div>

      {pwOpen && pendingDelete && (
        <PasswordConfirm
          open={pwOpen}
          title="Supprimer le ticket VR"
          description={pwDesc}
          confirmLabel="Supprimer définitivement"
          onCancel={() => { setPwOpen(false); setPendingDelete(null); }}
          onConfirm={async (password) => { await pendingDelete(password); }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
