import TypeaheadField, { productTypeaheadOptions, partyTypeaheadOptions } from '../components/TypeaheadField';
import DatePicker from '../components/DatePicker';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, BASE } from '../api';
import { openPrintDoc } from '../lib/reports';
import { getToken } from '../auth';
import SaveFeedback from '../components/SaveFeedback';
import { statusFr, statusBadgeClass } from '../lib/labels';
import { useUi } from '../components/AppDialogs';
import { numStr, numFromInput } from '../lib/numInput';
import NumberField from '../components/NumberField';
import EmptyState from '../components/EmptyState';
import { useWizard, StepBody, WizardFoot } from '../components/ui/FormWizard';
import RefreshIconButton from '../components/RefreshIconButton';
import PasswordConfirm from '../components/PasswordConfirm';
import { FloatingPortal } from '../components/FloatingPortal';
import { ModalFormError } from '../components/ModalFormFeedback';

export default function Quotes() {
  const [modalError, setModalError] = useState('');
  const { confirm } = useUi();
  const [list, setList] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const wz = useWizard(3);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveMsg, setSaveMsg] = useState('');
  const [saveMsgType, setSaveMsgType] = useState<'success' | 'error'>('success');
  const [clientId, setClientId] = useState('');
  const [clientName, setClientName] = useState('');
  const [clientQuery, setClientQuery] = useState('');
  const [clientDropOpen, setClientDropOpen] = useState(false);
  const [productDropIdx, setProductDropIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [issueDate, setIssueDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [items, setItems] = useState<{ product_id?: number; product_name: string; product_query?: string; quantity: number; list_price: number; unit_price: number; tax_rate: number; sku?: string }[]>([
    { product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, tax_rate: 20 },
  ]);
  const [taxExempt, setTaxExempt] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [convertId, setConvertId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [detailQuote, setDetailQuote] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [detailLoading, setDetailLoading] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [editLocked, setEditLocked] = useState(false);
  const [pwOpen, setPwOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pwTitle, setPwTitle] = useState('Confirmation');
  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<null | ((password: string) => Promise<void>)>(null);
  const filteredQuotes = list.filter((q) => {
    if (!search.trim()) return true;
    const s = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return (
      String(q.number || '').toLowerCase().includes(s) ||
      String(q.client_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(s) ||
      String(q.status || '').toLowerCase().includes(s) ||
      String(q.notes || '').toLowerCase().includes(s)
    );
  });

  const flash = (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setSaveMsg(msg); setSaveMsgType(type);
    setTimeout(() => setSaveMsg(''), 4500);
  };

  const load = (soft = false) => {
    if (soft) setRefreshing(true);
    else setLoading(true);
    Promise.all([api.getInvoices('quote'), api.getClients(), api.getProducts()])
      .then(([inv, cl, pr]) => {
        const all = inv.data || [];
        // also include status devis if filtered only quote misses some
        setList(all.filter((x: any) => x.status === 'quote' || x.status === 'devis'));
        setClients(cl.data || []);
        setProducts(pr.data || []);
      })
      .catch(async () => {
        // fallback: get all invoices and filter
        try {
          const inv = await api.getInvoices();
          setList((inv.data || []).filter((x: any) => x.status === 'quote' || x.status === 'devis'));
        } catch { /* ignore */ }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      });
  };

  
  useEffect(() => {
    const onLists = () => {
      try { load(true); } catch { /* */ }
    };
    window.addEventListener('atlas-lists-refresh', onLists as EventListener);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('atlas-lists-refresh', onLists as EventListener);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const onClient = (id: string) => {
    setClientId(id);
    const c = clients.find((x) => String(x.id) === id);
    if (c) {
      setClientName(c.name);
      setTaxExempt(!!c.tax_exempt);
    } else {
      setTaxExempt(false);
    }
  };

  const setItem = (i: number, patch: Partial<(typeof items)[0]>) => {
    setItems((prev) => prev.map((row, idx) => (idx === i ? { ...row, ...patch } : row)));
  };

  const pickProduct = (i: number, pid: string) => {
    const p = products.find((x) => String(x.id) === pid);
    if (!p) return;
    const price = Number(p.price || 0);
    setItem(i, {
      product_id: p.id,
      product_name: p.name,
      product_query: p.name,
      sku: p.sku || '',
      list_price: price,
      unit_price: price,
      tax_rate: taxExempt ? 0 : Number(p.tax_rate ?? 20),
    });
  };

  const create = async () => {
    if (!clientName.trim() || !items.some((it) => it.product_name && it.quantity > 0)) {
      setModalError('Client et au moins une ligne sont obligatoires.');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.createInvoice({
        client_id: clientId ? Number(clientId) : null,
        client_name: clientName,
        issue_date: issueDate,
        notes,
        status: 'quote',
        tax_exempt: taxExempt,
        items: items.filter((it) => it.product_name && it.quantity > 0).map((it) => ({
          ...it,
          tax_rate: taxExempt ? 0 : it.tax_rate,
        })),
      });
      setShowModal(false);
      setItems([{ product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, tax_rate: 20 }]);
      setNotes('');
      setTaxExempt(false);
      flash('Devis enregistré (non comptabilisé, stock intact).');
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e.message || 'Erreur', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const convertTo = async (id: number, target: 'invoice' | 'quick_sale') => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res: any = await api.convertQuoteToInvoice(id, { target });
      flash(
        res.message ||
          (target === 'quick_sale'
            ? 'Devis converti en vente rapide.'
            : 'Devis converti en facture.'),
      );
      setConvertId(null);
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e.message || 'Erreur', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const printDoc = (id: number) => {
    openPrintDoc(`/api/invoices/${id}/print`);
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setClientId('');
    setClientName('');
    setIssueDate(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    setNotes('');
    setItems([{ product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, tax_rate: 20 }]);
    setTaxExempt(false);
    setEditingId(null);
    setEditLocked(false);
    setDetailQuote(null);
  };

  const openDetail = async (id: number) => {
    setDetailLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.getInvoice(id);
      const data = res.data;
      setDetailQuote(data);
      setEditingId(Number(data.id));
      setClientId(data.client_id ? String(data.client_id) : '');
      setClientName(data.client_name || '');
      setIssueDate((data.issue_date || '').slice(0, 10) || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
      setNotes(data.notes || '');
      setTaxExempt(!!data.tax_exempt);
      const locked = data.status === 'cancelled';
      setEditLocked(locked);
      const lines = (data.items || []).map((it: any) => ({
        product_id: it.product_id || undefined,
        product_name: it.product_name || '',
        quantity: Number(it.quantity || 0),
        list_price: Number(it.list_price ?? it.catalog_price ?? it.unit_price ?? 0),
        unit_price: Number(it.unit_price || 0),
        tax_rate: Number(it.tax_rate ?? (data.tax_exempt ? 0 : 20)),
        sku: it.sku || '',
      }));
      setItems(lines.length ? lines : [{ product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, tax_rate: 20 }]);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Chargement du devis impossible', 'error');
    } finally {
      setDetailLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const saveEdit = async () => {
    if (!editingId) return;
    if (editLocked) {
      flash('Ce devis est annulé et ne peut plus être modifié.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    if (!clientName.trim() || !items.some((it) => it.product_name && it.quantity > 0)) {
      setModalError('Client et au moins une ligne sont obligatoires.');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.updateInvoice(editingId, {
        client_id: clientId ? Number(clientId) : null,
        client_name: clientName,
        issue_date: issueDate,
        notes,
        tax_exempt: taxExempt,
        items: items
          .filter((it) => it.product_name && it.quantity > 0)
          .map((it) => ({
            ...it,
            tax_rate: taxExempt ? 0 : it.tax_rate,
          })),
      });
      flash('Devis mis à jour.');
      resetForm();
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Enregistrement impossible', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const cancelQuote = async (id: number) => {
    const ok = await confirm({
      title: 'Annuler le devis',
      message: 'Le devis passera au statut annulé. Aucun impact stock.',
      confirmLabel: 'Annuler le devis',
      cancelLabel: 'Retour',
    });
    if (!ok) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.updateInvoiceStatus(id, { status: 'cancelled', void_reason: 'Annulation devis' } as any);
      flash('Devis annulé.');
      resetForm();
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Annulation impossible', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const deleteQuote = (id: number) => {
    setPwTitle('Supprimer le devis');
    setPendingAction(async (password: string) => {
      const res = await api.deleteInvoice(id, password);
      flash((res as any).message || 'Devis supprimé.');
      setPwOpen(false);
      setPendingAction(null);
      resetForm();
      load(true);
    });
    setPwOpen(true);
  };

  const sendQuoteEmail = async (q: any) => {
    const client = clients.find((c) => String(c.id) === String(q.client_id));
    const to = String(q.client_email || client?.email || '').trim();
    if (!to) {
      flash('Aucune adresse e-mail pour ce client.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await api.sendInvoiceEmail(q.id, to);
      flash(`E-mail personnalisé envoyé à ${to} (lien PDF inclus).`);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Envoi impossible', 'error');
    }
  };

  /** Live HT / TVA / TTC for the creation drawer */
  const draftTotals = (() => {
    let ht = 0;
    let tax = 0;
    for (const it of items) {
      const line = Number(it.quantity || 0) * Number(it.unit_price || 0);
      ht += line;
      const rate = taxExempt ? 0 : Number(it.tax_rate ?? 20);
      tax += line * (rate / 100);
    }
    return { ht, tax, ttc: ht + tax };
  })();

  const fmt = (n: number) =>
    Math.round(Number(n || 0)).toLocaleString('fr-FR');

  if (loading) return <div className="empty">Chargement des devis...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="atlas-crm quotes-page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1>Devis</h1>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 14, marginTop: 4 }}>
            Estimation avant vente — non comptabilisée. Convertissez en facture pour encaisser et déduire le stock.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <RefreshIconButton onClick={() => load(true)} loading={refreshing} />
          <button onClick={() => { resetForm(); wz.reset(); setShowModal(true); }}>+ Nouveau devis</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <SaveFeedback message={saveMsg} type={saveMsgType} />

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-filters">
        <div className="ac-products-filters-row">
          <div className="ac-search-field">
            <input
              className="ac-search-input"
              type="search"
              placeholder="Rechercher n°, client, statut…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Rechercher dans les devis"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-table-panel">
        <div className="table-wrap">
          <table className="data-dense ac-products-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>N°</th><th>Client</th><th>Date</th><th>Statut</th>
                <th style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>Total</th><th></th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {filteredQuotes.map((q) => (
                <tr key={q.id}>
                  <td><strong>{q.number}</strong></td>
                  <td>{q.client_name}</td>
                  <td>{q.issue_date}</td>
                  <td><span className={`badge ${statusBadgeClass(q.status)}`}>{statusFr(q.status)}</span></td>
                  <td style={{ textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: 700 }}>{fmt(q.total)}</td>
                  <td style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                      <button type="button" className="secondary" style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => openDetail(q.id)} disabled={detailLoading}>
                        Ouvrir
                      </button>
                      {q.status !== 'cancelled' && (
                        <button type="button" style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => setConvertId(q.id)} disabled={saving}>
                          → Facturer
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {q.status !== 'cancelled' && (
                        <button type="button" className="danger" style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => cancelQuote(q.id)} disabled={saving}>
                          Annuler
                        </button>
                      )}
                      <button type="button" className="danger" style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => deleteQuote(q.id)} disabled={saving}>
                        Suppr.
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {!list.length && (
                <tr><td colSpan={6}>
                    <EmptyState
                      title="Aucun devis"
                      description="Créez une estimation pour un client. Vous pourrez la convertir en facture ensuite."
                      actionLabel="Créer mon premier devis"
                      onAction={() => { resetForm(); setShowModal(true); }}
                      icon="quote"
                    />
                  </td></tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showModal && (
        <FloatingPortal><div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => { if (saving) return; setShowModal(false); resetForm(); wz.reset(); }}>
          <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 1080, width: '96vw' }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h2>Nouveau devis</h2>
            <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 16 }}>
              Non comptabilisé tant qu’il n’est pas converti en facture. Stock non modifié.
            </p>
            <StepBody active={wz.step === 1}>
            <div className="grid grid-2">
              <div className="form-row">
                <label>Client *</label>
                <TypeaheadField
                  value={clientQuery || clientName}
                  placeholder="Rechercher un client…"
                  options={partyTypeaheadOptions(clients, 'client')}
                  onOpen={() => {
                    api.getClients().then((r: any) => {
                      if (Array.isArray(r?.data)) setClients(r.data);
                    }).catch(() => {});
                  }}
                  onChange={(v) => {
                    setClientQuery(v);
                    setClientName(v);
                    setClientId('');
                  }}
                  onPick={(o) => {
                    onClient(String(o.id));
                    setClientQuery(o.label);
                  }}
                  emptyLabel="Aucun client"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="form-row">
                <label>Nom client (libre)</label>
                <input value={clientName} onChange={(e) => { setClientName(e.target.value); setClientQuery(e.target.value); }} placeholder="Monsieur Benane" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Date</label>
              <DatePicker value={issueDate} onChange={setIssueDate} />
            </div>

            <div className="form-row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={!taxExempt}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const enableTva = e.target.checked;
                    setTaxExempt(!enableTva);
                    setItems((prev) =>
                      prev.map((row) => ({
                        ...row,
                        tax_rate: enableTva ? (row.tax_rate > 0 ? row.tax_rate : 20) : 0,
                      })),
                    );
                  }}
                />
                TVA activée (désactiver pour total TTC = HT)
              </label>
              <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)', margin: '6px 0 0' }}>
                {taxExempt
                  ? 'TVA désactivée — totaux calculés à 0 %.'
                  : 'TVA activée — taux par ligne (défaut 20 %).'}
              </p>
            </div>

            </StepBody>
            <StepBody active={wz.step === 2}>
            <h3 style={{ fontSize: 14, margin: '16px 0 8px' }}>Lignes — prix catalogue · prix client (promo)</h3>
            <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: 8 }}>
              Le <strong>prix catalogue</strong> se remplit au choix du produit. Saisissez le <strong>prix client</strong> pour une promo / remise. Les devis ne touchent jamais le stock.
            </p>
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1.1fr 70px 90px 90px 70px 44px', gap: 8, marginBottom: 6, fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
              <span>Produit</span><span>Désignation</span><span>Qté</span><span>Catalogue</span><span>Prix client</span><span>Total</span><span></span>
            </div>
            {items.map((it, i) => {
              const listP = Number(it.list_price || 0);
              const unitP = Number(it.unit_price || 0);
              const promo = listP > 0 && unitP < listP;
              return (
              <div key={i} style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1.1fr 70px 90px 90px 70px 44px', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <TypeaheadField
                      value={(it as any).product_query ?? it.product_name ?? ''}
                      placeholder="Chercher produit (nom / SKU)…"
                      options={productTypeaheadOptions(products)}
                      onChange={(q) => {
                        setItem(i, { product_name: q, product_id: undefined, product_query: q });
                      }}
                      onPick={(o) => {
                        pickProduct(i, String(o.id));
                      }}
                      onOpen={() => {
                        api.getProducts({ fields: 'light', limit: 500 }).then((r: any) => {
                          if (Array.isArray(r?.data)) setProducts(r.data);
                        }).catch(() => {});
                      }}
                      emptyLabel="Aucun produit"
                    />
                  <input placeholder="Désignation" value={it.product_name} onChange={(e) => setItem(i, { product_name: e.target.value })} />
                  <NumberField value={it.quantity} onValueChange={(n) => setItem(i, { quantity: n })} min={0} step="0.01" />
                  <NumberField value={it.list_price} onValueChange={(n) => setItem(i, { list_price: n })} min={0} step="0.01" title="Prix catalogue" />
                  <NumberField value={it.unit_price} onValueChange={(n) => setItem(i, { unit_price: n })} min={0} step="0.01" title="Prix client (promo)" style={promo ? { borderColor: 'var(--success, #3f3f46)' } : undefined} />
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'right' }}>{(Number(it.quantity||0)*unitP).toLocaleString('fr-FR', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}</div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="secondary"
                    title="Supprimer la ligne"
                    aria-label="Supprimer la ligne"
                    style={{ padding: '6px 8px', minWidth: 40 }}
                    onClick={() =>
                      setItems((prev) => {
                        if (prev.length <= 1) {
                          return [{ product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, tax_rate: 20 }];
                        }
                        return prev.filter((_, j) => j !== i);
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                </div>
                {promo && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--success, #3f3f46)', marginTop: 2 }}>
                    Promo −{(listP - unitP).toLocaleString('fr-FR', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} / u ({listP > 0 ? (((listP - unitP) / listP) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0} %)
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              );
            })}
            <button type="button" className="secondary" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }} onClick={() => setItems([...items, { product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, tax_rate: 20 }])}>
              + Ligne
            </button>
            </StepBody>
            <StepBody active={wz.step === 3}>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Notes</label>
              <textarea rows={2} value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div style={{ margin: '12px 0', padding: '12px 14px', background: 'var(--bg-elevated, #f5f2eb)', borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 14 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}><span>HT</span><strong>{fmt(draftTotals.ht)} MAD</strong></div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}><span>TVA</span><strong>{fmt(draftTotals.tax)} MAD</strong></div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginTop: 4, fontSize: 16 }}><span>TTC</span><strong>{fmt(draftTotals.ttc)} MAD</strong></div>
            </div>
            <ModalFormError message={modalError} />
            </StepBody>
            <WizardFoot
              wz={wz}
              title="Nouveau devis"
              stepLabel={['Client', 'Lignes', 'Notes'][wz.step - 1]}
              onCancel={() => { setShowModal(false); resetForm(); wz.reset(); }}
              onSubmit={create}
              submitLabel="Enregistrer le devis"
              saving={saving}
            />
          </div>
        </div></FloatingPortal>
      )}

      {convertId != null && (
        <FloatingPortal><div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => !saving && setConvertId(null)}>
          <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} role="dialog" aria-labelledby="convert-quote-title">
            <h2 id="convert-quote-title" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Convertir le devis</h2>
            <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 14 }}>
              Choisissez le document cible. Le stock sera déduit dans les deux cas.
            </p>
            <div className="form-actions" style={{ flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'stretch', gap: 8 }}>
              <button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={() => convertTo(convertId, 'invoice')}>
                → Facture de vente (FA)
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={saving} onClick={() => convertTo(convertId, 'quick_sale')}>
                → Vente rapide (VR)
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="ghost" disabled={saving} onClick={() => setConvertId(null)}>
                Annuler
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div></FloatingPortal>
      )}

      {detailQuote && (
        <FloatingPortal><div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => !saving && resetForm()}>
          <div
            className="modal"
            style={{ maxWidth: 920, width: '96vw', maxHeight: '92vh', overflow: 'auto' }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
              {editLocked ? 'Devis (lecture seule)' : 'Modifier le devis'} {detailQuote.number}
            </h2>
            <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 0 }}>
              Restez sur cette page — client et lignes sont modifiables ici.
              {editLocked ? ' (annulé : édition bloquée)' : ''}
            </p>

            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 12 }}>
              <div className="form-row">
                <label>Client</label>
                <select
                  value={clientId}
                  disabled={editLocked || saving}
                  onChange={(e) => onClient(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="">— Choisir —</option>
                  {clients.map((c) => (
                    <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="form-row">
                <label>Nom client (libre)</label>
                <input
                  value={clientName}
                  disabled={editLocked || saving}
                  onChange={(e) => setClientName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Monsieur Benane"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Date</label>
              <DatePicker
                value={issueDate}
                disabled={editLocked || saving}
                onChange={setIssueDate}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="form-row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, cursor: editLocked ? 'default' : 'pointer' }}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={!taxExempt}
                  disabled={editLocked || saving}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const enableTva = e.target.checked;
                    setTaxExempt(!enableTva);
                    setItems((prev) =>
                      prev.map((row) => ({
                        ...row,
                        tax_rate: enableTva ? (row.tax_rate > 0 ? row.tax_rate : 20) : 0,
                      })),
                    );
                  }}
                />
                TVA activée (désactiver pour total TTC = HT)
              </label>
            </div>

            <h3 style={{ fontSize: 14, margin: '16px 0 8px' }}>Lignes produit</h3>
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1.1fr 70px 90px 90px 70px 44px', gap: 8, marginBottom: 6, fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
              <span>Produit</span><span>Désignation</span><span>Qté</span><span>Catalogue</span><span>Prix client</span><span>Total</span><span></span>
            </div>
            {items.map((it, i) => {
              const listP = Number(it.list_price || 0);
              const unitP = Number(it.unit_price || 0);
              const promo = listP > 0 && unitP < listP;
              return (
                <div key={i} style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1.1fr 70px 90px 90px 70px 44px', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <input
                      placeholder="Chercher produit (nom / SKU)…"
                      defaultValue=""
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const q = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
                        if (!q) return;
                        const p = products.find((x) =>
                          String(x.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                          String(x.sku || '').toLowerCase() === q ||
                          String(x.barcode || '') === q
                        );
                        if (p) pickProduct(i, String(p.id));
                      }}
                      list={`qp-${i}`}
                      
                    />
                    <datalist id={`qp-${i}`}>
                      {products.slice(0, 80).map((p) => (
                        <option key={p.id} value={p.name}>{p.sku ? p.sku + ' · ' : ''}{Number(p.price || 0)} MAD</option>
                      ))}
                    </datalist>
                    <input
                      placeholder="Désignation"
                      value={it.product_name}
                      disabled={editLocked || saving}
                      onChange={(e) => setItem(i, { product_name: e.target.value })}
                    />
                    <NumberField value={it.quantity} onValueChange={(n) => setItem(i, { quantity: n })} min={0} step="0.01" disabled={editLocked || saving} />
                    <NumberField value={it.list_price} onValueChange={(n) => setItem(i, { list_price: n })} min={0} step="0.01" disabled={editLocked || saving} title="Prix catalogue" />
                    <NumberField value={it.unit_price} onValueChange={(n) => setItem(i, { unit_price: n })} min={0} step="0.01" disabled={editLocked || saving} title="Prix client" style={promo ? { borderColor: 'var(--success, #3f3f46)' } : undefined} />
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, textAlign: 'right' }}>{(Number(it.quantity || 0) * unitP).toLocaleString('fr-FR', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}</div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="secondary"
                      title="Supprimer la ligne"
                      disabled={editLocked || saving || items.length <= 1}
                      style={{ padding: '6px 8px', minWidth: 40 }}
                      onClick={() =>
                      setItems((prev) => {
                        if (prev.length <= 1) {
                          return [{ product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, tax_rate: 20 }];
                        }
                        return prev.filter((_, j) => j !== i);
                      })
                    }
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
            {!editLocked && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="secondary"
                style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}
                disabled={saving}
                onClick={() => setItems([...items, { product_name: '', quantity: 1, list_price: 0, unit_price: 0, tax_rate: taxExempt ? 0 : 20 }])}
              >
                + Ligne
              </button>
            )}

            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Notes</label>
              <textarea rows={2} value={notes} disabled={editLocked || saving} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} />
            </div>

            <div style={{ margin: '12px 0', padding: '12px 14px', background: 'var(--bg-elevated, #f5f2eb)', borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 14 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}><span>HT</span><strong>{fmt(draftTotals.ht)} MAD</strong></div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}><span>TVA</span><strong>{fmt(draftTotals.tax)} MAD</strong></div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginTop: 4, fontSize: 16 }}><span>TTC</span><strong>{fmt(draftTotals.ttc)} MAD</strong></div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-actions" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {!editLocked && (
                <button type="button" onClick={saveEdit} disabled={saving}>
                  {saving ? 'Enregistrement…' : 'Enregistrer les modifications'}
                </button>
              )}
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => printDoc(detailQuote.id)}>PDF</button>
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => sendQuoteEmail(detailQuote)}>E-mail</button>
              {!editLocked && detailQuote.status !== 'cancelled' && (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => { const id = detailQuote.id; resetForm(); setConvertId(id); }}>
                  → Facturer
                </button>
              )}
              {!editLocked && (
                <button type="button" className="danger" onClick={() => cancelQuote(detailQuote.id)} disabled={saving}>
                  Annuler le devis
                </button>
              )}
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => resetForm()} disabled={saving}>
                Fermer
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div></FloatingPortal>
      )}

      {pwOpen && pendingAction && (
        <PasswordConfirm
          open={pwOpen}
          title={pwTitle}
          onCancel={() => { setPwOpen(false); setPendingAction(null); }}
          onConfirm={async (password: string) => {
            try {
              await pendingAction(password);
            } catch (e: any) {
              flash(e?.message || 'Action refusée', 'error');
              throw e;
            }
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { onAgentDraft } from '../lib/agentDraft';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import DatePicker from '../components/DatePicker';
import { api, BASE } from '../api';
import { getToken } from '../auth';
import SaveFeedback from '../components/SaveFeedback';
import { paymentMethodFr } from '../lib/labels';
import PasswordConfirm from '../components/PasswordConfirm';
import { useUi } from '../components/AppDialogs';
import { numStr, numFromInput } from '../lib/numInput';
import NumberField from '../components/NumberField';
import EmptyState from '../components/EmptyState';
import RefreshIconButton from '../components/RefreshIconButton';
import { FloatingPortal } from '../components/FloatingPortal';
import { useWizard, StepBody, WizardFoot } from '../components/ui/FormWizard';
import { ModalFormError, FieldHint } from '../components/ModalFormFeedback';

export default function Receipts() {
  const [modalError, setModalError] = useState('');
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const { confirm } = useUi();
  const [list, setList] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const wz = useWizard(2);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveMsg, setSaveMsg] = useState('');
  const [saveMsgType, setSaveMsgType] = useState<'success' | 'error'>('success');

  const [invoiceId, setInvoiceId] = useState<number | ''>('');
  const [clientName, setClientName] = useState('');
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(0);
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState('cash');
  const [issueDate, setIssueDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');

  // Delete OTP state
  const [pwOpen, setPwOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pwTitle, setPwTitle] = useState('');
  const [pwDesc, setPwDesc] = useState('');
  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<null | ((password: string) => Promise<void>)>(null);

  const flash = (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setSaveMsg(msg); setSaveMsgType(type);
    setTimeout(() => setSaveMsg(''), 4500);
  };

  const load = (soft = false) => {
    if (soft) setRefreshing(true);
    else setLoading(true);
    Promise.all([api.getReceipts(), api.getInvoices()])
      .then(([r, inv]) => { setList(r.data); setInvoices(inv.data); })
      .finally(() => {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      });
  };
  
  useEffect(() => {
    const onLists = () => {
      try { load(true); } catch { /* */ }
    };
    window.addEventListener('atlas-lists-refresh', onLists as EventListener);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('atlas-lists-refresh', onLists as EventListener);
  }, []);

  
  useEffect(() => {
    return onAgentDraft((d) => {
      if (d.entity && d.entity !== 'receipt') return;
      setModalError('');
      setShowModal(true);
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);


  const selectInvoice = (id: number | '') => {
    setInvoiceId(id);
    if (id) {
      const inv = invoices.find((x) => x.id === id);
      if (inv) {
        setClientName(inv.client_name);
        setAmount(Number(inv.total) - Number(inv.amount_paid || 0));
      }
    }
  };

  const create = async () => {
    if (!clientName || amount <= 0) { flash('Le nom du client et le montant sont obligatoires.', 'error'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.createReceipt({
        invoice_id: invoiceId || undefined, client_name: clientName, amount,
        payment_method: paymentMethod, issue_date: issueDate, notes,
      });
      setShowModal(false);
      setClientName(''); setAmount(0); setNotes(''); setInvoiceId('');
      flash('Reçu enregistré dans la base de données avec succès.');
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) { setModalError(e?.message || 'Enregistrement impossible'); } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const toggleSituation = async (r: any) => {
    const next = !(Number(r.include_client_situation) === 1);
    try {
      const res: any = await api.setReceiptClientSituation(r.id, next);
      flash(res.message || (next ? 'Situation activée pour ce reçu — réimprimez.' : 'Situation désactivée pour ce reçu.'));
      const resList: any = await api.getReceipts();
      setList(resList.data || resList || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Erreur', 'error');
    }
  };

  const requestDelete = async (id: number) => {
    let disclaimer = 'Cette action est définitive. Confirmez pour continuer.';
    let cascade_invoice = false;
    try {
      const links = await api.getReceiptLinks(id);
      const d = links.data;
      if (d?.disclaimer || d?.expenses?.length || d?.invoice) {
        const bits: string[] = [];
        if (d.expenses?.length) bits.push(`${d.expenses.length} écriture(s) solde`);
        if (d.invoice) bits.push(`liée à la facture ${d.invoice.number}`);
        disclaimer =
          `ATTENTION : suppression du reçu` + (bits.length ? ` (${bits.join(', ')})` : '') +
          '. Les écritures de solde liées seront aussi supprimées. Confirmez pour continuer.';
      }
      // Ask cascade BEFORE password so dialogs never stack on each other
      if (d?.invoice) {
        cascade_invoice = await confirm({
          title: 'Reçu lié à une facture',
          message: `Ce reçu est lié à la facture ${d.invoice.number}.\nOui = supprimer aussi la facture et ses paiements.\nNon = supprimer seulement le reçu et le solde lié.`,
          confirmLabel: 'Tout supprimer',
          cancelLabel: 'Reçu uniquement',
          danger: true,
        });
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setPwTitle('Supprimer le reçu et éléments liés');
    setPwDesc(disclaimer);
    setPendingAction(() => async (password: string) => {
      const res = await api.deleteReceipt(id, password, cascade_invoice);
      flash((res as any).message || 'Reçu supprimé.');
      setPwOpen(false); setPendingAction(null);
      load(true);
    });
    setPwOpen(true);
  };

  const fmt = (n: number) => Math.round(Number(n || 0)).toLocaleString('fr-FR');
  const filtered = list.filter((r) => !search || r.number?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || r.client_name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));
  const token = encodeURIComponent(getToken() || '');

  if (loading) return <div className="empty">Chargement des reçus...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="receipts-page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h1>Reçus</h1>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <RefreshIconButton onClick={() => load(true)} loading={refreshing} />
          <button onClick={() => { setModalError(''); setShowModal(true); }}>+ Nouveau reçu</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <SaveFeedback message={saveMsg} type={saveMsgType} />

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-filters">
        <div className="search-bar"><input className="search-input" placeholder="Rechercher par numéro ou nom de client..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} /></div>
      </div>

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-table-panel">
        <div className="table-wrap">
          <table className="data-dense ac-products-table">
            <thead>
              <tr><th>Numéro</th><th>Client</th><th>Montant</th><th>Mode</th><th>Date</th><th>Facture</th><th>Actions</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {filtered.map((r) => (
                <tr key={r.id}>
                  <td><strong>{r.number}</strong></td>
                  <td>{r.client_name}</td>
                  <td style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--success)' }}>{fmt(r.amount)}</td>
                  <td><span className="badge info">{paymentMethodFr(r.payment_method)}</span></td>
                  <td>{r.issue_date}</td>
                  <td>{r.invoice_number ? <strong>{r.invoice_number}</strong> : (r.invoice_id ? `#${r.invoice_id}` : '—')}</td>
                  <td>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', pointerEvents: 'auto' }}>
                      <a className="btn secondary" style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }} href={`${BASE}/api/receipts/${r.id}/print?layout=full&token=${token}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Reçu détail</a>
                      <a className="btn secondary" style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }} href={`${BASE}/api/receipts/${r.id}/print?layout=minimal&token=${token}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Ticket minimal</a>
                      <a className="btn secondary" style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }} href={`${BASE}/api/receipts/${r.id}/pdf?token=${token}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">PDF</a>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="secondary"
                        style={{
                          padding: '4px 10px',
                          fontSize: 12,
                          cursor: 'pointer',
                          borderColor: Number(r.include_client_situation) === 1 ? 'var(--ok, #3f3f46)' : undefined,
                          background: Number(r.include_client_situation) === 1 ? 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12)' : undefined,
                        }}
                        title="Affiche le QR situation client uniquement sur ce reçu (paramètre global reste inchangé)"
                        onClick={() => toggleSituation(r)}
                      >
                        {Number(r.include_client_situation) === 1 ? 'Situation QR : ON' : 'Situation QR'}
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" className="danger" style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12, background: '#6b2828', cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={() => requestDelete(r.id)}>Suppr.</button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {!filtered.length && (
                <tr><td colSpan={7}>
                    <EmptyState
                      title="Aucun reçu"
                      description="Créez un reçu manuellement, ou soldez une facture (un reçu est généré automatiquement)."
                      actionLabel="Créer mon premier reçu"
                      onAction={() => { setModalError(''); wz.reset(); setShowModal(true); }}
                      icon="receipt"
                    />
                  </td></tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showModal && (
        <FloatingPortal><div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => { setShowModal(false); wz.reset(); }}>
          <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h2>Nouveau reçu</h2>
            <StepBody active={wz.step === 1}>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label>Lier à une facture (optionnel)</label>
              <select value={invoiceId} onChange={(e) => selectInvoice(e.target.value ? numFromInput(e.target.value) : '')}>
                <option value="">— Reçu indépendant —</option>
                {invoices.filter((i) => i.status !== 'paid' && i.status !== 'cancelled').map((inv) => (
                  <option key={inv.id} value={inv.id}>{inv.number} — {inv.client_name} (Reste : {fmt(Number(inv.total) - Number(inv.amount_paid || 0))})</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-2">
              <div className="form-row"><label>Nom du client *</label><input value={clientName} onChange={(e) => setClientName(e.target.value)} /></div>
              <div className="form-row"><label>Montant *</label><NumberField value={amount} onValueChange={setAmount} step="0.01" min={0.01} /></div>

            <StepBody active={wz.step === 2}>

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api } from '../api';
import { openPrintDoc } from '../lib/reports';
import SaveFeedback from '../components/SaveFeedback';
import EmptyState from '../components/EmptyState';
import RefreshIconButton from '../components/RefreshIconButton';
import RemboursementModal from '../components/RemboursementModal';
import PasswordConfirm from '../components/PasswordConfirm';
import { useUi } from '../components/AppDialogs';
import { statusFr, statusBadgeClass } from '../lib/labels';
import { fmtMoney } from '../lib/money';

function isRemboursement(inv: any) {
  const kind = String(inv.doc_kind || '').toLowerCase();
  const st = String(inv.status || '').toLowerCase();
  const num = String(inv.number || '');
  return kind === 'remboursement' || st === 'remboursement' || num.startsWith('WR');
}

export default function Reimbursements() {
  const { confirm } = useUi();
  const [list, setList] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [saveMsg, setSaveMsg] = useState('');
  const [saveMsgType, setSaveMsgType] = useState<'success' | 'error'>('success');
  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false);
  const [pwOpen, setPwOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pendingDeleteId, setPendingDeleteId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const flash = (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setSaveMsg(msg);
    setSaveMsgType(type);
    setTimeout(() => setSaveMsg(''), 4500);
  };

  const load = (soft = false) => {
    if (soft) setRefreshing(true);
    else setLoading(true);
    Promise.all([
      api.getInvoices('remboursement', { kind: 'all' }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
      api.getInvoices(undefined, { kind: 'all' }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
    ])
      .then(([byStatus, all]) => {
        const merged = [...(byStatus.data || []), ...(all.data || [])];
        const map = new Map<number, any>();
        for (const inv of merged) {
          if (inv?.id != null && isRemboursement(inv)) map.set(inv.id, inv);
        }
        setList(
          Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) =>
            String(b.issue_date || '').localeCompare(String(a.issue_date || '')),
          ),
        );
      })
      .catch((e: any) => flash(e?.message || 'Chargement impossible', 'error'))
      .finally(() => {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      });
  };

  
  useEffect(() => {
    const onLists = () => {
      try { load(true); } catch { /* */ }
    };
    window.addEventListener('atlas-lists-refresh', onLists as EventListener);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('atlas-lists-refresh', onLists as EventListener);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const filtered = list.filter((inv) => {
    if (!search.trim()) return true;
    const s = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return (
      String(inv.number || '').toLowerCase().includes(s) ||
      String(inv.client_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(s) ||
      String(inv.notes || '').toLowerCase().includes(s)
    );
  });

  const printDoc = (id: number) => openPrintDoc(`/api/invoices/${id}/print`);

  const sendEmail = async (inv: any) => {
    const to = String(inv.client_email || '').trim();
    if (!to) {
      flash('Aucune adresse e-mail client sur ce document.', 'error');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await api.sendInvoiceEmail(inv.id, to);
      flash(`E-mail envoyé à ${to} (PDF inclus).`);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Envoi impossible', 'error');
    }
  };

  const requestDeleteWr = async (inv: any) => {
    const ok = await confirm({
      title: `Supprimer ${inv.number || 'cet avoir WR'} ?`,
      message:
        'La suppression annule le remboursement :\n' +
        '• stock re-déduit pour les articles remis en stock\n' +
        '• crédit retiré de la facture d’origine (si elle existe encore)\n' +
        '• sortie de caisse / solde annulée (argent rétabli)\n\n' +
        'Cette action est définitive.',
      confirmLabel: 'Continuer',
      cancelLabel: 'Retour',
    });
    if (!ok) return;
    setPendingDeleteId(inv.id);
    setPwOpen(true);
  };

  const confirmDeleteWr = async (password: string) => {
    if (pendingDeleteId == null) return;
    try {
      const res: any = await api.deleteInvoice(pendingDeleteId, password);
      flash(res?.message || 'Avoir WR supprimé — stock et solde rétabli.');
      setPwOpen(false);
      setPendingDeleteId(null);
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      flash(e?.message || 'Suppression refusée', 'error');
      throw e;
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="empty">Chargement des remboursements…</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1>Remboursements</h1>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 14, marginTop: 4 }}>
            Documents WR exclusivement — isolés des factures FA, devis et tickets VR.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <RefreshIconButton onClick={() => load(true)} loading={refreshing} />
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowCreate(true)}>
            + Remboursement (WR)
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <SaveFeedback message={saveMsg} type={saveMsgType} />

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-filters">
        <div className="ac-products-filters-row">
          <div className="ac-search-field">
            <input
              className="ac-search-input"
              type="search"
              placeholder="Rechercher n°, client…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Rechercher remboursements"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-table-panel">
        <div className="table-wrap">
          <table className="data-dense ac-products-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>N°</th>
                <th>Client</th>
                <th>Date</th>
                <th>Statut</th>
                <th style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>Total</th>
                <th></th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {filtered.map((inv) => (

          onConfirm={confirmDeleteWr}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );

      for (const part of qs.split('&')) {
        const [k, v] = part.split('=');

/**
 * Scan code-barres — same pipeline as the old phone terrain scan
 * (Quagga2 / html5-qrcode / ZXing via barcodeScan.ts).
 *
 * Unknown code → popup proposing a *product creation request* (code + optional
 * photo/name, never a price — a PC user completes the product later).
 * Desktop (PC) also lists open requests with a "Créer produit" shortcut.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api } from '../api';
import { canManageStock } from '../auth';
import {
  startBarcodeScan,
  decodeImageFile,
  preloadBarcodeScanner,
  type ScanStop,
} from '../lib/barcodeScan';

type Hit = {
  id: number;
  name?: string;
  sku?: string;
  barcode?: string;
  stock_quantity?: number;
  price?: number;
};

type ProductRequest = {
  id: number;
  code: string;
  name?: string;
  sku?: string;
  unit?: string;
  quantity?: number;
  category?: string;
  note?: string;
  photo_url?: string;
  status: string;
  created_by?: string;
  created_at?: string;
};

function useIsNarrow(): boolean {
  const [narrow, setNarrow] = useState(() =>
    typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches : false,
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)');
    const fn = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setNarrow(e.matches);
    mq.addEventListener('change', fn);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', fn);
  }, []);
  return narrow;
}

function readFileAsDataUrl(file: File): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const fr = new FileReader();
    fr.onload = () => resolve(String(fr.result || ''));
    fr.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Lecture du fichier impossible'));
    fr.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

const SCAN_UNITS = ['unité', 'pièce', 'kg', 'g', 'L', 'mL', 'm', 'carton', 'boîte', 'paquet', 'sachet'];

export default function Scan() {
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const narrow = useIsNarrow();
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [opMode, setOpMode] = useState<'vente' | 'receive' | 'transfer' | 'count'>('vente');
  const [opQty, setOpQty] = useState('1');
  const [opLot, setOpLot] = useState('');
  const [opExpiry, setOpExpiry] = useState('');
  const [opWh, setOpWh] = useState('');
  const [opWh2, setOpWh2] = useState('');
  const [opMsg, setOpMsg] = useState('');
  const [opErr, setOpErr] = useState('');
  const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState<any[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => { api.getStockLocations().then((r: any) => setWarehouses(r?.data || [])).catch(() => {}); }, []);
  const runOp = async () => {
    setOpErr(''); setOpMsg(''); setBusy(true);
    try {
      const code = q.trim().toLowerCase();
      const pr: any = await api.getProducts();
      const prod = (pr?.data || []).find((x: any) => String(x.barcode || '').toLowerCase() === code || String(x.sku || '').toLowerCase() === code);
      if (!prod) { setOpErr('Code inconnu pour cette opération — scannez un produit existant.'); return; }
      const qty = Number(opQty);
      if (opMode === 'receive') {
        const r: any = await api.stockReceive({ product_id: prod.id, quantity: qty, location_id: opWh ? Number(opWh) : undefined, lot: opLot, expiry: opExpiry });
        setOpMsg(`Réception ✓ — stock ${prod.name} : ${r?.data?.stock_quantity ?? '?'}`);
      } else if (opMode === 'count') {
        const r: any = await api.stockCount({ product_id: prod.id, quantity: qty, location_id: opWh ? Number(opWh) : undefined });
        setOpMsg(`Inventaire ✓ — stock ${prod.name} : ${r?.data?.stock_quantity ?? qty}`);
      } else {
        await api.stockTransfer({ product_id: prod.id, quantity: qty, from_location_id: Number(opWh), to_location_id: Number(opWh2) });
        setOpMsg(`Transfert ✓ — ${prod.name}`);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setOpErr(e?.message || 'Erreur opération');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [scanning, setScanning] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [hit, setHit] = useState<Hit | null>(null);
  const [unknown, setUnknown] = useState(false);
  const readerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const stopRef = useRef<ScanStop | null>(null);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  // Product-creation request (unknown barcode)
  const [reqOpen, setReqOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reqName, setReqName] = useState('');
  const [reqNote, setReqNote] = useState('');
  const [reqPhoto, setReqPhoto] = useState(''); // data URL preview + payload
  const [reqSku, setReqSku] = useState('');
  const [reqUnit, setReqUnit] = useState('unité');
  const [reqQty, setReqQty] = useState('1');
  const [reqCat, setReqCat] = useState('');
  const [reqCats, setReqCats] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [reqUnits, setReqUnits] = useState<string[]>(SCAN_UNITS);
  const [reqErrors, setReqErrors] = useState<{ name?: string; unit?: string; qty?: string }>({});
  const [reqBusy, setReqBusy] = useState(false);
  const [reqMsg, setReqMsg] = useState('');
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const reqPhotoRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState<ProductRequest[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canManageStock()) nav('/', { replace: true });
  }, [nav]);

  useEffect(() => {
    preloadBarcodeScanner();
    return () => {
      try { stopRef.current?.(); } catch { /* */ }
      stopRef.current = null;
    };
  }, []);

  const loadRequests = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const r: any = await api.listProductRequests('open');
      setRequests((r?.data || []) as ProductRequest[]);
    } catch { /* silent — panel is best-effort */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (narrow) return; // mobile stays minimal
    void loadRequests();
  }, [narrow, loadRequests]);

  // Unknown code → open the request popup automatically
  useEffect(() => {
    if (unknown) {
      setReqOpen(true);
      setReqMsg('');
      setReqErrors({});
      setReqSku(q.trim());
      api
        .getUnits()
        .then((r: any) => {
          const list = (r?.data || []).map((u: any) => String(u.name || u.label || '')).filter(Boolean);
          setReqUnits(list.length ? list : SCAN_UNITS);
        })
        .catch(() => setReqUnits(SCAN_UNITS));
      api
        .getProducts({ fields: 'light', limit: 500 })
        .then((r: any) => {
          const cats = Array.from(
            new Set((r?.data || []).map((pp: any) => String(pp.category || '')).filter(Boolean)),
          ) as string[];
          setReqCats(cats);
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [unknown]);

  const stopCamera = () => {
    try { stopRef.current?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    stopRef.current = null;
    if (readerRef.current) readerRef.current.innerHTML = '';
    setScanning(false);
  };

  const resolveCode = async (raw: string) => {
    const c = raw.trim();
    if (!c) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    setHit(null);
    setUnknown(false);
    try {
      const res = await api.scanBarcode(c);
      const data = (res as any)?.data as Hit | undefined;
      if (data && data.id) {
        setHit(data);
        setQ(c);
      } else {
        setUnknown(true);
        setQ(c);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (e?.status === 404 || e?.code === 'NOT_FOUND') {
        setUnknown(true);
        setQ(c);
      } else {
        // fallback list search
        try {
          const r = await api.getProducts({ q: c, limit: 5 });
          const rows = ((r as any)?.data || []) as Hit[];
          const exact =
            rows.find(
              (p) =>
                String(p.barcode || '').toLowerCase() === c.toLowerCase() ||
                String(p.sku || '').toLowerCase() === c.toLowerCase(),
            ) || rows[0];
          if (exact) setHit(exact);
          else setUnknown(true);
          setQ(c);
        } catch {
          setErr(e?.message || 'Recherche impossible');
        }
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const startCamera = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    setErr('');
    stopCamera();
    setScanning(true);
    // wait for reader div
    await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)));
    const el = readerRef.current;
    if (!el) {
      setErr('Zone caméra indisponible');
      setScanning(false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const stop = await startBarcodeScan(el, (text) => {
        const t = String(text || '').trim();
        if (!t) return;
        stopCamera();
        void resolveCode(t);
      });
      stopRef.current = stop;
    } catch (e: any) {
      setScanning(false);
      setErr(e?.message || 'Caméra indisponible — autorisez l’accès ou saisissez le code.');
    }
  };

  const onPickImage = async (file: File | null) => {
    if (!file) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      const text = await decodeImageFile(file);
      if (!text) {
        setErr('Aucun code détecté dans l’image.');
      } else {
        await resolveCode(text);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e?.message || 'Lecture image impossible');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const closeReqModal = () => {
    setReqOpen(false);
    setReqName('');
    setReqNote('');
    setReqPhoto('');
    setReqMsg('');
    setReqSku('');
    setReqUnit('unité');
    setReqQty('1');
    setReqCat('');
    setReqErrors({});
  };

  const submitRequest = async () => {
    if (!q.trim() || reqBusy) return;
    const errs: { name?: string; unit?: string; qty?: string } = {};
    if (!reqName.trim()) errs.name = 'Nom obligatoire';
    if (!reqUnit) errs.unit = 'Unité obligatoire';
    const qtyN = Number(String(reqQty).replace(',', '.'));
    if (!String(reqQty).trim() || !Number.isFinite(qtyN) || qtyN < 0) errs.qty = 'Quantité obligatoire (0 ou plus)';
    setReqErrors(errs);
    if (Object.keys(errs).length) return;
    setReqBusy(true);
    setReqMsg('');
    try {
      await api.createProductRequest({
        code: q.trim(),
        name: reqName.trim(),
        sku: reqSku.trim() || q.trim(),
        unit: reqUnit,
        quantity: qtyN,
        category: reqCat.trim() || undefined,
        note: reqNote.trim() || undefined,
        photo_data_url: reqPhoto || undefined,
      });
      closeReqModal();
      setUnknown(false);
      setErr('');
      setHit(null);
      setSent(true);
      void loadRequests();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setReqMsg(e?.message || 'Envoi impossible — réessayez');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      setReqBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const createProductFromRequest = (r: ProductRequest) => {
    nav('/products', {
      state: {
        newWithBarcode: r.code,
        newWithName: r.name || '',
        newWithSku: r.sku || r.code,
        newWithUnit: r.unit || 'unité',
        newWithQuantity: Number(r.quantity || 0),
        newWithCategory: r.category || '',
      },
    });
  };

  const dismissRequest = async (r: ProductRequest) => {
    try {
      await api.closeProductRequest(r.id, { status: 'dismissed' });
      setRequests((rows) => rows.filter((x) => x.id !== r.id));
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e?.message || 'Impossible de rejeter la demande');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="scan-page">
      <header className="scan-hero">
        <p className="scan-eyebrow">Scan</p>
        <h1 className="scan-title">Que scannez-vous&nbsp;?</h1>
        <p className="scan-lead">
          1) Ouvrez <strong>Caméra</strong> · 2) Placez le code dans le cadre · 3) Tenez stable 1&nbsp;s.
          Sinon : image ou saisie manuelle.
        </p>
      </header>

      {scanning ? (
        <div className="scan-cam-wrap">
          <div id="scan-reader" ref={readerRef} className="scan-reader" />
          <button type="button" className="scan-cam-stop" onClick={stopCamera}>
            Fermer la caméra
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="scan-actions-row">
          <button type="button" className="scan-btn-primary" onClick={() => void startCamera()} disabled={busy}>
            Caméra
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="scan-btn-secondary"
            onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
            disabled={busy}
          >
            Image
          </button>
          <input
            ref={fileRef}
            type="file"
            accept="image/*"
            capture="environment"
            hidden
            onChange={(e) => {
              const f = e.target.files?.[0] || null;
              e.target.value = '';
              void onPickImage(f);
            }}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="scan-ops-chips" role="tablist" aria-label="Mode de scan">
        {([['vente', 'Vente'], ['receive', 'Réception'], ['transfer', 'Transfert']] as const).map(([m, lbl]) => (
          <button key={m} type="button" className={`secondary${opMode === m ? ' is-active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setOpMode(m); setOpErr(''); setOpMsg(''); }}>
            {lbl}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {opMode !== 'vente' && (
        <form
          className="scan-form scan-ops-form"
          onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void runOp(); }}
        >
          <div className="scan-row">
            <input className="scan-input" type="number" step="any" min="0" value={opQty} onChange={(e) => setOpQty(e.target.value)} placeholder="Quantité" aria-label="Quantité" />
            {opMode === 'receive' && (
              <>
                <input className="scan-input" value={opLot} onChange={(e) => setOpLot(e.target.value)} placeholder="Lot (optionnel)" aria-label="Lot" />
                <input className="scan-input" type="date" value={opExpiry} onChange={(e) => setOpExpiry(e.target.value)} aria-label="Expiration" />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          {(opMode === 'receive' || opMode === 'count') && warehouses.length > 0 && (
            <select className="scan-input" value={opWh} onChange={(e) => setOpWh(e.target.value)} aria-label="Dépôt">
              <option value="">Dépôt principal</option>
              {warehouses.map((w: any) => <option key={w.id} value={w.id}>{w.name}</option>)}
            </select>
          )}
          {opMode === 'transfer' && (
            <div className="scan-row">
              <select className="scan-input" value={opWh} onChange={(e) => setOpWh(e.target.value)} aria-label="Dépôt source">
                {warehouses.map((w: any) => <option key={w.id} value={w.id}>{w.name} (source)</option>)}
              </select>
              <select className="scan-input" value={opWh2} onChange={(e) => setOpWh2(e.target.value)} aria-label="Dépôt destination">
                {warehouses.map((w: any) => <option key={w.id} value={w.id}>{w.name} (dest.)</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}
          <button type="submit" className="scan-submit" disabled={busy}>{opMode === 'receive' ? 'Réceptionner' : opMode === 'transfer' ? 'Transférer' : 'Compter'}</button>
          {opErr ? <div className="scan-alert" role="alert">{opErr}</div> : null}
          {opMsg ? <div className="scan-alert scan-alert--ok" role="status">{opMsg}</div> : null}
        </form>
      )}

      <form
        className="scan-form"
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setSent(false);
          void resolveCode(q);
        }}
      >
        <label className="scan-label" htmlFor="scan-code">
          Code-barres ou SKU
        </label>
        <div className="scan-row">
          <input
            id="scan-code"
            ref={inputRef}
            className="scan-input"
            value={q}
            onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Scannez ou saisissez un code"
            autoComplete="off"
            enterKeyHint="search"
          />
          <button type="submit" className="scan-submit" disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? '…' : 'Chercher'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {err ? (
        <div className="scan-alert" role="alert">
          {err}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {sent && !err ? (
        <div className="scan-alert scan-alert--ok" role="status">
          Demande de création envoyée ✓ — un utilisateur PC complétera le produit (prix, etc.).
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {hit ? (
        <article className="scan-result">
          <h2>{hit.name || 'Produit'}</h2>
          <dl className="scan-meta">
            <div>
              <dt>SKU</dt>
              <dd>{hit.sku || '—'}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Code-barres</dt>
              <dd>{hit.barcode || '—'}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Stock</dt>
              <dd className="tabular">{hit.stock_quantity ?? '—'}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Prix</dt>
              <dd className="tabular">{hit.price != null ? `${hit.price} MAD` : '—'}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          <div className="scan-actions">
            <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => nav('/products')}>
              Voir le stock
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setQ('');
                setHit(null);
                setUnknown(false);
                setSent(false);
                setErr('');
                inputRef.current?.focus();
              }}
            >
              Nouveau scan
            </button>
          </div>
        </article>
      ) : unknown ? (
        <div className="scan-alert scan-alert--muted" role="status">
          Code <strong>{q}</strong> inconnu — aucun produit correspondant.
        </div>
      ) : !scanning ? (
        <div className="scan-empty">
          <p>Le résultat du scan apparaîtra ici.</p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── Desktop (PC): open creation requests ── */}
      {!narrow && requests.length > 0 && (
        <section className="scan-requests" aria-label="Demandes de création">
          <h2 className="scan-requests-title">
            Demandes de création ({requests.length})
          </h2>
          <p className="scan-requests-lead">
            Envoyées depuis le scan (code inconnu). Créez le produit avec son prix, puis rejetez la demande.
          </p>
          <ul className="scan-requests-list">
            {requests.map((r) => (
              <li key={r.id} className="scan-requests-row">
                {r.photo_url ? (
                  <img className="scan-requests-photo" src={r.photo_url} alt="" loading="lazy" />
                ) : (
                  <span className="scan-requests-photo scan-requests-photo--none" aria-hidden />
                )}
                <div className="scan-requests-info">
                  <strong>{r.code}</strong>
                  {r.name ? <span>{r.name}</span> : null}
                  <em>
                    {r.created_by || '—'}
                    {r.created_at ? ` · ${String(r.created_at).replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)}` : ''}
                  </em>
                </div>
                <div className="scan-requests-actions">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => createProductFromRequest(r)}>
                    Créer produit
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => void dismissRequest(r)}>
                    Rejeter
                  </button>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* ── Unknown code → creation request popup ── */}
      {reqOpen && (
        <div className="scan-req-bg" role="presentation" onClick={closeReqModal}>
          <div
            className="scan-req-modal"
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-label="Demander la création du produit"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <h2>Produit introuvable</h2>
            <p className="scan-req-sub">
              Le code <strong>{q}</strong> n’existe pas encore. Envoyez une demande de création —
              le prix et le stock seront complétés sur PC.
            </p>
            <label className="scan-req-label" htmlFor="scan-req-barcode">Code-barres (automatique)</label>
            <input
              id="scan-req-barcode"
              className="scan-req-input"
              value={q}
              readOnly
              style={{ opacity: 0.75 }}
            />
            <label className="scan-req-label" htmlFor="scan-req-sku">SKU (automatique)</label>
            <input
              id="scan-req-sku"
              className="scan-req-input"
              value={reqSku}
              onChange={(e) => setReqSku(e.target.value)}
            />
            <label className="scan-req-label" htmlFor="scan-req-name">
              Nom du produit *
            </label>
            <input
              id="scan-req-name"
              className={`scan-req-input${reqErrors.name ? ' scan-req-input--err' : ''}`}
              value={reqName}
              onChange={(e) => { setReqName(e.target.value); setReqErrors((x) => ({ ...x, name: '' })); }}
              placeholder="Ex. Café moulu 250 g"
            />
            {reqErrors.name ? <span className="scan-req-err">{reqErrors.name}</span> : null}
            <div className="scan-req-grid">
              <div>
                <label className="scan-req-label" htmlFor="scan-req-unit">Unité *</label>
                <select
                  id="scan-req-unit"
                  className={`scan-req-input${reqErrors.unit ? ' scan-req-input--err' : ''}`}
                  value={reqUnit}
                  onChange={(e) => { setReqUnit(e.target.value); setReqErrors((x) => ({ ...x, unit: '' })); }}
                >
                  {reqUnits.map((u) => (
                    <option key={u} value={u}>{u}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                {reqErrors.unit ? <span className="scan-req-err">{reqErrors.unit}</span> : null}
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="scan-req-label" htmlFor="scan-req-qty">Quantité *</label>
                <input
                  id="scan-req-qty"
                  className={`scan-req-input${reqErrors.qty ? ' scan-req-input--err' : ''}`}
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  value={reqQty}
                  onChange={(e) => { setReqQty(e.target.value); setReqErrors((x) => ({ ...x, qty: '' })); }}
                  placeholder="0"
                />
                {reqErrors.qty ? <span className="scan-req-err">{reqErrors.qty}</span> : null}
              </div>
            </div>
            <label className="scan-req-label" htmlFor="scan-req-cat">Catégorie</label>
            <select
              id="scan-req-cat"
              className="scan-req-input"
              value={reqCat}
              onChange={(e) => setReqCat(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="">— choisir —</option>
              {reqCats.map((cc) => (
                <option key={cc} value={cc}>{cc}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <label className="scan-req-label" htmlFor="scan-req-photo">
              Photo (optionnel)
            </label>
            <div className="scan-req-photo-row">
              <button
                type="button"
                id="scan-req-photo"
                className="scan-req-photo-btn secondary"
                onClick={() => reqPhotoRef.current?.click()}
              >
                {reqPhoto ? 'Changer la photo' : 'Prendre / choisir une photo'}
              </button>
              {reqPhoto ? (
                <img className="scan-req-thumb" src={reqPhoto} alt="Aperçu de la photo" />
              ) : null}
            </div>
            <input
              ref={reqPhotoRef}
              type="file"
              accept="image/*"
              capture="environment"
              hidden
              onChange={(e) => {
                const f = e.target.files?.[0];
                e.target.value = '';
                if (!f) return;
                void readFileAsDataUrl(f)
                  .then((d) => setReqPhoto(d))
                  .catch(() => setReqMsg('Lecture de la photo impossible'));
              }}
            />
            <div className="scan-req-note">
              <label className="scan-req-label" htmlFor="scan-req-note">
                Note (optionnel)
              </label>
              <textarea
                id="scan-req-note"
                className="scan-req-input"
                rows={2}
                value={reqNote}
                onChange={(e) => setReqNote(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Détails utiles pour la saisie PC…"
              />
            </div>
            {reqMsg ? (
              <p className="scan-req-error" role="alert">
                {reqMsg}
              </p>
            ) : null}
            <div className="scan-req-actions">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void submitRequest()} disabled={reqBusy}>
                {reqBusy ? 'Envoi…' : 'Envoyer la demande'}
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={closeReqModal} disabled={reqBusy}>
                Plus tard
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

} from '../version';

  return typeof isLoggedIn === 'function' ? isLoggedIn() : !!getToken();
}
