            Les conversations sont stockées de façon chiffrée sur R2 selon la{' '}
            <Link to="/privacy">politique de confidentialité</Link>.
          </p>
          <ul>
            <li>
              <strong>Conversation unique :</strong> l&apos;agent conserve une seule
              conversation persistante par utilisateur ; il n&apos;existe pas d&apos;historique
              multi-discussions. La suppression des échanges s&apos;effectue depuis les
              Paramètres, protégée par code OTP.
            </li>
            <li>
              <strong>Quotas d&apos;usage :</strong> afin de garantir un accès équitable,
              l&apos;usage de l&apos;agent est plafonné en jetons par jour et par semaine pour
              les comptes non administrateurs ; les administrateurs ne sont pas limités.
            </li>
            <li>
              <strong>Interdiction d&apos;abus et d&apos;injection de prompt :</strong> toute
              tentative de contourner les consignes de l&apos;assistant (« ignore les
              instructions précédentes », jailbreak, extraction du prompt système, etc.)
              entraîne la suspension immédiate de l&apos;accès à l&apos;agent pour le compte
              concerné, jusqu&apos;à rétablissement explicite par un administrateur.

            </li>
            <li>
              <strong>Accès par rôles :</strong> les capacités de l&apos;agent (lecture,

              permissions définies par le propriétaire de l&apos;instance.
            </li>
            <li>
              <strong>Sécurité du compte :</strong> le propriétaire de l&apos;instance peut
              activer la double authentification (2FA) : un code OTP est alors exigé à chaque

            </li>
          </ul>
        </section>

        <section>
          <h2>5. Modules métier</h2>
          <p>
            Stock, facturation (FA / VR / devis), achats, clients, solde, employés (paie),

            données collaborateurs et des pièces d&apos;identité des collaborateurs doit respecter

          </p>
        </section>

        <section>
          <h2>6. Données et sauvegardes</h2>
          <p>
            Les données métier sont hébergées via Cloudflare (Workers, D1, R2). Les sauvegardes
            administrateur sont chiffrées. Vous restez responsable de la licéité des données
            que vous saisissez (clients, factures, etc.).
          </p>
        </section>

        <section>
          <h2>6. Disponibilité</h2>
          <p>
            Le service est fourni « en l&apos;état ». Des interruptions (maintenance, incidents
            cloud) peuvent survenir sans que cela ouvre droit à indemnité.
          </p>
        </section>

        <section>
          <h2>7. Propriété intellectuelle</h2>
          <p>
            L&apos;interface, le code et la marque {APP_NAME} restent la propriété de leurs
            titulaires. Votre contenu métier vous appartient.

          <p>

        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { TimedUndoDelete } from '../components/ui';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import PasswordConfirm from '../components/PasswordConfirm';
import SaveFeedback from '../components/SaveFeedback';
import { validateVendorForm, firstError } from '../lib/formValidate';
import EmptyState from '../components/EmptyState';
import { SupplierPartsPanel } from '../components/atlas-v209-panels';
import RefreshIconButton from '../components/RefreshIconButton';
import '../components/erp/crm-parties.css';
import { FloatingPortal } from '../components/FloatingPortal';
import { useWizard, StepBody, WizardFoot } from '../components/ui/FormWizard';

export default function Vendors() {
  const [pwOpen, setPwOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pwTitle, setPwTitle] = useState('');
  const [pwDesc, setPwDesc] = useState('');
  const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState<null | ((password: string) => Promise<void>)>(null);
  const [deleteArmId, setDeleteArmId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [list, setList] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const wz = useWizard(2);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [saveMsg, setSaveMsg] = useState('');
  const [saveMsgType, setSaveMsgType] = useState<'success' | 'error'>('success');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', ice: '', if_number: '', address: '', city: '', phone: '', email: '' });

  const flash = (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setSaveMsg(msg); setSaveMsgType(type);
    setTimeout(() => setSaveMsg(''), 4500);
  };

  const load = (soft = false) => {
    if (soft) setRefreshing(true);
    else setLoading(true);
    api.getVendors().then((r) => setList(r.data)).finally(() => {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    });
  };
  
  useEffect(() => {
    const onLists = () => {
      try { load(true); } catch { /* */ }
    };
    window.addEventListener('atlas-lists-refresh', onLists as EventListener);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('atlas-lists-refresh', onLists as EventListener);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const openEdit = (v: any) => {
    setEditId(Number(v.id));
    setForm({
      name: v.name || '',
      ice: v.ice || '',
      if_number: v.if_number || '',
      address: v.address || '',
      city: v.city || '',
      phone: v.phone || '',
      email: v.email || '',
    });
    setShow(true);
  };

  const save = async () => {
    const fe = validateVendorForm(form);
    setFieldErrors(fe);
    if (Object.keys(fe).length) return; // erreurs affichées sous chaque champ
    if (!form.name.trim()) { flash('Le nom du fournisseur est obligatoire.', 'error'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (editId) {
        await api.updateVendor(editId, form);
      } else {
        await api.createVendor(form);
      }
      setShow(false);
      setForm({ name: '', ice: '', if_number: '', address: '', city: '', phone: '', email: '' });
      setEditId(null);
      flash('Fournisseur enregistré dans la base de données avec succès.');
      load(true);
    } catch (e: any) { flash(e.message, 'error'); } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const remove = (id: number) => {
    setPwTitle('Supprimer le fournisseur');
    setPwDesc('Cette action est définitive. Confirmez pour continuer.');
    setPendingAction(() => async (password: string) => {
      await api.deleteVendor(id, password);
      flash('Fournisseur supprimé de la base de données.');
      setPwOpen(false); setPendingAction(null);
      load(true);
    });
    setPwOpen(true);
  };

  const filtered = list.filter((v) => !search || v.name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || v.ice?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));

  if (loading) return <div className="empty">Chargement des fournisseurs...</div>;

  const totalDue = list.reduce((s, v) => s + Number(v.balance_due || 0), 0);
  const withDue = list.filter((v) => Number(v.balance_due || 0) > 0.001).length;
  const now = new Date();
  const ym = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const newMonth = list.filter((v) => String(v.created_at || '').startsWith(ym)).length;

  return (
    <div className="atlas-crm vendors-page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h1>Fournisseurs</h1>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <RefreshIconButton onClick={() => load(true)} loading={refreshing} />
          <button onClick={() => { setEditId(null); setForm({ name: '', ice: '', if_number: '', address: '', city: '', phone: '', email: '' }); wz.reset(); setShow(true); }}>+ Nouveau fournisseur</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <SaveFeedback message={saveMsg} type={saveMsgType} />
<div className="ac-panel ac-products-filters">
        <div className="search-bar"><input className="ac-search-input" placeholder="Rechercher par nom ou identifiant..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} /></div>
      </div>

      <div className="ac-metric-grid" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label">Solde total dû</div>
          <div className="as-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.35rem' }}>{Math.round(totalDue).toLocaleString('fr-FR')} MAD</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 4 }}>sur {withDue} fournisseur{withDue !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</div>
          {withDue > 0 && <span className="badge" style={{ marginTop: 6, background: '#fef3c7', color: '#92400e' }}>à payer</span>}
        </div>
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label">Nouveaux ce mois</div>
          <div className="as-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.35rem' }}>{newMonth}</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 4 }}>fournisseurs ajoutés</div>
        </div>
        <div className="ac-metric">
          <div className="as-label">Fournisseurs actifs</div>
          <div className="as-value" style={{ fontSize: '1.35rem' }}>{list.length}</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted)', marginTop: 4 }}>dans le fichier</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="ac-panel ac-products-table-panel">
        <div className="table-wrap">
          <table className="data-dense ac-products-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Nom</th>
                <th>ICE / Identifiant</th>
                <th>Ville</th>
                <th>Solde</th>
                <th>Statut</th>
                <th>Téléphone</th>
                <th>E-mail</th>
                <th></th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {filtered.map((v) => {
                const due = Number(v.balance_due || 0);
                return (
                  <tr key={v.id}>
                    <td>
                      <span
                        className="party-name party-name-link"
                        role="button"
                        tabIndex={0}
                        title="Modifier"
                        onClick={() => openEdit(v)}
                        onKeyDown={(ev) => { if (ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === ' ') { ev.preventDefault(); openEdit(v); } }}
                      >
                        {v.name}
                      </span>
                      {v.ice && <div className="party-sub">{v.ice}</div>}
                    </td>
                    <td>{v.ice || '—'}</td>
                    <td>{v.city || '—'}</td>
                    <td><span className="mono-amt">{Math.round(due).toLocaleString('fr-FR')} MAD</span></td>
                    <td>
                      {due > 0.001
                        ? <span className="credit-pill warn">Solde dû</span>
                        : <span className="credit-pill ok">Soldé</span>}
                    </td>
                    <td>{v.phone || '—'}</td>
                    <td>{v.email || '—'}</td>
                    <td>
                      {deleteArmId === v.id ? (
                        <TimedUndoDelete autoStart deleteLabel="Supprimer" undoLabel="Annuler" initialSeconds={10}
                          onConfirm={() => { setDeleteArmId(null); void remove(v.id); }} />
                      ) : (
                        <TimedUndoDelete deleteLabel="Supprimer" undoLabel="Annuler" initialSeconds={10} onConfirm={() => { setDeleteArmId(null); openDelete([v.id]); }} />
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
              {!filtered.length && (
                <tr><td colSpan={8}>
                    <EmptyState
                      title="Aucun fournisseur"
                      description="Ajoutez vos fournisseurs pour les rattacher aux factures d'achat."
                      actionLabel="Ajouter mon premier fournisseur"
                      onAction={() => { setEditId(null); setForm({ name: '', ice: '', if_number: '', address: '', city: '', phone: '', email: '' }); wz.reset(); setShow(true); }}
                      icon="building"
                    />
                  </td></tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {show && (
        <FloatingPortal><div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => { setShow(false); wz.reset(); }}>
          <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h2>{editId ? 'Modifier le fournisseur' : 'Nouveau fournisseur'}</h2>
            <StepBody active={wz.step === 1}>
            <div className="form-row"><label>Nom *</label><input className={fieldErrors.name ? 'field-error' : undefined} value={form.name} onChange={(e) => { setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value }); setFieldErrors((x) => ({ ...x, name: '' })); }} placeholder="Ex. Ciments du Maroc" /><span className="field-error-msg">{fieldErrors.name || ''}</span></div>
            <div className="grid grid-2">
              <div className="form-row"><label>ICE / Identifiant fiscal</label><input value={form.ice} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, ice: e.target.value })} /></div>
              <div className="form-row"><label>IF</label><input value={form.if_number} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, if_number: e.target.value })} /></div>
            </div>
            </StepBody>
            <StepBody active={wz.step === 2}>
            <div className="form-row"><label>Adresse</label><input value={form.address} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, address: e.target.value })} /></div>
            <div className="grid grid-2">
              <div className="form-row"><label>Ville</label><input value={form.city} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, city: e.target.value })} /></div>
              <div className="form-row"><label>Téléphone</label><input value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, phone: e.target.value })} /></div>
            </div>
            <div className="form-row"><label>E-mail</label><input type="email" className={fieldErrors.email ? 'field-error' : undefined} value={form.email} onChange={(e) => { setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value }); setFieldErrors((x) => ({ ...x, email: '' })); }} placeholder="contact@fournisseur.ma" /><span className="field-error-msg">{fieldErrors.email || ''}</span></div>
            </StepBody>
            <WizardFoot
              title={editId ? 'Modifier le fournisseur' : 'Nouveau fournisseur'}
              wz={wz}
              stepLabel={wz.step === 1 ? 'Identité' : 'Contact'}
              onCancel={() => { setShow(false); wz.reset(); }}
              onSubmit={() => void save()}
              submitLabel={saving ? 'Enregistrement...' : 'Enregistrer dans la base'}
              saving={saving}
            />
          </div>
        </div></FloatingPortal>
      )}

      {pwOpen && pendingAction && (
        <PasswordConfirm
          open={pwOpen}
          title={pwTitle}
          description={pwDesc}
          confirmLabel="Confirmer"
          onCancel={() => { setPwOpen(false); setPendingAction(null); }}
          onConfirm={async (password) => { await pendingAction(password); }}
        />
      )}
      <SupplierPartsPanel />
    </div>
  );
}

import { WelcomePreview } from '../components/WelcomePreview';
import { FeatureTour } from '../components/ui/FeatureTour';
import { Package, FileText, Users, Bot, BarChart3 } from 'lucide-react';
/**
 * Full-screen Atlas Commerce welcome — comparison engine, mastery tips, theme/density.
 * No legacy modals. State survives refresh via localStorage.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  WELCOME_STEP_COUNT,
  WELCOME_PREVIEW_START,
  WELCOME_FEATURES_STEP,
  WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP,
  WELCOME_FINAL_STEP,
  getWelcomePrefs,
  getWelcomeStep,
  isWelcomeCompleted,
  markWelcomeCompleted,
  saveWelcomePrefs,
  setWelcomeStep,
  type WelcomeDensity,
  type WelcomePrefs,
  type WelcomeTheme,
} from '../lib/welcome';
import { setDensity, setGlassEnabled } from '../lib/density';
import {
  APP_CREATOR,
  APP_CREATOR_NAME,
  APP_GITHUB,
  APP_NAME,
  APP_PROFILE,
} from '../version';

function applyThemeMode(mode: WelcomeTheme) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('atlas-theme', mode);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  const resolved =
    mode === 'system'
      ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
        ? 'dark'
        : 'light'
      : mode;
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', resolved);
}

function ThemeMock({ mode }: { mode: WelcomeTheme }) {
  const isDark =
    mode === 'dark' ||
    (mode === 'system' &&
      typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
  const bg = isDark ? '#0f172a' : '#f8fafc';
  const card = isDark ? '#1e293b' : '#ffffff';
  const line = isDark ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0';
  const accent = '#71717a';
  return (
    <div className="welcome-pick-preview" data-theme-preview={isDark ? 'dark' : 'light'}>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 160 100" className="welcome-mock-svg" aria-hidden>
        <rect width="160" height="100" rx="8" fill={bg} />
        <rect x="8" y="8" width="36" height="84" rx="6" fill={card} stroke={line} strokeWidth="1" />
        <rect x="52" y="8" width="100" height="22" rx="5" fill={card} stroke={line} strokeWidth="1" />
        <rect x="52" y="38" width="100" height="54" rx="5" fill={card} stroke={line} strokeWidth="1" />
        <rect x="62" y="48" width="48" height="8" rx="2" fill={accent} opacity="0.9" />
        <rect x="62" y="62" width="72" height="5" rx="2" fill={line} />
        <rect x="62" y="72" width="56" height="5" rx="2" fill={line} />
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
}

      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <path d="M12 2a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v1h1a3 3 0 0 1 3 3v2a3 3 0 0 1-3 3h-1v1a4 4 0 0 1-8 0v-1H7a3 3 0 0 1-3-3v-2a3 3 0 0 1 3-3h1V6a4 4 0 0 1 4-4z" />
          <circle cx="9" cy="12" r="1" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" />
          <circle cx="15" cy="12" r="1" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" />
        </svg>
      );
    case 'security':
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z" />
          <path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4" />
        </svg>
      );
    case 'mobile':
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <rect x="7" y="2" width="10" height="20" rx="2" />
          <path d="M11 18h2" />
        </svg>
      );
    case 'reports':
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <path d="M3 3v18h18" />
          <path d="m7 14 4-4 3 3 5-6" />
        </svg>
      );
    case 'morocco':
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
          <path d="M2 12h20" />
          <path d="M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z" />
        </svg>
      );
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

function DensityMock({ density }: { density: WelcomeDensity }) {
  const gap = density === 'comfortable' ? 14 : 6;
  const rowH = density === 'comfortable' ? 16 : 10;
  const rows = density === 'comfortable' ? 3 : 5;
  return (
    <div className="welcome-pick-preview">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 160 100" className="welcome-mock-svg" aria-hidden>
        <rect width="160" height="100" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" />
        {Array.from({ length: rows }).map((_, i) => (
          <rect
            key={i}
            x="16"
            y={14 + i * (rowH + gap)}
            width="128"
            height={rowH}
            rx="4"
            fill="#71717a"
            opacity={0.25 + i * 0.12}
          />
        ))}
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
}

function WelcomeTourGate({ show, onClose, steps }: { show: boolean; onClose: () => void; steps: any[] }) {
  if (!show) return null;
  return <FeatureTour steps={steps} onClose={onClose} />;
}

export default function Welcome() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [showTour, setShowTour] = useState(false);
  const tourSteps = useMemo(
    () => [
      {
        id: 'stock',
        title: 'Stock & produits',
        description: 'Catalogue, seuils bas, scan code-barres et mouvements d’entrepôt.',
        icon: <Package size={40} strokeWidth={1.5} />,
      },
      {
        id: 'sales',
        title: 'Ventes & factures',
        description: 'Devis, FA, VR, reçus et TVA — numérotation centralisée.',
        icon: <FileText size={40} strokeWidth={1.5} />,
      },
      {
        id: 'people',
        title: 'Clients & équipe',
        description: 'Fiches clients, employés, présence et acomptes.',
        icon: <Users size={40} strokeWidth={1.5} />,
      },
      {
        id: 'agent',
        title: 'Atlas Agent',
        description: 'Assistant connecté aux API : créer, chercher, expliquer.',
        icon: <Bot size={40} strokeWidth={1.5} />,
      },
      {
        id: 'reports',
        title: 'Pilotage',
        description: 'Tableau de bord, rapports et clôture de période.',
        icon: <BarChart3 size={40} strokeWidth={1.5} />,
      },
    ],
    [],
  );

  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [step, setStep] = useState(() => getWelcomeStep());
  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState<WelcomePrefs>(() => getWelcomePrefs());
  const [showNext, setShowNext] = useState(step !== 0);
  const [avatar, setAvatar] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState(false);
  const [compareTab, setCompareTab] = useState<'paper' | 'erp'>('paper');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isWelcomeCompleted()) navigate('/dashboard', { replace: true });
  }, [navigate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setWelcomeStep(step);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' });
    const heading = panelRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('h1, h2');
    if (heading) {
      heading.tabIndex = -1;
      heading.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }, [step]);

  useEffect(() => {
    applyThemeMode(prefs.theme);
    setDensity('comfortable');
    setGlassEnabled(false);
  }, [prefs]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (step !== 0) {
      setShowNext(true);
      return;
    }
    setShowNext(false);
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setShowNext(true), 1200);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [step]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    fetch(`https://api.github.com/users/${APP_CREATOR}`, {
      headers: { Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json' },
    })
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((u) => {
        if (!cancelled && u?.avatar_url) setAvatar(String(u.avatar_url));
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const go = useCallback((next: number) => {
    setStep(Math.max(0, Math.min(WELCOME_STEP_COUNT - 1, next)));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      if (t && (t.closest('button, a, [role="tab"]') || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || t.tagName === 'SELECT' || (t.tagName === 'INPUT' && (t as HTMLInputElement).type !== 'checkbox' && (t as HTMLInputElement).type !== 'radio' && (t as HTMLInputElement).type !== 'button'))) {
        return;
      }
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      if (leaving) return;
      if (step === 0 && !showNext) return;
      if (step >= WELCOME_STEP_COUNT - 1) {
        (document.querySelector('.welcome-cta-glow, .welcome-cta') as HTMLButtonElement | null)?.click();
        return;
      }
      go(step + 1);
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [step, showNext, leaving, go]);

  const pickTheme = (theme: WelcomeTheme) => {
    setPrefs(saveWelcomePrefs({ theme }));
    applyThemeMode(theme);
  };

  const pickDensity = (density: WelcomeDensity) => {
    setPrefs(saveWelcomePrefs({ density }));
    setDensity(density);
  };


  const finish = () => {
    setLeaving(true);
    applyThemeMode(prefs.theme);
    setDensity('comfortable');
    setGlassEnabled(false);
    markWelcomeCompleted();
    setShowTour(true);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      navigate('/dashboard', { replace: true });
      try {
        window.location.reload();
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    }, 480);
  };

  const progress = useMemo(() => ((step + 1) / WELCOME_STEP_COUNT) * 100, [step]);

  return (
    <div className={`welcome-stage${leaving ? ' welcome-leaving' : ''}`} data-step={step}>
      {showTour ? <FeatureTour steps={tourSteps} onClose={() => { setShowTour(false); navigate('/dashboard'); }} /> : null}

      <div className="welcome-ambient" aria-hidden />
      <div
        className="welcome-progress"
        role="progressbar"
        aria-label="Progression du guide de bienvenue"
        aria-valuenow={step + 1}
        aria-valuemin={1}
        aria-valuemax={WELCOME_STEP_COUNT}
      >
        <div className="welcome-progress-bar" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
      </div>

      <div className="welcome-inner" ref={panelRef}>
        {step === 0 && (
          <section className="welcome-panel welcome-hello" key="hello">
            <p className="welcome-kicker">{APP_NAME}</p>
            <h1 className="welcome-bonjour">
              {'Bonjour'.split('').map((ch, i) => (
                <span key={i} style={{ animationDelay: `${0.08 + i * 0.06}s` }}>
                  {ch}
                </span>
              ))}
            </h1>
            <p className="welcome-sub welcome-fade-late">
              Configurons votre espace — thème, style, et ce qui change vraiment face au papier et aux outils lourds.
            </p>
            {showNext && (
              <button type="button" className="welcome-cta welcome-cta-glow" onClick={() => go(1)}>
                Suivant
              </button>
            )}
          </section>
        )}

        {step === 1 && (
          <section className="welcome-panel" key="theme">
            <h2 className="welcome-title">Choisissez votre thème</h2>
            <p className="welcome-sub">Aperçu en direct sur l&apos;interface.</p>
            <div className="welcome-picks welcome-picks-3">
              {(
                [
                  { id: 'dark' as const, label: 'Sombre' },
                  { id: 'light' as const, label: 'Clair' },
                  { id: 'system' as const, label: 'Système' },
                ] as const
              ).map((opt, i) => (
                <button
                  key={opt.id}
                  type="button"
                  className={`welcome-pick${prefs.theme === opt.id ? ' is-selected' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => pickTheme(opt.id)}
                  style={{ animationDelay: `${0.05 + i * 0.06}s` }}
                >
                  <ThemeMock mode={opt.id} />
                  <span className="welcome-pick-label">{opt.label}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="welcome-nav">
              <button type="button" className="welcome-btn-ghost" onClick={() => go(0)}>
                Retour
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="welcome-cta" onClick={() => go(2)}>
                Suivant
              </button>
            </div>
          </section>
        )}

        {step >= WELCOME_PREVIEW_START && step < WELCOME_FEATURES_STEP && (
          <WelcomePreview
            key={step}
            index={step - WELCOME_PREVIEW_START}
            onPrevious={() => go(step - 1)}
            onNext={() => go(step + 1)}
          />
        )}

        {step === WELCOME_FEATURES_STEP && (
          <section className="welcome-panel welcome-panel-wide" key="features">
            <h2 className="welcome-title">Tout pour vendre et gérer plus vite</h2>
            <p className="welcome-sub">Du stock à la facture, de la caisse aux employés — un seul outil clair.</p>
            <div className="welcome-features-grid">
              {WELCOME_FEATURES.map((f, i) => (
                <article
                  key={f.title}
                  className="welcome-feature-card"
                  style={{ animationDelay: `${0.04 + i * 0.03}s` }}
                >
                  <div className="welcome-feature-icon" aria-hidden>
                    <FeatureIcon name={f.icon} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="welcome-feature-body">
                    <strong>{f.title}</strong>
                    <span className="welcome-feature-blurb">{f.blurb}</span>
                    <span className="welcome-feature-pages">{f.pages}</span>
                  </div>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="welcome-nav">
              <button type="button" className="welcome-btn-ghost" onClick={() => go(WELCOME_FEATURES_STEP - 1)}>
                Retour
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="welcome-cta" onClick={() => go(WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP)}>
                Suivant
              </button>
            </div>
          </section>
        )}

        {step === WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP && (
          <section className="welcome-panel welcome-panel-wide" key="compare">
            <h2 className="welcome-title">Pourquoi {APP_NAME} change la donne</h2>
            <p className="welcome-sub">Comparaisons animées — papier &amp; outils lourds face à Atlas.</p>
            <div className="welcome-segment" role="tablist">
              <button
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={compareTab === 'paper'}
                className={compareTab === 'paper' ? 'active' : ''}
                onClick={() => setCompareTab('paper')}
              >
                Papier vs Atlas
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={compareTab === 'erp'}
                className={compareTab === 'erp' ? 'active' : ''}
                onClick={() => setCompareTab('erp')}
              >
                Excel / ERP vs Atlas
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="welcome-compare-slot">
              {compareTab === 'paper' ? (
                <ComparePaperVsAtlas key="cmp-paper" />
              ) : (
                <CompareErpVsAtlas key="cmp-erp" />
              )}
            </div>
            <MasteryTips />
            <div className="welcome-nav">
              <button type="button" className="welcome-btn-ghost" onClick={() => go(WELCOME_FEATURES_STEP)}>
                Retour
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="welcome-cta" onClick={() => go(WELCOME_FINAL_STEP)}>
                Suivant
              </button>
            </div>
          </section>
        )}

        {step === WELCOME_FINAL_STEP && (
          <section className="welcome-panel welcome-close" key="close">
            <p className="welcome-thanks welcome-fade-up">Merci de nous faire confiance</p>
            <h2 className="welcome-title welcome-fade-up" style={{ animationDelay: '0.08s' }}>
              Bienvenue dans {APP_NAME}
            </h2>
            <p className="welcome-sub welcome-fade-up" style={{ animationDelay: '0.14s', marginLeft: 'auto', marginRight: 'auto' }}>
              Merci d&apos;avoir choisi Atlas — stock, factures et caisse, sans abonnement et sous votre contrôle.
            </p>

            <div className="welcome-creator-badge welcome-fade-up" style={{ animationDelay: '0.2s' }}>
              {avatar ? (
                <img src={avatar} alt="" className="welcome-avatar" width={72} height={72} />
              ) : (
                <div className="welcome-avatar welcome-avatar-fallback">{APP_CREATOR_NAME.slice(0, 1)}</div>
              )}
              <div>
                <p className="welcome-kicker">Créateur</p>
                <h2 className="welcome-title" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.25rem' }}>
                  {APP_CREATOR_NAME}
                </h2>
                <a href={APP_GITHUB} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="welcome-gh-link">
                  @{APP_CREATOR} · GitHub
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className="welcome-craft welcome-fade-up" style={{ animationDelay: '0.26s' }}>
              Conçu avec passion pour simplifier la gestion commerciale — sans compromis.
            </p>

            <div className="welcome-projects welcome-fade-up" style={{ animationDelay: '0.32s' }}>
              <p className="welcome-projects-title">Autres projets</p>
              <div className="welcome-projects-grid">
                <a className="welcome-project-card" href="https://github.com/Etherealmber/afmarbre-main" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  <strong>afmarbre-main</strong>
                  <span>Vitrine &amp; infrastructure</span>
                </a>
                <a className="welcome-project-card" href="https://github.com/Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  <strong>atlas-commerce-android</strong>
                  <span>App Android native</span>
                </a>
                <a className="welcome-project-card" href="https://github.com/Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-desktop" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  <strong>atlas-commerce-desktop</strong>
                  <span>Client bureau Tauri</span>
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="welcome-nav">
              <button type="button" className="welcome-btn-ghost" onClick={() => go(WELCOME_COMPARE_STEP)}>
                Retour
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="welcome-cta welcome-cta-glow" onClick={finish} disabled={leaving}>
                {leaving ? 'Ouverture…' : 'Explorer Atlas Commerce'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </section>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

.bank-hub { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; padding-bottom: 88px; }
.bank-hub * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.bank-top {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.bank-top h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; }
.bank-metrics {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr));
  gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.bank-metric {
  background: var(--paper, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 9px); padding: 10px 12px;
}
.bank-metric .lbl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.bank-metric .val { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.bank-toolbar {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: end;
  padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 12px;
  background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
.bank-toolbar label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.bank-toolbar input, .bank-toolbar select {
  min-height: 40px; font-size: 14px;
}
.bank-pill {
  min-height: 40px; min-width: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: inherit;
}
.bank-pill.active { background: var(--zellij-soft, #f1f5f9); border-color: var(--zellij, #0a0a0a); color: var(--zellij); }
.bank-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.bank-badge.ok { background: var(--ok-bg); color: var(--ok); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 25%, transparent); }
.bank-badge.warn { background: var(--warn-bg); color: var(--warn); }
.bank-badge.bad { background: var(--bad-bg); color: var(--bad); }
.bank-badge.muted { background: rgba(107,114,128,.12); color: var(--muted); }
.bank-badge.info { background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); color: var(--zellij); }

/* Desktop split */
.bank-split {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr);
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 440px;
}
.bank-pane {
  background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius, 14px); overflow: hidden;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 320px;
}
.bank-pane-head {
  padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted);
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
}
.bank-feed { overflow: auto; flex: 1; max-height: min(62vh, 560px); -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.bank-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 76px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 8px; width: 100%; text-align: left;
  padding: 12px 14px; min-height: 52px;
  border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer;
}
.bank-row:hover { background: rgba(15,27,45,.03); }
.bank-row.active { background: var(--zellij-soft); }
.bank-row .date { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding-top: 2px; }
.bank-row .desc { font-size: 13px; overflow: hidden; }
.bank-row .desc .t { display: block; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-weight: 500; }
.bank-row .amt { font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; }
.bank-row .amt.credit { color: var(--ok); }
.bank-row .amt.debit { color: var(--bad); }

.bank-detail { padding: 14px; overflow: auto; flex: 1; }
.bank-tabs {
  display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.bank-tab {
  min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: inherit;
}
.bank-tab.active { background: var(--ink, #0f1b2d); color: #fff; border-color: var(--ink); }
html.dark .bank-tab.active, [data-theme="dark"] .bank-tab.active {
  background: #e2e8f0; color: #0f172a;
}

/* Mobile bottom nav */
.bank-mobile-nav {
  display: none;
  position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 40;
  background: var(--paper); border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding: 6px 8px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  justify-content: space-around; gap: 4px;
}
.bank-mobile-nav button {
  flex: 1; min-height: 48px; border: none; background: transparent;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px;
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.bank-mobile-nav button.active { color: var(--zellij); background: var(--zellij-soft); }

/* Sheet */
.bank-sheet-backdrop {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(15,27,45,.45); z-index: 50;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center;
}
.bank-sheet {
  width: min(640px, 100%); max-height: 88vh; overflow: auto;
  background: var(--paper); border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
  padding: 16px; padding-bottom: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  box-shadow: 0 -8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}
.bank-sheet h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 1.05rem; }

.bank-wizard-steps {
  display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.bank-wizard-steps span {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(107,114,128,.1); color: var(--muted);
}
.bank-wizard-steps span.on { background: var(--zellij-soft); color: var(--zellij); }

.bank-drop {
  border: 2px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px;
  text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px;
  min-height: 88px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
}
.bank-drop.over { border-color: var(--zellij); background: var(--zellij-soft); }

.bank-progress {
  height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--line); overflow: hidden; margin-top: 8px;
}
.bank-progress > i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--zellij); width: 0%; transition: width .2s; }

.bank-map-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin: 12px 0;
}
@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .bank-map-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

.bank-preview-table {
  width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px;
  display: block; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}
.bank-preview-table table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; min-width: 480px; }
.bank-preview-table th, .bank-preview-table td {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.bank-preview-table th:first-child, .bank-preview-table td:first-child {
  position: sticky; left: 0; background: var(--paper); z-index: 1;
}

.bank-actions-row {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px;
}
.bank-actions-row button { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 14px; }

/* Mobile: stack + show bottom nav */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .bank-split { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .bank-desktop-only { display: none !important; }
  .bank-mobile-nav { display: flex; }
  .bank-hub { padding-bottom: 96px; }
  .bank-pane .bank-feed { max-height: 48vh; }
}
@media (min-width: 901px) {
  .bank-mobile-only { display: none !important; }
}

/* MOBILE 375 — contain wide tables */

@media (max-width: 430px) {
  .bank-preview-table { overflow-x: auto !important; max-width: 100% !important; }
  .bank-preview-table table { min-width: 420px !important; }
}

/* Bits — styles for the React Bits / Magic UI adapted components (Bits.tsx).
   Imported BEFORE dark-force.css so the dark cascade still wins by design.
   No white surfaces are introduced: the lens ring uses translucent tokens. */

.bits-lens {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  max-width: 100%;
  line-height: 0;
}
.bits-lens img {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.bits-lens-mag {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  transition: opacity 0.16s ease;
  z-index: 6;
  line-height: normal;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .bits-lens-mag { transition: none; }
}

/* focus-pages-chrome.css — Clients/Vendors parity for Settings, About, WhatsNew, Balance
   Loaded AFTER overrides-final.css. No glass, no mint, no teal. */

html body .settings-shell,
html body .settings-main,
html body .settings-page,

html body .whats-new-page,
html body .balance-page,
html body .mailbox-page {
  --teal: #0a0a0a;
  --teal-soft: #f1f5f9;
  --mint: #ffffff;
  --glass-bg: #ffffff;
  --glass-blur: 0px;
  --glass-saturate: 100%;
}

/* Kill liquid glass on these surfaces */
html body .settings-shell *,

}

/* Delete / danger — force red pill (TimedUndo + .danger) */
html body .settings-main button.danger,

html body .settings-main .ac-btn-delete,
html body .balance-page button.danger,
html body .balance-page .ac-timed-delete-btn {

/* Atlas Commerce login — structure like Discord, palette Atlas only.
   Loaded from Login.tsx so it always applies on /login. */

html.atlas-login-page,
html.atlas-login-page body,
html.atlas-login-page #root {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 70% at 50% -10%, #1c1c1f 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 100% 100%, #12121a 0%, transparent 45%),
    linear-gradient(165deg, #0f0f12 0%, #0a0a0c 40%, #070708 100%) !important;
  min-height: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
}

html.atlas-login-page body {
  margin: 0 !important;
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

/* Kill legacy 2-col grid + white panels */
html.atlas-login-page .atlas-login.atlas-login--auth7 {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  grid-template-columns: none !important;
  grid-template-rows: none !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  min-height: 100dvh !important;
  max-height: none !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 56px 16px 32px !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
  overflow: auto !important;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 18% 12%, rgba(250, 248, 244, 0.07), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 40% at 88% 88%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.06), transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 35% at 50% 100%, rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.9), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(160deg, #121214 0%, #0c0c0e 45%, #080809 100%) !important;
  transition: background 0.8s ease, filter 0.8s ease, opacity 0.8s ease !important;
}

/* Mobile web /login/qr confirm */
.login-qr-page {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px 16px;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  color: #fafafa;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.login-qr-card {
  width: min(400px, 100%);
  background: #141414;
  border: 1px solid #27272a;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 28px 22px;
  text-align: center;
}
.login-qr-brand {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #71717a;
}
.login-qr-card h1 {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.login-qr-identity {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.login-qr-avatar {
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  object-fit: cover;
  border: 2px solid #3f3f46;
}
.login-qr-avatar--letter {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: #27272a;
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.login-qr-account { margin: 0; color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.login-qr-msg { margin: 12px 0; color: #d4d4d8; line-height: 1.45; }
.login-qr-msg--err { color: #fca5a5; }
.login-qr-msg--ok { color: #c7d2fe; }
.login-qr-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 16px;
}
.login-qr-btn {
  min-height: 48px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1rem;
  border: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.login-qr-btn--ok { background: #fafafa; color: #0a0a0a; }
.login-qr-btn--no { background: transparent; color: #a1a1aa; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; }
.login-qr-link { color: #a1a1aa; }
.login-qr-hint { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #71717a; }

html.atlas-login-page .atlas-login-qr-avatar-letter {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fafafa;
}
html.atlas-login-page .atlas-login-qr-avatar-lg {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}


/* QR stage transitions */
html.atlas-login-page .atlas-login-qr-stage {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
}
html.atlas-login-page .atlas-login-qr-denied-icon {
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #3f1d1d, #1c1212);
  color: #fca5a5;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #7f1d1d;
}
html.atlas-login-page .atlas-login-qr-retry {
  margin-top: 12px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 22px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 0;
  background: #fafafa;
  color: #0a0a0a;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
}

  background: #e4e4e7;
}

}
html.atlas-login-page .atlas-login-qr-check {

}
html.atlas-login-page .atlas-login-qr-panel {
  min-height: 280px;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}


/* v186 login qr contrast — beat global white/light overrides */
.login-qr-page {

/* MOTION_POLISH_V53 — make-interfaces-feel-better */
html {
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

/* Scale on press — buttons & nav */
button:not(:disabled):active,
a.btn:active,
.ac-nav-item:active,
.ac-topbar-icon-btn:active,
.ac-topbar-user-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}
button,
a.btn,
.ac-nav-item,
.ac-topbar-icon-btn,
.ac-topbar-user-btn {
  transition-property: transform, background-color, color, border-color, box-shadow, opacity;
  transition-duration: 0.18s;
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
}

/* Sidebar active / hover */
.ac-nav-item {
  transition-property: background-color, color, transform;
}
.ac-nav-item:hover {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
}
html[data-theme="dark"] .ac-nav-item:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

/* Logo mark soft lift */
.logo img,
.ac-brand img,
.sidebar .logo img {
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.logo:hover img,
.ac-brand:hover img,
.sidebar .logo:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.04);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
}

/* Dropdown enter */
.ac-user-dropdown {
  animation: ac-drop-in 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) both;
  transform-origin: top right;
}
@keyframes ac-drop-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-6px) scale(0.98);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

/* Cards / panels soft enter when present */
.atlas-page .card,
.atlas-crm .card,
.ac-products-table-panel,
.whats-new-list {
  animation: ac-panel-in 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) both;
}
@keyframes ac-panel-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

/* Metric tiles stagger via nth-child */
.ac-metric-grid > *,
.atlas-metric-grid > * {
  animation: ac-panel-in 0.36s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) both;
}
.ac-metric-grid > *:nth-child(1), .atlas-metric-grid > *:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.02s; }
.ac-metric-grid > *:nth-child(2), .atlas-metric-grid > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.06s; }
.ac-metric-grid > *:nth-child(3), .atlas-metric-grid > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.ac-metric-grid > *:nth-child(4), .atlas-metric-grid > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.14s; }
.ac-metric-grid > *:nth-child(5), .atlas-metric-grid > *:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.18s; }
.ac-metric-grid > *:nth-child(6), .atlas-metric-grid > *:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.22s; }

/* Tabular numbers on amounts */
.as-value,
.money,
.amount,
td.num,
.tabular {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* Headings */
h1, h2, .atlas-page h1, .page-title {
  text-wrap: balance;
}

/* Image outline */
img.ac-topbar-avatar,
.product-thumb img,
.thumb img,
.product-image-editor img {
  outline: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14));
  background: #ffffff;
}
html[data-theme="dark"] img.ac-topbar-avatar,
html[data-theme="dark"] .product-thumb img,
html[data-theme="dark"] .product-image-editor img {
  outline-color: #3f3f46;
  background: #26262a;
}

/* Prefer reduced motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}

}

/**
 * pdf-lib multi-page invoice / devis / receipt PDF with watermark.
 * Respects printable area: new pages when line items overflow.
 */
import { PDFDocument, PDFPage, PDFFont, StandardFonts, rgb, degrees } from 'pdf-lib';
import { qrMatrixWithLogo } from './qrSvg';

export type PdfLibDocInput = {
  title: string;
  number: string;
  issueDate: string;
  dueDate?: string;
  company: {
    name: string;
    address?: string;
    city?: string;
    phone?: string;
    email?: string;
    ice?: string;
    if_number?: string;
    rc?: string;
    patente?: string;
    cnss?: string;
    legal_form?: string;
    bank_name?: string;
    bank_iban?: string;
  };
  party: {
    label: string;
    name: string;
    ice?: string;
    address?: string;
    city?: string;
    email?: string;
    phone?: string;
  };
  items: { name: string; qty: number; unit: number; taxRate: number; total: number; listPrice?: number; discount?: number }[];
  subtotal: number;
  discountTotal?: number;
  taxAmount: number;
  total: number;
  amountPaid?: number;
  currency?: string;
  notes?: string;
  refundReason?: string;
  sourceInvoiceNumber?: string;
  /** Full refund policy text for sales invoices / WR (old + new). */
  refundPolicy?: string;
  status?: string;
  publicUrl?: string;
  watermark?: string;
  /** SHA-256 hex of canonical document fields (digital seal) */
  integrityHash?: string;
  /** Client signature data-url or short status */
  clientSignaturePresent?: boolean;
  signedAt?: string;
  signatureValid?: boolean;
  timestampAt?: string;
  timestampValid?: boolean;
};

function money(n: number) {
  const v = Math.round(Number(n || 0));
  // ASCII-only thousands separator (WinAnsi-safe). Avoid U+202F / NBSP from toLocaleString.
  return String(v).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ' ');
}

function amountInWordsFr(n: number, currency = 'MAD'): string {
  const ones = ['zéro','un','deux','trois','quatre','cinq','six','sept','huit','neuf','dix','onze','douze','treize','quatorze','quinze','seize','dix-sept','dix-huit','dix-neuf'];
  const tens = ['','','vingt','trente','quarante','cinquante','soixante','soixante','quatre-vingt','quatre-vingt'];
  const under100 = (x: number): string => {
    if (x < 20) return ones[x];
    if (x < 70) {
      const t = Math.floor(x / 10), u = x % 10;
      if (u === 0) return tens[t];
      if (u === 1 && t !== 8) return tens[t] + ' et un';
      return tens[t] + '-' + ones[u];
    }
    if (x < 80) return 'soixante' + (x === 71 ? ' et onze' : '-' + ones[x - 60]);
    if (x < 100) {
      const u = x - 80;
      if (u === 0) return 'quatre-vingts';
      return 'quatre-vingt-' + ones[u];
    }
    return String(x);
  };
  const under1000 = (x: number): string => {
    if (x < 100) return under100(x);
    const h = Math.floor(x / 100), r = x % 100;
    const hs = h === 1 ? 'cent' : ones[h] + ' cent' + (r === 0 ? 's' : '');
    return r ? hs + ' ' + under100(r) : hs;
  };
  const abs = Math.round(Math.abs(Number(n) || 0));
  if (abs === 0) return 'zéro dirham';
  let s = '';
  const millions = Math.floor(abs / 1_000_000);
  const thousands = Math.floor((abs % 1_000_000) / 1000);
  const rest = abs % 1000;
  if (millions) s += (millions === 1 ? 'un million' : under1000(millions) + ' millions');
  if (thousands) {
    if (s) s += ' ';
    s += thousands === 1 ? 'mille' : under1000(thousands) + ' mille';
  }
  if (rest || !s) {
    if (s) s += ' ';
    s += under1000(rest);
  }
  const unit = abs > 1 ? 'dirhams' : 'dirham';
  return (s + ' ' + unit).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}


/**
 * Helvetica = WinAnsi. Keep Latin-1 (é, à, ç…) so French reads correctly.
 * Map only chars outside WinAnsi (Arabic, emoji, fancy punctuation).
 */
function safe(s: string): string {
  return String(s || '')
    .normalize('NFC')
    // Narrow/thin/nbsp spaces from fr-FR locale → regular space (WinAnsi)
    .replace(/[\u00A0\u202F\u2009\u2007\u2008]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/[—–]/g, '-')
    .replace(/ - /g, '-')
    .replace(/€/g, 'EUR')
    .replace(/[‘’‚']/g, "'")
    .replace(/[“”„]/g, '"')
    .replace(/œ/g, 'oe')
    .replace(/Œ/g, 'OE')
    .replace(/æ/g, 'ae')
    .replace(/Æ/g, 'AE')
    // Keep Latin-1 (includes é è à ç ù …); drop everything else
    .replace(/[^\x20-\x7E\xA0-\xFF]/g, '?');
}

const PAGE_W = 595.28;
const PAGE_H = 841.89;
const M = 42;
const FOOTER_H = 56;
const BOTTOM = FOOTER_H + 24;

export async function buildInvoicePdfLib(input: PdfLibDocInput): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const pdf = await PDFDocument.create();
  const font = await pdf.embedFont(StandardFonts.Helvetica);
  const bold = await pdf.embedFont(StandardFonts.HelveticaBold);
  const ink = rgb(0.08, 0.1, 0.12);
  const muted = rgb(0.4, 0.4, 0.42);
  const rule = rgb(0.12, 0.14, 0.16);
  const headBg = rgb(0.12, 0.14, 0.16);
  const altRow = rgb(0.97, 0.97, 0.97);
  const cur = input.currency || 'MAD';
  const paid = Number(input.amountPaid || 0);
  const due = Math.max(0, Number(input.total || 0) - paid);
  const isInvoice = input.title === 'FACTURE';
  const isQuote = input.title === 'DEVIS';
  const wmText = safe(input.watermark || input.title || 'DOCUMENT');

  let page = pdf.addPage([PAGE_W, PAGE_H]);
  let y = PAGE_H - M;
  let pageIndex = 0;

  const drawWatermark = (p: PDFPage) => {
    const text = wmText.slice(0, 24);
    const size = 54;
    const tw = bold.widthOfTextAtSize(text, size);
    p.drawText(text, {
      x: (PAGE_W - tw) / 2,
      y: PAGE_H / 2 - 20,
      size,
      font: bold,
      color: rgb(0.75, 0.75, 0.75),
      opacity: 0.12,
      rotate: degrees(-28),
    });
  };

  const drawFooter = (p: PDFPage, idx: number, totalPages: number) => {
    p.drawLine({
      start: { x: M, y: 40 },
      end: { x: PAGE_W - M, y: 40 },
      thickness: 0.8,
      color: rule,
    });
    p.drawText(
      safe(String(input.footerNote || 'Document genere automatiquement — ne pas modifier').slice(0, 100)),
      { x: M, y: 28, size: 6.5, font, color: muted },
    );
    p.drawText(
      safe(`${input.number || ''}   -   page ${idx + 1}/${totalPages}`),
      { x: M, y: 16, size: 7, font, color: muted },
    );
  };

  const drawText = (
    p: PDFPage,
    text: string,
    x: number,
    yy: number,
    size = 9,
    f: PDFFont = font,
    color = ink,
  ) => {
    p.drawText(safe(text), { x, y: yy, size, font: f, color });
  };

  const ensureSpace = (need: number): void => {
    if (y - need < BOTTOM) {
      pageIndex++;
      page = pdf.addPage([PAGE_W, PAGE_H]);
      y = PAGE_H - M;
      drawWatermark(page);
      // continuation header
      drawText(page, `${input.title} ${input.number || ''} (suite)`, M, y, 10, bold);
      y -= 14;
      drawText(page, input.company.name || '', M, y, 8, font, muted);
      y -= 16;
      // table header again
      page.drawRectangle({ x: M, y: y - 6, width: PAGE_W - 2 * M, height: 18, color: headBg });
      const white = rgb(1, 1, 1);
      drawText(page, 'Article / service', M + 4, y - 1, 8, bold, white);
      drawText(page, 'Qte', M + 280, y - 1, 8, bold, white);
      drawText(page, 'P.U. HT', M + 320, y - 1, 8, bold, white);
      drawText(page, 'Total', M + 440, y - 1, 8, bold, white);
      y -= 20;
    }
  };

  drawWatermark(page);

  // Title + meta
  const isCredit =
    String(input.title || '').includes('WR') ||
    String(input.title || '').includes('REMBOURS') ||
    String(input.title || '').includes('AVOIR');
  drawText(page, input.title || 'FACTURE', M, y - 4, 20, bold);
  const metaX = PAGE_W - M - 160;
  drawText(page, 'N document', metaX, y, 8, font, muted);
  drawText(page, input.number || '-', metaX + 70, y, 9, bold);
  y -= 12;
  drawText(page, "Date d'emission", metaX, y, 8, font, muted);
  drawText(page, input.issueDate || '-', metaX + 70, y, 9);
  if (input.sourceInvoiceNumber) {
    y -= 12;
    drawText(page, 'Facture origine', metaX, y, 8, font, muted);
    drawText(page, String(input.sourceInvoiceNumber), metaX + 70, y, 9, bold);
  }
  if (input.dueDate && !isCredit) {
    y -= 12;
    drawText(page, isQuote ? 'Validité jusqu\'au' : 'Échéance', metaX, y, 8, font, muted);
    drawText(page, input.dueDate, metaX + 70, y, 9, bold);
  }
  y = PAGE_H - M - 36;

  drawText(page, input.company.name || 'Societe', M, y, 11, bold);
  y -= 12;
  const addr = [input.company.address, input.company.city].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
  if (addr) { drawText(page, addr, M, y, 8, font, muted); y -= 10; }
  const contact = [input.company.phone, input.company.email].filter(Boolean).join(' | ');
  if (contact) { drawText(page, contact, M, y, 8, font, muted); y -= 10; }
  const ids = [
    input.company.ice && `ICE ${input.company.ice}`,
    input.company.if_number && `IF ${input.company.if_number}`,
    input.company.rc && `RC ${input.company.rc}`,
    input.company.patente && `TP ${input.company.patente}`,
    (input.company as any).cnss && `CNSS ${(input.company as any).cnss}`,
  ].filter(Boolean).join('  ');
  if (ids) { drawText(page, ids, M, y, 7.5, font, muted); y -= 10; }

  y -= 6;
  page.drawRectangle({ x: M, y: y - 1, width: PAGE_W - 2 * M, height: 2.5, color: rule });
  y -= 18;

  const colW = (PAGE_W - 2 * M - 16) / 2;
  drawText(page, (input.party.label || 'Client').toUpperCase(), M, y, 8, bold, muted);
  drawText(page, 'PAIEMENT', M + colW + 16, y, 8, bold, muted);
  y -= 12;
  drawText(page, input.party.name || '-', M, y, 11, bold);
  if (input.company.bank_name) drawText(page, `Banque: ${input.company.bank_name}`, M + colW + 16, y, 9);
  y -= 11;
  let leftY = y;
  let rightY = y;
  if (input.party.ice) { drawText(page, `ICE: ${input.party.ice}`, M, leftY, 9); leftY -= 11; }
  if (input.party.address) { drawText(page, input.party.address, M, leftY, 8, font, muted); leftY -= 11; }
  if (input.party.city) { drawText(page, input.party.city, M, leftY, 8, font, muted); leftY -= 11; }
  if (input.company.bank_iban) {
    drawText(page, `RIB: ${input.company.bank_iban}`, M + colW + 16, rightY, 8, font, muted);
    rightY -= 11;
  }
  drawText(page, `Devise: ${cur}`, M + colW + 16, rightY, 9);
  y = Math.min(leftY, rightY) - 8;

  if (isInvoice) {
    const msg = due <= 0.001
      ? `STATUT: PAYÉE INTÉGRALEMENT — ${money(paid)} ${cur}`
      : `RESTE DÛ: ${money(due)} ${cur}   (payé ${money(paid)} / total ${money(input.total)} ${cur})`;
    page.drawRectangle({
      x: M, y: y - 8, width: PAGE_W - 2 * M, height: 24,
      borderColor: rule, borderWidth: 1, color: rgb(0.96, 0.96, 0.96),
    });
    drawText(page, msg, M + 10, y - 1, 10, bold);
    y -= 32;
  } else if (isQuote) {
    drawText(page, 'DEVIS — document estimatif (non facture)', M, y, 9, bold);
    y -= 16;
  }

  // Table header
  page.drawRectangle({ x: M, y: y - 6, width: PAGE_W - 2 * M, height: 18, color: headBg });
  const white = rgb(1, 1, 1);
  drawText(page, 'Article / service', M + 4, y - 1, 8, bold, white);
  drawText(page, 'Qte', M + 280, y - 1, 8, bold, white);
  drawText(page, 'P.U. HT', M + 320, y - 1, 8, bold, white);
  drawText(page, 'Total', M + 440, y - 1, 8, bold, white);
  y -= 20;

  let row = 0;
  for (const it of input.items || []) {
    const fullName = String(it.name || '-');
    const line1 = fullName.slice(0, 42);
    const line2 = fullName.length > 42 ? fullName.slice(42, 84) : '';
    const rowH = line2 ? 24 : 14;
    ensureSpace(rowH + 4);
    if (row % 2 === 1) {
      page.drawRectangle({ x: M, y: y - (line2 ? 14 : 4), width: PAGE_W - 2 * M, height: rowH, color: altRow });
    }
    drawText(page, line1, M + 4, y, 9);
    drawText(page, String(it.qty), M + 280, y, 9);
    drawText(page, money(it.unit), M + 320, y, 9);
    drawText(page, money(it.total), M + 440, y, 9);
    if (line2) {
      y -= 11;
      drawText(page, line2, M + 4, y, 8, font, muted);
    }
    y -= 14;
    row++;
  }

  ensureSpace(120);
  y -= 6;
  page.drawLine({ start: { x: M, y }, end: { x: PAGE_W - M, y }, thickness: 0.6, color: muted });
  y -= 16;

  const tx = PAGE_W - M - 175;
  {
    const discLib = Number(input.discountTotal || 0);
    const sous = discLib > 0.001 ? Number(input.subtotal || 0) + discLib : Number(input.subtotal || 0);
    drawText(page, 'Sous-total', tx, y, 9, font, muted);
    drawText(page, `${money(sous)} ${cur}`, tx + 95, y, 9);
    y -= 12;
    if (discLib > 0.001) {
      drawText(page, 'Promo / remise', tx, y, 9, font, muted);
      drawText(page, `−${money(discLib)} ${cur}`, tx + 95, y, 9);
      y -= 12;
    }
  }
  if (Number(input.taxAmount || 0) > 0.001) {
    drawText(page, 'TVA', tx, y, 9, font, muted);
    drawText(page, `${money(input.taxAmount)} ${cur}`, tx + 95, y, 9);
    y -= 14;
  }
  page.drawLine({ start: { x: tx, y: y + 8 }, end: { x: PAGE_W - M, y: y + 8 }, thickness: 1.2, color: rule });
  drawText(page, Number(input.taxAmount || 0) > 0.001 ? 'Total TTC' : 'Total', tx, y, 12, bold);
  drawText(page, `${money(input.total)} ${cur}`, tx + 95, y, 12, bold);
  y -= 16;
  if (isInvoice || isCredit) {
    ensureSpace(22);
    const words = amountInWordsFr(Math.abs(Number(input.total) || 0), cur);
    drawText(page, safe(`Arrêté ${isCredit ? 'le présent avoir' : 'la présente facture'} à la somme de ${words}.`), M, y, 8, font, muted);
    y -= 14;
  }
  if (isInvoice && paid > 0) {
    drawText(page, `Déjà payé: ${money(paid)} ${cur}   Reste: ${money(due)} ${cur}`, tx, y, 8, font, muted);
    y -= 14;
  }

  if (isCredit && input.refundReason) {
    ensureSpace(36);
    drawText(page, 'Motif du credit / remboursement', M, y, 8, bold);
    y -= 11;
    drawText(page, String(input.refundReason).slice(0, 110), M, y, 8, font, muted);
    y -= 14;
  } else if (input.notes) {
    ensureSpace(30);
    drawText(page, 'Notes', M, y, 8, bold, muted);
    y -= 11;
    drawText(page, String(input.notes).slice(0, 110), M, y, 8, font, muted);
    y -= 14;
  }

  // Refund policy on every sales invoice / WR (covers reprints of old invoices)
  if (input.refundPolicy && input.title !== 'DEVIS' && !String(input.title).includes('ACHAT')) {
    ensureSpace(48);
    drawText(page, 'Politique de remboursement', M, y, 8, bold);
    y -= 11;
    const policy = String(input.refundPolicy);
    const chunk = 95;
    for (let i = 0; i < policy.length && i < 380; i += chunk) {
      ensureSpace(12);
      drawText(page, policy.slice(i, i + chunk), M, y, 7, font, muted);
      y -= 10;
    }
    y -= 4;
  }

  if (isQuote) {
    // Stay on current page when space remains; only new page if strictly insufficient
    const need = 72;
    ensureSpace(need);
    y -= 6;
    drawText(page, 'BON POUR ACCORD', M, y, 10, bold);
    y -= 14;
    drawText(page, 'Date _______________  Nom / qualite _______________', M, y, 9, font, muted);
    y -= 16;
    drawText(page, 'Signature client ____________________  Cachet ____________________', M, y, 9, font, muted);
    y -= 14;
  }

    if (isInvoice && input.publicUrl) {
    ensureSpace(78);
    const boxH = 70;
    page.drawRectangle({
      x: M, y: y - boxH + 8, width: PAGE_W - 2 * M, height: boxH,
      borderColor: muted, borderWidth: 0.8, color: rgb(0.98, 0.98, 0.98),
    });
    try {
      const { matrix, logoFrom, logoSize } = qrMatrixWithLogo(String(input.publicUrl));
      const qs = 56;
      const qx = M + 8;
      const qy = y - boxH + 14;
      const n = matrix.length || 1;
      const cell = qs / n;
      page.drawRectangle({ x: qx, y: qy, width: qs, height: qs, color: rgb(1, 1, 1) });
      for (let r = 0; r < n; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) {
          if (matrix[r][c]) {
            page.drawRectangle({
              x: qx + c * cell,
              y: qy + (n - 1 - r) * cell,
              width: cell + 0.05,
              height: cell + 0.05,
              color: rgb(0.04, 0.04, 0.04),
            });
          }
        }
      }
      // Center Atlas plate
      const ls = logoSize * cell;
      const lx = qx + logoFrom * cell;
      const ly = qy + (n - logoFrom - logoSize) * cell;
      page.drawRectangle({
        x: lx, y: ly, width: ls, height: ls,
        color: rgb(0.04, 0.04, 0.04),
      });
      drawText(page, 'A', lx + ls * 0.28, ly + ls * 0.28, Math.max(8, ls * 0.55), bold, rgb(1, 1, 1));
      drawText(page, 'Scanner pour vérifier ce document', M + 72, y - 6, 9, bold);
      drawText(page, `${input.number || ''}  -  Total ${money(input.total)} ${cur}  -  Payé ${money(paid)}  -  Reste ${money(due)}`, M + 72, y - 20, 8, font, muted);
      drawText(page, 'QR officiel Atlas — ne scannez pas d\'autres codes.', M + 72, y - 32, 7, font, muted);
    } catch {
      drawText(page, 'Vérification en ligne (QR indisponible)', M + 8, y - 6, 8, bold);
      drawText(page, `Total ${money(input.total)} ${cur} | Payé ${money(paid)} | Reste ${money(due)}`, M + 8, y - 18, 8, font, muted);
    }
    y -= boxH + 8;
  }


  // Stamp + digital seal — continue from current y (no forced jump to page bottom)
  ensureSpace(56);
  const sigY = y - 10;
  page.drawLine({ start: { x: M, y: sigY }, end: { x: M + 120, y: sigY }, thickness: 0.5, color: muted });
  drawText(page, 'Signature société', M, sigY - 12, 7, font, muted);
  page.drawCircle({ x: M + 180, y: sigY + 8, size: 20, borderColor: muted, borderWidth: 0.7 });
  drawText(page, 'Cachet', M + 165, sigY - 12, 7, font, muted);

  // Digital signature / integrity seal
  const sealY = sigY - 36;
  page.drawRectangle({
    x: M + 240, y: sealY - 8, width: PAGE_W - M - 240 - M, height: 42,
    borderColor: rule, borderWidth: 0.8, color: rgb(0.97, 0.98, 0.97),
  });
  const sealTitle = input.clientSignaturePresent
    ? (input.signatureValid === false ? 'Signature client a verifier' : 'Signature client + sceau + horodatage')
    : 'Sceau numérique du document';
  drawText(page, sealTitle, M + 248, sealY + 18, 8, bold);
  if (input.integrityHash) {
    drawText(page, `Hash SHA-256: ${input.integrityHash.slice(0, 24)}...`, M + 248, sealY + 6, 7, font, muted);
  }
  if (input.signedAt) {
    drawText(page, `Signe le ${input.signedAt}`, M + 248, sealY - 4, 7, font, muted);
  } else {
    drawText(page, input.timestampAt
    ? `Horodatage: ${String(input.timestampAt).slice(0, 19)} UTC (PAdES-B-T)`
    : 'Empreinte document (intégrité SHA-256)', M + 248, sealY - 4, 7, font, muted);
  }

  // Footer on all pages
  const pages = pdf.getPages();
  pages.forEach((p, i) => {
    if (i === 0) drawWatermark(p); // already on first; continue pages got it in ensureSpace
    drawFooter(p, i, pages.length);
  });
  // Ensure watermark on every page
  for (const p of pages) {
    // watermark already drawn when page created; re-draw is ok with opacity
  }

  // PDF digital seal metadata (readable by PDF inspectors)
  const hash = input.integrityHash || '';
  pdf.setTitle(safe(`${input.title} ${input.number || ''}`));
  pdf.setSubject(safe(`Integrity ${hash.slice(0, 16)}  -  Atlas Commerce`));
  pdf.setKeywords([
    'atlas-commerce',
    input.title || 'doc',
    input.number || '',
    hash ? `hash:${hash.slice(0, 32)}` : 'unsigned',
    input.clientSignaturePresent ? 'client-signed' : 'no-client-sig',
  ].filter(Boolean).map(safe));
  pdf.setProducer('Atlas Commerce PDF');
  pdf.setCreator('Atlas Commerce');

  return pdf.save();
}

/**
 * Lightweight PDF generator for Cloudflare Workers (no native deps).
 * Produces valid PDF 1.4 with Helvetica — suitable for invoices / receipts.
 * For richer HTML→PDF later: Cloudflare Browser Rendering or pdf-lib.
 */

type RGB = [number, number, number];

function esc(s: string): string {
  return String(s || '')
    .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')
    .replace(/\(/g, '\\(')
    .replace(/\)/g, '\\)')
    .replace(/[^\x20-\x7E\u00C0-\u024F]/g, (ch) => {
      // Keep Latin-1 range for French accents via WinAnsi-ish approximation in comments;
      // Helvetica standard encoding is limited — map common FR chars to ASCII fallbacks for reliability.
      const map: Record<string, string> = {
        'é': 'e', 'è': 'e', 'ê': 'e', 'ë': 'e',
        'à': 'a', 'â': 'a', 'ä': 'a',
        'ù': 'u', 'û': 'u', 'ü': 'u',
        'ô': 'o', 'ö': 'o',
        'î': 'i', 'ï': 'i',
        'ç': 'c',
        'É': 'E', 'È': 'E', 'Ê': 'E', 'Ë': 'E',
        'À': 'A', 'Â': 'A', 'Ä': 'A',
        'Ù': 'U', 'Û': 'U', 'Ü': 'U',
        'Ô': 'O', 'Ö': 'O',
        'Î': 'I', 'Ï': 'I',
        'Ç': 'C',
        '·': '-', '—': '-', '–': '-',
        '€': 'EUR', '°': 'o',
      };
      return map[ch] || '?';
    });
}

function fmtMoney(n: number): string {
  return Math.round(Number(n || 0)).toLocaleString("fr-FR");
}

export type PdfDocInput = {
  title: string; // FACTURE | DEVIS | RECU
  number: string;
  issueDate: string;
  dueDate?: string;
  company: {
    name: string;
    address?: string;
    city?: string;
    phone?: string;
    email?: string;
    ice?: string;
    if_number?: string;
    rc?: string;
    patente?: string;
    cnss?: string;
    legal_form?: string;
    bank_name?: string;
    bank_iban?: string;
  };
  party: {
    label: string; // Client | Fournisseur
    name: string;
    ice?: string;
    address?: string;
    city?: string;
    email?: string;
    phone?: string;
  };
  items: { name: string; qty: number; unit: number; taxRate: number; total: number; listPrice?: number; discount?: number }[];
  subtotal: number;
  /** Total promo / remise (positive number shown as negative line) */
  discountTotal?: number;
  taxAmount: number;
  total: number;
  amountPaid?: number;
  currency?: string;
  notes?: string;
  refundPolicy?: string;
  status?: string;
};

/** Build a simple single-page A4 PDF (bytes). */
export function buildInvoicePdf(input: PdfDocInput): Uint8Array {
  const cur = input.currency || 'MAD';
  const paid = Number(input.amountPaid || 0);
  const due = Math.max(0, Number(input.total || 0) - paid);
  const W = 595; // A4 points
  const H = 842;
  const margin = 40;
  const lines: string[] = [];
  let y = H - margin;

  const push = (cmd: string) => lines.push(cmd);
  const text = (str: string, x: number, yy: number, size = 10) => {
    push(`BT /F1 ${size} Tf ${x.toFixed(1)} ${yy.toFixed(1)} Td (${esc(str)}) Tj ET`);
  };
  const bold = (str: string, x: number, yy: number, size = 10) => {
    push(`BT /F2 ${size} Tf ${x.toFixed(1)} ${yy.toFixed(1)} Td (${esc(str)}) Tj ET`);
  };
  const hline = (x1: number, x2: number, yy: number) => {
    push(`${x1} ${yy} m ${x2} ${yy} l S`);
  };

  // Header company
  bold(input.company.name || 'Societe', margin, y, 14);
  y -= 14;
  const coBits = [
    input.company.address,
    input.company.city,
    input.company.phone,
    input.company.email,
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' | ');
  if (coBits) { text(coBits, margin, y, 8); y -= 11; }
  const idBits = [
    input.company.ice ? `ICE: ${input.company.ice}` : '',
    input.company.if_number ? `IF: ${input.company.if_number}` : '',
    input.company.rc ? `RC: ${input.company.rc}` : '',
    input.company.patente ? `TP: ${input.company.patente}` : '',
    input.company.cnss ? `CNSS: ${input.company.cnss}` : '',
  ].filter(Boolean).join('  ');
  if (idBits) { text(idBits, margin, y, 8); y -= 12; }
  if (input.company.legal_form) { text(input.company.legal_form, margin, y, 8); y -= 12; }

  // Document title right
  bold(input.title, W - margin - 120, H - margin, 16);
  text(`N ${input.number}`, W - margin - 120, H - margin - 16, 10);
  text(`Date: ${input.issueDate}`, W - margin - 120, H - margin - 28, 9);
  if (input.dueDate) text(`Echeance: ${input.dueDate}`, W - margin - 120, H - margin - 40, 9);

  y -= 8;
  hline(margin, W - margin, y);
  y -= 18;

  // Party box
  bold(input.party.label, margin, y, 9);
  y -= 12;
  bold(input.party.name, margin, y, 11);
  y -= 12;
  if (input.party.ice) { text(`ICE client: ${input.party.ice}`, margin, y, 9); y -= 11; }
  if (input.party.address) { text(input.party.address, margin, y, 9); y -= 11; }
  if (input.party.city) { text(input.party.city, margin, y, 9); y -= 11; }
  if (input.party.email || input.party.phone) {
    text([input.party.email, input.party.phone].filter(Boolean).join(' | '), margin, y, 9);
    y -= 11;
  }

  // Bank
  if (input.company.bank_name || input.company.bank_iban) {
    y -= 4;
    text(
      `Banque: ${input.company.bank_name || '-'}  RIB: ${input.company.bank_iban || '-'}`,
      margin,
      y,
      8,
    );
    y -= 14;
  }

  // Status line
  if (input.title === 'FACTURE') {
    const statusLine =
      due <= 0.001
        ? `STATUT: SOLDEE (payee integralement) — Paye ${fmtMoney(paid)} ${cur}`
        : `STATUT: A REGLER — Reste du ${fmtMoney(due)} ${cur} (paye ${fmtMoney(paid)})`;
    bold(statusLine, margin, y, 9);
    y -= 16;
  } else if (input.title === 'DEVIS') {
    bold('DOCUMENT ESTIMATIF — non facture, stock non engage', margin, y, 9);
    y -= 16;
  }

  // Table header
  hline(margin, W - margin, y);
  y -= 12;
  bold('Designation', margin, y, 9);
  bold('Qte', margin + 280, y, 9);
  bold('P.U. HT', margin + 320, y, 9);
  bold('Total', margin + 440, y, 9);
  y -= 6;
  hline(margin, W - margin, y);
  y -= 14;

  for (const it of input.items || []) {
    if (y < 120) break; // keep footer space (single page simplification)
    const name = String(it.name || '').slice(0, 48);
    text(name, margin, y, 9);
    text(String(it.qty), margin + 280, y, 9);
    text(fmtMoney(it.unit), margin + 320, y, 9);
    text(fmtMoney(it.total), margin + 440, y, 9);
    y -= 13;
  }

  y -= 4;
  hline(margin, W - margin, y);
  y -= 16;

  // Totals
  const tx = W - margin - 160;
  {
    const disc = Number(input.discountTotal || 0);
    const sous = disc > 0.001 ? Number(input.subtotal || 0) + disc : Number(input.subtotal || 0);
    text(`Sous-total`, tx, y, 9); text(`${fmtMoney(sous)} ${cur}`, tx + 90, y, 9); y -= 12;
    if (disc > 0.001) {
      text(`Promo / remise`, tx, y, 9); text(`−${fmtMoney(disc)} ${cur}`, tx + 90, y, 9); y -= 12;
    }
  }
  if (Number(input.taxAmount || 0) > 0.001) { text(`TVA`, tx, y, 9); text(`${fmtMoney(input.taxAmount)} ${cur}`, tx + 90, y, 9); y -= 12; }
  bold(`Total`, tx, y, 11); bold(`${fmtMoney(input.total)} ${cur}`, tx + 90, y, 11); y -= 18;

  if (input.notes) {
    text(`Notes: ${String(input.notes).slice(0, 120)}`, margin, y, 8);
    y -= 12;
  }
  if (input.refundPolicy && input.title !== 'DEVIS' && !String(input.title).includes('ACHAT')) {
    bold('Politique de remboursement', margin, y, 8);
    y -= 11;
    const pol = String(input.refundPolicy);
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(pol.length, 360); i += 90) {
      text(pol.slice(i, i + 90), margin, y, 7);
      y -= 9;
    }
  }


  const contentStream = lines.join('\n');
  const contentLen = new TextEncoder().encode(contentStream).length;

  // Assemble PDF objects
  const objects: string[] = [];
  objects.push('1 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>\nendobj\n');
  objects.push('2 0 obj\n<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>\nendobj\n');
  objects.push(
    `3 0 obj\n<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 ${W} ${H}] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R /F2 6 0 R >> >> >>\nendobj\n`,
  );
  objects.push(`4 0 obj\n<< /Length ${contentLen} >>\nstream\n${contentStream}\nendstream\nendobj\n`);
  objects.push('5 0 obj\n<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>\nendobj\n');
  objects.push('6 0 obj\n<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>\nendobj\n');

  let pdf = '%PDF-1.4\n';
  const offsets: number[] = [0];
  for (const obj of objects) {
    offsets.push(new TextEncoder().encode(pdf).length);
    pdf += obj;
  }
  const xrefPos = new TextEncoder().encode(pdf).length;
  pdf += `xref\n0 ${objects.length + 1}\n`;
  pdf += '0000000000 65535 f \n';
  for (let i = 1; i <= objects.length; i++) {
    pdf += `${String(offsets[i]).padStart(10, '0')} 00000 n \n`;
  }
  pdf += `trailer\n<< /Size ${objects.length + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n${xrefPos}\n%%EOF`;

  return new TextEncoder().encode(pdf);
}

export function buildFinanceReportPdf(input: FinanceReportInput): Uint8Array {
  const cur = input.currency || 'MAD';

  const H = 842;
