import { afterEach, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { sendFcmToUser, upsertDeviceToken, resetLocalSchemaOnceForTests } from '../lib/fcm';

const SQLITE_MODULE = ['node:', 'sqlite'].join('');
const { DatabaseSync } = await import(SQLITE_MODULE);
let testPem: string;

beforeAll(async () => {
  // Ephemeral local test key, never production credentials or written to disk.
  const pair = await crypto.subtle.generateKey({ name: 'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', modulusLength: 2048, publicExponent: new Uint8Array([1, 0, 1]), hash: 'SHA-256' }, true, ['sign', 'verify']);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.exportKey('pkcs8', pair.privateKey));
  testPem = `-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n${btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes))}\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----`;
});

function makeD1() {
  const sqlite = new DatabaseSync(':memory:');
  const db: any = {
    prepare(sql: string) {
      let params: any[] = [];
      const stmt: any = {
        bind(...p: any[]) { params = p; return stmt; },
        async run() { const r = sqlite.prepare(sql).run(...params); return { success: true, meta: { changes: Number(r.changes) } }; },
        async all() { return { results: sqlite.prepare(sql).all(...params) }; },
      };
      return stmt;
    },
  };
  return { sqlite, db };
}

let db: any;
let sqlite: any;
let env: any;
let sends: any[];
let response: (body: any) => Response | Promise<Response>;
let oauthStatus: number;
let logs: unknown[][];
const opts = { title: 'Atlas Commerce', body: 'Une demande attend votre validation.', data: { event: 'stock_request_submitted', request_id: '42' } };
const fcmError = (code: string, status = 404, extra: unknown[] = []) => Response.json({ error: { status: status === 404 ? 'NOT_FOUND' : 'INVALID_ARGUMENT', details: [...extra, { '@type': 'type.googleapis.com/google.firebase.fcm.v1.FcmError', errorCode: code }] } }, { status });
const count = () => Number(sqlite.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM device_push_tokens').get().n);

beforeEach(async () => {
  resetLocalSchemaOnceForTests();
  ({ db, sqlite } = makeD1());
  await upsertDeviceToken(db, 'alice', 'registration-private-1');
  env = { DB: db, FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: 'atlas-test', FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL: 'test@atlas-test.iam.gserviceaccount.com', FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY: testPem };
  sends = [];
  logs = [];
  oauthStatus = 200;
  response = () => Response.json({ name: 'projects/atlas-test/messages/message-123' });
  for (const method of ['info', 'warn', 'error'] as const) vi.spyOn(console, method).mockImplementation((...args: unknown[]) => { logs.push(args); });
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', async (url: string, init: RequestInit) => {
    if (new URL(String(url)).hostname === 'oauth2.googleapis.com') return Response.json(oauthStatus === 200 ? { access_token: 'oauth-private-token' } : { error: 'invalid_grant', error_description: 'credential-private-text' }, { status: oauthStatus });
    const body = JSON.parse(String(init.body));
    sends.push({ url: String(url), ...body });
    return response(body);
  });
});
afterEach(() => { sqlite.close(); vi.unstubAllGlobals(); vi.restoreAllMocks(); });

describe('FCM Android send path', () => {
  it('sends a visible v1 notification on atlas_assist with event/IDs and logs the accepted message ID', async () => {
    expect(await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).toEqual({ sent: 1, purged: 0 });
    expect(sends[0]).toMatchObject({
      url: 'https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/atlas-test/messages:send',
      message: { token: 'registration-private-1', notification: { title: opts.title, body: opts.body }, android: { priority: 'HIGH', notification: { channel_id: 'atlas_assist' } }, data: { event: 'stock_request_submitted', request_id: '42', click_action: 'ATLAS_ASSIST_APPROVAL' } },
    });
    expect(JSON.stringify(logs)).toContain('message-123');
    expect(JSON.stringify(logs)).toContain('http_status');
    expect(JSON.stringify(logs)).not.toMatch(/registration-private|oauth-private|PRIVATE KEY|credential-private/);
  });

  it('supports normal priority and preserves older type-based click metadata', async () => {
    await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', { ...opts, data: { type: 'low_stock', product_id: '2' }, priority: 'NORMAL' });
    expect(sends[0].message.android.priority).toBe('NORMAL');
    expect(sends[0].message.data).toMatchObject({ event: 'low_stock', type: 'low_stock', product_id: '2' });
  });

  it.each([{ title: ' ', body: 'body' }, { title: 'title', body: '' }])('does not send an empty user-visible notification: %j', async (invalid) => {
    expect(await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', invalid)).toEqual({ sent: 0, purged: 0 });
    expect(sends).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(count()).toBe(1);
  });

  it('purges only explicit typed UNREGISTERED, even after an unrelated first detail', async () => {
    response = () => fcmError('UNREGISTERED', 404, [{ '@type': 'type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.BadRequest', fieldViolations: [] }]);
    expect(await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).toEqual({ sent: 0, purged: 1 });
    expect(count()).toBe(0);
  });

  it.each([400, 401, 403, 404, 410, 429, 500, 503])('retains tokens on bare HTTP %s and logs its response code', async (status) => {
    response = () => Response.json({ error: { status: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'registration-private-1 oauth-private-token' } }, { status });
    expect(await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).toEqual({ sent: 0, purged: 0 });
    expect(count()).toBe(1);
    expect(JSON.stringify(logs)).toContain(`"http_status":${status}`);
    expect(JSON.stringify(logs)).not.toMatch(/registration-private|oauth-private/);
  });

  it.each(['SENDER_ID_MISMATCH', 'INVALID_ARGUMENT', 'THIRD_PARTY_AUTH_ERROR', 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED', 'UNAVAILABLE'])('retains tokens explicitly rejected with %s', async (code) => {
    response = () => fcmError(code, 403);
    expect(await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).toEqual({ sent: 0, purged: 0 });
    expect(count()).toBe(1);
    expect(JSON.stringify(logs)).toContain(code);
  });

  it('does not mistake a generic or incorrectly typed error for an FCM unregistration', async () => {
    response = () => Response.json({ error: { status: 'NOT_FOUND', details: [{ errorCode: 'UNREGISTERED' }] } }, { status: 404 });
    expect((await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).purged).toBe(0);
    expect(count()).toBe(1);
  });

  it('does not count an empty, malformed or wrong-project 2xx response as acceptance', async () => {
    for (const body of [{}, { name: 'projects/other-project/messages/m1' }, { name: 'projects/atlas-test/messages/' }]) {
      response = () => Response.json(body);
      expect((await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).sent).toBe(0);
    }
    expect(count()).toBe(1);
  });

  it('continues to other devices on a network failure and never logs exception text', async () => {
    await upsertDeviceToken(db, 'alice', 'registration-private-2');
    response = (body) => {
      if (body.message.token === 'registration-private-1') throw new Error('registration-private-1 oauth-private-token');
      return Response.json({ name: 'projects/atlas-test/messages/other-message' });
    };
    expect(await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).toEqual({ sent: 1, purged: 0 });
    expect(sends).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(count()).toBe(2);
    expect(JSON.stringify(logs)).not.toMatch(/registration-private|oauth-private/);
  });

  it('does not fall back to legacy after configured v1 OAuth is rejected', async () => {
    env.FCM_SERVER_KEY = 'legacy-private-key';
    oauthStatus = 401;
    expect(await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).toEqual({ sent: 0, purged: 0 });
    expect(sends).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(count()).toBe(1);
    expect(JSON.stringify(logs)).not.toMatch(/credential-private|legacy-private|PRIVATE KEY/);
  });

  it('legacy compatibility inspects per-recipient errors; bare 404 cannot purge', async () => {
    delete env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID;
    env.FCM_SERVER_KEY = 'legacy-private-key';
    response = () => new Response('gone', { status: 404 });
    expect(await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).toEqual({ sent: 0, purged: 0 });
    expect(count()).toBe(1);
    response = () => Response.json({ results: [{ error: 'NotRegistered' }] });
    expect(await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).toEqual({ sent: 0, purged: 1 });
    expect(count()).toBe(0);
  });

  it('legacy HTTP 200 with a quota error is not accepted or purged', async () => {
    delete env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID;
    env.FCM_SERVER_KEY = 'legacy-private-key';
    response = () => Response.json({ results: [{ error: 'Unavailable' }] });
    expect(await sendFcmToUser(env, 'alice', opts)).toEqual({ sent: 0, purged: 0 });
    expect(count()).toBe(1);
  });

  it('creates the registration table independently for each database without discarding tokens', async () => {
    const other = makeD1();
    try {
      await upsertDeviceToken(other.db, 'alice', 'registration-private-other');
      expect(Number(other.sqlite.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM device_push_tokens').get().n)).toBe(1);
      expect(count()).toBe(1);
    } finally { other.sqlite.close(); }
  });
});

/**
 * v0.7.1 — Unit tests for the server-side inventory-privacy policy and the
 * device-label helper (worker/lib/inventory-policy.ts). Pure functions: no
 * D1/Hono needed.
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  normalizeInventoryRole,
  roleCanSeeFinancial,
  roleCanSeeSellPrices,
  roleCanApproveStockAdjustment,
  roleCanSubmitStockAdjustmentRequest,
  roleCanDirectAdjustStock,
  scrubProductForRole,
  deviceLabelFromUA,
} from '../lib/inventory-policy';

const ROW = {
  id: 7,
  name: 'Carrelage grès cérame 60×60',
  sku: 'CR-6060',
  barcode: '610000000001',
  stock_quantity: 42,
  low_stock_threshold: 5,
  track_inventory: 1,
  price: 89,
  unit_price: 89,
  cost: 61,
  cost_price: 61,
  stock_value: 2562,
};

describe('inventory privacy — scrub matrix', () => {
  it('owner/admin keep every field (financial access)', () => {
    for (const role of ['owner', 'admin']) {
      const out = scrubProductForRole(ROW, role) as any;
      expect(out.price).toBe(89);
      expect(out.cost).toBe(61);
      expect(out.stock_value).toBe(2562);
      expect(out.stock_quantity).toBe(42);
    }
  });

  it('secretaire keeps selling prices but never costs/valuation', () => {
    const out = scrubProductForRole(ROW, 'secretaire') as any;
    expect(out.price).toBe(89);
    expect(out.unit_price).toBe(89);
    expect(out.cost).toBeUndefined();
    expect(out.cost_price).toBeUndefined();
    expect(out.stock_value).toBeUndefined();
    expect(out.stock_quantity).toBe(42);
  });

  it('stock (magasinier) and user (operator) get operational basics only', () => {
    for (const role of ['stock', 'user']) {
      const out = scrubProductForRole(ROW, role) as any;
      expect(out.price).toBeUndefined();
      expect(out.unit_price).toBeUndefined();
      expect(out.cost).toBeUndefined();
      expect(out.cost_price).toBeUndefined();
      expect(out.stock_value).toBeUndefined();
      // operational basics survive
      expect(out.id).toBe(7);
      expect(out.name).toBe(ROW.name);
      expect(out.sku).toBe('CR-6060');
      expect(out.stock_quantity).toBe(42);
      expect(out.low_stock_threshold).toBe(5);
    }
  });

  it('unknown/empty roles fall back to the strictest profile', () => {
    for (const role of ['', 'hacker', undefined as any]) {
      const out = scrubProductForRole(ROW, role) as any;
      expect(out.price).toBeUndefined();
      expect(out.cost).toBeUndefined();
      expect(normalizeInventoryRole(role)).toBe('user');
    }
  });

  it('scrub never mutates the source row', () => {
    const copy = { ...ROW };
    scrubProductForRole(ROW, 'stock');
    expect(ROW).toEqual(copy);
  });
});

describe('inventory privacy — role gates', () => {
  it('financial access = owner/admin only', () => {
    expect(roleCanSeeFinancial('owner')).toBe(true);
    expect(roleCanSeeFinancial('admin')).toBe(true);
    expect(roleCanSeeFinancial('secretaire')).toBe(false);
    expect(roleCanSeeFinancial('stock')).toBe(false);
    expect(roleCanSeeFinancial('user')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('selling prices = owner/admin/secretaire', () => {
    expect(roleCanSeeSellPrices('secretaire')).toBe(true);
    expect(roleCanSeeSellPrices('stock')).toBe(false);
    expect(roleCanSeeSellPrices('user')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('approval = owner/admin/secretaire; submission = everyone authenticated', () => {
    expect(roleCanApproveStockAdjustment('secretaire')).toBe(true);
    expect(roleCanApproveStockAdjustment('stock')).toBe(false);
    expect(roleCanApproveStockAdjustment('user')).toBe(false);
    for (const r of ['owner', 'admin', 'secretaire', 'stock', 'user']) {
      expect(roleCanSubmitStockAdjustmentRequest(r)).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('direct stock mutation = owner/admin/secretaire (stock/user → approval flow)', () => {
    expect(roleCanDirectAdjustStock('owner')).toBe(true);
    expect(roleCanDirectAdjustStock('admin')).toBe(true);
    expect(roleCanDirectAdjustStock('secretaire')).toBe(true);
    expect(roleCanDirectAdjustStock('stock')).toBe(false);
    expect(roleCanDirectAdjustStock('user')).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('device labels (devices modal shows names, not fingerprint hex)', () => {
  it('Android app UA → model + Android version', () => {
    expect(deviceLabelFromUA('Atlas-Android/1.2.3 (Android 14; PGEM10)')).toBe(
      'Atlas Android 1.2.3 · PGEM10 (Android 14)',
    );
  });
  it('Windows Chrome UA → browser + OS', () => {
    const label = deviceLabelFromUA(
      'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/151.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
    );

    expect(label).toContain('Windows 10/11');
    expect(label).not.toContain('Mozilla');
  });
  it('iPhone Safari UA → device + iOS version', () => {
    const label = deviceLabelFromUA(
      'Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 18_7 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/18.7 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1',
    );
    expect(label).toContain('iPhone');
    expect(label).toContain('iOS 18.7');
  });
  it('empty UA → generic label, never an empty string', () => {
    expect(deviceLabelFromUA('')).toBe('Appareil');
  });
});

/**
 * v0.7.1 — « OTP required always » regression tests on the REAL login route
 * (worker/index.ts) through an in-process SQLite (node:sqlite) D1 shim, same
 * harness style as expenses-auth.test.ts / stock-adjustments.test.ts.
 *
 * Locks the hardened policy:
 *  - a TRUSTED device no longer bypasses the e-mail OTP (the old hole: logged
 *    in as A on a trusted device, B could sign in with password only);
 *  - a brand-new account's first-ever login also requires the OTP;
 *  - OTP recipient = the user's own email when set, else the company MAIN
 *    email (company_settings.email), else the configured OTP inbox;
 *  - wrong password → 401 and no OTP email at all.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
const SQLITE_MODULE = ['node:', 'sqlite'].join('');
const { DatabaseSync } = (await import(SQLITE_MODULE)) as { DatabaseSync: new (path: string) => any };
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';

const sha256 = (s: string) => createHash('sha256').update(s, 'utf8').digest('hex');
// legacy verification path: sha256(`pc:${salt}:${password}`) — accepted once by
// verifyUserPassword, perfect for tests without re-implementing PBKDF2.
const legacyHash = (salt: string, pw: string) => sha256(`pc:${salt}:${pw}`);

function makeD1() {
  const sqlite = new DatabaseSync(':memory:');
  const db: any = {
    prepare(sql: string) {
      let params: any[] = [];
      const api: any = {
        bind(...p: any[]) { params = p; return api; },
        async run() {
          const r = sqlite.prepare(sql).run(...(params as any));
          return { success: true, meta: { changes: Number(r.changes || 0), last_row_id: Number(r.lastInsertRowid || 0) } };
        },
        async first() {
          const r = sqlite.prepare(sql).get(...(params as any));
          return r === undefined ? null : { ...(r as any) };
        },
        async all() {
          const rows = sqlite.prepare(sql).all(...(params as any)).map((r: any) => ({ ...r }));
          return { success: true, results: rows, meta: {} };
        },
      };
      return api;
    },
    async batch(stmts: any[]) {
      const out: any[] = [];
      for (const st of stmts) out.push(await st.run());
      return out;
    },
  };
  return { db, sqlite };
}

let db: any;
let sqlite: any;
let app: any;
let sendSpy: any;
let env: any;

beforeEach(async () => {
  const made = makeD1();
  db = made.db;
  sqlite = made.sqlite;
  sqlite.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company_settings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_name TEXT DEFAULT '', email TEXT DEFAULT '');
    INSERT INTO company_settings (id, company_name, email) VALUES (1, 'TestCo', 'main@corp.ma');
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_users (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT UNIQUE, password_hash TEXT DEFAULT '',
      password_salt TEXT DEFAULT '', role TEXT DEFAULT 'user', display_name TEXT DEFAULT '',
      active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, email TEXT DEFAULT '', created_by TEXT DEFAULT '',
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), last_login TEXT
    );
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS login_attempts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, ip TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT DEFAULT '', success INTEGER DEFAULT 0, reputation_delta INTEGER DEFAULT 0, user_agent TEXT DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')));
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_reputation (ip TEXT PRIMARY KEY, score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, failed_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, success_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, blocked_until TEXT, updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')));
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS otp_codes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, code TEXT NOT NULL, resource_type TEXT NOT NULL, resource_id TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), UNIQUE(resource_type, resource_id));
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_config (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')));
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trusted_devices (fingerprint TEXT PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT DEFAULT '', last_ip TEXT DEFAULT '', last_seen TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), biometric_credential_id TEXT DEFAULT '', username TEXT DEFAULT '', user_agent TEXT DEFAULT '', city TEXT DEFAULT '', country TEXT DEFAULT '');
  `);
  sendSpy = vi.fn(async () => ({}));
  env = {
    DB: db,
    CACHE: {},
    EMAIL: { send: sendSpy },
    ADMIN_PASSWORD: 'OwnerPass123!',
    TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY: '',
    TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY: '',
  };
  const mod: any = await import('../index');
  app = mod.default?.fetch ? mod.default : mod.app;
});

async function login(body: any) {
  const res = await app.fetch(
    new Request('http://test.local/api/auth/login', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    }),
    env,
  );
  return { status: res.status, body: await res.json() as any };
}
const sentTo = () => String(sendSpy.mock.calls[0]?.[0]?.to ?? sendSpy.mock.calls[0]?.[1]?.to ?? '');

describe('OTP required always', () => {
  it('trusted device NO LONGER bypasses the OTP (account-switch hole)', async () => {
    sqlite.exec(`INSERT INTO app_users (username, password_salt, password_hash, role, email)
                 VALUES ('mag', 's1', '${legacyHash('s1', 'Test1234!')}', 'stock', '')`);
    // device already trusted from a previous account session
    sqlite.exec(`INSERT INTO trusted_devices (fingerprint, username, user_agent, last_ip, last_seen)
                 VALUES ('fp1', 'other', 'ua', '203.0.113.7', datetime('now'))`);
    const r = await login({ username: 'mag', password: 'Test1234!', fingerprint: 'fp1' });
    expect(r.status).toBe(200);
    expect(r.body.needs_otp).toBe(true);
    expect(r.body.token).toBeUndefined();
    expect(sendSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('brand-new account, unknown device → OTP as well', async () => {
    sqlite.exec(`INSERT INTO app_users (username, password_salt, password_hash, role, email)
                 VALUES ('newbie', 's2', '${legacyHash('s2', 'Test1234!')}', 'user', '')`);
    const r = await login({ username: 'newbie', password: 'Test1234!', fingerprint: 'fp-new' });
    expect(r.body.needs_otp).toBe(true);
    expect(r.body.token).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('recipient = company MAIN email while the user has none', async () => {
    sqlite.exec(`INSERT INTO app_users (username, password_salt, password_hash, role, email)
                 VALUES ('mag', 's1', '${legacyHash('s1', 'Test1234!')}', 'stock', '')`);
    const r = await login({ username: 'mag', password: 'Test1234!', fingerprint: 'fp1' });
    expect(r.body.needs_otp).toBe(true);
    expect(sentTo()).toBe('main@corp.ma');
    expect(String(r.body.otp_sent_to || '')).toContain('ma•••@corp.ma');
  });

  it('recipient = the user own email once set', async () => {
    sqlite.exec(`INSERT INTO app_users (username, password_salt, password_hash, role, email)
                 VALUES ('mag', 's1', '${legacyHash('s1', 'Test1234!')}', 'stock', 'mag@corp.ma')`);
    const r = await login({ username: 'mag', password: 'Test1234!', fingerprint: 'fp1' });
    expect(r.body.needs_otp).toBe(true);
    expect(sentTo()).toBe('mag@corp.ma');
  });

  it('wrong password → 401 and no OTP email', async () => {
    sqlite.exec(`INSERT INTO app_users (username, password_salt, password_hash, role, email)
                 VALUES ('mag', 's1', '${legacyHash('s1', 'Test1234!')}', 'stock', 'mag@corp.ma')`);
    const r = await login({ username: 'mag', password: 'nope', fingerprint: 'fp1' });
    expect(r.status).toBe(401);
    expect(sendSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { MobileHub } from '../durable/MobileHub';
import { addColumnIfMissing } from '../lib/schema';
import { ensureFinanceSchema } from '../lib/finance';

const SQLITE_MODULE = ['node:', 'sqlite'].join('');
const { DatabaseSync } = await import(SQLITE_MODULE);

function makeD1() {
  const sqlite = new DatabaseSync(':memory:');
  const statements: string[] = [];
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const db: any = {
    prepare(sql: string) {
      let params: any[] = [];
      function execute(mode: 'run' | 'get' | 'all') {
        statements.push(sql);
        try { return sqlite.prepare(sql)[mode](...params); }
        catch (e) { errors.push(String(e)); throw e; }
      }
      const stmt: any = {
        bind(...values: any[]) { params = values; return stmt; },
        async run() { const r = execute('run'); return { success: true, meta: { changes: Number(r.changes) } }; },
        async first() { return execute('get') ?? null; },
        async all() { return { success: true, results: execute('all') }; },
      };
      return stmt;
    },
  };
  return { db, sqlite, statements, errors };
}

function makeHub() {
  const values = new Map<string, unknown>();
  const state: any = { storage: {
    async get(keys: string[]) { return new Map(keys.filter((k) => values.has(k)).map((k) => [k, values.get(k)])); },
    async put(patch: Record<string, unknown>) { for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(patch)) values.set(k, v); },
  } };
  const hub = new MobileHub(state, {} as any);
  return { hub, values };
}

const avatarRequest = (v: string, init?: RequestInit) => new Request(`https://do/avatar?v=${v}`, init);
afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());

describe('avatar cache observability', () => {
  it('returns a bodyless 204 for a cold cache, not an error span', async () => {
    const { hub } = makeHub();
    const response = await hub.fetch(avatarRequest('1'));
    expect(response.status).toBe(204);

/**
 * v262 — report period bounds test suite (worker/lib/report-period.ts).
 *
 * Covers: strictly validated YYYY-MM months (valid + invalid), timezone
 * boundaries via the injectable localTodayYmd(now), current partial months
 * (stop at today), historical months (full, leap-year safe), future months
 * (clamped), relative/custom parity with the previous behaviour, and period
 * propagation into section links (rt ticket kept, raw input & JWT never).
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';

import {
  buildReportLinkQuery,
  computePeriodBounds,
  parsePeriodMonth,
} from '../lib/report-period';
import { localTodayYmd } from '../lib/finance';

const TODAY = '2026-10-26';
const bounds = (period?: string | null, extra: { from?: string; to?: string } = {}) =>
  computePeriodBounds({ period, ...extra }, { todayYmd: TODAY });

describe('strict YYYY-MM validation', () => {
  it('parses only well-formed months', () => {
    expect(parsePeriodMonth('2026-09')).toEqual({ year: 2026, month: 9 });
    expect(parsePeriodMonth('2026-12')).toEqual({ year: 2026, month: 12 });
    expect(parsePeriodMonth(' 2026-01 ')).toEqual({ year: 2026, month: 1 });
    for (const bad of ['2026-13', '2026-00', '2026-1', '26-10', '2026-10-05', 'abcd-ef', 'nope', '', null, undefined, '2026/10', '2026_10', '99999-01']) {
      expect(parsePeriodMonth(bad)).toBeNull();
    }
    // sane year range only
    expect(parsePeriodMonth('1969-12')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePeriodMonth('1970-01')).toEqual({ year: 1970, month: 1 });
    expect(parsePeriodMonth('2100-12')).toEqual({ year: 2100, month: 12 });
    expect(parsePeriodMonth('2101-01')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('rejects invalid months by falling back to the current month (never crashes)', () => {
    for (const bad of ['2026-13', '2026-1', '26-10', '2026-10-05', 'abcd-ef', 'nope', '']) {
      const b = bounds(bad);
      expect(b.periodKey).toBe('month');
      expect(b.from).toBe('2026-10-01');
      expect(b.to).toBe(TODAY);
      expect(b.label).toBe('octobre 2026');
    }
  });
});

describe('absolute months', () => {
  it('historical month uses the FULL calendar month', () => {
    const b = bounds('2026-09');
    expect(b).toMatchObject({ from: '2026-09-01', to: '2026-09-30', label: 'septembre 2026', periodKey: '2026-09' });
  });

  it('is leap-year safe', () => {
    expect(bounds('2024-02')).toMatchObject({ from: '2024-02-01', to: '2024-02-29' });
    expect(bounds('2026-02')).toMatchObject({ from: '2026-02-01', to: '2026-02-28' });
    expect(bounds('2024-01')).toMatchObject({ to: '2024-01-31' });
    expect(bounds('2024-04')).toMatchObject({ to: '2024-04-30' });
  });

  it('current month is PARTIAL — stops at today (timezone today)', () => {
    const b = bounds('2026-10');
    expect(b).toMatchObject({ from: '2026-10-01', to: TODAY, label: 'octobre 2026', periodKey: '2026-10' });
  });

  it('future month clamps `to` at today (deterministic empty window)', () => {
    const b = bounds('2027-01');
    expect(b.from).toBe('2027-01-01');
    expect(b.to).toBe(TODAY);
    expect(b.periodKey).toBe('2027-01');
  });

  it('year boundaries: december and january', () => {
    expect(bounds('2025-12')).toMatchObject({ from: '2025-12-01', to: '2025-12-31', label: 'décembre 2025' });
    const jan = computePeriodBounds({ period: 'month' }, { todayYmd: '2026-01-15' });
    expect(jan).toMatchObject({ from: '2026-01-01', to: '2026-01-15', label: 'janvier 2026' });
  });
});

describe('relative periods (parity with previous behaviour, tz-anchored)', () => {
  it('month/3m/12m anchor on the timezone today', () => {
    expect(bounds('month')).toMatchObject({ from: '2026-10-01', to: TODAY, periodKey: 'month' });
    expect(bounds('3m')).toMatchObject({ from: '2026-08-01', to: TODAY, label: '3 derniers mois', periodKey: '3m' });
    expect(bounds('12m')).toMatchObject({ from: '2025-11-01', to: TODAY, periodKey: '12m' });
    expect(bounds()).toMatchObject(bounds('month')); // default = month
    expect(bounds(null)).toMatchObject(bounds('month'));
  });

  it('3m rolls over the year boundary', () => {
    const b = computePeriodBounds({ period: '3m' }, { todayYmd: '2026-01-15' });
    expect(b).toMatchObject({ from: '2025-11-01', to: '2026-01-15' });
  });

  it('year/ytd start january 1st of the timezone year', () => {
    expect(bounds('year')).toMatchObject({ from: '2026-01-01', to: TODAY, label: 'Année 2026', periodKey: 'year' });
    expect(bounds('ytd')).toMatchObject({ from: '2026-01-01', to: TODAY, periodKey: 'ytd' });
  });

  it('custom requires valid YYYY-MM-DD bounds and clamps `to` at today', () => {
    expect(bounds('custom', { from: '2026-09-05', to: '2026-09-20' }))
      .toMatchObject({ from: '2026-09-05', to: '2026-09-20', label: 'Du 2026-09-05 au 2026-09-20', periodKey: 'custom' });
    expect(bounds('custom', { from: '2026-09-05', to: '2027-01-01' }).to).toBe(TODAY);
    // invalid custom bounds → current-month fallback (no NaN dates like before)
    expect(bounds('custom', { from: 'nope', to: '2026-09-20' }).periodKey).toBe('month');
    expect(bounds('custom').periodKey).toBe('month');
  });
});

describe('timezone boundaries (company finance timezone, injectable now)', () => {
  it('Tokyo is already tomorrow when UTC is still today — bounds follow the timezone', () => {
    const now = new Date('2026-10-26T15:30:00Z'); // 00:30 JST on the 27th
    const tokyo = localTodayYmd('Asia/Tokyo', now);
    const utc = localTodayYmd('UTC', now);
    expect(tokyo).toBe('2026-10-27');
    expect(utc).toBe('2026-10-26');
    const bTokyo = computePeriodBounds({ period: 'month' }, { todayYmd: tokyo });
    expect(bTokyo.to).toBe('2026-10-27');
  });

  it('month rollover happens at the timezone midnight, not UTC midnight', () => {
    const now = new Date('2026-10-31T15:30:00Z'); // already Nov 1st in Tokyo
    const tokyo = localTodayYmd('Asia/Tokyo', now);
    expect(tokyo).toBe('2026-11-01');
    const b = computePeriodBounds({ period: 'month' }, { todayYmd: tokyo });
    expect(b).toMatchObject({ from: '2026-11-01', to: '2026-11-01', label: 'novembre 2026' });
    // same instant, UTC still in October
    const bUtc = computePeriodBounds({ period: 'month' }, { todayYmd: localTodayYmd('UTC', now) });
    expect(bUtc).toMatchObject({ from: '2026-10-01', to: '2026-10-31' });
  });

  it('uses the configured timezone today verbatim (no frozen Casablanca offset)', () => {
    // Whatever the current Africa/Casablanca offset (DST/Ramadan shifts),
    // the bound MUST equal the tz calendar day — never the raw UTC day when
    // they differ.
    for (const iso of ['2026-10-26T07:00:00Z', '2026-10-26T23:30:00Z', '2026-03-15T12:00:00Z']) {
      const now = new Date(iso);
      const casa = localTodayYmd('Africa/Casablanca', now);
      const b = computePeriodBounds({ period: 'month' }, { todayYmd: casa });
      expect(b.to).toBe(casa);
      expect(b.from).toBe(`${casa.slice(0, 7)}-01`);
    }
  });
});

describe('period propagation into section links (rt flow preserved)', () => {
  it('links carry rt + the NORMALIZED period, never raw input', () => {
    const b = bounds('2026-9'); // invalid raw input
    const q = buildReportLinkQuery('1234.abc', b.periodKey);
    expect(q).toBe('?rt=1234.abc&period=month'); // fell back + normalized

    const ok = bounds('2026-09');
    const q2 = buildReportLinkQuery('1234.abc', ok.periodKey, { employee_id: '7' });
    expect(q2).toContain('rt=1234.abc');
    expect(q2).toContain('period=2026-09');
    expect(q2).toContain('employee_id=7');
  });

  it('never emits a session JWT into a link, even if smuggled', () => {
    const q = buildReportLinkQuery('1234.abc', '2026-09', { token: 'SESSION-JWT-VALUE', rt: 'ignored-dup' });
    expect(q).not.toContain('SESSION-JWT-VALUE');
    expect(q).not.toContain('token=');
    // single rt — the ticket argument wins
    expect(q.match(/rt=/g)?.length).toBe(1);
    expect(q).toContain('rt=1234.abc');
  });

  it('degrades gracefully without rt (fallback fetch flow) and without period', () => {
    expect(buildReportLinkQuery('', '2026-09')).toBe('?period=2026-09');
    expect(buildReportLinkQuery('', '')).toBe('?');
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  REPORTS_REPO_DEFAULT,
  REPORTS_REPO_LEGACY,
  resolveReportsRepo,
} from '../lib/reports';

/**
 * v0.7 — crash/user reports come FROM the apps: GitHub issues must land in
 * the ANDROID repository, not the web project. The pre-0.7 default (web repo)
 * may still sit in app_config → it migrates on read.
 */
describe('resolveReportsRepo', () => {
  it('defaults to the android repository', () => {
    expect(REPORTS_REPO_DEFAULT).toBe('Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android');
    expect(resolveReportsRepo(null)).toBe('Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android');
    expect(resolveReportsRepo(undefined)).toBe('Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android');
    expect(resolveReportsRepo('')).toBe('Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android');
    expect(resolveReportsRepo('   ')).toBe('Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android');
  });

  it('migrates the legacy web-repo default saved before 0.7', () => {
    expect(REPORTS_REPO_LEGACY).toBe('Etherealmber/atlas-commerce');
    expect(resolveReportsRepo('Etherealmber/atlas-commerce')).toBe('Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android');
  });

  it('honors an explicit owner override (including other repos)', () => {
    expect(resolveReportsRepo('Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android')).toBe('Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android');
    expect(resolveReportsRepo('SomeOrg/other-repo')).toBe('SomeOrg/other-repo');
  });
});

/**
 * v260 — crash & user reports test suite (docs/reports-github.md).
 *
 * Covers: sanitization (secret redaction + truncation), fingerprint stability,
 * D1 intake (insert + dedup counter), queueing without a GitHub token,
 * draining with a stubbed GitHub API (create → linked, failure → stays
 * pending), token precedence (env > app) and the admin list view.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';

const SQLITE_MODULE = ['node:', 'sqlite'].join('');
const { DatabaseSync } = (await import(SQLITE_MODULE)) as { DatabaseSync: new (path: string) => any };

import {
  ensureReportTables,
  fingerprintOf,
  githubConfig,
  listReports,
  redactSecrets,
  reportCrash,
  reportUser,
  retryPendingReports,
  sanitizeCrashPayload,
  saveGithubConfig,
} from '../lib/reports';

function makeD1() {
  const sqlite = new DatabaseSync(':memory:');
  const db = {
    prepare(sql: string) {
      let params: any[] = [];
      const api: any = {
        bind(...p: any[]) { params = p; return api; },
        async run() {
          const r = sqlite.prepare(sql).run(...(params as any));
          return { success: true, meta: { changes: Number(r.changes || 0), last_row_id: Number(r.lastInsertRowid || 0) } };
        },
        async first() { return sqlite.prepare(sql).get(...(params as any)) ?? null; },
        async all() { return { results: sqlite.prepare(sql).all(...(params as any)) }; },
      };
      return api;
    },
  };
  return { db: db as unknown as D1Database, sqlite };
}

const CRASH = {
  message: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading \'total\')',
  stack: "TypeError: boom\n    at Dashboard (https://stock.afmarbre.com/assets/Dashboard-abc.js:10:5)\n    at render (x.js:1:1)\n    at y (x.js:2:2)\n    at z (x.js:3:3)",
  route: '/dashboard',
  version: '0.5.9-beta',
  ua: 'TestBrowser/1.0',
};

let made: ReturnType<typeof makeD1>;

beforeEach(async () => {
  made = makeD1();
  await ensureReportTables(made.db);
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe('sanitization', () => {
  it('redacts bearer tokens, JWTs, github/atlas/groq/resend keys and long blobs', () => {
    const dirty = [
      'Authorization: Bearer abc123.DEF-456_xyz',
      'jwt eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJoYWNrZXIifQ.c2lnbmF0dXJlLXBhcnQ',
      'ghp_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789',
      'github_pat_11AAAAAAAAA0Bbbbbbbbb_CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC',
      'atlas_livekey123456',
      'gsk_aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ012345',
      're_1234567890_AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWx',
      'data:image/png;base64,' + 'A'.repeat(200),
    ].join(' | ');
    const clean = redactSecrets(dirty);
    expect(clean).not.toMatch(/Bearer abc123/);
    expect(clean).not.toMatch(/eyJhbGci/);
    expect(clean).not.toMatch(/ghp_/);
    expect(clean).not.toMatch(/github_pat_/);
    expect(clean).not.toMatch(/atlas_livekey/);
    expect(clean).not.toMatch(/gsk_/);
    expect(clean).not.toMatch(/re_1234567890/);
    expect(clean).not.toMatch(/A{120}/);
    expect(clean).toMatch(/\[REDACTED\]/);
  });

  it('keeps ordinary text intact', () => {
    expect(redactSecrets('Erreur sur /dashboard en cliquant sur "Valider"')).toBe('Erreur sur /dashboard en cliquant sur "Valider"');
  });

  it('truncates and defaults crash fields', () => {
    // realistic prose (spaces break the long-blob redaction pattern, so the
    // truncation limits are what apply)
    const p = sanitizeCrashPayload({ message: 'erreur calcul total '.repeat(60), stack: 'at frame (x.js:1:1) '.repeat(500), route: '/page/very/deep '.repeat(40) });
    expect(p.message.length).toBe(400);
    expect(p.stack.length).toBe(4000);
    expect(p.route.length).toBe(200);
    expect(sanitizeCrashPayload({}).message).toBe('Erreur inconnue');
    // opaque long blobs (data URLs, dumped keys) are redacted before truncation
    expect(sanitizeCrashPayload({ message: 'A'.repeat(300) }).message).toBe('[REDACTED]');
  });
});

describe('fingerprint', () => {

    const c = sanitizeCrashPayload({ ...CRASH, message: 'Autre erreur' });

describe('github sync with a stubbed API', () => {
  function stubGithub(opts: { createOk?: boolean } = {}) {
    const calls: { method: string; url: string }[] = [];
    const original = globalThis.fetch;
    const stub = vi.fn(async (input: any, init: any) => {
      const url = String(input);
      const method = String(init?.method || 'GET');
      calls.push({ method, url });
      const respond = (status: number, body: any) => ({
        ok: status >= 200 && status < 300,
        status,
        json: async () => body,
      }) as unknown as Response;
      if (url.includes('/search/issues')) return respond(200, { items: [] });
      if (url.endsWith('/labels')) return respond(422, { message: 'exists' });
      if (url.endsWith('/issues') && method === 'POST') {
        return opts.createOk === false
          ? respond(403, { message: 'rate limited' })
          : respond(201, { number: 42, html_url: 'https://github.com/Etherealmber/atlas-commerce/issues/42' });
      }
      return respond(200, {});
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', stub);
    return { calls, restore: () => vi.stubGlobal('fetch', original) };
  }

/**
 * v0.7.1 — Stock-adjustment approval workflow tests
 * (worker/routes/stockAdjustments.ts) against an in-process SQLite
 * (node:sqlite) wrapped in a D1-compatible shim — same harness style as
 * expenses-auth.test.ts — through a REAL Hono app.
 *
 * Locks the contract:
 *  - submit (any role) NEVER mutates stock; invalid qty/direction → 422,
 *    unknown product → 404 (== cross-tenant in this single-tenant deploy),
 *    inactive → 422, non-tracked → 409;
 *  - idempotency-key replay returns the same request (200 + replayed);
 *  - approve/reject = owner/admin/secretaire ONLY (fresh users-table role at
 *    decision time wins over the session role);
 *  - approval applies the movement EXACTLY once (duplicate/replay/concurrent
 *    → 409 ALREADY_DECIDED), writes stock_movements + before/after;
 *  - rejection leaves stock unchanged; insufficient stock at approval time
 *    → 409 and the request stays pending with stock untouched;
 *  - listing visibility: approvers see all, stock/user see only their own.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
const SQLITE_MODULE = ['node:', 'sqlite'].join('');
const { DatabaseSync } = (await import(SQLITE_MODULE)) as { DatabaseSync: new (path: string) => any };
type DatabaseSync = any;
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import { registerStockAdjustmentRoutes, ensureStockAdjustmentTables } from '../routes/stockAdjustments';

function makeD1() {
  const sqlite = new DatabaseSync(':memory:');
  const db: any = {
    prepare(sql: string) {
      let params: any[] = [];
      const api: any = {
        bind(...p: any[]) { params = p; return api; },
        async run() {
          const s = sqlite.prepare(sql);
          const r = s.run(...(params as any));
          return { success: true, meta: { changes: Number(r.changes || 0), last_row_id: Number(r.lastInsertRowid || 0) } };
        },
        async first() {
          const s = sqlite.prepare(sql);
          const r = s.get(...(params as any));
          return r === undefined ? null : { ...(r as any) };
        },
        async all() {
          const s = sqlite.prepare(sql);
          const rows = s.all(...(params as any)).map((r: any) => ({ ...r }));
          return { success: true, results: rows, meta: {} };
        },
      };
      return api;
    },
    async batch(stmts: any[]) {
      const out: any[] = [];
      for (const st of stmts) out.push(await st.run());
      return out;
    },
  };
  return { db, sqlite };
}

const SESSIONS: Record<string, { username: string; role: string }> = {
  'owner-tok': { username: 'boss', role: 'owner' },
  'sec-tok': { username: 'sec', role: 'secretaire' },
  'stock-tok': { username: 'mag', role: 'stock' },
  'stock2-tok': { username: 'mag2', role: 'stock' },
  'user-tok': { username: 'usr', role: 'user' },
};

let sqlite: DatabaseSync;

let auditSpy: any;

      price REAL DEFAULT 0, cost REAL DEFAULT 0, updated_at TEXT
    );
    CREATE TABLE stock_movements (

      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );

    },
    freshRole: async (d: any, username: string) => {

function call(method: string, path: string, body: unknown, token?: string) {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  return app.fetch(
    new Request(`http://test.local${path}`, { method, headers, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body) }),
    { DB: db },
  );
}

  return Number(r.stock_quantity);
}

  const r = await db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM stock_movements WHERE product_id = ?`).bind(id).first();
  return Number(r.c);
}

/**
 * v0.7.8 — push notifications des demandes d'ajustement de stock.
 *
 * Verrouille (route réelle, D1 shim SQLite, FCM legacy stubbé) :
 *  1. submit → seuls les approveurs autorisés (politique de rôle) sont poussés,
 *     demandeur exclu, rôles non-approveurs exclus ;
 *  2. replay idempotent → AUCUN push supplémentaire ;
 *  3. isolation tenant : chaque base D1 ne pousse que ses propres jetons ;
 *  4. approve / reject → seul le demandeur est notifié, après le changement de
 *     statut réussi ; transition répétée (409) → aucun push ;
 *  5. échec push (HTTP 500) → la demande/la décision restent intactes ;
 *  6. jeton explicitement NotRegistered → purgé de device_push_tokens.
 * Payload non sensible : event + request_id (+ status), texte générique.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';

const { DatabaseSync } = (await import(SQLITE_MODULE)) as { DatabaseSync: new (path: string) => any };
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';

async function sha256(s: string): Promise<string> {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(s));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

          return { success: true, meta: { changes: Number(r.changes || 0), last_row_id: Number(r.lastInsertRowid || 0) } };
        },
        async first() {
          const r = sqlite.prepare(sql).get(...(params as any));
          return r === undefined ? null : { ...(r as any) };
        },
        async all() {
          const rows = sqlite.prepare(sql).all(...(params as any)).map((r: any) => ({ ...r }));
          return { success: true, results: rows, meta: {} };
        },
      };
      return api;
    },
    async batch(stmts: any[]) {

async function seedUser(sqlite: any, username: string, pw: string, role: string) {
  const salt = `s-${username}`;
  const hash = await legacyHash(salt, pw);
  sqlite.exec(
    `INSERT INTO app_users (username, password_salt, password_hash, role, email)
     VALUES ('${username}', '${salt}', '${hash}', '${role}', '${username}@corp.ma')`,
  );
  return hash;
}

function seedDeviceSql(sqlite: any, fp: string, username: string) {
  sqlite.exec(`INSERT OR REPLACE INTO trusted_devices (fingerprint, username, user_agent, last_ip, last_seen) VALUES ('${fp}', '${username}', 'ua', '${IP}', datetime('now'))`);
}

function seedPushToken(sqlite: any, username: string, token: string) {
  sqlite.exec(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO device_push_tokens (username, token, platform, updated_at) VALUES ('${username}', '${token}', 'android', datetime('now'))`);
}

async function tokenFor(username: string, role: string, secretMaterial: string, fp: string) {
  const user = username.toLowerCase();
  const proof = await sha256(`proof|${user}|${role}|${secretMaterial}|${IP}|${fp}`);
  return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(`stock-auth-v2|${user}|${role}|${IP}|${fp}|${proof}`)));
}

async function call(env: any, path: string, token: string, body?: any) {
  const res = await app.fetch(
    new Request(`http://test.local${path}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'CF-Connecting-IP': IP },
      body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
    }),
    env,
  );
  return { status: res.status, body: await res.json().catch(() => ({})) };
}

const tos = () => pushes.map((p) => p.to);

describe('v0.7.8 — push demandes de stock', () => {
  it('submit → approveurs autorisés seulement (demandeur et stock exclus)', async () => {
    const mag = await seedUser(sqliteA, 'mag', 'Test1234!', 'stock');

    const sec = await seedUser(sqliteA, 'sec1', 'Test1234!', 'secretaire');
    const bob = await seedUser(sqliteA, 'bob', 'Test1234!', 'stock');
    seedDeviceSql(sqliteA, 'fp-mag', 'mag');
    seedDeviceSql(sqliteA, 'fp-adm', 'adm1');
    seedPushToken(sqliteA, 'mag', 'tok-mag');
    seedPushToken(sqliteA, 'adm1', 'tok-adm1');
    seedPushToken(sqliteA, 'sec1', 'tok-sec1');
    seedPushToken(sqliteA, 'bob', 'tok-bob');

    const r = await call(envA, '/api/stock-adjustment-requests', await tokenFor('mag', 'stock', mag, 'fp-mag'), {
      product_id: 1, direction: 'out', quantity: 3, reason: 'casse', idempotency_key: 'k1',
    });
    expect(r.status).toBe(201);
    expect(tos().sort()).toEqual(['tok-adm1', 'tok-sec1']); // owner sans appareil = silencieux
    expect(pushes[0].data).toMatchObject({ event: 'stock_request_submitted', request_id: '1' });
    expect(pushes[0].notification.body).toContain('ajustement de stock');
    expect(JSON.stringify(pushes[0].data)).not.toContain('Produit A'); // non sensible
    void adm; void sec; void bob;
  });

  it('replay idempotent → aucun push supplémentaire', async () => {
    const mag = await seedUser(sqliteA, 'mag', 'Test1234!', 'stock');
    await seedUser(sqliteA, 'sec1', 'Test1234!', 'secretaire');
    seedDeviceSql(sqliteA, 'fp-mag', 'mag');

    const tok = await tokenFor('mag', 'stock', mag, 'fp-mag');
    const first = await call(envA, '/api/stock-adjustment-requests', tok, { product_id: 1, direction: 'in', quantity: 2, idempotency_key: 'kk' });
    expect(first.status).toBe(201);
    const n = pushes.length;
    const replay = await call(envA, '/api/stock-adjustment-requests', tok, { product_id: 1, direction: 'in', quantity: 2, idempotency_key: 'kk' });
    expect(replay.status).toBe(200);
    expect((replay.body as any).replayed).toBe(true);
    expect(pushes.length).toBe(n); // pas de doublon
  });

  it('isolation tenant : aucun jeton du tenant B poussé par le tenant A', async () => {
    const magA = await seedUser(sqliteA, 'mag', 'Test1234!', 'stock');
    await seedUser(sqliteA, 'sec1', 'Test1234!', 'secretaire');
    const magB = await seedUser(sqliteBHolder, 'mag', 'Test1234!', 'stock');
    seedDeviceSql(sqliteA, 'fp-mag', 'mag');
    seedPushToken(sqliteA, 'sec1', 'tok-sec1-A');
    seedPushToken(sqliteBHolder, 'mag', 'tok-mag-B');
    seedPushToken(sqliteBHolder, 'sec1', 'tok-sec1-B');
    const r = await call(envA, '/api/stock-adjustment-requests', await tokenFor('mag', 'stock', magA, 'fp-mag'), { product_id: 1, direction: 'out', quantity: 1 });
    expect(r.status).toBe(201);
    expect(tos()).toEqual(['tok-sec1-A']);
    void magB;
  });

  it('approve → demandeur notifié une fois ; 2e approve (409) silencieux', async () => {
    const mag = await seedUser(sqliteA, 'mag', 'Test1234!', 'stock');
    const adm = await seedUser(sqliteA, 'adm1', 'Test1234!', 'admin');
    seedDeviceSql(sqliteA, 'fp-mag', 'mag');
    seedDeviceSql(sqliteA, 'fp-adm', 'adm1');
    seedPushToken(sqliteA, 'mag', 'tok-mag');
    seedPushToken(sqliteA, 'adm1', 'tok-adm1');
    const sub = await call(envA, '/api/stock-adjustment-requests', await tokenFor('mag', 'stock', mag, 'fp-mag'), { product_id: 1, direction: 'out', quantity: 2 });
    expect(sub.status).toBe(201);
    const id = (sub.body as any).data.id;
    pushes = [];
    const ap = await call(envA, `/api/stock-adjustment-requests/${id}/approve`, await tokenFor('adm1', 'admin', adm, 'fp-adm'), {});
    expect(ap.status).toBe(200);
    expect(tos()).toEqual(['tok-mag']);
    expect(pushes[0].data).toMatchObject({ event: 'stock_request_decided', status: 'approved', request_id: String(id) });
    const again = await call(envA, `/api/stock-adjustment-requests/${id}/approve`, await tokenFor('adm1', 'admin', adm, 'fp-adm'), {});
    expect(again.status).toBe(409);
    expect(pushes.length).toBe(1); // transition répétée = silencieuse
  });

  it('reject → demandeur notifié status rejected', async () => {
    const mag = await seedUser(sqliteA, 'mag', 'Test1234!', 'stock');
    const adm = await seedUser(sqliteA, 'adm1', 'Test1234!', 'admin');

    const id = (sub.body as any).data.id;
    pushes = [];
    const rj = await call(envA, `/api/stock-adjustment-requests/${id}/reject`, await tokenFor('adm1', 'admin', adm, 'fp-adm'), { note: 'non' });
    expect(rj.status).toBe(200);
    expect(tos()).toEqual(['tok-mag']);
    expect(pushes[0].data).toMatchObject({ event: 'stock_request_decided', status: 'rejected' });

    expect(sub.status).toBe(201); // push en échec ne défait rien
    const id = (sub.body as any).data.id;
    const ap = await call(envA, `/api/stock-adjustment-requests/${id}/approve`, await tokenFor('adm1', 'admin', adm, 'fp-adm'), {});
    expect(ap.status).toBe(200);
    expect((ap.body as any).data.status).toBe('approved');
  });

  it('jeton explicitement NotRegistered → purgé de device_push_tokens', async () => {
    pushStatus = 404;
    const mag = await seedUser(sqliteA, 'mag', 'Test1234!', 'stock');
    await seedUser(sqliteA, 'sec1', 'Test1234!', 'secretaire');
    seedDeviceSql(sqliteA, 'fp-mag', 'mag');
    seedPushToken(sqliteA, 'sec1', 'tok-dead');
    const sub = await call(envA, '/api/stock-adjustment-requests', await tokenFor('mag', 'stock', mag, 'fp-mag'), { product_id: 1, direction: 'in', quantity: 1 });
    expect(sub.status).toBe(201);
    const left = sqliteA.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM device_push_tokens WHERE token = 'tok-dead'`).get() as any;
    expect(Number(left.c)).toBe(0);
  });
});

/**
 * v259 — WebAuthn verifier test suite.
 *
 * Exercises the REAL cryptographic paths in worker/lib/webauthn.ts with live
 * ES256 key material (node WebCrypto): valid registration/authentication and
 * rejection of every tamper class the task lists (signature, origin, RP id,
 * credential/account binding, challenge expiry & replay, flags, malformed
 * client data), plus challenge atomicity and policy defaults.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';

const SQLITE_MODULE = ['node:', 'sqlite'].join('');
const { DatabaseSync } = (await import(SQLITE_MODULE)) as { DatabaseSync: new (path: string) => any };

import {
  WebAuthnError,
  androidLegacyOrigin,
  androidLegacyOriginFromSha1,
  androidOrigin,
  androidOriginFromCertHash,
  androidOrigins,
  credentialDescriptors,
  matchesAndroidOrigin,
  b64uToBytes,
  bytesToB64u,
  consumeChallenge,
  createChallenge,
  expectedOrigin,

  policyFromEnv,
  sha256,
  userHandleFor,
  verifyAuthentication,
  verifyRegistration,
  type WebAuthnPolicy,
} from '../lib/webauthn';

/* ─────────────────────────── tiny CBOR encoder (test-only) ─────────────────────────── */

function head(major: number, n: number): number[] {
  if (n < 24) return [(major << 5) | n];
  if (n < 256) return [(major << 5) | 24, n];
  if (n < 65536) return [(major << 5) | 25, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255];
  return [(major << 5) | 26, (n >>> 24) & 255, (n >>> 16) & 255, (n >>> 8) & 255, n & 255];
}
const cborBytes = (b: Uint8Array) => Uint8Array.from([...head(2, b.length), ...b]);
const cborText = (s: string) => { const u = new TextEncoder().encode(s); return Uint8Array.from([...head(3, u.length), ...u]); };
const cborUInt = (n: number) => Uint8Array.from(head(0, n));
const cborNInt = (n: number) => Uint8Array.from(head(1, -1 - n));
function cborMap(pairs: [Uint8Array, Uint8Array][]): Uint8Array {
  const out: number[] = head(5, pairs.length);
  for (const [k, v] of pairs) out.push(...k, ...v);
  return Uint8Array.from(out);
}
const concat = (...parts: Uint8Array[]) => {
  const total = parts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.length, 0);
  const out = new Uint8Array(total);
  let o = 0;
  for (const p of parts) { out.set(p, o); o += p.length; }
  return out;
};

/* ─────────────────────────── fixtures ─────────────────────────── */

const RP_ID = 'stock.afmarbre.com';
const ORIGIN = 'https://stock.afmarbre.com';
const ANDROID_PACKAGE = 'ma.etherealmber.atlascommerce';
/** Deterministic stand-in for the Play app-signing SHA-256 fingerprint. */
const CERT_HEX = '9F:86:D0:81:88:4C:7D:65:9A:2F:EA:A0:C5:5A:D0:15:A3:BF:4F:1B:2B:0B:82:2C:D1:5D:6C:15:B0:F0:0A:08';
const POLICY: WebAuthnPolicy = policyFromEnv({ WEBAUTHN_ENABLED: 'true' });
const POLICY_ANDROID: WebAuthnPolicy = policyFromEnv({
  WEBAUTHN_ENABLED: 'true',
  WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_PACKAGE: ANDROID_PACKAGE,
  WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_CERT_HASH: CERT_HEX,
});
/** Deterministic stand-in for the SHA-1 fingerprint of the same signing cert. */
const CERT_SHA1_HEX = '2A:E2:D3:0F:8B:1C:47:9D:6E:5A:03:F8:14:7C:B9:22:90:1D:EE:F3';
const POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH: WebAuthnPolicy = policyFromEnv({
  WEBAUTHN_ENABLED: 'true',
  WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_PACKAGE: ANDROID_PACKAGE,
  WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_CERT_HASH: CERT_HEX,
  WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_CERT_SHA1: CERT_SHA1_HEX,
});

type KeyMaterial = { priv: CryptoKey; pub: CryptoKey; jwk: JsonWebKey };

async function makeKey(): Promise<KeyMaterial> {
  const kp = await crypto.subtle.generateKey({ name: 'ECDSA', namedCurve: 'P-256' }, true, ['sign', 'verify']);
  const jwk = await crypto.subtle.exportKey('jwk', kp.publicKey);
  return { priv: kp.privateKey, pub: kp.publicKey, jwk };
}

function coseKey(jwk: JsonWebKey): Uint8Array {
  return cborMap([
    [cborUInt(1), cborUInt(2)],          // kty: EC2
    [cborUInt(3), cborNInt(-7)],         // alg: ES256
    [cborNInt(-1), cborUInt(1)],         // crv: P-256
    [cborNInt(-2), cborBytes(b64uToBytes(String(jwk.x)))],
    [cborNInt(-3), cborBytes(b64uToBytes(String(jwk.y)))],
  ]);
}

async function buildAuthData(opts: {
  rpId?: string;
  up?: boolean;
  uv?: boolean;
  be?: boolean;
  counter?: number;
  credId?: Uint8Array;
  cose?: Uint8Array;
}): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const rpIdHash = await sha256(opts.rpId ?? RP_ID);
  let flags = 0;
  if (opts.up !== false) flags |= 0x01;
  if (opts.uv !== false) flags |= 0x04;
  if (opts.be) flags |= 0x08;
  if (opts.cose) flags |= 0x40;
  const counter = opts.counter ?? 0;
  const base = concat(rpIdHash, Uint8Array.from([flags, (counter >>> 24) & 255, (counter >>> 16) & 255, (counter >>> 8) & 255, counter & 255]));
  if (!opts.cose) return base;
  const credId = opts.credId ?? crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
  const aaguid = new Uint8Array(16);
  return concat(base, aaguid, Uint8Array.from([(credId.length >> 8) & 255, credId.length & 255]), credId, opts.cose);
}

function clientDataB64(type: string, challenge: string, origin: string, crossOrigin = false, androidPackageName?: string): string {
  const json = JSON.stringify(androidPackageName
    ? { type, challenge, origin, crossOrigin, androidPackageName }
    : { type, challenge, origin, crossOrigin });
  return bytesToB64u(new TextEncoder().encode(json));
}

function attestationObjectB64(authData: Uint8Array, fmt = 'none'): string {
  const obj = cborMap([
    [cborText('fmt'), cborText(fmt)],
    [cborText('attStmt'), cborMap([])],
    [cborText('authData'), cborBytes(authData)],
  ]);
  return bytesToB64u(obj);
}

async function signEs256(priv: CryptoKey, data: Uint8Array): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const sig = await crypto.subtle.sign({ name: 'ECDSA', hash: 'SHA-256' }, priv, data as unknown as BufferSource);
  return new Uint8Array(sig);
}

/* ─────────────────────────── D1 shim for challenge tests ─────────────────────────── */

function makeD1() {
  const sqlite = new DatabaseSync(':memory:');
  sqlite.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE webauthn_challenges (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, challenge TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT DEFAULT '',
      purpose TEXT NOT NULL, username TEXT DEFAULT '', rp_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
      origin TEXT DEFAULT '', expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      consumed INTEGER DEFAULT 0, consumed_at TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    );
  `);
  const db = {
    prepare(sql: string) {
      let params: any[] = [];
      const api: any = {
        bind(...p: any[]) { params = p; return api; },
        async run() {
          const r = sqlite.prepare(sql).run(...(params as any));
          return { success: true, meta: { changes: Number(r.changes || 0), last_row_id: Number(r.lastInsertRowid || 0) } };
        },
        async first() { return sqlite.prepare(sql).get(...(params as any)) ?? null; },
        async all() { return { results: sqlite.prepare(sql).all(...(params as any)) }; },
      };
      return api;
    },
  };
  return db as unknown as D1Database;
}

describe('webauthn registration verification', () => {
  let key: KeyMaterial;

    credId = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));

    const authData = await buildAuthData({ rpId: over.rpId, up: over.up, uv: over.uv, credId, cose: coseKey(key.jwk) });
    return verifyRegistration({
      clientDataJSON: over.clientData ?? clientDataB64('webauthn.create', over.challenge ?? challenge, over.origin ?? ORIGIN, over.crossOrigin ?? false, over.pkg),
      attestationObject: attestationObjectB64(authData, over.fmt),

  });

  });

/* ─────────────────────────── authentication ─────────────────────────── */

describe('webauthn authentication verification', () => {
  let key: KeyMaterial;
  let challenge: string;

    userHandle = await userHandleFor('yasmine');

  async function authenticate(over: {
    origin?: string; challenge?: string; rpId?: string; up?: boolean; uv?: boolean;
    counter?: number; storedCounter?: number; backupEligible?: boolean;
    userHandle?: string; tamperSig?: boolean; wrongKey?: boolean;

  } = {}) {
    const authData = await buildAuthData({ rpId: over.rpId, up: over.up, uv: over.uv, be: over.backupEligible, counter: over.counter ?? 1 });
    const cd = clientDataB64('webauthn.get', over.challenge ?? challenge, over.origin ?? ORIGIN, over.crossOrigin ?? false, over.pkg);

    const signer = over.wrongKey ? await makeKey() : null;
    if (signer) sig = await signEs256(signer.priv, concat(authData, clientHash));
    return verifyAuthentication({
      clientDataJSON: cd,
      authenticatorData: bytesToB64u(authData),
      signature: bytesToB64u(sig),
      userHandle: over.userHandle,
      expectedChallenge: challenge,
      policy: over.policy ?? POLICY,
      stored: {
        publicKeyJwk: storedJwk,
        counter: over.storedCounter ?? 0,
        backupEligible: over.backupEligible ?? false,
        userHandle,
      },
    });
  }

  it('accepts a valid assertion and advances the counter', async () => {
    const v = await authenticate({ counter: 4, storedCounter: 3 });
    expect(v.counter).toBe(4);
    expect(v.uv).toBe(true);
  });

  it('accepts stable-zero counters only for backup-eligible (synced) passkeys', async () => {
    await expect(authenticate({ counter: 0, storedCounter: 0, backupEligible: true })).resolves.toMatchObject({ counter: 0 });
    await expect(authenticate({ counter: 0, storedCounter: 0, backupEligible: false })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_COUNTER' });
  });

  it('rejects a tampered signature', async () => {
    await expect(authenticate({ tamperSig: true, counter: 2 })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_BAD_SIGNATURE' });
  });

  it('rejects a signature from another key (wrong credential material)', async () => {
    await expect(authenticate({ wrongKey: true, counter: 2 })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_BAD_SIGNATURE' });
  });

  it('rejects wrong origin and wrong RP id', async () => {
    await expect(authenticate({ origin: 'https://phish.example', counter: 2 })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_BAD_ORIGIN' });
    await expect(authenticate({ rpId: 'other.example.com', counter: 2 })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_BAD_RPID' });
  });

  it('rejects a stale / non-advancing counter (clone detection)', async () => {
    await expect(authenticate({ counter: 3, storedCounter: 3 })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_COUNTER' });
  });

  it('rejects a userHandle from another account', async () => {
    const other = await userHandleFor('someone-else');
    await expect(authenticate({ userHandle: other, counter: 2 })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_WRONG_ACCOUNT' });
  });

  it('rejects missing flags and replayed/mismatched challenge', async () => {
    await expect(authenticate({ up: false, counter: 2 })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_MISSING_FLAGS' });
    await expect(authenticate({ uv: false, counter: 2 })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_MISSING_FLAGS' });
    await expect(authenticate({ challenge: bytesToB64u(new Uint8Array(32)), counter: 2 })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_BAD_CHALLENGE' });
  });

  it('parses authenticator data flags correctly', async () => {
    const ad = await buildAuthData({ up: true, uv: false, counter: 7 });
    const p = parseAuthenticatorData(ad);
    expect(p.up).toBe(true);
    expect(p.uv).toBe(false);
    expect(p.counter).toBe(7);
  });
});

/* ─────────────────────────── challenges ─────────────────────────── */

describe('webauthn challenge lifecycle', () => {
  let db: D1Database;
  beforeEach(() => { db = makeD1(); });

  it('consumes a challenge exactly once (atomic single use)', async () => {
    const ch = await createChallenge(db, { purpose: 'register', username: 'Yasmine', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN });
    const first = await consumeChallenge(db, { challenge: ch, purpose: 'register', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN, username: 'yasmine' });
    expect(first?.username).toBe('yasmine');
    const replay = await consumeChallenge(db, { challenge: ch, purpose: 'register', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN, username: 'yasmine' });
    expect(replay).toBeNull();
  });

  it('rejects expired challenges', async () => {
    const ch = await createChallenge(db, { purpose: 'login', username: '', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN, ttlMs: -1000 });
    expect(await consumeChallenge(db, { challenge: ch, purpose: 'login', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('is purpose-bound: a login challenge cannot finish a registration', async () => {
    const ch = await createChallenge(db, { purpose: 'login', username: '', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN });
    expect(await consumeChallenge(db, { challenge: ch, purpose: 'register', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN, username: 'x' })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('is account-bound: another username cannot consume it', async () => {
    const ch = await createChallenge(db, { purpose: 'register', username: 'alice', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN });
    expect(await consumeChallenge(db, { challenge: ch, purpose: 'register', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN, username: 'mallory' })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('is RP/origin-bound', async () => {
    const ch = await createChallenge(db, { purpose: 'login', username: '', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN });
    expect(await consumeChallenge(db, { challenge: ch, purpose: 'login', rpId: 'evil.example', origin: ORIGIN })).toBeNull();
    expect(await consumeChallenge(db, { challenge: ch, purpose: 'login', rpId: RP_ID, origin: 'https://evil.example' })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('generates unpredictable, unique challenges', async () => {
    const a = await createChallenge(db, { purpose: 'login', username: '', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN });
    const b = await createChallenge(db, { purpose: 'login', username: '', rpId: RP_ID, origin: ORIGIN });
    expect(a).not.toBe(b);
    expect(b64uToBytes(a).length).toBe(32);
  });
});

/* ─────────── android credential manager origin integration (v259.1) ─────────── */

describe('android credential manager integration', () => {
  it('derives the apk-key-hash-sha256 origin from the signing-cert fingerprint', () => {
    const o = androidOriginFromCertHash(CERT_HEX)!;
    expect(o).toBe(androidOriginFromCertHash(CERT_HEX.replace(/:/g, '').toLowerCase())!);
    expect(o.startsWith('android:apk-key-hash-sha256:')).toBe(true);
    const bytes = Uint8Array.from((CERT_HEX.replace(/:/g, '').match(/../g) as string[]).map((h) => Number.parseInt(h, 16)));
    expect(o).toBe(`android:apk-key-hash-sha256:${bytesToB64u(bytes)}`);
    expect(androidOriginFromCertHash('not-a-hash')).toBeNull();
    expect(androidOriginFromCertHash('')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('androidOrigin is null unless package AND cert hash are configured', () => {
    expect(androidOrigin(POLICY)).toBeNull();
    expect(androidOrigin(POLICY_ANDROID)).toBe(androidOriginFromCertHash(CERT_HEX));
  });

  it('accepts a native registration from the configured apk-key-hash origin', async () => {
    const key = await makeKey();
    const challenge = bytesToB64u(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)));
    const credId = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
    const authData = await buildAuthData({ rpId: RP_ID, credId, cose: coseKey(key.jwk) });
    const v = await verifyRegistration({
      clientDataJSON: clientDataB64('webauthn.create', challenge, androidOrigin(POLICY_ANDROID)!, true),
      attestationObject: attestationObjectB64(authData),
      expectedChallenge: challenge,
      policy: POLICY_ANDROID,
    });
    expect(v.credentialId).toBe(bytesToB64u(credId));
    expect(v.publicKeyJwk.alg).toBe('ES256');
  });

  it('accepts the web origin cross-origin ONLY when clientData names the configured package', async () => {
    const key = await makeKey();
    const challenge = bytesToB64u(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)));
    const credId = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
    const authData = await buildAuthData({ rpId: RP_ID, credId, cose: coseKey(key.jwk) });
    const base = { attestationObject: attestationObjectB64(authData), expectedChallenge: challenge };
    await expect(verifyRegistration({
      ...base,
      clientDataJSON: clientDataB64('webauthn.create', challenge, ORIGIN, true, ANDROID_PACKAGE),
      policy: POLICY_ANDROID,
    })).resolves.toBeTruthy();
    // same clientData, android integration NOT configured → cross-origin rejected
    await expect(verifyRegistration({
      ...base,
      clientDataJSON: clientDataB64('webauthn.create', challenge, ORIGIN, true, ANDROID_PACKAGE),
      policy: POLICY,
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_CROSS_ORIGIN' });
    // a different package riding the allowlisted origin → rejected
    await expect(verifyRegistration({
      ...base,
      clientDataJSON: clientDataB64('webauthn.create', challenge, ORIGIN, true, 'com.evil.app'),
      policy: POLICY_ANDROID,
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_CROSS_ORIGIN' });
  });

  it('rejects the android origin when the signing cert is not configured', async () => {
    const key = await makeKey();
    const challenge = bytesToB64u(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)));
    const credId = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
    const authData = await buildAuthData({ rpId: RP_ID, credId, cose: coseKey(key.jwk) });
    await expect(verifyRegistration({
      clientDataJSON: clientDataB64('webauthn.create', challenge, androidOrigin(POLICY_ANDROID)!, true),
      attestationObject: attestationObjectB64(authData),
      expectedChallenge: challenge,
      policy: POLICY,
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_BAD_ORIGIN' });
  });

  it('accepts a native assertion (login) from the configured apk-key-hash origin', async () => {
    const key = await makeKey();
    const storedJwk = { kty: 'EC', crv: 'P-256', x: String(key.jwk.x), y: String(key.jwk.y), alg: 'ES256' };
    const userHandle = await userHandleFor('yasmine');
    const challenge = bytesToB64u(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)));
    const authData = await buildAuthData({ rpId: RP_ID, counter: 1 });
    const cd = clientDataB64('webauthn.get', challenge, androidOrigin(POLICY_ANDROID)!, true);
    const sig = await signEs256(key.priv, concat(authData, await sha256(b64uToBytes(cd))));
    const v = await verifyAuthentication({
      clientDataJSON: cd,
      authenticatorData: bytesToB64u(authData),
      signature: bytesToB64u(sig),
      userHandle,
      expectedChallenge: challenge,
      policy: POLICY_ANDROID,
      stored: { publicKeyJwk: storedJwk, counter: 0, backupEligible: false, userHandle },
    });
    expect(v.counter).toBe(1);
  });

  it('accepts the LEGACY android:apk-key-hash: origin (base64 of SHA-1) when configured', async () => {
    const legacy = androidLegacyOrigin(POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)!;
    expect(legacy).toBe(androidLegacyOriginFromSha1(CERT_SHA1_HEX));
    expect(legacy.startsWith('android:apk-key-hash:')).toBe(true);
    const key = await makeKey();
    const challenge = bytesToB64u(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)));
    const credId = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
    const authData = await buildAuthData({ rpId: RP_ID, credId, cose: coseKey(key.jwk) });
    const v = await verifyRegistration({
      clientDataJSON: clientDataB64('webauthn.create', challenge, legacy, true),
      attestationObject: attestationObjectB64(authData),
      expectedChallenge: challenge,
      policy: POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH,
    });
    expect(v.credentialId).toBe(bytesToB64u(credId));
  });

  it('matches byte-for-byte across base64 alphabets and padding (string equality is not enough)', () => {
    const legacy = androidLegacyOrigin(POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)!;
    const suffix = legacy.slice('android:apk-key-hash:'.length);
    // standard alphabet + padding variant of the same bytes
    let std = suffix.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    while (std.length % 4) std += '=';
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin(`android:apk-key-hash:${std}`, POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)).toBe(true);
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin(legacy, POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)).toBe(true);
    // sha256 form still matches under the combined policy
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin(androidOrigin(POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)!, POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)).toBe(true);
    // wrong bytes / wrong prefix / unconfigured → false
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin(`android:apk-key-hash:${suffix.slice(1)}A`, POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)).toBe(false);
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin(legacy, POLICY_ANDROID)).toBe(false); // no SHA-1 configured
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin(legacy, POLICY)).toBe(false);        // no android at all
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin('android:apk-key-hash:', POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)).toBe(false);
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin('https://stock.afmarbre.com', POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('v0.7 — comma-separated fingerprints: every key associates, unknown rejected', () => {
    const A = '53:D0:74:2C:A3:34:22:36:58:E1:D7:F8:8C:DC:67:C5:4D:B0:AC:4E:17:88:59:DA:13:2D:4A:9F:30:62:65:6E';
    const B = 'FC:CC:F6:C3:B2:3D:B8:BE:1D:74:AF:BE:D5:04:DA:EA:5F:5D:FF:AF:8C:6F:C4:5A:F8:F0:2B:6A:C8:87:6C:C1';
    const multi = policyFromEnv({
      WEBAUTHN_ENABLED: 'true',
      WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_PACKAGE: 'ma.etherealmber.atlascommerce',
      WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_CERT_HASH: `${A},${B}`,
    });
    expect(multi.androidCertHashes).toEqual([A, B]);
    expect(multi.androidCertHash).toBe(A); // primary = first, status compat
    const oA = androidOriginFromCertHash(A)!;
    const oB = androidOriginFromCertHash(B)!;
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin(oA, multi)).toBe(true);
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin(oB, multi)).toBe(true);
    expect(androidOrigins(multi)).toEqual([oA, oB]);
    const wrong = androidOriginFromCertHash(
      '11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF:00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF',
    )!;
    expect(matchesAndroidOrigin(wrong, multi)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('rejects the legacy origin end-to-end when the SHA-1 fingerprint is not configured', async () => {
    const legacy = androidLegacyOrigin(POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)!;
    const key = await makeKey();
    const challenge = bytesToB64u(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)));
    const credId = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
    const authData = await buildAuthData({ rpId: RP_ID, credId, cose: coseKey(key.jwk) });
    await expect(verifyRegistration({
      clientDataJSON: clientDataB64('webauthn.create', challenge, legacy, true),
      attestationObject: attestationObjectB64(authData),
      expectedChallenge: challenge,
      policy: POLICY_ANDROID, // SHA-256 only
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'WEBAUTHN_BAD_ORIGIN' });
  });

  it('accepts a legacy-origin assertion (login) with the combined policy', async () => {
    const key = await makeKey();
    const storedJwk = { kty: 'EC', crv: 'P-256', x: String(key.jwk.x), y: String(key.jwk.y), alg: 'ES256' };
    const userHandle = await userHandleFor('haytam');
    const challenge = bytesToB64u(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)));
    const authData = await buildAuthData({ rpId: RP_ID, counter: 1 });
    const cd = clientDataB64('webauthn.get', challenge, androidLegacyOrigin(POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH)!, true);
    const sig = await signEs256(key.priv, concat(authData, await sha256(b64uToBytes(cd))));
    const v = await verifyAuthentication({
      clientDataJSON: cd,
      authenticatorData: bytesToB64u(authData),
      signature: bytesToB64u(sig),
      userHandle,
      expectedChallenge: challenge,
      policy: POLICY_ANDROID_BOTH,
      stored: { publicKeyJwk: storedJwk, counter: 0, backupEligible: false, userHandle },
    });
    expect(v.counter).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('register/options excludeCredentials filtering', () => {
  it('omits legacy rows without public_key_jwk, keeps verifiable ones', async () => {
    const db = makeD1() as any;
    await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webauthn_credentials (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT DEFAULT '', transports TEXT DEFAULT '',
      public_key_jwk TEXT
    )`).run();
    await db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO webauthn_credentials (id, username, transports, public_key_jwk) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    ).bind('legacy-1', 'alice', '', null).run();
    await db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO webauthn_credentials (id, username, transports, public_key_jwk) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    ).bind('legacy-empty', 'alice', 'internal', '').run();
    await db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO webauthn_credentials (id, username, transports, public_key_jwk) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    ).bind('valid-1', 'alice', 'internal,hybrid', '{"kty":"OKP","crv":"P-256"}').run();
    await db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO webauthn_credentials (id, username, transports, public_key_jwk) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    ).bind('other-user', 'bob', '', '{"kty":"OKP"}').run();

    const desc = await credentialDescriptors(db, 'alice');
    expect(desc.map((d) => d.id)).toEqual(['valid-1']);
    expect(desc[0].transports).toEqual(['internal', 'hybrid']);
    // case-insensitive username match, same as the routes
    const upper = await credentialDescriptors(db, 'ALICE');
    expect(upper.map((d) => d.id)).toEqual(['valid-1']);
    // unknown account → empty exclude list (fresh registration allowed)
    expect(await credentialDescriptors(db, 'carol')).toEqual([]);
  });
});

/**
 * Controller layer helpers — thin handlers that:
 * 1. Validate input
 * 2. Call services
 * 3. Map results / errors to HTTP
 *
 * Routes register controllers; services own business rules; repositories own SQL.
 */

import type { Context } from 'hono';
import { apiFail, apiOk } from '../lib/api-response';
import { AppError, toClientError } from '../lib/errors';
import type { FieldErrors } from '../lib/validate';

export type ControllerResult<T = unknown> =
  | { ok: true; data?: T; message?: string; status?: number }
  | { ok: false; error: string; code?: string; details?: unknown; status?: number };

/** Run a controller function and always return a safe JSON response. */
export async function runController(
  c: Context,
  fn: () => Promise<ControllerResult>,
) {
  try {
    const result = await fn();
    if (result.ok) {
      return apiOk(c, result.data, result.message, result.status ?? 200);
    }
    const code = (result.code as any) || 'BAD_REQUEST';
    return apiFail(c, result.error, code, result.details, result.status);
  } catch (err) {
    const safe = toClientError(err);
    return apiFail(c, safe.error, safe.code, safe.details, safe.status);
  }
}

/** Throw validation AppError from FieldErrors map. */
export function rejectValidation(errors: FieldErrors): never {
  const first = Object.values(errors).find(Boolean) || 'Données invalides';
  throw new AppError('VALIDATION', first, errors);
}

/** Require a non-empty JSON body object. */
export async function readJsonBody<T extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>>(
  c: Context,
): Promise<T> {
  let body: unknown;
  try {
    body = await c.req.json();
  } catch {
    throw new AppError('BAD_REQUEST', 'Corps JSON invalide');
  }
  if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) {
    throw new AppError('BAD_REQUEST', 'Corps JSON invalide');
  }
  return body as T;
}

/**
 * Products controller — HTTP boundary only.
 */
import type { Context } from 'hono';
import type { Env } from '../env';
import { runController, rejectValidation } from './base';
import * as productsService from '../services/productsService';

export function listProductsController(c: Context<{ Bindings: Env }>) {
  return runController(c, async () => {
    const data = await productsService.listProductsSafe(c.env, {
      q: c.req.query('q') || undefined,
      limit: c.req.query('limit') || undefined,
      offset: c.req.query('offset') || undefined,
    });
    return { ok: true, data };
  });
}

export function getProductController(c: Context<{ Bindings: Env }>) {
  return runController(c, async () => {
    const data = await productsService.getProductSafe(c.env, c.req.param('id'));
    return { ok: true, data };
  });
}
