import type { Env } from '../env';

/**
 * AgentQuotaHub — per-user Atlas Agent token counters (day / week) stored in a
 * Durable Object so usage survives deploys, restarts and edge replay.
 * One instance per user: idFromName('agent-quota:' + username).
 * Writes happen only on /add (after a reply) and on rollover/seeding.
 */
export type QuotaCounters = {
  dailyUsed: number;
  weeklyUsed: number;
  dailyDate: string;
  weeklyStart: string;
  initialized: boolean;
};

const KEYS = ['daily_tokens', 'daily_date', 'weekly_tokens', 'weekly_start', 'initialized'] as const;

export class AgentQuotaHub {
  constructor(
    private readonly state: DurableObjectState,
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars
    private readonly env: Env,
  ) {}

  static today(): string {
    return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  static weekStart(): string {
    const d = new Date();
    const day = (d.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7;
    d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - day);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  private async read(): Promise<QuotaCounters> {
    const bag = await this.state.storage.get([...KEYS]);
    return {
      dailyUsed: Number(bag.get('daily_tokens') ?? 0),
      weeklyUsed: Number(bag.get('weekly_tokens') ?? 0),
      dailyDate: String(bag.get('daily_date') ?? ''),
      weeklyStart: String(bag.get('weekly_start') ?? ''),
      initialized: bag.get('initialized') === 1 || bag.get('initialized') === true,
    };
  }

  private async write(q: QuotaCounters): Promise<void> {
    await this.state.storage.put({
      daily_tokens: q.dailyUsed,
      daily_date: q.dailyDate,
      weekly_tokens: q.weeklyUsed,
      weekly_start: q.weeklyStart,
      initialized: q.initialized ? 1 : 0,
    });
  }

  private roll(q: QuotaCounters): { q: QuotaCounters; changed: boolean } {
    const today = AgentQuotaHub.today();
    const week = AgentQuotaHub.weekStart();
    let changed = false;
    if (q.dailyDate !== today) { q.dailyUsed = 0; q.dailyDate = today; changed = true; }
    if (q.weeklyStart !== week) { q.weeklyUsed = 0; q.weeklyStart = week; changed = true; }
    return { q, changed };
  }

  async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    let q = (await this.read());
    const rolled = this.roll(q);
    q = rolled.q;
    let dirty = rolled.changed;

    if (request.method === 'POST' && url.pathname === '/add') {
      const body = (await request.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { tokens?: number };
      const tokens = Math.max(0, Math.min(200000, Number(body.tokens) || 0));
      q.dailyUsed += tokens;
      q.weeklyUsed += tokens;
      q.initialized = true;
      dirty = true;
    } else if (request.method === 'POST' && url.pathname === '/seed') {
      // One-time migration from the legacy D1 agent_controls counters.
      const body = (await request.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        daily?: number; weekly?: number; dailyDate?: string; weeklyStart?: string;
      };
      if (!q.initialized) {
        if (typeof body.daily === 'number' && body.daily > 0) { q.dailyUsed = body.daily; q.dailyDate = body.dailyDate || AgentQuotaHub.today(); }
        if (typeof body.weekly === 'number' && body.weekly > 0) { q.weeklyUsed = body.weekly; q.weeklyStart = body.weeklyStart || AgentQuotaHub.weekStart(); }
        q.initialized = true;
        dirty = true;
      }
    }

    if (dirty) await this.write(q);
    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      data: { dailyUsed: q.dailyUsed, weeklyUsed: q.weeklyUsed, dailyDate: q.dailyDate, weeklyStart: q.weeklyStart, initialized: q.initialized },
    });
  }
}

export default AgentQuotaHub;

import type { Env } from '../env';

/**
 * Free-tier SQLite Durable Object — shared live counters for phone + PC,
 * plus per-user profile cache (idFromName('profile:' + username)).
 * Keep writes sparse (on mutations only) to stay under free DO request limits.
 */
export type HubSnapshot = {
  pending: number;
  productCount: number;
  lowStock: number;
  stockValue: number;
  lastBarcode: string | null;
  lastProductId: number | null;
  lastActionAt: string | null;
  updatedAt: string | null;
};

export type UserProfile = {
  display_name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  avatar_url: string;
  notes: string;
  updatedAt: string | null;
};

const KEYS = [
  'pending',
  'productCount',
  'lowStock',
  'stockValue',
  'lastBarcode',
  'lastProductId',
  'lastActionAt',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

const PROFILE_KEYS = [
  'display_name',
  'email',
  'phone',
  'avatar_url',
  'notes',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

export class MobileHub {
  /** In-memory avatar blob cache (warm DO = instant avatar serves). */
  private avatarCache: { version: string; bytes: Uint8Array; ctype: string } | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly state: DurableObjectState,
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars
    private readonly env: Env
  ) {}

  private async readSnapshot(): Promise<HubSnapshot> {
    const bag = await this.state.storage.get([...KEYS]);
    return {
      pending: Number(bag.get('pending') ?? 0),
      productCount: Number(bag.get('productCount') ?? 0),
      lowStock: Number(bag.get('lowStock') ?? 0),
      stockValue: Number(bag.get('stockValue') ?? 0),
      lastBarcode: (bag.get('lastBarcode') as string) || null,
      lastProductId: bag.get('lastProductId') != null ? Number(bag.get('lastProductId')) : null,
      lastActionAt: (bag.get('lastActionAt') as string) || null,
      updatedAt: (bag.get('updatedAt') as string) || null,
    };
  }

  private async readProfile(): Promise<UserProfile> {
    const bag = await this.state.storage.get([...PROFILE_KEYS]);
    return {
      display_name: String(bag.get('display_name') ?? ''),
      email: String(bag.get('email') ?? ''),
      phone: String(bag.get('phone') ?? ''),
      avatar_url: String(bag.get('avatar_url') ?? ''),
      notes: String(bag.get('notes') ?? ''),
      updatedAt: (bag.get('updatedAt') as string) || null,
    };
  }

  async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const path = url.pathname;

    try {
      // ─── Per-user profile (object idFromName('profile:username')) ───
      if (path === '/profile' || path.endsWith('/profile')) {
        if (request.method === 'GET') {
          const data = await this.readProfile();
          return Response.json({ success: true, data });
        }
        if (request.method === 'PUT' || request.method === 'PATCH' || request.method === 'POST') {
          const body = (await request.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<UserProfile>;
          const now = new Date().toISOString();
          const cur = await this.readProfile();
          const next: UserProfile = {
            display_name:
              body.display_name != null ? String(body.display_name).trim().slice(0, 80) : cur.display_name,
            email: body.email != null ? String(body.email).trim().slice(0, 120) : cur.email,
            phone: body.phone != null ? String(body.phone).trim().slice(0, 40) : cur.phone,
            avatar_url:
              body.avatar_url != null ? String(body.avatar_url).trim().slice(0, 2000) : cur.avatar_url,
            notes: body.notes != null ? String(body.notes).trim().slice(0, 300) : cur.notes,
            updatedAt: now,
          };
          await this.state.storage.put({
            display_name: next.display_name,
            email: next.email,
            phone: next.phone,
            avatar_url: next.avatar_url,
            notes: next.notes,
            updatedAt: now,
          });
          return Response.json({ success: true, data: next });
        }
        return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'Method not allowed' }, { status: 405 });
      }

      // ─── Avatar blob cache (memory-only, keyed by URL version) ───
      if (path === '/avatar' || path.endsWith('/avatar')) {
        const v = url.searchParams.get('v') || '';
        if (request.method === 'GET') {
          const hit = this.avatarCache;
          if (hit && hit.version === v) {
            return new Response(hit.bytes as unknown as BodyInit, {
              headers: { 'x-avatar-ctype': hit.ctype },
            });
          }
          // An empty in-memory cache is expected after eviction / version changes,
          // not a missing route or application error. The proxy loads the origin.
          return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
        }
        if (request.method === 'PUT') {
          const bytes = new Uint8Array(await request.arrayBuffer());
          if (bytes.byteLength > 0 && bytes.byteLength <= 4_000_000) {
            this.avatarCache = {
              version: v,
              bytes,
              ctype: request.headers.get('x-avatar-ctype') || 'image/jpeg',
            };
          }
          return Response.json({ success: true });
        }
        return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'Method not allowed' }, { status: 405 });
      }

      if (request.method === 'GET' && (path === '/' || path === '/stats' || path === '/snapshot')) {
        const data = await this.readSnapshot();
        return Response.json({ success: true, data });
      }

      if (request.method === 'POST' && (path === '/sync' || path === '/snapshot')) {
        const body = (await request.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<HubSnapshot>;
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        const patch: Record<string, unknown> = { updatedAt: now };
        if (body.pending != null) patch.pending = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(body.pending)));
        if (body.productCount != null) patch.productCount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(body.productCount)));
        if (body.lowStock != null) patch.lowStock = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(body.lowStock)));
        if (body.stockValue != null) patch.stockValue = Math.max(0, Number(body.stockValue));
        if (body.lastBarcode !== undefined) patch.lastBarcode = body.lastBarcode ? String(body.lastBarcode).slice(0, 64) : null;
        if (body.lastProductId !== undefined) {
          patch.lastProductId = body.lastProductId != null ? Number(body.lastProductId) : null;
        }
        if (body.lastActionAt) patch.lastActionAt = String(body.lastActionAt);
        else if (body.pending != null || body.lastBarcode || body.lastProductId) patch.lastActionAt = now;
        await this.state.storage.put(patch);
        const data = await this.readSnapshot();
        return Response.json({ success: true, data });
      }

      // Back-compat
      if (request.method === 'POST' && path === '/pending') {
        const body = (await request.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { pending?: number };
        await this.state.storage.put({
          pending: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(body.pending ?? 0))),
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
        return Response.json({ success: true, data: await this.readSnapshot() });
      }

      if (request.method === 'POST' && path === '/bump') {
        const body = (await request.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { delta?: number };
        const cur = Number((await this.state.storage.get<number>('pending')) ?? 0);
        const pending = Math.max(0, cur + Number(body.delta ?? 1));
        await this.state.storage.put({ pending, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        return Response.json({ success: true, data: await this.readSnapshot() });
      }

      // ─── Short-lived QR login session (idFromName('qr:' + token)) ───
      // Keeps poll/claim off D1 to avoid Worker CPU limits. Alarm deletes after ~2 min.
      if (path === '/qr' || path.endsWith('/qr')) {
        if (request.method === 'GET') {
          const bag = await this.state.storage.get([
            'status', 'username', 'role', 'created_by', 'expires_at',
            'claim_fingerprint', 'display_name', 'avatar_url',
          ]);
          if (!bag.get('status')) {
            return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND' }, { status: 404 });
          }
          let status = String(bag.get('status') || 'pending');
          const exp = bag.get('expires_at') ? String(bag.get('expires_at')) : '';
          if (exp && status !== 'consumed' && status !== 'denied' && new Date(exp) < new Date()) {
            status = 'expired';
          }
          return Response.json({
            success: true,
            data: {
              status,
              username: String(bag.get('username') || ''),
              role: String(bag.get('role') || ''),
              created_by: String(bag.get('created_by') || ''),
              expires_at: exp,
              claim_fingerprint: bag.get('claim_fingerprint')
                ? String(bag.get('claim_fingerprint')).slice(0, 12) + '…'
                : '',
              has_device: !!bag.get('claim_fingerprint'),
              display_name: String(bag.get('display_name') || ''),
              avatar_url: String(bag.get('avatar_url') || ''),
            },
          });
        }
        if (request.method === 'PUT' || request.method === 'POST') {
          const body = (await request.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;
          const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
          for (const k of [
            'status', 'username', 'role', 'created_by', 'expires_at',
            'claim_fingerprint', 'claim_ua', 'claim_ip', 'display_name', 'avatar_url',
          ]) {
            if (body[k] !== undefined) patch[k] = body[k];
          }
          if (Object.keys(patch).length) {
            await this.state.storage.put(patch);
          }
          // Auto-delete ~130s after create/update to respect free-tier storage
          if (body.status === 'pending' || body._schedule_alarm) {
            await this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 130_000);
          }
          if (body.status === 'consumed' || body.status === 'denied' || body.status === 'expired') {
            await this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 15_000);
          }
          const bag = await this.state.storage.get(['status', 'username', 'role', 'expires_at', 'display_name', 'avatar_url', 'claim_fingerprint']);
          return Response.json({
            success: true,
            data: {
              status: bag.get('status'),
              username: bag.get('username'),
              role: bag.get('role'),
              expires_at: bag.get('expires_at'),
              display_name: bag.get('display_name'),
              avatar_url: bag.get('avatar_url'),
              has_device: !!bag.get('claim_fingerprint'),
            },
          });
        }
        return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'Method not allowed' }, { status: 405 });
      }

      return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'Not found' }, { status: 404 });
    } catch (e: any) {
      return Response.json({ success: false, error: e?.message || 'DO error' }, { status: 500 });
    }
  }

  async alarm(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.state.storage.deleteAll();
    } catch { /* */ }
  }
}

/**
 * Atomic document number sequences (FA / VR / DEV / …).
 * One DO instance: idFromName('doc-numbers').
 */
export class NumberHub {
  constructor(
    private readonly state: DurableObjectState,
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars
    _env: unknown,
  ) {}

  async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    if (request.method === 'POST' && url.pathname.endsWith('/next')) {
      const body = (await request.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        series?: string;
        floor?: number;
      };
      const series = String(body.series || 'invoice').slice(0, 64);
      const floor = Math.max(1, Number(body.floor) || 1);
      const key = `seq:${series}`;
      let cur = Number((await this.state.storage.get<number>(key)) || 0);
      if (cur < floor - 1) cur = floor - 1;
      const next = cur + 1;
      await this.state.storage.put(key, next);
      return Response.json({ success: true, data: { series, next } });
    }
    if (request.method === 'POST' && url.pathname.endsWith('/seed')) {
      const body = (await request.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        series?: string;
        value?: number;
      };
      const series = String(body.series || 'invoice').slice(0, 64);
      const value = Math.max(0, Number(body.value) || 0);
      await this.state.storage.put(`seq:${series}`, value);
      return Response.json({ success: true, data: { series, value } });
    }
    if (request.method === 'GET' && url.pathname.endsWith('/peek')) {
      const series = String(url.searchParams.get('series') || 'invoice').slice(0, 64);
      const cur = Number((await this.state.storage.get<number>(`seq:${series}`)) || 0);
      return Response.json({ success: true, data: { series, current: cur } });
    }
    return new Response('Not found', { status: 404 });
  }
}

import type { Env } from '../env';

export type RestoreJobState = {
  id: string;
  status: string;
  message?: string;
  progress?: number;
  safety_key?: string | null;
  source_key?: string;
  error?: string;
  started_at?: string;
  finished_at?: string;
  tables?: string[];
  rows?: number;
  /** R2 key of decrypted work payload JSON */
  work_key?: string | null;
  /** Next table index to process */
  table_index?: number;
  /** Ordered table names */
  table_order?: string[];
  /** Cancel requested */
  cancel?: boolean;
};

const BATCH = 40;

function tableLabelFr(table: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    products: 'Produits',
    clients: 'Clients',
    vendors: 'Fournisseurs',
    invoices: 'Factures',
    invoice_items: 'Lignes de facture',
    quotes: 'Devis',
    bills: 'Achats',
    bill_items: 'Lignes d’achat',
    product_units: 'Unités produit',
    product_categories: 'Catégories produit',
    product_catalog: 'Catalogue',
    categories: 'Catégories',
    units: 'Unités',
    audit_log: 'Journal d’audit',
    expenses: 'Dépenses',
    app_config: 'Configuration',
    company_settings: 'Société',
    stock_locations: 'Entrepôts',
    stock_movements: 'Mouvements de stock',
  };
  return map[table] || table;
}

/**
 * Durable Object that owns restore progress AND drives one-table-at-a-time execution
 * via alarms so large backups never blow a single Worker waitUntil/CPU budget.
 */
export class RestoreHub {
  constructor(
    private readonly state: DurableObjectState,
    private readonly env: Env,
  ) {}

  private async putJob(job: RestoreJobState): Promise<void> {
    await this.state.storage.put('job', job);
    if (job.id) await this.state.storage.put('latest_id', job.id);
    try {
      const cache = (this.env as any).CACHE;
      if (cache && job.id) {
        await cache.put(`restore_job:${job.id}`, JSON.stringify(job), { expirationTtl: 3600 * 6 });
        await cache.put('restore_job:latest', job.id, { expirationTtl: 3600 * 6 });
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  private async getJob(): Promise<RestoreJobState | null> {
    return (await this.state.storage.get<RestoreJobState>('job')) || null;
  }

  async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const path = url.pathname;

    if (request.method === 'GET' && (path === '/' || path === '/status')) {
      const job = await this.getJob();
      return Response.json({ success: true, data: job });
    }

    // Bootstrap: store job + schedule first table
    if ((request.method === 'PUT' || request.method === 'POST') && (path === '/' || path === '/job' || path === '/start')) {
      const body = (await request.json()) as RestoreJobState & { start?: boolean };
      if (!body?.id) {
        return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'id required' }, { status: 400 });
      }
      const prev = (await this.getJob()) || ({} as RestoreJobState);
      const next: RestoreJobState = { ...prev, ...body, cancel: false };
      await this.putJob(next);
      if (body.start || path === '/start') {
        // Process first table inline so UI leaves 20% immediately, then alarm for the rest
        try {
          await this.alarm();
        } catch {
          await this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 100);
        }
      }
      return Response.json({ success: true, data: await this.getJob() });
    }

    // Force cancel
    if (request.method === 'POST' && path === '/cancel') {
      const job = await this.getJob();
      if (job) {
        const finished = new Date().toISOString();
        const failed: RestoreJobState = {
          ...job,
          status: 'failed',
          message: 'Restauration annulée',
          error: 'CANCELLED',
          progress: 100,
          finished_at: finished,
          cancel: true,
        };
        await this.putJob(failed);
        try { await this.state.storage.deleteAlarm(); } catch { /* */ }
        // Cleanup work payload
        try {
          if (job.work_key && (this.env as any).IMAGES) {
            await (this.env as any).IMAGES.delete(job.work_key);
          }
        } catch { /* */ }
      }
      return Response.json({ success: true });
    }

    if (request.method === 'DELETE') {
      try { await this.state.storage.deleteAlarm(); } catch { /* */ }
      await this.state.storage.delete('job');
      return Response.json({ success: true });
    }

    return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'Not found' }, { status: 404 });
  }

  /** Alarm: process exactly one table, then schedule next. */
  async alarm(): Promise<void> {
    const job = await this.getJob();
    if (!job || job.cancel || job.status === 'ok' || job.status === 'failed') return;
    if (job.status !== 'running' && job.status !== 'pending') return;

    const order = job.table_order || [];
    let index = Number(job.table_index || 0);
    const total = Math.max(1, order.length);
    const db = (this.env as any).DB as D1Database;
    const images = (this.env as any).IMAGES;

    if (!db || !job.work_key || !images) {
      await this.putJob({
        ...job,
        status: 'failed',
        message: 'Environnement restore incomplet (DB/R2)',
        error: 'ENV',
        progress: 100,
        finished_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
      return;
    }

    // Load work payload (decrypted tables JSON)
    let payload: any = null;
    try {
      const obj = await images.get(job.work_key);
      if (!obj) throw new Error('work payload missing');
      payload = await obj.json();
    } catch (e: any) {
      await this.putJob({
        ...job,
        status: 'failed',
        message: 'Payload de travail introuvable ou illisible',
        error: String(e?.message || e),
        progress: 100,
        finished_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
      return;
    }

    const tables = payload?.tables || {};

    // Done?
    if (index >= order.length) {
      try { await images.delete(job.work_key); } catch { /* */ }
      try {
        // Invalidate caches after full restore
        const cache = (this.env as any).CACHE;
        if (cache) {
          // best-effort: mark mutation
          await cache.put('biz_mutated_at', new Date().toISOString(), { expirationTtl: 86400 });
        }
      } catch { /* */ }
      await this.putJob({
        ...job,
        status: 'ok',
        message: `Terminé — ${(job.tables?.length || order.length)} tables, ${job.rows || 0} lignes`,
        progress: 100,
        finished_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        work_key: null,
      });
      return;
    }

    const table = order[index];
    const data = Array.isArray(tables[table]) ? (tables[table] as any[]) : [];
    const label = tableLabelFr(table);
    const basePct = Math.min(92, Math.round(18 + ((index + 1) / total) * 74));
    let rows = Number(job.rows || 0);
    const restoredTables = [...(job.tables || [])];

    await this.putJob({
      ...job,
      status: 'running',
      message: `Restauration « ${label} » (${index + 1}/${total})…`,
      progress: basePct,
      table_index: index,
    });

    if (!data.length) {
      // skip empty
      index += 1;
      await this.putJob({
        ...job,
        table_index: index,
        message: `« ${label} » vide — suivant…`,
        progress: basePct,
        rows,
      });
      await this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 30);
      return;
    }

    const sample = data[0];
    if (!sample || typeof sample !== 'object') {
      index += 1;
      await this.putJob({ ...job, table_index: index, rows });
      await this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 30);
      return;
    }

    const cols = Object.keys(sample);
    let tableRows = 0;

    try {
      try {
        await db.prepare(`DELETE FROM ${table}`).run();
      } catch {
        // table missing — skip
        index += 1;
        await this.putJob({
          ...job,
          table_index: index,
          message: `« ${label} » ignoré (table absente)`,
          progress: basePct,
          rows,
        });
        await this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 30);
        return;
      }

      const placeholders = cols.map(() => '?').join(',');
      const colList = cols.join(', ');
      const sql = `INSERT INTO ${table} (${colList}) VALUES (${placeholders})`;

      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += BATCH) {
        // Re-check cancel between batches
        const live = await this.getJob();
        if (live?.cancel) return;

        const chunk = data.slice(i, i + BATCH);
        const stmts: D1PreparedStatement[] = [];
        for (const row of chunk) {
          try {
            const vals = cols.map((c) => (row[c] === undefined ? null : row[c]));
            stmts.push(db.prepare(sql).bind(...vals));
          } catch { /* skip */ }
        }
        if (stmts.length) {
          try {
            await db.batch(stmts);
            tableRows += stmts.length;
            rows += stmts.length;
          } catch {
            for (const row of chunk) {
              try {
                const vals = cols.map((c) => (row[c] === undefined ? null : row[c]));
                await db.prepare(sql).bind(...vals).run();
                tableRows++;
                rows++;
              } catch { /* skip bad row */ }
            }
          }
        }

        // Mid-table progress for large tables
        if (data.length > BATCH * 2 && i + BATCH < data.length) {
          const frac = (i + BATCH) / data.length;
          await this.putJob({
            ...job,
            status: 'running',
            table_index: index,
            rows,
            message: `Restauration « ${label} »… ${Math.min(data.length, i + BATCH)}/${data.length}`,
            progress: Math.min(94, basePct + Math.round(frac * 3)),
          });
        }
      }

      restoredTables.push(table);
      index += 1;
      await this.putJob({
        ...job,
        status: 'running',
        table_index: index,
        tables: restoredTables,
        rows,
        message: `« ${label} » restauré (${tableRows} lignes)`,
        progress: Math.min(96, basePct + 2),
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      // Table failed — continue with next
      index += 1;
      await this.putJob({
        ...job,
        table_index: index,
        rows,
        message: `« ${label} » erreur partielle — suite…`,
        progress: basePct,
      });
    }

    // Schedule next table (or finalization)
    await this.state.storage.setAlarm(Date.now() + 40);
  }
}

/**
 * v264 — Atlas Agent document ingestion: BOUNDED, MIME-VALIDATED extraction.
 *
 * Before this module, attached PDFs never reached the model at all (the SPA
 * only inlined client-side text excerpts for text/* files and image data-URLs
 * for vision) and the server trusted whatever the client put in the prompt.
 * Now the worker itself validates and extracts, server-side:
 *
 *  - allow-list of declared MIME types (PDF + plain-text family only);
 *  - MAGIC-BYTE validation — a data-URL claiming application/pdf must start
 *    with `%PDF-`; text types must decode as strict UTF-8 with no NUL and no
 *    abnormal control-byte ratio. MIME laundering is rejected, never trusted;
 *  - hard bounds: max documents per message, max decoded bytes per document,
 *    max PDF pages, max extracted characters (same 12 000-char ceiling the SPA
 *    already used for text excerpts). Over a bound → explicit refusal with a
 *    stable code; nothing is silently truncated away except the extracted text
 *    itself, which is flagged `truncated: true`;
 *  - NEVER INFER: a valid PDF whose text cannot be extracted (scanned image,
 *    exotic encodings) yields `extraction: 'empty'` with an honest placeholder
 *    in the prompt — the model is told the content is unreadable instead of
 *    being fed invented text;
 *  - PDF text extraction is bounded and dependency-free: content streams are
 *    inflated with DecompressionStream('deflate') (zlib-wrapped FlateDecode,
 *    the PDF standard) and text-show operators (Tj / TJ / ' / " + hex strings)
 *    are collected with a hard cap on streams processed and bytes inflated.
 *
 * Pure module (no Hono, no D1) → fully unit-tested in __tests__/agent-docs.test.ts.
 */

export const AGENT_DOC_LIMITS = {
  /** Max documents accepted per chat message. */
  maxDocuments: 2,
  /** Max DECODED bytes per document. */
  maxBytesPerDocument: 2_000_000,
  /** Max pages a PDF may declare (/Type /Page objects) — over → refusal. */
  maxPdfPages: 30,
  /** Max extracted characters handed to the model (SPA parity). */
  maxExtractedChars: 12_000,
  /** Max content streams inspected per PDF (bomb-safe bound). */
  maxPdfStreams: 40,
  /** Max inflated bytes per content stream. */
  maxInflatedBytes: 400_000,
} as const;

/** Declared-MIME allow-list. Images keep their existing vision path (data:image/*). */
export const AGENT_DOC_ALLOWED_MIME = [
  'application/pdf',
  'text/plain',
  'text/csv',
  'text/markdown',
  'application/json',
] as const;

export type AgentDocExcerpt = {
  name: string;
  mime: string;
  kind: 'pdf' | 'text';
  bytes: number;
  /** PDF only — null when the document declares no countable page objects
   *  (never guessed). */
  pages: number | null;
  chars: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  /** Extracted text ('' when extraction yielded nothing). */
  text: string;
  /** 'ok' = real text extracted; 'empty' = valid file, no extractable text. */
  extraction: 'ok' | 'empty';
};

export type AgentDocError = { name: string; code: string; error: string };

export type AgentDocsResult =
  | { ok: true; docs: AgentDocExcerpt[] }
  | { ok: false; errors: AgentDocError[] };

type RawDocInput = string | { name?: string; data_url?: string; url?: string; data?: string };

function decodeDataUrl(raw: string): { mime: string; base64: boolean; payload: string } | null {
  const m = raw.match(/^data:([^;,]*)(;[^,]*)?,([\s\S]*)$/);
  if (!m) return null;
  return { mime: m[1].trim().toLowerCase(), base64: /;base64/i.test(m[2] || ''), payload: m[3] };
}

function b64ToBytes(payload: string): Uint8Array | null {
  try {
    const clean = payload.replace(/[\r\n\s]/g, '');
    const bin = atob(clean);
    const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    return out;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function latin1(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let s = '';
  const CH = 8192;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += CH) {
    s += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + CH));
  }
  return s;
}

/** Strict UTF-8 decode + binary-content heuristics for the text family. */
function validateTextBytes(bytes: Uint8Array): { text: string } | { error: string } {
  let text: string;
  try {
    text = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(bytes);
  } catch {
    return { error: 'Contenu non-UTF-8 — fichier texte invalide ou binaire déguisé.' };
  }
  if (text.includes('\u0000')) return { error: 'Octet NUL détecté — contenu binaire refusé en document texte.' };
  let control = 0;
  const scan = text.slice(0, 20_000);
  for (const ch of scan) {
    const cp = ch.codePointAt(0) || 0;
    if (cp < 32 && cp !== 9 && cp !== 10 && cp !== 13) control++;
  }
  if (scan.length && control / scan.length > 0.02) {
    return { error: 'Trop de caractères de contrôle — contenu binaire refusé en document texte.' };
  }
  return { text };
}

/** Count /Type /Page objects (not /Pages) — a declared page count, never guessed. */
function countPdfPages(s: string): number | null {
  const matches = s.match(/\/Type\s*\/Page[^sA-Za-z]/g);
  if (!matches || !matches.length) return null;
  return matches.length;
}

async function inflate(bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
  try {
    if (typeof DecompressionStream === 'undefined') return null;
    const ds = new DecompressionStream('deflate');
    const stream = new Blob([bytes.slice() as unknown as BlobPart]).stream().pipeThrough(ds);
    const buf = await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer();
    const out = new Uint8Array(buf);
    if (out.length > AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxInflatedBytes) return out.subarray(0, AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxInflatedBytes);
    return out;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function unescapePdfString(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/\\([nrtbf()\\]|[0-7]{1,3})/g, (_m, g: string) => {
    switch (g) {
      case 'n': return '\n';
      case 'r': return '\r';
      case 't': return '\t';
      case 'b': return '\b';
      case 'f': return '\f';
      case '(': return '(';
      case ')': return ')';
      case '\\': return '\\';
      default: return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(g, 8));
    }
  });
}

/** Collect text-show operators from one (decoded) content stream. Bounded. */
function pdfTextFromContentStream(s: string, budget: number): string {
  const out: string[] = [];
  let used = 0;
  // Literal strings before Tj/'/" , TJ arrays, hex strings, and line breaks.
  const re = /\(((?:\\.|[^\\()])*)\)\s*(?:Tj|'|")|\[((?:[^[\]\\]|\\.)*)\]\s*TJ|<([0-9A-Fa-f\s]+)>\s*(?:Tj|'|")|(T\*|Td|TD|ET)/g;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((m = re.exec(s)) !== null) {
    let piece = '';
    if (m[1] !== undefined) piece = unescapePdfString(m[1]);
    else if (m[2] !== undefined) {
      // TJ array: concatenate every literal string inside, keep the kerning gaps as-is.
      const inner = /\(((?:\\.|[^\\()])*)\)/g;
      let im: RegExpExecArray | null;
      while ((im = inner.exec(m[2])) !== null) piece += unescapePdfString(im[1]);
    } else if (m[3] !== undefined) {
      const hex = m[3].replace(/\s+/g, '');
      for (let i = 0; i + 1 < hex.length; i += 2) {
        const code = parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16);
        if (!Number.isNaN(code)) piece += String.fromCharCode(code);
      }
    } else if (m[4] !== undefined) piece = '\n';
    if (!piece) continue;
    out.push(piece);
    used += piece.length;
    if (used > budget) break;
  }
  return out.join('');
}

/** Decode a content stream honestly: strict UTF-8 when the bytes are valid
 *  UTF-8 (modern generators), latin1 otherwise (PDFDocEncoding/WinAnsi is
 *  latin1-shaped — accent bytes land on the same code points). */
function decodeStreamBytes(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  try {
    return new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(bytes);
  } catch {
    return latin1(bytes);
  }
}

/** Bounded PDF text extraction: inflate FlateDecode streams, collect text ops. */
async function extractPdfText(bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<{ text: string; truncated: boolean }> {
  const raw = latin1(bytes);
  const parts: string[] = [];
  let total = 0;
  let streams = 0;
  const streamRe = /(<<[^>]*(?:>(?!>)[^>]*)*>>)?\s*stream\r?\n/g;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((m = streamRe.exec(raw)) !== null && streams < AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxPdfStreams) {
    const dict = m[1] || '';
    if (/\/Subtype\s*\/Image/.test(dict)) continue; // images → the vision path, not text
    const start = m.index + m[0].length;
    const endIdx = raw.indexOf('endstream', start);
    if (endIdx < 0) continue;
    streams++;
    // Byte-exact slice: the EOL before `endstream` is NOT part of the stream data.
    let byteEnd = endIdx;
    if (raw[byteEnd - 1] === '\n') byteEnd--;
    if (raw[byteEnd - 1] === '\r') byteEnd--;
    let slice = bytes.subarray(Math.min(start, bytes.length), Math.min(byteEnd, bytes.length));
    if (/\/FlateDecode/.test(dict)) {
      const inflated = await inflate(slice);
      if (!inflated) continue; // undecodable stream — honest skip, never invent
      slice = inflated;
    }
    const content = decodeStreamBytes(slice);
    if (!/(Tj|TJ)\b/.test(content)) continue;
    const piece = pdfTextFromContentStream(content, AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxExtractedChars);
    if (!piece) continue;
    parts.push(piece);
    total += piece.length;
    if (total >= AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxExtractedChars) break;
  }
  let text = parts.join('\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
  const truncated = text.length > AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxExtractedChars;
  if (truncated) text = text.slice(0, AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxExtractedChars);
  return { text, truncated };
}

/**
 * Validate + extract every attached document. ALL-OR-NOTHING: if any document
 * fails validation the whole request is refused with per-document errors —
 * a rejected file is never silently dropped.
 */
export function parseAgentDocuments(input: unknown): AgentDocsResult | Promise<AgentDocsResult> {
  return parseAgentDocumentsAsync(input);
}

export async function parseAgentDocumentsAsync(input: unknown): Promise<AgentDocsResult> {
  if (input == null) return { ok: true, docs: [] };
  if (!Array.isArray(input)) {
    return { ok: false, errors: [{ name: 'documents', code: 'DOC_FORMAT', error: 'Le champ documents doit être une liste.' }] };
  }
  if (input.length === 0) return { ok: true, docs: [] };
  if (input.length > AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxDocuments) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      errors: [{
        name: 'documents',
        code: 'DOC_COUNT',
        error: `Trop de documents joints (${input.length}) — maximum ${AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxDocuments} par message.`,
      }],
    };
  }

  const docs: AgentDocExcerpt[] = [];
  const errors: AgentDocError[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    const item = input[i] as RawDocInput;
    const name = String((typeof item === 'object' && item?.name) || `document-${i + 1}`).slice(0, 80);
    const rawUrl = typeof item === 'string' ? item : String(item?.data_url || item?.url || item?.data || '');
    const fail = (code: string, error: string) => { errors.push({ name, code, error }); };

    const parsed = decodeDataUrl(rawUrl);
    if (!parsed) { fail('DOC_FORMAT', 'Document invalide — data-URL attendue (data:<mime>;base64,…).'); continue; }
    if (!(AGENT_DOC_ALLOWED_MIME as readonly string[]).includes(parsed.mime)) {
      fail('DOC_MIME', `Type refusé « ${parsed.mime || 'inconnu'} » — PDF ou texte brut uniquement (images : voie vision existante).`);
      continue;
    }
    const bytes = parsed.base64 ? b64ToBytes(parsed.payload) : new TextEncoder().encode(decodeURIComponent(parsed.payload));
    if (!bytes) { fail('DOC_ENCODING', 'Encodage base64 invalide.'); continue; }
    if (bytes.length > AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxBytesPerDocument) {
      fail('DOC_TOO_LARGE', `Document trop lourd (${bytes.length} octets) — maximum ${AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxBytesPerDocument} octets.`);
      continue;
    }
    if (bytes.length < 8) { fail('DOC_TOO_SMALL', 'Document vide ou illisible.'); continue; }

    if (parsed.mime === 'application/pdf') {
      const magic = latin1(bytes.subarray(0, 5));
      if (magic !== '%PDF-') { fail('DOC_MAGIC', 'PDF invalide — en-tête %PDF- absent (type déclaré ≠ contenu réel).'); continue; }
      const asText = latin1(bytes);
      const pages = countPdfPages(asText);
      if (pages !== null && pages > AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxPdfPages) {
        fail('DOC_PAGES', `PDF trop long (${pages} pages) — maximum ${AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxPdfPages} pages.`);
        continue;
      }
      const { text, truncated } = await extractPdfText(bytes);
      docs.push({
        name, mime: parsed.mime, kind: 'pdf', bytes: bytes.length, pages,
        chars: text.length, truncated, text, extraction: text ? 'ok' : 'empty',
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Text family — magic-content validation: strict UTF-8, no NUL, no binary smell.
    const v = validateTextBytes(bytes);
    if ('error' in v) { fail('DOC_BINARY', v.error); continue; }
    let text = v.text;
    const truncated = text.length > AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxExtractedChars;
    if (truncated) text = text.slice(0, AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxExtractedChars);
    docs.push({
      name, mime: parsed.mime, kind: 'text', bytes: bytes.length, pages: null,
      chars: text.length, truncated, text, extraction: text.trim() ? 'ok' : 'empty',
    });
  }

  if (errors.length) return { ok: false, errors };
  return { ok: true, docs };
}

/**
 * Server-authored prompt section for validated documents. Honest by design:
 * an unreadable PDF says so explicitly — the model is instructed never to
 * invent its content.
 */
export function agentDocumentPromptSection(docs: AgentDocExcerpt[]): string {
  if (!docs.length) return '';
  const blocks = docs.map((d) => {
    const meta = [d.mime, d.pages ? `${d.pages} pages` : null, `${d.bytes} octets`].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
    const head = `--- Document joint (validé serveur) : ${d.name} (${meta}) ---`;
    if (d.extraction === 'empty') {
      return `${head}\n[Contenu non extractible : fichier valide mais sans texte lisible (document scanné ou encodage non pris en charge). Ne pas inventer de contenu — signale-le à l'utilisateur.]`;
    }
    return `${head}\n${d.text}${d.truncated ? `\n[Extrait tronqué à ${AGENT_DOC_LIMITS.maxExtractedChars} caractères — le document continue au-delà.]` : ''}`;
  });
  return `\n\nDocuments joints (extraits validés côté serveur — ne redemande pas ces fichiers) :\n${blocks.join('\n\n')}`;
}

/**
 * v0.7.7 — Atlas Agent : MÉMOIRE, CONTEXTE, GARDE-FOUS, OUTILS et RAG persistants.
 * Tout est stocké en D1, éditable depuis les Paramètres (ancres agent-knowledge)
 * et injecté côté serveur dans chaque conversation de l'Agent.
 *
 *  - agent_memory     : souvenirs par utilisateur (ou partagés org) ;
 *  - agent_context    : bloc de contexte org (métier, préférences de ton…) ;
 *  - agent_guardrails : règles impératives imposées au modèle ;
 *  - agent_tool_prefs : activation/désactivation des outils métier ;
 *  - agent_docs       : base de connaissances RAG (extraits indexés).
 */

export type AgentMemoryRow = {
  id: number;
  username: string;
  scope: 'user' | 'org';
  content: string;
  created_at: string;
};
export type AgentGuardrailRow = { id: number; rule: string; active: number; created_at: string };
export type AgentDocRow = { id: number; name: string; content: string; chars: number; created_at: string };

export type AgentKnowledge = {
  memory: AgentMemoryRow[];
  context: string;
  guardrails: AgentGuardrailRow[];
  toolPrefs: Record<string, 0 | 1>;
  docs: AgentDocRow[];
};

const MEMORY_MAX = 120;
const DOC_MAX = 40;
const DOC_CHARS_MAX = 20000;
const GUARDRAIL_MAX = 40;
const CONTEXT_CHARS_MAX = 4000;

export async function ensureAgentKnowledgeTables(db: D1Database): Promise<void> {
  await db.batch([
    db.prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_memory (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        username TEXT NOT NULL,
        scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
        content TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
      )`,
    ),
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_memory_user ON agent_memory (username, id)`),
    db.prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_context (
        scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        text TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
      )`,
    ),
    db.prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_guardrails (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        rule TEXT NOT NULL,
        active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
      )`,
    ),
    db.prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_tool_prefs (
        tool TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
      )`,
    ),
    db.prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_docs (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        content TEXT NOT NULL,
        chars INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
      )`,
    ),
  ]);
}

export async function loadAgentKnowledge(db: D1Database, username: string): Promise<AgentKnowledge> {
  await ensureAgentKnowledgeTables(db);
  const [mem, ctx, gr, tp, docs] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT * FROM agent_memory WHERE scope = 'org' OR username = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ${MEMORY_MAX}`,
      )
      .bind(username)
      .all(),
    db.prepare(`SELECT text FROM agent_context WHERE scope = 'org'`).first(),
    db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM agent_guardrails ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ${GUARDRAIL_MAX}`).all(),
    db.prepare(`SELECT tool, enabled FROM agent_tool_prefs`).all(),
    db.prepare(`SELECT id, name, content, chars, created_at FROM agent_docs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ${DOC_MAX}`).all(),
  ]);
  const toolPrefs: Record<string, 0 | 1> = {};
  for (const r of (tp.results || []) as any[]) toolPrefs[String(r.tool)] = Number(r.enabled) ? 1 : 0;
  return {
    memory: (mem.results || []) as unknown as AgentMemoryRow[],
    context: String((ctx as any)?.text || ''),
    guardrails: ((gr.results || []) as unknown as AgentGuardrailRow[]).filter((g) => Number(g.active) === 1),
    toolPrefs,
    docs: (docs.results || []) as unknown as AgentDocRow[],
  };
}

/* ── CRUD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export async function addMemory(db: D1Database, username: string, content: string, scope: 'user' | 'org'): Promise<AgentMemoryRow> {
  await ensureAgentKnowledgeTables(db);
  const clean = String(content || '').trim().slice(0, 500);
  if (!clean) throw new Error('MEMORY_EMPTY');
  const r = await db
    .prepare(`INSERT INTO agent_memory (username, scope, content) VALUES (?, ?, ?) RETURNING *`)
    .bind(username, scope, clean)
    .first();
  return r as unknown as AgentMemoryRow;
}

export async function deleteMemory(db: D1Database, id: number, username: string, isAdmin: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
  const row = await db.prepare(`SELECT username, scope FROM agent_memory WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first() as any;
  if (!row) return false;
  if (!isAdmin && !(row.scope === 'user' && row.username === username)) return false;
  await db.prepare(`DELETE FROM agent_memory WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).run();
  return true;
}

export async function setContext(db: D1Database, text: string): Promise<void> {
  await ensureAgentKnowledgeTables(db);
  const clean = String(text || '').slice(0, CONTEXT_CHARS_MAX);
  await db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO agent_context (scope, text, updated_at) VALUES ('org', ?, datetime('now'))
       ON CONFLICT(scope) DO UPDATE SET text = excluded.text, updated_at = datetime('now')`,
    )
    .bind(clean)
    .run();
}

export async function addGuardrail(db: D1Database, rule: string): Promise<AgentGuardrailRow> {
  await ensureAgentKnowledgeTables(db);
  const clean = String(rule || '').trim().slice(0, 300);
  if (!clean) throw new Error('GUARDRAIL_EMPTY');
  const r = await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO agent_guardrails (rule) VALUES (?) RETURNING *`).bind(clean).first();
  return r as unknown as AgentGuardrailRow;
}

export async function setGuardrailActive(db: D1Database, id: number, active: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
  const r = await db.prepare(`UPDATE agent_guardrails SET active = ? WHERE id = ?`).bind(active ? 1 : 0, id).run();
  return (r.meta?.changes || 0) > 0;
}

export async function deleteGuardrail(db: D1Database, id: number): Promise<boolean> {
  const r = await db.prepare(`DELETE FROM agent_guardrails WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).run();
  return (r.meta?.changes || 0) > 0;
}

export async function setToolPref(db: D1Database, tool: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
  await ensureAgentKnowledgeTables(db);
  await db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO agent_tool_prefs (tool, enabled, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, datetime('now'))
       ON CONFLICT(tool) DO UPDATE SET enabled = excluded.enabled, updated_at = datetime('now')`,
    )
    .bind(tool, enabled ? 1 : 0)
    .run();
}

export async function addDoc(db: D1Database, name: string, content: string): Promise<AgentDocRow> {
  await ensureAgentKnowledgeTables(db);
  const cleanName = String(name || 'Document').trim().slice(0, 120);
  const clean = String(content || '').trim().slice(0, DOC_CHARS_MAX);
  if (!clean) throw new Error('DOC_EMPTY');
  const r = await db
    .prepare(`INSERT INTO agent_docs (name, content, chars) VALUES (?, ?, ?) RETURNING *`)
    .bind(cleanName, clean, clean.length)
    .first();
  return r as unknown as AgentDocRow;
}

export async function deleteDoc(db: D1Database, id: number): Promise<boolean> {
  const r = await db.prepare(`DELETE FROM agent_docs WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).run();
  return (r.meta?.changes || 0) > 0;
}

/* ── RAG : score lexical simple, déterministe et sans dépendance ──────── */

const STOP = new Set(
  'le la les un une des du de d l et ou à au aux ce cet cette ces mon ma mes ton ta tes son sa ses en dans sur pour par avec sans que qui quoi dont je tu il elle nous vous ils elles est sont suis es sommes êtes ai as a ont avoir être était fur mais donc or ni car ne pas plus moins très bien merci hello bonjour bonsoir salut the and for with from this that these those'.split(
    /\s+/,
  ),
);

function tokens(s: string): string[] {
  return String(s || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ')
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter((t) => t.length > 2 && !STOP.has(t));
}

export type RagHit = { id: number; name: string; excerpt: string; score: number };

/** RAG : retrouve les 3 meilleurs extraits de la base de connaissances. */
export function retrieveKnowledge(docs: AgentDocRow[], query: string, top = 3): RagHit[] {
  const qt = tokens(query);
  if (!qt.length || !docs.length) return [];
  const qset = new Set(qt);
  const hits: RagHit[] = [];
  for (const d of docs) {
    const chunks = String(d.content)
      .split(/\n{2,}/)
      .filter((c) => c.trim().length > 20);
    let best = '';
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const ch of chunks.slice(0, 60)) {
      const ct = tokens(ch);
      if (!ct.length) continue;
      const present = new Set(ct);
      let score = 0;
      for (const q of qset) if (present.has(q)) score += 1;
      // léger bonus de densité pour éviter les murs de texte
      score += (score / Math.max(12, ct.length)) * 2;
      if (score > bestScore) {
        bestScore = score;
        best = ch.trim();
      }
    }
    if (bestScore >= 2) hits.push({ id: d.id, name: d.name, excerpt: best.slice(0, 1400), score: bestScore });
  }
  return hits.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, top);
}

/* ── Sections de prompt injectées côté serveur ────────────────────────── */

export function knowledgePromptSections(k: AgentKnowledge, query: string): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (k.context.trim()) {
    parts.push(`CONTEXTE MÉTIER (fourni par l'organisation — à respecter):\n${k.context.trim()}`);
  }
  if (k.guardrails.length) {
    parts.push(
      `GARDE-FOUS IMPÉRATIFS (règles absolues, prioritaires sur tout le reste):\n${k.guardrails
        .map((g, i) => `${i + 1}. ${g.rule}`)
        .join('\n')}`,
    );
  }
  if (k.memory.length) {
    parts.push(
      `MÉMOIRE DE L'UTILISATEUR (souvenirs enregistrés — utilise-les quand c'est pertinent):\n${k.memory
        .slice(0, 25)
        .map((m) => `- ${m.content}`)
        .join('\n')}`,
    );
  }
  const hits = retrieveKnowledge(k.docs, query);
  if (hits.length) {
    parts.push(
      `BASE DE CONNAISSANCES (extraits retrouvés par recherche — cite la source si tu t'en sers):\n${hits
        .map((h) => `【${h.name}】 ${h.excerpt}`)
        .join('\n\n')}`,
    );
  }
  return parts.length ? `\n\n=== SAVOIR ATLAS (interne, ne pas recopier tel quel) ===\n${parts.join('\n\n')}\n` : '';
}
