function moneyToolsAllowed(role: string) {
  return canMutateBusiness(role);
}

function toolAllowed(name: string, role: string): boolean {
  const r = normalizeRole(role);
  if (!canFloorStock(r) && r !== 'user') return false;

  const stockTools = new Set([
    'get_dashboard_snapshot',
    'search_products',
    'get_product',
    'list_actions_pending',
    'warehouse_stock',
    'list_warehouses',
    'list_low_stock',
    'propose_inventory_adjustment',
    'anomaly_notes',
    'summarize_pending_actions',
    'explain_pending_action',
    'SCAN_BARCODE',
    'NAVIGATE',
    'HAPTIC_FEEDBACK',
  ]);
  if (r === 'stock') return stockTools.has(name);

  const moneyOnly = new Set([
    'list_unpaid_invoices',
    'list_open_quotes',
    'draft_day_close_report',
    'list_recent_invoices',
    'get_invoice_brief',
    'search_clients',
    'draft_client_message',
    'propose_quote_lines',
    'closing_pack',
    'create_client',
    'update_client',
    'create_invoice_draft',
    'create_quote_draft',
  ]);
  if (moneyOnly.has(name)) return moneyToolsAllowed(r) || r === 'user';

  if (name === 'propose_inventory_adjustment') return canFloorStock(r);
  return true;
}

/** Read tools only (no propose_* write proposals). */
const READ_ONLY_TOOLS = new Set([
  'get_dashboard_snapshot',
  'search_products',
  'get_product',
  'list_actions_pending',
  'list_open_quotes',
  'list_unpaid_invoices',
  'warehouse_stock',
  'list_low_stock',
  'list_warehouses',
  'list_recent_invoices',
  'get_invoice_brief',
  'search_clients',
  'summarize_pending_actions',
  'explain_pending_action',
  'draft_day_close_report',
  'anomaly_notes',
  'closing_pack',
  'draft_client_message',
  'propose_quote_lines', // draft text only, not saved
]);

export type AgentPermMode = 'full' | 'read_only' | 'custom';

export function toolsForRole(
  role: string,
  opts?: { mode?: AgentPermMode; customTools?: string[] },
) {
  const mode = opts?.mode || 'full';
  const custom = new Set(opts?.customTools || []);
  return TOOL_DEFS.filter((t) => {
    const name = t.function.name;
    if (!toolAllowed(name, role)) return false;
    if (mode === 'full') return true;
    if (mode === 'read_only') return READ_ONLY_TOOLS.has(name) && !name.startsWith('propose_inventory');
    if (mode === 'custom') return custom.has(name);
    return true;
  });
}

export function listAllToolNames(): string[] {
  return TOOL_DEFS.map((t) => t.function.name);
}

/** v0.7.7 — nom + description de chaque outil (UI Paramètres). */
export function listAllToolsMeta(): { name: string; description: string }[] {
  return TOOL_DEFS.map((t) => ({
    name: t.function.name,
    description: String((t.function as any).description || ''),
  }));
}

async function localDateCasablanca(): Promise<string> {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
      timeZone: 'Africa/Casablanca',
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
    }).format(new Date());
  } catch {
    return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}

export async function runAssistTool(
  env: Env,
  name: string,
  args: Record<string, unknown>,
  role: string,
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; data?: unknown; proposal?: Record<string, unknown>; error?: string }> {
  if (!toolAllowed(name, role)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Outil non autorisé pour ce rôle.' };
  }
  const db = env.DB;
  const day = await localDateCasablanca();
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(args.limit) || 8, 1), 20);

  try {
    switch (name) {
      case 'get_dashboard_snapshot': {
        const dash = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products) as products,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients) as clients,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE status NOT IN ('quote','devis','cancelled','remboursement') AND date(issue_date) = date(?)) as inv_today,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM invoices WHERE status NOT IN ('quote','devis','cancelled','remboursement') AND date(issue_date) = date(?) AND COALESCE(doc_kind,'') NOT IN ('remboursement')) as sales_today,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(doc_kind,'') = 'remboursement' OR status = 'remboursement' THEN 0 ELSE total - amount_paid END),0)
               FROM invoices WHERE status IN ('sent','partial','overdue')) as unpaid,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE status IN ('quote','devis')) as open_quotes,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE COALESCE(stock_quantity,0) <= COALESCE(low_stock_threshold, 5)) as low_stock,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mobile_actions WHERE status = 'pending') as actions_pending
          `,
          )
          .bind(day, day)
          .first();
        if (normalizeRole(role) === 'stock') {
          return {
            ok: true,
            data: {
              products: dash?.products,
              low_stock: dash?.low_stock,
              actions_pending: dash?.actions_pending,
              note: 'Rôle stock: pas de montants ventes/impayés',
            },
          };
        }
        return { ok: true, data: dash };
      }
      case 'search_products': {
        const q = String(args.query || '').trim().slice(0, 80);
        if (!q) return { ok: false, error: 'query requis' };
        const like = `%${q}%`;
        const { results } = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT id, name, sku, barcode, stock_quantity, low_stock_threshold, unit_price, category
             FROM products
             WHERE name LIKE ? OR sku LIKE ? OR barcode LIKE ?
             ORDER BY name LIMIT ?`,
          )
          .bind(like, like, like, limit)
          .all();
        // v0.7.1 — inventory privacy in the LLM context as well.
        return { ok: true, data: (results || []).map((r: any) => scrubProductForRole(r, role)) };
      }
      case 'get_product': {
        let row: any = null;
        if (args.id) {
          row = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(Number(args.id)).first();
        } else if (args.sku) {
          row = await db
            .prepare(`SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = ? OR barcode = ?`)
            .bind(String(args.sku), String(args.sku))
            .first();
        }
        if (!row) return { ok: false, error: 'Produit introuvable' };
        return { ok: true, data: scrubProductForRole(row as any, role) };
      }
      case 'list_actions_pending': {
        const { results } = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT id, type, status, payload, created_at FROM mobile_actions
             WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?`,
          )
          .bind(limit)
          .all();
        return { ok: true, data: results || [] };
      }
      case 'list_open_quotes': {
        const { results } = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT id, number, client_name, total, status, issue_date FROM invoices
             WHERE status IN ('quote','devis') ORDER BY issue_date DESC LIMIT ?`,
          )
          .bind(limit)
          .all();
        return { ok: true, data: results || [] };
      }
      case 'list_unpaid_invoices': {
        const { results } = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT id, number, client_name, total, amount_paid, status, issue_date FROM invoices
             WHERE status IN ('sent','partial','overdue')
             ORDER BY (total - amount_paid) DESC LIMIT ?`,
          )
          .bind(limit)
          .all();
        return { ok: true, data: results || [] };
      }
      case 'warehouse_stock': {
        const code = String(args.code || '').trim().slice(0, 32);
        const loc = await db
          .prepare(`SELECT id, name, code FROM locations WHERE code = ? OR name LIKE ? LIMIT 1`)
          .bind(code, `%${code}%`)
          .first();
        if (!loc) {
          // fallback aggregate by product if no locations table match
          const { results } = await db
            .prepare(
              `SELECT id, name, sku, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY name LIMIT ?`,
            )
            .bind(limit)
            .all();
          return { ok: true, data: { location: null, note: 'Emplacement non trouvé — extrait stock global', products: results } };
        }
        try {
          const { results } = await db
            .prepare(
              `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.sku, COALESCE(ps.quantity, p.stock_quantity) as quantity
               FROM products p
               LEFT JOIN product_stocks ps ON ps.product_id = p.id AND ps.location_id = ?
               WHERE p.is_active = 1
               ORDER BY quantity ASC LIMIT ?`,
            )
            .bind(loc.id, limit)
            .all();
          return { ok: true, data: { location: loc, products: results || [] } };
        } catch {
          return { ok: true, data: { location: loc, products: [], note: 'Table product_stocks absente' } };
        }
      }
      case 'draft_day_close_report': {
        const snap = await runAssistTool(env, 'get_dashboard_snapshot', {}, role);
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            date: day,
            snapshot: snap.data,
            template_fr: [
              `Clôture du ${day}`,
              `• Ventes du jour : ${(snap.data as any)?.sales_today ?? '—'} MAD (${(snap.data as any)?.inv_today ?? 0} pièces)`,
              `• Impayés ouverts : ${(snap.data as any)?.unpaid ?? '—'} MAD`,
              `• Stock bas : ${(snap.data as any)?.low_stock ?? 0} article(s)`,
              `• Devis ouverts : ${(snap.data as any)?.open_quotes ?? 0}`,
              `• Actions mobile : ${(snap.data as any)?.actions_pending ?? 0}`,
            ].join('\n'),
          },
        };
      }
      case 'anomaly_notes': {
        const low = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT name, sku, stock_quantity FROM products
             WHERE COALESCE(stock_quantity,0) <= COALESCE(low_stock_threshold, 5)
             ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC LIMIT 5`,
          )
          .all();
        const unpaid =
          normalizeRole(role) === 'stock'
            ? { results: [] }
            : await db
                .prepare(
                  `SELECT number, client_name, total - amount_paid as due FROM invoices
                   WHERE status IN ('sent','partial','overdue') ORDER BY due DESC LIMIT 5`,
                )
                .all();
        const pending = await db
          .prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM mobile_actions WHERE status = 'pending'`)
          .first();
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            low_stock: low.results || [],
            top_unpaid: unpaid.results || [],
            actions_pending: Number((pending as any)?.n || 0),
          },
        };
      }
      case 'propose_inventory_adjustment': {
        const delta = Number(args.delta);
        if (!Number.isFinite(delta) || delta === 0) return { ok: false, error: 'delta invalide' };
        let product: any = null;
        if (args.product_id) {
          product = await db.prepare(`SELECT id, name, sku, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(Number(args.product_id)).first();
        } else if (args.sku) {
          product = await db
            .prepare(`SELECT id, name, sku, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE sku = ? OR barcode = ?`)
            .bind(String(args.sku), String(args.sku))
            .first();
        }
        if (!product) return { ok: false, error: 'Produit introuvable pour proposition' };
        const proposal = {
          type: 'inventory_adjustment',
          product_id: product.id,
          product_name: product.name,
          sku: product.sku,
          delta,
          current_stock: product.stock_quantity,
          note: String(args.note || 'Proposition assistant IA').slice(0, 200),
          requires_approval: true,
        };
        return { ok: true, data: proposal, proposal };
      }

      case 'list_low_stock': {
        const { results } = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT id, name, sku, stock_quantity, low_stock_threshold, price
             FROM products
             WHERE COALESCE(stock_quantity,0) <= COALESCE(low_stock_threshold, 5)
             ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC LIMIT ?`,
          )
          .bind(limit)
          .all();
        return { ok: true, data: { items: results || [] } };
      }
      case 'search_clients': {
        const q = String(args.query || '').trim();
        if (!q) return { ok: false, error: 'query requis' };
        const like = `%${q}%`;
        const { results } = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT id, name, ice, phone, email, city FROM clients
             WHERE name LIKE ? OR ice LIKE ? OR phone LIKE ? OR email LIKE ?
             ORDER BY name LIMIT ?`,
          )
          .bind(like, like, like, like, limit)
          .all();
        return { ok: true, data: { items: results || [] } };
      }
      case 'list_recent_invoices': {
        const { results } = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT id, number, client_name, status, total, amount_paid, issue_date
             FROM invoices
             WHERE status NOT IN ('quote','devis')
             ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?`,
          )
          .bind(limit)
          .all();
        return { ok: true, data: { items: results || [] } };
      }
      case 'get_invoice_brief': {
        let inv: any = null;
        if (args.id) {
          inv = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE id = ?`).bind(Number(args.id)).first();
        } else if (args.number) {
          inv = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE number = ?`).bind(String(args.number)).first();
        }
        if (!inv) return { ok: false, error: 'Facture introuvable' };
        const { results: lines } = await db
          .prepare(`SELECT product_name, quantity, unit_price, line_total FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id = ? LIMIT 30`)
          .bind(inv.id)
          .all();
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            id: inv.id,
            number: inv.number,
            client: inv.client_name,
            status: inv.status,
            total: inv.total,
            paid: inv.amount_paid,
            issue_date: inv.issue_date,
            lines: lines || [],
          },
        };
      }
      case 'list_warehouses': {
        try {
          const { results } = await db
            .prepare(`SELECT id, code, name, is_default FROM warehouses ORDER BY is_default DESC, name LIMIT 30`)
            .all();
          return { ok: true, data: { items: results || [] } };
        } catch {
          return { ok: true, data: { items: [], note: 'Table entrepôts absente' } };
        }
      }
      case 'summarize_pending_actions': {
        const { results } = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT type, COUNT(*) as n FROM mobile_actions WHERE status = 'pending' GROUP BY type`,
          )
          .all();
        const total = (results || []).reduce((s: number, r: any) => s + Number(r.n || 0), 0);
        return { ok: true, data: { total, by_type: results || [] } };
      }


      case 'draft_client_message': {
        const q = String(args.client_query || '').trim();
        if (!q) return { ok: false, error: 'client_query requis' };
        const like = `%${q}%`;
        const client = await db
          .prepare(`SELECT id, name, phone, email FROM clients WHERE name LIKE ? OR phone LIKE ? OR email LIKE ? LIMIT 1`)
          .bind(like, like, like)
          .first() as any;
        if (!client) return { ok: false, error: 'Client introuvable' };
        const unpaid = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT number, total, amount_paid, issue_date FROM invoices
             WHERE client_id = ? AND status IN ('sent','partial','overdue')
             ORDER BY issue_date DESC LIMIT 3`,
          )
          .bind(client.id)
          .all();
        const channel = String(args.channel || 'whatsapp').toLowerCase();
        const intent = String(args.intent || 'unpaid').toLowerCase();
        const lines = (unpaid.results || []) as any[];
        let body = '';
        if (intent === 'thanks') {
          body = `Bonjour ${client.name},\n\nMerci pour votre confiance. N’hésitez pas si vous avez besoin d’autre chose.\n\nCordialement`;
        } else if (intent === 'quote') {
          body = `Bonjour ${client.name},\n\nSuite à notre échange, voici le devis. Dites-moi si vous souhaitez des ajustements.\n\nCordialement`;
        } else {
          const detail = lines.length
            ? lines.map((x) => `- ${x.number}: ${Number(x.total) - Number(x.amount_paid || 0)} MAD restant`).join('\n')
            : '- (voir solde en boutique)';
          body = `Bonjour ${client.name},\n\nNous vous contactons concernant le solde en cours :\n${detail}\n\nMerci de nous indiquer la date de règlement prévue.\n\nCordialement`;
        }
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            client: { id: client.id, name: client.name, phone: client.phone, email: client.email },
            channel,
            intent,
            body,
            wa_link: client.phone
              ? `https://wa.me/${String(client.phone).replace(/\D/g, '')}?text=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`
              : null,
          },
        };
      }
      case 'propose_quote_lines': {
        const pq = String(args.product_query || args.client_query || '').trim();
        let products: any[] = [];
        if (pq) {
          const like = `%${pq}%`;
          const r = await db
            .prepare(
              `SELECT id, name, sku, unit_price, stock_quantity FROM products
               WHERE name LIKE ? OR sku LIKE ? ORDER BY name LIMIT ?`,
            )
            .bind(like, like, limit)
            .all();
          products = (r.results || []) as any[];
        } else {
          const r = await db
            .prepare(
              `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.sku, p.unit_price, p.stock_quantity, COUNT(ii.id) as sold
               FROM products p
               LEFT JOIN invoice_items ii ON ii.product_id = p.id
               GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT ?`,
            )
            .bind(limit)
            .all();
          products = (r.results || []) as any[];
        }
        const lines = products.map((p) => ({
          product_id: p.id,
          product_name: p.name,
          sku: p.sku,
          quantity: 1,
          unit_price: Number(p.unit_price || 0),
          stock: p.stock_quantity,
        }));
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            lines,
            note: 'Brouillon — à coller / éditer dans Devis avant enregistrement',
            href: '/quotes',
          },
          proposal: { type: 'quote_lines_draft', lines, requires_approval: false },
        };
      }
      case 'closing_pack': {
        const day = await localDateCasablanca();
        const low = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT id, name, sku, stock_quantity FROM products
             WHERE COALESCE(stock_quantity,0) <= COALESCE(low_stock_threshold, 5)
             ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC LIMIT 8`,
          )
          .all();
        const unpaid = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT id, number, client_name, total, amount_paid FROM invoices
             WHERE status IN ('sent','partial','overdue') ORDER BY issue_date DESC LIMIT 8`,
          )
          .all();
        const quotes = await db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT id, number, client_name, total FROM invoices
             WHERE status IN ('quote','devis') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 8`,
          )
          .all();
        const actions = await db
          .prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM mobile_actions WHERE status = 'pending'`)
          .first() as any;
        const checklist = [
          { label: 'Actions mobile en attente', count: Number(actions?.n || 0), href: '/actions' },
          { label: 'Stock bas', count: (low.results || []).length, href: '/products' },
          { label: 'Factures impayées', count: (unpaid.results || []).length, href: '/invoices' },
          { label: 'Devis ouverts', count: (quotes.results || []).length, href: '/quotes' },
        ];
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            day,
            checklist,
            low_stock: low.results || [],
            unpaid: unpaid.results || [],
            open_quotes: quotes.results || [],
          },
        };
      }
      case 'explain_pending_action': {
        const id = Number(args.action_id);
        if (!id) return { ok: false, error: 'action_id requis' };
        const row = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM mobile_actions WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first() as any;
        if (!row) return { ok: false, error: 'Action introuvable' };
        let meta: any = {};
        try { meta = row.meta_json ? JSON.parse(row.meta_json) : {}; } catch { /* */ }
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            id: row.id,
            type: row.type,
            title: row.title,
            detail: row.detail,
            status: row.status,
            barcode: row.barcode,
            created_at: row.created_at,
            meta,
            href: '/actions',
            tip:
              row.type === 'new_product'
                ? 'Vérifier nom, prix, stock initial puis Approuver le produit.'
                : row.type === 'stock_check' || row.type === 'inventory'
                  ? 'Comparer le stock saisi au rayon puis valider l’ajustement.'
                  : 'Lire le détail et Approuver / Refuser avec motif.',
          },
        };
      }

      case 'create_client': {
        if (!moneyToolsAllowed(role) && normalizeRole(role) !== 'user') {
          return { ok: false, error: 'Création client non autorisée pour ce rôle.' };
        }
        const name = String(args.name || '').trim();
        if (!name) return { ok: false, error: 'name requis' };
        const ice = String(args.ice || '').trim();
        const phone = String(args.phone || '').trim();
        const email = String(args.email || '').trim();
        const address = String(args.address || '').trim();
        const city = String(args.city || '').trim();
        const r = await db
          .prepare(
            `INSERT INTO clients (name, ice, if_number, address, city, phone, email) VALUES (?, ?, '', ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          )
          .bind(name, ice, address, city, phone, email)
          .run();
        const id = Number((r as any)?.meta?.last_row_id || 0);
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            id,
            name,
            ice: ice || null,
            phone: phone || null,
            email: email || null,
            message: `Client « ${name} » créé avec succès.`,
            href: '/clients',
          },
        };
      }
      case 'create_product': {
        if (!canMutateBusiness(role) && normalizeRole(role) !== 'user' && !canFloorStock(role)) {
          return { ok: false, error: 'Création produit non autorisée pour ce rôle.' };
        }
        const name = String(args.name || '').trim();
        if (!name) return { ok: false, error: 'name requis' };
        const sku = String(args.sku || '').trim();
        const barcode = String(args.barcode || '').trim();
        const price = Number(args.price ?? 0) || 0;
        const stock = Number(args.stock_quantity ?? 0) || 0;
        const unit = String(args.unit || 'unité').trim() || 'unité';
        const category = String(args.category || 'Général').trim() || 'Général';
        const r = await db
          .prepare(
            `INSERT INTO products (sku, name, description, category, unit, price, cost, stock_quantity, low_stock_threshold, track_inventory, image_url, barcode, tax_rate, bulk_discounts)
             VALUES (?, ?, '', ?, ?, ?, 0, ?, 5, 1, '', ?, NULL, NULL)`,
          )
          .bind(sku || null, name, category, unit, price, stock, barcode || null)
          .run();
        const id = Number((r as any)?.meta?.last_row_id || 0);
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            id,
            name,
            sku: sku || null,
            price,
            stock_quantity: stock,
            message: `Produit « ${name} » créé avec succès.`,
            href: '/products',
          },
        };
      }

      case 'update_client': {
        if (!moneyToolsAllowed(role) && normalizeRole(role) !== 'user') {
          return { ok: false, error: 'Modification client non autorisée pour ce rôle.' };
        }
        let id = args.id ? Number(args.id) : 0;
        const searchName = String(args.name || '').trim();
        if (!id && searchName) {
          const found = await db
            .prepare(`SELECT id FROM clients WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER(?) LIMIT 1`)
            .bind(`%${searchName}%`)
            .first() as any;
          id = Number(found?.id || 0);
        }
        if (!id) return { ok: false, error: 'Client introuvable (id ou name).' };
        const row = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first() as any;
        if (!row) return { ok: false, error: 'Client introuvable.' };
        const name = args.name != null ? String(args.name).trim() : row.name;
        const phone = args.phone != null ? String(args.phone).trim() : row.phone;
        const email = args.email != null ? String(args.email).trim() : row.email;
        const address = args.address != null ? String(args.address).trim() : row.address;
        const city = args.city != null ? String(args.city).trim() : row.city;
        const ice = args.ice != null ? String(args.ice).trim() : row.ice;
        await db
          .prepare(
            `UPDATE clients SET name = ?, phone = ?, email = ?, address = ?, city = ?, ice = ? WHERE id = ?`,
          )
          .bind(name, phone || '', email || '', address || '', city || '', ice || '', id)
          .run();
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: { id, name, message: `Client « ${name} » mis à jour.`, href: '/clients' },
        };
      }
      case 'update_product': {
        if (!canMutateBusiness(role) && normalizeRole(role) !== 'user' && !canFloorStock(role)) {
          return { ok: false, error: 'Modification produit non autorisée pour ce rôle.' };
        }
        let id = args.id ? Number(args.id) : 0;
        const searchName = String(args.name || '').trim();
        if (!id && searchName) {
          const found = await db
            .prepare(`SELECT id FROM products WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER(?) LIMIT 1`)
            .bind(`%${searchName}%`)
            .first() as any;
          id = Number(found?.id || 0);
        }
        if (!id) return { ok: false, error: 'Produit introuvable (id ou name).' };
        const row = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first() as any;
        if (!row) return { ok: false, error: 'Produit introuvable.' };
        const name = args.name != null ? String(args.name).trim() : row.name;
        const price = args.price != null ? Number(args.price) : Number(row.price || 0);
        const stock = args.stock_quantity != null ? Number(args.stock_quantity) : Number(row.stock_quantity || 0);
        const sku = args.sku != null ? String(args.sku).trim() : row.sku;
        const barcode = args.barcode != null ? String(args.barcode).trim() : row.barcode;
        const category = args.category != null ? String(args.category).trim() : row.category;
        await db
          .prepare(
            `UPDATE products SET name = ?, price = ?, stock_quantity = ?, sku = ?, barcode = ?, category = ? WHERE id = ?`,
          )
          .bind(name, price, stock, sku || null, barcode || null, category || 'Général', id)
          .run();
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            id,
            name,
            price,
            stock_quantity: stock,
            message: `Produit « ${name} » mis à jour.`,
            href: '/products',
          },
        };
      }
      case 'create_invoice_draft':
      case 'create_quote_draft': {

        if (!moneyToolsAllowed(role) && normalizeRole(role) !== 'user') {
          return { ok: false, error: 'Création document non autorisée pour ce rôle.' };
        }
        const isQuote = name === 'create_quote_draft';
        const clientName = String(args.client_name || '').trim();
        if (!clientName) return { ok: false, error: 'client_name requis' };
        let clientId = args.client_id ? Number(args.client_id) : null;
        if (!clientId) {
          const found = await db
            .prepare(`SELECT id, name FROM clients WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(?) LIMIT 1`)
            .bind(clientName)
            .first() as any;
          if (found?.id) clientId = Number(found.id);
        }
        const notes = String(args.notes || '').trim();
        const status = isQuote ? 'quote' : 'draft';
        // Minimal insert — numbering handled loosely for agent drafts
        const prefix = isQuote ? 'DV-A-' : 'FA-A-';
        const number = `${prefix}${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}`;
        const day = await localDateCasablanca();
        const r = await db
          .prepare(
            `INSERT INTO invoices (number, client_id, client_name, client_ice, client_address, client_city, client_email, client_phone, issue_date, due_date, status, subtotal, tax_amount, total, notes, amount_paid)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, '', '', '', '', '', ?, ?, ?, 0, 0, 0, ?, 0)`,
          )
          .bind(number, clientId, clientName, day, day, status, notes)
          .run();
        const id = Number((r as any)?.meta?.last_row_id || 0);
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            id,
            number,
            status,
            client_name: clientName,
            message: isQuote
              ? `Devis ${number} créé pour « ${clientName} ».`
              : `Facture brouillon ${number} créée pour « ${clientName} ».`,
            href: isQuote ? '/quotes' : `/invoices/${id}`,
          },
        };
      }

      case 'SCAN_BARCODE':
      case 'NAVIGATE':
      case 'HAPTIC_FEEDBACK':
        return {
          ok: true,
          data: {
            client_action: name,
            args,
            message:
              name === 'SCAN_BARCODE'
                ? 'Ouvrir le scanneur'
                : name === 'NAVIGATE'
                  ? `Naviguer vers ${String(args.path || '/m/')}`
                  : 'Retour haptique',
          },
          proposal: {
            type: 'mobile_ui',
            action: name,
            ...args,
          },
        };

      default:
        return { ok: false, error: `Outil inconnu: ${name}` };
    }
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { ok: false, error: e?.message || 'Erreur outil' };
  }
}

export async function buildNextActions(env: Env, role: string): Promise<
  { priority: number; title: string; detail: string; href?: string }[]
> {
  const items: { priority: number; title: string; detail: string; href?: string }[] = [];
  const pending = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM mobile_actions WHERE status = 'pending'`).first() as any;
  const nPend = Number(pending?.n || 0);
  if (nPend > 0) {
    items.push({
      priority: 10,
      title: `${nPend} action(s) mobile à traiter`,
      detail: 'Boîte d’actions — valider ou refuser les envois téléphone',
      href: '/actions',
    });
  }
  const low = await env.DB.prepare(
    `SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM products WHERE COALESCE(stock_quantity,0) <= COALESCE(low_stock_threshold, 5)`,
  ).first() as any;
  if (Number(low?.n || 0) > 0) {
    items.push({
      priority: 8,
      title: `${low.n} produit(s) en stock bas`,
      detail: 'Vérifier le rayon ou proposer un ajustement',
      href: '/products',
    });
  }
  if (moneyToolsAllowed(role)) {
    const unpaid = await env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM invoices WHERE status IN ('sent','partial','overdue')`,
    ).first() as any;
    if (Number(unpaid?.n || 0) > 0) {
      items.push({
        priority: 7,
        title: `${unpaid.n} facture(s) impayée(s)`,
        detail: 'Relancer ou enregistrer un paiement',
        href: '/invoices',
      });
    }
    const quotes = await env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM invoices WHERE status IN ('quote','devis')`,
    ).first() as any;
    if (Number(quotes?.n || 0) > 0) {
      items.push({
        priority: 5,
        title: `${quotes.n} devis ouvert(s)`,
        detail: 'Convertir en facture ou relancer le client',
        href: '/quotes',
      });
    }
  }
  items.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);
  return items.slice(0, 8);
}

export async function mistralChatWithTools(opts: {
  env: Env;
  apiKey: string;
  model: string;
  role: string;
  username: string;
  message: string;
  task?: string;
  timezone?: string;
  /** android | ios | web | mobile */
  source?: string;
}): Promise<{
  reply: string;
  tool_trace: { name: string; ok: boolean; error?: string; data?: unknown }[];
  proposals: Record<string, unknown>[];
  model: string;
}> {
  let mode: AgentPermMode = 'full';
  let customTools: string[] = [];
  try {
    const modeRow = await opts.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key = 'agent_perm_mode'`).first() as any;
    const customRow = await opts.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key = 'agent_perm_tools'`).first() as any;
    if (modeRow?.value === 'read_only' || modeRow?.value === 'custom' || modeRow?.value === 'full') {
      mode = modeRow.value as AgentPermMode;
    }
    if (customRow?.value) {
      try { customTools = JSON.parse(String(customRow.value)); } catch { customTools = []; }
    }
  } catch { /* defaults */ }

/**
 * Consistent API response shape for Atlas Worker (web + Capacitor + future partners).
 * { success: true, data?, message? } | { success: false, error, code?, details? }
 */

import type { Context } from 'hono';
import { looksLikeDbError } from './errors';

export type ApiFailCode =
  | 'BAD_REQUEST'
  | 'UNAUTHORIZED'
  | 'FORBIDDEN'
  | 'NOT_FOUND'
  | 'CONFLICT'
  | 'RATE_LIMITED'
  | 'VALIDATION'
  | 'INTERNAL'
  | 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';

const STATUS: Record<ApiFailCode, number> = {
  BAD_REQUEST: 400,
  UNAUTHORIZED: 401,
  FORBIDDEN: 403,
  NOT_FOUND: 404,
  CONFLICT: 409,
  RATE_LIMITED: 429,
  VALIDATION: 422,
  INTERNAL: 500,
  SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: 503,
};

export function apiOk(c: Context, data?: unknown, message?: string, status = 200) {
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = { success: true };
  if (data !== undefined) body.data = data;
  if (message) body.message = message;
  return c.json(body, status as any);
}

export function apiFail(
  c: Context,
  error: string,
  code: ApiFailCode = 'BAD_REQUEST',
  details?: unknown,
  statusOverride?: number,
) {
  const status = statusOverride ?? STATUS[code] ?? 400;
  // Never return raw database / driver messages to clients
  let safeError = error || 'Erreur';
  if (looksLikeDbError(safeError) || code === 'INTERNAL') {
    if (looksLikeDbError(safeError)) {
      console.error('[apiFail-db-leak]', safeError.slice(0, 300));
      safeError = 'Erreur interne — réessayez plus tard';
    }
  }
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = { success: false, error: safeError, code };
  if (details !== undefined && code !== 'INTERNAL') body.details = details;
  if (code === 'RATE_LIMITED' && details && typeof details === 'object' && details !== null && 'retry_after' in details) {
    body.retry_after = (details as any).retry_after;
  }
  return c.json(body, status as any);
}

/**
 * v0.7 — backend-controlled minimum supported Android version.
 *
 * The policy (enabled + floor versionCode) is owned by owner/admin via
 * PUT /api/admin/app-update, persisted in `app_config` (source of truth,
 * never touched by CI release ingestion) and mirrored into the R2
 * `latest.json` manifest so the public update check can echo it without a
 * DB round-trip. Reads follow the existing order: R2 manifest first,
 * app_config fallback.
 *
 * Enforcement: Android API clients (`X-Atlas-Client: android`) that advertise
 * a version code BELOW the floor get HTTP 426 `APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED` with the
 * update payload. Clients whose version is UNKNOWN (no header — installed
 * builds predating the header) are NOT blocked (no fleet-wide lockout); they
 * are steered to the update screen by the public update check
 * (minimumVersionRequired / mandatory). Web clients, bootstrap/health and the
 * update-check / APK download routes are never blocked.
 * The version header is compatibility metadata, NOT a security credential:
 * authentication, authorization, WebAuthn and device binding stay untouched.
 */
import { pickUiLang, tr, type UiLang } from './error-i18n';

export type MinVersionPolicy = { enabled: boolean; code: number };

export const MIN_VERSION_CONFIG_KEYS = {
  enabled: 'android_min_version_enabled',
  code: 'android_min_version_code',
} as const;

/** Short TTL cache so every Android API request doesn't hit D1. */
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 60_000;
let cache: { at: number; policy: MinVersionPolicy } | null = null;

/** Test-only: drop the TTL cache between in-process databases. */
export function resetMinVersionPolicyCacheForTests(): void {
  cache = null;
}

export function parseMinVersionPolicy(enabledRaw: unknown, codeRaw: unknown): MinVersionPolicy {
  const enabled =
    enabledRaw === true || enabledRaw === 'true' || enabledRaw === '1' || enabledRaw === 1;
  const code = Math.floor(Number(codeRaw ?? 0));
  return { enabled, code: Number.isFinite(code) && code > 0 ? code : 0 };
}

/** Policy embedded in a manifest, or null when the manifest carries none. */
export function policyFromManifest(manifest: any): MinVersionPolicy | null {
  if (!manifest || typeof manifest !== 'object') return null;
  const has =
    'minimumVersionEnabled' in manifest || 'minimumSupportedVersionCode' in manifest;
  if (!has) return null;
  return parseMinVersionPolicy(
    manifest.minimumVersionEnabled,
    manifest.minimumSupportedVersionCode,
  );
}

export async function readMinVersionPolicy(
  db: { prepare: (sql: string) => any } | null | undefined,
  opts: { bypassCache?: boolean } = {},
): Promise<MinVersionPolicy> {
  if (!opts.bypassCache && cache && Date.now() - cache.at < CACHE_TTL_MS) return cache.policy;
  let policy: MinVersionPolicy = { enabled: false, code: 0 };
  if (db) {
    try {
      const rows = await db
        .prepare(`SELECT key, value FROM app_config WHERE key = ? OR key = ?`)
        .bind(MIN_VERSION_CONFIG_KEYS.enabled, MIN_VERSION_CONFIG_KEYS.code)
        .all();
      const map: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const r of (rows?.results || []) as any[]) map[String(r.key)] = String(r.value || '');
      policy = parseMinVersionPolicy(
        map[MIN_VERSION_CONFIG_KEYS.enabled],
        map[MIN_VERSION_CONFIG_KEYS.code],
      );
    } catch { /* no app_config yet → policy disabled (backward compatible) */ }
  }
  cache = { at: Date.now(), policy };
  return policy;
}

export async function writeMinVersionPolicy(
  db: { prepare: (sql: string) => any },
  policy: MinVersionPolicy,
): Promise<void> {
  await db
    .prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_config (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT)`)
    .run();
  await db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO app_config (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value`,
    )
    .bind(MIN_VERSION_CONFIG_KEYS.enabled, policy.enabled ? '1' : '0')
    .run();
  await db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO app_config (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value`,
    )
    .bind(MIN_VERSION_CONFIG_KEYS.code, String(policy.code))
    .run();
  cache = { at: Date.now(), policy };
}

/** Manifest copy of the policy (public check echoes it without a DB hit). */
export function manifestWithPolicy(manifest: any, policy: MinVersionPolicy): any {
  const base = manifest && typeof manifest === 'object' ? manifest : {};
  return {
    ...base,
    minimumVersionEnabled: policy.enabled,
    minimumSupportedVersionCode: policy.enabled ? policy.code : 0,
  };
}

/**
 * CI release ingestion must NEVER reset the admin policy: carry it from the
 * previous manifest, or from app_config when the manifest had none.
 */
export function carryPolicyIntoManifest(
  newManifest: any,
  oldManifest: any,
  dbPolicy: MinVersionPolicy | null,
): { manifest: any; policy: MinVersionPolicy } {
  const policy = policyFromManifest(oldManifest) || dbPolicy || { enabled: false, code: 0 };
  return { manifest: manifestWithPolicy(newManifest, policy), policy };
}

/** A blocking policy needs a positive floor AND a usable update to point at. */
export function validateMinVersionPolicy(policy: MinVersionPolicy, manifest: any): string | null {
  if (!policy.enabled) return null;
  if (!Number.isInteger(policy.code) || policy.code < 1) {
    return 'minimumSupportedVersionCode doit être un entier ≥ 1';
  }
  const available = Math.floor(Number(manifest?.versionCode || 0));
  if (!Number.isFinite(available) || available < 1) {
    return 'Aucune release disponible : impossible d\'activer une politique bloquante';
  }
  const apkUrl = String(manifest?.apkUrl || manifest?.apk_url || '').trim();
  if (!/^https:\/\/\S+$/i.test(apkUrl)) {
    return 'Aucune URL APK utilisable : impossible d\'activer une politique bloquante';
  }
  if (policy.code > available) {
    return `Le plancher (${policy.code}) ne peut pas dépasser la release disponible (${available})`;
  }
  return null;
}

/** Routes an outdated Android client must still reach to update itself. */
export const ANDROID_MIN_GUARD_EXEMPT = ['/api/health', '/api/app/android-update'];

export function androidClientMeta(c: any): { isAndroid: boolean; code: number | null } {
  const client = String(c.req.header('X-Atlas-Client') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const raw = String(c.req.header('X-Atlas-App-Version-Code') || '').trim();
  let code: number | null = null;
  if (raw !== '') {
    const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
    code = Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
  }
  return { isAndroid: client === 'android', code };
}

export function updateRequiredBody(manifest: any, policy: MinVersionPolicy, lang: UiLang = 'fr') {
  return {
    success: false,
    code: 'APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED',
    error: tr(lang, 'update_required'),
    update: {
      versionCode: Math.floor(Number(manifest?.versionCode || 0)) || null,
      versionName: manifest?.versionName || manifest?.version_name || null,
      apkUrl: manifest?.apkUrl || manifest?.apk_url || null,
      minimumSupportedVersionCode: policy.code,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Hono middleware: enforce the floor on Android API clients ONLY.
 * Version headers are compatibility metadata — never a security credential.
 */
export function androidMinVersionGuard(deps: {
  readPolicy: (db: any) => Promise<MinVersionPolicy>;
  readManifest: (env: any) => Promise<any>;
}) {
  return async (c: any, next: any) => {
    const { isAndroid, code } = androidClientMeta(c);
    if (!isAndroid) return next();
    const path = new URL(c.req.url).pathname;
    if (ANDROID_MIN_GUARD_EXEMPT.some((p) => path === p || path.startsWith(`${p}/`))) {
      return next();
    }
    let policy: MinVersionPolicy;
    try {
      policy = await deps.readPolicy(c.env?.DB);
    } catch {
      policy = { enabled: false, code: 0 };
    }
    if (!policy.enabled) return next();
    // KNOWN version at/above the floor → fine. UNKNOWN version (installed
    // builds whose OkHttp interceptor predates the version headers) must NOT
    // be hard-blocked here — that would lock out the whole current fleet the
    // moment the policy is enabled. Those builds are steered to the update
    // screen by the update check (minimumVersionRequired + mandatory), and
    // builds that DO send the header are enforced strictly below.
    if (code === null || code >= policy.code) return next();
    // Known and below the floor → update prompt.
    let manifest: any = null;
    try {
      manifest = await deps.readManifest(c.env);
    } catch { /* 426 still returned, update URLs best-effort */ }
    return c.json(updateRequiredBody(manifest, policy, pickUiLang(c.req.header('Accept-Language'))), 426);
  };
}

/**
 * Multi-BFF style routing without separate Nest apps.
 * Same Worker, different contracts by client surface:
 *   - web:     session Bearer, full UI API /api/*
 *   - mobile:  same API + /m/* SPA; X-Atlas-Client: mobile
 *   - partner: /api/v1/* + API key
 *
 * Nginx is unnecessary on Cloudflare (edge TLS + routing).
 * Redis → KV. gRPC → JSON/HTTP (Workers-friendly).
 */

export type BffSurface = 'web' | 'mobile' | 'partner' | 'public';

export function detectBffSurface(c: { req: { header: (n: string) => string | undefined; url: string } }): BffSurface {
  const path = new URL(c.req.url).pathname;
  if (path.startsWith('/api/v1')) return 'partner';
  if (path.startsWith('/api/public')) return 'public';
  const client = (c.req.header('x-atlas-client') || c.req.header('X-Atlas-Client') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (client === 'mobile' || client === 'capacitor' || client === 'android') return 'mobile';
  if (path.startsWith('/m/') || path.startsWith('/m')) return 'mobile';
  return 'web';
}

/**
 * Cache layer — KV free-tier aware (100k reads / 1k writes per day).
 *
 * Strategy:
 * 1. In-isolate memory is the primary store (0 KV cost).
 * 2. KV is used sparingly for multi-isolate sharing, with write throttling.
 * 3. Invalidate = bump gen in memory (+ at most 1 KV write / 45s).
 * 4. All KV ops are best-effort; failures never break the request.
 */

const GEN_KEY = 'cache:gen';
const DASHBOARD_BASE = 'dash';
const SETTINGS_BASE = 'settings';
const PRODUCTS_PREFIX = 'products:';

/** Default TTL (seconds). Longer = fewer refreshes. */
export const DEFAULT_CACHE_TTL = 1800; // 30 min

/** Memory store: key → { value, expMs } */
const memStore = new Map<string, { value: unknown; exp: number }>();
const MEM_MAX = 80;

let memGen: { value: number; fetchedAt: number } | null = null;
const MEM_GEN_MS = 120_000; // 2 min before re-reading gen from KV

let lastGenKvWrite = 0;
const GEN_KV_WRITE_MIN_MS = 45_000; // at most ~2 gen writes / minute

let kvReadBudget = 0;
let kvWriteBudget = 0;
let budgetWindowStart = Date.now();
/** Soft daily-ish budgets per isolate (reset every hour of isolate life) */
const KV_READ_SOFT_CAP = 800; // per hour / isolate
const KV_WRITE_SOFT_CAP = 40;

function rollBudget() {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - budgetWindowStart > 3_600_000) {
    kvReadBudget = 0;
    kvWriteBudget = 0;
    budgetWindowStart = now;
  }
}

function canKvRead(): boolean {
  rollBudget();
  return kvReadBudget < KV_READ_SOFT_CAP;
}

function canKvWrite(): boolean {
  rollBudget();
  return kvWriteBudget < KV_WRITE_SOFT_CAP;
}

function memGet<T>(key: string): T | null {
  const e = memStore.get(key);
  if (!e) return null;
  if (Date.now() > e.exp) {
    memStore.delete(key);
    return null;
  }
  return e.value as T;
}

function memPut(key: string, value: unknown, ttlSeconds: number) {
  const ttl = Math.max(30, Math.min(86400, Math.floor(ttlSeconds || DEFAULT_CACHE_TTL)));
  memStore.set(key, { value, exp: Date.now() + ttl * 1000 });
  if (memStore.size > MEM_MAX) {
    // drop oldest-ish (Map insertion order)
    const first = memStore.keys().next().value;
    if (first) memStore.delete(first);
  }
}

function memDelPrefix(prefix: string) {
  // oxlint-disable-next-line unicorn/no-useless-spread -- snapshot on purpose: keys are deleted during the loop
  for (const k of [...memStore.keys()]) {
    if (k.startsWith(prefix)) memStore.delete(k);
  }
}

export async function getCacheGen(kv: KVNamespace | undefined): Promise<number> {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (memGen && now - memGen.fetchedAt < MEM_GEN_MS) return memGen.value;
  if (!kv || !canKvRead()) {
    return memGen?.value || 1;
  }
  try {
    kvReadBudget++;
    const raw = await kv.get(GEN_KEY, 'text');
    const n = Math.max(1, Number(raw) || 1);
    memGen = { value: n, fetchedAt: now };
    return n;
  } catch {
    return memGen?.value || 1;
  }
}

export async function bumpCacheGen(kv: KVNamespace | undefined): Promise<void> {
  const cur = memGen?.value || 1;
  const next = cur + 1;
  memGen = { value: next, fetchedAt: Date.now() };
  // Drop versioned memory keys so this isolate sees fresh data
  memDelPrefix('dash');
  memDelPrefix('settings');
  memDelPrefix(PRODUCTS_PREFIX);
  memDelPrefix('g');

  if (!kv || !canKvWrite()) return;
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - lastGenKvWrite < GEN_KV_WRITE_MIN_MS) return; // throttle KV writes
  try {
    kvWriteBudget++;
    lastGenKvWrite = now;
    await kv.put(GEN_KEY, String(next), { expirationTtl: 86400 * 30 });
  } catch {
    /* ignore — free tier cap or network */
  }
}

export async function kvGetJson<T>(kv: KVNamespace | undefined, key: string): Promise<T | null> {
  const hit = memGet<T>(key);
  if (hit != null) return hit;
  if (!kv || !canKvRead()) return null;
  try {
    kvReadBudget++;
    const raw = await kv.get(key, 'text');
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as T;
    memPut(key, parsed, DEFAULT_CACHE_TTL);
    return parsed;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function kvPutJson(
  kv: KVNamespace | undefined,
  key: string,
  value: unknown,
  ttlSeconds: number
): Promise<void> {
  const ttl = Math.max(60, Math.min(86400, Math.floor(ttlSeconds || DEFAULT_CACHE_TTL)));
  memPut(key, value, ttl);
  // Skip most KV writes under free tier — memory covers same-isolate traffic
  if (!kv || !canKvWrite()) return;
  // Only persist "heavy" shared keys to KV (dashboard / settings), not every product list variant
  const shared = key.includes('dash') || key.includes('settings') || key === GEN_KEY;
  if (!shared && kvWriteBudget > KV_WRITE_SOFT_CAP / 2) return;
  try {
    kvWriteBudget++;
    await kv.put(key, JSON.stringify(value), { expirationTtl: ttl });
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

export async function kvDel(kv: KVNamespace | undefined, key: string): Promise<void> {
  memStore.delete(key);
  // Never spend KV delete quota on free tier — rely on TTL
  void kv;
}

export async function dashboardCacheKey(kv?: KVNamespace): Promise<string> {
  const g = await getCacheGen(kv);
  return `${DASHBOARD_BASE}:g${g}`;
}

export async function settingsCacheKey(kv?: KVNamespace): Promise<string> {
  const g = await getCacheGen(kv);
  return `${SETTINGS_BASE}:g${g}`;
}

export async function productsCacheKey(kv?: KVNamespace, suffix?: string): Promise<string> {
  const g = await getCacheGen(kv);
  const s = (suffix || 'all').slice(0, 120);
  return `${PRODUCTS_PREFIX}g${g}:${s || 'all'}`;
}

/** @deprecated */
export function configCacheKey(k: string): string {
  return `cfg:${k}`;
}

export async function invalidateDashboardCache(kv: KVNamespace | undefined): Promise<void> {
  await bumpCacheGen(kv);
}

export async function invalidateAllBusinessCache(kv: KVNamespace | undefined): Promise<void> {
  await bumpCacheGen(kv);
}

 * Phase 3: coordinated delete across D1 + R2 + KV.
 * Always remove CDN objects when D1 image rows are deleted.
 */

import { invalidateDashboardCache } from './cache';
import { deleteR2Object, keyFromCdnUrl } from './r2';

type EnvLike = {
  DB: D1Database;
  CACHE?: KVNamespace;
  IMAGES?: R2Bucket;
  CDN_BASE?: string;
};

/** Delete all product_images rows for a product and their R2 objects. */
export async function deleteProductImagesCascade(
  env: EnvLike,
  productId: string | number
): Promise<{ removed_db: number; removed_r2: number }> {
  const id = String(productId);
  const { results } = await env.DB.prepare(
    `SELECT id, url FROM product_images WHERE product_id = ?`
  ).bind(id).all();
  const rows = (results || []) as { id: number; url: string }[];
  let removed_r2 = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    const key = keyFromCdnUrl(env, String(row.url || ''));
    if (key) {
      await deleteR2Object(env.IMAGES, key);
      removed_r2 += 1;
    }
    // Also try products/{id}/ prefix cleanup is done per-object via key
  }
  // Remove primary image_url on product if it pointed at CDN
  const product = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT image_url FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first() as any;
  if (product?.image_url) {
    const key = keyFromCdnUrl(env, String(product.image_url));
    if (key) {
      await deleteR2Object(env.IMAGES, key);
      removed_r2 += 1;
    }
  }
  const del = await env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM product_images WHERE product_id = ?`).bind(id).run();
  const removed_db = Number(del.meta?.changes || rows.length);
  return { removed_db, removed_r2 };
}

/** Full product hard-delete: images (R2+D1) → product row → KV dashboard. */
export async function deleteProductCascade(
  env: EnvLike,
  productId: string | number
): Promise<{ removed_db: number; removed_r2: number }> {
  const img = await deleteProductImagesCascade(env, productId);
  await env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(String(productId)).run();
  await invalidateDashboardCache(env.CACHE);
  return img;
}

/** Bulk product delete with image cleanup. */
export async function deleteProductsCascade(
  env: EnvLike,
  ids: number[]
): Promise<{ count: number; removed_r2: number }> {
  let removed_r2 = 0;
  for (const id of ids) {
    const r = await deleteProductImagesCascade(env, id);
    removed_r2 += r.removed_r2;
  }
  if (ids.length) {
    const placeholders = ids.map(() => '?').join(',');
    await env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM products WHERE id IN (${placeholders})`).bind(...ids).run();
  }
  await invalidateDashboardCache(env.CACHE);
  return { count: ids.length, removed_r2 };
}

/** Delete a single image row + R2 object. */
export async function deleteOneImageCascade(
  env: EnvLike,
  productId: string | number,
  imageId: string | number
): Promise<boolean> {
  const existing = await env.DB.prepare(
    `SELECT * FROM product_images WHERE id = ? AND product_id = ?`
  ).bind(imageId, productId).first() as any;
  if (!existing) return false;
  const key = keyFromCdnUrl(env, String(existing.url || ''));
  if (key) await deleteR2Object(env.IMAGES, key);
  await env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM product_images WHERE id = ? AND product_id = ?`)
    .bind(imageId, productId).run();
  return true;
}

/**
 * Lightweight circuit breaker for upstream APIs (Groq, GitHub, mail).
 * Per-isolate state (Workers have no global Redis) — good enough to shed load
 * after consecutive failures without a separate mesh.
 */

type State = 'closed' | 'open' | 'half_open';

type Bucket = {
  state: State;
  failures: number;
  openedAt: number;
  halfOpenProbes: number;
};

const buckets = new Map<string, Bucket>();

const DEFAULTS = {
  failureThreshold: 5,
  openMs: 30_000,
  halfOpenMax: 2,
};

export function circuitAllow(name: string, opts = DEFAULTS): boolean {
  const b = buckets.get(name);
  if (!b || b.state === 'closed') return true;
  const now = Date.now();
  if (b.state === 'open') {
    if (now - b.openedAt >= opts.openMs) {
      b.state = 'half_open';
      b.halfOpenProbes = 0;
      buckets.set(name, b);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  // half_open
  if (b.halfOpenProbes >= opts.halfOpenMax) return false;
  b.halfOpenProbes += 1;
  buckets.set(name, b);
  return true;
}

export function circuitSuccess(name: string): void {
  buckets.set(name, { state: 'closed', failures: 0, openedAt: 0, halfOpenProbes: 0 });
}

export function circuitFailure(name: string, opts = DEFAULTS): void {
  const b = buckets.get(name) || { state: 'closed' as State, failures: 0, openedAt: 0, halfOpenProbes: 0 };
  b.failures += 1;
  if (b.state === 'half_open' || b.failures >= opts.failureThreshold) {
    b.state = 'open';
    b.openedAt = Date.now();
    b.failures = 0;
  }
  buckets.set(name, b);
}

export function circuitStatus(name: string): State {
  return buckets.get(name)?.state || 'closed';
}

import { addColumnIfMissing } from './schema';

const _localSchemaOnce = new Set<string>();
/** Client schema helpers — shared by routes/clients and invoice credit checks */

export async function ensureClientTaxExempt(db: D1Database) {
  if (_localSchemaOnce.has('ensureClientTaxExempt')) return;

  await addColumnIfMissing(db, 'clients', 'tax_exempt', 'INTEGER DEFAULT 0');

  _localSchemaOnce.add('ensureClientTaxExempt');
}

/** Max outstanding credit in currency units; 0 or null = unlimited */
export async function ensureClientCreditLimit(db: D1Database) {
  if (_localSchemaOnce.has('ensureClientCreditLimit')) return;

  await addColumnIfMissing(db, 'clients', 'credit_limit', 'REAL DEFAULT 0');

  _localSchemaOnce.add('ensureClientCreditLimit');
}

/**
 * Outstanding balance for a client (open invoices only).
 * Returns { outstanding, limit, ok, message }
 */
export async function checkClientCreditLimit(
  db: D1Database,
  opts: { clientId?: number | null; clientName?: string; clientIce?: string; addAmount: number },
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; outstanding: number; limit: number; message?: string }> {
  await ensureClientCreditLimit(db);
  let client: any = null;
  if (opts.clientId) {
    client = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?`).bind(opts.clientId).first();
  }
  if (!client && opts.clientIce) {
    client = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE ice = ?`).bind(opts.clientIce).first();
  }
  if (!client && opts.clientName) {
    client = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE lower(name) = lower(?)`).bind(opts.clientName).first();
  }
  if (!client) {
    return { ok: true, outstanding: 0, limit: 0 };
  }
  const limit = Number(client.credit_limit || 0);
  if (!limit || limit <= 0) {
    return { ok: true, outstanding: 0, limit: 0 };
  }
  let row: any;
  if (client.ice) {
    row = await db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total - COALESCE(amount_paid, 0)), 0) as due
       FROM invoices
       WHERE status NOT IN ('quote','devis','cancelled','paid')
         AND (client_id = ? OR client_ice = ? OR lower(client_name) = lower(?))`,
      )
      .bind(client.id, client.ice, client.name)
      .first();
  } else {
    row = await db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total - COALESCE(amount_paid, 0)), 0) as due
       FROM invoices
       WHERE status NOT IN ('quote','devis','cancelled','paid')
         AND (client_id = ? OR lower(client_name) = lower(?))`,
      )
      .bind(client.id, client.name)
      .first();
  }
  const outstanding = Number(row?.due || 0);
  const projected = outstanding + Number(opts.addAmount || 0);
  if (projected > limit + 0.001) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      outstanding,
      limit,
      message: `Limite de crédit dépassée pour ${client.name}: en cours ${outstanding} + cette facture ${(opts.addAmount || 0)} = ${projected} (plafond ${limit}).`,
    };
  }
  return { ok: true, outstanding, limit };
}

/**
 * Coordinated delete: D1 rows + R2 objects + KV cache invalidation.
 */
import { invalidateDashboardCache } from './cache';
import { keyFromCdnUrl, deleteR2Object } from './r2';

export async function deleteProductImagesFromR2(
  db: D1Database,
  images: R2Bucket | undefined,
  env: { CDN_BASE?: string },
  productId: string | number
): Promise<number> {
  let n = 0;
  try {
    const { results } = await db
      .prepare(`SELECT id, url FROM product_images WHERE product_id = ?`)
      .bind(productId)
      .all();
    for (const row of (results || []) as any[]) {
      const key = keyFromCdnUrl(env, String(row.url || ''));
      if (key) {
        await deleteR2Object(images, key);
        n++;
      }
    }
    await db.prepare(`DELETE FROM product_images WHERE product_id = ?`).bind(productId).run();
  } catch {
    /* best-effort */
  }
  // Also remove product.image_url object if CDN
  try {
    const p = await db.prepare(`SELECT image_url FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(productId).first() as any;
    if (p?.image_url) {
      const key = keyFromCdnUrl(env, String(p.image_url));
      if (key) {
        await deleteR2Object(images, key);
        n++;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
  return n;
}

export async function afterBusinessMutation(kv: KVNamespace | undefined): Promise<void> {
  await invalidateDashboardCache(kv);
}

/** List R2 objects under a prefix (for admin inventory / catalog of stored files). */
export async function listR2Prefix(
  bucket: R2Bucket | undefined,
  prefix: string,
  limit = 50
): Promise<{ key: string; size: number; uploaded: string }[]> {
  if (!bucket) return [];
  try {
    const listed = await bucket.list({ prefix, limit: Math.min(1000, limit) });
    return (listed.objects || []).map((o) => ({
      key: o.key,
      size: o.size,
      uploaded: o.uploaded?.toISOString?.() || String(o.uploaded || ''),
    }));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * v0.7 — stable server error messages in the three app languages.
 *
 * The Android app (and the web SPA) surface `error` strings to users. Until
 * now every stable message was French-only. Messages are picked from an
 * allowlist keyed by Accept-Language (OkHttp sends the device/app locale);
 * machine-readable `code` values are unchanged so existing clients keep
 * working. Unknown/absent header → French (historical default).
 */
export type UiLang = 'fr' | 'en' | 'ar';

const MESSAGES = {
  auth_required: {
    fr: 'Authentification requise.',
    en: 'Authentication required.',
    ar: 'المصادقة مطلوبة.',
  },
  message_empty: {
    fr: 'Message vide.',
    en: 'Empty message.',
    ar: 'الرسالة فارغة.',
  },
  agent_no_key: {
    fr: 'Assistant IA non configuré. Secret GROQ_API_KEY manquant.',
    en: 'AI assistant not configured. Missing GROQ_API_KEY secret.',
    ar: 'مساعد الذكاء الاصطناعي غير مهيأ. مفتاح GROQ_API_KEY مفقود.',
  },
  agent_upstream: {
    fr: 'Échec Atlas Agent',
    en: 'Atlas Agent request failed',
    ar: 'فشل طلب مساعد Atlas',
  },
  update_required: {
    fr: "Cette version de l'application Android n'est plus supportée. Mettez à jour pour continuer.",
    en: 'This Android app version is no longer supported. Please update to continue.',
    ar: 'هذا الإصدار من تطبيق Android لم يعد مدعومًا. يرجى التحديث للمتابعة.',
  },
  token_required: {
    fr: 'token requis',
    en: 'token required',
    ar: 'الرمز مطلوب',
  },
  token_store_error: {
    fr: 'Enregistrement du token impossible pour le moment.',
    en: 'Unable to register the token right now.',
    ar: 'تعذر تسجيل الرمز حاليًا.',
  },
} as const;

export type UiMessageKey = keyof typeof MESSAGES;

/**
 * Allowlist parse of Accept-Language, honoring q-values
 * ("ar-SA,ar;q=0.9,en;q=0.8" → ar). Anything outside fr/en/ar → 'fr'.
 */
export function pickUiLang(acceptLanguage?: string | null): UiLang {
  const raw = String(acceptLanguage || '');
  const scored: { tag: string; q: number }[] = [];
  for (const part of raw.split(',')) {
    const [tagPart, ...params] = part.split(';');
    const tag = String(tagPart || '').trim().toLowerCase().split('-')[0];
    if (!tag) continue;
    let q = 1;
    for (const prm of params) {
      const m = String(prm || '').trim().match(/^q=([0-9.]+)$/i);
      if (m) q = Number(m[1]);
    }
    if (Number.isFinite(q)) scored.push({ tag, q });
  }
  scored.sort((a, b) => b.q - a.q);
  for (const { tag } of scored) {
    if (tag === 'ar') return 'ar';
    if (tag === 'en') return 'en';
    if (tag === 'fr') return 'fr';
  }
  return 'fr';
}

/** Localized stable message. Never interpolates caller input. */
export function tr(lang: UiLang, key: UiMessageKey): string {
  return MESSAGES[key][lang];
}

/**
 * Safe application errors — never leak SQL / D1 / stack traces to clients.
 */

export type ErrorCode =
  | 'BAD_REQUEST'
  | 'UNAUTHORIZED'
  | 'FORBIDDEN'
  | 'NOT_FOUND'
  | 'CONFLICT'
  | 'RATE_LIMITED'
  | 'VALIDATION'
  | 'INTERNAL'
  | 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'
  | 'DB_CORRUPT'
  | 'TIMEOUT';

const STATUS: Record<ErrorCode, number> = {
  BAD_REQUEST: 400,
  UNAUTHORIZED: 401,
  FORBIDDEN: 403,
  NOT_FOUND: 404,
  CONFLICT: 409,
  RATE_LIMITED: 429,
  VALIDATION: 422,
  INTERNAL: 500,
  SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: 503,
  DB_CORRUPT: 503,
  TIMEOUT: 504,
};

/** User-facing French messages — never include raw DB text. */
const SAFE_DEFAULTS: Record<ErrorCode, string> = {
  BAD_REQUEST: 'Requête invalide',
  UNAUTHORIZED: 'Session invalide ou expirée',
  FORBIDDEN: 'Action non autorisée',
  NOT_FOUND: 'Ressource introuvable',
  CONFLICT: 'Conflit de données',
  RATE_LIMITED: 'Trop de requêtes — réessayez plus tard',
  VALIDATION: 'Données invalides',
  INTERNAL: 'Erreur interne — réessayez plus tard',
  SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: 'Service temporairement indisponible',
  DB_CORRUPT: 'Base de données D1 corrompue (SQLITE_CORRUPT) — aucune écriture n’est possible tant qu’une restauration Cloudflare (TimeTravel / backup) n’a pas été faite. Contactez l’administrateur puis réessayez.',
  TIMEOUT: 'Délai dépassé — réessayez',
};

export class AppError extends Error {
  readonly code: ErrorCode;
  readonly status: number;
  readonly details?: unknown;
  readonly expose: boolean;

  constructor(code: ErrorCode, message?: string, details?: unknown) {
    super(message || SAFE_DEFAULTS[code]);
    this.name = 'AppError';
    this.code = code;
    this.status = STATUS[code] ?? 500;
    this.details = details;
    this.expose = code !== 'INTERNAL';
  }
}

/** Physical D1/SQLite corruption — storage-level, needs a restore, not a retry. */
const DB_CORRUPT_RE = /SQLITE_CORRUPT|database disk image is malformed/i;

const DB_LEAK_RE =
  /\b(SQLITE_|D1_|SQLSTATE|near\s+"|syntax error|UNIQUE constraint|FOREIGN KEY|no such table|no such column|constraint failed|database is locked|disk i\/o error)\b/i;

/**
 * Convert any thrown value into a client-safe payload.
 * Raw database / driver messages are replaced with a generic INTERNAL message.
 */
export function toClientError(err: unknown): {
  status: number;
  code: ErrorCode;
  error: string;
  details?: unknown;
} {
  if (err instanceof AppError) {
    const msg = DB_LEAK_RE.test(err.message) ? SAFE_DEFAULTS[err.code] : err.message;
    return {
      status: err.status,
      code: err.code,
      error: msg,
      details: err.expose ? err.details : undefined,
    };
  }

  if (err instanceof Error) {
    const name = err.name || '';
    const msg = err.message || '';

    if (name === 'AbortError' || /aborted|timeout|timed out/i.test(msg)) {
      return { status: 504, code: 'TIMEOUT', error: SAFE_DEFAULTS.TIMEOUT };
    }

    if (DB_CORRUPT_RE.test(msg)) {
      console.error('[db-corrupt]', msg.slice(0, 400));
      return { status: 503, code: 'DB_CORRUPT', error: SAFE_DEFAULTS.DB_CORRUPT };
    }

    if (DB_LEAK_RE.test(msg) || /D1_|prepare\(|\.bind\(/i.test(msg)) {
      console.error('[db-error]', msg.slice(0, 400));
      return { status: 500, code: 'INTERNAL', error: SAFE_DEFAULTS.INTERNAL };
    }

    // Unknown Error — log server-side, generic client message
    console.error('[unhandled]', name, msg.slice(0, 400));
    return { status: 500, code: 'INTERNAL', error: SAFE_DEFAULTS.INTERNAL };
  }

  console.error('[unhandled-nonerror]', String(err).slice(0, 200));
  return { status: 500, code: 'INTERNAL', error: SAFE_DEFAULTS.INTERNAL };
}

/** Guard: true if a string looks like a leaked DB / SQL error. */
export function looksLikeDbError(message: string): boolean {
  return DB_LEAK_RE.test(message || '');
}
