import { fetchWithTimeout } from './http-client';

/** Schema readiness is per D1 binding, not shared across databases. */
let pushSchemaReady = new WeakSet<object>();

/** Test-only: clears schema readiness between in-process DBs. */
export function resetLocalSchemaOnceForTests(): void {
  pushSchemaReady = new WeakSet<object>();
}

/**
 * FCM HTTP v1 dispatcher for Cloudflare Workers.
 * Secrets (wrangler secret put):
 *   FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
 *   FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL
 *   FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY   (PEM, newlines as \n)
 *
 * Legacy fallback: FCM_SERVER_KEY (deprecated legacy HTTP API).
 */

export type FcmEnv = {
  DB: D1Database;
  FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID?: string;
  FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL?: string;
  FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY?: string;
  FCM_SERVER_KEY?: string;
  FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY?: string;
  CACHE?: KVNamespace;
};

export type FcmDataPayload = Record<string, string>;

type PushRow = { token: string; username?: string; platform?: string };

function pemToArrayBuffer(pem: string): ArrayBuffer {
  const b64 = pem
    .replace(/-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----/g, '')
    .replace(/-----END PRIVATE KEY-----/g, '')
    .replace(/\\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '');
  const raw = atob(b64);
  const buf = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) buf[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
  return buf.buffer;
}

function b64url(data: ArrayBuffer | string): string {
  let bytes: Uint8Array;
  if (typeof data === 'string') {
    bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(data);
  } else {
    bytes = new Uint8Array(data);
  }
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) s += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  return btoa(s).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/g, '');
}

async function getGoogleAccessToken(env: FcmEnv): Promise<string | null> {
  const email = String(env.FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL || '').trim();
  const keyPem = String(env.FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY || '').trim();
  if (!email || !keyPem) return null;

  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const header = b64url(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT' }));
  const claim = b64url(
    JSON.stringify({
      iss: email,
      sub: email,
      aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
      iat: now,
      exp: now + 3600,
      scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/firebase.messaging',
    }),
  );
  const unsigned = `${header}.${claim}`;

  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'pkcs8',
    pemToArrayBuffer(keyPem),
    { name: 'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    false,
    ['sign'],
  );
  const sig = await crypto.subtle.sign(
    'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5',
    key,
    new TextEncoder().encode(unsigned),
  );
  const jwt = `${unsigned}.${b64url(sig)}`;

  const res = await fetchWithTimeout('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
    body: new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
      assertion: jwt,
    }),
  });
  const data: any = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!res.ok || !data.access_token) {
    // OAuth responses can contain sensitive diagnostic text. Never log the body.
    console.error('[fcm-oauth]', { http_status: res.status, outcome: 'rejected' });
    return null;
  }
  return String(data.access_token);
}

async function ensurePushTable(db: D1Database) {
  if (pushSchemaReady.has(db)) return;

  await db
    .prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS device_push_tokens (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        username TEXT NOT NULL,
        token TEXT NOT NULL,
        platform TEXT DEFAULT 'android',
        updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
        UNIQUE(username, token)
      )`,
    )
    .run();

  pushSchemaReady.add(db);
}

/** Upsert FCM registration token for a user. */
export async function upsertDeviceToken(
  db: D1Database,
  username: string,
  token: string,
  platform = 'android',
): Promise<void> {
  await ensurePushTable(db);
  await db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO device_push_tokens (username, token, platform, updated_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
       ON CONFLICT(username, token) DO UPDATE SET
         updated_at = datetime('now'),
         platform = excluded.platform`,
    )
    .bind(username, token, platform)
    .run();
}

export async function deleteDeviceToken(db: D1Database, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const result = await db.prepare(`DELETE FROM device_push_tokens WHERE token = ?`).bind(token).run();
    return Number(result.meta?.changes || 0) > 0;
  } catch {
    console.error('[fcm-token]', { outcome: 'purge_failed' });
    return false;
  }
}

export async function listDeviceTokens(
  db: D1Database,
  username: string,
  platform = 'android',
  limit = 5,
): Promise<PushRow[]> {
  await ensurePushTable(db);
  const rows = await db
    .prepare(
      `SELECT token, platform FROM device_push_tokens
       WHERE username = ? AND platform = ?
       ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?`,
    )
    .bind(username, platform, limit)
    .all();
  return (rows?.results || []) as PushRow[];
}

/** Firebase tokens are opaque: neither their project nor their freshness can
 * be inferred from their string. Only an explicitly typed FCM error permits
 * deletion. HTTP 404 / NOT_FOUND alone can also mean a bad project or URL. */
const FCM_ERROR_TYPE = 'type.googleapis.com/google.firebase.fcm.v1.FcmError';
const FCM_CODES = new Set(['UNSPECIFIED_ERROR', 'INVALID_ARGUMENT', 'UNREGISTERED', 'SENDER_ID_MISMATCH', 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED', 'APNS_AUTH_ERROR', 'THIRD_PARTY_AUTH_ERROR', 'UNAVAILABLE', 'INTERNAL']);
const RPC_CODES = new Set(['OK', 'INVALID_ARGUMENT', 'NOT_FOUND', 'PERMISSION_DENIED', 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED', 'UNAVAILABLE', 'INTERNAL', 'DEADLINE_EXCEEDED', 'FAILED_PRECONDITION', 'UNKNOWN']);

function responseCodes(body: any): { status: string; fcm_codes: string[] } {
  const status = RPC_CODES.has(body?.error?.status) ? body.error.status : 'UNKNOWN';
  const details = Array.isArray(body?.error?.details) ? body.error.details : [];
  const codes: string[] = details
    .filter((d: any) => d?.['@type'] === FCM_ERROR_TYPE && FCM_CODES.has(d?.errorCode))
    .map((d: any) => d.errorCode);
  return { status, fcm_codes: [...new Set(codes)] };
}

/** Accept only the expected resource shape; never log arbitrary response text. */
function acceptedMessageId(body: any, project: string): string | null {
  const prefix = `projects/${project}/messages/`;
  if (typeof body?.name !== 'string' || !body.name.startsWith(prefix)) return null;
  const id = body.name.slice(prefix.length);
  return /^[A-Za-z0-9_:%.~-]{1,256}$/.test(id) ? id : null;
}

/** `sent` means accepted by FCM, NOT displayed or delivered to Android.
 * Only an explicit UNREGISTERED (legacy: NotRegistered) permits purging. */
export async function sendFcmToUser(
  env: FcmEnv,
  username: string,
  opts: {
    title: string;
    body: string;
    data?: FcmDataPayload;
    platform?: string;
    /** HIGH for time-sensitive, user-visible alerts; NORMAL for nonurgent work. */
    priority?: 'HIGH' | 'NORMAL';
  },
): Promise<{ sent: number; purged: number }> {
  const title = String(opts.title || '').trim();
  const body = String(opts.body || '').trim();
  if (!title || !body) {
    console.error('[fcm-send]', { outcome: 'invalid_notification' });
    return { sent: 0, purged: 0 };
  }
  const tokens = await listDeviceTokens(env.DB, username, opts.platform || 'android');
  if (!tokens.length) return { sent: 0, purged: 0 };

  const projectId = String(env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID || '').trim();
  let accessToken: string | null = null;
  if (projectId) {
    try { accessToken = await getGoogleAccessToken(env); }
    catch { console.error('[fcm-oauth]', { outcome: 'unavailable' }); }
    // Do not silently switch projects/transports after a configured v1 failure.
    if (!accessToken) {
      console.error('[fcm-send]', { transport: 'v1', outcome: 'credentials_unavailable' });
      return { sent: 0, purged: 0 };
    }
  }
  const legacyKey = env.FCM_SERVER_KEY || env.FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY;
  if (!projectId && !legacyKey) {
    console.error('[fcm-send]', { outcome: 'not_configured' });
    return { sent: 0, purged: 0 };
  }
  const priority = opts.priority || 'HIGH';
  const data = {
    ...opts.data,
    event: opts.data?.event?.trim() || opts.data?.type?.trim() || opts.data?.kind?.trim() || 'atlas_notification',
    click_action: 'ATLAS_ASSIST_APPROVAL',
  };
  let sent = 0;
  let purged = 0;

  for (const row of tokens) {
    const token = String(row.token || '');
    if (!token) continue;
    const transport = projectId ? 'v1' : 'legacy';
    try {
      if (projectId && accessToken) {
        const res = await fetchWithTimeout(
          `https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/messages:send`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              message: {
                token,
                notification: { title, body },
                data,
                android: {
                  priority,
                  notification: { channel_id: 'atlas_assist', click_action: 'ATLAS_ASSIST_APPROVAL' },
                },
              },
            }),
          },
        );
        // Inspect every response, including 2xx. A status alone is not an ack.
        const reply: any = await res.json().catch(() => null);
        const messageId = res.ok ? acceptedMessageId(reply, projectId) : null;
        if (res.ok && messageId) {
          sent++;
          console.info('[fcm-send]', { transport, http_status: res.status, status: 'OK', outcome: 'accepted', message_id: messageId });
          continue;
        }
        const codes = responseCodes(reply);
        const unregistered = !res.ok && codes.fcm_codes.includes('UNREGISTERED');
        console.warn('[fcm-send]', { transport, http_status: res.status, ...codes, outcome: unregistered ? 'unregistered' : res.ok ? 'invalid_response' : 'rejected' });
        if (unregistered && await deleteDeviceToken(env.DB, token)) purged++;
        continue;
      }

      // Compatibility only for deployments explicitly configured for legacy.
      // Parse its per-recipient result too: HTTP 200 can contain a send error.
      const res = await fetchWithTimeout('https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { Authorization: `key=${legacyKey}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          to: token,
          priority: priority.toLowerCase(),
          notification: { title, body, sound: 'default', android_channel_id: 'atlas_assist', click_action: 'ATLAS_ASSIST_APPROVAL' },
          data,
        }),
      });
      const reply: any = await res.json().catch(() => null);
      const result = reply?.results?.[0];
      const id = result?.message_id ?? reply?.message_id;
      const messageId = typeof id === 'string' || typeof id === 'number' ? String(id) : '';
      const unregistered = result?.error === 'NotRegistered';
      if (res.ok && !result?.error && /^[A-Za-z0-9_:%.~-]{1,256}$/.test(messageId)) {
        sent++;
        console.info('[fcm-send]', { transport, http_status: res.status, outcome: 'accepted', message_id: messageId });
      } else {
        console.warn('[fcm-send]', { transport, http_status: res.status, outcome: unregistered ? 'unregistered' : 'rejected' });
        if (unregistered && await deleteDeviceToken(env.DB, token)) purged++;
      }
    } catch {
      // Exception messages/response bodies may echo a token or credential.
      console.error('[fcm-send]', { transport, outcome: 'network_or_response_failure' });
      // Continue with the other registered devices; never purge on a timeout.
    }
  }
  return { sent, purged };
}

/** Convenience for assist approval / proposal flows */
export async function notifyAssistApproval(
  env: FcmEnv,
  username: string,
  title: string,
  body: string,
  data?: FcmDataPayload,
) {
  return sendFcmToUser(env, username, {
    title,
    body,
    data: { ...data, event: data?.event || 'assist_approval' },
  });
}


/** Notify every registered device (owners / warehouse). Used for low stock. */
export async function sendFcmToAllDevices(
  env: FcmEnv,
  opts: { title: string; body: string; data?: FcmDataPayload },
): Promise<{ sent: number; purged: number }> {
  try {
    await env.DB.prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS push_tokens (
        token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        username TEXT,
        platform TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
      )`,
    ).run();
  } catch { /* */ }
  const rows = await env.DB.prepare(
    `SELECT DISTINCT token, username, platform FROM push_tokens ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 80`,
  ).all();
  const list = (rows?.results || []) as PushRow[];
  let sent = 0;
  let purged = 0;
  for (const row of list) {
    const user = String(row.username || '').trim();
    if (!user) continue;
    const r = await sendFcmToUser(env, user, {
      title: opts.title,
      body: opts.body,
      data: opts.data,
      platform: row.platform || 'android',
    });
    sent += r.sent;
    purged += r.purged;
  }
  return { sent, purged };
}

export async function notifyLowStock(
  env: FcmEnv,
  product: { id: number; name?: string; sku?: string; stock?: number; threshold?: number },
) {
  const name = product.name || `Produit #${product.id}`;
  const qty = product.stock ?? 0;
  const th = product.threshold ?? 0;
  const title = qty <= 0 ? 'Rupture de stock' : 'Stock bas';
  const body =
    qty <= 0
      ? `${name} est en rupture.`
      : `${name} : ${qty} restant(s) (seuil ${th}).`;
  return sendFcmToAllDevices(env, {
    title,
    body,
    data: {
      type: 'low_stock',
      product_id: String(product.id),
      stock: String(qty),
    },
  });
}

/**
import { fetchWithTimeout } from './http-client';
 * Atlas Agent — Gemini generateContent path.
 *
 * Auth: header x-goog-api-key (required for current Gemini / auth keys).
 * Docs: finishReason MAX_TOKENS = response cut by maxOutputTokens;
 *       STOP = natural end. We set a high token budget and continue once if truncated.
 */

const DEFAULT_MODELS = [
  'gemini-flash-latest',
  'gemini-2.5-flash',
  'gemini-3.6-flash',
  'gemini-3.8-flash',
  'gemini-1.5-flash-latest',
  'gemini-1.5-flash',
];

export async function geminiSimpleChat(opts: {
  apiKey: string;
  model?: string;
  system: string;
  message: string;
  maxTokens?: number;
}): Promise<{ reply: string; model: string }> {
  const preferred = (opts.model || '').trim();
  const candidates = [preferred, ...DEFAULT_MODELS].filter(
    (m, i, a) => !!m && a.indexOf(m) === i,
  ) as string[];

  // Full sentences need room; ~4 chars/token → 1024 tokens ≈ long paragraph
  const maxTok = Math.max(256, Math.min(opts.maxTokens ?? 1024, 2048));
  let lastErr = 'Atlas Agent indisponible.';

  for (const model of candidates) {
    try {
      const text = await callWithContinuation(
        opts.apiKey,
        model,
        opts.system,
        opts.message,
        maxTok,
      );
      if (text) return { reply: scrubVendorNames(text), model };
      lastErr = "Atlas Agent n'a pas pu répondre. Réessayez.";
    } catch (e: any) {
      const msg = String(e?.message || e);
      if (msg.startsWith('HTTP_404')) {
        lastErr = msg;
        continue;
      }
      if (msg.startsWith('HTTP_429')) {
        throw new Error('Atlas Agent est temporairement saturé. Réessayez dans une minute.');
      }
      if (msg.startsWith('HTTP_401') || msg.startsWith('HTTP_403')) {
        throw new Error(
          'Atlas Agent: clé refusée. Créez une clé Auth (AI Studio), puis: npx wrangler secret put GEMINI_API_KEY',
        );
      }
      lastErr = msg.replace(/^HTTP_\d+:\s*/, '') || lastErr;
      continue;
    }
  }

  throw new Error(
    lastErr.includes('404')
      ? 'Atlas Agent: modèle inaccessible. Définissez GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-flash-latest ou définissez GROQ_API_KEY.'
      : lastErr,
  );
}

type GenResult = { text: string; finishReason: string };

async function generateOnce(
  apiKey: string,
  model: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<GenResult> {
  const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${encodeURIComponent(model)}:generateContent`;
  const res = await fetchWithTimeout(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'x-goog-api-key': apiKey,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const raw = await res.text().catch(() => '');
  if (res.status === 404) throw new Error(`HTTP_404:${raw.slice(0, 120)}`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP_${res.status}:${raw.slice(0, 180)}`);

  let data: any = {};
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Réponse API illisible');
  }

  const cand = data?.candidates?.[0];
  const finishReason = String(cand?.finishReason || data?.promptFeedback?.blockReason || '');
  const parts = cand?.content?.parts || [];
  const text = parts
    .map((p: any) => p?.text || '')
    .join('')
    .trim();
  return { text, finishReason };
}

async function callWithContinuation(
  apiKey: string,
  model: string,
  system: string,
  message: string,
  maxTokens: number,
): Promise<string> {
  const baseBody = {
    systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: system }] },
    contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: message }] }],
    generationConfig: {
      temperature: 0.35,
      maxOutputTokens: maxTokens,
      candidateCount: 1,
    },
  };

  let { text, finishReason } = await generateOnce(apiKey, model, baseBody);

  // If empty, retry without systemInstruction (compat)
  if (!text) {
    const retry = await generateOnce(apiKey, model, {
      contents: [
        {
          role: 'user',
          parts: [
            {
              text: `${system}\n\nMessage utilisateur:\n${message}\n\nRéponds en français, phrases complètes.`,
            },
          ],
        },
      ],
      generationConfig: {
        temperature: 0.35,
        maxOutputTokens: maxTokens,
        candidateCount: 1,
      },
    });
    text = retry.text;
    finishReason = retry.finishReason;
  }

  // MAX_TOKENS = hard cut mid-reply — ask model to finish once
  if (text && /MAX_TOKENS/i.test(finishReason)) {
    try {
      const cont = await generateOnce(apiKey, model, {
        systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: system }] },
        contents: [
          { role: 'user', parts: [{ text: message }] },
          { role: 'model', parts: [{ text }] },
          {
            role: 'user',
            parts: [
              {
                text: 'Continue exactement où tu t’es arrêté. Termine la phrase en français, sans recommencer.',
              },
            ],
          },
        ],
        generationConfig: {
          temperature: 0.3,
          maxOutputTokens: Math.min(512, maxTokens),
          candidateCount: 1,
        },
      });
      if (cont.text) {
        // append if continuation doesn't already include the start
        const extra = cont.text.trim();
        if (extra && !text.endsWith(extra)) {
          text = `${text}${/^\s/.test(extra) || /[.!?…]$/.test(text) ? '' : ' '}${extra}`.trim();
        }
      }
    } catch {
      /* keep partial text rather than fail */
    }
  }

  return cleanModelEcho(text);
}

function cleanModelEcho(s: string): string {
  let t = String(s || '').trim();
  t = t.replace(/^(NO introductory phrases|No introductory phrases)[.\s]*/i, '');
  t = t.replace(/^(System:|Instructions?:|Règles?:)\s*/i, '');
  return t.trim();
}

export function scrubVendorNames(s: string): string {
  return String(s || '')
    .replace(/\b(Google|Gemini|Mistral|OpenAI|ChatGPT|Claude|Anthropic|Grok)\b/gi, 'Atlas Agent')
    .replace(/\bLLM\b/gi, 'assistant')
    .trim();
}

/** v0.7 — client-selectable agent response languages (Android app language). */
export type AgentResponseLanguage = 'fr' | 'en' | 'ar';

/**
 * Allowlist for the `response_language` body field. Returns null when the
 * value is absent or outside the allowlist → the legacy rule applies
 * (answer in the user's language, French default). Values are never echoed
 * into the prompt — only the allowlisted directive is.
 */
export function normalizeResponseLanguage(value: unknown): AgentResponseLanguage | null {
  const raw = String(value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 32).split('-')[0];
  if (!raw) return null;
  if (raw === 'fr' || raw === 'french' || raw === 'francais') return 'fr';
  if (raw === 'en' || raw === 'english' || raw === 'anglais') return 'en';
  if (raw === 'ar' || raw === 'arabic' || raw === 'arabe') return 'ar';
  return null;
}

/** Hard language directive for the system prompt (overrides the French context). */
function languageDirective(lang: AgentResponseLanguage | null): string {
  if (lang === 'en') {
    return 'LANGUAGE (HARD RULE, overrides everything below and any other language in this prompt or the history): ALWAYS answer in English. Complete sentences.';
  }
  if (lang === 'ar') {
    return 'LANGUAGE (HARD RULE, overrides everything below and any other language in this prompt or the history): ALWAYS answer in Modern Standard Arabic. اللغة (قاعدة صارمة): أجب دائمًا بالعربية الفصحى، بجمل كاملة.';
  }
  if (lang === 'fr') {
    return 'Langue (RÈGLE STRICTE, prioritaire sur tout le reste): réponds TOUJOURS en français, même si la question est dans une autre langue. Phrases complètes.';
  }
  return 'Langue: réponds dans la langue de l’utilisateur (français par défaut). Phrases complètes.';
}

/** Concise by instruction; language follows the client-selected `response_language`. */
export function atlasAgentSystem(opts: {
  role: string;
  username: string;
  timezone?: string;
  source?: string;
  responseLanguage?: AgentResponseLanguage | string | null;
}): string {
  const lang = normalizeResponseLanguage(opts.responseLanguage);
  const isMobile = ['android', 'ios', 'mobile', 'capacitor'].includes(
    (opts.source || '').toLowerCase(),
  );
  return [
    'Tu es Atlas Agent, assistant intelligent d’Atlas Commerce (ERP stock, facturation, Maroc, MAD).',
    'Tu peux discuter librement: identité, explications, culture générale, conseils — pas seulement le stock.',
    'Si on te demande qui tu es: présente-toi clairement comme Atlas Agent (assistant Atlas Commerce).',
    languageDirective(lang),
    'Sois utile et naturel. Pour le métier: sois précis (chiffres, actions concrètes).',
    'Évite le jargon vendeur IA (ne dis pas que tu es Gemini, Mistral, Groq, Llama, ChatGPT).',
    'Si l’utilisateur est déjà sur une page, explique quoi y faire — n’ouvre pas cette même page.',
    `Rôle utilisateur: ${opts.role || 'user'} (${opts.username || 'user'}). Fuseau: ${opts.timezone || 'Africa/Casablanca'}.`,
    isMobile ? 'Mobile: réponses un peu plus courtes.' : '',
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' ');
}

import { upstreamFetch } from './upstream';

/**
 * Groq free-tier — OpenAI-compatible.
 * https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions
 */

const MODELS = [
  'openai/gpt-oss-20b',
  'openai/gpt-oss-120b',
  'llama-3.3-70b-versatile',
  'llama-3.1-8b-instant',
];

/* v232 — vision-capable Groq models, tried first when images are attached */
/* v234 — Groq docs (console.groq.com/docs/vision): qwen3.8-27b + llama-4-scout are the
   current vision models; llama-3.2-*-vision-preview was deprecated 2025-04-14.
   Data-URL base64 images allowed, ≤4 MB per image, ≤5 images per request. */
const VISION_MODELS = [
  'qwen/qwen3.8-27b',
  'meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct',
];

export async function groqChat(opts: {
  apiKey: string;
  model?: string;
  system: string;
  message: string;
  maxTokens?: number;
  images?: string[];
}): Promise<{ reply: string; model: string; usage?: { prompt: number; completion: number } }> {
  const preferred = (opts.model || '').trim();
  const images = (opts.images || []).filter((u) => typeof u === 'string' && u.startsWith('data:image/') && u.length <= 3_500_000).slice(0, 4);
  const maxTokens = Math.max(64, Math.min(opts.maxTokens ?? 1024, 4096));
  let lastStatus = 0;
  let lastBody = '';
  let activeImages = images;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < (images.length ? 2 : 1); attempt++) {
    if (attempt === 1) activeImages = []; // vision failed everywhere → answer without images
    const base = activeImages.length ? [...VISION_MODELS, ...MODELS] : MODELS;
    const models = [preferred, ...base].filter((m, i, a) => !!m && a.indexOf(m) === i);
    for (const model of models) {
    const res = await upstreamFetch('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${opts.apiKey}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model,
        temperature: 0.55,
        max_tokens: maxTokens,
        messages: [
          { role: 'system', content: opts.system },
          activeImages.length
            ? {
                role: 'user',
                content: [
                  { type: 'text', text: opts.message },
                  ...activeImages.map((url) => ({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url } })),
                ],
              }
            : { role: 'user', content: opts.message },
        ],
      }),
    }, { timeoutMs: 20000, retries: 2, label: 'groq' });

    const raw = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    lastStatus = res.status;
    lastBody = raw.slice(0, 240);

    if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
      throw new Error('Atlas Agent: clé Groq refusée. Vérifiez GROQ_API_KEY (console.groq.com).');
    }
    if (res.status === 429) {
      throw new Error('Quota Groq atteint. Réessayez dans quelques minutes.');
    }
    // 404 = bad model id → try next
    if (res.status === 404 || res.status === 400) {
      continue;
    }
    if (!res.ok) continue;

    let data: any = {};
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    let text = String(data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '').trim();
    if (!text) continue;
    text = text
      .replace(/\b(Google|Gemini|Mistral|OpenAI|ChatGPT|Claude|Groq|Llama|Meta)\b/gi, 'Atlas Agent')
      .trim();
    return {
      reply: text,
      model: String(data?.model || model),
      usage: {
        prompt: Number(data?.usage?.prompt_tokens || 0),
        completion: Number(data?.usage?.completion_tokens || 0),
      },
    };
    }
  }

  if (lastStatus === 401 || lastStatus === 403) {
    throw new Error('Atlas Agent: clé Groq refusée. Vérifiez GROQ_API_KEY.');
  }
  if (lastStatus === 404) {
    throw new Error('Modèle Groq introuvable. Définissez GROQ_MODEL=openai/gpt-oss-20b');
  }
  throw new Error(
    lastStatus
      ? `Atlas Agent indisponible (HTTP ${lastStatus}).`
      : 'Atlas Agent indisponible (Groq).',
  );
}

/* ─────────────────────── boucle d'outils (v0.7.7) ───────────────────────

    if (!res.ok) {
      // modèle sans support outils ? → repli sans outils
      const fallback = await groqChat({
        apiKey: opts.apiKey,
        model: opts.model,
        system: opts.system,
        message: opts.message,
        maxTokens,
      });
      return { ...fallback, tool_trace: trace };
    }
    promptTokens += Number(data?.usage?.prompt_tokens || 0);
    completionTokens += Number(data?.usage?.completion_tokens || 0);
    lastModel = String(data?.model || opts.model || MODELS[0]);
    const msg = data?.choices?.[0]?.message || {};
    const calls: any[] = Array.isArray(msg.tool_calls) ? msg.tool_calls.slice(0, 4) : [];
    if (!calls.length) {
      const text = String(msg.content || '')
        .trim()
        .replace(/\b(Google|Gemini|Mistral|OpenAI|ChatGPT|Claude|Groq|Llama|Meta)\b/gi, 'Atlas Agent')
        .trim();
      if (text) return { reply: text, model: lastModel, usage: { prompt: promptTokens, completion: completionTokens }, tool_trace: trace };
      break;
    }
    messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content: msg.content || null, tool_calls: calls });
    for (const call of calls) {
      const name = String(call?.function?.name || '');
      let args: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      try { args = JSON.parse(String(call?.function?.arguments || '{}')); } catch { args = {}; }
      let out: AgentToolResult = { ok: false, error: 'Outil inconnu.' };
      try {
        out = await opts.executor(name, args);
      } catch (e: any) {
        out = { ok: false, error: String(e?.message || e).slice(0, 200) };
      }
      trace.push({ name, ok: out.ok, error: out.ok ? undefined : out.error, data: out.ok ? out.data : undefined, ...(out.ok && out.proposal ? { proposal: out.proposal } : {}) });
      messages.push({
        role: 'tool',
        tool_call_id: String(call?.id || ''),
        content: JSON.stringify(out).slice(0, 6000),
      });
    }
  }
  // dernier recours : réponse directe sans outils
  const fallback = await groqChat({
    apiKey: opts.apiKey,
    model: opts.model,
    system: opts.system,
    message: opts.message,
    maxTokens,
  });
  return { ...fallback, tool_trace: trace };
}

/* ───────────────── streaming + outils (v0.7.8) ─────────────────────────
 * SSE twin of groqChatWithTools(): every round is a STREAMED Groq call with
 * the SAME role-filtered business tools as the buffered route. Content deltas
 * are forwarded live; when a round ends with tool_calls, the tools run, an
 * onTool trace entry fires, and the next round streams the grounded answer.
 * Quota accounting sums the real usage of every round, exactly like the
 * buffered loop. Final fallback = buffered groqChat() without tools. */
const VENDOR_WORDS_RE = /\b(Google|Gemini|Mistral|OpenAI|ChatGPT|Claude|Groq|Llama|Meta)\b/gi;

export async function groqChatStreamWithTools(opts: {
  apiKey: string;
  model?: string;
  system: string;
  message: string;
  maxTokens?: number;
  tools: unknown[];
  executor: (name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<AgentToolResult>;
  maxRounds?: number;
  onToken: (delta: string) => void;
  onTool?: (t: AgentToolTrace) => void;
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
}): Promise<{
  reply: string;
  model: string;
  usage?: { prompt: number; completion: number };
  tool_trace: AgentToolTrace[];
}> {
  const f = opts.fetchImpl || fetch;
  const maxRounds = Math.max(1, Math.min(opts.maxRounds ?? 3, 4));
  const maxTokens = Math.max(64, Math.min(opts.maxTokens ?? 700, 4096));
  const model = (opts.model || '').trim() || MODELS[0];
  const messages: any[] = [
    { role: 'system', content: opts.system },
    { role: 'user', content: opts.message },
  ];
  const trace: AgentToolTrace[] = [];
  let promptTokens = 0;
  let completionTokens = 0;
  let lastModel = model;
  for (let round = 0; round < maxRounds; round++) {
    const res = await f('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${opts.apiKey}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model,
        temperature: 0.55,
        max_tokens: maxTokens,
        stream: true,
        stream_options: { include_usage: true },
        tools: opts.tools,
        tool_choice: 'auto',
        messages,
      }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(45_000),
    });
    if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
      throw new Error('Atlas Agent: clé Groq refusée. Vérifiez GROQ_API_KEY (console.groq.com).');
    }
    if (res.status === 429) throw new Error('Quota Groq atteint. Réessayez dans quelques minutes.');
    if (!res.ok || !res.body) throw new Error(`Atlas Agent indisponible en flux (HTTP ${res.status}).`);
    const reader = res.body.getReader();
    const dec = new TextDecoder();
    let buf = '';
    let roundText = '';
    const callsByIndex = new Map<number, { id: string; name: string; args: string }>();
    for (;;) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      buf += dec.decode(value, { stream: true });
      let idx: number;
      while ((idx = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) {
        const line = buf.slice(0, idx).trim();
        buf = buf.slice(idx + 1);
        if (!line.startsWith('data:')) continue;
        const payload = line.slice(5).trim();
        if (!payload || payload === '[DONE]') continue;
        let j: any = null;
        try { j = JSON.parse(payload); } catch { continue; }
        if (j?.model) lastModel = String(j.model);
        const delta = String(j?.choices?.[0]?.delta?.content || '');
        if (delta) {
          roundText += delta;
          try { opts.onToken(delta); } catch { /* consumer went away — keep draining */ }
        }
        const tcs = j?.choices?.[0]?.delta?.tool_calls;
        if (Array.isArray(tcs)) {
          for (const tc of tcs) {
            const i = Number(tc?.index ?? 0);
            const cur = callsByIndex.get(i) || { id: '', name: '', args: '' };
            if (tc?.id) cur.id = String(tc.id);
            if (tc?.function?.name) cur.name += String(tc.function.name);
            if (tc?.function?.arguments) cur.args += String(tc.function.arguments);
            callsByIndex.set(i, cur);
          }
        }
        const u = j?.usage || j?.x_groq?.usage;
        if (u) {
          promptTokens += Number(u.prompt_tokens || 0);
          completionTokens += Number(u.completion_tokens || 0);
        }
      }
    }
    const calls = [...callsByIndex.entries()]
      .sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])
      .map(([, v]) => v)
      .filter((v) => v.name)
      .slice(0, 4);
    if (!calls.length) {
      const text = roundText.trim().replace(VENDOR_WORDS_RE, 'Atlas Agent').trim();
      if (text) {
        return { reply: text, model: lastModel, usage: { prompt: promptTokens, completion: completionTokens }, tool_trace: trace };
      }
      break;
    }
    messages.push({
      role: 'assistant',
      content: roundText || null,
      tool_calls: calls.map((v, k) => ({ id: v.id || `call_${k}`, type: 'function', function: { name: v.name, arguments: v.args || '{}' } })),
    });
    for (const call of calls) {
      let args: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      try { args = JSON.parse(call.args || '{}'); } catch { args = {}; }
      let out: AgentToolResult = { ok: false, error: 'Outil inconnu.' };
      try {
        out = await opts.executor(call.name, args);
      } catch (e: any) {
        out = { ok: false, error: String(e?.message || e).slice(0, 200) };
      }
      const entry: AgentToolTrace = { name: call.name, ok: out.ok, error: out.ok ? undefined : out.error, data: out.ok ? out.data : undefined, ...(out.ok && out.proposal ? { proposal: out.proposal } : {}) };
      trace.push(entry);
      try { opts.onTool?.(entry); } catch { /* consumer went away */ }
      messages.push({ role: 'tool', tool_call_id: call.id || '', content: JSON.stringify(out).slice(0, 6000) });
    }
  }
  // dernier recours : réponse directe bufferisée sans outils (jumeau bufferisé)
  const fallback = await groqChat({ apiKey: opts.apiKey, model: opts.model, system: opts.system, message: opts.message, maxTokens });
  return { ...fallback, tool_trace: trace };
}

/* ─────────────────────────── streaming (v264) ───────────────────────────
 * SSE token streaming for POST /api/assist/chat/stream. Same provider, same
 * scrubbing rules as groqChat(); deltas are forwarded as they arrive and the
 * REAL usage (prompt+completion tokens) is read from the final chunk so the
 * server-side quota charges streamed turns exactly like buffered ones.
 * `fetchImpl` is injectable for tests; the production path uses global fetch
 * (upstreamFetch buffers whole bodies and cannot stream). */

export async function groqChatStream(opts: {
  apiKey: string;
  model?: string;
  system: string;
  message: string;
  maxTokens?: number;
  onToken: (delta: string) => void;
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
}): Promise<{ reply: string; model: string; usage?: { prompt: number; completion: number } }> {
  const f = opts.fetchImpl || fetch;
  const model = (opts.model || '').trim() || MODELS[0];
  const maxTokens = Math.max(64, Math.min(opts.maxTokens ?? 700, 4096));
  const res = await f('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${opts.apiKey}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model,
      temperature: 0.55,
      max_tokens: maxTokens,
      stream: true,
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: opts.system },
        { role: 'user', content: opts.message },
      ],
    }),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(45_000),
  });
  if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
    throw new Error('Atlas Agent: clé Groq refusée. Vérifiez GROQ_API_KEY (console.groq.com).');
  }
  if (res.status === 429) {
    throw new Error('Quota Groq atteint. Réessayez dans quelques minutes.');
  }
  if (!res.ok || !res.body) {
    throw new Error(`Atlas Agent indisponible en flux (HTTP ${res.status}).`);
  }
  const reader = res.body.getReader();
  const dec = new TextDecoder();
  let buf = '';
  let reply = '';
  let usedModel = model;
  let usage: { prompt: number; completion: number } | undefined;
  for (;;) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    buf += dec.decode(value, { stream: true });
    let idx: number;
    while ((idx = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) {
      const line = buf.slice(0, idx).trim();
      buf = buf.slice(idx + 1);
      if (!line.startsWith('data:')) continue;
      const payload = line.slice(5).trim();
      if (!payload || payload === '[DONE]') continue;
      let j: any = null;
      try { j = JSON.parse(payload); } catch { continue; }
      if (j?.model) usedModel = String(j.model);
      const delta = String(j?.choices?.[0]?.delta?.content || '');
      if (delta) {
        reply += delta;
        try { opts.onToken(delta); } catch { /* consumer went away — keep draining */ }
      }
      const u = j?.usage || j?.x_groq?.usage;
      if (u) {
        usage = {
          prompt: Number(u.prompt_tokens || 0),
          completion: Number(u.completion_tokens || 0),
        };
      }
    }
  }
  reply = reply
    .replace(/\b(Google|Gemini|Mistral|OpenAI|ChatGPT|Claude|Groq|Llama|Meta)\b/gi, 'Atlas Agent')
    .trim();
  if (!reply) throw new Error('Atlas Agent: réponse vide du flux Groq.');
  return { reply, model: usedModel, usage };
}

/**
 * External HTTP calls with mandatory timeout + optional retries.
 * Prefer this over raw fetch() for any third-party API.
 *
 * Compatible with fetch(url, init) — pass RequestInit as the 2nd argument,
 * or HttpClientOptions ({ timeoutMs, retries, init }).
 */

export type HttpClientOptions = {
  timeoutMs?: number;
  retries?: number;
  retryOn?: number[];
  label?: string;
  init?: RequestInit;
} & RequestInit;

const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 12_000;
const DEFAULT_RETRIES = 0;

function sleep(ms: number) {
  return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
}

function normalizeOpts(opts: HttpClientOptions = {}): {
  timeoutMs: number;
  retries: number;
  retryOn: number[];
  label: string;
  init: RequestInit;
} {
  const { timeoutMs, retries, retryOn, label, init, ...rest } = opts as any;

  const hasFetchFields =
    rest.method != null ||
    rest.headers != null ||
    rest.body != null ||
    rest.signal != null ||
    rest.credentials != null ||
    rest.cache != null ||
    rest.redirect != null ||
    rest.mode != null;

  const requestInit: RequestInit = {
    ...init,
    ...(hasFetchFields ? rest : {}),
  };

  return {
    timeoutMs: timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
    retries: retries ?? DEFAULT_RETRIES,
    retryOn: retryOn ?? [502, 503, 504],
    label: label || 'upstream',
    init: requestInit,
  };
}

/** fetch() with AbortSignal timeout. Drop-in for fetch(url, init). */
export async function fetchWithTimeout(
  url: string,
  opts: HttpClientOptions = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  const { timeoutMs, retries, retryOn, label, init } = normalizeOpts(opts);
  let lastErr: unknown;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= retries; attempt++) {
    const ac = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), timeoutMs);
    try {
      if (init.signal) {
        const parent = init.signal;
        if (parent.aborted) ac.abort();
        else parent.addEventListener('abort', () => ac.abort(), { once: true });
      }
      const res = await fetch(url, { ...init, signal: ac.signal });
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (retryOn.includes(res.status) && attempt < retries) {
        await sleep(250 * 2 ** attempt);
        continue;
      }
      return res;
    } catch (e) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      lastErr = e;
      const aborted =
        e instanceof Error && (e.name === 'AbortError' || /aborted|timeout/i.test(e.message));
      if (aborted && attempt >= retries) {
        const { AppError } = await import('./errors');
        throw new AppError('TIMEOUT', `Délai dépassé (${label})`);
      }
      if (attempt < retries) {
        await sleep(250 * 2 ** attempt);
        continue;
      }
      throw e;
    }
  }
  throw lastErr instanceof Error ? lastErr : new Error(`HTTP failed: ${label}`);
}

export async function fetchJsonWithTimeout<T = unknown>(
  url: string,
  opts: HttpClientOptions = {},
): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetchWithTimeout(url, opts);
  if (!res.ok) {
    const { AppError } = await import('./errors');
    throw new AppError(
      res.status >= 500 ? 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE' : 'BAD_REQUEST',
      `Service distant indisponible (${res.status})`,
    );
  }
  return (await res.json()) as T;
}

/**
 * v0.7.1 — Server-side role-based inventory privacy (Atlas Commerce Worker).
 *
 * Policy (single source of truth, enforced on EVERY response — Android, web,
 * agent/LLM context — by omitting restricted fields from the JSON, never by
 * client-side masking):
 *
 *  - owner / admin            → financial access (costs, valuation, totals…);
 *  - owner / admin / secretaire → selling prices needed for sales;
 *  - stock (magasinier) / user (operator) → operational product basics and
 *    stock quantities ONLY: no selling price, no cost price, no stock
 *    valuation, no sales totals, no balances, no receivables/payables, no
 *    payroll amounts.
 *
 * Stock-adjustment workflow roles:
 *  - submit request  : any authenticated role (stock/user cannot mutate stock
 *                      directly — see roleCanDirectAdjustStock);
 *  - approve / reject: owner / admin / secretaire only;
 *  - direct adjust   : owner / admin / secretaire only (POST
 *                      /api/products/:id/adjust-stock); stock/user get 403
 *                      APPROVAL_REQUIRED and must use
 *                      POST /api/stock-adjustment-requests.
 *
 * Identity/role/tenant always come from the signed server session token (and a
 * fresh users-table read at decision time) — never from client-supplied body
 * or query values. The deployment is single-tenant per D1 database: a product
 * that does not exist in this database IS the cross-tenant case (404).
 */

/** Fields that carry selling-price information. */
export const SELL_PRICE_FIELDS = ['price', 'unit_price'] as const;

/** Fields that carry cost / valuation / margin information. */
export const COST_FIELDS = [
  'cost',
  'cost_price',
  'average_cost',
  'stock_value',
  'valuation',
  'margin',
] as const;

export function normalizeInventoryRole(role: unknown): string {
  const r = String(role || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  return ['owner', 'admin', 'secretaire', 'stock', 'user'].includes(r) ? r : 'user';
}

/** Owner/admin only: costs, valuation, sales totals, balances, payroll… */
export function roleCanSeeFinancial(role: string): boolean {
  const r = normalizeInventoryRole(role);
  return r === 'owner' || r === 'admin';
}

/** Selling prices (needed for sales): owner/admin/secretaire. */
export function roleCanSeeSellPrices(role: string): boolean {
  const r = normalizeInventoryRole(role);
  return r === 'owner' || r === 'admin' || r === 'secretaire';
}

/** Approve/reject stock-adjustment requests: owner/admin/secretaire. */
export function roleCanApproveStockAdjustment(role: string): boolean {
  const r = normalizeInventoryRole(role);
  return r === 'owner' || r === 'admin' || r === 'secretaire';
}

/** Any authenticated role may propose an adjustment (it never mutates stock). */
export function roleCanSubmitStockAdjustmentRequest(role: string): boolean {
  return !!normalizeInventoryRole(role);
}

/** Direct inventory mutation (adjust-stock): owner/admin/secretaire. */
export function roleCanDirectAdjustStock(role: string): boolean {
  return roleCanApproveStockAdjustment(role);
}

/**
 * Return a copy of a product row with the fields the role must never receive.
 * Owner/admin rows pass through untouched.
 */
export function scrubProductForRole<T extends Record<string, any>>(row: T, role: string): Partial<T> {
  const r = normalizeInventoryRole(role);
  if (roleCanSeeFinancial(r)) return { ...row };
  const out: Record<string, any> = { ...row };
  if (!roleCanSeeSellPrices(r)) {
    for (const f of SELL_PRICE_FIELDS) delete out[f];
  }
  for (const f of COST_FIELDS) delete out[f];
  return out as Partial<T>;
}

/**
 * Human-readable device label from a User-Agent string — the devices modal
 * must show a device name, never a raw fingerprint hex blob.
 *  "Atlas-Android/1.2.3 (Android 14; PGEM10)" → "Atlas Android 1.2.3 · PGEM10 (Android 14)"
 *  Chrome/Windows UA                          → "Chrome 15x · Windows 10/11"
 *  iPhone Safari UA                           → "Safari · iPhone (iOS 18.7)"
 */
export function deviceLabelFromUA(ua: unknown): string {
  const s = String(ua || '');
  if (!s) return 'Appareil';
  const atlas = s.match(/Atlas-Android\/([\d.]+)\s*\(([^;)]*?);\s*([^)]+)\)/i);
  if (atlas) return `Atlas Android ${atlas[1]} · ${String(atlas[3]).trim()} (${String(atlas[2]).trim()})`;
  const browser = /Edg\//.test(s)
    ? 'Edge'
    : /OPR\//.test(s)
      ? 'Opera'
      : /Chrome\//.test(s)
        ? 'Chrome'
        : /Firefox\//.test(s)
          ? 'Firefox'
          : /Safari\//.test(s)
            ? 'Safari'
            : 'Navigateur';
  const bver = (s.match(new RegExp(`${browser}\\/(\\d+)`)) || [])[1] || '';
  const ios = s.match(/\((iPhone|iPad)[^)]*OS\s+(\d+(?:[_]\d+)*)/i);
  if (ios) return `${browser}${bver ? ` ${bver}` : ''} · ${ios[1]} (iOS ${ios[2].replace(/_/g, '.')})`;
  const android = s.match(/\(Android\s+([\d.]+)/i);
  if (android) return `${browser}${bver ? ` ${bver}` : ''} · Android ${android[1]}`;
  const os = /Windows NT 10/.test(s)
    ? 'Windows 10/11'
    : /Windows NT/.test(s)
      ? 'Windows'
      : /Mac OS X/.test(s)
        ? 'macOS'
        : /Linux/.test(s)
          ? 'Linux'
          : '';
  const label = [browser + (bver ? ` ${bver}` : ''), os].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  return label || s.slice(0, 40);
}

/**
 * Lightweight async job helper for Workers.
 * Prefer c.executionCtx.waitUntil for fire-and-forget.
 * Optional KV ledger for dedupe (job id) — not Redis/SQS; same role at edge scale.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   enqueue(c.executionCtx, () => sendEmail(...));
 *   await enqueueOnce(env.CACHE, 'mail:inv:123', 3600, () => ...);
 */

export function enqueue(ctx: { waitUntil: (p: Promise<unknown>) => void } | undefined, work: () => Promise<unknown>): void {
  const p = Promise.resolve()
    .then(work)
    .catch((e) => {
      console.error('job-queue', e?.message || e);
    });
  if (ctx && typeof ctx.waitUntil === 'function') {
    ctx.waitUntil(p);
  }
}

/** Run at most once per key within TTL seconds (KV). */
export async function enqueueOnce(
  kv: KVNamespace | undefined,
  jobId: string,
  ttlSeconds: number,
  work: () => Promise<unknown>,
  ctx?: { waitUntil: (p: Promise<unknown>) => void },
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (kv) {
    const existing = await kv.get(`job:${jobId}`);
    if (existing) return false;
    await kv.put(`job:${jobId}`, '1', { expirationTtl: Math.max(60, ttlSeconds) });
  }
  enqueue(ctx, work);
  return true;
}

import type { Env } from '../env';

/**
 * Document numbering (FA / DEV / VR / ACH / REC / WR).
 * Optional Durable Object NUMBER_HUB for atomic sequences under concurrency.
 */
export async function nextDocumentNumber(
  db: D1Database,
  kind: 'invoice' | 'quote' | 'bill' | 'receipt' | 'credit_note' | 'quick_sale',
  settings: any,
  env?: Env,

    invoice: 'FA-',
    quote: 'DEV-',
    bill: 'ACH-',
    receipt: 'REC-',
    credit_note: 'WR-',
    quick_sale: 'VR-',
  };
  const prefixMap: Record<string, string> = {
    invoice: settings?.invoice_prefix || defaultPrefixes.invoice,
    quote: settings?.quote_prefix || defaultPrefixes.quote,
    bill: settings?.bill_prefix || defaultPrefixes.bill,
    receipt: settings?.receipt_prefix || defaultPrefixes.receipt,
    credit_note: settings?.credit_prefix || defaultPrefixes.credit_note,
    quick_sale: settings?.quick_sale_prefix || defaultPrefixes.quick_sale,
  };
  const counterMap: Record<string, string> = {
    invoice: 'next_invoice_number',
    quote: 'next_quote_number',
    bill: 'next_bill_number',
    receipt: 'next_receipt_number',
    credit_note: 'next_credit_number',
    quick_sale: 'next_quick_sale_number',
  };
  const tableMap: Record<string, string> = {
    invoice: 'invoices',
    quote: 'invoices',
    bill: 'bills',
    receipt: 'receipts',
    credit_note: 'invoices',
    quick_sale: 'invoices',
  };
  const style = String(settings?.numbering_style || 'prefix_year').trim();
  const year = new Date().getFullYear();
  const pad = Math.max(3, Math.min(6, Number(settings?.numbering_pad || 4)));
  let prefix = String(prefixMap[kind] || '').trim();
  // Ensure prefix ends cleanly for styles that append year
  if (prefix && !/[-/]$/.test(prefix) && (style === 'prefix_year' || style === 'prefix_year_slash' || style === 'prefix_pad5')) {
    // keep as-is; user controls trailing dash/slash
  }
  const counterCol = counterMap[kind];
  let counter = Number(settings?.[counterCol] || 1);
  if (!counter || counter < 1) counter = 1;

  // Align with highest existing number for this series (avoids duplicates after imports)
  try {
    const table = tableMap[kind];
    const likePattern =
      style === 'year_seq' || style === 'year_slash'
        ? `${year}%`
        : prefix
          ? prefix + '%'
          : '%';
    const { results } = await db.prepare(`SELECT number FROM ${table} WHERE number LIKE ?`).bind(likePattern).all();
    let maxFound = 0;
    for (const row of (results || []) as any[]) {
      const n = String(row.number || '');
      // Extract trailing numeric sequence
      const m = n.match(/(\d+)\s*$/);
      if (!m) continue;
      // For year styles, only consider current year numbers
      if ((style === 'year_seq' || style === 'year_slash' || style === 'prefix_year' || style === 'prefix_year_slash') && !n.includes(String(year))) {
        continue;
      }
      const v = parseInt(m[1], 10);
      if (!isNaN(v) && v > maxFound) maxFound = v;
    }
    if (maxFound >= counter) counter = maxFound + 1;
  } catch { /* ignore */ }

  // Atomic sequence via Durable Object (safe under concurrent creates)
  const numberHub = env && (env as Env).NUMBER_HUB;
  if (numberHub) {
    try {
      const series = `${kind}:${year}`;
      const id = numberHub.idFromName('doc-numbers');
      const stub = numberHub.get(id);
      const res = await stub.fetch('https://number-hub/next', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ series, floor: counter }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const j: any = await res.json();
        const n = Number(j?.data?.next);
        if (n > 0) counter = n;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.log('NUMBER_HUB allocate fail', e);
    }
  }

  const formatNum = (c: number) => {
    const seq = String(c).padStart(pad, '0');
    switch (style) {
      case 'year_seq':
        return `${year}-${seq}`;
      case 'year_slash':
        return `${year}/${seq}`;
      case 'prefix_year_slash':
        return `${prefix.replace(/[-/]+$/, '')}/${year}/${seq}`;
      case 'prefix_pad5':
        return `${prefix}${String(c).padStart(5, '0')}`;
      case 'prefix_year':
      default:
        return `${prefix.replace(/[-/]+$/, '')}-${year}-${seq}`;
    }
  };

  // Uniqueness loop (Phase 0) — never return a number already in the table
  const table = tableMap[kind];
  let number = formatNum(counter);
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 25; attempt++) {
    const clash = await db.prepare(`SELECT id FROM ${table} WHERE number = ? LIMIT 1`).bind(number).first();
    if (!clash) break;
    counter += 1;
    number = formatNum(counter);
  }

  // Bump counter in settings past the number we issued
  try {
    const next = counter + 1;
    if (kind === 'quote') {
      await db.prepare(`UPDATE company_settings SET next_quote_number = ? WHERE id = 1`).bind(next).run();
    } else if (kind === 'bill') {
      try {
        await db.prepare(`UPDATE company_settings SET next_bill_number = ? WHERE id = 1`).bind(next).run();
      } catch { /* */ }
    } else if (kind === 'receipt') {
      await db.prepare(`UPDATE company_settings SET next_receipt_number = ? WHERE id = 1`).bind(next).run();
    } else if (kind === 'credit_note') {
      try {
        await db.prepare(`UPDATE company_settings SET next_credit_number = ? WHERE id = 1`).bind(next).run();
      } catch { /* */ }
    } else if (kind === 'quick_sale') {
      try {
        await db.prepare(`UPDATE company_settings SET next_quick_sale_number = ? WHERE id = 1`).bind(next).run();
      } catch { /* */ }
    } else {
      await db.prepare(`UPDATE company_settings SET next_invoice_number = ? WHERE id = 1`).bind(next).run();
    }
  } catch { /* ignore */ }

  return number;
}

/**
 * R2 helpers for product / company images and optional archives.
 * Bucket binding: IMAGES → company-stock-images
 * Public CDN: CDN_BASE (https://cdn1.afmarbre.com) must be configured
 * as a custom domain on the R2 bucket in the Cloudflare dashboard.
 */

const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024; // 4 MB — stay well under Worker memory limits
const ALLOWED_MIME = new Set(['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/gif']);

export function cdnBase(env: { CDN_BASE?: string }): string {
  const b = (env.CDN_BASE || 'https://cdn1.afmarbre.com').trim().replace(/\/$/, '');
  return b || 'https://cdn1.afmarbre.com';
}

export function publicImageUrl(env: { CDN_BASE?: string }, key: string): string {
  return `${cdnBase(env)}/${key.replace(/^\//, '')}`;
}

/** Safe object key: products/{productId}/{uuid}.{ext} */
export function productImageKey(productId: string | number, ext: string): string {
  const id = String(productId).replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') || '0';
  const e = (ext || 'jpg').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '') || 'jpg';
  const rand =
    typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID
      ? crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 16)
      : `${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
  return `products/${id}/${rand}.${e}`;
}

export function companyAssetKey(kind: 'logo' | 'signature' | 'stamp', ext: string): string {
  const e = (ext || 'png').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '') || 'png';
  return `company/${kind}.${e}`;
}

function extFromMime(mime: string): string {
  if (mime === 'image/png') return 'png';
  if (mime === 'image/webp') return 'webp';
  if (mime === 'image/gif') return 'gif';
  return 'jpg';
}

/**
 * Upload raw bytes to R2. Returns public CDN URL or null if R2 unavailable / invalid.
 */
export async function uploadImageBytes(
  bucket: R2Bucket | undefined,
  env: { CDN_BASE?: string },
  key: string,
  bytes: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array,
  contentType: string
): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!bucket) return null;
  const mime = (contentType || '').split(';')[0].trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!ALLOWED_MIME.has(mime)) return null;
  const size = bytes instanceof ArrayBuffer ? bytes.byteLength : bytes.byteLength;
  if (size <= 0 || size > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) return null;
  try {
    await bucket.put(key, bytes, {
      httpMetadata: {
        contentType: mime,
        cacheControl: 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
      },
    });
    return publicImageUrl(env, key);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Accept data-URL (data:image/png;base64,...) or raw base64 + mime.
 * Returns CDN URL or null.
 */
export async function uploadDataUrlImage(
  bucket: R2Bucket | undefined,
  env: { CDN_BASE?: string },
  dataUrl: string,
  key: string
): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!bucket || !dataUrl || typeof dataUrl !== 'string') return null;
  const m = /^data:(image\/[a-z0-9+.-]+);base64,(.+)$/i.exec(dataUrl.trim());
  if (!m) return null;
  const mime = m[1].toLowerCase();
  if (!ALLOWED_MIME.has(mime)) return null;
  try {
    const binary = atob(m[2]);
    const len = binary.length;
    if (len > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) return null;
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    return uploadImageBytes(bucket, env, key, bytes, mime);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function deleteR2Object(bucket: R2Bucket | undefined, key: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!bucket || !key) return;
  try {
    await bucket.delete(key);
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

/** Extract R2 object key from a CDN URL if it matches our CDN base. */
export function keyFromCdnUrl(env: { CDN_BASE?: string }, url: string): string | null {
  if (!url) return null;
  try {
    const base = cdnBase(env).replace(/\/$/, '');
    if (url.startsWith(base + '/')) {
      return decodeURIComponent(url.slice(base.length + 1).split('?')[0]);
    }
    // Also accept common R2 public hosts / custom domains pointing at the same keys
    const u = new URL(url);
    const host = u.hostname.toLowerCase();
    if (
      host === 'cdn1.afmarbre.com' ||
      host.endsWith('.r2.dev') ||
      host.endsWith('.afmarbre.com')
    ) {
      const key = u.pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
      return key ? decodeURIComponent(key) : null;
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  return null;
}

export function mimeToExt(mime: string): string {
  return extFromMime(mime);
}

export async function r2PutText(
  bucket: R2Bucket | undefined,
  key: string,
  body: string,
  contentType = 'application/json'
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!bucket) return false;
  try {
    await bucket.put(key, body, { httpMetadata: { contentType } });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function r2GetText(bucket: R2Bucket | undefined, key: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!bucket) return null;
  try {
    const obj = await bucket.get(key);
    if (!obj) return null;
    return await obj.text();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function auditArchiveKey(ymd: string): string {
  return `audit/${ymd}.jsonl`;
}

/** RBAC — shared by Worker */

export function normalizeRole(role: string | undefined | null): string {
  const r = String(role || 'user').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (r === 'owner' || r === 'admin' || r === 'secretaire' || r === 'stock' || r === 'user') return r;
  return 'user';
}

/** Invoices, clients, hard product create, payments — not stock-only floor staff */
export function canMutateBusiness(role: string | undefined | null): boolean {
  const r = normalizeRole(role);
  return r === 'owner' || r === 'admin' || r === 'secretaire';
}

export function canHardDeleteStock(role: string | undefined | null): boolean {
  const r = normalizeRole(role);
  return r === 'owner' || r === 'admin';
}

/** Floor: scan, propose products, stock checks */
export function canFloorStock(role: string | undefined | null): boolean {
  const r = normalizeRole(role);
  return r === 'owner' || r === 'admin' || r === 'secretaire' || r === 'stock';
}

/**
 * Reliability toolkit for Atlas Worker (Cloudflare edge).
 *
 * What Cloudflare already provides (no extra code):
 * - Global anycast load balancing across PoPs
 * - CDN for static assets (Workers Assets + R2 custom domain)
 * - D1 managed replication within a region (platform-level)
 *
 * What this module adds in-app:
 * - Circuit breaker (via circuit-breaker.ts)
 * - Timeouts + retries (via http-client.ts)
 * - Cache-aside reads (via cache.ts)
 * - In-isolate job queue + optional Cloudflare Queues binding
 * - Stronger product search (FTS5 when available, LIKE fallback)
 * - Backup helpers (R2 encrypted dumps — see admin backup routes)
 * - Shard key helper for future multi-DB tenancy
 */

import type { Env } from '../env';
import { circuitAllow, circuitFailure, circuitSuccess } from './circuit-breaker';
import { fetchWithTimeout, type HttpClientOptions } from './http-client';
import { AppError } from './errors';

/* ── External call with circuit + timeout + retries ───────────────── */

export async function reliableFetch(
  name: string,
  url: string,
  opts: HttpClientOptions = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  if (!circuitAllow(name)) {
    throw new AppError('SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', `Service ${name} temporairement coupé`);
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetchWithTimeout(url, {
      timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 12_000,
      retries: opts.retries ?? 1,
      label: name,
      ...opts,
    });
    if (res.status >= 500) {
      circuitFailure(name);
    } else {
      circuitSuccess(name);
    }
    return res;
  } catch (e) {
    circuitFailure(name);
    throw e;
  }
}

/* ── In-isolate message queue (best-effort, per isolate) ──────────── */

type Job = { id: string; type: string; payload: unknown; enqueuedAt: number };
const localQueue: Job[] = [];
const MAX_LOCAL = 200;

export function enqueueLocal(type: string, payload: unknown): string {
  const id = `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  if (localQueue.length >= MAX_LOCAL) localQueue.shift();
  localQueue.push({ id, type, payload, enqueuedAt: Date.now() });
  return id;
}

export function drainLocal(max = 20): Job[] {
  return localQueue.splice(0, max);
}

/** Prefer Cloudflare Queues when bound; else local buffer. */
export async function enqueueMessage(
  env: Env & { QUEUE?: { send: (body: unknown) => Promise<void> } },
  type: string,
  payload: unknown,
): Promise<{ id: string; backend: 'cloudflare_queue' | 'local' }> {
  const body = { type, payload, ts: Date.now() };
  if (env.QUEUE && typeof env.QUEUE.send === 'function') {
    await env.QUEUE.send(body);
    return { id: `cq-${body.ts}`, backend: 'cloudflare_queue' };
  }
  const id = enqueueLocal(type, payload);
  return { id, backend: 'local' };
}

/* ── Shard key (future multi-tenant / multi-D1) ───────────────────── */

/**
 * Deterministic shard id for a tenant or entity key.
 * With a single D1 binding today, always returns 0.
 * When multiple D1s are bound (DB_0, DB_1, …), route by shardId.
 */
export function shardIdFor(key: string, shardCount = 1): number {
  if (shardCount <= 1) return 0;
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < key.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + key.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return h % shardCount;
}

export function dbForShard(env: Env, shardId: number): D1Database {
  const multi = (env as any)[`DB_${shardId}`] as D1Database | undefined;
  return multi || env.DB;
}

/* ── Read path: prefer cache, then D1 ─────────────────────────────── */

export type ReadOptions = {
  cacheKey?: string;
  ttlSec?: number;
  /** If true, skip cache (force primary) */
  primary?: boolean;
};

/**
 * Note: D1 does not expose a separate read-replica binding in free tier.
 * Cache (memory + KV) acts as the read-acceleration layer.
 * Platform-level D1 replication is handled by Cloudflare.
 */

/* ── Search index bootstrap (FTS5) ────────────────────────────────── */

let ftsReady: boolean | null = null;

/** Ensure products_fts exists (FTS5). Safe to call often. */
export async function ensureProductSearchIndex(db: D1Database): Promise<boolean> {
  if (ftsReady === true) return true;
  try {
    await db
      .prepare(
        `CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products_fts USING fts5(
          name, sku, barcode, category, variant_label,
          content='products', content_rowid='id'
        )`,
      )
      .run();
    // Triggers to keep FTS in sync
    await db
      .prepare(
        `CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS products_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON products BEGIN
          INSERT INTO products_fts(rowid, name, sku, barcode, category, variant_label)
          VALUES (new.id, new.name, new.sku, new.barcode, new.category, new.variant_label);
        END`,
      )
      .run();
    await db
      .prepare(
        `CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS products_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON products BEGIN
          INSERT INTO products_fts(products_fts, rowid, name, sku, barcode, category, variant_label)
          VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.name, old.sku, old.barcode, old.category, old.variant_label);
        END`,
      )
      .run();
    await db
      .prepare(
        `CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS products_fts_au AFTER UPDATE ON products BEGIN
          INSERT INTO products_fts(products_fts, rowid, name, sku, barcode, category, variant_label)
          VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.name, old.sku, old.barcode, old.category, old.variant_label);
          INSERT INTO products_fts(rowid, name, sku, barcode, category, variant_label)
          VALUES (new.id, new.name, new.sku, new.barcode, new.category, new.variant_label);
        END`,
      )
      .run();
    // Seed if empty
    const cnt = await db.prepare(`SELECT count(*) AS n FROM products_fts`).first<{ n: number }>();
    if (!cnt || Number(cnt.n) === 0) {
      await db
        .prepare(
          `INSERT INTO products_fts(rowid, name, sku, barcode, category, variant_label)
           SELECT id, name, sku, barcode, category, variant_label FROM products`,
        )
        .run();
    }
    ftsReady = true;
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[search-index] FTS unavailable, LIKE fallback', e);
    ftsReady = false;
    if (/SQLITE_CORRUPT|database disk image is malformed/i.test(String((e as any)?.message || e))) {
      void repairProductSearchIndex(db);
    }
    return false;
  }
}

/** FTS5 integrity probe — true when the virtual-table shadow pages are sound. */
export async function checkProductSearchIndex(db: D1Database): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO products_fts(products_fts, rank) VALUES('integrity-check', 1)`).run();
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

let repairInFlight: Promise<'rebuilt' | 'recreated' | 'failed'> | null = null;
let lastRepairAt = 0;
let lastFtsProbeAt = 0;

/**
 * Throttled background integrity probe (≤1/5 min per isolate): catches FTS
 * corruption even when no write has hit it yet, and repairs automatically —
 * the app heals itself with zero CLI / zero dashboard action.
 */
export async function proactiveFtsHealth(db: D1Database): Promise<void> {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - lastFtsProbeAt < 5 * 60_000) return;
  lastFtsProbeAt = now;
  try {
    const ok = await checkProductSearchIndex(db);
    if (!ok) {
      console.warn('[search-index] integrity-check failed → automatic repair');
      await repairProductSearchIndex(db, { force: true });
    }
  } catch { /* best-effort */ }
}

/**
 * Self-heal a corrupted products_fts (SQLITE_CORRUPT_VTAB).
 *
 * The FTS index is DERIVED data (content='products'): rebuilding it — or, when
 * the shadow pages are too damaged, dropping triggers + table and letting
 * ensureProductSearchIndex recreate and reseed it — loses no business data.
 * Cooldown + in-flight guard keep a corruption burst from looping repairs.
 */
export function repairProductSearchIndex(
  db: D1Database,
  opts?: { force?: boolean },
): Promise<'rebuilt' | 'recreated' | 'failed'> {
  if (repairInFlight) return repairInFlight;
  if (!opts?.force && Date.now() - lastRepairAt < 60_000) return Promise.resolve('failed');
  repairInFlight = (async () => {
    lastRepairAt = Date.now();
    try {
      try {
        await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO products_fts(products_fts) VALUES('rebuild')`).run();
        console.log('[search-index] products_fts rebuilt from products');
        return 'rebuilt' as const;
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('[search-index] rebuild failed, recreating table', String((e as any)?.message || e).slice(0, 300));
      }
      for (const t of ['products_fts_ai', 'products_fts_ad', 'products_fts_au']) {
        try { await db.prepare(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS ${t}`).run(); } catch { /* */ }
      }
      try { await db.prepare(`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS products_fts`).run(); } catch { /* */ }
      ftsReady = null;
      const ok = await ensureProductSearchIndex(db);
      console.log('[search-index] products_fts recreated:', ok);
      return ok ? ('recreated' as const) : ('failed' as const);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[search-index] repair failed', String((e as any)?.message || e).slice(0, 300));
      return 'failed' as const;
    } finally {
      repairInFlight = null;
    }
  })();
  return repairInFlight;
}

/** Stronger product search: FTS5 MATCH when available, else multi-column LIKE. */
export async function searchProducts(
  db: D1Database,
  q: string,
  limit = 50,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]> {
  const query = (q || '').trim().slice(0, 120);
  const lim = Math.min(Math.max(1, limit), 200);
  if (!query) {
    const { results } = await db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT id, name, sku, barcode, quantity, price, category, image_url
         FROM products ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT ?`,
      )
      .bind(lim)
      .all();
    return (results || []) as Record<string, unknown>[];
  }

  const useFts = await ensureProductSearchIndex(db);
  if (useFts) {
    try {
      // Prefix search: token*
      const ftsQuery = query
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map((t) => `"${t.replace(/"/g, '')}"*`)
        .join(' ');
      const { results } = await db
        .prepare(
          `SELECT p.id, p.name, p.sku, p.barcode, p.quantity, p.price, p.category, p.image_url
           FROM products_fts f
           JOIN products p ON p.id = f.rowid
           WHERE products_fts MATCH ?
           ORDER BY rank
           LIMIT ?`,
        )
        .bind(ftsQuery, lim)
        .all();
      return (results || []) as Record<string, unknown>[];
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[search-index] FTS query failed, LIKE fallback', e);
    }
  }

  const like = `%${query.replace(/[%_]/g, '')}%`;
  const { results } = await db
    .prepare(
      `SELECT id, name, sku, barcode, quantity, price, category, image_url
       FROM products
       WHERE name LIKE ? OR IFNULL(sku,'') LIKE ? OR IFNULL(barcode,'') LIKE ?
          OR IFNULL(category,'') LIKE ? OR IFNULL(variant_label,'') LIKE ?
       ORDER BY name ASC
       LIMIT ?`,
    )
    .bind(like, like, like, like, like, lim)
    .all();
  return (results || []) as Record<string, unknown>[];
}

/* ── Backup / replication status (informational) ──────────────────── */

export function reliabilityStatus(env: Env) {
  return {
    load_balancer: 'cloudflare_anycast',
    cdn: env.CDN_BASE || 'workers_assets_r2',
    circuit_breaker: true,
    cache: { memory: true, kv: !!env.CACHE },
    queues: { local: true, cloudflare: !!(env as any).QUEUE },
    search_index: ftsReady === null ? 'unknown' : ftsReady ? 'fts5' : 'like_fallback',
    read_acceleration: 'kv_memory_cache',
    d1_replication: 'platform_managed',
    sharding: 'single_db_ready_for_multi',
    backups: 'r2_encrypted_30m',
    timeouts_retries: true,
  };
}

/**
 * v262 — Report period bounds, extracted from worker/index.ts so the logic is
 * pure and unit-testable (same pattern as lib/finance.ts / lib/webauthn.ts).
 *
 * Accepted `period` values:
 *  - relative: month (default), 3m/6m/9m/12m/24m/36m/48m, year/ytd,
 *    custom (+ from/to YYYY-MM-DD);
 *  - absolute: a STRICTLY validated `YYYY-MM` month (4-digit year 1970–2100,
 *    month 01–12 — nothing else; `2026-1`, `2026-13`, `2026-10-05` are
 *    rejected and fall back to the current month).
 *
 * Timezone semantics: the caller supplies `todayYmd` — the company's calendar
 * today in its configured finance timezone (company_settings.finance_timezone,
 * default Africa/Casablanca — computed with lib/finance.localTodayYmd, never
 * the worker's UTC clock). The current month stops at `todayYmd`; past months
 * use the full calendar month (leap-year safe); future months clamp `to` at
 * today (empty window, deterministic).
 *
 * `periodKey` is the normalized, validated period that gets propagated to
 * every report section link — raw user input is never echoed into links.
 */

export type PeriodParams = {
  period?: string | null;
  from?: string | null;
  to?: string | null;
};

export type PeriodBounds = {
  from: string;
  to: string;
  label: string;
  periodKey: string;
};

const MONTH_NAMES_FR = [
  'janvier', 'février', 'mars', 'avril', 'mai', 'juin',
  'juillet', 'août', 'septembre', 'octobre', 'novembre', 'décembre',
];

const RELATIVE_LABELS_FR: Record<string, string> = {
  '3m': '3 derniers mois',
  '6m': '6 derniers mois',
  '9m': '9 derniers mois',
  '12m': '12 derniers mois',
  '24m': '2 ans',
  '36m': '3 ans',
  '48m': '4 ans',
};

const MONTHS_BACK: Record<string, number> = {
  month: 0, '3m': 2, '6m': 5, '9m': 8, '12m': 11, '24m': 23, '36m': 35, '48m': 47,
};

/** Strict YYYY-MM parse → { year, month(1-12) } or null. No coercion. */
export function parsePeriodMonth(period: unknown): { year: number; month: number } | null {
  const m = String(period ?? '').trim().match(/^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/);
  if (!m) return null;
  const year = Number(m[1]);
  if (year < 1970 || year > 2100) return null;
  return { year, month: Number(m[2]) };
}

function isValidYmd(value: unknown): value is string {
  return /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])$/.test(String(value ?? ''));
}

function lastDayOfMonth(year: number, month: number): number {
  return new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate();
}

function ymd(year: number, month: number, day: number): string {
  return `${String(year).padStart(4, '0')}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(day).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function monthLabel(year: number, month: number): string {
  return `${MONTH_NAMES_FR[month - 1]} ${year}`;
}

/**
 * Compute { from, to, label, periodKey } for a report request.
 * `opts.todayYmd` MUST be the company-timezone calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD).
 */
export function computePeriodBounds(params: PeriodParams, opts: { todayYmd: string }): PeriodBounds {
  const today = isValidYmd(opts.todayYmd)
    ? String(opts.todayYmd).slice(0, 10)
    : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const curYear = Number(today.slice(0, 4));
  const curMonth = Number(today.slice(5, 7));
  const period = String(params.period ?? '').trim() || 'month';

  // 1) Absolute month — strictly validated YYYY-MM.
  const ym = parsePeriodMonth(period);
  if (ym) {
    const from = ymd(ym.year, ym.month, 1);
    const monthEnd = ymd(ym.year, ym.month, lastDayOfMonth(ym.year, ym.month));
    // past → full month; current → stops at today; future → clamped (empty)
    const to = monthEnd < today ? monthEnd : today;
    return { from, to, label: monthLabel(ym.year, ym.month), periodKey: `${ym.year}-${String(ym.month).padStart(2, '0')}` };
  }

  // 2) Calendar year to date.
  if (period === 'year' || period === 'ytd') {
    const label = period === 'year' ? `Année ${curYear}` : `Année en cours ${curYear}`;
    return { from: ymd(curYear, 1, 1), to: today, label, periodKey: period };
  }

  // 3) Custom range — both bounds must be valid YYYY-MM-DD; `to` clamps at today.
  if (period === 'custom' && isValidYmd(params.from) && isValidYmd(params.to)) {
    const from = String(params.from).slice(0, 10);
    const to = String(params.to).slice(0, 10) > today ? today : String(params.to).slice(0, 10);
    return { from, to, label: `Du ${from} au ${to}`, periodKey: 'custom' };
  }

  // 4) Relative month windows (month = current month → today).
  if (period in MONTHS_BACK) {
    const idx = curYear * 12 + (curMonth - 1) - MONTHS_BACK[period];
    const fy = Math.floor(idx / 12);
    const fm = (idx % 12) + 1;
    const label = period === 'month' ? monthLabel(fy, fm) : RELATIVE_LABELS_FR[period];
    return { from: ymd(fy, fm, 1), to: today, label, periodKey: period };
  }

  // 5) Unknown / invalid (e.g. '2026-13', '2026-1', 'nope') → current month.
  return { from: ymd(curYear, curMonth, 1), to: today, label: monthLabel(curYear, curMonth), periodKey: 'month' };
}

/**
 * Query string for report deep-links: the short-lived HMAC `rt` ticket plus
 * the NORMALIZED period key (never the raw user input) and section extras.
 * A session JWT is never accepted here nor emitted into links — `token` is
 * dropped defensively even if a caller tries to smuggle it.
 */
export function buildReportLinkQuery(rt: string, periodKey: string, extra: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (rt) p.set('rt', rt);
  if (periodKey) p.set('period', periodKey);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(extra)) {
    if (v && k !== 'token' && k !== 'rt') p.set(k, v);
  }
  return `?${p.toString()}`;
}
