/**
 * v260 — Crash reporting & user reports → GitHub issues.
 *
 * Two queues, one sink:
 *  - crash_reports: automatic, sent by the app's global error handlers
 *    (window error / unhandledrejection / ErrorBoundary). Public endpoint but
 *    rate-limited, size-capped, deduplicated by fingerprint and SANITIZED —
 *    tokens, JWTs, API keys and atlas_ keys are redacted before anything is
 *    stored or forwarded.
 *  - user_reports: explicit "Signaler un problème" submissions from logged-in
 *    users (any role).
 *
 * GitHub sync: when a token is available (env GITHUB_ISSUE_TOKEN secret or the
 * owner-configured app_config value — set in-app, never echoed back), each
 * report becomes an issue in the configured repo (default
 * Etherealmber/atlas-commerce) with labels crash-report / user-report.
 * Crashes are deduplicated against OPEN issues carrying the fingerprint in
 * the title, so one bug = one issue (occurrence count kept in D1).
 * Without a token everything queues in D1 with status 'new'/'pending' and
 * retryPendingReports() (daily cron + owner button) drains the queue once the
 * token is configured. No report is ever lost, no CLI needed.
 *
 * Privacy: crash IPs are stored as a truncated SHA-256 (abuse control only);
 * user reports store only the reporting account's own username/role.
 */

/** v0.7 — crash/user reports come FROM the apps: issues land in the ANDROID repo. */
export const REPORTS_REPO_DEFAULT = 'Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android';
/** Pre-0.7 default (web repo): migrated on read so old saved configs follow. */
export const REPORTS_REPO_LEGACY = 'Etherealmber/atlas-commerce';
/** Resolve the delivery repo: explicit override wins, legacy default migrates. */
export function resolveReportsRepo(configured?: string | null): string {
  const raw = String(configured || '').trim();
  if (!raw || raw === REPORTS_REPO_LEGACY) return REPORTS_REPO_DEFAULT;
  return raw;
}
const DEFAULT_REPO = REPORTS_REPO_DEFAULT;
const LABEL_CRASH = 'crash-report';
const LABEL_USER = 'user-report';
const LABEL_FROM_APP = 'from-app';

export async function ensureReportTables(db: D1Database): Promise<void> {
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crash_reports (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    stack TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    component_stack TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    route TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    ua TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    ip_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
    issue_number INTEGER,
    issue_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    first_seen TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    last_seen TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  )`).run();
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_reports (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    username TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bug',
    message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    contact TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    page TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
    issue_number INTEGER,
    issue_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  )`).run();
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_config (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  )`).run();
}

/* ─────────────────────────── sanitization ─────────────────────────── */

/** Anything that looks like a credential gets redacted before storage/sync. */
const SECRET_PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
  /Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+/gi,
  /github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]+/g,
  /\bghp_[A-Za-z0-9]+/g,
  /\bgho_[A-Za-z0-9]+/g,
  /\batlas_[A-Za-z0-9]+/g,
  /\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}/g,
  /\bgsk_[A-Za-z0-9]+/g,
  /\bre_[A-Za-z0-9_]{16,}/g,
  // JWT-ish triples
  /\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}/g,
  // long base64/hex blobs (data URLs, keys)
  /\b[A-Za-z0-9+/]{120,}={0,2}\b/g,
];

export function redactSecrets(text: string): string {
  let out = String(text || '');
  for (const re of SECRET_PATTERNS) out = out.replace(re, '[REDACTED]');
  return out;
}

export type SanitizedCrash = {
  message: string;
  stack: string;
  componentStack: string;
  route: string;
  version: string;
  ua: string;
};

export function sanitizeCrashPayload(body: any): SanitizedCrash {
  const clip = (v: unknown, n: number) => redactSecrets(String(v ?? '')).slice(0, n);
  return {
    message: clip(body?.message, 400) || 'Erreur inconnue',
    stack: clip(body?.stack, 4000),
    componentStack: clip(body?.componentStack, 2000),
    route: clip(body?.route, 200),
    version: clip(body?.version, 40),
    ua: clip(body?.ua, 200),
  };
}

async function sha256Hex(text: string): Promise<string> {
  const bytes = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(text));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(bytes)).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

/** Stable fingerprint: message + first meaningful stack frames. */
export async function fingerprintOf(p: SanitizedCrash): Promise<string> {
  const frames = p.stack
    .split('\n')
    .map((l) => l.trim())
    .filter((l) => l.startsWith('at '))
    .slice(0, 3)
    .join('|');
  return (await sha256Hex(`${p.message}§${frames}`)).slice(0, 16);
}

export async function hashIp(ip: string): Promise<string> {
  return (await sha256Hex(`atlas-crash-ip§${ip}`)).slice(0, 16);
}

/* ─────────────────────────── github config ─────────────────────────── */

export type ReportsEnv = {
  DB: D1Database;
  GITHUB_ISSUE_TOKEN?: string;
  GITHUB_ISSUE_REPO?: string;
};

async function getConfigValue(db: D1Database, key: string): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const row = await db.prepare(`SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key = ?`).bind(key).first() as any;
    return String(row?.value || '');
  } catch { return ''; }
}

async function setConfigValue(db: D1Database, key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
  await db.prepare(
    `INSERT INTO app_config (key, value, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, datetime('now'))
     ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value, updated_at = excluded.updated_at`
  ).bind(key, value).run();
}

/** env secret wins over the in-app configured token; repo is overridable. */
export async function githubConfig(env: ReportsEnv): Promise<{ token: string; repo: string; source: 'env' | 'app' | null }> {
  const envToken = String(env.GITHUB_ISSUE_TOKEN || '').trim();
  if (envToken) {
    return { token: envToken, repo: resolveReportsRepo(env.GITHUB_ISSUE_REPO), source: 'env' };
  }
  const appToken = await getConfigValue(env.DB, 'github_reports_token');
  const appRepo = await getConfigValue(env.DB, 'github_reports_repo');
  if (appToken) {
    return { token: appToken, repo: resolveReportsRepo(appRepo || env.GITHUB_ISSUE_REPO), source: 'app' };
  }
  return { token: '', repo: resolveReportsRepo(env.GITHUB_ISSUE_REPO), source: null };
}

export async function saveGithubConfig(db: D1Database, token: string, repo: string): Promise<void> {
  await setConfigValue(db, 'github_reports_token', token);
  if (repo) await setConfigValue(db, 'github_reports_repo', repo);
}

async function gh(token: string, method: string, path: string, body?: any): Promise<{ ok: boolean; status: number; json: any }> {
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
      'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
      'User-Agent': 'atlas-commerce-reports',
      ...(body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
    },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  let json: any = null;
  try { json = await res.json(); } catch { /* 204 etc. */ }
  return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, json };
}

/** Validate a token (used before storing it). Returns login name or null. */
export async function validateGithubToken(token: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; login?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const r = await gh(token, 'GET', '/user');
    if (r.ok && r.json?.login) return { ok: true, login: String(r.json.login) };
    if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) return { ok: false, error: 'Token refusé par GitHub (401/403)' };
    return { ok: false, error: `GitHub a répondu ${r.status}` };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, error: 'GitHub injoignable — réessayez' };
  }
}

async function ensureLabels(token: string, repo: string): Promise<void> {
  const wanted: [string, string, string][] = [
    [LABEL_CRASH, 'Bugs detectedés automatiquement par l’application', 'd73a4a'],
    [LABEL_USER, 'Signalements envoyés par les utilisateurs depuis l’application', '0075ca'],
    [LABEL_FROM_APP, 'Créé automatiquement par Atlas Commerce', 'ededed'],
  ];
  for (const [name, description, color] of wanted) {
    try {
      const r = await gh(token, 'POST', `/repos/${repo}/labels`, { name, description, color });
      if (!r.ok && r.status !== 422) { /* 422 = exists */ }
    } catch { /* labels are cosmetic — never block a report */ }
  }
}

async function findOpenIssueByFingerprint(token: string, repo: string, fingerprint: string): Promise<{ number: number; url: string } | null> {
  try {
    const q = encodeURIComponent(`repo:${repo} is:issue is:open "${fingerprint}" in:title`);
    const r = await gh(token, 'GET', `/search/issues?q=${q}&per_page=1`);
    const item = r.ok ? r.json?.items?.[0] : null;
    if (item?.number) return { number: Number(item.number), url: String(item.html_url || '') };
  } catch { /* fall through → create a new issue */ }
  return null;
}

async function createIssue(
  token: string, repo: string, title: string, body: string, labels: string[],
): Promise<{ number: number; url: string } | null> {
  try {
    await ensureLabels(token, repo);
    const r = await gh(token, 'POST', `/repos/${repo}/issues`, { title: title.slice(0, 200), body: body.slice(0, 60000), labels });
    if (r.ok && r.json?.number) return { number: Number(r.json.number), url: String(r.json.html_url || '') };
    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────── crash intake ─────────────────────────── */

export type CrashIntakeResult = { id: number; deduped: boolean; issue_url: string };

export async function reportCrash(db: D1Database, env: ReportsEnv, rawBody: any, ip: string): Promise<CrashIntakeResult> {
  const p = sanitizeCrashPayload(rawBody);
  const fingerprint = await fingerprintOf(p);
  const ipHash = await hashIp(ip);

  const existing = await db.prepare(
    `SELECT id, count, issue_number, issue_url, status FROM crash_reports WHERE fingerprint = ?`
  ).bind(fingerprint).first() as any;

  let id: number;
  let deduped = false;
  if (existing?.id) {
    deduped = true;
    id = Number(existing.id);
    await db.prepare(
      `UPDATE crash_reports SET count = count + 1, last_seen = datetime('now'), version = ?, route = ?, ua = ? WHERE id = ?`
    ).bind(p.version, p.route, p.ua, id).run();
  } else {
    const res = await db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO crash_reports (fingerprint, message, stack, component_stack, route, version, ua, ip_hash, count, status)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 'new')`
    ).bind(fingerprint, p.message, p.stack, p.componentStack, p.route, p.version, p.ua, ipHash).run();
    id = Number((res.meta as any)?.last_row_id || 0);
  }

  const { token, repo } = await githubConfig(env);
  let issueUrl = String(existing?.issue_url || '');
  if (token) {
    const alreadyLinked = existing?.issue_number && existing?.status === 'linked';
    if (!alreadyLinked) {
      const found = await findOpenIssueByFingerprint(token, repo, fingerprint);
      if (found) {
        issueUrl = found.url;
        await db.prepare(`UPDATE crash_reports SET status='linked', issue_number=?, issue_url=? WHERE id=?`)
          .bind(found.number, found.url, id).run();
      } else {
        const body = [
          `**Plantage détecté automatiquement par l'application Atlas Commerce.**`,
          ``,
          `- Empreinte : \`${fingerprint}\``,
          `- Occurrences : ${deduped ? Number(existing?.count || 0) + 1 : 1}`,
          `- Version : ${p.version || '?'}`,
          `- Page : \`${p.route || '?'}\``,
          `- User-Agent : ${p.ua || '?'}`,
          ``,
          `### Message`, '```', p.message, '```',
          p.stack ? `### Stack\n\`\`\`\n${p.stack}\n\`\`\`` : '',
          p.componentStack ? `### Composant React\n\`\`\`\n${p.componentStack}\n\`\`\`` : '',
          ``,
          `> Rapport assaini automatiquement (secrets retirés). Les occurrences suivantes de la même empreinte mettent à jour ce ticket au lieu d'en créer un nouveau.`,
        ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
        const created = await createIssue(token, repo, `[crash ${fingerprint}] ${p.message.slice(0, 100)}`, body, [LABEL_CRASH, LABEL_FROM_APP]);
        if (created) {
          issueUrl = created.url;
          await db.prepare(`UPDATE crash_reports SET status='linked', issue_number=?, issue_url=? WHERE id=?`)
            .bind(created.number, created.url, id).run();
        } else {
          await db.prepare(`UPDATE crash_reports SET status='pending' WHERE id=?`).bind(id).run();
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    // No token yet — keep queued for retryPendingReports() once configured.
    await db.prepare(`UPDATE crash_reports SET status='pending' WHERE id=? AND status='new'`).bind(id).run();
  }
  return { id, deduped, issue_url: issueUrl };
}

/* ─────────────────────────── user reports ─────────────────────────── */

export type UserReportInput = {
  username: string;
  role: string;
  kind: string;
  message: string;
  contact?: string;
  page?: string;
  version?: string;
};

export type UserReportResult = { reference: string; issue_url: string };

export async function reportUser(db: D1Database, env: ReportsEnv, input: UserReportInput): Promise<UserReportResult> {
  const kind = ['bug', 'feedback', 'other'].includes(input.kind) ? input.kind : 'other';
  const message = redactSecrets(String(input.message || '')).slice(0, 2000);
  const contact = redactSecrets(String(input.contact || '')).slice(0, 120);
  const page = redactSecrets(String(input.page || '')).slice(0, 200);
  const version = String(input.version || '').slice(0, 40);

  const res = await db.prepare(
    `INSERT INTO user_reports (username, role, kind, message, contact, page, version, status)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'new')`
  ).bind(String(input.username || '').toLowerCase(), input.role, kind, message, contact, page, version).run();
  const id = Number((res.meta as any)?.last_row_id || 0);
  const reference = `R-${id}`;

  const { token, repo } = await githubConfig(env);
  let issueUrl = '';
  if (token) {
    const body = [
      `**Signalement utilisateur envoyé depuis l'application Atlas Commerce.**`,
      ``,
      `- Référence : \`${reference}\``,
      `- Type : ${kind}`,
      `- Compte : ${input.username || '?'} (rôle : ${input.role || '?'})`,
      page ? `- Page : \`${page}\`` : '',
      version ? `- Version : ${version}` : '',
      contact ? `- Contact laissé : ${contact}` : '',
      ``,
      `### Message`, message,
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    const created = await createIssue(token, repo, `[report:${kind} ${reference}] ${message.slice(0, 90)}`, body, [LABEL_USER, LABEL_FROM_APP]);
    if (created) {
      issueUrl = created.url;
      await db.prepare(`UPDATE user_reports SET status='linked', issue_number=?, issue_url=? WHERE id=?`)
        .bind(created.number, created.url, id).run();
    } else {
      await db.prepare(`UPDATE user_reports SET status='pending' WHERE id=?`).bind(id).run();
    }
  } else {
    await db.prepare(`UPDATE user_reports SET status='pending' WHERE id=?`).bind(id).run();
  }
  return { reference, issue_url: issueUrl };
}

/* ─────────────────────────── queue drain + admin views ─────────────────────────── */

/** Cron + owner button: push queued reports to GitHub once a token exists. */
export async function retryPendingReports(env: ReportsEnv): Promise<{ crashes: number; user_reports: number; skipped: boolean }> {
  const db = env.DB;
  const { token, repo } = await githubConfig(env);
  if (!token) return { crashes: 0, user_reports: 0, skipped: true };

  let crashes = 0;
  let userReports = 0;
  const pendingCrashes = await db.prepare(
    `SELECT id, fingerprint, message, stack, component_stack, route, version, ua, count FROM crash_reports
     WHERE status IN ('new','pending','failed') ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 10`
  ).all() as any;
  for (const row of (pendingCrashes.results || []) as any[]) {
    const found = await findOpenIssueByFingerprint(token, repo, String(row.fingerprint));
    const created = found || await createIssue(token, repo, `[crash ${row.fingerprint}] ${String(row.message).slice(0, 100)}`, [
      `**Plantage détecté automatiquement par l'application Atlas Commerce.** (rattrapage file d'attente)`,
      ``, `- Empreinte : \`${row.fingerprint}\``, `- Occurrences : ${row.count}`, `- Version : ${row.version || '?'}`, `- Page : \`${row.route || '?'}\``,
      ``, `### Message`, '```', String(row.message), '```',
      row.stack ? `### Stack\n\`\`\`\n${String(row.stack).slice(0, 4000)}\n\`\`\`` : '',
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\n'), [LABEL_CRASH, LABEL_FROM_APP]);
    if (created) {
      await db.prepare(`UPDATE crash_reports SET status='linked', issue_number=?, issue_url=? WHERE id=?`)
        .bind(created.number, created.url, Number(row.id)).run();
      crashes++;
    }
  }

  const pendingUser = await db.prepare(
    `SELECT id, username, role, kind, message, contact, page, version FROM user_reports
     WHERE status IN ('new','pending','failed') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10`
  ).all() as any;
  for (const row of (pendingUser.results || []) as any[]) {
    const created = await createIssue(token, repo, `[report:${row.kind} R-${row.id}] ${String(row.message).slice(0, 90)}`, [
      `**Signalement utilisateur envoyé depuis l'application Atlas Commerce.** (rattrapage file d'attente)`,
      ``, `- Référence : \`R-${row.id}\``, `- Type : ${row.kind}`, `- Compte : ${row.username} (rôle : ${row.role})`,
      row.page ? `- Page : \`${row.page}\`` : '', row.version ? `- Version : ${row.version}` : '',
      row.contact ? `- Contact laissé : ${row.contact}` : '', ``, `### Message`, String(row.message),
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\n'), [LABEL_USER, LABEL_FROM_APP]);
    if (created) {
      await db.prepare(`UPDATE user_reports SET status='linked', issue_number=?, issue_url=? WHERE id=?`)
        .bind(created.number, created.url, Number(row.id)).run();
      userReports++;
    }
  }
  return { crashes, user_reports: userReports, skipped: false };
}

/** Owner/admin view — D1 rows only, already sanitized at intake. */
export async function listReports(db: D1Database, limit = 25): Promise<{ crashes: any[]; user_reports: any[]; pending: number }> {
  const cap = Math.min(Math.max(Number(limit) || 25, 1), 100);
  const crashes = await db.prepare(
    `SELECT id, fingerprint, message, route, version, count, status, issue_number, issue_url, first_seen, last_seen
     FROM crash_reports ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT ?`
  ).bind(cap).all() as any;
  const users = await db.prepare(
    `SELECT id, username, role, kind, message, contact, page, version, status, issue_number, issue_url, created_at
     FROM user_reports ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?`
  ).bind(cap).all() as any;
  const pendingRow = await db.prepare(
    `SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crash_reports WHERE status != 'linked') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_reports WHERE status != 'linked') AS n`
  ).first() as any;
  return {
    crashes: (crashes.results || []) as any[],
    user_reports: (users.results || []) as any[],
    pending: Number(pendingRow?.n || 0),
  };
}

/**
 * Shared idempotent schema helpers.
 *
 * Why PRAGMA-first: Cloudflare observability records every failing D1
 * statement as an error span at the binding layer — a JS try/catch around
 * `ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN` silences the exception but still produces
 * `duplicate column name: SQLITE_ERROR` error events on each fresh isolate.
 * Checking PRAGMA table_info first means the failing ALTER is never issued.
 */
export async function addColumnIfMissing(
  db: D1Database,
  table: string,
  column: string,
  typeSql: string,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const info = await db.prepare(`PRAGMA table_info(${table})`).all();
    const rows = (info?.results || []) as { name?: string }[];
    if (rows.some((r) => String(r.name || '').toLowerCase() === column.toLowerCase())) {
      return;
    }
  } catch {
    /* pragma may fail on some bindings — fall through to guarded ALTER */
  }
  try {
    await db.prepare(`ALTER TABLE ${table} ADD COLUMN ${column} ${typeSql}`).run();
  } catch (e: any) {
    const msg = String(e?.message || e || '');
    if (/duplicate column name/i.test(msg) || /already exists/i.test(msg)) return;
    /* schema drift is non-fatal — swallow */
  }
}

/**
 * Phase 2 hardening helpers — rate limits, SSRF allow-list, write guards.
 * Designed for Cloudflare Workers free tier (minimal D1/KV pressure).
 */

/** Hosts allowed for server-side outbound fetch (SSRF protection). */
const ALLOWED_FETCH_HOSTS = new Set([
  'api.resend.com',
  'cdn1.afmarbre.com',
  'catalog.cloudflarestorage.com',
]);

export function assertSafeOutboundUrl(raw: string): URL {
  let u: URL;
  try {
    u = new URL(raw);
  } catch {
    throw new Error('URL invalide');
  }
  if (u.protocol !== 'https:') {
    throw new Error('Seules les URLs HTTPS sont autorisées');
  }
  const host = u.hostname.toLowerCase();
  // Block private / link-local / metadata
  if (
    host === 'localhost' ||
    host === '127.0.0.1' ||
    host === '0.0.0.0' ||
    host === '::1' ||
    host.endsWith('.local') ||
    host.endsWith('.internal') ||
    host.startsWith('10.') ||
    host.startsWith('192.168.') ||
    /^172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[0-1])\./.test(host) ||
    host === '169.254.169.254' ||
    host === 'metadata.google.internal'
  ) {
    throw new Error('Hôte privé ou réservé interdit');
  }
  if (!ALLOWED_FETCH_HOSTS.has(host)) {
    throw new Error(`Hôte non autorisé pour les requêtes sortantes: ${host}`);
  }
  return u;
}

export function isAllowedImageUrl(raw: string): boolean {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'string') return false;
  if (raw.startsWith('data:image/')) return true;
  try {
    const u = new URL(raw);
    if (u.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
    const h = u.hostname.toLowerCase();
    return (
      h === 'cdn1.afmarbre.com' ||
      h === 'stock.afmarbre.com' ||
      h.endsWith('.afmarbre.com') ||
      h.endsWith('.r2.dev') ||
      h.endsWith('.cloudflarestorage.com') ||
      ALLOWED_FETCH_HOSTS.has(h)
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * In-memory rate limit only (per isolate).
 * Avoids KV ops on every auth/admin request (free-tier daily cap).
 */
const memBuckets = new Map<string, { count: number; resetAt: number }>();

export async function rateLimit(
  _kv: KVNamespace | undefined,
  key: string,
  limit: number,
  windowSeconds: number
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; remaining: number; retryAfter?: number }> {
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const windowKey = `rl:${key}:${Math.floor(now / windowSeconds)}`;

  const bucket = memBuckets.get(windowKey);
  if (bucket && bucket.resetAt > now) {
    if (bucket.count >= limit) {
      return { ok: false, remaining: 0, retryAfter: bucket.resetAt - now };
    }
    bucket.count += 1;
    return { ok: true, remaining: Math.max(0, limit - bucket.count) };
  }
  memBuckets.set(windowKey, { count: 1, resetAt: now + windowSeconds });
  if (memBuckets.size > 500) {
    for (const [k, v] of memBuckets) {
      if (v.resetAt <= now) memBuckets.delete(k);
    }
  }
  return { ok: true, remaining: limit - 1 };
}

/** Reject SQL-like strings that look like mass UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE (defense in depth for dynamic builders). */
export function assertHasWhereClause(sql: string): void {
  const s = sql.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (s.startsWith('UPDATE ') || s.startsWith('DELETE ')) {
    if (!/\bWHERE\b/.test(s)) {
      throw new Error('Requête d\'écriture refusée: clause WHERE obligatoire');
    }
  }
}

export function clientIpFromRequest(c: { req: { header: (n: string) => string | undefined } }): string {
  return (
    c.req.header('cf-connecting-ip') ||
    c.req.header('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ||
    c.req.header('x-real-ip') ||
    '0.0.0.0'
  );
}

/**
 * HTML entity escape for server-rendered HTML (public verify pages, invoice HTML).
 * Prevents XSS when interpolating user-controlled fields (names, notes, addresses).
 */
export function escapeHtml(input: unknown): string {
  return String(input ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

/** Safe href/src for images — only https (or data:image) on allow-listed hosts. */
export function safeImageSrc(raw: unknown): string {
  const s = String(raw ?? '').trim();
  if (!s) return '';
  if (!isAllowedImageUrl(s)) return '';
  // Attribute-safe: block quotes that could break out of src="..."
  return s.replace(/"/g, '%22').replace(/'/g, '%27');
}

/**
import { fetchWithTimeout } from './http-client';
 * TokenRa OpenAI-compatible gateway (DeepSeek V4 Flash, etc.)
 * https://tokenra.io — POST /v1/chat/completions
 * Auth: Authorization: Bearer sk-...
 */

const BASES = [
  'https://api.tokenra.io/v1',
  'https://tokenra.io/v1',
];

const MODEL_FALLBACKS = [
  'deepseek-v4-flash',
  'deepseek-chat',
  'deepseek-v4-pro',
  'deepseek-reasoner',
];

export async function tokenraChat(opts: {
  apiKey: string;
  baseUrl?: string;
  model?: string;
  system: string;
  message: string;
  maxTokens?: number;
}): Promise<{ reply: string; model: string }> {
  const preferredBase = (opts.baseUrl || '').trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const bases = [preferredBase, ...BASES].filter((b, i, a) => !!b && a.indexOf(b) === i);
  const preferredModel = (opts.model || '').trim();
  const models = [preferredModel, ...MODEL_FALLBACKS].filter((m, i, a) => !!m && a.indexOf(m) === i);
  const maxTokens = Math.max(64, Math.min(opts.maxTokens ?? 1024, 4096));

  let lastStatus = 0;
  let lastBody = '';

  for (const base of bases) {
    for (const model of models) {
      try {
        const res = await fetchWithTimeout(`${base}/chat/completions`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${opts.apiKey}`,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            Accept: 'application/json',
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            model,
            temperature: 0.3,
            max_tokens: maxTokens,
            stream: false,
            messages: [
              { role: 'system', content: opts.system },
              { role: 'user', content: opts.message },
            ],
          }),
        });

        const raw = await res.text().catch(() => '');
        lastStatus = res.status;
        lastBody = raw.slice(0, 300);

        if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
          throw new Error('Atlas Agent: clé TokenRa refusée. Vérifiez TOKENRA_API_KEY dans Wrangler.');
        }
        if (res.status === 429) {
          throw new Error('Atlas Agent saturé (TokenRa). Réessayez dans une minute.');
        }
        // 404 model → try next model
        if (res.status === 404 || res.status === 400) {
          const low = raw.toLowerCase();
          if (low.includes('model') || low.includes('not found') || low.includes('invalid')) {
            continue;
          }
        }
        // 502/503/520/521/522/530 = gateway / origin down → try next base
        if (res.status >= 500) {
          continue;
        }
        if (!res.ok) continue;

        let data: any = {};
        try {
          data = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch {
          continue;
        }

        let text = String(data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '').trim();
        if (!text) {
          text = String(data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.reasoning_content || '').trim();
        }
        if (!text && data?.error?.message) {
          lastBody = String(data.error.message);
          continue;
        }
        if (!text) continue;

        text = text
          .replace(/\b(Google|Gemini|Mistral|OpenAI|ChatGPT|Claude|DeepSeek|TokenRa)\b/gi, 'Atlas Agent')
          .trim();

        return { reply: text, model: String(data?.model || model) };
      } catch (e: any) {
        const msg = String(e?.message || e);
        if (msg.includes('clé TokenRa') || msg.includes('saturé')) throw e;
        lastBody = msg.slice(0, 200);
        continue;
      }
    }
  }

  if (lastStatus === 530 || lastStatus === 520 || lastStatus === 522) {
    throw new Error(
      'TokenRa inaccessible (passerelle). Vérifiez le modèle activé sur la clé, ou réessayez plus tard.',
    );
  }
  if (lastStatus === 404 || lastStatus === 400) {
    throw new Error(
      'Modèle TokenRa introuvable. Activez deepseek-v4-flash sur la clé, ou définissez TOKENRA_MODEL.',
    );
  }
  if (lastStatus) {
    throw new Error(`Atlas Agent indisponible (HTTP ${lastStatus}).`);
  }
  throw new Error('Atlas Agent indisponible (TokenRa). Réessayez.');
}

/**
 * Upstream HTTP resilience for Workers (Groq, GitHub, mail APIs, …).
 * - timeout via AbortSignal
 * - retry with exponential backoff on 429 / 502 / 503 / network errors
 * - circuit breaker per named upstream (no Redis — isolate memory)
 */

import { circuitAllow, circuitFailure, circuitSuccess } from './circuit-breaker';

export type UpstreamOptions = {
  timeoutMs?: number;
  retries?: number;
  retryOn?: number[];
  label?: string;
};

const DEFAULT_RETRY = [429, 502, 503, 504];

function sleep(ms: number) {
  return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
}

export async function upstreamFetch(
  url: string,
  init: RequestInit = {},
  opts: UpstreamOptions = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  const timeoutMs = opts.timeoutMs ?? 12_000;
  const retries = opts.retries ?? 2;
  const retryOn = opts.retryOn ?? DEFAULT_RETRY;
  const label = opts.label || new URL(url).hostname;
  let lastErr: unknown;

  if (!circuitAllow(label)) {
    throw new Error(`Circuit ouvert (${label}) — réessayez dans un instant`);
  }

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= retries; attempt++) {
    const ac = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), timeoutMs);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { ...init, signal: ac.signal });
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (retryOn.includes(res.status) && attempt < retries) {
        const ra = Number(res.headers.get('retry-after'));
        const backoff = Number.isFinite(ra) && ra > 0 ? ra * 1000 : 300 * 2 ** attempt;
        await sleep(Math.min(backoff, 5000));
        continue;
      }
      if (res.ok) circuitSuccess(label);
      else if (res.status >= 500 || res.status === 429) circuitFailure(label);
      else circuitSuccess(label);
      return res;
    } catch (e) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      lastErr = e;
      if (attempt < retries) {
        await sleep(300 * 2 ** attempt);
        continue;
      }
      circuitFailure(label);
      throw e;
    }
  }
  circuitFailure(label);
  throw lastErr instanceof Error ? lastErr : new Error('upstream failed');
}

/**
 * Lightweight input validation (no Zod dependency — Workers-friendly).
 * Use on write endpoints; return first error string or null if ok.
 */

export type FieldErrors = Record<string, string>;

export function requireString(v: unknown, field: string, opts?: { min?: number; max?: number }): string | null {
  if (v == null || typeof v !== 'string') return `${field} est requis`;
  const s = v.trim();
  if (!s) return `${field} est requis`;
  if (opts?.min != null && s.length < opts.min) return `${field} trop court (min ${opts.min})`;
  if (opts?.max != null && s.length > opts.max) return `${field} trop long (max ${opts.max})`;
  return null;
}

export function optionalString(v: unknown, field: string, opts?: { max?: number }): string | null {
  if (v == null || v === '') return null;
  if (typeof v !== 'string') return `${field} invalide`;
  if (opts?.max != null && v.length > opts.max) return `${field} trop long (max ${opts.max})`;
  return null;
}

export function requireNumber(v: unknown, field: string, opts?: { min?: number; max?: number }): string | null {
  const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(v);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return `${field} doit être un nombre`;
  if (opts?.min != null && n < opts.min) return `${field} trop petit (min ${opts.min})`;
  if (opts?.max != null && n > opts.max) return `${field} trop grand (max ${opts.max})`;
  return null;
}

export function requireEmail(v: unknown, field = 'email'): string | null {
  const base = requireString(v, field, { max: 254 });
  if (base) return base;
  const s = String(v).trim();
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(s)) return `${field} invalide`;
  return null;
}

export function requireId(v: unknown, field = 'id'): string | null {
  const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(v);
  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n <= 0) return `${field} invalide`;
  return null;
}

/** Collect first error from a list of checks (null = ok). */
export function firstError(...checks: Array<string | null | undefined>): string | null {
  for (const e of checks) if (e) return e;
  return null;
}

/** Merge field errors; return null if none. */
export function collectErrors(fields: FieldErrors): FieldErrors | null {
  const out: FieldErrors = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(fields)) {
    if (v) out[k] = v;
  }
  return Object.keys(out).length ? out : null;
}

/** Domain validators for write APIs */

export function validateClientWrite(body: any): FieldErrors | null {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  const nameErr = requireString(body?.name, 'name', { min: 1, max: 200 });
  if (nameErr) errors.name = nameErr;
  const email = body?.email;
  if (email != null && String(email).trim()) {
    const e = requireEmail(email, 'email');
    if (e) errors.email = e;
  }
  if (body?.credit_limit != null && body.credit_limit !== '') {
    const n = requireNumber(body.credit_limit, 'credit_limit', { min: 0, max: 1e12 });
    if (n) errors.credit_limit = n;
  }
  if (body?.phone != null && String(body.phone).length > 40) errors.phone = 'phone trop long';
  if (body?.ice != null && String(body.ice).length > 40) errors.ice = 'ICE trop long';
  return collectErrors(errors);
}

export function validateProductWrite(body: any): FieldErrors | null {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  const nameErr = requireString(body?.name, 'name', { min: 1, max: 200 });
  if (nameErr) errors.name = nameErr;
  if (body?.sku != null && String(body.sku).length > 80) errors.sku = 'sku trop long';
  if (body?.price != null && body.price !== '') {
    const n = requireNumber(body.price, 'price', { min: 0, max: 1e12 });
    if (n) errors.price = n;
  }
  if (body?.cost != null && body.cost !== '') {
    const n = requireNumber(body.cost, 'cost', { min: 0, max: 1e12 });
    if (n) errors.cost = n;
  }
  if (body?.stock_quantity != null && body.stock_quantity !== '') {
    const n = requireNumber(body.stock_quantity, 'stock_quantity', { min: 0, max: 1e9 });
    if (n) errors.stock_quantity = n;
  }
  return collectErrors(errors);
}

export function validateInvoiceWrite(body: any): FieldErrors | null {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  const nameErr = requireString(body?.client_name, 'client_name', { min: 1, max: 200 });
  if (nameErr) errors.client_name = nameErr;
  if (!Array.isArray(body?.items) || body.items.length === 0) {
    errors.items = 'Au moins une ligne est obligatoire';
  } else {
    let okLine = false;
    for (const it of body.items) {
      const qty = Number(it?.quantity ?? 0);
      if (qty > 0) okLine = true;
    }
    if (!okLine) errors.items = 'Chaque ligne doit avoir une quantité > 0';
  }
  return collectErrors(errors);
}

export function validateVendorWrite(body: any): FieldErrors | null {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  const nameErr = requireString(body?.name, 'name', { min: 1, max: 200 });
  if (nameErr) errors.name = nameErr;
  if (body?.email != null && String(body.email).trim()) {
    const e = requireEmail(body.email, 'email');
    if (e) errors.email = e;
  }
  return collectErrors(errors);
}

export function validateExpenseWrite(body: any): FieldErrors | null {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  const n = requireNumber(body?.amount, 'amount', { min: 0.01, max: 1e12 });
  if (n) errors.amount = n;
  if (body?.label != null || body?.description != null || body?.title != null) {
    const label = body.label ?? body.description ?? body.title;
    const e = optionalString(label, 'label', { max: 300 });
    if (e) errors.label = e;
  }
  return collectErrors(errors);
}

export function validateReceiptWrite(body: any): FieldErrors | null {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  const amount = body?.amount ?? body?.total;
  const n = requireNumber(amount, 'amount', { min: 0.01, max: 1e12 });
  if (n) errors.amount = n;
  return collectErrors(errors);
}

export function validateBillWrite(body: any): FieldErrors | null {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  if (!Array.isArray(body?.items) || !body.items.length) {
    errors.items = 'Au moins une ligne est obligatoire';
  }
  if (body?.vendor_name != null) {
    const e = optionalString(body.vendor_name, 'vendor_name', { max: 200 });
    if (e) errors.vendor_name = e;
  }
  return collectErrors(errors);
}

/**
 * v259 — WebAuthn verifier (registration + authentication), written to the
 * W3C WebAuthn Level 2 verification procedures. Replaces the pre-v259 routes
 * that accepted client-submitted fields without cryptographic proof (no
 * attestation parsing, no signature check, no stored public key).
 *
 * Security properties enforced here (see docs/webauthn.md):
 *  - challenges: 32 crypto-random bytes, purpose-bound (register|login),
 *    bound to username (register / filtered login), RP id and expected
 *    origin; 5-minute expiry; ATOMIC single use (conditional UPDATE,
 *    consumed flag) — expired, replayed or mismatched challenges fail;
 *  - registration: clientData type `webauthn.create`, challenge echo,
 *    exact origin match, crossOrigin false, rpIdHash = SHA-256(rpId),
 *    UP flag required, UV per policy, AT flag required, attestation policy
 *    explicit (`none` only — any other fmt rejected), COSE key restricted to
 *    EC2 / P-256 / ES256; credential id uniqueness enforced by the caller's
 *    INSERT (PK);
 *  - authentication: clientData type `webauthn.get`, challenge echo, exact
 *    origin, crossOrigin false, rpIdHash, UP (+UV per policy), ES256
 *    signature over authenticatorData ‖ SHA-256(clientDataJSON) verified with
 *    the STORED public key, clone-safe counter rule that accepts stable-zero
 *    counters only for backup-eligible (synced) passkeys, userHandle bound to
 *    the stored account;
 *  - nothing session-like is ever issued from this module; routes issue
 *    tokens only after verifyAuthentication/verifyRegistration return ok.
 */

export class WebAuthnError extends Error {
  code: string;
  constructor(code: string, message?: string) {
    super(message || code);
    this.code = code;
  }
}

/* ────────────────────────────── encoding ────────────────────────────── */

export function b64uToBytes(s: string): Uint8Array {
  const b64 = String(s || '').replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/').trim();
  if (!b64) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'empty base64url');
  const pad = b64.length % 4 === 0 ? '' : '='.repeat(4 - (b64.length % 4));
  const bin = atob(b64 + pad);
  const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return out;
}

export function bytesToB64u(b: Uint8Array): string {
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) s += String.fromCharCode(b[i]);
  return btoa(s).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}

export function bytesToHex(b: Uint8Array): string {
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) s += b[i].toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  return s;
}

export async function sha256(bytes: Uint8Array | string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const data = typeof bytes === 'string' ? new TextEncoder().encode(bytes) : bytes;
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data as unknown as BufferSource);
  return new Uint8Array(buf);
}

export function timingSafeEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  const x = new TextEncoder().encode(a);
  const y = new TextEncoder().encode(b);
  if (x.length !== y.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) diff |= x[i] ^ y[i];
  return diff === 0;
}

/* ────────────────────────────── minimal CBOR ──────────────────────────────
 * Enough for attestation objects and COSE_Key maps (RFC 8949): unsigned/
 * negative ints, byte/text strings, arrays, maps, tags, simple values.
 * Not a general-purpose decoder: depth- and size-bounded. */

type CborValue = number | string | Uint8Array | CborValue[] | Map<CborValue, CborValue> | boolean | null;

function cborDecode(input: Uint8Array): { value: CborValue; offset: number } {
  let o = 0;
  const readArg = (add: number): bigint | number => {
    const ai = add;
    if (ai < 24) return ai;
    if (ai === 24) return input[o++];
    if (ai === 25) { const v = (input[o] << 8) | input[o + 1]; o += 2; return v; }
    if (ai === 26) { const v = ((input[o] * 0x1000000) + ((input[o + 1] << 16) | (input[o + 2] << 8) | input[o + 3])); o += 4; return v; }
    if (ai === 27) { let v = 0n; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) v = (v << 8n) | BigInt(input[o + i]); o += 8; return v; }
    throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'cbor bad additional info');
  };
  const decodeOne = (depth: number): CborValue => {
    if (depth > 8 || o >= input.length) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'cbor depth/length');
    const ib = input[o++];
    const mt = ib >> 5;
    const ai = ib & 31;
    if (mt === 0) return Number(readArg(ai));
    if (mt === 1) { const v = readArg(ai); return -1 - Number(v); }
    if (mt === 2) { const n = Number(readArg(ai)); const v = input.slice(o, o + n); o += n; return v; }
    if (mt === 3) { const n = Number(readArg(ai)); const v = new TextDecoder().decode(input.slice(o, o + n)); o += n; return v; }
    if (mt === 4) { const n = Number(readArg(ai)); const arr: CborValue[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) arr.push(decodeOne(depth + 1)); return arr; }
    if (mt === 5) { const n = Number(readArg(ai)); const m = new Map<CborValue, CborValue>(); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const k = decodeOne(depth + 1); const v = decodeOne(depth + 1); m.set(k, v); } return m; }
    if (mt === 6) { readArg(ai); return decodeOne(depth + 1); }
    if (mt === 7) {
      if (ai === 20) return false;
      if (ai === 21) return true;
      if (ai === 22 || ai === 23) return null;
      throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'cbor simple/float unsupported');
    }
    throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'cbor major type');
  };
  const value = decodeOne(0);
  return { value, offset: o };
}

function mapGet(m: Map<CborValue, CborValue>, key: number | string): CborValue | undefined {
  for (const [k, v] of m) if ((typeof k === 'number' || typeof k === 'string') && k === key) return v;
  return undefined;
}

/* ───────────────────────── authenticator data ───────────────────────── */

export type ParsedAuthData = {
  raw: Uint8Array;
  rpIdHash: Uint8Array;
  flags: number;
  counter: number;
  up: boolean;
  uv: boolean;
  at: boolean;
  be: boolean;
  bs: boolean;
  aaguid?: string;
  credentialId?: string;
  credentialPublicKeyJwk?: { kty: string; crv: string; x: string; y: string; alg: string };
};

const FLAG_UP = 0x01;
const FLAG_UV = 0x04;
const FLAG_BE = 0x08;
const FLAG_BS = 0x10;
const FLAG_AT = 0x40;

export function parseAuthenticatorData(raw: Uint8Array): ParsedAuthData {
  if (raw.length < 37) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'authData too short');
  const rpIdHash = raw.slice(0, 32);
  const flags = raw[32];
  const counter = ((raw[33] << 24) | (raw[34] << 16) | (raw[35] << 8) | raw[36]) >>> 0;
  const out: ParsedAuthData = {
    raw,
    rpIdHash,
    flags,
    counter,
    up: (flags & FLAG_UP) === FLAG_UP,
    uv: (flags & FLAG_UV) === FLAG_UV,
    at: (flags & FLAG_AT) === FLAG_AT,
    be: (flags & FLAG_BE) === FLAG_BE,
    bs: (flags & FLAG_BS) === FLAG_BS,
  };
  if (out.at) {
    if (raw.length < 55) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'authData attested too short');
    out.aaguid = bytesToHex(raw.slice(37, 53));
    const credLen = (raw[53] << 8) | raw[54];
    if (raw.length < 55 + credLen) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'credId truncated');
    const credId = raw.slice(55, 55 + credLen);
    out.credentialId = bytesToB64u(credId);
    const rest = raw.slice(55 + credLen);
    const { value } = cborDecode(rest);
    if (!(value instanceof Map)) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'COSE_Key not a map');
    const kty = mapGet(value, 1);
    const alg = mapGet(value, 3);
    const crv = mapGet(value, -1);
    const x = mapGet(value, -2);
    const y = mapGet(value, -3);
    // Explicit algorithm policy: EC2 + P-256 + ES256 only.
    if (kty !== 2 || alg !== -7 || crv !== 1) {
      throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_UNSUPPORTED_ALG', 'only EC2 P-256 ES256 credentials are accepted');
    }
    if (!(x instanceof Uint8Array) || !(y instanceof Uint8Array) || x.length !== 32 || y.length !== 32) {
      throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'COSE_Key coordinates');
    }
    out.credentialPublicKeyJwk = { kty: 'EC', crv: 'P-256', x: bytesToB64u(x), y: bytesToB64u(y), alg: 'ES256' };
  }
  return out;
}

/* ────────────────────────────── client data ────────────────────────────── */

export type ParsedClientData = { type: string; challenge: string; origin: string; crossOrigin: boolean; androidPackageName: string | null };

export function parseClientData(b64u: string): { json: ParsedClientData; raw: Uint8Array } {
  let raw: Uint8Array;
  let parsed: any;
  try {
    raw = b64uToBytes(b64u);
    parsed = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(raw));
  } catch {
    throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED_CLIENTDATA', 'clientDataJSON unreadable');
  }
  if (typeof parsed?.type !== 'string' || typeof parsed?.challenge !== 'string' || typeof parsed?.origin !== 'string') {
    throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED_CLIENTDATA', 'clientDataJSON missing fields');
  }
  return {
    raw,
    json: {
      type: parsed.type,
      challenge: parsed.challenge,
      origin: parsed.origin,
      crossOrigin: parsed.crossOrigin === true,
      // Native Credential Manager assertions may carry the requesting package.
      androidPackageName: typeof parsed.androidPackageName === 'string' ? parsed.androidPackageName : null,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Origin acceptance (exact match, allowlist-driven):
 *  - the native Android Credential Manager origin
 *    `android:apk-key-hash-sha256:<base64url(SHA-256(signing-cert DER))>` derived
 *    from WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_CERT_HASH — accepted only when the Android package is
 *    configured (the cert hash IS the Play signing key fingerprint, so this ties
 *    the assertion to the allowlisted APK signature);
 *  - any allowlisted web origin with crossOrigin=false (browser flows);
 *  - an allowlisted web origin with crossOrigin=true ONLY when the Android
 *    integration is configured and clientDataJSON.androidPackageName equals that
 *    package (androidx.credentials lets the app pass the web origin explicitly;
 *    the provider then marks the assertion cross-origin and names the package).
 */
function checkClientData(cd: ParsedClientData, expectedType: string, expectedChallenge: string, policy: WebAuthnPolicy): void {
  if (cd.type !== expectedType) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_BAD_TYPE', `clientData type ${cd.type}`);
  if (!timingSafeEqual(cd.challenge, expectedChallenge)) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_BAD_CHALLENGE', 'clientData challenge mismatch');
  if (matchesAndroidOrigin(cd.origin, policy)) return;
  if (policy.origins.includes(cd.origin)) {
    if (cd.crossOrigin && !(policy.androidPackage && cd.androidPackageName === policy.androidPackage)) {
      throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_CROSS_ORIGIN', 'cross-origin assertion');
    }
    return;
  }
  throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_BAD_ORIGIN', `origin ${cd.origin}`);
}

/* ────────────────────────────── registration ────────────────────────────── */

export type RegistrationInput = {
  clientDataJSON: string;
  attestationObject: string;
  expectedChallenge: string;
  /** Origin/RP/UV/attestation acceptance comes from the server-side policy. */
  policy: WebAuthnPolicy;
};

export type VerifiedRegistration = {
  credentialId: string;
  publicKeyJwk: { kty: string; crv: string; x: string; y: string; alg: string };
  counter: number;
  backupEligible: boolean;
  backupState: boolean;
  aaguid: string;
  fmt: string;
};

export async function verifyRegistration(input: RegistrationInput): Promise<VerifiedRegistration> {
  const cd = parseClientData(input.clientDataJSON);
  checkClientData(cd.json, 'webauthn.create', input.expectedChallenge, input.policy);

  let att: any;
  try {
    att = cborDecode(b64uToBytes(input.attestationObject)).value;
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof WebAuthnError && e.code === 'WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED') throw e;
    throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'attestationObject unreadable');
  }
  if (!(att instanceof Map)) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'attestationObject not a map');
  const fmt = mapGet(att, 'fmt');
  const authDataRaw = mapGet(att, 'authData');
  // Explicit attestation policy: `none` only. Anything else (packed/fido-u2f/…)
  // is rejected rather than half-verified.
  if (input.policy.attestation === 'none' && fmt !== 'none') {
    throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_BAD_ATTESTATION', `fmt ${String(fmt)} not allowed by policy`);
  }
  if (!(authDataRaw instanceof Uint8Array)) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'authData missing');

  const ad = parseAuthenticatorData(authDataRaw);
  const rpIdHash = await sha256(input.policy.rpId);
  if (bytesToHex(ad.rpIdHash) !== bytesToHex(rpIdHash)) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_BAD_RPID', 'rpIdHash mismatch');
  if (!ad.up) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MISSING_FLAGS', 'UP flag required');
  if (input.policy.requireUV && !ad.uv) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MISSING_FLAGS', 'UV flag required by policy');
  if (!ad.at || !ad.credentialId || !ad.credentialPublicKeyJwk) {
    throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MALFORMED', 'attested credential data missing');
  }
  return {
    credentialId: ad.credentialId,
    publicKeyJwk: ad.credentialPublicKeyJwk,
    counter: ad.counter,
    backupEligible: ad.be,
    backupState: ad.bs,
    aaguid: ad.aaguid || '',
    fmt: String(fmt),
  };
}

/* ────────────────────────────── authentication ────────────────────────────── */

export type AuthenticationInput = {
  clientDataJSON: string;
  authenticatorData: string;
  signature: string;
  userHandle?: string;
  expectedChallenge: string;
  /** Origin/RP/UV acceptance comes from the server-side policy. */
  policy: WebAuthnPolicy;
  stored: {
    publicKeyJwk: { kty: string; crv: string; x: string; y: string; alg: string };
    counter: number;
    backupEligible: boolean;
    userHandle: string;
  };
};

export type VerifiedAuthentication = { counter: number; backupState: boolean; uv: boolean };

export async function verifyAuthentication(input: AuthenticationInput): Promise<VerifiedAuthentication> {
  const cd = parseClientData(input.clientDataJSON);
  checkClientData(cd.json, 'webauthn.get', input.expectedChallenge, input.policy);

  const ad = parseAuthenticatorData(b64uToBytes(input.authenticatorData));
  const rpIdHash = await sha256(input.policy.rpId);
  if (bytesToHex(ad.rpIdHash) !== bytesToHex(rpIdHash)) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_BAD_RPID', 'rpIdHash mismatch');
  if (!ad.up) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MISSING_FLAGS', 'UP flag required');
  if (input.policy.requireUV && !ad.uv) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_MISSING_FLAGS', 'UV flag required by policy');

  if (input.userHandle !== undefined && input.userHandle !== '') {
    if (!timingSafeEqual(String(input.userHandle), input.stored.userHandle)) {
      throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_WRONG_ACCOUNT', 'userHandle does not match the credential account');
    }
  }

  // Signature over authenticatorData ‖ SHA-256(clientDataJSON), ES256.
  const clientHash = await sha256(cd.raw);
  const signed = new Uint8Array(ad.raw.length + clientHash.length);
  signed.set(ad.raw, 0);
  signed.set(clientHash, ad.raw.length);
  const jwk = input.stored.publicKeyJwk;
  if (!jwk || jwk.kty !== 'EC' || jwk.crv !== 'P-256' || jwk.alg !== 'ES256') {
    throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_UNSUPPORTED_ALG', 'stored key is not ES256 P-256');
  }
  let key: CryptoKey;
  try {
    key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
      'jwk',
      { kty: jwk.kty, crv: jwk.crv, x: jwk.x, y: jwk.y, ext: true } as JsonWebKey,
      { name: 'ECDSA', namedCurve: 'P-256' },
      false,
      ['verify'],
    );
  } catch {
    throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_BAD_KEY', 'stored public key unusable');
  }
  let sig: Uint8Array;
  try {
    sig = b64uToBytes(input.signature);
  } catch {
    throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_BAD_SIGNATURE', 'signature not base64url');
  }
  const ok = await crypto.subtle.verify(
    { name: 'ECDSA', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    key,
    sig as unknown as BufferSource,
    signed as unknown as BufferSource,
  );
  if (!ok) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_BAD_SIGNATURE', 'signature verification failed');

  // Clone detection: counters must advance, except synced passkeys
  // (backup-eligible) which legitimately keep a zero counter.
  const stored = Number(input.stored.counter || 0);
  const next = ad.counter;
  if (!(next > stored)) {
    const syncedZero = input.stored.backupEligible && next === 0 && stored === 0;
    if (!syncedZero) throw new WebAuthnError('WEBAUTHN_COUNTER', 'signature counter did not advance (possible clone)');
  }
  return { counter: next, backupState: ad.bs, uv: ad.uv };
}

/* ────────────────────────────── challenges ────────────────────────────── */

export type ChallengePurpose = 'register' | 'login';

export type ChallengeRow = {
  id: string;
  challenge: string;
  purpose: ChallengePurpose;
  username: string;
  rp_id: string;
  origin: string;
  expires_at: string;
};

function randomBytes(n: number): Uint8Array {
  const b = new Uint8Array(n);
  crypto.getRandomValues(b);
  return b;
}

/** Unpredictable, purpose-bound, account/RP/origin-bound, 5-minute challenge. */
export async function createChallenge(
  db: D1Database,
  opts: { purpose: ChallengePurpose; username: string; rpId: string; origin: string; ttlMs?: number },
): Promise<string> {
  const challenge = bytesToB64u(randomBytes(32));
  const id = bytesToB64u(randomBytes(16));
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + (opts.ttlMs ?? 5 * 60 * 1000)).toISOString();
  await db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO webauthn_challenges (id, challenge, fingerprint, purpose, username, rp_id, origin, expires_at, consumed)
       VALUES (?, ?, '', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)`,
    )
    .bind(id, challenge, opts.purpose, String(opts.username || '').toLowerCase(), opts.rpId, opts.origin, expiresAt)
    .run();
  return challenge;
}

/**
 * Atomic single use: the conditional UPDATE is the lock — two concurrent
 * verifies can never both see changes=1. Returns the consumed row context or
 * null when expired / replayed / mismatched.
 */
export async function consumeChallenge(
  db: D1Database,
  opts: { challenge: string; purpose: ChallengePurpose; rpId: string; origin: string; username?: string },
): Promise<{ username: string } | null> {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  if (opts.username !== undefined) {
    const username = String(opts.username || '').toLowerCase();
    const res = await db
      .prepare(
        `UPDATE webauthn_challenges SET consumed = 1, consumed_at = ?6
         WHERE purpose = ?1 AND rp_id = ?2 AND origin = ?3 AND challenge = ?4
           AND lower(username) = ?5 AND consumed = 0 AND expires_at > ?6`,
      )
      .bind(opts.purpose, opts.rpId, opts.origin, opts.challenge, username, now)
      .run();
    if (Number((res as any)?.meta?.changes ?? 0) !== 1) return null;
    return { username };
  }
  const res = await db
    .prepare(
      `UPDATE webauthn_challenges SET consumed = 1, consumed_at = ?5
       WHERE purpose = ?1 AND rp_id = ?2 AND origin = ?3 AND challenge = ?4
         AND consumed = 0 AND expires_at > ?5`,
    )
    .bind(opts.purpose, opts.rpId, opts.origin, opts.challenge, now)
    .run();
  if (Number((res as any)?.meta?.changes ?? 0) !== 1) return null;
  // Discoverable login: read back the bound username (row already consumed).
  const row = await db
    .prepare(`SELECT username FROM webauthn_challenges WHERE challenge = ? AND purpose = ? LIMIT 1`)
    .bind(opts.challenge, opts.purpose)
    .first() as any;
  return { username: String(row?.username || '').toLowerCase() };
}

/** Opaque, stable per-account user handle (never the raw username on the wire). */
export async function userHandleFor(username: string): Promise<string> {
  const h = await sha256(`atlas-wa-v1|${String(username || '').toLowerCase()}`);
  return bytesToB64u(h.slice(0, 16));
}

/* ────────────────────────────── policy ────────────────────────────── */

export type WebAuthnPolicy = {
  enabled: boolean;
  rpId: string;
  rpName: string;
  origins: string[];
  requireUV: boolean;
  attestation: 'none';
  androidPackage: string;
  androidCertHash: string;
  /** v0.7 — ALL accepted SHA-256 signing fingerprints (comma-separated env). */
  androidCertHashes: string[];
  /** Optional SHA-1 fingerprint — legacy `android:apk-key-hash:` origin format. */
  androidCertSha1: string;
};

export function policyFromEnv(env: Record<string, string | undefined>): WebAuthnPolicy {
  const origins = String(env.WEBAUTHN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS || 'https://stock.afmarbre.com')
    .split(',')
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
  return {
    enabled: String(env.WEBAUTHN_ENABLED || 'false').toLowerCase() === 'true',
    rpId: String(env.WEBAUTHN_RP_ID || 'stock.afmarbre.com').trim(),
    rpName: String(env.WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME || 'Atlas Commerce').trim(),
    origins,
    requireUV: String(env.WEBAUTHN_REQUIRE_UV || 'required').toLowerCase() !== 'preferred',
    attestation: 'none',
    androidPackage: String(env.WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_PACKAGE || '').trim(),
    androidCertHash: (
      String(env.WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_CERT_HASH || '')
        .split(',')
        .map((s) => s.trim().toUpperCase())
        .filter(Boolean)[0] || ''
    ),
    androidCertHashes: String(env.WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_CERT_HASH || '')
      .split(',')
      .map((s) => s.trim().toUpperCase())
      .filter(Boolean),
    androidCertSha1: String(env.WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_CERT_SHA1 || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
  };
}

/** The canonical web origin of this deployment (first allowlisted entry). */
export function expectedOrigin(policy: WebAuthnPolicy): string {
  return policy.origins[0] || 'https://stock.afmarbre.com';
}

/** Fingerprint hex (colon-separated or plain) → raw bytes, or null. */
function certHashBytes(hex: string, hexLen: number): Uint8Array | null {
  const h = String(hex || '').replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, '').toUpperCase();
  if (h.length !== hexLen) return null;
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(hexLen / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < hexLen / 2; i++) bytes[i] = Number.parseInt(h.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
  return bytes;
}

/** Decode base64 tolerantly: url-safe or standard alphabet, padded or not. */
function b64DecodeLoose(value: string): Uint8Array | null {
  try {
    return b64uToBytes(String(value).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, ''));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Native Android Credential Manager origin for a signing-cert SHA-256
 * fingerprint: `android:apk-key-hash-sha256:<base64url(fingerprint bytes)>`
 * (the fingerprint IS sha256(cert DER), per the WebAuthn origin format).
 * Accepts colon-separated or plain hex; returns null when malformed.
 */
export function androidOriginFromCertHash(certHash: string): string | null {
  const bytes = certHashBytes(certHash, 64);
  return bytes ? `android:apk-key-hash-sha256:${bytesToB64u(bytes)}` : null;
}

/**
 * Legacy FIDO2/GMS origin format documented by Android:
 * `android:apk-key-hash:<base64(SHA-1(signing cert DER))>` — derived from the
 * optional WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_CERT_SHA1 fingerprint.
 */
export function androidLegacyOriginFromSha1(sha1Hex: string): string | null {
  const bytes = certHashBytes(sha1Hex, 40);
  return bytes ? `android:apk-key-hash:${bytesToB64u(bytes)}` : null;
}

/** The primary (sha256) android origin accepted, or null when not configured. */
export function androidOrigin(policy: WebAuthnPolicy): string | null {
  if (!policy.androidPackage || !policy.androidCertHash) return null;
  return androidOriginFromCertHash(policy.androidCertHash);
}

/**
 * v0.7 — credential descriptors for excludeCredentials (register) and
 * allowCredentials (login): ONLY rows that still carry stored verification
 * material (public_key_jwk). Legacy pre-v259 rows without a public key can
 * never pass verification, so they must not block re-registration — and no
 * row is ever deleted here. Single source of truth for both options routes.
 */
export async function credentialDescriptors(
  db: { prepare: (sql: string) => any },
  username: string,
): Promise<{ type: 'public-key'; id: string; transports: string[] }[]> {
  const q = await db
    .prepare(
      `SELECT id, transports FROM webauthn_credentials
       WHERE lower(username) = ?
         AND COALESCE(public_key_jwk, '') != ''`,
    )
    .bind(String(username || '').toLowerCase())
    .all();
  return ((q?.results || []) as any[]).map((r: any) => ({
    type: 'public-key' as const,
    id: String(r.id),
    transports: String(r.transports || '').split(',').filter(Boolean),
  }));
}

/** v0.7 — every accepted sha256 android origin (one per configured fingerprint). */
export function androidOrigins(policy: WebAuthnPolicy): string[] {
  if (!policy.androidPackage) return [];
  return policy.androidCertHashes
    .map((h) => androidOriginFromCertHash(h))
    .filter((o): o is string => !!o);
}

/** The legacy (sha1) android origin accepted, or null when not configured. */
export function androidLegacyOrigin(policy: WebAuthnPolicy): string | null {
  if (!policy.androidPackage || !policy.androidCertSha1) return null;
  return androidLegacyOriginFromSha1(policy.androidCertSha1);
}

/**
 * Byte-level acceptance of BOTH documented native origin formats — string
 * comparison alone is not enough: Android docs reference `android:apk-key-hash:`
 * (SHA-1) while Credential Manager emits `android:apk-key-hash-sha256:`, and
 * encodings differ (base64 vs base64url, padding). We decode the suffix and
 * compare RAW BYTES against the configured fingerprints, so any encoding of the
 * correct hash matches — and only the correct hash matches.
 */
export function matchesAndroidOrigin(origin: string, policy: WebAuthnPolicy): boolean {
  if (!policy.androidPackage || typeof origin !== 'string') return false;
  const P256 = 'android:apk-key-hash-sha256:';
  const P1 = 'android:apk-key-hash:';
  if (origin.startsWith(P256)) {
    const got = b64DecodeLoose(origin.slice(P256.length));
    if (!got || got.length !== 32) return false;
    // v0.7 — any configured signing fingerprint matches (Play + release keys).
    return policy.androidCertHashes.some((h) => {
      const expected = certHashBytes(h, 64);
      return !!expected && bytesToHex(got) === bytesToHex(expected);
    });
  }
  if (origin.startsWith(P1)) {
    const expected = certHashBytes(policy.androidCertSha1, 40);
    const got = b64DecodeLoose(origin.slice(P1.length));
    return !!expected && !!got && got.length === 20 && bytesToHex(got) === bytesToHex(expected);
  }
  return false;
}

# Repositories layer

All SQL / D1 access should eventually live here.

- Accept typed params only (never raw client JSON).
- Catch driver errors and rethrow `AppError('INTERNAL')` — never bubble SQL text.
- Keep queries small and named (`listProducts`, `getInvoiceById`, …).

/**
 * Products repository — all product SQL lives here.
 * Never return raw driver errors; wrap as AppError INTERNAL.
 */
import type { Env } from '../env';
import { AppError } from '../lib/errors';
import { searchProducts as ftsSearch } from '../lib/reliability';

export type ProductRow = Record<string, unknown>;

export async function listProducts(
  env: Env,
  opts: { q?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number } = {},
): Promise<ProductRow[]> {
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(1, opts.limit ?? 100), 500);
  const offset = Math.max(0, opts.offset ?? 0);
  const q = (opts.q || '').trim();

  try {
    if (q) {
      const rows = await ftsSearch(env.DB, q, limit + offset);
      return rows.slice(offset, offset + limit) as ProductRow[];
    }
    const { results } = await env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT id, name, sku, barcode, quantity, price, cost, category, image_url, updated_at
       FROM products
       ORDER BY name ASC
       LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`,
    )
      .bind(limit, offset)
      .all();
    return (results || []) as ProductRow[];
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[productsRepo.listProducts]', e);
    throw new AppError('INTERNAL');
  }
}

export async function getProductById(env: Env, id: number): Promise<ProductRow | null> {
  if (!Number.isFinite(id) || id <= 0) throw new AppError('BAD_REQUEST', 'Identifiant produit invalide');
  try {
    const row = await env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1`,
    )
      .bind(id)
      .first();
    return (row as ProductRow) || null;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[productsRepo.getProductById]', e);
    throw new AppError('INTERNAL');
  }
}

import type { AtlasApp } from './types';

export type AdminRouteDeps = {
  requireOwner: (c: any) => { ok: true; username: string } | { ok: false; response: Response };
  getOwnerUsername: (env: any) => string;
  ensureSecurityTables: (db: D1Database) => Promise<void>;
};

/**
 * Core admin routes extracted from the monolith.
 * Password / user create still needs hash helpers in index until auth-gate expands.
 */
export function registerAdminReadRoutes(app: AtlasApp, deps: AdminRouteDeps): void {
  app.get('/api/admin/users', async (c) => {
    const gate = deps.requireOwner(c);
    if (!gate.ok) return gate.response;
    await deps.ensureSecurityTables(c.env.DB);
    const { results } = await c.env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT id, username, role, display_name, active, created_by, created_at, last_login, email FROM app_users ORDER BY username`,
    ).all();
    const ownerUser = deps.getOwnerUsername(c.env);
    return c.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        owner: {
          username: ownerUser,
          role: 'owner',
          display_name: 'Administrateur principal',
          source: 'cloudflare_secret',
        },
        users: results || [],
      },
    });
  });
}
