/**
 * Android release ingestion & update serving — zero manual uploads.
 *
 * GitHub Actions in Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android POSTs every signed
 * APK to `POST /api/admin/android-release` (Bearer ANDROID_RELEASE_TOKEN).
 * The worker streams it into the R2 bucket behind https://cdn1.afmarbre.com
 * (binding IMAGES) twice — immutable versioned key + `latest.apk` alias —
 * using request.body.tee() + FixedLengthStream (no full buffering in worker
 * memory), then writes the live `latest.json` manifest.
 *
 * The Android app (v1.0.8+) reads `GET /api/app/android-update?versionCode=…`
 * (public, pre-login) and pings `HEAD /app-updates/android/latest.apk` for
 * its mirror-latency meter — served via bucket.head() so HEAD never 404/405s
 * when cdn1 traffic reaches the worker.
 */
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import type { Env } from '../env';
import {
  carryPolicyIntoManifest,
  parseMinVersionPolicy,
  policyFromManifest,
  readMinVersionPolicy,
  writeMinVersionPolicy,
  type MinVersionPolicy,
} from '../lib/app-update-policy';

export const ANDROID_UPDATE_PREFIX = 'app-updates/android';
const APK_MIME = 'application/vnd.android.package-archive';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200, headers?: Record<string, string>): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', ...headers },
  });
}

/** Constant-time secret comparison (SHA-256 digests → fixed-length compare). */
async function secretMatches(provided: string, expected: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const enc = new TextEncoder();
    const [a, b] = await Promise.all([
      crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', enc.encode(provided)),
      crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', enc.encode(expected)),
    ]);
    const ua = new Uint8Array(a);
    const ub = new Uint8Array(b);
    let diff = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < ua.length; i++) diff |= ua[i] ^ ub[i];
    return diff === 0;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** Safe UTF-8 base64 decode (TextDecoder over Uint8Array). */
function b64ToText(b64: string): string {
  try {
    const bin = atob(String(b64 || '').replace(/\s/g, ''));
    const bytes = Uint8Array.from(bin, (ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0));
    return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

export const androidReleaseRouter = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();

/* ── CI ingestion: raw signed APK stream → R2 (versioned + latest) + manifest ── */
androidReleaseRouter.post('/api/admin/android-release', async (c) => {
  const env = c.env;
  const expected = String(env.ANDROID_RELEASE_TOKEN || '').trim();
  if (!expected) return json({ ok: false, success: false, error: 'RELEASE_TOKEN_UNCONFIGURED' }, 503);

  const authHeader = c.req.header('Authorization') || '';
  const provided = authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ') ? authHeader.slice(7).trim() : '';
  if (!provided || !(await secretMatches(provided, expected))) {
    return json({ ok: false, success: false, error: 'UNAUTHORIZED' }, 401);
  }

  const bucket = env.IMAGES;
  if (!bucket) return json({ ok: false, success: false, error: 'R2_UNAVAILABLE' }, 503);

  const versionCode = Number.parseInt((c.req.header('X-Release-Version-Code') || '').trim(), 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(versionCode) || versionCode <= 0) {
    return json({ ok: false, success: false, error: 'INVALID_VERSION_CODE' }, 400);
  }
  const versionName = String(c.req.header('X-Release-Version-Name') || '')
    .replace(/[^0-9A-Za-z._-]/g, '')
    .trim();
  if (!versionName) return json({ ok: false, success: false, error: 'INVALID_VERSION_NAME' }, 400);

  const shaHeader = (c.req.header('X-Release-Sha256') || '').trim();
  const sha256 = /^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(shaHeader) ? shaHeader.toLowerCase() : null;
  const githubHeaderUrl = (c.req.header('X-Release-Github-Url') || '').trim();
  const mandatory = (c.req.header('X-Release-Mandatory') || '').trim() === 'true';
  const notes = b64ToText((c.req.header('X-Release-Notes-B64') || '').trim());

  const request = c.req.raw;
  const contentLength = Number(request.headers.get('content-length') || '0');
  if (!request.body || !Number.isFinite(contentLength) || contentLength < 10_000) {
    return json({ ok: false, success: false, error: 'INVALID_APK_BODY' }, 400);
  }

  // Stream twice with minimal buffering: R2 requires FixedLengthStream for
  // non-buffered put() bodies.
  const [rawA, rawB] = request.body.tee();
  const fixedA = new FixedLengthStream(contentLength);
  const fixedB = new FixedLengthStream(contentLength);
  void rawA.pipeTo(fixedA.writable);
  void rawB.pipeTo(fixedB.writable);
  try {
    await Promise.all([
      bucket.put(`${ANDROID_UPDATE_PREFIX}/atlas-commerce-v${versionName}.apk`, fixedA.readable, {
        httpMetadata: { contentType: APK_MIME, cacheControl: 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' },
      }),
      bucket.put(`${ANDROID_UPDATE_PREFIX}/latest.apk`, fixedB.readable, {
        httpMetadata: { contentType: APK_MIME, cacheControl: 'no-cache, max-age=0, must-revalidate' },
      }),
    ]);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[android-release] R2 put failed', String((e as any)?.message || e).slice(0, 300));
    return json({ ok: false, success: false, error: 'R2_WRITE_FAILED' }, 502);
  }

  const cdn1Base = (env.CDN1_PUBLIC_BASE_URL || 'https://cdn1.afmarbre.com/app-updates/android').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const cdn1VersionedUrl = `${cdn1Base}/atlas-commerce-v${versionName}.apk`;
  const githubUrl =
    githubHeaderUrl ||
    `https://github.com/Etherealmber/atlas-commerce-android/releases/download/v${versionName}/atlas-commerce-v${versionName}.apk`;
  const manifest = {
    success: true,
    ok: true,
    updateAvailable: true,
    versionCode,
    versionName,
    mandatory,
    sha256: sha256 || null,
    sizeBytes: contentLength,
    apkUrl: cdn1VersionedUrl,
    apk_url: cdn1VersionedUrl,
    cdn1Url: cdn1VersionedUrl,
    cdn1_url: cdn1VersionedUrl,
    githubUrl,
    github_url: githubUrl,
    notes,
    publishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
  // v0.7 — CI ingestion must NEVER reset the admin minimum-version policy:
  // carry it from the previous manifest (or app_config when absent).
  let oldManifest: any = null;
  try {
    const oldObj = await bucket.get(`${ANDROID_UPDATE_PREFIX}/latest.json`);
    if (oldObj) oldManifest = JSON.parse(await oldObj.text());
  } catch { /* first release ever → no policy to carry */ }
  let dbPolicy: MinVersionPolicy | null = null;
  try {
    dbPolicy = await readMinVersionPolicy(env.DB);
  } catch { dbPolicy = null; }
  const carried = carryPolicyIntoManifest(manifest, oldManifest, dbPolicy);
  try {
    await writeMinVersionPolicy(env.DB, carried.policy);
  } catch { /* best-effort: app_config stays as-is */ }
  try {
    await bucket.put(`${ANDROID_UPDATE_PREFIX}/latest.json`, JSON.stringify(carried.manifest, null, 2), {
      httpMetadata: {
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        cacheControl: 'no-cache, max-age=0, must-revalidate',
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[android-release] latest.json write failed', String((e as any)?.message || e).slice(0, 300));
    return json({ ok: false, success: false, error: 'MANIFEST_WRITE_FAILED' }, 502);
  }
  console.log('[android-release] ingested', versionName, 'code', versionCode, contentLength, 'bytes');
  return json({ ok: true, success: true, manifest: carried.manifest });
});

/* ── Public update check (pre-login) + HEAD variant ── */
async function buildAndroidUpdateResponse(c: any, head: boolean): Promise<Response> {
  const env = c.env as Env;
  const clientCode = Number(c.req.query('versionCode') || '0');
  const noCache = { 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, max-age=0, must-revalidate' };
  let manifest: any = null;
  try {
    if (env.IMAGES) {
      const obj = await env.IMAGES.get(`${ANDROID_UPDATE_PREFIX}/latest.json`);
      if (obj) manifest = JSON.parse(await obj.text());
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  if (!manifest && env.DB) {
    // Legacy fallback: owner-configured rows keep working until the first CI release.
    try {
      const rows = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT key, value FROM app_config WHERE key LIKE 'android_update_%'`).all();
      const map: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const r of (rows?.results || []) as any[]) map[String(r.key)] = String(r.value || '');
      if (map.android_update_version_code || map.android_update_apk_url) {
        manifest = {
          versionCode: Number(map.android_update_version_code || 0),
          versionName: map.android_update_version_name || '',
          apkUrl: map.android_update_apk_url || '',
          mandatory: map.android_update_mandatory === '1' || map.android_update_mandatory === 'true',
          notes: map.android_update_notes || '',
        };
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
  }
  if (!manifest) {
    let noManifestPolicy: MinVersionPolicy = { enabled: false, code: 0 };
    try {
      noManifestPolicy = await readMinVersionPolicy(env.DB);
    } catch { /* disabled */ }
    const body = {
      success: true,
      ok: true,
      updateAvailable: false,
      versionCode: clientCode,
      versionName: c.req.query('versionName') || null,
      apkUrl: null,
      cdn1Url: null,
      githubUrl: null,
      mandatory: false,
      sha256: null,
      sizeBytes: null,
      notes: null,
      minimumVersionEnabled: noManifestPolicy.enabled,
      minimumSupportedVersionCode: noManifestPolicy.enabled ? noManifestPolicy.code : 0,
      minimumVersionRequired: false,
      message: 'Aucun manifeste de mise à jour (uploadez app-updates/android/latest.json sur R2)',
    };
    if (head) return new Response(null, { status: 200, headers: noCache });
    return json(body, 200, noCache);
  }
  const remoteCode = Number(manifest.versionCode || manifest.version_code || 0);
  const apkUrl = manifest.apkUrl || manifest.apk_url || null;
  // v0.7 — echo the minimum-version policy (manifest copy, DB fallback).
  let policy = policyFromManifest(manifest);
  if (!policy) {
    try {
      policy = await readMinVersionPolicy(env.DB);
    } catch {
      policy = parseMinVersionPolicy(false, 0);
    }
  }
  const minRequired = !!policy.enabled && clientCode < policy.code;
  const body = {
    success: true,
    ok: true,
    updateAvailable: remoteCode > clientCode,
    versionCode: remoteCode,
    versionName: manifest.versionName || manifest.version_name || null,
    mandatory: !!manifest.mandatory,
    sha256: manifest.sha256 || null,
    sizeBytes: manifest.sizeBytes ?? null,
    apkUrl,
    apk_url: apkUrl,
    cdn1Url: manifest.cdn1Url || manifest.cdn1_url || apkUrl,
    githubUrl: manifest.githubUrl || manifest.github_url || null,
    notes: manifest.notes ?? null,
    minimumVersionEnabled: !!policy.enabled,
    minimumSupportedVersionCode: policy.enabled ? policy.code : 0,
    minimumVersionRequired: minRequired,
  };
  if (head) return new Response(null, { status: 200, headers: noCache });
  return json(body, 200, noCache);
}
androidReleaseRouter.get('/api/app/android-update', (c) => buildAndroidUpdateResponse(c, false));
androidReleaseRouter.on('HEAD', '/api/app/android-update', (c) => buildAndroidUpdateResponse(c, true));

/* ── CDN1 mirror paths through the worker: GET streams, HEAD uses bucket.head() ── */
function assetHeaders(o: any, key?: string): Headers {
  const h = new Headers();
  const meta = o?.httpMetadata || {};
  h.set('Content-Type', meta.contentType || 'application/octet-stream');
  // v0.7 — live objects (manifest + latest.apk alias) are ALWAYS revalidated at
  // the edge, whatever metadata older objects carry: an admin save or a CI
  // publish must be visible on the CDN immediately (stale stored cacheControl
  // on pre-existing objects used to keep the edge serving the old manifest).
  const live = !!key && (key.endsWith('/latest.json') || key.endsWith('/latest.apk'));
  h.set('Cache-Control', live ? 'no-cache, max-age=0, must-revalidate' : (meta.cacheControl || 'public, max-age=60'));
  const size = o?.size ?? meta.contentLength;
  if (size != null) h.set('Content-Length', String(size));
  if (o?.etag) h.set('ETag', `"${o.etag}"`);
  return h;
}

export async function serveAppUpdatesAsset(request: Request, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
  const bucket = env.IMAGES;
  if (!bucket) return new Response('R2 unavailable', { status: 503 });
  const key = decodeURIComponent(new URL(request.url).pathname.replace(/^\/+/, ''));
  if (!key.startsWith(`${ANDROID_UPDATE_PREFIX}/`)) return new Response('Not found', { status: 404 });
  if (request.method === 'HEAD') {
    const head = await bucket.head(key).catch(() => null);
    if (!head) return new Response(null, { status: 404 });
    return new Response(null, { status: 200, headers: assetHeaders(head, key) });
  }
  if (request.method !== 'GET') return new Response('Method not allowed', { status: 405 });
  const obj = await bucket.get(key).catch(() => null);
  if (!obj) return new Response('Not found', { status: 404 });
  return new Response(obj.body as unknown as BodyInit, { status: 200, headers: assetHeaders(obj, key) });
}

/**
 * v209 — InvenTree-inspired roadmap (S/M/L):
 *  M3 scan-first ops (receive / transfer / count) · M2 lots + expiry · S4 supplier parts + price breaks
 *  M5 quote status pipeline + journal · L8 kits/BOM assembly · L10 webhooks · S6 label printing (SVG)
 *  M1 locations: products.location (bin reference) on top of existing warehouses.
 */
import type { AtlasApp } from './types';
import { qrToSvg } from '../qrSvg';

const once = new Set<string>();
async function ensure(db: D1Database, key: string, ddl: string): Promise<void> {
  if (once.has(key)) return;
  once.add(key);
  await db.prepare(ddl).run();
}

export async function ensureV209Schema(db: D1Database): Promise<void> {
  await ensure(db, 'lots', `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_lots (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    lot TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    expiry TEXT DEFAULT '',
    quantity REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    warehouse_id INTEGER,
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  )`);
  await ensure(db, 'sparts', `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supplier_parts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    vendor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    supplier_sku TEXT DEFAULT '',
    price_breaks TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  )`);
  await ensure(db, 'kits', `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kits (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  )`);
  await ensure(db, 'kit_items', `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kit_items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    kit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  )`);
  await ensure(db, 'webhooks', `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhooks (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    url TEXT NOT NULL,
    events TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
    active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  )`);
  await ensure(db, 'atlas_alerts', `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS atlas_alerts (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, threshold REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)`);
  await ensure(db, 'status_events', `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS status_events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    from_status TEXT DEFAULT '',
    to_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    by_user TEXT DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  )`);
  // products.location (bin / emplacement reference) — M1
  try {
    const cols = await db.prepare(`PRAGMA table_info(products)`).all() as any;
    if (!(cols.results || []).some((c: any) => c.name === 'location')) {
      await db.prepare(`ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN location TEXT DEFAULT ''`).run();
    }
    const icols = await db.prepare(`PRAGMA table_info(invoices)`).all() as any;
    if (!(icols.results || []).some((c: any) => c.name === 'pipeline_status')) {
      await db.prepare(`ALTER TABLE invoices ADD COLUMN pipeline_status TEXT DEFAULT ''`).run();
    }
  } catch { /* fresh db */ }
}

export async function dispatchWebhook(env: any, ctx: any, event: string, payload: any): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const db = env.DB as D1Database;
    await ensureV209Schema(db);
    const rows = await db.prepare(`SELECT url, events FROM webhooks WHERE active = 1`).all() as any;
    for (const w of rows.results || []) {
      let evts: string[] = [];
      try { evts = JSON.parse(w.events || '[]'); } catch { evts = []; }
      if (evts.length && !evts.includes(event) && !evts.includes('*')) continue;
      // fire-and-forget, never block the API — waitUntil keeps the fetch alive after the response
      const p = fetch(w.url, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ event, payload, at: new Date().toISOString() }),
      }).catch(() => undefined);
      try { ctx?.waitUntil?.(p); } catch { /* isolated test contexts */ }
    }
  } catch { /* webhooks must never break business flows */ }
}

/* CODE128-B barcode → SVG paths (compact implementation) */
const C128_PATTERNS = ['11011001100','11001101100','11001100110','10010011000','10010001100','10001001100','10011001000','10011000100','10001100100','11001001000','11001000100','11000100100','10110011100','10011011100','10011001110','10111001100','10011101100','10011100110','11001110010','11001011100','11001001110','11011100100','11001110100','11101101110','11101001100','11100101100','11100100110','11101100100','11100110100','11100110010','11011011000','11011000110','11000110110','10100011000','10001011000','10001000110','10110001000','10001101000','10001100010','11010001000','11000101000','11000100010','10110111000','10110001110','10001101110','10111011000','10111000110','10001110110','11101110110','11010001110','11000101110','11011101000','11011100010','11011101110','11101011000','11101000110','11100010110','11101101000','11101100010','11100011010','11101011110','11101110100','11101110010','11011011110','11110101110','11110111010','11101011110','11110101110','11110111010','11010011110','11011110100','11011110010','11110110100','11110110010','11011110110','11110101100','11110100110','11110010110','11110011010','11011011110','11011110110','11110110110','10101111000','10100011110','10001011110','10111101000','10111100010','11110101000','11110100010','10111011110','10111101110','11101011110','11110101110'];
function code128Svg(text: string, height = 46): string {
  const vals: number[] = [104];
  for (const ch of text) vals.push(Math.max(0, Math.min(94, ch.charCodeAt(0) - 32)));
  let sum = 104;
  vals.slice(1).forEach((v, i) => { sum += v * (i + 1); });
  vals.push(sum % 103, 106);
  let bits = '';
  for (const v of vals) bits += C128_PATTERNS[v] || C128_PATTERNS[0];
  let x = 0;
  let rects = '';
  bits.split('').forEach((b, i) => {
    if (b === '1') rects += `<rect x="${i * 2}" y="0" width="2" height="${height}"/>`;
    x = i;
  });
  void x;
  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${bits.length * 2} ${height}" width="${bits.length * 2}" height="${height}" fill="#0a0a0a">${rects}</svg>`;
}

const PIPELINE = ['pending', 'approved', 'shipped', 'delivered'];

export interface V209Deps {
  sessionUserFromHeader: (h?: string) => { username: string; role?: string };
  applyStockDelta?: (db: D1Database, productId: number, delta: number, reason: string, type: string, opts?: any) => Promise<any>;
  adjustLocationStock?: (db: D1Database, productId: number, locationId: number, delta: number, opts?: any) => Promise<any>;
  getDefaultLocationId?: (db: D1Database) => Promise<number | null>;
}

export function registerAtlasV209Routes(app: AtlasApp, deps: V209Deps): void {
  const gate = (c: any) => {
    const s = deps.sessionUserFromHeader(c.req.header('Authorization'));
    if (!s.username) return { ok: false as const, status: 401, error: 'Non authentifié' };
    const role = (s.role || 'user').toLowerCase();
    if (!['owner', 'admin', 'stock'].includes(role)) return { ok: false as const, status: 403, error: 'Rôle insuffisant' };
    return { ok: true as const, username: s.username };
  };

  async function applyDelta(db: D1Database, productId: number, warehouseId: number | null, delta: number, type: string, reason: string, user: string, prevTotal: number, newTotal: number) {
    if (warehouseId) {
      const row = await db.prepare(`SELECT quantity FROM warehouse_stock WHERE product_id = ? AND warehouse_id = ?`).bind(productId, warehouseId).first() as any;
      const q = (row?.quantity || 0) + delta;
      await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO warehouse_stock (product_id, warehouse_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(product_id, warehouse_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = excluded.quantity`).bind(productId, warehouseId, q).run();
    }
    await db.prepare(`UPDATE products SET stock_quantity = ?, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?`).bind(newTotal, productId).run();
    await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO stock_movements (product_id, type, quantity, previous_quantity, new_quantity, reason, reference, created_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`).bind(productId, type, delta, prevTotal, newTotal, reason, '', user).run();
  }

    const db = c.env.DB; await ensureV209Schema(db);

    if (!p) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND' }, 404);

    if (deps.applyStockDelta) {

      if (loc && deps.adjustLocationStock) { try { await deps.adjustLocationStock(db, pid, loc, qty, {}); } catch { /* location optional */ } }
    } else {
      await applyDelta(db, pid, loc, qty, 'receive', String(b.note || 'Réception'), g.username, Number(p.stock_quantity), Number(p.stock_quantity) + qty);
    }
    const after = await db.prepare(`SELECT stock_quantity FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(pid).first() as any;
    const newTotal = Number(after?.stock_quantity ?? Number(p.stock_quantity) + qty);
    if (b.lot || b.expiry) {

    const db = c.env.DB; await ensureV209Schema(db);

  app.post('/api/kits/:id/assemble', async (c) => {

    const qty = Number((await c.req.json<any>()).quantity || 1);
    if (!isFinite(qty) || qty <= 0) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'QTY_INVALID' }, 400);
    const db = c.env.DB; await ensureV209Schema(db);

    if (!kit) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'KIT_NOT_FOUND' }, 404);
    const items = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM kit_items WHERE kit_id = ?`).bind(kit.id).all() as any;
    for (const it of items.results || []) {
      const p = await db.prepare(`SELECT stock_quantity, name FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(it.product_id).first() as any;
      if ((p?.stock_quantity || 0) < Number(it.quantity) * qty) return c.json({ success: false, error: `INSUFFICIENT:${p?.name || it.product_id}` }, 400);

    const out = await db.prepare(`SELECT stock_quantity FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(kit.product_id).first() as any;
    await applyDelta(db, kit.product_id, null, qty, 'kit_in', `Assemblage kit ${kit.name}`, g.username, Number(out.stock_quantity), Number(out.stock_quantity) + qty);
    await dispatchWebhook(c.env, c.executionCtx, 'kit.assembled', { kit_id: kit.id, quantity: qty });
    return c.json({ success: true });

    return c.json({ success: true, data: { id: r.meta.last_row_id } });
  });
  app.delete('/api/webhooks/:id', async (c) => {
    const g = gate(c); if (!g.ok) return c.json({ success: false, error: g.error }, g.status as any);
    await ensureV209Schema(c.env.DB);

    return c.json({ success: true });

  app.get('/api/atlas/alerts', async (c) => {

    return c.json({ success: true, data: rows.results || [] });

    const label = String(b.label || key);
    const enabled = b.enabled ? 1 : 0;
    const threshold = Number(b.threshold || 0);
    if (b.test) {
      await dispatchWebhook(c.env, c.executionCtx, 'atlas.alert', { key, label, threshold, message: String(b.message || 'Test alerte — ' + label), test: true });
      return c.json({ success: true, test: true });
    }
    await c.env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO atlas_alerts (key, label, enabled, threshold) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET label = excluded.label, enabled = excluded.enabled, threshold = excluded.threshold`).bind(key, label, enabled, threshold).run();
    return c.json({ success: true });
  });

  app.get('/api/products/:id/label.svg', async (c) => {
    const s = deps.sessionUserFromHeader(c.req.header('Authorization'));
    if (!s.username) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Non authentifié' }, 401);
    const db = c.env.DB;
    const p = await db.prepare(`SELECT id, name, sku, barcode, price, unit, location FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(Number(c.req.param('id'))).first() as any;
    if (!p) return c.text('Not found', 404);
    const code = String(p.barcode || p.sku || `P${p.id}`);
    const origin = new URL(c.req.url).origin;
    const qr = qrToSvg(`${origin}/scan?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}`, 88, 2);
    const barcode = code128Svg(code, 40);
    const price = new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-MA', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(p.price || 0));
    const esc = (v: string) => String(v).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
    const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="320" height="180" viewBox="0 0 320 180">
<rect width="320" height="180" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d4d4d8"/>
<text x="12" y="26" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#0a0a0a">${esc(p.name).slice(0, 34)}</text>
<text x="12" y="44" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#52525b">${esc(code)} · ${esc(p.unit || '')}${p.location ? ` · ${esc(p.location)}` : ''}</text>
<text x="12" y="76" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="800" fill="#0a0a0a">${price} MAD</text>
<g transform="translate(220,52)">${qr.replace(/^<svg[^>]*>/, '').replace(/<\/svg>$/, '')}</g>
<g transform="translate(12,120)">${barcode}</g>
<text x="12" y="172" font-family="monospace" font-size="10" fill="#0a0a0a">${esc(code)}</text>
</svg>`;
    return c.text(svg, 200, { 'content-type': 'image/svg+xml' });

/**
 * Clients domain routes — peeled from worker/index.ts
 */
import type { Hono } from 'hono';
import { apiFail } from '../lib/api-response';
import { validateClientWrite } from '../lib/validate';
import {
  ensureClientTaxExempt,
  ensureClientCreditLimit,
  checkClientCreditLimit,
} from '../lib/clients-schema';
import { afterBusinessMutation } from '../lib/delete-coord';

export { ensureClientTaxExempt, ensureClientCreditLimit, checkClientCreditLimit };

export type ClientRouteDeps = {
  issueDeleteOtp: (
    env: any,
    kind: string,
    id: string,
    label: string,
    subject: string,
  ) => Promise<{ message: string; emailed: boolean; otp?: string }>;
  requireBizMutator: (
    c: any,
  ) => { ok: true; username: string; role: string } | { ok: false; response: Response };
  checkConfirmPassword: (
    env: any,
    db: D1Database,
    auth: string | undefined,
    body: any,
  ) => Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string; code?: string; status: number }>;
  clientDeleteBlockers: (db: D1Database, clientId: number | string) => Promise<string | null>;
  writeAudit: (db: D1Database, opts: any) => Promise<void>;
};

export function registerClientRoutes(app: Hono<any>, deps?: ClientRouteDeps): void {
  const issueDeleteOtp = deps?.issueDeleteOtp;
  const requireBizMutator = deps?.requireBizMutator;
  const checkConfirmPassword = deps?.checkConfirmPassword;
  const clientDeleteBlockers = deps?.clientDeleteBlockers;
  const writeAudit = deps?.writeAudit;

  app.get('/api/clients', async (c) => {
    await ensureClientTaxExempt(c.env.DB);
    await ensureClientCreditLimit(c.env.DB);
    let results: any[] = [];
    try {
      const r = await c.env.DB.prepare(`
        SELECT c.*,
          COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(i.total - COALESCE(i.amount_paid, 0))
            FROM invoices i
            WHERE i.client_id = c.id
              AND i.status NOT IN ('quote','devis','cancelled','paid','remboursement')
              AND COALESCE(i.doc_kind,'') != 'remboursement'
              AND (i.total - COALESCE(i.amount_paid, 0)) > 0.001
          ), 0) as balance_due
        FROM clients c
        ORDER BY c.name
      `).all();
      results = r.results || [];
    } catch {
      const r = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients ORDER BY name`).all();
      results = r.results || [];
    }
    return c.json({ success: true, data: results });
  });

  app.post('/api/clients', async (c) => {
    await ensureClientTaxExempt(c.env.DB);
    await ensureClientCreditLimit(c.env.DB);
    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const verr = validateClientWrite(body);
    if (verr) return apiFail(c, verr.name || Object.values(verr)[0] || 'Validation', 'VALIDATION', verr);
    const { name, ice = '', if_number = '', address = '', city = '', phone = '', email = '' } = body;
    if (!name) return apiFail(c, 'Le nom du client est obligatoire', 'VALIDATION');
    const tax_exempt = body.tax_exempt ? 1 : 0;
    const credit_limit = Math.max(0, Number(body.credit_limit || 0));
    let result;
    try {
      result = await c.env.DB.prepare(
        `INSERT INTO clients (name, ice, if_number, address, city, phone, email, tax_exempt, credit_limit) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
      ).bind(name, ice, if_number, address, city, phone, email, tax_exempt, credit_limit).run();
    } catch {
      result = await c.env.DB.prepare(
        `INSERT INTO clients (name, ice, if_number, address, city, phone, email, tax_exempt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
      ).bind(name, ice, if_number, address, city, phone, email, tax_exempt).run();
    }
    const client = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?`).bind(result.meta.last_row_id).first();
    return c.json({ success: true, data: client, message: 'Client enregistré dans la base de données.' }, 201);
  });

  app.put('/api/clients/:id', async (c) => {
    await ensureClientTaxExempt(c.env.DB);
    await ensureClientCreditLimit(c.env.DB);
    const id = c.req.param('id');
    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const existing = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first() as any;
    if (!existing) return apiFail(c, 'Client introuvable', 'NOT_FOUND');
    const fields = ['name', 'ice', 'if_number', 'address', 'city', 'phone', 'email', 'credit_limit'];
    const updates: string[] = [];
    const values: any[] = [];
    for (const f of fields) {
      if (body[f] !== undefined) {
        updates.push(`${f} = ?`);
        values.push(body[f]);
      }
    }
    if (body.tax_exempt !== undefined) {
      updates.push(`tax_exempt = ?`);
      values.push(body.tax_exempt ? 1 : 0);
    }
    if (!updates.length) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Aucun champ à modifier' }, 400);
    values.push(id);
    await c.env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE clients SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`).bind(...values).run();
    const client = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first();
    return c.json({ success: true, data: client, message: 'Client mis à jour.' });
  });

  app.post('/api/clients/:id/request-delete-otp', async (c) => {
    const id = c.req.param('id');
    const client = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first() as any;
    if (!client) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Client introuvable' }, 404);
    const label = `Client ${client.name}`;
    const result = await issueDeleteOtp(c.env, 'client', String(id), label, `Code de suppression — ${label}`);
    return c.json({ success: true, message: result.message, emailed: result.emailed, otp: result.emailed ? undefined : result.otp });
  });

  app.delete('/api/clients/:id', async (c) => {
    try {
      const gate = requireBizMutator(c);
      if (!gate.ok) return gate.response;
      const id = c.req.param('id');
      const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const pw = await checkConfirmPassword(c.env, c.env.DB, c.req.header('Authorization'), body);
      if (!pw.ok) return c.json({ success: false, error: pw.error, code: pw.code }, pw.status);
      const client = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first() as any;
      if (!client) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Client introuvable' }, 404);
      const block = await clientDeleteBlockers(c.env.DB, id);
      if (block) {
        return c.json({ success: false, error: block, code: 'CLIENT_HAS_HISTORY' }, 400);
      }
      await c.env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM clients WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).run();
      await afterBusinessMutation(c.env.CACHE);
      await writeAudit(c.env.DB, {
        username: gate.username, role: gate.role, action: 'client.delete',
        entity: 'clients', entity_id: id, detail: client.name || '',
        ip: c.req.header('cf-connecting-ip') || '',
      });
      return c.json({ success: true, message: `Client ${client.name} supprimé de la base de données.` });
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('client delete', e);
      return c.json({ success: false, error: e?.message || 'Échec de la suppression', code: 'DELETE_FAILED' }, 400);
    }
  });

  app.post('/api/clients/request-bulk-delete-otp', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const ids: number[] = Array.isArray(body.ids) ? body.ids.map((x: any) => Number(x)).filter((n: number) => n > 0) : [];
    if (!ids.length) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Aucun client sélectionné' }, 400);
    const placeholders = ids.map(() => '?').join(',');
    const { results: clients } = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT id, name FROM clients WHERE id IN (${placeholders})`).bind(...ids).all();
    if (!clients?.length) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Aucun client trouvé' }, 404);
    const resourceId = ids.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).join(',');
    const label = `${clients.length} client(s) : ${(clients as any[]).map((x) => x.name).join(', ')}`;
    const result = await issueDeleteOtp(c.env, 'clients_bulk', resourceId, label, `Code de suppression — ${clients.length} client(s)`);
    return c.json({ success: true, message: result.message, emailed: result.emailed, otp: result.emailed ? undefined : result.otp, count: clients.length });
  });

  app.post('/api/clients/bulk-delete', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const ids: number[] = Array.isArray(body.ids) ? body.ids.map((x: any) => Number(x)).filter((n: number) => n > 0) : [];
      if (!ids.length) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Aucun client sélectionné' }, 400);
    const resourceId = ids.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).join(',');
    const pw = await checkConfirmPassword(c.env, c.env.DB, c.req.header('Authorization'), body);
    if (!pw.ok) return c.json({ success: false, error: pw.error, code: pw.code }, pw.status);
    const placeholders = ids.map(() => '?').join(',');
    await c.env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM clients WHERE id IN (${placeholders})`).bind(...ids).run();
    return c.json({ success: true, message: `${ids.length} client(s) supprimé(s) de la base de données.` });
  });


  /* ─── Client import (Part 9) ─── */

  app.post('/api/clients/import/preview', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const rows: any[] = Array.isArray(body.rows) ? body.rows : [];
    if (!rows.length) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Aucune ligne à analyser' }, 400);

    const { results: existing } = await c.env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT id, name, ice, email, phone FROM clients`
    ).all();
    const byIce = new Map<string, any>();
    const byEmail = new Map<string, any>();
    const byName = new Map<string, any>();
    for (const e of (existing || []) as any[]) {
      if (e.ice) byIce.set(String(e.ice).replace(/\s/g, '').toLowerCase(), e);
      if (e.email) byEmail.set(String(e.email).trim().toLowerCase(), e);
      if (e.name) byName.set(String(e.name).trim().toLowerCase(), e);
    }

    const preview = rows.map((r: any, idx: number) => {
      const name = String(r.name || r.nom || '').trim();
      const ice = String(r.ice || '').replace(/\s/g, '').trim();
      const email = String(r.email || r.mail || '').trim();
      const phone = String(r.phone || r.tel || r.telephone || '').trim();
      const if_number = String(r.if_number || r.if || '').trim();
      const address = String(r.address || r.adresse || '').trim();
      const city = String(r.city || r.ville || '').trim();

      const errors: string[] = [];
      if (!name) errors.push('Nom manquant');
      if (ice && !/^\d{15}$/.test(ice.replace(/\D/g, '')) && ice.replace(/\D/g, '').length > 0) {
        // soft warning: ICE should be 15 digits
        if (ice.replace(/\D/g, '').length !== 15) errors.push('ICE non standard (15 chiffres attendus)');
      }
      if (email && !email.includes('@')) errors.push('E-mail invalide');

      let duplicate: any = null;
      let match_on = '';
      if (ice && byIce.has(ice.toLowerCase())) {
        duplicate = byIce.get(ice.toLowerCase());
        match_on = 'ice';
      } else if (email && byEmail.has(email.toLowerCase())) {
        duplicate = byEmail.get(email.toLowerCase());
        match_on = 'email';
      } else if (name && byName.has(name.toLowerCase())) {
        duplicate = byName.get(name.toLowerCase());
        match_on = 'name';
      }

      return {
        row: idx + 1,
        name,
        ice: ice.replace(/\D/g, '') || ice,
        if_number,
        address,
        city,
        phone,
        email,
        errors,
        valid: errors.filter((e) => e !== 'ICE non standard (15 chiffres attendus)').length === 0 && !!name,
        warning: errors.includes('ICE non standard (15 chiffres attendus)'),
        duplicate: duplicate
          ? { id: duplicate.id, name: duplicate.name, ice: duplicate.ice, email: duplicate.email, match_on }
          : null,
        action: duplicate ? 'skip' : 'create', // default: skip duplicates
      };
    });

    const stats = {
      total: preview.length,
      valid: preview.filter((p) => p.valid).length,
      invalid: preview.filter((p) => !p.valid).length,
      duplicates: preview.filter((p) => p.duplicate).length,
    };
    return c.json({ success: true, data: { rows: preview, stats } });
  });

  app.post('/api/clients/import', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const rows: any[] = Array.isArray(body.rows) ? body.rows : [];
    if (!rows.length) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Aucune ligne à importer' }, 400);

    let created = 0, updated = 0, skipped = 0, failed = 0;
    const details: any[] = [];

    for (const r of rows) {
      const action = String(r.action || 'create');
      const name = String(r.name || '').trim();
      if (!name) {
        failed++;
        details.push({ name: r.name, status: 'failed', reason: 'Nom manquant' });
        continue;
      }
      const ice = String(r.ice || '').trim();
      const if_number = String(r.if_number || '').trim();
      const address = String(r.address || '').trim();
      const city = String(r.city || '').trim();
      const phone = String(r.phone || '').trim();
      const email = String(r.email || '').trim();

      try {
        if (action === 'skip') {
          skipped++;
          details.push({ name, status: 'skipped' });
          continue;
        }
        if (action === 'update' && r.duplicate_id) {
          await c.env.DB.prepare(
            `UPDATE clients SET name = ?, ice = ?, if_number = ?, address = ?, city = ?, phone = ?, email = ? WHERE id = ?`
          ).bind(name, ice, if_number, address, city, phone, email, r.duplicate_id).run();
          updated++;
          details.push({ name, status: 'updated', id: r.duplicate_id });
          continue;
        }
        // create
        const result = await c.env.DB.prepare(
          `INSERT INTO clients (name, ice, if_number, address, city, phone, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
        ).bind(name, ice, if_number, address, city, phone, email).run();
        created++;
        details.push({ name, status: 'created', id: result.meta.last_row_id });
      } catch (e: any) {
        failed++;
        details.push({ name, status: 'failed', reason: String(e?.message || e) });
      }
    }

    return c.json({
      success: true,
      data: { created, updated, skipped, failed, details },
      message: `Import clients : ${created} créé(s), ${updated} mis à jour, ${skipped} ignoré(s), ${failed} échec(s).`,
    });
  });
}

import { Hono, type Context } from 'hono';

export const DESKTOP_AUTH = '/api/auth/desktop/v1';
export const DESKTOP_TTL = 300;
export const DESKTOP_POLL_SECONDS = 5;
const PUBLIC_PATHS = new Set(['capabilities', 'requests', 'poll', 'exchange', 'cancel'].map(p => `${DESKTOP_AUTH}/${p}`));
const ALL_PATHS = new Set([...PUBLIC_PATHS, `${DESKTOP_AUTH}/prepare`, `${DESKTOP_AUTH}/authorize`]);

export const isDesktopAuthPath = (path: string) => ALL_PATHS.has(path);
/** Browser consent endpoints deliberately remain behind the normal auth gate. */
export const isPublicDesktopAuthPath = (path: string) => PUBLIC_PATHS.has(path);

export async function desktopHash(value: string): Promise<string> {

function random(): string {

    const n = char.charCodeAt(0);
    return n >= 32 && !(n >= 0x7f && n <= 0x9f) && char !== '<' && char !== '>' && n !== 0x061c && !(n >= 0x200e && n <= 0x200f) && !(n >= 0x202a && n <= 0x202e) && !(n >= 0x2066 && n <= 0x206f);

const ready = new WeakSet<object>();

/** D1 compare-and-set transitions, never isolate memory, are the authority. */
async function schema(db: D1Database): Promise<void> {
  if (ready.has(db)) return;
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS desktop_auth_v1 (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, origin TEXT NOT NULL, state_hash TEXT NOT NULL, challenge TEXT NOT NULL,
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, ip_hash TEXT NOT NULL, device_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    username TEXT, role TEXT, credential_tag TEXT, consent_hash TEXT, actor_hash TEXT,
    approver_fingerprint TEXT, consent_until INTEGER, polls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_poll INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

    bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )`).run();
  await db.prepare('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_desktop_auth_v1_expires ON desktop_auth_v1(expires_at)').run();
  await db.prepare('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_desktop_auth_limits_v1_expires ON desktop_auth_limits_v1(expires_at)').run();

type Identity = { username: string; role: string };
type Dependencies = {

      WHERE id = ? AND status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'cancelled') AND expires_at > ? RETURNING id`).bind(row.id, Date.now()).first();
    if (!changed) reject('DENIED', 403);
    return c.json({ success: true, data: { status: 'cancelled' } });
  });

  app.post(`${DESKTOP_AUTH}/exchange`, async c => {
    const body = await json(c, desktopFields);
    const row = await desktop(c, body);
    terminal(row);
    if (row.status !== 'approved') reject('NOT_APPROVED', 409);
    const material = await deps.material(c.env, row.username, row.role);
    if (!material || !equal(row.credential_tag, await desktopHash(material))) reject('ACCOUNT_CHANGED', 409);
    const approver: any = await c.env.DB.prepare('SELECT username FROM trusted_devices WHERE fingerprint = ?').bind(row.approver_fingerprint).first();
    if (!approver || String(approver.username).toLowerCase() !== row.username.toLowerCase()) reject('ACCOUNT_CHANGED', 409);
    // Mint privately, then claim exactly once. No session leaves before CAS + trust.
    const token = await deps.mint(row.username, row.role, material, deps.ip(c), row.fingerprint);
    const consumed: any = await c.env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE desktop_auth_v1 SET status = 'consumed', consent_hash = NULL, actor_hash = NULL, credential_tag = NULL
      WHERE id = ? AND status = 'approved' AND expires_at > ?
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trusted_devices WHERE fingerprint = ? AND lower(username) = lower(?)) RETURNING id`)
      .bind(row.id, Date.now(), row.approver_fingerprint, row.username).first();
    if (!consumed) reject('USED', 409);
    await deps.trust(c.env, row.fingerprint, deps.ip(c), row.username, String(c.req.header('User-Agent') || '').slice(0, 240));
    await deps.audit(c, { username: row.username, role: row.role }, 'exchange');
    return c.json({ success: true, data: { token, token_type: 'Bearer', username: row.username, role: row.role, request_id: row.id, origin: row.origin, state: body.state } });
  });
  root.route('/', app);
}

/**
 * v0.7.1 — « Appareils connectés » routes, extracted from worker/index.ts
 * (same paths, same behaviour — mechanical move, deps injected):
 *   GET  /api/auth/devices         → list + device_label + city/country (cf IP)
 *   POST /api/auth/devices/revoke  → revoke (OTP note kept by caller UI)
 */
export interface DeviceRoutesDeps {
  sessionUserFromHeader: (h: string | undefined) => { username: string; role: string };
  authFailReason: (...a: any[]) => Promise<string>;
  clientIp: (c: any) => string;
  ensureSecurityTables: (db: any) => Promise<void>;
  touchTrustedDevice: (...a: any[]) => Promise<void>;
  deviceLabelFromUA: (ua: unknown) => string;
  cfGeo: (c: any) => { city: string; country: string };
  writeAudit: (db: any, e: any) => Promise<void>;
}

export function registerDeviceRoutes(app: any, deps: DeviceRoutesDeps): void {
app.get('/api/auth/devices', async (c: any) => {
  const reason = await deps.authFailReason(c.req.header('Authorization'), c.env, c.env.DB, deps.clientIp(c), c.req.header('X-Device-Fingerprint') || '');
  if (reason !== 'ok') return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Session invalide', code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' }, 401);
  const session = deps.sessionUserFromHeader(c.req.header('Authorization'));
  const username = String(session.username || '').toLowerCase();
  const fp = String(c.req.header('X-Device-Fingerprint') || '');
  await deps.ensureSecurityTables(c.env.DB);
  const rows = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT fingerprint, last_ip, last_seen, user_agent FROM trusted_devices WHERE lower(username) = ? ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 25`).bind(username).all() as any;
  const data = (rows.results || []).map((r: any) => ({
    fingerprint: String(r.fingerprint || '').slice(0, 12) + '…',
    full: String(r.fingerprint || ''),
    last_ip: r.last_ip,
    last_seen: r.last_seen,
    user_agent: String(r.user_agent || '').slice(0, 90),
    device_label: deps.deviceLabelFromUA(r.user_agent),
    city: String(r.city || ''),
    country: String(r.country || ''),
    current: fp && String(r.fingerprint || '') === fp,
  }));
  if (fp && !data.some((d: any) => d.current)) {
    try {
      await deps.touchTrustedDevice(c.env.DB, username, fp, deps.clientIp(c), c.req.header('User-Agent') || '', deps.cfGeo(c));
      const cfNow = deps.cfGeo(c);
      data.unshift({
        fingerprint: fp.slice(0, 12) + '…',
        full: fp,
        last_ip: deps.clientIp(c),
        last_seen: new Date().toISOString(),
        user_agent: String(c.req.header('User-Agent') || '').slice(0, 90),
        device_label: deps.deviceLabelFromUA(c.req.header('User-Agent') || ''),
        city: cfNow.city,
        country: cfNow.country,
        current: true,
      });
    } catch { /* best-effort */ }
  }
  return c.json({ success: true, data });
});

app.post('/api/auth/devices/revoke', async (c: any) => {
  const reason = await deps.authFailReason(c.req.header('Authorization'), c.env, c.env.DB, deps.clientIp(c), c.req.header('X-Device-Fingerprint') || '');
  if (reason !== 'ok') return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Session invalide', code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' }, 401);
  const session = deps.sessionUserFromHeader(c.req.header('Authorization'));
  const username = String(session.username || '').toLowerCase();
  const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
  const target = String(body.fingerprint || '');
  if (!target) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Empreinte requise' }, 400);
  await c.env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM trusted_devices WHERE fingerprint = ? AND lower(username) = ?`).bind(target, username).run();
  await deps.writeAudit(c.env.DB, { username, role: session.role, action: 'device.revoke', entity: target.slice(0, 12), detail: 'trusted_device' });
  return c.json({ success: true });
});

/** Best-effort: remember every device that actively uses the account. */
}

/**
 * v0.7 — FCM device-token registration route, extracted for testability.
 * POST /api/assist/device-token : authenticated user upserts an Android push
 * token. Schema is ensured by worker/lib/fcm (upsertDeviceToken). Errors are
 * returned as a stable code — never raw exception text or stack details.
 */
import type { Hono } from 'hono';
import { upsertDeviceToken } from '../lib/fcm';
import { pickUiLang, tr } from '../lib/error-i18n';

export function registerDeviceTokenRoutes(
  app: Hono<any>,
  getSession: (authHeader: string | undefined) => { username: string; role: string },
): void {
  app.post('/api/assist/device-token', async (c) => {
    const lang = pickUiLang(c.req.header('Accept-Language'));
    const authHeader = c.req.header('Authorization');
    if (!authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      return c.json({ success: false, error: tr(lang, 'auth_required'), code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' }, 401);
    }
    const session = getSession(authHeader);
    const user = String(session.username || '').trim();
    if (!user) {
      return c.json({ success: false, error: tr(lang, 'auth_required'), code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' }, 401);
    }

    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const token = String(body.token || body.fcm_token || '').trim();
    const platform = String(body.platform || 'android').slice(0, 32);
    if (!token) return c.json({ success: false, error: tr(lang, 'token_required'), code: 'TOKEN_REQUIRED' }, 400);
    // Never register a truncated value that differs from the SDK's token.
    if (token.length > 512) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Jeton de notification trop long.', code: 'TOKEN_INVALID' }, 400);
    try {
      await upsertDeviceToken(c.env.DB, user, token, platform);
      return c.json({ success: true, data: { registered: true } });
    } catch {
      // DB exceptions can echo bind parameters: never log their raw text.
      console.error('[device-token]', { outcome: 'store_failed' });
      return c.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: tr(lang, 'token_store_error'),
          code: 'DEVICE_TOKEN_STORE_ERROR',
        },
        500,
      );
    }
  });
}

export function registerDocPreviewRoutes(app: any, deps: DocPreviewDeps): void {

    if (doc?.id) {
      items = await lines(`SELECT * FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id = ?`, doc.id);

    }
  } else {
    doc = await latest(`SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE IFNULL(status,'') NOT IN ('quote','devis') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`);
    if (doc?.id) { items = await lines(`SELECT * FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id = ?`, doc.id); real = true; }
  }

  const prefix = (type === 'quote' ? settings?.quote_prefix : type === 'bill' ? settings?.bill_prefix : type === 'receipt' ? settings?.receipt_prefix : type === 'credit' ? settings?.credit_prefix : settings?.invoice_prefix) || '';
  const title = titles[type] || titles.invoice;
  if (!doc) {
    const ht = 100;
    const taxAmt = Math.round(ht * (tax / 100) * 100) / 100;
    doc = {
      number: `${prefix || 'DEMO-'}${String(1).padStart(pad, '0')}`,
      issue_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      status: 'draft',
      client_name: 'Marbrerie Démo SARL',
      client_ice: settings?.ice || '002345678000099',
      client_city: settings?.city || 'Casablanca',
      subtotal: ht,
      tax_amount: taxAmt,
      total: ht + taxAmt,
      amount_paid: 0,
      notes: DEMO_NOTE,
    };
    items = sampleItems;
    if (type === 'credit') {
      doc.doc_kind = 'remboursement';
      doc.status = 'remboursement';
      doc.number = `${settings?.credit_prefix || 'WR-'}0001`;
    }
    if (type === 'quote') {
      doc.status = 'quote';
      doc.due_date = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  }

  const summary = [
    'ATLAS COMMERCE',
    title,
    String(doc.number || ''),
    `Partie: ${doc.client_name || doc.vendor_name || '—'}`,
    `Total: ${Number(doc.total || 0).toFixed(2)} ${settings?.currency || 'MAD'}`,
    `Emetteur: ${company}`,
    real ? 'Source: dernier document enregistré' : 'Source: modele (aucun document)',
    'Apercu non contractuel',
  ].join('\n');

  doc.preview_qr = true;
  doc.preview_qr_text = summary;
  // v0.7 — Reçu : l'aperçu peut montrer (ou non) le QR « situation client »,
  // choisi dans l'app via ?qr_situation=1|0 (défaut = réglage de l'entreprise).
  if (type === 'receipt') {
    const qsSit = String(c.req.query('qr_situation') || '').toLowerCase();
    const sitOn = qsSit === '1' || qsSit === 'true'
      ? true
      : qsSit === '0' || qsSit === 'false'
        ? false
        : Number(settings?.qr_client_situation ?? 0) === 1;
    if (sitOn) {
      doc.preview_situation_qr = true;
      doc.preview_situation_text = [
        'ATLAS COMMERCE — SITUATION CLIENT (APERCU)',
        `Partie: ${doc.client_name || doc.vendor_name || '—'}`,
        `Total du recu: ${Number(doc.total || 0).toFixed(2)} ${settings?.currency || 'MAD'}`,
        "Exemple de QR situation tel qu'imprime sur le recu reel si l'option est activee.",
        'Apercu non contractuel',
      ].join('\n');
    }
  }
  doc.preview_banner = DISCLAIMER + (real ? ' Données : dernier document réel de ce type.' : ' Aucun document de ce type — modèle avec votre société et un article exemple.');

  return c.html(deps.previewEmbed(deps.generateInvoiceHTML(settings, doc, items.length ? items : sampleItems, title, false)));
});

/**
 * v264 — Ledger WRITE routes (owner/admin only), extracted from the monolith
 * so the authorization contract is integration-tested (worker/__tests__/expenses-auth.test.ts).
 *
 * Audit finding fixed here: POST /api/expenses and POST /api/expenses/import
 * sat behind the generic /api/* authentication middleware ONLY — any
 * authenticated role (including 'stock' and plain 'user') could insert ledger
 * rows, and even owner movements (entry_type owner_contrib / owner_draw),
 * while DELETE /api/expenses/:id was already gated (requireBizMutator +
 * password confirm). Both write routes now enforce owner/admin explicitly —
 * the same contract as requireOwner() in the monolith (403 OWNER_ONLY) — with
 * defense-in-depth session re-validation (authFailReason) exactly like
 * routes/finance.ts does for every finance surface.
 *
 * Read routes (GET /api/expenses, /:id/links) and DELETE stay where they are;
 * response shapes, French messages and validation codes are unchanged.
 */
import type { AtlasApp } from './types';
import { validateExpenseWrite } from '../lib/validate';
import { normalizeRole } from '../lib/rbac';
import { apiFail } from '../lib/api-response';

export type ExpenseWriteDeps = {
  sessionUserFromHeader(authHeader: string | undefined): { username: string; role: string };
  authFailReason(
    authHeader: string | undefined,
    env: any,
    db: D1Database,
    ip: string,
    fingerprint: string | undefined,
  ): Promise<string>;
  clientIp(c: any): string;
  ensureExpenseTypeColumn(db: D1Database): Promise<void>;
  invalidateDashboardCache(cache: any): Promise<void>;
  writeAudit(
    db: D1Database,
    opts: { username?: string; role?: string; action: string; entity?: string; entity_id?: string | number; detail?: string; ip?: string },
  ): Promise<void>;
};

/** Ledger writes are owner/admin only — secretaire keeps invoice/client access
 *  on the other routes but never touches the treasury journal directly. */
const LEDGER_WRITE_ROLES = ['owner', 'admin'];

export function registerExpenseWriteRoutes(app: AtlasApp, deps: ExpenseWriteDeps): void {
  /** Shared gate: verified session (401) + owner/admin role (403 OWNER_ONLY). */
  async function requireLedgerWriter(c: any): Promise<{ username: string; role: string } | Response> {
    const authHeader = c.req.header('Authorization');
    const reason = await deps.authFailReason(
      authHeader, c.env, c.env.DB, deps.clientIp(c), c.req.header('X-Device-Fingerprint') || undefined,
    );
    if (reason !== 'ok') {
      return c.json({
        success: false,
        error: reason === 'ip_changed' ? 'Adresse IP modifiée — reconnexion requise'
          : reason === 'fp_changed' ? 'Appareil différent — reconnexion requise'
          : 'Non autorisé',
        code: reason === 'ip_changed' ? 'IP_CHANGED' : reason === 'fp_changed' ? 'DEVICE_CHANGED' : 'UNAUTHORIZED',
      }, 401);
    }
    const session = deps.sessionUserFromHeader(authHeader);
    const role = normalizeRole(session.role);
    if (!LEDGER_WRITE_ROLES.includes(role)) {
      return c.json(
        { success: false, error: 'Réservé à l\'administrateur principal', code: 'OWNER_ONLY', role },
        403,
      );
    }
    return { username: String(session.username || 'user'), role };
  }

  /* ─── POST /api/expenses — create a ledger entry (owner/admin) ─── */
  app.post('/api/expenses', async (c) => {
    const gate = await requireLedgerWriter(c);
    if (gate instanceof Response) return gate;
    await deps.ensureExpenseTypeColumn(c.env.DB);
    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const verr = validateExpenseWrite(body);
    if (verr) return apiFail(c, Object.values(verr)[0] || 'Validation', 'VALIDATION', verr);
    const {
      category = 'General',
      description,
      amount,
      payment_method = 'cash',
      expense_date,
      vendor_name = '',
      reference = '',
      notes = '',
      entry_type = 'expense',
    } = body;
    if (!description || amount == null) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'La description et le montant sont obligatoires' }, 400);
    const allowedTypes = ['expense', 'income', 'owner_draw', 'owner_contrib'];
    const type = allowedTypes.includes(entry_type) ? entry_type : 'expense';
    const result = await c.env.DB.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO expenses (category, description, amount, payment_method, expense_date, vendor_name, reference, notes, entry_type)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
    ).bind(
      category,
      description,
      amount,
      payment_method,
      expense_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      vendor_name,
      reference,
      notes,
      type,
    ).run();
    const expense = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM expenses WHERE id = ?`).bind(result.meta.last_row_id).first();
    await deps.invalidateDashboardCache(c.env.CACHE);
    void deps.writeAudit(c.env.DB, {
      username: gate.username, role: gate.role, action: 'expense.create', entity: 'expenses',
      entity_id: String((expense as any)?.id ?? ''), detail: `${type}:${Number(amount)}`, ip: deps.clientIp(c),
    });
    const msg = type === 'income' ? 'Recette enregistrée dans la base de données.' : 'Dépense enregistrée dans la base de données.';
    return c.json({ success: true, data: expense, message: msg }, 201);
  });

  /* ─── POST /api/expenses/import — bulk ledger import (owner/admin) ─── */
  app.post('/api/expenses/import', async (c) => {
    const gate = await requireLedgerWriter(c);
    if (gate instanceof Response) return gate;
    await deps.ensureExpenseTypeColumn(c.env.DB);
    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const rows = Array.isArray(body.rows) ? body.rows : [];
    if (!rows.length) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Aucune ligne à importer' }, 400);
    let inserted = 0;
    for (const row of rows) {
      const amount = Number(row.amount || row.montant || 0);
      if (!amount || amount <= 0) continue;
      const entryType = row.entry_type || row.type || (row.direction === 'in' || row.direction === 'entrée' || row.direction === 'دخول' ? 'income' : 'expense');
      const type = ['expense', 'income', 'owner_draw', 'owner_contrib'].includes(entryType) ? entryType : (Number(row.in || row['دخول'] || 0) > 0 ? 'income' : 'expense');
      const amt = amount || Number(row.in || row['دخول'] || row.out || row['خروج'] || 0);
      if (!amt) continue;
      const description = String(row.description || row.label || row.libelle || row['معلومات'] || 'Import').trim();
      const category = String(row.category || row.categorie || 'Import Excel').trim();
      const payment_method = String(row.payment_method || row.mode || 'cash');
      const expense_date = String(row.date || row.expense_date || row['التاريخ'] || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)).slice(0, 10);
      await c.env.DB.prepare(
        `INSERT INTO expenses (category, description, amount, payment_method, expense_date, vendor_name, reference, notes, entry_type)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
      ).bind(category, description, amt, payment_method, expense_date, row.vendor || '', row.reference || 'import', row.notes || '', type).run();
      inserted++;
    }
    void deps.writeAudit(c.env.DB, {
      username: gate.username, role: gate.role, action: 'expense.import', entity: 'expenses',
      detail: `inserted=${inserted}`, ip: deps.clientIp(c),
    });
    return c.json({ success: true, message: `${inserted} écriture(s) importée(s).`, count: inserted });
  });
}

/**
 * v254 — Finance, payroll & monthly report endpoints.
 *
 * Server-authoritative rules (never trust the client):
 *  - identity/role come ONLY from the verified session (Authorization header,
 *    re-validated here with authFailReason even though the /api/* middleware
 *    already ran — defense in depth inside every endpoint);
 *  - owner/admin pass financeGate(); secretaire/stock/user get 403 with the
 *    stable code FIN_FORBIDDEN (secretaire keeps its existing invoice/client
 *    access on the other routes — payroll & treasury are NOT part of it);
 *  - every amount is computed from persisted ledger rows (see lib/finance.ts
 *    calculation rules) — client-sent totals are never read;
 *  - responses are additive: existing invoice/bill/employee routes are
 *    untouched, nothing here renames or removes a field.
 */
import type { AtlasApp } from './types';
import {
  computeMonthlySummary,
  computePayrollObligations,
  computePeriodBreakdown,
  computeStatement,
  ensureFinanceSchema,
  financeGate,
  getFinanceContext,
  isValidPeriod,
  monthBounds,
  payrollObligation,
  round2,
  runFinanceReminders,
} from '../lib/finance';
import { addColumnIfMissing } from '../lib/schema';
import { buildFinanceReportPdf } from '../pdf';

export type FinanceRouteDeps = {
  sessionUserFromHeader(authHeader: string | undefined): { username: string; role: string };
  authFailReason(
    authHeader: string | undefined,
    env: any,
    db: D1Database,
    ip: string,
    fingerprint: string | undefined,
  ): Promise<string>;
  clientIp(c: any): string;
  writeAudit(
    db: D1Database,
    opts: { username?: string; role?: string; action: string; entity?: string; entity_id?: string | number; detail?: string; ip?: string },
  ): Promise<void>;
};

const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 200;
const MAX_DOCS = 200;

function resolvePeriod(c: any, fallback: string): string | null {
  const p = String(c.req.query('period') || '').trim();
  if (!p) return fallback;
  return isValidPeriod(p) ? p : null;
}

export function registerFinanceRoutes(app: AtlasApp, deps: FinanceRouteDeps): void {
  /**
   * Shared gate for every finance surface. Returns the session on success,
   * or a ready JSON error response (401 UNAUTHORIZED / 403 FIN_FORBIDDEN).
   */
  async function requireFinanceAdmin(c: any): Promise<{ username: string; role: string } | Response> {
    const authHeader = c.req.header('Authorization');
    const reason = await deps.authFailReason(authHeader, c.env, c.env.DB, deps.clientIp(c), c.req.header('X-Device-Fingerprint') || '');
    if (reason !== 'ok') {
      return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Session invalide', code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', reason }, 401);
    }
    const session = deps.sessionUserFromHeader(authHeader);
    const gate = financeGate(session.role, session.username);
    if (!gate.ok) {
      return c.json({ success: false, error: gate.error, code: gate.code }, 403);
    }
    return session;
  }

  /* ─── GET /api/admin/finance/monthly?period=YYYY-MM ─── */
  app.get('/api/admin/finance/monthly', async (c) => {
    const auth = await requireFinanceAdmin(c);
    if (auth instanceof Response) return auth;
    try {
      await ensureFinanceSchema(c.env.DB);
      const ctx = await getFinanceContext(c.env.DB);
      const period = resolvePeriod(c, ctx.today.slice(0, 7));
      if (!period) {
        return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Période invalide — format attendu YYYY-MM.', code: 'BAD_PERIOD' }, 400);
      }
      const summary = await computeMonthlySummary(c.env.DB, period, ctx);
      const recvCount = summary.receivables.documents.length;
      const payCount = summary.payables.documents.length;
      summary.receivables.documents = summary.receivables.documents.slice(0, MAX_DOCS);
      summary.payables.documents = summary.payables.documents.slice(0, MAX_DOCS);
      return c.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          ...summary,
          receivables: { ...summary.receivables, count: recvCount, truncated: recvCount > MAX_DOCS },
          payables: { ...summary.payables, count: payCount, truncated: payCount > MAX_DOCS },
        },
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('finance_monthly_err', String(e?.message || e));
      return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Calcul mensuel impossible', code: 'FINANCE_ERROR' }, 500);
    }
  });

  /* ─── GET /api/admin/employees/payroll?period=YYYY-MM&page=1&page_size=50&due_before=YYYY-MM-DD ───
   * Fields are deliberately minimal (privacy): employee_id, display_name,
   * amount_due, pay_period, due_date, status, last_payment. Never phone,
   * national id, sales figures or balances. */
  app.get('/api/admin/employees/payroll', async (c) => {
    const auth = await requireFinanceAdmin(c);
    if (auth instanceof Response) return auth;
    try {
      await ensureFinanceSchema(c.env.DB);
      const ctx = await getFinanceContext(c.env.DB);
      const period = resolvePeriod(c, ctx.today.slice(0, 7));
      if (!period) {
        return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Période invalide — format attendu YYYY-MM.', code: 'BAD_PERIOD' }, 400);
      }
      const page = Math.max(1, Number(c.req.query('page') || 1) || 1);
      const pageSize = Math.min(MAX_PAGE_SIZE, Math.max(1, Number(c.req.query('page_size') || 50) || 50));
      const dueBefore = String(c.req.query('due_before') || '').slice(0, 10);
      const b = monthBounds(period);
      // For a past period, obligations are frozen at the period end; for the
      // current/future period, accrual runs to today (never into the future).
      const asOf = ctx.today < b.end ? ctx.today : b.end;
      const obligations = await computePayrollObligations(c.env.DB, asOf);

      const rows = [];
      for (const ob of obligations) {
        if (!ob) continue;
        if (dueBefore && (!ob.due_date || ob.due_date > dueBefore)) continue;
        let lastPayment: { amount: number; paid_at: string; period_label: string } | null = null;
        try {
          const lp = await c.env.DB.prepare(
            `SELECT amount, paid_at, period_label FROM employee_payments
             WHERE employee_id = ? ORDER BY substr(paid_at,1,10) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1`,
          ).bind(ob.employee_id).first() as any;
          if (lp) {
            lastPayment = {
              amount: round2(Number(lp.amount || 0)),
              paid_at: String(lp.paid_at || '').slice(0, 10),
              period_label: String(lp.period_label || ''),
            };
          }
        } catch { /* table may lag */ }
        const unpaid = !!ob.due_date && ob.due_date <= asOf && ob.amount_due > 0.005;
        rows.push({
          employee_id: ob.employee_id,
          display_name: ob.display_name,
          amount_due: ob.amount_due,
          pay_period: ob.pay_period,
          due_date: ob.due_date,
          status: unpaid ? 'unpaid' : 'paid',
          last_payment: lastPayment,
        });
      }
      rows.sort((x, y) => String(x.due_date || '9999').localeCompare(String(y.due_date || '9999')) || x.employee_id - y.employee_id);

      const total = rows.length;
      const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;
      const slice = rows.slice(start, start + pageSize);
      return c.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          period,
          as_of: asOf,
          timezone: ctx.timezone,
          currency: ctx.currency,
          totals: {
            amount_due: round2(rows.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.status === 'unpaid' ? r.amount_due : 0), 0)),
            unpaid_count: rows.filter((r) => r.status === 'unpaid').length,
            count: total,
          },
          page,
          page_size: pageSize,
          total,
          has_more: start + slice.length < total,
          rows: slice,
        },
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('finance_payroll_err', String(e?.message || e));
      return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Calcul de paie impossible', code: 'FINANCE_ERROR' }, 500);
    }
  });

  /* ─── GET /api/me/payroll ───
   * v256 — employee-SELF pay date. ANY authenticated session (user, stock,

   * linked to its own login (employees.user_username) — nothing else. The

  app.get('/api/me/payroll', async (c) => {
    const authHeader = c.req.header('Authorization');
    const reason = await deps.authFailReason(authHeader, c.env, c.env.DB, deps.clientIp(c), c.req.header('X-Device-Fingerprint') || '');
    if (reason !== 'ok') {
      return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Session invalide', code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', reason }, 401);
    }

    try {

      const found = await c.env.DB.prepare(

         FROM employees WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(user_username,''))) = ? LIMIT 2`,
      ).bind(username).all() as any;
      const rows = found?.results || [];
      if (!rows.length) {

      }
      if (rows.length > 1) {

        const r = await c.env.DB.prepare(

           WHERE employee_id = ? AND substr(paid_at,1,10) >= ? AND substr(paid_at,1,10) <= ?
             AND (period_label LIKE 'Acompte%' OR note LIKE '%[acompte]%')`,

          `SELECT amount, paid_at, period_label FROM employee_payments
           WHERE employee_id = ? ORDER BY substr(paid_at,1,10) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1`,
        ).bind(Number(row.id)).first() as any;
        if (lp) {
          lastPayment = {
            amount: round2(Number(lp.amount || 0)),
            paid_at: String(lp.paid_at || '').slice(0, 10),
            period_label: String(lp.period_label || ''),
          };
        }
      } catch { /* table may lag */ }
      const ob = payrollObligation(row, asOf, advances);
      if (!ob) {
        // Linked file but payroll not configured (no pay_amount / no anchor):
        // expose the link only — never other employees' data.
        return c.json({
          success: true,
          data: {
            linked: true,
            payroll_configured: false,
            employee_id: Number(row.id),
            as_of: asOf,
            timezone: ctx.timezone,
            currency: ctx.currency,
            last_payment: lastPayment,
          },
        });
      }
      const unpaid = !!ob.due_date && ob.due_date <= asOf && ob.amount_due > 0.005;
      return c.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          linked: true,
          payroll_configured: true,
          employee_id: ob.employee_id,
          display_name: ob.display_name,
          amount_due: ob.amount_due,
          pay_period: ob.pay_period,
          due_date: ob.due_date,
          daily_rate: ob.daily_rate,
          status: unpaid ? 'unpaid' : 'paid',
          last_payment: lastPayment,
          as_of: asOf,
          timezone: ctx.timezone,
          currency: ctx.currency,
        },
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('me_payroll_err', String(e?.message || e));
      return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Lecture de paie impossible', code: 'FINANCE_ERROR' }, 500);
    }
  });

  /* ─── GET /api/admin/finance/statement?period=YYYY-MM&page=1&page_size=50 ───
   * v258 — server-backed monthly statement (owner/admin): opening balance,
   * chronological cash rows (sale / refund / expense / payroll / supplier) with
   * running balance, totals and the reconciliation invariant. Same canonical
   * filtered queries as the monthly summary and the PDF, so the three can never
   * disagree. Mirror ledger rows and « Avoir » audit trails are excluded here
   * exactly as in the summary (see lib/finance.ts SQL filters). */
  app.get('/api/admin/finance/statement', async (c) => {
    const auth = await requireFinanceAdmin(c);
    if (auth instanceof Response) return auth;
    try {
      await ensureFinanceSchema(c.env.DB);
      const ctx = await getFinanceContext(c.env.DB);
      const period = resolvePeriod(c, ctx.today.slice(0, 7));
      if (!period) {
        return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Période invalide — format attendu YYYY-MM.', code: 'BAD_PERIOD' }, 400);
      }
      const page = Math.max(1, Number(c.req.query('page') || 1) || 1);
      const pageSize = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Number(c.req.query('page_size') || 50) || 50));
      const stmt = await computeStatement(c.env.DB, period, ctx, page, pageSize);
      return c.json({ success: true, data: stmt });
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('finance_statement_err', String(e?.message || e));
      return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Relevé impossible à calculer', code: 'FINANCE_ERROR' }, 500);
    }
  });

  /* ─── GET /api/admin/finance/period?period=YYYY-MM ───
   * v264 — owner/admin cash & bank breakdown of the selected period:
   * inflows/outflows split by payment method (canonical caisse/banque rule),
   * owner contributions/withdrawals, expense-category totals and the
   * statement invariant. Computed ONLY from persisted ledger rows with the
   * SAME timezone + canonical filters as GET /api/admin/finance/statement —
   * missing methods are reported as `not_recorded`, never inferred. */
  app.get('/api/admin/finance/period', async (c) => {
    const auth = await requireFinanceAdmin(c);
    if (auth instanceof Response) return auth;
    try {
      await ensureFinanceSchema(c.env.DB);
      const ctx = await getFinanceContext(c.env.DB);
      const period = resolvePeriod(c, ctx.today.slice(0, 7));
      if (!period) {
        return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Période invalide — format attendu YYYY-MM.', code: 'BAD_PERIOD' }, 400);
      }
      const data = await computePeriodBreakdown(c.env.DB, period, ctx);
      return c.json({ success: true, data });
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('finance_period_err', String(e?.message || e));
      return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Ventilation de période impossible à calculer', code: 'FINANCE_ERROR' }, 500);
    }
  });

  /* ─── GET /api/admin/finance/monthly/report.pdf?period=YYYY-MM ───
   * Generated on demand, streamed, never stored, never publicly enumerable
   * (no R2 object, no stable URL — the period alone yields nothing without a
   * verified owner/admin session). Audit-logged per download. */
  app.get('/api/admin/finance/monthly/report.pdf', async (c) => {
    const auth = await requireFinanceAdmin(c);
    if (auth instanceof Response) return auth;
    try {
      await ensureFinanceSchema(c.env.DB);
      const ctx = await getFinanceContext(c.env.DB);
      const period = resolvePeriod(c, ctx.today.slice(0, 7));
      if (!period) {
        return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Période invalide — format attendu YYYY-MM.', code: 'BAD_PERIOD' }, 400);
      }
      const summary = await computeMonthlySummary(c.env.DB, period, ctx);
      const bytes = buildFinanceReportPdf({
        companyName: ctx.companyName,
        currency: ctx.currency,
        period,
        generatedAt: summary.reconciliation.generated_at,
        openingBalance: summary.opening_balance,
        closingBalance: summary.closing_balance,
        salesReceived: summary.sales_received,
        expenses: summary.expenses,
        refunds: summary.refunds,
        payrollPaid: summary.payroll_paid,
        supplierPaid: summary.supplier_paid,
        receivablesTotal: summary.receivables.total_outstanding,
        receivablesOverdue: summary.receivables.total_overdue,
        payablesTotal: summary.payables.total_outstanding,
        payablesOverdue: summary.payables.total_overdue,
        payrollDue: summary.payroll.total_due,
        payrollCount: summary.payroll.employees,
        receivableDocs: summary.receivables.documents.slice(0, 14),
        receivableDocsTotal: summary.receivables.documents.length,
        payableDocs: summary.payables.documents.slice(0, 14),
        payableDocsTotal: summary.payables.documents.length,
      });
      void deps.writeAudit(c.env.DB, {
        username: auth.username,
        role: auth.role,
        action: 'finance_report_pdf',
        entity: 'finance_report',
        entity_id: period,
        detail: 'Rapport mensuel PDF téléchargé',
        ip: deps.clientIp(c),
      });
      return new Response(bytes as unknown as BodyInit, {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/pdf',
          'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="rapport-mensuel-${period}.pdf"`,
          'Cache-Control': 'no-store',
        },
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('finance_pdf_err', String(e?.message || e));
      return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Génération du rapport impossible', code: 'FINANCE_ERROR' }, 500);
    }
  });

  /* ─── POST /api/cron/finance-reminders ───
   * Manual/external trigger for the same idempotent run the wrangler cron
   * performs. CRON_SECRET-gated exactly like /api/cron/backup-execute; the
   * /api/* auth middleware exempts /api/cron/* so this handler is the gate. */
  app.post('/api/cron/finance-reminders', async (c) => {
    const auth = String(c.req.header('Authorization') || '').trim();
    const secret = String((c.env as any).CRON_SECRET || '').trim();
    if (!secret) {
      return c.json({
        success: false,
        error: 'CRON_SECRET non configuré. Exécutez: npx wrangler secret put CRON_SECRET',
        code: 'CRON_SECRET_MISSING',
      }, 503);
    }
    const bearer = auth.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ') ? auth.slice(7).trim() : '';
    const headerToken = String(c.req.header('X-Cron-Secret') || '').trim();
    if (bearer !== secret && headerToken !== secret) {
      return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Unauthorized', code: 'CRON_UNAUTHORIZED' }, 401);
    }
    try {
      const report = await runFinanceReminders(c.env);
      return c.json({ success: true, data: report });
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('finance_cron_err', String(e?.message || e));
      return c.json({ success: false, error: String(e?.message || e).slice(0, 200), code: 'FINANCE_CRON_ERROR' }, 500);
    }
  });
}
