import type { AtlasApp } from './types';

/** Invoice read routes (list/detail). Create/pay/delete remain in worker/index.ts for now. */
export function registerInvoiceReadRoutes(app: AtlasApp): void {
  app.get('/api/invoices', async (c) => {
    const status = c.req.query('status');
    const clientId = c.req.query('client');
    const kind = String(c.req.query('kind') || '').trim();
    let sql = `SELECT * FROM invoices`;
    const conditions: string[] = [];
    const binds: any[] = [];
    if (status) {
      conditions.push('status = ?');
      binds.push(status);
    }
    if (clientId) {
      conditions.push('client_id = ?');
      binds.push(clientId);
    }
    if (kind === 'quick_sale') {
      conditions.push(
        `(COALESCE(doc_kind,'') IN ('quick_sale','ticket') OR IFNULL(number,'') LIKE 'VR-%' OR IFNULL(number,'') LIKE 'VR/%')`,
      );
    } else if (kind !== 'all') {
      conditions.push(
        `(COALESCE(doc_kind,'invoice') NOT IN ('quick_sale','ticket') AND IFNULL(number,'') NOT LIKE 'VR-%' AND IFNULL(number,'') NOT LIKE 'VR/%')`,
      );
    }
    if (conditions.length) sql += ` WHERE ` + conditions.join(' AND ');
    sql += ` ORDER BY created_at DESC`;
    const stmt = binds.length ? c.env.DB.prepare(sql).bind(...binds) : c.env.DB.prepare(sql);
    const { results } = await stmt.all();
    return c.json({ success: true, data: results });
  });

  app.get('/api/invoices/:id', async (c) => {
    const id = c.req.param('id');
    const invoice = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first();
    if (!invoice) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Facture introuvable' }, 404);
    const { results: items } = await c.env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id = ?`)
      .bind(id)
      .all();
    return c.json({ success: true, data: { ...invoice, items } });
  });
}

/**
 * Mailbox domain — peeled from worker/index.ts
 * HTTP: /api/admin/mailbox/*
 * Helpers: ensureMailSchema, R2 body crypto, Resend sync
 */
import type { Hono } from 'hono';
import { assertSafeOutboundUrl } from '../lib/security';
import { apiFail } from '../lib/api-response';
import { upstreamFetch } from '../lib/upstream';
import { enqueue } from '../lib/job-queue';

export type MailboxRouteDeps = {
  verifyBackupAccess: (
    c: any,
    opts?: { requireBackupToken?: boolean },
  ) => Promise<{ ok: true; username: string } | { ok: false; response: Response }>;
  sessionUserFromHeader: (authHeader: string | undefined) => { username: string; role: string };
};

export const ADMIN_MAILBOX = 'admin@afmarbre.com';

export async function ensureMailSchema(db: D1Database): Promise<void> {
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mail_messages (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    direction TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'out',
    mailbox TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin@afmarbre.com',
    from_addr TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    to_addr TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    cc_addr TEXT DEFAULT '',
    subject TEXT DEFAULT '',
    body_text TEXT DEFAULT '',
    body_html TEXT DEFAULT '',
    resend_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
    r2_key TEXT DEFAULT '',
    thread_key TEXT DEFAULT '',
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'received',
    meta_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  )`).run();
  try { await db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mail_created ON mail_messages(created_at DESC)`).run(); } catch { /* */ }
  try { await db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mail_mailbox ON mail_messages(mailbox, direction)`).run(); } catch { /* */ }
  try { await db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mail_resend_id ON mail_messages(resend_id)`).run(); } catch { /* */ }
  // Also ensure optional tables that backup/export may touch (avoids noisy "no such table" logs)
  try {
    await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS push_tokens (
      token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      username TEXT,
      platform TEXT,
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    )`).run();
  } catch { /* */ }
}

/** Magic header for encrypted mail blobs stored in R2 (`.mail` files). */
const MAIL_BLOB_MAGIC = new TextEncoder().encode('ATLASMAIL1'); // 10 bytes

/** Derive a 32-byte AES key for mail body encryption. */
async function mailBodyCryptoKey(env: any, usage: KeyUsage[]): Promise<CryptoKey> {
  const explicit = String(env.MAIL_BODY_ENCRYPTION_KEY || '').trim();
  const material = explicit.length >= 16
    ? explicit
    : `atlas-mail-v1|${String(env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || env.JWT_SECRET || 'atlas-mail-fallback').trim()}`;
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(material));
  return crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', hash, 'AES-GCM', false, usage);
}

/**
 * Persist full mail body to R2 as an encrypted `.mail` blob (AES-GCM).
 * Old messages may still point at plain `.json` — those remain readable via loadMailBodyR2.
 */
export async function storeMailBodyR2(env: any, id: string, html: string, text: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    if (!env.IMAGES) return null;
    const key = `mail/${ADMIN_MAILBOX}/${id}.mail`;
    const payload = JSON.stringify({
      html: String(html || ''),
      text: String(text || ''),
      stored_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      v: 1,
    });
    const cryptoKey = await mailBodyCryptoKey(env, ['encrypt']);
    const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
    const cipher = new Uint8Array(
      await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, cryptoKey, new TextEncoder().encode(payload))
    );
    // layout: magic(10) + iv(12) + ciphertext
    const out = new Uint8Array(MAIL_BLOB_MAGIC.length + iv.length + cipher.length);
    out.set(MAIL_BLOB_MAGIC, 0);
    out.set(iv, MAIL_BLOB_MAGIC.length);
    out.set(cipher, MAIL_BLOB_MAGIC.length + iv.length);
    await env.IMAGES.put(key, out, {
      httpMetadata: { contentType: 'application/vnd.atlas.mail', cacheControl: 'private, no-store' },
      customMetadata: { encrypted: 'aes-gcm-v1', format: 'mail' },
    });
    return key;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('storeMailBodyR2_err', String((e as any)?.message || e));
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Load a mail body from R2.
 * Supports:
 *  - new encrypted `.mail` blobs (ATLASMAIL1 + AES-GCM)
 *  - legacy plain `.json` objects `{ html, text }`
 */

/** Write body only to R2; keep D1 columns empty (metadata + r2_key only). */
async function persistMailBodyR2Only(
  env: any,
  msgId: string | number,
  html: string,
  text: string,
): Promise<string | null> {
  const key = await storeMailBodyR2(env, String(msgId), html || '', text || '');
  if (!key) return null;
  try {
    await env.DB.prepare(
      `UPDATE mail_messages SET r2_key = ?, body_html = '', body_text = '' WHERE id = ?`,
    )
      .bind(key, msgId)
      .run();
  } catch {
    try {
      await env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE mail_messages SET r2_key = ? WHERE id = ?`).bind(key, msgId).run();
    } catch { /* */ }
  }
  return key;
}

export async function loadMailBodyR2(
  env: any,
  r2Key: string
): Promise<{ html?: string; text?: string } | null> {
  try {
    if (!env.IMAGES || !r2Key) return null;
    const obj = await env.IMAGES.get(r2Key);
    if (!obj) return null;

    // Legacy plain JSON
    const ct = (obj.httpMetadata?.contentType || '').toLowerCase();
    const isLegacyJson =
      r2Key.endsWith('.json') ||
      ct.includes('application/json') ||
      (obj.customMetadata?.encrypted !== 'aes-gcm-v1' && !r2Key.endsWith('.mail'));

    if (isLegacyJson && !r2Key.endsWith('.mail')) {
      try {
        const j = (await obj.json()) as any;
        if (j && (j.html != null || j.text != null)) {
          return { html: j.html ? String(j.html) : undefined, text: j.text ? String(j.text) : undefined };
        }
      } catch { /* fall through to binary path */ }
    }

    const buf = new Uint8Array(await obj.arrayBuffer());
    // Encrypted .mail with magic header
    if (buf.length > 22) {
      let magicOk = true;
      for (let i = 0; i < MAIL_BLOB_MAGIC.length; i++) {
        if (buf[i] !== MAIL_BLOB_MAGIC[i]) { magicOk = false; break; }
      }
      if (magicOk) {
        const iv = buf.subarray(10, 22);
        const cipher = buf.subarray(22);
        const cryptoKey = await mailBodyCryptoKey(env, ['decrypt']);
        const plain = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, cryptoKey, cipher);
        const j = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(plain)) as any;
        return {
          html: j?.html != null ? String(j.html) : undefined,
          text: j?.text != null ? String(j.text) : undefined,
        };
      }
    }

    // Older encrypted layout without magic (iv + cipher only) — try if metadata says encrypted
    if (obj.customMetadata?.encrypted === 'aes-gcm-v1' && buf.length > 12) {
      try {
        const iv = buf.subarray(0, 12);
        const cipher = buf.subarray(12);
        const cryptoKey = await mailBodyCryptoKey(env, ['decrypt']);
        const plain = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, cryptoKey, cipher);
        const j = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(plain)) as any;
        return {
          html: j?.html != null ? String(j.html) : undefined,
          text: j?.text != null ? String(j.text) : undefined,
        };
      } catch { /* */ }
    }

    // Last resort: treat body as UTF-8 JSON
    try {
      const j = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buf)) as any;
      if (j && (j.html != null || j.text != null)) {
        return { html: j.html ? String(j.html) : undefined, text: j.text ? String(j.text) : undefined };
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
    return null;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('loadMailBodyR2_err', String((e as any)?.message || e));
    return null;
  }
}

function normalizeAddrList(v: any): string {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(String).filter(Boolean).join(', ');
  return String(v || '').trim();
}

export async function syncResendHistory(env: any, opts?: { limit?: number }): Promise<{ imported: number; skipped: number; errors: number; total_listed: number }> {
  const apiKey = String(env.RESEND_API_KEY || '').trim();
  if (!apiKey) return { imported: 0, skipped: 0, errors: 0, total_listed: 0 };
  await ensureMailSchema(env.DB);
  const max = Math.min(200, Math.max(10, Number(opts?.limit || 100)));
  let imported = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let errors = 0;
  let total_listed = 0;
  let after: string | null = null;

  for (let page = 0; page < 15 && total_listed < max; page++) {
    const url = new URL('https://api.resend.com/emails');
    url.searchParams.set('limit', String(Math.min(100, max - total_listed)));
    if (after) url.searchParams.set('after', after);
    const listRes = await fetch(url.toString(), {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, Accept: 'application/json' },
    });
    if (!listRes.ok) {
      errors++;
      break;
    }
    const listJson = await listRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as any;
    const items: any[] = Array.isArray(listJson?.data) ? listJson.data : [];
    if (!items.length) break;
    total_listed += items.length;

    for (const item of items) {
      const rid = String(item.id || '').trim();
      if (!rid) continue;
      try {
        const existing = await env.DB.prepare(
          `SELECT id FROM mail_messages WHERE resend_id = ? LIMIT 1`
        ).bind(rid).first();
        if (existing) {
          skipped++;
          continue;
        }

        let detail: any = item;
        try {
          // Soft rate-limit: Resend free tier is ~10 req/s; pause briefly between detail fetches
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 120));
          const dRes = await fetch(`https://api.resend.com/emails/${encodeURIComponent(rid)}`, {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, Accept: 'application/json' },
          });
          if (dRes.ok) {
            const dj = await dRes.json().catch(() => null);
            // Resend may wrap as { data: {...} }
            if (dj?.data && typeof dj.data === 'object') detail = dj.data;
            else if (dj) detail = dj;
          } else if (dRes.status === 429) {
            // Hit rate limit — stop further detail fetches this run
            errors++;
            break;
          }
        } catch { /* use list item */ }

        const from = String(detail.from || item.from || env.RESEND_FROM || ADMIN_MAILBOX);
        const to = normalizeAddrList(detail.to ?? item.to);
        const cc = normalizeAddrList(detail.cc ?? item.cc);
        const subject = String(detail.subject || item.subject || '(sans objet)').slice(0, 500);
        const html = String(detail.html || '').slice(0, 200000);
        const text = String(detail.text || '').slice(0, 50000);
        const createdRaw = String(detail.created_at || item.created_at || new Date().toISOString());
        const created = createdRaw.includes('T')
          ? createdRaw.replace('T', ' ').replace(/\.\d+Z?$/, '').slice(0, 19)
          : createdRaw.slice(0, 19);
        const status = String(detail.last_event || item.last_event || 'sent');

        const ins = await env.DB.prepare(
          `INSERT INTO mail_messages (direction, mailbox, from_addr, to_addr, cc_addr, subject, body_text, body_html, resend_id, status, meta_json, created_at)
           VALUES ('out', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
        ).bind(
          ADMIN_MAILBOX,
          from,
          to,
          cc,
          subject,
          text || (html ? html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 5000) : ''),
          html,
          rid,
          status,
          JSON.stringify({ source: 'resend_sync', last_event: status }),
          created,
        ).run();
        const newId = String(ins.meta?.last_row_id || '');
        if (newId && (html || text)) {
          await persistMailBodyR2Only(env, newId, html, text);
        }
        imported++;
      } catch {
        errors++;
      }
    }

    const lastId = items[items.length - 1]?.id;
    if (listJson?.has_more && lastId) {
      after = String(lastId);
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }

  // Also try Resend receiving (inbound) API if available on the account
  try {
    const rUrl = new URL('https://api.resend.com/emails/receiving');
    rUrl.searchParams.set('limit', '50');
    const rRes = await fetch(rUrl.toString(), {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, Accept: 'application/json' },
    });
    if (rRes.ok) {
      const rj = await rRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as any;
      const rItems: any[] = Array.isArray(rj?.data) ? rj.data : [];
      total_listed += rItems.length;
      for (const item of rItems) {
        const rid = String(item.id || '').trim();
        if (!rid) continue;
        try {
          const existing = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT id FROM mail_messages WHERE resend_id = ? LIMIT 1`).bind(`recv-${rid}`).first();
          if (existing) { skipped++; continue; }
          const from = String(item.from || '');
          const to = normalizeAddrList(item.to) || ADMIN_MAILBOX;
          const subject = String(item.subject || '(sans objet)').slice(0, 500);
          const createdRaw = String(item.created_at || new Date().toISOString());
          const created = createdRaw.includes('T')
            ? createdRaw.replace('T', ' ').replace(/\.\d+Z?$/, '').slice(0, 19)
            : createdRaw.slice(0, 19);
          await env.DB.prepare(
            `INSERT INTO mail_messages (direction, mailbox, from_addr, to_addr, subject, body_text, resend_id, status, meta_json, created_at)
             VALUES ('in', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'received', ?, ?)`
          ).bind(
            ADMIN_MAILBOX, from, to, subject,
            String(item.text || item.html || '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').slice(0, 5000),
            `recv-${rid}`,
            JSON.stringify({ source: 'resend_receiving' }),
            created,
          ).run();
          imported++;
        } catch { errors++; }
      }
    }
  } catch { /* receiving API may not be enabled */ }

  return { imported, skipped, errors, total_listed };
}


export function registerMailboxRoutes(app: Hono<any>, deps: MailboxRouteDeps): void {
  const verifyBackupAccess = deps.verifyBackupAccess;
  const sessionUserFromHeader = deps.sessionUserFromHeader;

  const AGENT_BLOB_MAGIC = new TextEncoder().encode('ATLASAGNT1');

  async function agentCryptoKey(env: any, usage: KeyUsage[]): Promise<CryptoKey> {
    const material = String(
      env.AGENT_CHAT_SECRET || env.MAIL_BODY_ENCRYPTION_KEY || env.JWT_SECRET || env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'atlas-agent',
    ).trim();
    const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(`atlas-agent-v1|${material}`));
    return crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', hash, 'AES-GCM', false, usage);
  }

  async function storeAgentThreadR2(env: any, userKey: string, threadId: string, payload: any): Promise<boolean> {
    const body = { ...payload, stored_at: new Date().toISOString(), v: 1 };
    try {
      if (env.IMAGES) {
        const key = `agent/${userKey}/${threadId}.agent`;
        const plain = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(body));
        if (plain.byteLength > 1_500_000) return false; // v231: refuse oversized blobs, keep local copy
        const cryptoKey = await agentCryptoKey(env, ['encrypt']);
        const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
        const cipher = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, cryptoKey, plain));
        const out = new Uint8Array(AGENT_BLOB_MAGIC.length + iv.length + cipher.length);
        out.set(AGENT_BLOB_MAGIC, 0);
        out.set(iv, AGENT_BLOB_MAGIC.length);
        out.set(cipher, AGENT_BLOB_MAGIC.length + iv.length);
        await env.IMAGES.put(key, out, {
          httpMetadata: { contentType: 'application/vnd.atlas.agent', cacheControl: 'private, no-store' },
          customMetadata: { encrypted: 'aes-gcm-agent-v1', thread: String(threadId).slice(0, 64) },
        });
        return true;
      }
      // Fallback: KV (no R2 binding in this env) — still no plaintext in D1
      if (env.CACHE) {
        const k = `agent-thread:${userKey}:${threadId}`;
        await env.CACHE.put(k, JSON.stringify(body), { expirationTtl: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 });
        // index of thread ids
        const idxKey = `agent-thread-idx:${userKey}`;
        let ids: string[] = [];
        try {
          const raw = await env.CACHE.get(idxKey);
          if (raw) ids = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch { /* */ }
        if (!Array.isArray(ids)) ids = [];
        if (!ids.includes(threadId)) ids.unshift(threadId);
        await env.CACHE.put(idxKey, JSON.stringify(ids.slice(0, 40)), { expirationTtl: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 });
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('storeAgentThreadR2', String((e as any)?.message || e));
      return false;
    }
  }

  async function loadAgentThreadR2(env: any, userKey: string, threadId: string): Promise<any | null> {
    try {
      if (env.IMAGES) {
        const key = `agent/${userKey}/${threadId}.agent`;
        const obj = await env.IMAGES.get(key);
        if (obj) {
          const buf = new Uint8Array(await obj.arrayBuffer());
          if (buf.length >= AGENT_BLOB_MAGIC.length + 12 + 1) {
            const magicOk = AGENT_BLOB_MAGIC.every((b, i) => buf[i] === b);
            if (magicOk) {
              const iv = buf.subarray(AGENT_BLOB_MAGIC.length, AGENT_BLOB_MAGIC.length + 12);
              const cipher = buf.subarray(AGENT_BLOB_MAGIC.length + 12);
              const cryptoKey = await agentCryptoKey(env, ['decrypt']);
              const plain = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, cryptoKey, cipher);
              return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(plain));
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (env.CACHE) {
        const raw = await env.CACHE.get(`agent-thread:${userKey}:${threadId}`);
        if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
      }
      return null;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('loadAgentThreadR2', String((e as any)?.message || e));
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function listAgentThreadKeys(env: any, userKey: string): Promise<string[]> {
    const ids: string[] = [];
    try {
      if (env.IMAGES) {
        const listed = await env.IMAGES.list({ prefix: `agent/${userKey}/`, limit: 50 });
        const cutoff = Date.now() - 30 * 86400000;
        for (const o of listed.objects || []) {
          const k = String(o.key || '');
          if (!k.endsWith('.agent')) continue;
          const uploaded = o.uploaded ? new Date(o.uploaded).getTime() : 0;
          if (uploaded && uploaded < cutoff) {
            try { await env.IMAGES.delete(k); } catch { /* */ }
            continue;
          }
          ids.push(k.replace(`agent/${userKey}/`, '').replace(/\.agent$/, ''));
        }
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
    try {
      if (env.CACHE) {
        const raw = await env.CACHE.get(`agent-thread-idx:${userKey}`);
        if (raw) {
          const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
            for (const id of arr) {
              if (id && !ids.includes(id)) ids.push(String(id));
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
    return ids.slice(0, 50);
  }

  function agentUserKeyFromRequest(c: any): { ok: true; userKey: string; username: string } | { ok: false; response: Response } {
    const authHeader = c.req.header('Authorization');
    if (!authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      return { ok: false, response: c.json({ success: false, error: 'Authentification requise.' }, 401) };
    }
    const session = sessionUserFromHeader(authHeader);
    const username = String(session.username || '').trim();
    if (!username) {
      return { ok: false, response: c.json({ success: false, error: 'Session invalide.' }, 401) };
    }
    const userKey = username.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_').slice(0, 64) || 'user';
    return { ok: true, userKey, username };
  }

  app.get('/api/admin/agent/threads', async (c) => {
    const gate = agentUserKeyFromRequest(c);
    if (!gate.ok) return gate.response;
    const ids = await listAgentThreadKeys(c.env, gate.userKey);
    const threads: any[] = [];
    for (const id of ids.slice(0, 40)) {
      const data = await loadAgentThreadR2(c.env, gate.userKey, id);
      if (data) {
        threads.push({
          id,
          title: data.title || 'Sans titre',
          updated_at: data.updated_at || data.stored_at || null,
          message_count: Array.isArray(data.messages) ? data.messages.length : 0,
        });
      } else {
        threads.push({ id, title: id, updated_at: null, message_count: 0 });
      }
    }
    threads.sort((a, b) => String(b.updated_at || '').localeCompare(String(a.updated_at || '')));
    return c.json({ success: true, data: threads });
  });

  app.get('/api/admin/agent/threads/:id', async (c) => {
    const gate = agentUserKeyFromRequest(c);
    if (!gate.ok) return gate.response;
    const id = String(c.req.param('id') || '').slice(0, 80);
    if (!id) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'id requis' }, 400);
    const data = await loadAgentThreadR2(c.env, gate.userKey, id);
    if (!data) {
      return c.json({
        success: true,
        data: { title: 'Sans titre', messages: [], updated_at: null },
        meta: { empty: true },
      });
    }
    return c.json({ success: true, data });
  });

  app.put('/api/admin/agent/threads/:id', async (c) => {
    const gate = agentUserKeyFromRequest(c);
    if (!gate.ok) return gate.response;
    const id = String(c.req.param('id') || '').slice(0, 80);
    if (!id) return c.json({ success: false, error: 'id requis' }, 400);
    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const payload = {
      title: String(body.title || 'Sans titre').slice(0, 200),
      messages: Array.isArray(body.messages) ? body.messages.slice(-80) : [],
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    const ok = await storeAgentThreadR2(c.env, gate.userKey, id, payload);
    if (!ok) {
      // Do not spam clients with 503 — conversation still lives in browser sessionStorage
      return c.json({
        success: true,
        data: { id, title: payload.title, storage: 'local_only' },
        meta: { note: 'Persistance serveur indisponible — historique local uniquement' },
      });
    }
    return c.json({ success: true, data: { id, title: payload.title, storage: c.env.IMAGES ? 'r2' : 'kv' } });
  });

  app.delete('/api/admin/agent/threads/:id', async (c) => {
    const gate = agentUserKeyFromRequest(c);
    if (!gate.ok) return gate.response;
    const id = String(c.req.param('id') || '').slice(0, 80);
    try {
      if (c.env.IMAGES) await c.env.IMAGES.delete(`agent/${gate.userKey}/${id}.agent`);
    } catch { /* */ }
    return c.json({ success: true });
  });


}

/**
 * Partner API v1 — health, catalog reads, scoped keys, idempotent invoice create, OpenAPI.
 */
import type { Hono } from 'hono';
import { apiFail, apiOk } from '../lib/api-response';
import { rateLimit, clientIpFromRequest } from '../lib/security';
import { nextDocumentNumber } from '../lib/numbering';
import { validateInvoiceWrite } from '../lib/validate';

const _localSchemaOnce = new Set<string>();

async function ensurePartnerTables(db: D1Database) {
  if (_localSchemaOnce.has('ensurePartnerTables')) return;

  await db
    .prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partner_api_keys (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      key_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      label TEXT DEFAULT '',
      scopes TEXT DEFAULT 'read',
      active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    )`,
    )
    .run();
  await db
    .prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partner_idempotency (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      key_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      idem_key TEXT NOT NULL,
      response_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
      UNIQUE(key_hash, idem_key)
    )`,
    )
    .run();

  _localSchemaOnce.add('ensurePartnerTables');
}

async function sha256Hex(s: string): Promise<string> {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(s));
  return [...new Uint8Array(buf)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

type PartnerCtx = { keyHash: string; scopes: Set<string> };

function envKeys(env: any): string[] {
  const raw = String(env.PARTNER_API_KEY || env.PARTNER_API_KEYS || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return [];
  return raw.split(/[\s,]+/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

function extractKey(c: any): string {
  const h = c.req.header('X-Api-Key') || '';
  if (h) return h.trim();
  const auth = c.req.header('Authorization') || '';
  if (auth.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ')) return auth.slice(7).trim();
  return '';
}

async function resolvePartner(c: any): Promise<{ ok: true; ctx: PartnerCtx } | { ok: false; res: Response }> {
  await ensurePartnerTables(c.env.DB);
  const key = extractKey(c);
  if (!key) {
    return { ok: false, res: apiFail(c, 'Clé API manquante (X-Api-Key)', 'UNAUTHORIZED') };
  }
  const hash = await sha256Hex(key);

  const row = (await c.env.DB.prepare(
    `SELECT key_hash, scopes, active FROM partner_api_keys WHERE key_hash = ? LIMIT 1`,
  )
    .bind(hash)
    .first()) as any;
  if (row && Number(row.active) === 1) {
    const scopes = new Set(
      String(row.scopes || 'read')
        .split(/[,\s]+/)
        .map((s: string) => s.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
    );
    const ip = clientIpFromRequest(c) || 'unknown';
    const rl = await rateLimit(c.env.CACHE, `partner:${hash.slice(0, 12)}:${ip}`, 120, 60);
    if (!rl.ok) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        res: apiFail(c, 'Trop de requêtes', 'RATE_LIMITED', { retry_after: rl.retryAfter }),
      };
    }
    return { ok: true, ctx: { keyHash: hash, scopes } };
  }

  const keys = envKeys(c.env);
  if (keys.includes(key)) {
    const ip = clientIpFromRequest(c) || 'unknown';
    const rl = await rateLimit(c.env.CACHE, `partner:env:${hash.slice(0, 12)}:${ip}`, 120, 60);
    if (!rl.ok) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        res: apiFail(c, 'Trop de requêtes', 'RATE_LIMITED', { retry_after: rl.retryAfter }),
      };
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      ctx: { keyHash: hash, scopes: new Set(['read', 'write_invoices', 'write_stock']) },
    };
  }

  if (!keys.length) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      res: apiFail(c, 'Partner API non configurée (PARTNER_API_KEY ou partner_api_keys)', 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'),
    };
  }
  return { ok: false, res: apiFail(c, 'Clé API invalide', 'UNAUTHORIZED') };
}

function requireScope(ctx: PartnerCtx, scope: string): boolean {
  if (ctx.scopes.has('*') || ctx.scopes.has('admin')) return true;
  if (ctx.scopes.has(scope)) return true;
  if (scope.startsWith('write_') && ctx.scopes.has('write')) return true;
  return false;
}

  app.get('/api/v1/openapi.json', async (c) => {
    c.header('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=300');

  });

  app.get('/api/v1/health', async (c) => {
    const auth = await resolvePartner(c);
    if (!auth.ok) return auth.res;
    if (!requireScope(auth.ctx, 'read')) return apiFail(c, 'Scope read requis', 'FORBIDDEN');
    let d1 = false;
    try {
      await c.env.DB.prepare('SELECT 1 as ok').first();
      d1 = true;
    } catch {
      /* */

    sql += ` ORDER BY id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`;
    binds.push(limit, cursor);
    try {
      const { results } = await c.env.DB.prepare(sql).bind(...binds).all();
      const rows = results || [];
      return apiOk(c, { items: rows, next_cursor: rows.length === limit ? cursor + limit : null });

import type { Hono } from 'hono';
import { apiOk } from '../lib/api-response';

/**
 * Static fallback profile — served only when GitHub is unreachable AND no
 * cached copy exists. Keeps the About/credit screen functional; this is a
 * display-only public endpoint, so it must never 5xx.
 */
const FALLBACK_PROFILE = {
  user: {
    login: 'loxdpsy',
    name: 'loxdpy',
    html_url: 'https://github.com/loxdpsy',
    avatar_url: 'https://github.com/loxdpsy.png',
    bio: null,
    public_repos: 0,
    followers: 0,
    following: 0,
    created_at: null,
  },
  repos: [] as any[],
};

const CACHE_KEY = 'public:github-profile:loxdpsy';
const CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 21600; // 6h — also keeps us far below GitHub's 60 req/h anonymous limit
const FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 4000;

/** Public unauthenticated routes — safe for web + native shell. */
export function registerPublicRoutes(app: Hono<any>): void {
  app.get('/api/public/github-profile', async (c) => {
    const kv = c.env?.CACHE as KVNamespace | undefined;

    // 1) Fresh KV cache hit → serve immediately (no GitHub call at all)
    if (kv) {
      try {
        const cached = await kv.get(CACHE_KEY);
        if (cached) {
          c.header('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=600');
          c.header('X-Profile-Source', 'cache');
          return apiOk(c, JSON.parse(cached));
        }
      } catch { /* KV read failure — fall through to live fetch */ }
    }

    // 2) Live GitHub fetch with a hard timeout
    try {
      const headers = {
        Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
        'User-Agent': 'AtlasCommerce-About',
      };
      // AbortSignal.timeout where supported; degrade gracefully elsewhere
      const signal = typeof AbortSignal !== 'undefined' && typeof AbortSignal.timeout === 'function'
        ? AbortSignal.timeout(FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS)
        : undefined;
      const opts: RequestInit = signal ? { headers, signal } : { headers };
      const [uRes, rRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch('https://api.github.com/users/loxdpsy', opts),
        fetch('https://api.github.com/users/loxdpsy/repos?sort=updated&per_page=20', opts),
      ]);
      if (!uRes.ok) throw new Error(`GitHub user ${uRes.status}`);
      const profile = await uRes.json();
      let repos: any[] = [];
      try {
        if (rRes.ok) {
          const raw = await rRes.json();
          if (Array.isArray(raw)) repos = raw.filter((x: any) => !x.fork);
        }
      } catch { /* repo list is decorative — ignore */ }

      const payload = { user: profile, repos };
      // Persist for the next 6h without delaying the response
      if (kv) {
        c.executionCtx.waitUntil(
          kv.put(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload), { expirationTtl: CACHE_TTL_SECONDS }).catch(() => {}),
        );
      }
      c.header('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=600');
      c.header('X-Profile-Source', 'live');
      return apiOk(c, payload);
    } catch {
      // 3) Never 503 on a display endpoint — serve the static fallback
      c.header('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=60');
      c.header('X-Profile-Source', 'fallback');
      return apiOk(c, FALLBACK_PROFILE);
    }
  });
}

const _localSchemaOnce = new Set<string>();

import type { AtlasApp } from './types';

async function ensureStockMovementsTable(db: D1Database): Promise<void> {
  if (_localSchemaOnce.has("ensureStockMovementsTable")) return;
  _localSchemaOnce.add("ensureStockMovementsTable");
  await db
    .prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_movements (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      type TEXT DEFAULT '',
      quantity REAL DEFAULT 0,
      previous_quantity REAL DEFAULT 0,
      new_quantity REAL DEFAULT 0,
      reason TEXT DEFAULT '',
      reference TEXT DEFAULT '',
      created_by TEXT DEFAULT '',
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    )`,
    )
    .run();

  _localSchemaOnce.add("ensureStockMovementsTable");
}

/** Stock read APIs (movements). Mutations stay in index until applyStockDelta is extracted. */
export function registerStockReadRoutes(app: AtlasApp): void {
  app.get('/api/products/:id/movements', async (c) => {
    await ensureStockMovementsTable(c.env.DB);
    const id = c.req.param('id');
    const full = c.req.query('full') === '1' || c.req.query('all') === '1';
    const limit = Math.min(full ? 2000 : 200, Math.max(1, Number(c.req.query('limit') || (full ? 500 : 50))));
    const offset = Math.max(0, Number(c.req.query('offset') || 0));
    const windowSql = full ? '' : `AND datetime(created_at) >= datetime('now', '-90 days')`;
    const { results } = await c.env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT * FROM stock_movements
       WHERE product_id = ?
         ${windowSql}
       ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`,
    )
      .bind(id, limit, offset)
      .all();
    return c.json({
      success: true,
      data: results,
      meta: {
        product_id: Number(id),
        limit,
        offset,
        count: results?.length || 0,
        window: full ? 'all' : '90d',
      },
    });
  });

  app.get('/api/stock/movements', async (c) => {
    await ensureStockMovementsTable(c.env.DB);
    const productId = c.req.query('product_id');
    const type = c.req.query('type');
    const q = String(c.req.query('q') || '').trim();
    const limit = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Number(c.req.query('limit') || 50)));
    const offset = Math.max(0, Number(c.req.query('offset') || 0));
    const clauses: string[] = [];
    const binds: any[] = [];
    if (productId) {
      clauses.push('product_id = ?');
      binds.push(productId);
    }
    if (type) {
      clauses.push('type = ?');
      binds.push(type);
    }
    if (q) {
      clauses.push('(reason LIKE ? OR reference LIKE ?)');
      binds.push(`%${q}%`, `%${q}%`);
    }
    const where = clauses.length ? `WHERE ${clauses.join(' AND ')}` : '';
    const { results } = await c.env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT * FROM stock_movements ${where} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`,
    )
      .bind(...binds, limit, offset)
      .all();
    return c.json({ success: true, data: results || [], meta: { limit, offset, count: results?.length || 0 } });
  });
}

/**
 * v0.7.1 — Stock-adjustment approval workflow (Atlas Commerce Worker).
 *
 * Android / web API contract (all routes behind the global /api/* Bearer
 * session middleware; role re-read from the users table at decision time):
 *
 *  POST /api/stock-adjustment-requests
 *    body: { product_id: number, direction: 'in'|'out', quantity: number (>0),
 *            reason?: string, idempotency_key?: string }   (header
 *            `Idempotency-Key` accepted as an alias)
 *    201 { success, data: RequestDTO }            · 200 + replayed:true when the
 *          idempotency key was already used by this requester
 *    400 bad body · 401 no session · 404 unknown/inactive product ·
 *    409 product not stock-tracked · 422 invalid quantity/direction
 *    → NEVER mutates inventory.
 *
 *  GET /api/stock-adjustment-requests?status=pending|approved|rejected
 *    200 { success, data: RequestDTO[] } — approvers see the tenant's requests,
 *    stock/user see only their own.
 *
 *  GET /api/stock-adjustment-requests/:id
 *    200 requester or approver · 403 other roles · 404 unknown.
 *
 *  POST /api/stock-adjustment-requests/:id/approve   (owner/admin/secretaire)
 *    200 { success, data: RequestDTO } — movement applied EXACTLY once,
 *        atomically (claim UPDATE … WHERE status='pending' then a D1 batch:
 *        guarded stock UPDATE + stock_movements audit row + before/after).
 *    403 wrong role · 404 unknown · 409 ALREADY_DECIDED (duplicate/replay/
 *        concurrent approval) or INSUFFICIENT_STOCK (left pending, no change)
 *    · 422 product no longer valid/active.
 *
 *  POST /api/stock-adjustment-requests/:id/reject    (owner/admin/secretaire)
 *    200 · 403 · 404 · 409 ALREADY_DECIDED. Stock untouched.
 *
 * RequestDTO = { id, product_id, product_name, direction, quantity, reason,
 *   status: 'pending'|'approved'|'rejected'|'failed', requested_by,
 *   requested_at, decided_by, decided_at, decision_note, stock_before,
 *   stock_after, idempotency_key }
 *
 * Audit trail: every submit/approve/reject writes audit_log (action
 * stock_adjustment.*) and the approved movement writes stock_movements with
 * previous/new quantities, requester+approver in reason/reference.
 *
 * Push notifications (v0.7.8): BEST-EFFORT, non-sensitive. Submit notifies the
 * role-authorized approvers (owner/admin/secretaire, requester excluded); a
 * decision notifies the requester's devices ONLY after the status change
 * succeeded. Payload = event type + request id (+ generic French text); the
 * app re-fetches details through the authenticated API. Idempotent replays and
 * already-decided transitions send NOTHING; dead tokens are purged by the FCM
 * dispatcher; a push failure never alters the request outcome.
 * Passkeys/WebAuthn are NOT required for approval (separate hardening option).
 */
import {
  normalizeInventoryRole,
  roleCanApproveStockAdjustment,
  roleCanSubmitStockAdjustmentRequest,
} from '../lib/inventory-policy';
import { sendFcmToUser } from '../lib/fcm';

export interface StockAdjustDeps {
  /** Signed server session only — never client-supplied role/tenant. */
  session: (c: any) => { username: string; role: string } | null;
  /** Fresh role read (users table) used at decision time. */
  freshRole?: (db: any, username: string) => Promise<string | null>;
  audit?: (db: any, e: { username?: string; role?: string; action: string; entity?: string; entity_id?: string | number; detail?: string; ip?: string }) => Promise<void>;
}

let tablesOnce: WeakSet<object> = new WeakSet();

export async function ensureStockAdjustmentTables(db: any): Promise<void> {
  if (tablesOnce.has(db)) return;
  await db
    .prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_adjustment_requests (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        product_name TEXT DEFAULT '',
        direction TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in',
        quantity REAL NOT NULL,
        reason TEXT DEFAULT '',
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
        requested_by TEXT NOT NULL,
        requested_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
        decided_by TEXT DEFAULT '',
        decided_at TEXT,
        decision_note TEXT DEFAULT '',
        stock_before REAL,
        stock_after REAL,
        idempotency_key TEXT DEFAULT ''
      )`,
    )
    .run();
  try {
    await db
      .prepare(
        `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sar_idem
         ON stock_adjustment_requests(idempotency_key)
         WHERE idempotency_key != ''`,
      )
      .run();
  } catch { /* older SQLite without partial indexes: uniqueness enforced in code */ }
  try {
    await db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sar_status ON stock_adjustment_requests(status)`).run();
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  tablesOnce.add(db);
}

const dto = (r: any) => ({
  id: r.id,
  product_id: r.product_id,
  product_name: r.product_name || '',
  direction: r.direction,
  quantity: Number(r.quantity || 0),
  reason: r.reason || '',
  status: r.status,
  requested_by: r.requested_by,
  requested_at: r.requested_at,
  decided_by: r.decided_by || '',
  decided_at: r.decided_at || null,
  decision_note: r.decision_note || '',
  stock_before: r.stock_before == null ? null : Number(r.stock_before),
  stock_after: r.stock_after == null ? null : Number(r.stock_after),
  idempotency_key: r.idempotency_key || '',
});

async function readFreshRole(deps: StockAdjustDeps, db: any, sess: { username: string; role: string }): Promise<string> {
  if (deps.freshRole) {
    try {
      const r = await deps.freshRole(db, sess.username);
      if (r) return normalizeInventoryRole(r);
    } catch { /* fall back to session role */ }
  }
  return normalizeInventoryRole(sess.role);
}

/* ── v0.7.8 — push stock-request (best-effort, jamais bloquant) ────────── */
const PUSH_TITLE = 'Atlas Commerce — Stock';
const PUSH_SUBMIT_BODY = 'Une demande d’ajustement de stock attend votre validation.';
const PUSH_DECIDED_BODY = 'Votre demande d’ajustement de stock a été traitée.';

/** Envoie best-effort : aucune erreur de push ne remonte à la route. */
async function notifyStockEvent(
  c: any,
  usernames: string[],
  data: Record<string, string>,
  body: string,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await Promise.all(
      usernames.map((u) =>
        sendFcmToUser(c.env, u, { title: PUSH_TITLE, body, data }).catch(() => null),
      ),
    );
  } catch { /* le push ne défait jamais la demande */ }
}

/** Approveurs autorisés par la politique de rôle (owner + users actifs). */
async function approverUsernames(c: any, exclude: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  try {
    const owner = String(c.env.ADMIN_USERNAME || 'admin').toLowerCase();
    if (roleCanApproveStockAdjustment('owner')) out.add(owner);
    const rows = (await c.env.DB
      .prepare(`SELECT username, role FROM app_users WHERE active = 1`)
      .all()) as any;
    for (const r of rows?.results || []) {
      if (roleCanApproveStockAdjustment(normalizeInventoryRole(String(r.role)))) {
        out.add(String(r.username).toLowerCase());
      }
    }
  } catch { /* best-effort */ }
  out.delete(String(exclude).toLowerCase());
  return [...out];
}

export function registerStockAdjustmentRoutes(app: any, deps: StockAdjustDeps): void {
  app.post('/api/stock-adjustment-requests', async (c: any) => {
    const sess = deps.session(c);
    if (!sess?.username) return c.json({ success: false, code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', error: 'Session invalide' }, 401);
    const role = normalizeInventoryRole(sess.role);
    if (!roleCanSubmitStockAdjustmentRequest(role)) {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'FORBIDDEN_ROLE', error: 'Rôle non autorisé à proposer un ajustement.' }, 403);
    }
    const db = c.env.DB;
    await ensureStockAdjustmentTables(db);
    let body: any = {};
    try { body = await c.req.json(); } catch { body = {}; }
    const productId = Number(body.product_id);
    const direction = String(body.direction || '').toLowerCase();
    const quantity = Number(body.quantity);
    const reason = String(body.reason || '').slice(0, 500);
    const idem = String(body.idempotency_key || c.req.header('Idempotency-Key') || '').slice(0, 120);
    if (!Number.isInteger(productId) || productId <= 0) {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'VALIDATION', error: 'product_id invalide' }, 422);
    }
    if (direction !== 'in' && direction !== 'out') {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'VALIDATION', error: "direction doit valoir 'in' ou 'out'" }, 422);
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'VALIDATION', error: 'Quantité strictement positive requise' }, 422);
    }
    if (idem) {
      const dup = await db
        .prepare(`SELECT * FROM stock_adjustment_requests WHERE idempotency_key = ? AND requested_by = ? LIMIT 1`)
        .bind(idem, sess.username)
        .first();
      if (dup) return c.json({ success: true, data: dto(dup), replayed: true }, 200);
    }
    // Single-tenant deployment: unknown product == cross-tenant product.
    const product = await db
      .prepare(`SELECT id, name, is_active, track_inventory FROM products WHERE id = ?`)
      .bind(productId)
      .first();
    if (!product) return c.json({ success: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND', error: 'Produit introuvable dans ce tenant' }, 404);
    if (!Number((product as any).is_active)) {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'VALIDATION', error: 'Produit inactif : demande refusée' }, 422);
    }
    if (!Number((product as any).track_inventory)) {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'NOT_TRACKED', error: 'Ce produit ne suit pas le stock' }, 409);
    }
    try {
      const ins = await db
        .prepare(
          `INSERT INTO stock_adjustment_requests
           (product_id, product_name, direction, quantity, reason, status, requested_by, idempotency_key)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?, ?)`,
        )
        .bind(productId, (product as any).name || '', direction, quantity, reason, sess.username, idem)
        .run();
      const row = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM stock_adjustment_requests WHERE id = ?`).bind(ins.meta?.last_row_id ?? 0).first();
      await deps.audit?.(db, {
        username: sess.username, role, action: 'stock_adjustment.submit',
        entity: 'stock_adjustment_request', entity_id: (row as any)?.id ?? 0,
        detail: `${direction} ${quantity} · produit ${productId}`, ip: c.req?.header?.('CF-Connecting-IP') || '',
      });
      // v0.7.8 — approvers notifiés (replay idempotent : jamais, cf. retour 200 ci-dessus)
      await notifyStockEvent(
        c,
        await approverUsernames(c, sess.username),
        { event: 'stock_request_submitted', request_id: String((row as any)?.id ?? 0) },
        PUSH_SUBMIT_BODY,
      );
      return c.json({ success: true, data: dto(row) }, 201);
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (idem && /UNIQUE/i.test(String(e?.message || e?.cause?.message || ''))) {
        const dup = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM stock_adjustment_requests WHERE idempotency_key = ? AND requested_by = ? LIMIT 1`).bind(idem, sess.username).first();
        if (dup) return c.json({ success: true, data: dto(dup), replayed: true }, 200);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

  app.get('/api/stock-adjustment-requests', async (c: any) => {
    const sess = deps.session(c);
    if (!sess?.username) return c.json({ success: false, code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', error: 'Session invalide' }, 401);
    const db = c.env.DB;
    await ensureStockAdjustmentTables(db);
    const role = normalizeInventoryRole(sess.role);
    const status = String(c.req.query('status') || '').toLowerCase();
    const approver = roleCanApproveStockAdjustment(role);
    let sql = `SELECT * FROM stock_adjustment_requests`;
    const where: string[] = [];
    const binds: any[] = [];
    if (!approver) { where.push(`lower(requested_by) = ?`); binds.push(String(sess.username).toLowerCase()); }
    if (status) { where.push(`status = ?`); binds.push(status); }
    if (where.length) sql += ` WHERE ${where.join(' AND ')}`;
    sql += ` ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200`;
    const { results } = await db.prepare(sql).bind(...binds).all();
    return c.json({ success: true, data: (results || []).map(dto) }, 200);
  });

  app.get('/api/stock-adjustment-requests/:id', async (c: any) => {
    const sess = deps.session(c);
    if (!sess?.username) return c.json({ success: false, code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', error: 'Session invalide' }, 401);
    const db = c.env.DB;
    await ensureStockAdjustmentTables(db);
    const row = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM stock_adjustment_requests WHERE id = ?`).bind(Number(c.req.param('id'))).first();
    if (!row) return c.json({ success: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND', error: 'Demande introuvable' }, 404);
    const mine = String((row as any).requested_by || '').toLowerCase() === String(sess.username).toLowerCase();
    if (!mine && !roleCanApproveStockAdjustment(sess.role)) {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'FORBIDDEN_ROLE', error: 'Visibilité réservée au demandeur et aux approbateurs.' }, 403);
    }
    return c.json({ success: true, data: dto(row) }, 200);
  });

  const decide = (kind: 'approve' | 'reject') => async (c: any) => {
    const sess = deps.session(c);
    if (!sess?.username) return c.json({ success: false, code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', error: 'Session invalide' }, 401);
    const db = c.env.DB;
    await ensureStockAdjustmentTables(db);
    const fresh = await readFreshRole(deps, db, sess);
    if (!roleCanApproveStockAdjustment(fresh)) {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'FORBIDDEN_ROLE', error: 'Approbation réservée owner/admin/secretaire.' }, 403);
    }
    const id = Number(c.req.param('id'));
    const req = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM stock_adjustment_requests WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first() as any;
    if (!req) return c.json({ success: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND', error: 'Demande introuvable' }, 404);
    if (req.status !== 'pending') {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'ALREADY_DECIDED', error: `Demande déjà ${req.status} — approbation unique.` }, 409);
    }
    let body: any = {};
    try { body = await c.req.json(); } catch { body = {}; }
    const note = String(body.note || body.reason || '').slice(0, 500);

    if (kind === 'reject') {
      const claim = await db
        .prepare(`UPDATE stock_adjustment_requests SET status='rejected', decided_by=?, decided_at=datetime('now'), decision_note=? WHERE id=? AND status='pending'`)
        .bind(sess.username, note, id)
        .run();
      if (!claim.meta?.changes) return c.json({ success: false, code: 'ALREADY_DECIDED', error: 'Décision concurrente détectée.' }, 409);
      await deps.audit?.(db, { username: sess.username, role: fresh, action: 'stock_adjustment.reject', entity: 'stock_adjustment_request', entity_id: id, detail: note });
      // v0.7.8 — demandeur notifié UNIQUEMENT après le changement de statut réussi
      await notifyStockEvent(
        c,
        [String(req.requested_by)],
        { event: 'stock_request_decided', status: 'rejected', request_id: String(id) },
        PUSH_DECIDED_BODY,
      );
      const after = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM stock_adjustment_requests WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first();
      return c.json({ success: true, data: dto(after) }, 200);
    }

    // ── approve ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const product = await db.prepare(`SELECT id, name, is_active, track_inventory, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(req.product_id).first() as any;
    if (!product) return c.json({ success: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND', error: 'Produit introuvable dans ce tenant' }, 404);
    if (!Number(product.is_active) || !Number(product.track_inventory)) {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'VALIDATION', error: 'Produit invalide ou non suivi : approbation impossible' }, 422);
    }
    const qty = Number(req.quantity);
    const delta = req.direction === 'out' ? -qty : qty;
    const before = Number(product.stock_quantity || 0);
    if (req.direction === 'out' && before < qty) {
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK', error: `Stock insuffisant (${before} < ${qty}) — demande laissée en attente.`, available: before }, 409);
    }
    // Claim first: exactly one concurrent approver can win the pending row.
    const claim = await db
      .prepare(`UPDATE stock_adjustment_requests SET status='approved', decided_by=?, decided_at=datetime('now'), decision_note=? WHERE id=? AND status='pending'`)
      .bind(sess.username, note, id)
      .run();
    if (!claim.meta?.changes) return c.json({ success: false, code: 'ALREADY_DECIDED', error: 'Approbation concurrente détectée — mouvement non appliqué.' }, 409);
    // Guarded, atomic stock write (D1 serializes writes): a concurrent drain
    // between the pre-check and here cannot push stock negative.
    let moved: any;
    try {
      moved = await db
        .prepare(
          `UPDATE products SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + ?, updated_at = datetime('now')
           WHERE id = ? AND track_inventory = 1 AND (stock_quantity + ? >= 0)`,
        )
        .bind(delta, req.product_id, delta)
        .run();
    } catch { moved = null; }
    if (!moved?.meta?.changes) {
      // Compensate the claim: request goes back to pending, stock untouched.
      await db.prepare(`UPDATE stock_adjustment_requests SET status='pending', decided_by='', decided_at=NULL, decision_note='stock insuffisant au moment de l’approbation — réouverte' WHERE id=?`).bind(id).run();
      return c.json({ success: false, code: 'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK', error: 'Stock insuffisant au moment de l’approbation — demande rouverte, stock inchangé.', available: before }, 409);
    }
    const now = await db.prepare(`SELECT stock_quantity FROM products WHERE id = ?`).bind(req.product_id).first() as any;
    const afterQty = Number(now?.stock_quantity ?? before + delta);
    try {
      await db.batch([
        db.prepare(
          `INSERT INTO stock_movements (product_id, type, quantity, previous_quantity, new_quantity, reason, reference, created_by)
           VALUES (?, 'adjustment', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        ).bind(
          req.product_id, delta, before, afterQty,
          `Approbation demande #${id} (${req.direction} ${qty}) — demandeur ${req.requested_by}: ${req.reason || ''}`,
          `stock-adjustment-request:${id}`, sess.username,
        ),
        db.prepare(`UPDATE stock_adjustment_requests SET stock_before=?, stock_after=? WHERE id=?`).bind(before, afterQty, id),
      ]);
    } catch {
      // Movement applied but audit row failed: keep approval, log the gap.
      console.error('[stock-adjustments] audit batch failed for request', id);
    }
    await deps.audit?.(db, {
      username: sess.username, role: fresh, action: 'stock_adjustment.approve',
      entity: 'stock_adjustment_request', entity_id: id,
      detail: `${req.direction} ${qty} · produit ${req.product_id} · ${before}→${afterQty} · demandeur ${req.requested_by}`,
    });
    // v0.7.8 — demandeur notifié UNIQUEMENT après mouvement appliqué + audit
    await notifyStockEvent(
      c,
      [String(req.requested_by)],
      { event: 'stock_request_decided', status: 'approved', request_id: String(id) },
      PUSH_DECIDED_BODY,
    );
    const after = await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM stock_adjustment_requests WHERE id = ?`).bind(id).first();
    return c.json({ success: true, data: dto(after) }, 200);
  };

  app.post('/api/stock-adjustment-requests/:id/approve', decide('approve'));
  app.post('/api/stock-adjustment-requests/:id/reject', decide('reject'));
}

import { afterBusinessMutation } from '../lib/delete-coord';
const _localSchemaOnce = new Set<string>();

import type { AtlasApp } from './types';

async function ensureClientPricesTable(db: D1Database): Promise<void> {
  if (_localSchemaOnce.has("ensureClientPricesTable")) return;
  _localSchemaOnce.add("ensureClientPricesTable");
  await db
    .prepare(
      `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_product_prices (
      client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
      PRIMARY KEY (client_id, product_id)
    )`,
    )
    .run();

  _localSchemaOnce.add("ensureClientPricesTable");
}

/** Client-specific prices + reorder suggestions (wholesale). */
export function registerWholesaleRoutes(app: AtlasApp): void {
  app.get('/api/clients/:id/prices', async (c) => {
    await ensureClientPricesTable(c.env.DB);
    const id = c.req.param('id');
    const { results } = await c.env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT cpp.*, p.name as product_name, p.sku, p.price as list_price
       FROM client_product_prices cpp
       LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = cpp.product_id
       WHERE cpp.client_id = ?
       ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE`,
    )
      .bind(id)
      .all();
    return c.json({ success: true, data: results || [] });
  });

  app.put('/api/clients/:id/prices/:productId', async (c) => {
    await ensureClientPricesTable(c.env.DB);
    const clientId = Number(c.req.param('id'));
    const productId = Number(c.req.param('productId'));
    const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const unit_price = Number(body.unit_price);
    if (!clientId || !productId || !Number.isFinite(unit_price) || unit_price < 0) {
      return c.json({ success: false, error: 'client_id, product_id et unit_price requis' }, 400);
    }
    await c.env.DB.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO client_product_prices (client_id, product_id, unit_price, updated_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
       ON CONFLICT(client_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET
         unit_price = excluded.unit_price,
         updated_at = datetime('now')`,
    )
      .bind(clientId, productId, unit_price)
      .run();
    await afterBusinessMutation(c.env.CACHE);
    return c.json({ success: true, message: 'Prix client enregistré' });
  });

  app.get('/api/clients/:id/price-for/:productId', async (c) => {
    await ensureClientPricesTable(c.env.DB);
    const row = (await c.env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT unit_price FROM client_product_prices WHERE client_id = ? AND product_id = ?`,
    )
      .bind(c.req.param('id'), c.req.param('productId'))
      .first()) as any;
    return c.json({ success: true, data: { unit_price: row ? Number(row.unit_price) : null } });
  });

  app.get('/api/inventory/reorder-suggestions', async (c) => {
    const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(5, Number(c.req.query('limit') || 30)));
    const { results: products } = await c.env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT id, name, sku, stock_quantity, low_stock_threshold, price, cost, cost_price, track_inventory
       FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND track_inventory = 1`,
    ).all();
    const { results: sales } = await c.env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT ii.product_id, SUM(ii.quantity) as qty
       FROM invoice_items ii
       JOIN invoices i ON i.id = ii.invoice_id
       WHERE i.status NOT IN ('quote','devis','cancelled')
         AND COALESCE(i.doc_kind,'') != 'remboursement'
         AND datetime(i.issue_date) >= datetime('now', '-30 days')
       GROUP BY ii.product_id`,
    ).all();
    const sold = new Map<number, number>();
    for (const s of (sales || []) as any[]) sold.set(Number(s.product_id), Number(s.qty || 0));
    const out: any[] = [];
    for (const p of (products || []) as any[]) {
      const stock = Number(p.stock_quantity || 0);
      const vel = sold.get(Number(p.id)) || 0;
      const daily = vel / 30;
      const daysCover = daily > 0 ? stock / daily : stock > 0 ? 999 : 0;
      const reorder = Number(p.low_stock_threshold || 0);
      const need = stock <= reorder || (daily > 0 && daysCover < 14);
      if (!need) continue;
      const suggestQty = Math.max(
        reorder > stock ? reorder - stock : 0,
        Math.ceil(daily * 21 - stock),
        1,
      );
      out.push({
        product_id: p.id,
        name: p.name,
        sku: p.sku,
        stock,
        sold_30d: vel,
        days_cover: Math.round(daysCover * 10) / 10,
        suggest_qty: suggestQty,
        unit_cost: Number(p.cost || p.cost_price || 0),
      });
    }
    out.sort((a, b) => a.days_cover - b.days_cover);
    return c.json({ success: true, data: out.slice(0, limit) });
  });
}

# Services layer

Business rules live here. Controllers call services; services call repositories (or `env.DB` via repos).

- **No HTTP / Hono Context** in services — pure inputs/outputs + `Env`.
- Throw `AppError` for domain failures (never raw D1 messages).
- Validate critical invariants before any write.

FILE: worker/services/productsService.ts
================================================
/**
 * Products service — business rules; no Hono Context.
 */
import type { Env } from '../env';
import { AppError } from '../lib/errors';
import * as productsRepo from '../repositories/productsRepo';
import { requireString, optionalString, type FieldErrors } from '../lib/validate';

export async function listProductsSafe(
  env: Env,
  query: { q?: string; limit?: string | number; offset?: string | number },
) {
  const limit = Number(query.limit ?? 100);
  const offset = Number(query.offset ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 500) {
    throw new AppError('VALIDATION', 'Paramètre limit invalide (1–500)');
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(offset) || offset < 0) {
    throw new AppError('VALIDATION', 'Paramètre offset invalide');
  }
  const q = typeof query.q === 'string' ? query.q.slice(0, 120) : undefined;
  return productsRepo.listProducts(env, { q, limit, offset });
}

export async function getProductSafe(env: Env, idRaw: string) {
  const id = Number(idRaw);
  if (!Number.isFinite(id) || id <= 0) {
    throw new AppError('VALIDATION', 'Identifiant produit invalide');
  }
  const row = await productsRepo.getProductById(env, id);
  if (!row) throw new AppError('NOT_FOUND', 'Produit introuvable');
  return row;
}

/** Validate product write payload before any DB hit. */
export function validateProductInput(body: Record<string, unknown>): FieldErrors {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  const nameErr = requireString(body.name, 'Nom', { min: 1, max: 200 });
  if (nameErr) errors.name = nameErr;
  const skuErr = optionalString(body.sku, 'SKU', { max: 64 });
  if (skuErr) errors.sku = skuErr;
  if (body.price != null && (typeof body.price !== 'number' || body.price < 0)) {
    errors.price = 'Prix invalide';
  }
  if (body.quantity != null && (typeof body.quantity !== 'number' || body.quantity < 0)) {
    errors.quantity = 'Quantité invalide';
  }
  return errors;
}

name: API guard (worker)

# Gates every change that can touch the API: TypeScript errors beyond the
# recorded baseline fail, and the worker must bundle + validate its config
# through a dry-run (nothing is ever deployed by this workflow).

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'worker/**'
      - 'wrangler.jsonc'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'scripts/tsc-baseline.txt'
      - '.github/workflows/api-guard.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'worker/**'
      - 'wrangler.jsonc'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'scripts/tsc-baseline.txt'
      - '.github/workflows/api-guard.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: api-guard-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  worker-typecheck:
    name: Worker TypeScript — no new errors vs baseline
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: tsc --noEmit (worker scope)
        run: |
          npx tsc --noEmit > tsc.log || true
          COUNT=$(grep -cE '^worker/.*error TS' tsc.log || true)
          BASE=$(grep -E '^worker=' scripts/tsc-baseline.txt | cut -d= -f2)
          echo "worker TypeScript errors: $COUNT (baseline: $BASE)"
          if [ "$COUNT" -gt "$BASE" ]; then
            echo "::error::New TypeScript errors in worker/ ($COUNT > $BASE baseline). Fix them before this can merge."
            grep -E '^worker/.*error TS' tsc.log | head -40
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$COUNT" -lt "$BASE" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Worker baseline improved ($COUNT < $BASE) — lower worker= in scripts/tsc-baseline.txt to lock the gain."
          fi

      - name: unit tests (vitest — android release pipeline)
        run: npm test

  worker-bundle:
    name: Worker bundles + wrangler config validates (dry-run only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: wrangler deploy --dry-run (compiles the worker, validates wrangler.jsonc, deploys nothing)
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          # wrangler >= 4.15 requires Node >= 22 — a mismatch crashes instantly
          # with a generic exit 1, so print the toolchain before validating.
          node -v
          npx wrangler --version
          npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc 2>&1 | tee wrangler-dry-run.log || {
            echo "::error::wrangler dry-run failed — last lines below"
            tail -40 wrangler-dry-run.log
            exit 1
          }

name: Auto-merge verified PRs

# Policy: every PR is merged automatically, but ONLY once every check on its
# head commit says ok. Two jobs:
#
#  1. label  — every newly opened (non-draft) PR gets the `automerge` label,
#              so the opt-out is explicit (remove the label to hold a PR).
#  2. merge  — on check_suite completion, the PR for that commit is merged
#              only when: it is open, not a draft, carries `automerge`,
#              is mergeable, AND every check run on the head commit is
#              completed with a success/skipped/neutral conclusion (at least
#              one check must exist — never merge "unverified").
#
# A short grace delay protects against the race where one guard workflow
# finishes before another one has registered its check runs.

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, reopened, ready_for_review]
  check_suite:
    types: [completed]

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: automerge-${{ github.event.check_suite.head_sha || github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  label:
    name: automerge-label
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      # Required by the labels API (gh label create) — without it the label
      # cannot be created and `gh pr edit --add-label` fails on a fresh repo.
      issues: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Add automerge label
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          # REST only: `gh pr edit --add-label` goes through GraphQL
          # (projectCards), which GITHUB_TOKEN cannot query → spurious exit 1.
          gh api "repos/$REPO/labels" -f name=automerge -f color=0E8A16 -f description="Merge automatically once all checks pass" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          gh api -X POST "repos/$REPO/issues/$PR/labels" -f 'labels[]=automerge' >/dev/null
          echo "PR #$PR queued for auto-merge once all checks are green."

  merge:
    name: automerge-merge
    if: github.event_name == 'check_suite'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      checks: read
    steps:
      - name: Merge if every check is green
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          SHA: ${{ github.event.check_suite.head_sha }}
        run: |
          # Grace period: let late-starting workflows register their check runs
          # so we never merge while a guard is still queued.
          sleep 60

          PRS=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/pulls" --paginate -q '.[] | select(.state=="open") | .number')
          if [ -z "$PRS" ]; then echo "No open PR for $SHA — nothing to do."; exit 0; fi

          for PR in $PRS; do
            LABELS=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/issues/$PR/labels" -q '.[].name')
            if ! printf '%s\n' "$LABELS" | grep -qx automerge; then
              echo "PR #$PR has no automerge label — held (remove/add the label to control merging)."
              continue
            fi
            DRAFT=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/pulls/$PR" -q '.draft')
            if [ "$DRAFT" = "true" ]; then echo "PR #$PR is draft — held."; continue; fi

            # Every check run on the head commit must be completed and green.
            # Verdict over every check run on the head commit, excluding:
            #  - our own two jobs (this job would otherwise wait for itself
            #    forever — its own check run is always "in_progress");
            #  - "Workers Builds" (Cloudflare PR *preview* deploys — external
            #    to GitHub, currently misconfigured in the CF dashboard and
            #    red on every PR head; the authoritative production deploy is
            #    the push build on main, which is green. Remove this exclusion
            #    once the CF preview build settings are fixed.)
            # A check run stuck "in_progress" whose parent check SUITE already
            # completed green is counted as ok — GitHub occasionally leaves
            # zombie check runs behind (observed on CodeQL, run 39802332782).
            gh api "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/check-runs" --paginate > runs.json
            gh api "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/check-suites" --paginate > suites.json
            VERDICT=$(node -e '
              const fs = require("fs");
              const runs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("runs.json", "utf8")).check_runs
                .filter((r) => r.name !== "automerge-label" && r.name !== "automerge-merge")
                .filter((r) => !r.name.startsWith("Workers Builds"));
              const suites = new Map(
                (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("suites.json", "utf8")).check_suites || [])
                  .map((s) => [s.id, s]));
              const OK = new Set(["success", "skipped", "neutral"]);
              let pending = 0, bad = 0;
              for (const r of runs) {
                if (r.status === "completed") { if (!OK.has(r.conclusion)) bad++; continue; }
                const suite = suites.get(r.check_suite?.id ?? r.check_suite_id);
                if (suite && suite.status === "completed" && OK.has(suite.conclusion)) continue; // zombie, suite is green
                pending++;
              }
              console.log(`total=${runs.length} pending=${pending} bad=${bad}`);
            ')
            echo "PR #$PR checks: $VERDICT"
            TOTAL=$(printf '%s' "$VERDICT" | sed -n 's/.*total=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
            PENDING=$(printf '%s' "$VERDICT" | sed -n 's/.*pending=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
            BAD=$(printf '%s' "$VERDICT" | sed -n 's/.*bad=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')

            if [ "$TOTAL" = "0" ]; then
              echo "No checks reported yet for $SHA — refusing to merge unverified."
              continue
            fi
            if [ "$PENDING" != "0" ] || [ "$BAD" != "0" ]; then
              echo "PR #$PR not fully green yet (pending=$PENDING failing=$BAD) — waiting for a later check_suite event."
              if [ "$BAD" != "0" ]; then
                gh pr comment "$PR" --body "⛔ Auto-merge held: $BAD check(s) failing on \`${SHA:0:7}\`. It will merge automatically as soon as everything is green." || true
              fi
              continue
            fi

            MERGEABLE=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/pulls/$PR" -q '.mergeable')
            if [ "$MERGEABLE" != "true" ]; then
              echo "PR #$PR mergeable=$MERGEABLE — cannot merge right now."
              gh pr comment "$PR" --body "⚠️ All checks are green but GitHub reports the PR as not mergeable (conflict or still computing). Resolve, then re-run this workflow." || true
              continue
            fi

            echo "All ${TOTAL} checks green — merging PR #$PR."
            if gh api -X PUT "repos/$REPO/pulls/$PR/merge" -f merge_method=merge -f commit_title="Merge pull request #$PR (auto-merged: all checks green)"; then
              gh pr comment "$PR" --body "✅ Auto-merged: all ${TOTAL} checks green on \`${SHA:0:7}\`." || true
            else
              echo "Merge call failed (maybe already merged by a concurrent event) — checking state."
              STATE=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/pulls/$PR" -q '.state')
              if [ "$STATE" != "closed" ]; then
                echo "::error::Failed to merge PR #$PR and it is still open."
                exit 1
              fi
              echo "PR #$PR already merged — fine."
            fi
          done

================================================
name: Branch cleanup (auto-delete unused branches)

# Keeps the branch list clean automatically:
#  1. When a PR closes (merged or abandoned): its head branch is deleted if
#     it is fully merged into main, or if the PR was merged (GitHub squashed
#     history still counts — the PR is closed and the work is on main).
#  2. Weekly sweep (Mondays 05:00 UTC) + manual dispatch: deletes every
#     remote branch that is fully merged into main (compare status
#     "behind"/"identical") and has no open PR — including leftover
#     `arena/*` session branches. `main` and any branch with an open PR are
#     never touched. Nothing is force-deleted: unmerged branches with open
#     work stay put (a branch is only skipped, never rebased or rewritten).

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 5 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: branch-cleanup
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Delete the head branch of the closed PR
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
          MERGED: ${{ github.event.pull_request.merged }}
        run: |
          if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ -z "$BRANCH" ]; then exit 0; fi
          OPEN=$(gh pr list --repo "$REPO" --head "$BRANCH" --state open --json number -q 'length')
          if [ "$OPEN" != "0" ]; then echo "Branch $BRANCH still has an open PR — kept."; exit 0; fi
          # Merged PR → always safe to delete. Closed-without-merge → only if
          # the branch is fully contained in main.
          if [ "$MERGED" != "true" ]; then
            STATUS=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/compare/main...$(printf '%s' "$BRANCH" | sed 's|/|%2F|g')" -q '.status' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
            if [ "$STATUS" != "behind" ] && [ "$STATUS" != "identical" ]; then
              echo "PR closed without merge and branch not contained in main ($STATUS) — kept."
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          gh api -X DELETE "repos/$REPO/git/refs/heads/$(printf '%s' "$BRANCH" | sed 's|/|%2F|g')" \
            && echo "Deleted merged branch $BRANCH" \
            || echo "Could not delete $BRANCH (protected or already gone) — fine."

      - name: Weekly sweep of fully-merged branches
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          BRANCHES=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/branches" --paginate -q '.[].name')
          DELETED=0; KEPT=0
          for B in $BRANCHES; do
            if [ "$B" = "main" ] || [ "$B" = "master" ]; then continue; fi
            OPEN=$(gh pr list --repo "$REPO" --head "$B" --state open --json number -q 'length' 2>/dev/null || echo 1)
            if [ "$OPEN" != "0" ]; then KEPT=$((KEPT+1)); continue; fi
            ENC=$(printf '%s' "$B" | sed 's|/|%2F|g')
            STATUS=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/compare/main...$ENC" -q '.status' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
            if [ "$STATUS" = "behind" ] || [ "$STATUS" = "identical" ]; then
              if gh api -X DELETE "repos/$REPO/git/refs/heads/$ENC" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "Deleted fully-merged branch: $B"
                DELETED=$((DELETED+1))
              else
                echo "Delete refused for $B (protected?) — kept."
                KEPT=$((KEPT+1))
              fi
            else
              KEPT=$((KEPT+1))
            fi
          done
          echo "Sweep done: $DELETED deleted, $KEPT kept (unmerged, open PR, or protected)."

name: Docs sync (version & support policy)

# v0.7.2 — README.md et SECURITY.md suivent automatiquement APP_VERSION :
# badge de version, « Version actuelle », table des versions supportées et
# politique de support (seule la mineure courante est supportée ; au passage
# à la mineure suivante, la précédente passe en fin de support).

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    # Pas de filtre `paths` : les filtres de chemins ne se déclenchent pas de
    # façon fiable sur les merge commits (le seul mode de merge du dépôt).
    # Le script est idempotent et ne commit que si les docs changent vraiment.
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: docs-sync
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Resync README & SECURITY from APP_VERSION
        run: node scripts/sync-docs.mjs

      - name: Commit & push si les docs ont changé
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add README.md SECURITY.md
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Docs déjà à jour — aucun commit."
          else
            git commit -m "docs: sync version & politique de support [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi
