name: Frontend guard (client)

# Gates every client-side change: the Vite build must succeed, the bundle must
# contain hashed assets, and src/ TypeScript errors must not exceed baseline.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'index.html'
      - 'vite.config.ts'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'scripts/tsc-baseline.txt'
      - '.github/workflows/frontend-guard.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'index.html'
      - 'vite.config.ts'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'scripts/tsc-baseline.txt'
      - '.github/workflows/frontend-guard.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: frontend-guard-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  oxlint:
    name: oxlint — correctness gate (zero errors)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      # Fails on ANY correctness error in src/ or worker/ (warnings, like the
      # known no-unused-vars backlog, are reported but do not block).
      - run: npm run lint

  client-build:
    name: Vite build + bundle sanity
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: bundle sanity (index.html + hashed assets present)
        run: |
          test -f dist/client/index.html
          grep -qE '/assets/index-[^"]+\.js' dist/client/index.html
          test -n "$(ls dist/client/assets/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
          echo "client bundle OK"

  client-typecheck:
    name: src/ TypeScript — no new errors vs baseline
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: tsc --noEmit (src scope)
        run: |
          npx tsc --noEmit > tsc.log || true
          COUNT=$(grep -vE '^worker/' tsc.log | grep -cE 'error TS' || true)
          BASE=$(grep -E '^src=' scripts/tsc-baseline.txt | cut -d= -f2)
          echo "src TypeScript errors: $COUNT (baseline: $BASE)"
          if [ "$COUNT" -gt "$BASE" ]; then
            echo "::error::New TypeScript errors in src/ ($COUNT > $BASE baseline). Fix them before this can merge."
            grep -vE '^worker/' tsc.log | grep -E 'error TS' | head -40
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$COUNT" -lt "$BASE" ]; then
            echo "::notice::src baseline improved ($COUNT < $BASE) — lower src= in scripts/tsc-baseline.txt to lock the gain."
          fi

# OSV-Scanner — official v2.7.0 unified layout (scheduled + PR scans).
# Pin SHA copied verbatim from google/osv-scanner-action's own
# osv-scanner-unified-workflow.yml at v2.7.0 (ef6dfdf0…), which is the
# combination tested by the maintainers; job-level permissions are
# required by the reusable workflow for SARIF upload.

name: OSV-Scanner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  schedule:
    - cron: '34 17 * * 5'
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  scan-scheduled:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
    permissions:
      # Required to upload SARIF file to CodeQL.
      actions: read
      # Require writing security events to upload SARIF file to security tab
      security-events: write
      # Read commit contents
      contents: read
    uses: "google/osv-scanner-action/.github/workflows/osv-scanner-reusable.yml@ef6dfdf01765802d5a8dbc3c39852a6128b00af0" # v2.7.0
    with:
      scan-args: |-
        --include-git-root
        -r
        ./
  scan-pr:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}
    permissions:
      actions: read
      security-events: write
      contents: read
    uses: "google/osv-scanner-action/.github/workflows/osv-scanner-reusable-pr.yml@ef6dfdf01765802d5a8dbc3c39852a6128b00af0" # v2.7.0
    with:
      scan-args: |-
        --include-git-root
        -r
        ./

================================================
name: Security patrol (intrusion detection)

# Daily black-box probe of the PRODUCTION site: the workflow "tries to hack
# in" (SQLi, XSS, traversal, Log4Shell, unauthenticated admin access), audits
# security headers, and reads the canary's WAF counters to report the real
# intrusion attempts that were detected and blocked since the last deploy.
# Findings open (or update) a single GitHub issue, each finding with a
# concrete "fix possible" hint. No findings → any open patrol issue gets an
# all-clear comment and is closed. Read-only probes with harmless payloads
# that our own WAF blocks; nothing is ever deployed or mutated.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 6 * * *'   # daily 06:30 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      base_url:
        description: 'Target base URL (default: https://stock.afmarbre.com)'
        required: false
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: security-patrol
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  patrol:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Probe production
        id: probe
        env:
          PATROL_BASE_URL: ${{ github.event.inputs.base_url || vars.PATROL_BASE_URL || 'https://stock.afmarbre.com' }}
          # Optional Cloudflare self-heal: purge leaked edge-cache URLs and
          # name the firewall rule challenging our probes. Token scopes
          # (zone afmarbre.com): Zone Read, Cache Purge Edit, Security Events Read.
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
          CF_ZONE_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_ZONE_ID }}
        run: |
          node scripts/security-patrol.mjs > patrol.json.raw 2> patrol.log || true
          cat patrol.log
          node -e '
            const fs = require("fs");
            const raw = fs.readFileSync("patrol.json.raw", "utf8");
            const m = raw.match(/::PATROL-JSON::([\s\S]*?)::END-PATROL-JSON::/);
            if (!m) { console.error("no patrol JSON produced"); process.exit(1); }
            const doc = JSON.parse(m[1]);
            const findings = doc.findings.length;
            const critical = doc.findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "critical").length;
            fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, "findings=" + findings + "\ncritical=" + critical + "\n");
            console.log("findings=" + findings + " critical=" + critical + " waf_blocked=" + ((doc.waf && doc.waf.blocked) || 0));
          '

      - name: Open / update / close the patrol issue
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TARGET: ${{ github.event.inputs.base_url || vars.PATROL_BASE_URL || 'https://stock.afmarbre.com' }}
        run: |
          gh label create security --color E11D48 --description "Sécurité / intrusion" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          EXISTING=$(gh issue list --state open --search "in:title [security-patrol]" --json number -q '.[0].number // empty')
          FINDINGS=${{ steps.probe.outputs.findings }}
          if [ "$FINDINGS" != "0" ]; then
            if [ -n "$EXISTING" ]; then
              gh issue comment "$EXISTING" --body-file report.md
              echo "Commented fresh findings on open patrol issue #$EXISTING"
            else
              gh issue create --title "[security-patrol] Findings on $TARGET" --label security --body-file report.md
              echo "Created patrol issue"
            fi
          else
            if [ -n "$EXISTING" ]; then
              gh issue comment "$EXISTING" --body-file report.md
              gh issue close "$EXISTING" --comment "All clear — patrol du $(date -u +%F) : tous les contrôles passent, fermeture automatique."
              echo "All clear, closed #$EXISTING"
            else
              echo "All clear, no open issue"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Fail the run on critical findings (red X in the Actions tab)
        if: steps.probe.outputs.critical != '0'
        run: |
          echo "::error::${{ steps.probe.outputs.critical }} critical security finding(s) — see the [security-patrol] issue."
          exit 1

name: Themes & CSS guard

# Dedicated gate for anything visual: every stylesheet must stay structurally
# sound (balanced braces/parens, valid hex colors), dark-force.css must remain
# the LAST imported stylesheet (it wins the cascade by design), and pull
# requests may not introduce NEW white backgrounds inside dark-theme blocks.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**/*.css'
      - 'src/main.tsx'
      - 'scripts/css-check.mjs'
      - '.github/workflows/themes-css-guard.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**/*.css'
      - 'src/main.tsx'
      - 'scripts/css-check.mjs'
      - '.github/workflows/themes-css-guard.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: themes-css-guard-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
